In Gdańsk Południe, the race will be held on May 10, 2026, starting at 13:00 near the finish area at Parkrun Gdańsk-Poludnie. The route is a loop approximately 3 km long on a paved surface, with a minimal incline on the connector. All proceeds from the entry fees support spinal cord research.

The race begins at 13:00, with participants registering and tracking progress via the app. The event is open to runners and wheelchair users.

location: Stadion Miejski w Olecku, Olecko, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland

tiers.label: tier_2

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: dla wszystkich uczestników biegu głównego stała kwota w wysokości 70 zł

description: The XIII Olecka Thirteenth is an annual race held at the Municipal Stadium in Olecko. The event includes the main race and Nordic walking, attracting both runners and outdoor activity enthusiasts. The event is open and participant-friendly, with clearly defined start fees and professional organization. The start is scheduled for 8:30 AM, and the event runs until 2:20 PM.
course_highlights: Race around Lake Oleckie Wielkie
Flat and gravel route
Additional children's and youth races, Nordic walking march
additional: Start fees must be confirmed by transfer to oleckobiega@wp.pl. The event is organized by VALDANO, with Willa na Kozińcu as a partner. The event takes place at the Municipal Stadium in Olecko, with registration available from January to May 2026. Participants can enjoy various competitions and sports attractions, as well as beautiful views and an atmosphere conducive to active recreation.

name: XVII Bieg Piastowski - półmaraton z Kruszwicy

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Opłata startowa od 1 stycznia do 31 marca 2026

description: The 17th Piastowski Run is a traditional half marathon held in Inowrocław, attracting runners from across the region. The half marathon route takes participants through scenic areas of the city, offering both a sporting challenge and the opportunity to admire local attractions. The event is part of the Piastowski Running Festival, which also includes other distances, creating a running tradition and community atmosphere.
course_highlights: The half marathon route runs through charming parts of Inowrocław
Varied terrain - asphalt and city paths
Views of characteristic city and surrounding landmarks
additional: Race office, regulations, and detailed route available on the website. The half marathon route is marked and secured, and participants receive start packages. The event is held as part of the Piastowski Running Festival, which also includes 5 km and 10 km races. Registration options are available for the half marathon, 5 km, and 10 km, along with information about the route and event partners.

name: XXVIII Oleskie Uliczne Biegi Pokoju
description: The 28th Olesno Street Peace Runs is an annual running event organized by the Olesno Municipality, attracting runners from various categories. The race takes place on the streets of Olesno, offering participants professional timing measurement provided by Pomiar Czasu Atelier Sportu. The race start is scheduled for 4:50 PM, and online registration is open until May 14, 2026. This sporting event combines a passion for running with local tradition and a competitive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Street run in the center of Olesno
Professional electronic timing measurement with RFID chips
Start at 4:50 PM
additional: Timing measurement is carried out using the most modern electronic system based on RFID chips and start/finish mats. The organizer provides professional timing service and online results available on the website. The race office and number distribution are managed by the organizer. Contact for timing measurement is available from 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM and on race day at the emergency number. Online registration is open until May 14, 2026. Details regarding time and location are available on the organizer's website.

name: Běh města Nýřany

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Děti s bydlištěm mimo okolí Nýřan mají start zpoplatněný částkou 30,00 Kč

description: The Nýřany City Run is a traditional sporting event organized by Atletclub Nýřany, z.s. and the Education, Sports, and Culture Committee. The main race over 10 km, including a team run of 2x 5 km, offers an active experience for the general public. There are also supplementary races for children from Nýřany and the surrounding area, which are free or for a symbolic fee. The event takes place at the ZŠ Nýřany athletics stadium and concludes with a disco with free entry.
course_highlights: Main race over 10 km with a team run of 2x 5 km
Supplementary free children's races for local kids
Event concluded with a disco on the asphalt playground
additional: Registration is possible online and on-site with a higher fee. The disco starts at 18:00 with free entry. Starting numbers for children are issued at school facilities or in the white booth next to the gymnasium. The 10 km race, 2x 5 km team runs, children's races, online registration since 2018, results and photos available.

name: Mácháč Run Fest
location: Máchovo jezero, Liberec region, Czech Republic
organizer: Mácháč brothers crew, Jan Venca Francke
description: Mácháč Run Fest is a hilly cross-country race set amidst the beautiful nature of Lake Mácha in the Liberec Region. It offers courses of 160 km, 60 km, 25 km, 10 km, and 5 km, with 90% of the route through terrain. The race is suitable for nature lovers and those seeking a more challenging trail run. Come enjoy running in a picturesque environment with a challenge for every runner.
course_highlights: Hilly cross-country terrain with 90% natural paths
Courses from 5 km to 160 km ultramarathon
Picturesque nature of Lake Mácha in the Liberec Region
additional: Trail race with multiple distances, taking place in May 2026, unsupported race, single loop course.

name: Lesempolem
description: Lesempolem is a traditional running race held in the picturesque environment of Veselice in the South Moravian Region. It offers three courses - 14 km, marathon (42 km), and ultramarathon (84 km) - mainly along forest and field paths around the Podvrší lookout tower, which guarantees beautiful views and an experience of running in nature. The race is suitable for all runners from amateurs to experienced athletes, and the marathon is part of the Blansko District Running League. The start and finish are at the sports complex in Veselice, where a rich program, refreshments, and a friendly atmosphere are prepared for competitors and spectators.
course_highlights: The course mainly runs along forest and field paths (90%), only 10% on asphalt
Surroundings of the Podvrší lookout tower with beautiful views
Three courses: 14 km, marathon (42 km), and ultramarathon (84 km)
additional: Start and registration are at the cultural house in Veselice, parking approximately 200 meters from the registration. On site, there is abundant refreshments (water, tea, isotonic drinks, fruit, traditional Loštice spread) and the possibility to store your own refreshments. For spectators, there is a cultural program, a beer tent, and children's runs. Accommodation is available in the cultural house for a symbolic fee in personal sleeping bags. The marathon is part of the Blansko District Running League. The races take place around Veselice, in the Moravian Karst, emphasizing a family atmosphere and social experiences.

name: Mattoni 1/2Maraton Karlovy Vary 2026
location: Karlovy Vary, Karlovy Vary District, Czech Republic
description: Mattoni Running Festival Karlovy Vary 2026 is a unique race in the heart of the spa town of Karlovy Vary, offering runners the opportunity to experience the joy of running while discovering the city's UNESCO monuments. The course, certified by World Athletics, runs around iconic hotels Thermal and Pupp and through a unique colonnade. This festival is a traditional gathering of runners with a rich atmosphere and beautiful views of world-famous landmarks.
course_highlights: The course runs around the Thermal and Pupp hotels
Passes through the unique colonnade in Karlovy Vary
Surroundings with UNESCO monuments
additional: Registration is only possible using a registration code. The race takes place on May 16, 2026, with the first wave starting at 14:00. The festival includes various running disciplines including a half marathon and relay half marathon. Registration only via registration code; more race categories including 3x5 km and 6.0975 km; races are held in the beautiful environment of UNESCO monuments and hotels.

name: Zručský májový běh
location: Zruč nad Sázavou, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic

price_tiers.distance: Dětské závody (150 m, 300 m, 600 m, 1100 m)

description: The Zruč May Run is a traditional race held annually in May in the picturesque environment of the castle park and the Sázava River in Zruč nad Sázavou. The race offers courses for all age categories from the youngest children to adults, including the main race of 10 km, which is a fast certified course by ČAS. The event also includes children's races, relays, and a popular 3 km run. The goal of the run is to support the athletic club TJ Jiskra Zruč nad Sázavou and promote sports activities in the region, with the proceeds donated to a good cause in the local area.
course_highlights: The main 10 km race is a fast certified ČAS course running around the castle park and the Sázava River
Four color-coded circuits for children and youth from 150 m to 1100 m in the castle park
The popular 3 km run leads through the castle park, cycle path, and square with the finish at Barončina Stezka
additional: Race numbers can be picked up on Friday from 17:00 for the Friday Popular Run and on Saturday from 8:30 for all categories. On-site registration is only possible on Saturday from 8:30 and closes 30 minutes before each race start. Each registered participant in the main race over 35 years automatically participates in the MČR Masters 2026. The course is marked with colorful wooden directional signs at turns. Results and records of the main race are financially rewarded. The races take place in the castle park and surroundings, with on-site and online registration, various race lengths including children's and relay races, and a certified 10 km course.

name: NN Night Run Brno
location: Hněvkovského sportovně-rekreační areál, Brno, Czech Republic

price_tiers.distance: BELLIS RUN proti rakovině prsu - 5 km

description: NN Night Run Brno is the largest running event in Brno, held at the Hněvkovského sports and recreation area. Each year, more than 2000 runners of all ages participate, from beginners to experienced competitors. The event offers not only the main 10 km race but also children's races and shorter runs, all in a friendly and lively atmosphere. The program includes accompanying activities, performances, and a rich supporting program for all participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Sports and recreation area Hněvkovského in Brno
Main race of 10 km with a 90-minute limit
Children's races and runs of 3 km and 5 km with a charitable aspect
additional: The program includes KIDS CUP children's races, FÉNIX RUN 3 km and BELLIS RUN 5 km with a charitable aspect, a 2x5 km relay, accompanying performances and warm-up sessions with Honza Kaňůrek (NUTREND). There is a baggage storage and changing rooms, testing of MIZUNO running shoes, airbrush tattoos, a photo booth, a raffle, and other supporting activities. Registration is available online and on-site. The entry fee can be discounted by 50% for NN clients, and athletes receive a discount on life insurance through the Fit Sport program. The terrain includes an urban park and recreational area; the event features various race categories and supporting activities.

name: Dobřichovický kros půlmaraton a 10 km
location: Nádvoří zámku Dobřichovice, Dobřichovice, Czech Republic
description: The Dobřichovice Cross Half Marathon and 10 km is a traditional running race organized by Radost v pohybu in the picturesque courtyard of Dobřichovice Castle. The race offers three variants: a free children's race of 1 km, a 10 km race suitable for beginners and advanced runners with a mostly flat course, and a half marathon for more experienced runners with a challenging second half full of hills. There are refreshment stations along the route, and participants receive a commemorative medal after the race. The atmosphere is friendly and suitable for all age groups.
course_highlights: Half marathon with an initial flat section and a second half full of hills
10 km race mostly flat with one refreshment station
Three refreshment stations on the half marathon (5, 10, and 15 km) with water, isotonic drinks, and fruit
additional: Athletes registered by 1.5.2026 are entitled to a commemorative medal, which is distributed after the results are announced. All participants meet in the courtyard of Dobřichovice Castle. By registering, you confirm participation at your own risk and agree to the use of visual recordings for promotional purposes. The race includes a half marathon and a 10 km race, starting in the courtyard of Dobřichovice Castle, and features a children's race.

name: Rakovnická 100
description: Rakovnická 100 is a traditional ultralong walk and run in the beautiful landscape of Křivoklátsko, offering a challenging but manageable route approximately 107 kilometers long with 2400 meters of elevation gain. The event is known for its excellent organization and pleasant atmosphere, making it ideal for testing physical capabilities. It starts from Husovo Square in Rakovník, and participants can expect a combination of running and walking with various natural obstacles, including fords and wet sections. Rakovnická 100 is suitable for experienced athletes seeking a challenge in a less extreme but still demanding terrain.
course_highlights: Route approximately 107 km long with 2400 m elevation gain
Beautiful nature of Křivoklátsko with rivers, streams, and fords
Well-organized refreshment stations and support along the route
additional: Start at 4 a.m. from Husovo Square in Rakovník. The route is a combination of running and walking, suitable for testing physical condition after the winter season. The event is known for its pleasant atmosphere and quality organization. In the past, the route has been slightly adjusted but still offers a challenge with the possibility of fords and wet sections. The race takes place in May, with the finish at Penzion Šéba, and is part of regional ultramarathons. The route is suitable for experienced runners seeking a challenge in a natural environment.

name: Charitativní Běh Na Špince
location: Tábořiště Špinka, Červený Kostelec, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Charity Run at Špinka is a sporting event with the motto #KdyžMůžuPomůžu, which combines the joy of movement with helping those in need. The proceeds from the event go to support the NONA 92 Day Care Center in Nové Město nad Metují, which helps people with mental disabilities integrate into society. The race is open to everyone - professional runners, beginners, moms with strollers, and children. The race atmosphere is unique, and 100% of the entry fee goes to charity, with operational costs covered by sponsors.
course_highlights: Routes for all age groups from 100 m for the youngest to 10 km for adults
Children's race starts at 10:00 and 10:15, main routes of 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km start at 10:30 and 11:00
Charity run supporting NONA 92 Day Care Center, which offers meaningful daily activities and preparation for independent living
additional: Registration is possible online via SportChallenge.cz or on-site from 9:00 until 30 minutes before the start. The race is part of the Primátor CUP series. Teams can register (minimum 3 members), with the final time averaged. The program includes children's races, main races of 2, 5, and 10 km, a quiz, and a raffle for a scooter. All entry fees go to charity, with operational costs covered by sponsors. The charity run supports NONA 92 Day Care Center, is open to all age groups, with 100% of the entry fee donated to charity.

name: Májový běh Slapy
location: Sigma Slapy, Slapy, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné je dobrovolné formou příspěvku v libovolné výši na jednu ze sbírek Blíž domovu

description: The May Run Slapy is a traditional running race organized by the Slapský Cultural Association, held in the picturesque environment of the Slapské forests and hills. The race offers routes for children and adults, emphasizing beautiful nature, forest paths, and interesting elevation changes. The start and facilities are located at the Sigma Slapy area, where participants can change clothes and store belongings. The race is suitable for all age groups and offers a friendly atmosphere with awards for the best and all children.
course_highlights: Forest paths and terrain with minimal elevation change for children
Manageable but hilly profile with an elevation of 225 m for adults
Beautiful view of the dam lake from the middle of the adult race
additional: Children start independently at 9:30, adults start at 10:00 after children finish. Registration is from 9:00 to 9:20 for children and until 9:45 for adults. There is an option to change clothes and store belongings without valuables at the start area. The route is well marked with white arrows on the ground. Children can be accompanied by parents. Children up to 9 years run 1.4 km, older children 2.8 km, adults 7.5 km. Children up to 18 years can run the adult route with parental consent. Start times: children at 9:30, adults at 10:00; race distances: 1.4 km for children up to 9 years, 2.8 km for children 10-18 years, 7.5 km for adults; the race takes place on forest trails with elevation changes.

name: Městecká desítka
location: Náměstí Republiky, Městec Králové, Czech Republic
description: Městec Králové Ten is a traditional running race in Městec Králové, offering courses of 10 km, 5 km, and a children's race of 1 km, including a run for the youngest. The course mainly runs on asphalt roads with slight elevation changes, and the start and finish are at Náměstí Republiky. The race is known for its records and great atmosphere, with participants able to use refreshment stations on the course and at the finish. After the race, runners receive an SMS with their finishing time, and winners receive trophies and material prizes. Organizers emphasize fair play and the safety of all participants.
course_highlights: Course without significant elevation
Surface: 80% asphalt, 20% paving and paths
Start and finish at Náměstí Republiky, Městec Králové
additional: Refreshment stations on the course and at the finish. SMS with the finishing time after the race. On-site registration will not be available. Functional T-shirt NO.6 available for purchase at 490 CZK. The children's run is not timed and is free; registration takes place on race day from 8:30 to 9:20. Children can run with an escort; the use of tricycles and scooters is prohibited. The race includes refreshments on the course and at the finish. Registration is only possible online, and results are available via SMS and online. The course runs over asphalt, paving, and sandy areas; start and finish are at Náměstí Republiky.

name: 7 pohoří Orlické hory
location: Deštné v Orlických horách, Orlické hory, Czech Republic
description: The 7 Mountains of the Orlické Hory are part of the largest trail running series in the Czech Republic, which takes you through seven of the most beautiful and challenging mountain ranges. The race in the Orlické Hory offers technical trails with epic views and an atmosphere you won't experience anywhere else. The route passes through viewpoints, Šerlich, the border with Poland, and the highest peak of the Orlické Hory, Velká Deštná. Prepare for a challenge with an elevation gain of 920 meters and a length of 24 km, which will test your strength and determination.
course_highlights: The route passes through viewpoints and Šerlich
Across the border with Poland to Masarykova Chata
Climb to the highest peak of the Orlické Hory, Velká Deštná (1,115 m)

name: LHUT – Lysohorský Skyrace a Ultratrail, MČR Skyrace a Ultra Sky 2026
location: SKI Malenovice, Lysá hora, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné pro Ultra Trail je 1 690 Kč od 6. 2. 2026 do 6. 3. 2026

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Startovné pro Ultra Trail je 1 790 Kč od 7. 3. 2026 do 8. 5. 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné pro Skyrace je 990 Kč od 6. 2. 2026 do 6. 3. 2026

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Startovné pro Skyrace je 1090 Kč od 7. 3. 2026 do 8. 5. 2026

tiers.label: tier_1

tiers.label: tier_2

description: Lysohorský Ultra Trail is a mountain running race in the Lysá hora massif, offering three race routes: Ultra Trail (67 km, +4100 m), Skyrace (31 km, +2100 m), and Supersky (16 km, +875 m). The routes run along marked hiking trails with stunning views of Lysá hora from all sides. The race is organized with the support of Lysá hora hunters, LČR, and CHKO, emphasizing the athlete's ethical code and nature protection. The start and finish are at the KAM hotel complex in Malenovice, where refreshments, recovery zones, and other services for competitors are provided. After the race, there is a ceremonial announcement and afterparty.
course_highlights: Routes run along marked hiking trails in the Lysá hora massif
Challenging elevation gain up to 4100 m on the Ultra Trail route
Refreshment stations at the top of Lysá hora and at the start/finish area
additional: Registration for competitors will take place on Friday, May 15, 2026, from 16:00 to 20:00 at the KAM hotel complex in Malenovice. Participants will receive a start package with a chip, bib number, and gifts from partners. The refreshment station offers abundant refreshments, and showers and a recovery zone are available after the race. Accommodation in Hannah tents is available with reservation via roman.tulinsky@rockpoint.cz. Changes of participant are possible for a fee of 200 CZK; route changes are not allowed. The bib number must be visibly worn on clothing. Support is only permitted on Lysá hora within 100 meters of the refreshment station. The race takes place on May 16, 2026, at SKI Malenovice, with different start times depending on the route length, and is supported by local hunters, LČR, and CHKO.

name: Energon běh – Penzion Nový rybník
location: Penzion Nový Rybník, Obořiště, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Energon Run at the Nový Rybník guesthouse in Obořiště is part of the Brdský Running Cup and offers races for adults, juniors, and children. The main adult race and relay are run on four loops with a combination of asphalt and trail surfaces. Children's routes lead along a field path to Rosovice and back, with the length adjusted to age. The event is family-friendly and open to runners of all ages, with a traditional start at 12:00 at the Nový Rybník guesthouse.
course_highlights: The course combines asphalt, field, and forest paths
The main race consists of 4 loops with asphalt and trail surfaces
Children's routes lead along a field path to Rosovice and back, with length according to age
additional: Children's races are free of charge. Registration is possible until May 15, 2026, at 22:00, or on the day of the race on-site. The main race can also be run as a four-member relay. The track surface is a combination of asphalt and trail. Organizers offer neoprene chip bands for 100 CZK for purchase. The event includes various age categories, options for pre-registration and on-site registration, and sports accompanying activities including children's races.

name: Hostivice RUN

price_tiers.distance: dospělé závody (5 km, 10 km, 21 km, CROSS)

description: Hostivice RUN is a traditional running race held in the picturesque environment of the Hostivice ponds. In 2026, the thirteenth edition will take place, offering four main courses: 5 km, 10 km, 21 km, and a 4 km cross-country terrain run, complemented by children's races. The race is suitable for all runners who want to experience the joy of sport and challenge themselves in a pleasant atmosphere. Participants will also receive an original metal medal as a symbol of success and determination.
course_highlights: Routes lead around the system of Hostivice ponds with natural scenery
The half marathon consists of two laps of the green course
The cross-country run CROSS offers a more challenging surface and natural obstacles
additional: Children's races start at 9:00, main adult races from 11:00 (10 km and half marathon), cross at 11:10, and 5 km at 11:20. Hostivice RUN T-shirts can be ordered until April 1, 2026, as part of online registration, with a limited number available on-site later. Registration is possible online, in person at the Hostivice Municipal Library, and on race day at the start area. The parent ultramarathon and some children's categories are already at capacity. Multiple race distances, children's races, registration opens December 1, 2025, event held in Hostivice, Czech Republic.

name: Hradubický běh (start Pardubice)
description: Hradubický běh (start Pardubice) is a friendly running race between the cities of Hradec Králové and Pardubice, with the goal in Čeperka, 10 km from each city. The course combines asphalt sections with natural parts, with the Pardubice side offering more nature and the Hradec side more asphalt. The race takes place in all weather conditions and is popular among runners from both cities. More information and registration are available on the race website www.ph7.cz.
course_highlights: 10 km course from Pardubice to Čeperka
Combination of asphalt and natural sections
More nature on the Pardubice side, more asphalt on the Hradec side
additional: The race is run in all weather conditions. More information and registration are available at www.ph7.cz. Reports and photo galleries from previous editions are available. 10 km course, asphalt and nature, in all weather conditions.

name: Hradubický běh (start Hradec Králové)
location: Lipky – zastávka MHD „Lipky“, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Hradubický Run is a friendly running race between the cities of Hradec Králové and Pardubice, taking place on May 16, 2026. The race has two starts, each in its own city, and a shared finish line at the halfway point. The course is 10 kilometers long from each side, partially paved and partially through nature, and is run in all weather conditions. A new feature is the children's races, which are free for children of registered main race participants. The race is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere and refreshments at the finish line.
course_highlights: Course 10 km from each side, precisely measured with a Jones counter
Part of the course runs on asphalt, part through nature with a predominance of natural scenery on the Pardubice side
The route is marked with orange spray or flags
additional: Children's races are free for children of registered main race participants. On-site registration is possible with card payment or QR code. Luggage storage is provided at the finish line, with luggage transportation from both starts by car. Refreshments at the finish include water, isotonic drinks, fruit, sweet pastries, and salt; there is a refreshment station with water at the 5 km mark. Starts are in Hradec Králové (Lipky, MHD stop) and Pardubice (Poděbradská Street).

name: Pivoňův běh
location: Louka Na Křižatkách, Písecké hory, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Pivoňův běh is a traditional running race in the Písecké hory mountains, held on the Na Křižatkách meadow near the White House. It offers routes for beginners and experienced runners in lengths of 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon, as well as children's races and a charity walk. The race is known for its friendly atmosphere, beautiful nature, and the opportunity to support charitable projects. The starting field passes through picturesque ponds, a game reserve with mouflons and fallow deer, and forest paths with diverse surfaces. After the race, participants can enjoy a relaxed environment and original Pivoňovo clothing.
course_highlights: Routes pass around ponds with wooden bridges and dams
Running through a game reserve with mouflons and fallow deer in Písecké hory nature park
Forest paths with varied surfaces and an elevation gain of up to 465 meters
additional: Children's races have different lengths depending on the age of the children with separate starts. The charity walk with Toyota Dolák donates half of the entry fee to charitable projects. Race numbers and clothing can be picked up on the race day. The routes have time limits: 5 km - 1 hour, 10 km - 2 hours, half marathon - 3.5 hours. The terrain is a combination of forest, paved, and asphalt paths with an elevation gain of up to 465 meters. Registration is possible via bank transfer, the event offers refreshments, an accompanying program, and the option to purchase T-shirts. The routes are suitable for runners of all levels.

name: ČEZ RunTour Kopřivnice
location: Tatra Kopřivnice, Tatra Trucks, Kopřivnice, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: CEZ RunTour Kopřivnice is part of a popular running series that offers races for all age groups and performance levels. The program includes courses from children's runs, family and hobby runs, to more demanding half marathons. The race takes place at the Tatra Trucks premises and offers a family atmosphere, quality facilities, and an accompanying program for the whole family. Each participant receives a starter pack and contributes to charity. A guiding team and medical services ensure a safe and enjoyable race experience.
course_highlights: Courses of 3, 5, 10, and 21.1 km at the Tatra Trucks premises
Children's runs of 500 and 1000 meters with a kids' corner
Refreshment stations on courses of 5 km and more, at least twice during the half marathon
additional: Each runner receives an official gymsack with gifts from partners. A starter pack from Lidl is prepared for children. Guides with flags are available on the track to help maintain pace. Emergency services are accessible via a dedicated phone line during the race. Refreshments are available at the finish for shorter runs, and refreshment stations are set up along longer courses. Multiple race distances, family activities, charity support, participant medals, photos, and comprehensive race services.

name: SKYRUN – DLOUHÉ STRÁNĚ
location: Kouty nad Desnou, Olomoucký kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné je stanoveno na 900,- Kč / závod

description: SKYRUN - DLOUHÉ STRÁNĚ is a challenging individual race of 22 km with an elevation gain of 820 meters, leading from Kouty nad Desnou to the crown of the upper reservoir of the Dlouhé Stráně pumped-storage hydroelectric plant and back. The route combines unpaved paths, roads, and trails, offering participants unique views of Jeseníky and the technical works of the power plant. The race is scheduled at the turn of the winter and summer seasons, which brings a specific atmosphere and challenges, including possible snow on the track. The Kouty nad Desnou area provides complete facilities with restaurants, accommodation, and parking directly at the start and finish.
course_highlights: 22 km route with an elevation gain of 820 m
Passage over the crown of the upper reservoir of the Dlouhé Stráně pumped-storage hydroelectric plant at an altitude of 1354 m above sea level
Combination of unpaved roads, roads, and trails with views of Jeseníky

description: The Sídliště Run is a traditional running race organized by the Ski Club Police nad Metují. The race takes place in Police nad Metují and offers an opportunity for runners of all ages. The course runs through the city housing estate and is suitable for the general public as well as experienced athletes. Organizers emphasize a friendly atmosphere and a sporting experience.
course_highlights: The course runs through the city housing estate in Police nad Metují
Suitable for all age groups
Friendly atmosphere and sporting experience
additional: The race is part of the local running series, with exact course lengths of 3 km for men and 1.2 km for women.

name: Jarov-Károv
description: Jarov-Károv race is a uphill run 2.99 km long with an elevation gain of 150 meters, which is part of the Hill Runs series in Prague and the surrounding area. This race offers a challenge for runners who want to test their strength and endurance on a demanding ascent. The course runs through scenic terrain in the Prague locality of Jarov and is suitable for everyone who enjoys uphill running and wants to experience the atmosphere of the series. The race is ideal for athletes seeking a short but intense running experience.
course_highlights: Distance of the course 2.99 km
Elevation gain 150 m
Uphill run in the Prague locality of Jarov
additional: The race is part of the mountain running series in Prague, participants can look forward to a sporting challenge in a natural environment and the opportunity to view results online.

description: Brdská 25 is a traditional endurance running race through the central Bohemian Forest (Brdy), designed for the general sports public. The race offers a challenging 25 km course with an elevation gain of over 400 meters, with start and finish located at the SK Litavan Bohutín football field, which provides facilities including changing rooms and refreshments. The program also includes accompanying races such as Nordic Walking Brdy, Cruiser Race Brdy, and children's races. The race is part of the Brdský běžecký pohár (Brdy Running Cup) and offers beautiful running weather and a superb course with safe guidance away from traffic.
course_highlights: 25 km course with an elevation gain of over 400 meters
Start and finish at the SK Litavan Bohutín football field with full facilities
Course runs on the Tok trail, more trail-like, safe away from traffic
additional: Start and finish of the race are at the SK Litavan Bohutín football field, which provides changing rooms and refreshments. Registration begins at 8:00 for children's races, the main race starts at 11:00, the 12 km race, Nordic Walking, and Cruiser Race start at 11:05. The entry fee includes refreshments on the course and after the race (water, isotonic drink, cola, banana, salt). Student categories and children start free of charge. The race takes place on May 17, 2026, in Láz u Příbrami, offering various course lengths including 25 km and 12 km. Registration is possible on-site, and the event includes medals, refreshments, and a social program.

name: Běh na Kašperk
location: Kašperské Hory, South Bohemia, Czech Republic
description: The Kašperk Run is a traditional and prestigious race as part of the Ešus League series, held in Kašperské Hory. The race, 3.2 km long, starts from the town square at an altitude of 750 meters above sea level and runs on flat terrain as well as challenging ascents to Kašperk Castle, where the finish line is located. The route offers beautiful views of the surrounding mountains and the atmosphere of the castle, making the race a unique experience for runners of all levels. After the race, participants can enjoy the atmosphere of the castle and a jog back to the town.
course_highlights: Start at the town square at an altitude of 750 m above sea level
Flat section along the green trail with views of Křemelná Mountain and surrounding peaks
Final 1.7 km ascent with a 200 m elevation gain to Kašperk Castle
additional: Registration takes place from 9:15 to 9:45 in front of the cinema building in Kašperské Hory. The start and finish may slightly shift, so no record times are set for the course. The event is organized by the town of Kašperské Hory, with contact person Mrs. Renata Hartmanová (tel. 777 848 756). The races include the Ždánov Run (13th edition) and the Kašperk Run (12th edition), a challenging climb to Kašperk (2.9 km), with results and complete information available online.

name: Běh pro kočku
location: Lázně Toušeň, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Cat Run is a charity running event held in Lázně Toušeň, which raises awareness about homeless cats and supports a selected cat shelter. The race offers a main run of 8 km along the Elbe River between the Toušeňský and Čelákovický bridges, and a accompanying 4 km route suitable for running and walking. The event is suitable for all age groups and, in addition to the run, offers accompanying activities for children and the opportunity to purchase items with cat motifs, with proceeds going to support the shelter. Start and registration take place at the football field area in Lázně Toušeň.
course_highlights: Main 8 km run between the Toušeňský and Čelákovický bridges along the cycle path by the Elbe River
Accompanying 4 km route around Lake Malvíny suitable for running and walking
Start and finish at the football field area in Lázně Toušeň
additional: Registration is also possible on the day of the race at the venue. The entry fee and proceeds from the sale of items with cat motifs are donated to the cat shelter. The accompanying program includes activities for children and adults, the possibility to sit in a restaurant with a summer terrace and a children's playground. There is also a shorter run or walk of 4 km around Lake Malvíny. Participants agree to the race rules and participate at their own risk. A charity run with proceeds supporting cat shelters and veterinary care, suitable for all age groups, including families with children.

name: X RUN během pro dobrou věc
location: Park Na Solidaritě, Praha 10, Praha, Czech Republic
description: X RUN is a charity running event organized by the Prague 10 Municipal District, taking place on Sunday, May 17, 2026, in Na Solidarity Park and its surroundings. The event is open to all runners who want to support a good cause and enjoy a sports day in a pleasant environment. The run takes place in a beautiful city park with the possibility for the whole family and friends to participate. The start and finish are located directly in the park, ensuring convenient access and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Run in Na Solidarity Park and the surrounding area
Urban environment with natural elements
Charity event supporting a good cause
additional: The event runs from 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM in Na Solidarity Park and its surroundings. Registration is possible via an online form on the municipal district's website. Currently, registration is only open to administrators, which may mean that public registration will be available later. Registration is conducted online, the event is sports and charity-oriented, held in Na Solidarity Park, suitable for children and dogs.

name: Hanácká kojetínská desítka
location: Kojetín, u fotbalového stadionu Morava, Kojetín, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Hanácká Kojetínská desítka is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, held in Kojetín near the Morava football stadium. The race is part of a series of running events in Central Moravia and offers an opportunity for both fitness and competitive runners. The Liga stovkařů club specializes in promoting endurance running and supports runners of all levels. The race is suitable for the general public and is part of the Great Prize of Endurance Runners of the Olomouc Region.
course_highlights: The course runs through nature, floodplain forests, and along the Morava River
Surface includes asphalt, gravel, and natural paths
The race takes place in the picturesque environment of Kojetín near Olomouc
additional: The race will take place on May 17, 2026, with the start scheduled at 11:00 at the Morava football stadium in Kojetín.

name: Brdská 12
location: Bohutín, Příbram District, South Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: Brdská 12 is a traditional running race held in Bohutín, offering a course approximately 12 km long. The race takes place on a loop run counterclockwise, passing through forest paths and asphalt roads. The start is at the SK Litavan Bohutín football pitch, and the main race begins at 11:05. The event also includes free children's races, making it attractive to the general public and families with children.
course_highlights: Loop runs counterclockwise
Surface includes forest paths and asphalt
Start and finish at SK Litavan Bohutín football pitch
additional: Children's races are free. The course is GPS-measured at 12.09 km. Results have been available in the system since 2014. The loop is forested with asphalt sections. Trail race on forest and asphalt roads, with pre-registration and on-site registration options, start at 11:05, children's races are part of the event.

name: Běh alejí
description: The Alley Run is a traditional running race in Králíky, held in a picturesque setting along an avenue leading to the monastery on Mount Mother of God. The race is part of the ISCAREX cup and offers a hill run with a course length of about 1.25 km. The event is suitable for the general public, including youth, and is organized in a friendly atmosphere. Registration and check-in take place in the center of Králíky, with on-site registration available. The race is known for its pleasant environment and scenic views around.
course_highlights: Hill run along the avenue from Králíky to the monastery on Mount Mother of God
Course length approx. 1.25 km with an elevation gain of around 168 m
Picturesque environment and natural scenery in the Pardubice Region
additional: Check-in and registration take place at the parking lot behind house number 316 (Sadová Street, Králíky) from 8:30 to 9:30 AM. The start is at the entrance gate by the avenue to the monastery. The race is part of the ISCAREX cup and offers categories for various age groups, including children. In the past, the start fee was free; current information about the registration fee has not been published. The race is part of the ISCAREX 2026 cup, offering various categories and a technical course in a mountain environment.

name: FUN&RUN 2026
description: Fun&Run 2026 is a charity run organized by Prague Pride, taking place on May 17, 2026, in Prague's Stromovka Park. This 15th edition of the run focuses on fighting homophobia, bifobia, intersexphobia, transphobia, and the stigmatization of people living with HIV. The event offers running courses of 5 km and 10 km and an accompanying program full of fun and activities for all participants. The proceeds support activities promoting the LGBTQ+ community and people living with HIV in the Czech Republic.
course_highlights: Run on 5 km and 10 km courses in Stromovka Park
Charity run against homophobia and HIV stigmatization
Accompanying program with warm-up, yoga, and musical performances
additional: The event begins at 12:00 with park opening and registration, at 13:00 there is a warm-up with John Reed Fitness. After the race, participants can join free Queer Sensitive Yoga and other accompanying activities. Restrooms, showers, changing rooms, food and drink stalls are available in the area. Registration for the high heels run must be completed in advance. Terrain: Stromovka Park; registration: online and on-site; the event includes 5 km and 10 km runs, a high heels race, family programs, fitness warm-up, and themed runs.

name: Jarov - Károv
location: Jarov u Prahy, Praha, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Jarov-Károv is a hill race covering 2.99 km with an elevation gain of 150 meters, which is part of the Hill Running series in Prague and its surroundings. This race offers runners a challenge in the form of a demanding ascent and is ideal for mountain running enthusiasts and those who enjoy short, fast courses. The race takes place in the picturesque environment of Jarov near Prague and attracts runners who want to test their strength and endurance in hilly terrain. Come and enjoy the atmosphere and competitiveness of this traditional race.
course_highlights: Distance of the course 2.99 km
Elevation gain of 150 m
Uphill race in the natural environment of Jarov near Prague
additional: The race is regularly part of the hill running series, with high participation and a challenging course with elevation gain in natural terrain.

name: Peřimovská desítka
description: The Peřimov Ten is a traditional road race held in the village of Peřimov in the Hradec Králové Region, offering a course of 10 km and 6 km. The race is suitable for runners of all levels and runs on local roads with minimal elevation gain, in traffic. The event is organized by SDH Peřimov and is part of the local sports calendar, attracting participants from the surrounding area and beyond.
course_highlights: The course runs on local roads with minimal elevation gain
Both courses are looped and suitable for runners of all levels
The race takes place in traffic, adding to the atmosphere
additional: The course runs on local roads, looped, in traffic, with minimal elevation gain

description: The Vertikál Martinky is the fourth edition of a challenging uphill run that is part of the Slovak Skyrunning League. Participants have the opportunity to earn ITRA Score points and compete against the best on an extreme route with an elevation gain of 944 meters. The event offers a challenge for both professionals and hobby runners in the beautiful environment of Martinských holí. There are also children's categories with shorter routes and parental accompaniment. Organizers provide transportation of personal belongings to the finish line, refreshments, and free parking.
course_highlights: Extreme uphill run route with an elevation gain of 944 meters
Start and finish at the Martinské holí ski resort
Children's categories with elevation gains of 76 m and 186 m
additional: Registration on the day of the race from 8:30 to 9:30 at Hrdinov SNP Martin - Stráne, FATRA SKI rental, and from 10:15 to 10:45 at the Nová Ponorka restaurant. Free parking is available above the registration area for adults and at Martinské holí for children. The registration fee includes transportation of personal belongings to the finish, a drink, and food at the restaurant. Children can start at 11:00, and parents can accompany them free of charge. Participants run at their own risk, and minors under 18 require written consent from a legal guardian. The course consists of 20% asphalt and 80% forest trail. Registration is possible online and on-site. Personal belongings transportation is provided. The event starts at 10:00 and ends around 14:00. Free parking is available.

name: Beh vďaky – Továrne – memoriál Františka Chmeľa
description: Run of Thanks - Továrne - František Chmeľ Memorial is a running event organized by the municipality of Továrne in the Vranov nad Topľou district. The race takes place in front of the Municipal Office building in Továrne and is open to a wide range of runners by age and gender. The event has a traditional character and offers the opportunity to compete in various age categories for men and women. Organizers provide complete information and support for participants.
course_highlights: Available categories for different age groups and genders
Two distances: 5 km and 10 km
Held in the scenic environment of Továrne
additional: The race is organized by the municipality of Továrne, with the contact person being Mayor Kvetoslava Mižáková. Payment information for the start fee is sent via email after registration or can be checked through the payment status in the list of registered participants. Categories are divided by age and gender, and the race takes place in front of the Municipal Office building in Továrne. Registration is possible online or on-site. The event is dedicated to the memory of František Chmeľ and is open to the general public.

name: Orungutan Run
description: The ORungutan charity run at Bratislava Zoo is a traditional sporting event that brings together runners of all ages to support primate conservation. Participants have the opportunity to run through the zoo grounds, including areas normally closed to the public. The proceeds from the entry fees are dedicated to improving conditions in the Primate Pavilion, where Sumatran orangutans and other species, including new zoo residents, live. The event is suitable for families, companies, and individuals who want to enjoy sports while contributing to a good cause.
course_highlights: The run takes place within Bratislava Zoo grounds with access to normally restricted areas
Courses are designed for children and adults with various disciplines
Support for the revitalization and improvement of primate living conditions, including Sumatran orangutans
additional: The event is a charity with a limit of 800 participants. Runners can participate in teams or individually. The proceeds are used for the reconstruction and enhancement of the primate pavilion, including biopark flooring installation, new climbing structures, and greenery. The race is scheduled for Sunday, May 17, 2026, starting at 10:00 AM. Companies have the option to participate as a team or offer participation to employees and their families. Results are available at vysledkovyservis.sk/orungutan. The course likely runs through the Bratislava Zoo grounds; registration is available online; proceeds go towards improving conditions for primates.

description: Zabudišová Running Race is a running event held in the village of Zabudišová, Nové Mesto nad Váhom district, offering a 5400-meter course with beautiful views and an elevation gain of 133 meters. The surface of the course is a combination of asphalt, gravel, and grassy paths. The event also includes fun children's races for various age groups. After the race, participants can enjoy game meat goulash, a raffle, medals, and prizes for the winners. Runners participate at their own risk, and registration is available online with a participant limit, with children running for free.
course_highlights: 5400 m course with 133 m elevation gain (2 hills)
Surface: 25% asphalt, 75% gravel or grassy path
Beautiful views during the run
additional: Registration for participants is from 9:00 to 10:30, children's races start at 10:30, main start at 11:00, and awards at 12:15. At the finish line, there will be game meat goulash, a raffle, medals, and prizes for the winners. No changing rooms or showers are available, but there are two toilets (flush and latrine). Parking is limited directly at the start; after capacity is reached, parking is available at a football field 200 meters from the start. Timing is provided by SunBell s.r.o. - VysledkovyServis.sk. A start number is mandatory and must be visible on the chest. The course is mainly natural with hilly terrain, suitable for all age groups. Registration is limited to 100 participants. The race will take place on May 17, 2026.

name: Behá celá rodina
location: Športový areál ZŠ Báhoň, Báhoň, Slovakia
description: The Whole Family Running is the 1st edition of a charity run, which will take place on May 17, 2026, at the sports complex of ZŠ Báhoň. The event is intended for all age groups, from the youngest children to adults, with various race distances and accompanying activities for children. The registration fee is voluntary, and all proceeds will be donated to support the kindergarten and elementary school in Báhoň. Come to exercise, have fun, and support a good cause in the pleasant environment of Báhoň.
course_highlights: Race distances for children: 200 m, 400 m, 800 m
Race distances for adults: 2.6 km, 5.2 km, 8.2 km
Nordic walking on 2.6 km
additional: The event includes courses for various age categories including children and adults, as well as Nordic walking. Activities and games for children are prepared throughout the event. The registration fee is voluntary, and all proceeds are dedicated to supporting local schools. Online registration available.

name: Backyard Ultra Jabłonna
location: Jabłonna, Legionowo County, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Backyard Ultra Jabłonna is a unique ultra-format race that originated in the USA. Participants start every hour and must complete a loop of 6.706 km. After finishing the loop, they have rest time until the next full hour, and the competition continues until only one participant remains who completes the last loop within the time limit. It is an endurance race where not only speed but also strategy and perseverance matter.
course_highlights: Loop of 6.706 km (4.167 miles)
Start every full hour
Unique format - race lasts until a single winner is determined
additional: No podium - only a throne for the winner. Adult event. The time limit to complete each loop is 1 hour. Regulations and map available for download on the website. The event features the Backyard Ultra format, with participant limits and online registration. The series also includes winter editions and special editions with prizes such as the Silver Ticket to the World Championships.

name: Cytadela by Night # 115 - Wartostrada
location: Cytadela, Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Cytadela by Night is a series of free timed runs organized in Poznań on distances of 5 km and 10 km. The races take place in the picturesque surroundings of the Citadel, offering participants a unique nocturnal racing atmosphere. The event attracts runners of various age groups and skill levels, promoting physical activity and local community integration.
course_highlights: The route runs through the Citadel area in Poznań
Distances of 5 km and 10 km with timing measurement
Nighttime race atmosphere
additional: The races are free of charge, organized regularly, with timing measurement. The event is supported by Kiprun Poznań Runners. The event is free, takes place at night, attracts participants from different age groups and skill levels, promoting physical activity and community integration.

The race starts at 6:00 PM, allowing runners to enjoy a pleasant evening run in a natural setting. The race is part of the Hanácký Running Cup 2026, which groups several running events in the region.

Race coefficient of 1.1 ensures quality racing conditions
Evening start at 6:00 PM for a pleasant running experience
additional: The race has a coefficient of 1.1 and attracts runners seeking a quality and challenging cross-country run in a natural environment.

The route passes through picturesque countryside and provides an opportunity to enjoy running in nature with a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Course length 6.65 km
Elevation gain 187 m
Cross-country terrain around Šumperk
additional: Race is part of the Chlapácký běh series; terrain is likely mixed; registration details are not explicitly provided.

name: Běh okolo Červeného kamene

The race takes place in the picturesque environment of Janíkova Sedla in the Moravian-Silesian Region and offers runners the opportunity to test their strength on a circuit with available maps and a GPX route. The race is part of the club's athletic activities and is suitable for the general public who enjoy running in nature. Results and reports from previous editions are regularly published on the club's website.
course_highlights: Circuit in the natural environment of Janíkova Sedla
Available GPX route and segment on Strava
Scenic views and forest terrain

description: The Small Monaco Prize - Janderovská Ten is a traditional running race held in Slatiňany in the Pardubice Region. The race offers runners the opportunity to test their strength on a ten-kilometer course, which is part of the long-standing Small Monaco Prize series. The event is suitable for the general public and runners of all performance levels. Organized by KRB Chrudim, it provides quality organizational support and a pleasant race atmosphere.
course_highlights: Ten-kilometer course around Slatiňany
Traditional running race with a long history
Pleasant environment and quality organizational facilities
additional: The race takes place at the Monaco restaurant in Slatiňany. Exact registration details are not published, but the event is part of the local running calendar.

name: Trail Modřanskou roklí VAŠÍ LIGY 2026
description: Trail Modřanskou roklí 2026 is a running race in Prague offering two routes - 8.5 km and 15 km. The race takes place in the picturesque Modřanská Gorge, where runners can expect technical narrow footpaths, wide trails, and a climb to a rock with panoramic views. The event is held in a friendly atmosphere and is easily accessible by tram. Included in the registration fee are refreshments, a medal, prizes for the best in categories, as well as results service and a photo report.
course_highlights: Narrow technical footpaths and wide trails
Climb to a rock with panoramic views
Jungle between panel buildings within tram reach
additional: Registration from 17:00 at the blue tent near the turnaround at Lipiny reservoir. The registration fee includes an ion drink and light refreshments after the race and along the route, baggage storage available at the organizer's tent. Awards for the best runners in categories 40- and 40+. Cancellation possible up to 24 hours before the start with a refund of the registration fee for future races. Good public transport access, parking at the start, cycling route A21 from Vltava. The race takes place on May 20, 2026. Registration is possible online and on-site. The event includes medals, refreshments, and results service.

name: XIII Bieg 5 Mil
organizer: Gdyński Dywizjon Okrętów Bojowych, Gdyńskie Centrum Sportu, Stowarzyszenie Oficerów Marynarki Wojennej
description: The XIII 5 MILE Run is a race over a distance of 5 nautical miles (9260 meters), organized in Gdynia by the Gdynia Combat Ships Squadron and the Navy Officers' Association in cooperation with the Gdynia Sports Center. The route consists of two loops of 4630 meters each and runs along the quay, with the start and finish located in front of the ORP "Gen. K. Pułaski" ship. The race is open to active professional soldiers, civilian military employees, and civilian competitors after prior verification. The event is held in a friendly atmosphere, promoting physical activity and the sporting spirit.
course_highlights: Distance of 5 nautical miles (9260 m) - two loops of 4630 m
Start and finish in front of the ORP "Gen. K. Pułaski" ship
Seaside route in Gdynia, without PZLA certification
additional: Payments are processed via Przelewy24. Participants must be verified; foreigners can participate after prior arrangement with the organizer. The participant limit is 500 people, online registration, recovery meal, no PZLA certification.

Organizer SABZO offers this race as an opportunity for runners of all levels to test their strength and enjoy a sporting experience in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Held in the natural environment of Prague Hostivař
Opportunity to participate in races of various lengths
Friendly atmosphere and sporting experiences for all levels of runners
additional: The race is scheduled for May 21, 2026; further details about the courses and registration are not explicitly provided.

description: The Holednou Run is a running race held in Brno, Kohoutovice, at the Tatran sports field. The race features a 5.5 km circuit that men and women run together in one category. A separate race for children is prepared with a circuit length determined before the start. The event is part of the Brno Runs series and is suitable for all age groups. After the race, refreshments are provided along with the possibility to store belongings.
course_highlights: A 5.5 km circuit in a pleasant environment of Kohoutovice
Joint start for men and women
Children's race with circuit length determined before the start

The course runs through the city park, registration is on-site, the race is open to all age groups, with start and finish at the Tatran sports field in Kohoutovice.

name: Ultra-Trail® Malopolska
location: Gorce and Beskid mountains, Małopolska, Poland
description: Ultra-Trail® Małopolska is a festival of challenging mountain running held in the Małopolska region, in the Gorce and Beskid Mountains. The event offers a variety of distances from 16 to 240 km, which lead through scenic and demanding mountain trails. Organized by the 4 Alternatives Foundation, it attracts runners who appreciate challenges and the beauty of mountain nature. Ultra-Trail® Małopolska is an excellent opportunity to test your strength on routes of varying difficulty and experience the unique atmosphere of ultra running.
course_highlights: Routes lead through the Gorce and Beskid Mountains
Distances from 16 km to 240 km, including very demanding ultramarathons
Scenic and technical mountain trails
additional: The organizer is the 4 Alternatives Foundation based in Kraków. The event also features other running competitions, including Szczebel CUP and Winter Trail Małopolska. There is a training camp for Ultra-Trail® Małopolska with professional instructors and coordinator Paweł Derlatka. Contact details for the organizer and camp coordinator are available at fundacja@utm.run and by phone. Information about registration, route details, and event updates can be found on the organizer's website. The event also includes a winter edition, Winter Trail Małopolska, scheduled for December 2025.

description: Stonařov Aleje is a traditional running race with a history dating back to 1978, held in the picturesque environment of Stonařov in the Vysočina region. The main race runs along field and forest paths beside a stream and along Zelená Alej to the hunting lodge, featuring a slightly hilly profile and predominantly soft terrain. The race offers routes for various age categories from preschoolers to veterans, emphasizing a family atmosphere and sporting experience for all runners. Each participant receives a commemorative prize and a diploma, category winners receive material prizes and the Traveling Cup of the Stonařov Runner.
course_highlights: Main course 10 km along field and forest paths with 30% asphalt
Route runs along a stream and along Zelená Alej to the hunting lodge
Slightly undulating profile with predominantly soft surface
additional: Start at the football field, categories from 3 years and older, youth run for free, mass starts for categories A, B, C, D, P, each participant receives a diploma and a small package, the top three in categories receive material prizes, a traveling cup for the best man and woman in the main race. Scenic course with historical and natural elements, multiple categories including youth and children, the race is part of the Vysočina Running Cup.

name: Biegi Śnieżnickie
location: Międzygórze, Kłodzko County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Snow Mountain Runs are legendary mountain races held in the picturesque Międzygórze, in the heart of the Śnieżnik Massif. The routes feature demanding ascents and technical descents, leading through beautiful forest paths and gravel roads, as well as to the very summit of Śnieżnik. This event, with a rich tradition dating back to the 1990s, attracts both amateurs and elite runners from across Europe. Participants can choose between the classic alpine race of 9.6 km and the Snow Mountain Half Marathon of approximately 21 km, which encircles the Crown of Śnieżnik.
course_highlights: Alpine race 9.6 km with over 800 m elevation gain on a short distance
Half Marathon 21 km with fast descents, demanding ascents, and singletracks
Scenic routes through forests and ridges of the Śnieżnik Massif with a legendary finish at the summit
additional: The alpine race (9.7 km) starts at 10:30 from the promenade by the Wilczki Waterfall, with the finish at the Śnieżnik summit. The Snow Mountain Half Marathon (21 km) starts at 10:30 from Senatoryjna Street. The race office and participant verification take place at OW Słoneczna, Sanatoryjna 2. After the race, there is a sports festival and prize draw. Time measurement at the finish until 13:00. Mountain routes, races of 9.6 km, half marathon, marathon, scheduled for May 2026, with a history and tradition of mountain running.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia – edycja wiosenna 2026
location: Leśny Ogród Botaniczny Marszewo, Gdynia, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia - spring edition 2026 is a cross-country run organized in the picturesque Marszewo Botanical Forest Garden in Gdynia. The event is part of the Botaniczna Piątka race series, which has been promoting running and the beauty of natural routes in Poland since 2014. The race attracts running enthusiasts who value contact with nature and the aesthetic environment. It is an excellent opportunity to spend active time outdoors amidst greenery and a unique atmosphere.
course_highlights: Cross-country route in the Marszewo Botanical Forest Garden
Picturesque natural surroundings and aesthetic qualities
Spring run as part of the Botaniczna Piątka series
additional: The race takes place from 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM. Organizers are a group of running enthusiasts emphasizing cross-country races and the aesthetics of the location. The event is part of a series of races held in various Polish cities during the spring season. It is aimed at runners of different skill levels, with the option to participate in the 5 km run. The race promotes outdoor activity and popularizes running within the local community.

name: I Górski Pólmaraton Szczytniański
location: Szczytna, Kłodzko County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Górski Półmaraton Szczytniański is a unique running event held in the picturesque Szczytna, featuring a 21.1 km route with numerous mountain ascents. The race offers beautiful views of the charming town of the Kłodzko Land and a contact with nature, providing unforgettable experiences for every participant. The event also includes a 10 km Nordic Walking march, which is an excellent option for those who value active recreation without time pressure. The Szczytna Biega Association, organizer of the event, promotes a healthy lifestyle and integrates the local running community.
course_highlights: Route of the half marathon 21.1 km with many mountain ascents
Picturesque views and contact with nature in the charming Kłodzko Land region
Nordic Walking 10 km without time measurement, with prizes and a shared finish line with runners
additional: 10% discount for teams of 5 or more people. Nordic Walking without time measurement, prizes at the finish line, shared finish line with half marathon participants. The Nordic Walking route leads through the most beautiful corners of the Kłodzko Land with forest paths and Sudeck climate. Mountain running, training preparations and plans available online, an event aimed at trail running enthusiasts and mountain challenges.

name: Kiełczowska Dycha i Piątka
location: Kiełczów, Wrocław, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Kiełczowska Dycha and Five-Kilometer Run is a unique running event scheduled for May 23, 2026, in Kiełczów. It is a full Sports Day designed for both professionals and amateurs, as well as entire families. The run combines athletic competition with community integration, offering positive energy and the opportunity to improve running results. The event is part of the Running Grand Prix of the Copper Basin and promotes physical activity at various levels of proficiency.
course_highlights: Scenic and runner-friendly route in Kiełczów
Two distance options: 10 km and 5 km
Family event with an atmosphere of integration and sporting competition
additional: Registration is conducted through an external system at fitstrefa-kielczow.cms.efitness.com.pl. The event is part of the Running Grand Prix of the Copper Basin. Timing is provided by Feniks - Timing, ensuring professional electronic timing services. Street race, online registration available, the event promotes sport and community integration.

name: Maraton Zagłębiowski
location: ArcelorMittal Park – ZPS Sosnowiec, Sosnowiec, Śląskie, Poland
organizer: Centrum Sportu i Rekreacji w Dąbrowie Górniczej
description: The Zagłębiowski Marathon is a prestigious marathon held at ArcelorMittal Park - ZPS Sosnowiec. The route has an official certification from the Polish Athletic Association (PZLA), which guarantees a precisely measured distance and reliable results. This event is for runners of various skill levels, combining athletic competition with the satisfaction of overcoming personal challenges. The organizers ensure professional organization and extensive support for participants.
course_highlights: Route with official PZLA certification
Race held at ArcelorMittal Park - ZPS Sosnowiec
Professionally prepared and accurately measured route
additional: Registration is conducted through the Datasport Registration Portal. Participants can choose to run in the individual marathon or in a two-person relay, where each participant completes a half marathon. The marathon route is certified, allowing for result comparisons with other races. The event is part of the Zagłębiowska Triada, a series of three races in the region. The event includes relay options, a 6-hour time limit, and attractions on the route, including the halfway point at Pogoria 3 and a fan zone.

name: Pancerna Piątka
organizer: Zarząd Wojewódzki NSZZ Policjantów województwa podkarpackiego
description: Pancerna Piątka is the Podkarpackie Police Championships in street running over a distance of 5 km, held in Żurawica. The event is under the Honorary Patronage of the Provincial Police Commander in Rzeszów. Over 400 participants take part in the competition, and the route runs through the roads of Żurawica. The organizer is the Provincial Board of the NSZZ Policemen of the Podkarpackie Voivodeship.
course_highlights: Street run over a distance of 5 km
The route runs through the roads of Żurawica
Event under the Honorary Patronage of the Provincial Police Commander in Rzeszów
additional: Over 400 participants compete in the event. The organizer is the Provincial Board of the NSZZ Policemen of the Podkarpackie Voivodeship. The run takes place on May 23, 2026, with electronic timing, and is part of local events promoting sport and physical activity.

name: Ultramaraton Jaga-Kora
description: The Jaga-Kora Ultramarathon is a mountain ultra race held in the picturesque region of the Low Beskids, on routes of varying difficulty. The event references the historic Courier Route "Jaga-Kora" from World War II, giving the race a unique character and historical significance. Participants can choose from five distances, ranging from 19 km to 101 km, passing through the areas of Jaśliska and Rymanów-Zdrój. The race is certified by ITRA and UTMB, highlighting its prestige in the mountain running community.
course_highlights: The route is based on the historic Courier Route "Jaga-Kora" from World War II
Five distances of varying difficulty: 101 km, 68 km, 42 km, 33 km, and 19 km
Runs through scenic areas of the Low Beskids, including Jaśliska and Rymanów-Zdrój
additional: Starts take place at night and in the morning on May 23, 2026, with different times for each distance. The race office is open on May 22 from 17:00 to 22:00 and on May 23 from 5:00 to 7:30. Bus transportation is organized to the start points for the 100 km, 33 km, and 19 km distances. The routes have specified closing times, and winners' ceremonies are held on the amphitheater stage near the Altana by the Black Stream. No prizes will be shipped to those absent from the awards ceremony. Registration opens on December 1, 2025. Detailed routes and schedules are available on the organizer's website. The event features refreshment points, awards, live tracking, and online results.

name: Bieg Ulicą Piotrkowską Rossman Run
description: The Piotrkowska Street Run Rossmann Run is one of the most important running events in Poland, taking place in the city center of Łódź on Piotrkowska Street. Established in 2003, the race attracts both amateurs and top athletes from the country. The course runs through the representative avenue of the city, and the event features a rich program of attractions, including a food zone and a free recovery meal. There is a Mini Run for children and people with disabilities on shorter distances.
course_highlights: The race course runs along Piotrkowska Street in Łódź
Start and finish at al. Scheiblerów, close to al. Poznańskich
Evening start at 19:00 with start zones divided according to declared times
additional: The race office is open from Wednesday to Saturday at Łódź Fabryczna Station. Deposits and changing rooms are available at the station. Showers are available at Well Fitness club upon presentation of the start number. Participants have free travel on Łódzka Kolej Aglomeracyjna on race day. After the race, the organizer provides a free recovery meal - soup. Each participant can use a one-hour access to the swimming and sauna zone at Aquapark Fala from May 20 to 25, 2026. It is forbidden for accompanying persons to move on the route by bicycles, scooters, and other vehicles. Traffic disruptions and public transport delays are expected during the race, which starts at 19:00, with disruptions from 18:00 to 21:30.

name: 10 Family Run
description: The 10th KSOS Family Run is a special celebration of family running events held at Kraków Błonia. The event combines generations, promotes physical activity and family integration, offering various races for children, parents, and an open race for everyone. The event features games, activities for children, a simultaneous chess game, and artistic performances, creating a joyful and sporty atmosphere for the whole family. It is an excellent opportunity to stay fit, meet in a relaxed environment, and enjoy outdoor activity together.
course_highlights: All races take place on the grassy area of Kraków Błonia
Open 5 km race with a time limit of 46 minutes
Children's races on distances from 200 m to 2100 m adapted to age
additional: Opportunity to participate in more than one race. Parental or guardian declaration required for children. Participant limit: 90 for the Open Race, 190 in total for the Mom and Dad Race, 455 in total for Children's Races. Race kit with T-shirt guaranteed only with prior registration and payment. Race office open on 22.05.2026 (16:00 - 20:00) and 23.05.2026 (8:30 - 11:30). In the 'Wilczki' race (children born in 2020 and later), parental supervision on the route is allowed. All races take place on the lawns of Kraków Błonia; the event is aimed at the local community, schools, and families; detailed route information available one week before the event.

The event is very popular and is organized by the Sports and Recreation Center in Hajnówka, which ensures the comfort and safety of runners. The race office is open the day before the race and on the race day, and participants can count on race packets and a coffee buffet.
course_highlights: Route runs through Hajnówka Municipal Park
Picturesque areas of Białowieża and surroundings
Contact with nature and beautiful views
additional: The race office is open on May 22 from 15:00 to 21:00 at the Amphitheater of the Hajnówka Municipal Park and on May 23 from 8:00 to 9:30. A valid ID is required to collect the race packet. It is not possible to run under another participant's name. No registrations on race day. Participants have access to a free coffee buffet. The route is asphalt, starting in Białowieża, finishing in Hajnówka, race office at the amphitheater, massages and showers available after the race.

Registrations until May 10, start and recovery packages, cheerleading contest, previous edition's race sold out.

description: Poznaniak Run for Preschoolers is a family running event held on May 23, 2026, in the picturesque Greater Poland National Park and at the Museum of Agriculture in Szreniawa. The program includes main races over distances of 11 km and 5.5 km, Nordic Walking marches, and children's and youth races on various distances. The event is charitable, with all proceeds supporting children with autism. Organizers provide electronic timing, commemorative medals, and numerous attractions for participants and their families, including free museum tours and outdoor games for children.

Participants in the 11 km distance complete the loop twice
Children's races take place at the Museum of Agriculture and Food Industry in Szreniawa

Free tours of the Museum of Agriculture and Food Industry in Szreniawa and participation in outdoor games for children. Races over 11 km and 5.5 km, Nordic Walking march, children's races, museum tours, electronic timing, commemorative medals.

name: Maraton Sztafet Ekiden
location: Kampus Główny Akademii Wychowania Fizycznego, Białołęka, Warszawa, Poland

This unique event brings together runners of all skill levels, where teams of six members collectively cover the marathon distance in the Japanese ekiden relay format. The event promotes team spirit and cooperation, offering various relay change distances that facilitate participation for beginner runners. It is an excellent opportunity for sports competition and integration among friends, families, or colleagues.

The route consists of two loops
Fast and friendly course for teams of six members
additional: Start is organized in waves, with the start time chosen during registration. The race number must be placed at the front of the clothing and be visible. Participants should arrive at the start area early enough to comfortably use deposit points, changing rooms, and toilets. Net time is counted from crossing the start line. Volunteers support the organization and atmosphere of the race, and volunteer recruitment is open. The event promotes cooperation, integration, and team spirit, with various distances and categories for different age groups, including races for children and youth.

Participants can expect comprehensive start packages, recovery meals, and great fun in a charming setting.

Night street races with start and finish at the Nowe Miasto Market Square
Two distances: 5 km and 10 km

Both races start and finish at the Nowe Miasto Market Square. The event combines a passion for running with joy and community in a charming town. Night race, registration on Superczas.pl, prizes, start packages, festive atmosphere

The event offers a variety of distances for adults and children, promoting active spending time with family and friends. Participants can expect rich start packages, commemorative medals, attractive prizes, as well as integration and a chillout zone.

Nordic walking 5 km for adults
Children's races from 100 to 800 meters

The event includes 10 km races, 5 km Nordic walking, and children's races from 100 to 800 meters. Participants can enjoy attractions and prizes, with the route passing through the forest, providing scenic views and active entertainment.

name: Sieprawska Piątka
