The event takes place in a picturesque area, with the race route passing through the Sunny Park and the Orlik sports complex, offering participants comfortable conditions for competition and recreation. The run is community-oriented and promotes physical activity among residents and visitors. Organizers provide extensive sports infrastructure and support during the event.
course_highlights: The race route passes through Sunny Park in Siepraw
Start and finish located at the Orlik Sports Complex
Well-prepared sports infrastructure with changing rooms and toilets
additional: The organizer is the Municipal Cultural and Sports Center in Siepraw. The Orlik Sports Complex provides sanitary facilities and changing rooms for participants. The event has a community-building character and promotes physical activity among the local community. It also includes various sports and cultural activities, with participation from local communities, including races for children and youth, marches, and accompanying events.

name: Ultramaraton Jaga-Kora
description: The Jaga-Kora Ultramarathon is a mountain ultra race held in the picturesque Low Beskids, near Rymanów-Zdrój. The route is based on the historic Beskid Courier Route "Jaga-Kora," used during World War II. The event features five races of varying difficulty and length, from 19 km to 101 km. The races are certified by ITRA and UTMB, highlighting their prestige and high organizational standards. We invite you to participate in the 10th edition, which will take place on May 23, 2026.
course_highlights: Route based on the historic Beskid Courier Route "Jaga-Kora" from World War II
Five races of different distances: 101 km, 70 km, 42 km, 33 km, and 19 km
Scenic areas of the Low Beskids with numerous trails and historic sites
additional: Starts take place at night and in the morning of May 23, 2026. The longest distances (100 km and 33 km) start at midnight from the market square in Jaśliska after prior bus transportation. The other distances start from the Shelters above Czarne Potok or Moszczaniec. The routes have specified closing times, and the winners' ceremonies are held on the stage of the amphitheater next to the Shelters above Czarne Potok. No prizes are shipped; attendance at the awards ceremony is mandatory. Registration opens in December 2025. The event includes various distances, and participants can expect support along the route and beautiful views.

The event aims to promote running as a form of active recreation and a healthy lifestyle, as well as to integrate the local community. In addition to the main race, races for children are also organized, making the event attractive for entire families.

Team classification considering the gender of competitors

The route includes fields, dirt roads, and forest paths; online registration and via Facebook; outdoor event regardless of weather; prizes and medals are planned.

organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Miedźnej, Szkoła Podstawowa we Frydku, Nadleśnictwo Kobiór

The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and outdoor activity, encouraging runners of all ages and skill levels to participate. Ability to download routes in GPX format for mobile devices
Run promoting health and outdoor physical activity

Registration is conducted via an online platform, the event promotes a healthy lifestyle and sports among residents of Miedźna municipality.

name: XV Biegiem po Wichrowskich Lasach
description: The XV Wichrowskie Forest Run is an annual running event organized by the Wichrowo Forest District Office, attracting enthusiasts of outdoor physical activity. The start and finish are located at the Wichrowo Forest District Office, and participants have the opportunity to join a trail familiarization training session.

Scenic forest trails of 10 km
Categories for children, youth, individuals with disabilities, and Nordic walking
additional: A trail familiarization training session takes place on June 6 at 10:00 AM. The children's and youth races start from approximately 10:10 to 11:00 AM. The Nordic walking march starts at 9:00 AM from Garnizonowa Street in Dobre Miasto, with a distance of about 10 km. The main 10 km race starts and finishes at the Wichrowo Forest District Office. The main distance is 10 km, with races for children and youth, Nordic walking, a pre-race training, online registration until May 21, 2026, and a time limit of 2 hours for Nordic walking.

Professional RFID timing measurement
Organized in Kędzierzyn-Koźle

The event attracts athletes from across the country, creating a unique climate of competition and integration. Registrations are now open on the dedicated website.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified race
Professional timing
Medal and meal for participants
additional: The Lupus Run is an event with professional timing, a medal, and a meal for participants. The organization ensures a great atmosphere and environment. name: XXI Cross Maraton przez Piekło do Nieba
description: The 21st Cross Marathon "Through Hell to Heaven" is a unique running event organized by the PTTK Branch in Końskie. The event will take place on May 23, 2026, attracting both runners and amateurs, offering a challenging route in a picturesque area. The marathon is known for its interesting and demanding course, which passes through areas called Hell and Heaven, emphasizing its character and challenge. Organizers provide professional support and assistance for participants.

Picturesque landscapes around Końskie
Challenging cross terrain
additional: The organizer's office is open on Mondays from 13:00 to 17:00, Tuesdays and Thursdays from 8:00 to 11:00. Contact by phone: +48 514 030 401. No details provided about start waves, participant limits, or entry fees on the website. Participation is available for persons over 18 years old, with various age categories and classifications. The race starts at 9:00 AM, with an earlier start for participants planning to finish in over 6 hours. After the race, participants will receive medals, trophies, and refreshments.

name: XXVIII Bieg Święców
location: Sławno, Sławno County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 28th Saint's Run in Sławno is an annual running event scheduled for May 23, 2026. The main race covers a distance of 10 km through the city streets, including asphalt roads, basalt cobblestones, and bike paths. The route is secured and marked, with refreshment points offering water along the way. The event also features youth and children's races at the athletics stadium, with distances ranging from 50 to 600 meters. Organizers aim to promote community integration and a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: Main 10 km race route (3 x 3.33 km) through Sławno streets: asphalt, basalt cobblestones, asphalt bike paths
Refreshment points every 1.5 km, 3 km, 4.5 km, 6 km, and 7.5 km with water in paper cups
Youth and children's races at the athletics stadium - tartan track, distances from 50 to 600 meters
additional: The time limit to complete the main race is 90 minutes. Participants must follow the instructions of security personnel. The youth and children's races start at 11:00 AM at the athletics stadium, with distances adjusted to participants' ages. Award ceremony will take place at the amphitheater at 5:30 PM. Registration is available online; the event also includes organized activities and support for runners.

name: Jistebnický VH maraton
location: TJ Jistebník, Jistebník, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 100-200 Kč (za jednotlivé závody, dle registrace a délky)
description: Jistebník Water Management Half Marathon is a traditional running race held for the sixteenth time in the picturesque landscape on the border of the Poodří Protected Landscape Area. It offers routes from 3.6 km up to a marathon, which lead through nature with beautiful views of the Beskydy Mountains. The start and finish of all races are at the TJ Jistebník sports complex, where there is also a rich accompanying program including a children's olympiad. The race is suitable for the general public, including children and youth, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and quality organization.
course_highlights: Routes lead through nature on the edge of the Poodří Protected Landscape Area
Landscape between Jistebník, Polanka nad Odrou, and Klimkovice
Excellent views of the Beskydy Mountains
additional: Registration for all races opens at 7:00 AM and closes 20 minutes before the start of the respective race. The start and finish are at the TJ Jistebník sports complex. There is refreshment available on the course, with one refreshment station at the finish and additional refreshments offered by a local pub known for its Marathon Soup. Parking is available near the complex, and it is recommended to use train or bus connections. After the race, changing rooms and showers are available. Blood and plasma donors are offered a 50% discount on the entry fee upon presentation of the latest donation. The races take place in a natural environment, offering various distances, including children's categories and an accompanying program. Registration is possible online.

name: Vrané – Zvole
location: Vrané nad Vltavou, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Vrané - Zvole is part of the KOPEC series, which features uphill runs in Prague and the surrounding area. This race offers a challenge in the form of a demanding ascent and is intended for runners who want to test their endurance and strength in hilly terrain. The KOPEC series is a traditional and popular circuit where competitors can automatically be included in the overall ranking without the need for additional registration. The races are organized with an emphasis on fairness, safety, and sportsmanship.
course_highlights: Uphill run in Prague and Central Bohemia terrain
Challenging ascent and hilly profile of the course
Part of the traditional KOPEC series with scoring and league
additional: Participants are automatically included in the overall KOPEC series ranking by participating in any race. The series standings are determined by the total points from placements in individual races, with a maximum of the 10 best results counting. Runners must adhere to start and conduct rules on the course, including the obligation to run with a bib number and not to use assistance from other persons or animals. In case of health threats, the race director may suspend or terminate the race.

name: Štramberská desítka
description: The Štramberk Ten is a traditional road race organized by the Emil Zátopek Athletic Club Kopřivnice. The race takes place in the picturesque town of Štramberk and offers a 10 km course with mixed terrain predominantly on roads. The run is open to the general public and is known for its friendly atmosphere and rich history. Participants can expect refreshments at the finish line and prizes for the best runners in various categories. The race is run in traffic, with each participant at their own risk.
course_highlights: Length of the course 10 km, mixed terrain with predominance of roads
Refreshments at the finish line and traditional Štramberské uši
Course record men 37:26.6, women 47:26.5
additional: Registration of competitors takes place from 9:15 to 10:40 at the gymnasium of the Štramberk Elementary School. Changing rooms and showers are available at the Sokolovna in Štramberk. Prizes are awarded in categories based on age and gender, including monetary premiums and material prizes. The race is part of the Ing. Petr Bayer Memorial. Registration from 9:15 to 10:40 at the elementary school gymnasium in Štramberk, refreshments at the finish line, changing rooms and showers at the Sokolovna, the race is run in traffic at your own risk.

name: Berounská desítka
price_range: drahší poplatek na místě, přesná cena není uvedena
description: Berounská desítka is a renewed running race with a tradition, taking place on May 23, 2026, in the village of Zdejcina near Beroun. It offers three courses: a main race of 10 km for experienced runners, a shorter 4 km route suitable for everyone, and a free children's run of 500 meters. The course runs through forest paths with an elevation gain of 252 meters and features the lookout tower Děd at an altitude of 491 meters above sea level. Participants can look forward to refreshments during and after the race and a friendly atmosphere that revives the local running tradition.
course_highlights: Forest paved and unpaved paths
Highest ascent to the Děd lookout tower (491 m above sea level)
Total elevation gain of 252 meters
additional: Race bibs are issued from 8:00 to 10:00 on race day. Runners in the 10 km race will have refreshments at approximately 6 km, as well as fruit and water after finishing. The children's 500 m race starts at 10:15, and the 4 km and 10 km races start together at 11:00. On-site payment is possible but at a higher fee. The race takes place in all weather conditions; suitable footwear for wet terrain is recommended. Parking is available on Hudlická road; it is advised not to attempt parking directly in the village. The course has an elevation gain of 252 meters, with refreshments before the start, at 6 km, and after finishing. Weather conditions may vary, and the race is held regardless of weather.

name: Orelský běh lesoparkem Skalky, memoriál prof. P. Leopolda Benáčka
location: Olešnice v Jihomoravském kraji, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Orel Run through the Skalky Forest Park is a traditional sporting event organized by the Christian sports organization Orel in Olešnice, South Moravian Region. The Memorial of Prof. P. Leopold Benáček offers runners the opportunity to compete in the beautiful natural environment of the Skalky Forest Park. The event is part of Orel's broader program, which promotes sports for all in the spirit of fair play and a healthy lifestyle. The race is suitable for the general public and contributes to the development of sports activities in the region.
course_highlights: Skalky Forest Park with natural running trails
Beautiful natural environment around Olešnice
Traditional memorial dedicated to Prof. P. Leopold Benáček
additional: The race is part of the OBL 2026 race schedule, offers rules and results, takes place in May 2026

name: Hannah Pilsen Trail Letkov
location: Letkov u Plzně, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: Hannah Pilsen Trail Letkov is a traditional trail running race in nature near Plzeň, offering scenic routes of various lengths and difficulty levels. The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Letkov and is part of the celebrations of the 750th anniversary of the village. The course passes through Jandova Skála, Čilina, and includes a marathon with a run up to Maršál and Radyně. For children and families, a multigenerational relay is prepared, promoting active movement for all generations.
course_highlights: 8.5 km course through Jandova Skála
21 km route through Čilina
Marathon with a run up to Maršál and Radyně
additional: The race is part of the Running Cup of Plzeň Region. There are school routes and a multigenerational relay for children called "Running for Totem" with parents. The event also celebrates the 750th anniversary of the village of Letkov. It includes various distances, such as 8.5 km, 21 km, and a marathon, with options for family relays and children's categories. Registration opens at the end of 2025, and the races take place in a natural environment with refreshments and medals for participants.

description: Tisá Ultra Trail is a new event that continues the tradition of the Libouchecký Ultramarathon. It offers several routes of varying lengths and difficulty in the beautiful surroundings of Tisá and its vicinity. The races are mainly run off asphalt roads, on forest and field paths and trails, with clear signage. The race facilities are well equipped, with showers, changing rooms, refreshments, and the option to stay overnight in your own tent or car. Organizers emphasize safety and ecology, for example by limiting plastic cups at refreshment stations.
course_highlights: Routes are mainly off asphalt roads, on forest and field paths and trails
Refreshment stations are located every 15 - 20 km with a diverse selection of food and drinks
Race facilities include changing rooms, showers, toilets, and the possibility to stay overnight in your own tent or car
additional: Start and finish are behind the football field in Tisá. Facilities include changing rooms, toilets, showers, seating, and refreshments in a covered tent. Possibility to stay overnight in your own tent or car. Parking is available in the Burg area. Mandatory equipment for the 100 km race includes a start chip and a charged mobile phone. At refreshment stations, water, cola, isotonic drinks, fruit, bread, cheese, cookies, muesli bars, and salt are available. At the finish, there is soup and a main meal; it is recommended to bring your own dishes and cutlery. The 10 km race starts at 12:00, the 100 km race at 5:00. Registration and drop bag handover are the day before the race. Course options range from 25 km to 100 km, with children's races, facilities at the football field and in the Libouchecká hall, the possibility of a tent city, ceramic medals, and T-shirts for participants.

name: Běhej lesy Brdy
location: Obecnice, CHKO Brdy, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 150 Kč při koupi 8 závodů v rámci jedné objednávky
description: Běhej lesy Brdy is a trail run held in the Brdy Protected Landscape Area, near Prague and Příbram. The race offers various routes including a short and a long one, which are part of the international UTMB Index Races. Runners can enjoy beautiful nature, technical sections, and competitions for valuable prizes. The finish line is extended to 500 meters, providing an interesting challenge for all participants. The Běhej lesy series is known for its community atmosphere and respect for nature.
course_highlights: UTMB Index Races with international scoring
Conti Speed Section - a 150-meter speed segment with Continental flags
Generali Investments Finish - extended 500m finish line with a measured section
additional: In Brdy, competitions are held on the Nova 12 km and ČSOB 22 km routes. The winner of the Conti Speed Section receives a voucher for tires and a running jersey. The fastest man and woman across all routes will receive a functional Craft running jersey as the GENERALI INVESTMENTS FINISHER #1 title. The race includes various distances from 4 to 22 km, children's races, accompanying program, and the opportunity for family participation. The event takes place in the natural environment of CHKO Brdy with an emphasis on ecology and community atmosphere.

name: Běh pro hospic Litoměřice

description: Run for the Litoměřice Hospice is a charity sporting event organized to support the St. Stephen Hospice in Litoměřice. Participants run to help those whose life journey is coming to an end, thereby contributing to the funding and support of hospice care. The event takes place in a beautiful setting and is complemented by professional timing. The motto of the race is 'Who runs, helps'.
course_highlights: Charity sporting event supporting the hospice
Beautiful environment of Litoměřice
Professional timing
additional: The event is a charity initiative supporting hospice care. name: Milada Run
location: Hlavní pláž jezera Milada, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Milada Run is part of the popular sports series Milada Tour, which takes place in the unique landscape of the former brown coal mine transformed into the natural Milada Lake. The jubilee 10th edition offers a family-friendly and friendly atmosphere with routes for children and adults. The races run along hilly and flat paths with beautiful views of the lake and surrounding nature. The high level and popularity of the race are confirmed by the participants themselves.
course_highlights: Half marathon route with two loops, including a hilly path by the water and views over the lake
10 km route on paved, flat paths suitable for all runners
Children's races 500 m and 1 km near the main beach with parental supervision
additional: The race capacity is limited to 500 participants. All runners will receive a medal, and a start number with their name upon payment by May 16, 2026. An official Milada Tour 2026 T-shirt is available for order during registration, and a free children's T-shirt for the first 100 registered children. The accompanying program includes the Olympia children's corner and childcare. The race includes routes around Lake Milada, children's races, medals for all participants, and an accompanying program.

name: Brdské rokle
location: Lesní divadlo, Řevnice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Brdské rokle is a trail race held in the picturesque environment of the Forest Theatre in Řevnice, offering three routes of varying lengths and difficulty. All routes lead through the forest with diverse terrain, including ascents, descents, and beautiful views of spring nature. The race is known for its technical sections and variable profile, which will test runners and experienced trail enthusiasts alike. Starting numbers can be personalized with a name, and participants can use facilities with refreshments and a children's corner for families with children.
course_highlights: Forest routes with elevation gain of 200 - 360 m depending on the distance
Technical sections with rocky and soft forest paths
Beautiful views and spring nature in full bloom
additional: Starting number with a personal name can be ordered by May 17, 2026. The facilities at the Forest Theatre include toilets, baggage storage, and refreshments at the finish line (Corny bars, bananas, water, Ionilyte sports drink). A children's corner with art activities and supervision by an experienced teacher is available for kids. It is recommended to travel by train due to limited parking in Řevnice. Trail races in nature, technical sections, refreshment stations, routes of 10 km and 15 km, start from the Forest Theatre in Řevnice.

The event includes various routes, online or on-site registration, accompanying activities, and races focused on families and health.

name: Salomon Valašský Hrb

This race is ideal for mountain running enthusiasts who want to experience the beauty of nature and enjoy a sporting challenge. Various distances from 10 km to 50 km

The race is run in two relay variants: 4×5.5 km and 2×11 km, with a total distance of a half marathon 21.1 km. The event supports children in need, with all entry fees and voluntary contributions for original running jerseys going directly to the o.p.s. Život dětem. In addition to the main race, there are free children's runs and a non-competitive ride on kick scooters. The race is suitable for teams who want to combine athletic performance with supporting a good cause.

Ability to monitor the current race status on a large screen

Children's runs are free and take place from 13:30 to 14:45 with results announced afterward. The main race starts at 15:00, covering four laps with a 3-hour time limit. Registration is possible via an online form. The event also includes children's races and a ceremonial award ceremony.

description: Running for Children is a sports and entertainment afternoon organized since 2015 that supports children and young people from children's homes. The event offers running races and fun sports activities for all age groups, including a family run and a team relay. The program features accompanying activities such as face painting, a bouncy castle, a magic show, and musical performances. In 2026, the event will take place on May 23rd in Na Pankráci Park in Prague 4 and is organized under the auspices of the mayor of Prague 4. Everyone who helps is a winner, and every participant is entered into a raffle for prizes.

Family run of 1 km for 2 to 5 members, all start and finish together
4 x 1 km team relay with at least one adult in the team

name: SeziRun
location: Sezimovo Ústí, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 150 Kč pro hlavní závody, 100 Kč za 4 km s kočárkem, 50 Kč pro děti do 16 let, dobrovolný příspěvek pro děti do 12 let
description: SeziRun is a traditional running race held in Sezimovo Ústí, taking place on May 23, 2026. The 10th anniversary offers a wide range of races for children and adults, including a half marathon, 12 km, 6 km, and 4 km courses. The race is suitable for all age groups and running levels, with winners announced in individual categories. Parking is available near the start and finish lines, making it easy for participants to arrive. The race atmosphere is sporty and friendly, with opportunities to share photos and a limited edition headband for participants.

Start and finish in Sezimovo Ústí with accessible parking about 300 meters from the start
Announcement of the top three in all categories except the walking category

Vehicle entry directly to the forest hut is prohibited. A limited edition headband is being prepared for the 2026 anniversary. A photo gallery is shared for all participants and fans of SeziRun. The race takes place in a natural environment with online registration, refreshments, chip timing, and a raffle with prizes. Temporary changing rooms are available at the haystack, without showers or storage facilities.

name: Zaječický bůr
location: Zaječice u Pyšel, Zaječice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Zaječický běh je tradiční cross-country race with a family atmosphere, offering courses for all age groups from children to adults. The race takes place in the picturesque environment of Zaječice near Pyšely and is part of the Ladov Region Cup. It offers material prizes for the top three in each category and prize money for the course record on the longest track. The race is popular for its friendly atmosphere and quality organization, attracting runners of all levels.

Main prize for the overall winner of the MAXI rabbit category on 5555 m
Part of the Ladov Region Cup with prize money for the course record on 10,555 m
additional: Registration is possible online until May 22nd or on-site on the race day. Starts are divided by categories from 9:00 to 12:50. Parking is available near the start and marked from the entrance to Zaječice. The race is scored for the Ladov Region Cup and the Regional Skiing Association of the Central Bohemian Region. The HOLE category is Nordic walking with style control. The race offers medals, material prizes, diplomas, start packages, refreshments for all participants (cookie, juice or tea, soup), and online registration options. The event is suitable for the whole family and includes a children's program.

name: Krok za Šimonka
location: Skalka, Nový Jičín, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Krok za Šimonka is a sporting event organized to support a collection for Šimonka, a boy suffering from the rare metabolic disease Lesch Nyhan syndrome. The event offers a fun sports day for the whole family in the Skalka area near Nový Jičín. The goal is not only to support treatment and rehabilitation but also to raise awareness about this disease and the strength of the community. Participants can look forward to a pleasant atmosphere and the opportunity to help a good cause.
course_highlights: Run of 13 km combining asphalt and trail routes
Support for children with serious illnesses, especially Šimonka with Lesch-Nyhan syndrome
Supporting program, raffle, and collection to support healthcare
additional: The event is a fun sports day for the whole family with refreshments. Part of the support includes the sale of T-shirts, with a portion of the proceeds going towards Šimonka's treatment. The event takes place at the Skalka amphitheater, registration is possible online, and the proceeds are allocated to rehabilitation, aids, and medical examinations. There are races for children and adults, a program, and a collection.

location: Pelhřimov náměstí, Pelhřimov, Vysočina, Czech Republic

description: Run for a Smile is a sporting event for the whole family held at Masaryk Square in Pelhřimov. This Pelhřimov half marathon is suitable for active and non-active families, seniors, and children from 1 year old, and you do not have to run the race, walking is also fine. Half of the entry fee goes to the Julinka Foundation, which fights against childhood obesity. Races for children and parents are scheduled back-to-back, and while waiting for parents, children can enjoy activities such as face painting, a bouncy castle, riding scooters, or learning first aid.
course_highlights: Routes of 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon are certified
Children's routes without placement evaluation, run for joy and a smile
Start and finish at Masaryk Square in Pelhřimov

Runners in the 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon are chip-timed with single-use chips attached to their bibs. The registration fee until April 30, 2026, includes a medal, a name-tagged bib, and Rajec water. Parents accompanying children run for free. A baggage storage service is available for runners. The event hosts are Ondřej Havlík (En.dru) and Petr Cerha (Nasty). The races are suitable for all age groups, including children and seniors, with accompanying activities for children and a charitable aspect.

name: Memoriál Ivana Belobrada

The event is suitable for the general public, including youth and children, with the possibility of individual starts for the youngest. The race takes place in a pleasant sports area and is known for its friendly atmosphere and quality organization.

Varied surface: asphalt, paved, and unpaved terrain
Sports area Dlouhoňovice as start and finish

For the youngest children, a community run with flexible start times is prepared. Online registration is available as well as on-site registration with different entry fees. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup 2026 series, includes various categories, exact courses are not specified.

The event is suitable for runners who enjoy challenges in natural terrain and want to experience an active sports day in a beautiful environment. The organizer is Petr Holec, who ensures the smooth running of the race.

Uphill run with the finish at Rezek
Natural terrain and scenic views

name: Gočárův běh
location: Hradec Králové and Pardubice, Hradec Králové Region, Czech Republic
description: The Gočár Run is a unique race connecting two regional cities, Hradec Králové and Pardubice, following in the footsteps of architect Josef Gočár. Runners will face a 33-kilometer route combining road and natural sections with the backdrop of Gočár's buildings, from schools in Hradec to the iconic Automatic Mills in Pardubice. The race is open to individuals, pairs, four-member relay teams, and children, offering not only a sporting challenge but also a cultural and social experience with an accompanying program and musical performances. The Gočár Run is quickly becoming a tradition in the East Bohemia region and attracts hundreds of runners and thousands of fans each year.
course_highlights: 33 km route from Hradec Králové to Pardubice
Combination of road and natural sections
Backdrops of Gočár's buildings including Automatic Mills
additional: The start package includes original Eleven socks, a medal, a Hradecký Klenot beer pack, a race number with logo, an electronic timing chip, refreshments on the course and at the finish line, an electronic diploma, and an accompanying program. There are changing rooms, baggage storage with transfer to the finish, medical services, catering, race photos and videos, testing of Craft footwear, and taping at a discounted price. The VIP experience includes a personalized T-shirt, diploma, and a rooftop experience at the Automatic Mills. The accompanying program features musical performances, children's activities, various race categories, and the opportunity to share the experience with friends.

name: Běhej lesy Brdy
location: Skořice, CHKO Brdy, Příbram, Czech Republic
description: Run Forests Brdy is a trail run held on May 23, 2026, in the Brdy Protected Landscape Area (CHKO Brdy), near Prague and Příbram. The race offers both short and long routes, including a charity race, and is part of the international UTMB Index Races. Runners can compete in speed sections such as the Conti Speed Section and Generali Investments Finish, which provide additional motivation and rewards. The course runs through beautiful nature of the Brdy and is suitable for all trail running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: UTMB Index Races - international point rating of trail races
Conti Speed Section - a 150-meter speed segment marked with Continental flags
Generali Investments Finish - a 500-meter flat finish stretch with timing and rewards
additional: Online registration and registration fee changes are available via SportID. The charity race is part of the event. Results and performance analyses are accessible on the website and in the SportID app. Starting numbers are already sold out for some dates; early registration is recommended. Routes are 12 km and 22 km, featuring charity and UTMB Index point evaluation, speed sections, race speed sections, online registration and results, and GPX format routes available for download.

name: Bóžovo 59ka
description: Bóžovo 59ka is a traditional race organized by the Jasan Ski Club in Aš, Karlovy Vary Region. The race takes place on May 23, 2026, and offers a sporting experience in a beautiful environment with the opportunity for active participation by club members and the public. Club Jasan is known for its long-standing tradition and active approach to training and competitions in the region.
course_highlights: Terrain includes slopes around Aš
Race date is May 23, 2026
Organizer offers sporting experiences in a natural environment
additional: Registration is open until January 31, 2026; the race course includes slopes and natural terrains around Aš; start and registration information are available on the official website.

name: Běh o štěně okolo Poděbrad - memoriál Zdeňka Slepičky
description: The Puppy Run - Zdeněk Slepička Memorial is a cross-country race covering 7.2 km, held in Hejčín, Olomouc. The race is part of the Great Prize of Runners of the Olomouc Region and offers runners an interesting course in natural terrain. The event is suitable for cross-country running enthusiasts who want to test their strength on a more challenging route with diverse surfaces. The race has a tradition and is named in memory of Zdeněk Slepička.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in natural terrain
Distance of 7.2 km
Part of the Great Prize of Runners of the Olomouc Region
additional: The event is intended for the broad running public and supports the regional running community.

description: Žlutavská 11 is a running race that takes you through picturesque hills around the village of Žlutava. It offers courses for all age groups from the youngest children to a race over 11 km. Participants have access to abundant refreshments, comfortable facilities including changing rooms and showers. Come enjoy the sporting atmosphere and beautiful nature around Žlutava.

Surface of the course: asphalt (35%), grass and dirt (30%), cobblestone (35%)
Picturesque hills around the village of Žlutava
additional: Participants have access to chip timing, refreshments (drinks, fruit), a voucher for food and drinks for online registered participants in main races A and B, participant medals for children, and material prizes for the top three in age categories. The course is over 11 km, with refreshments, showers, parking at the football field, online and on-site registration, various age categories, start on 23 May 2026.

name: Salomon Valašský Hrb
location: Solanec pod Soláněm, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Salomon Valašský Hrb is a daily individual running race held along the ridge of the Beskydy mountains in the beautiful environment of forests around Solance under Soláně. The course is off-road, running on marked hiking trails, and offers smoothly undulating terrain with inspiring views. The race is suitable for cross-country and trail running enthusiasts seeking a challenge in the beautiful nature of the Beskydy Mountains.
course_highlights: The course runs along the ridge of the Beskydy mountains off-road with one secured crossing of a road
Marked hiking trails in smoothly undulating terrain
Beautiful forest environment with inspiring views
additional: The organizer is the 3THX sports club, Tomáš Knop-Kostka. The race is a fast-paced individual running event. The race distances are 50 km, 30 km, 20 km, and 10 km. The course is off-road, with only one secured road crossing. Course lengths: 50 km / 30 km / 20 km / 10 km; terrain trail and cross-country, registration fee varies depending on registration order.

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Brno
location: Brno, Pavilon Anthropos, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1

description: Run for the Nation's Memory in Brno is a sports and social event organized to support the non-profit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of witnesses and helps them. The race takes place at the Anthropos pavilion and offers timed runs of 6 km, 10.5 km, and a relay of 4 x 2.5 km, as well as untimed family and children's runs. The route runs along the Svratka River with a surface of paved paths and asphalt. Participants contribute through their entry fee to the filming and preservation of witnesses' stories and educational programs.
course_highlights: Route along the Svratka River towards Kamenná Colony and Kamenný Bridge
Surface of paved paths and asphalt
Timed runs of 6 km (1 lap) and 10.5 km (2 laps)
additional: Start and finish at the Anthropos pavilion. Changing rooms, storage, sanitary facilities, water for rinsing, and refreshments to replenish energy are available. Students, individuals under 18, members of the Memory of the Nation club, and runners over 65 receive a 50% discount on the entry fee. On-site registration is possible with a higher registration fee. The event includes not only sports activities but also an accompanying program with music, refreshments, and facilities including changing rooms and water stations. Registration is available online and on-site.

name: Jistebnický vodohospodářský půlmaraton
location: Sportovní areál TJ Jistebník, Jistebník, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 100 Kč (pro mladistvé do 19 let registrované do 17.5.2024), 200 Kč na místě
description: Jistebník Water Management Half Marathon is a traditional running race held for the sixteenth time in the picturesque landscape on the border of the Poodří Protected Landscape Area. The races offer routes from 3.6 km up to a marathon, including relay races and a children's olympiad, starting and ending at the TJ Jistebník sports complex. The running courses lead through nature with beautiful views of the Beskydy Mountains and between the villages of Jistebník, Polanka nad Odrou, and Klimkovice. The event is complemented by a rich accompanying program and is suitable for a wide range of runners and families with children.
course_highlights: Routes lead through nature on the edge of the Poodří Protected Landscape Area
Landscape between Jistebník, Polanka nad Odrou, and Klimkovice
Views of the Beskydy Mountains
additional: Start and finish of all runs are at the TJ Jistebník sports complex. Registration begins at 7:00 AM and ends 20 minutes before the start of the respective race. There is refreshment on the course, and at the finish line, one refreshment is available included in the entry fee. It is recommended to try the Marathon Soup at the local pub. Parking is available near the complex and on the main road, with ideal options being train and bus connections. The event also includes a children's olympiad and an accompanying program from 10:00 to 15:00. Blood and plasma donors receive a 50% discount on the entry fee upon presenting proof of their last donation. The course passes through natural areas, the event includes multiple race categories and children's activities, and it takes place in May 2026.

name: Krušnej seběh
location: Nové Hamry, Karlovarský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Krušnej downhill is a traditional running race organized by Bike Team Nejdek, held in the picturesque environment of Nové Hamry in the Karlovy Vary Region. The race offers two courses - the longer FullHD approximately 14 km long and the shorter HD 7 km, which mainly run through forest paths and paved roads with hilly terrain and technical sections. The start and finish are in Nové Hamry, with the start moved to an earlier hour to ensure the race takes only part of the morning. The race is suitable for all runners who want to experience a challenging yet attractive cross-country run in the Ore Mountains.
course_highlights: Circuit course with a length of 14 km (FullHD) and 7 km (HD)
Forest paths, paved forest roads, and asphalt crossings
Hilly terrain with demanding climbs and technical descents
additional: The race starts in Nové Hamry at the Velká sjezdovka, with a circuit course featuring water stations on the track (for FullHD) and at the finish. Transportation to the start is provided without the need for train transfer. Results are announced before noon, so the race takes only the morning part of the day. Course variants: FullHD (18.9 km) and HD (11 km), hilly profile, bus departure from the registration site, on-site and online registration, changes in the route and schedule compared to previous years.

name: Běšinský běh
location: Běšiny u Klatov, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: The Běšinský Run is a traditional running race held in Běšiny near Klatovy, offering a course length of 4.8 km. The race is of a mixed type and includes a hill climb prize, adding to its attractiveness and challenge for runners. The start is at a football field, and the race takes place in all weather conditions. The organizer is Sokol Běšiny, ensuring a friendly atmosphere and a safe event.
course_highlights: Course length of 4.8 km in Běšiny near Klatovy
Mixed type race with a hill climb prize
Start at a football field
additional: The race takes place in all weather conditions. Each participant runs at their own risk and is responsible for their health. Children start for free. The course passes through a football field, registration is at your own risk, the race is held in all weather conditions, and there is a hill climb prize.

description: The Run for the Nation's Memory in Olomouc is a sports and social event organized to support the non-profit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of witnesses. The race takes place on May 23, 2026, in Smetanovy and Čechovy Parks and offers timed runs of 5 km, 10 km, and a 4x2.5 km relay, as well as untimed children's and family runs. The start and finish are near the collection greenhouses in Smetanovy Park. The event is suitable for all age groups and promotes remembrance of heroism and freedom.
course_highlights: The route runs through Smetanovy and Čechovy Parks on marked circuits
The 5 km race consists of 2 laps, the 10 km race of 4 laps
The relay is composed of 4 segments of 2.5 km each
additional: Students, minors under 18, members of the Post Bellum Friends Club, and runners over 65 receive a 50% discount on the registration fee. Changing rooms, a storage area, sanitary facilities, and water at the finish are available. The accompanying program includes stalls with games for children, a relaxation and science zone by Palacký University, workshops, and prize competitions. Race numbers are issued during check-in on the race day. The event includes refreshments, water, a family and children’s program, and promotes memories of the past and the fight for freedom.

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Kladno
location: Libčice nad Vltavou, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Run for the Nation's Memory in Libčice nad Vltavou is a sports and social event organized to support the non-profit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of witnesses and helps them. The race offers timed runs of 5 km and 10 km with mass start, which lead along paved paths and asphalt in the forest park and along the cycle path. The event is suitable for all age groups and promotes remembrance of history and the courage of fighters for freedom. Start numbers are issued on the day of the race at the registration site. The event also includes a children's run and the possibility of a symbolic run "Anywhere!" outside the official routes.
course_highlights: Start at the entrance near Sletiště
The route runs through the forest park along the cycle path
Surface of paved paths and asphalt
additional: Students, pupils under 18, members of the Friends of the Nation's Memory Club, and runners over 65 receive a 50% discount on the entry fee. Registration and pick-up of start numbers take place from 9:00 to 9:30 on the race day. It is recommended to write medications, allergies, and a contact person on the back of the start number for medical emergencies. The terrain includes paved and asphalt paths; registration is available online and on-site; the event is part of a series of runs supporting national memory.

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Jihlava
location: Český mlýn, Jihlava, Vysočina, Czech Republic
organizer: Post Bellum, z. ú. a Parlament Gymnázia Jihlava
price_range: on-line registrace od 200 Kč, na místě od 300 Kč
description: Run for the Nation's Memory in Jihlava is a sports and social event organized to support the non-profit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of witnesses and helps them. The race takes place at the Český mlýn area with start and finish behind the skatepark. Runners can choose from timed runs of 4 km and 10 km, or untimed children's and family races. The event is suitable for all age groups and offers a pleasant environment on paved cycle paths. The entry fee is a donation for a good cause and supports the Memory of the Nation.
course_highlights: The route runs along paved cycle paths in the Český mlýn area
Start and finish are located behind the skatepark in the area
Offers timed runs of 4 km and 10 km, as well as untimed children's and family races
additional: Students, members of the Memory of the Nation club, and runners over 65 years old receive a 50% discount on the entry fee. Hygienic facilities, water at the finish, and refreshments are available. Registration and bib pickup take place on the race day at specified times. Results are announced after the runners finish. Paved paths, registration details, support for various race categories.

name: Night Run Trenčín
location: Klub Lúč, Mierové námestie, Trenčín, Slovakia
price_range: 12 € až 35 € v závislosti od registrácie a kategórie
description: Night Run Trenčín is a running event taking place on May 23, 2026, in Trenčín, at the Lúč club and, in favorable weather, at Mierové námestie. Runners have the opportunity to challenge themselves in a pleasant evening city atmosphere. Registration is available online until May 21, 2026, or on the day of the race at the venue if the participant limit has not been reached. The organizer provides electronic timing and refreshments on the course. The event is suitable for runners aged 12 and above, with younger participants needing parental consent.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Lúč club or at Mierové námestie in favorable weather
Electronic timing at the start, finish, and at 4 km
Option to use city parking near Trenčianska brána
additional: Registration for participants is from 17:00 to 20:40 at the Lúč club, and in favorable weather at Mierové námestie. Men and women over 60 years old do not pay an entry fee but must be registered online. The minimum age for participants is 12 years; those under 15 require parental consent. The organizer is not responsible for property or health damages. Electronic timing is provided by SunBell s.r.o. - VysledkovyServis.sk, and results will be published continuously on vysledkovyservis.sk. Night run, online and on-site registration, start from 17:00 to 20:40, possibility to use city facilities, health data on the race bib.

name: Dynasport beh na Vtáčnik
description: Dynasport Race to Vtáčnik is a challenging mountain run in the vicinity of Kamenec under Vtáčnik, offering three courses with different distances and elevation gains. Participants can choose from a 50 km course with 2000 m elevation gain, a 27 km course with 1000 m elevation gain, or an 8.4 km course with 380 m elevation gain. Each course has its own time limit and categories for women and men up to and over 40 years old. The race starts at a farm below Vtáčnik and refreshments are provided at several points along the route. The organizer emphasizes mandatory equipment and runner safety.
course_highlights: 50 km course with +2000 m elevation gain and a 10-hour time limit
27 km course with +1000 m elevation gain and a 5-hour time limit
8.4 km course with +380 m elevation gain and a 2-hour time limit
additional: On the 50 km route, there are three refreshment stations at 9 km, 27 km, and 44 km. Mandatory equipment includes identification documents, a charged mobile phone, a map or GPX file, a personal folding cup or bottle with a minimum volume of 1.5 dl, a first aid kit (thermal foil, elastic bandage), and at least 0.5 liters of water. The start number must be visibly placed on the front of the body throughout the race. Recommended equipment includes a waterproof jacket in case of rain. Route lengths: 50 km, 27 km, 8 km; elevation gains: +2000 m, +1000 m, +380 m; mandatory equipment, refreshment stations along the routes, time limits of 10, 5, and 2 hours.

name: Petržalská 10
price_range: 20 € (online pred 1. aprílom 2026), 25 € (po, do uzávierky registrácie); deti 6-8 €
description: Petržalská 10 is a popular running race in Bratislava, held at Námestie Republiky in Petržalka. The race offers various categories including a children's run, the main 10 km run, Nordic walking, and a family run with dogs. The children's races start at 10:00 AM and the main run at 11:30 AM. The organizer is Športová Nadácia Kotrmelec, which ensures a pleasant atmosphere and quality organization for all participants.
course_highlights: The course runs in Bratislava-Petržalka, start and finish at Námestie Republiky
Main 10 km run with categories for men, women, and Nordic walking
Family run with dogs over 1.8 km and children's run over 5 km
additional: Children up to 5 years old and children from child and family centers (CDR) can participate for free. Categories include men and women in various age groups, 5 km Nordic walking, and a family run with dogs over 1.8 km. Multiple categories include 5 km, family run, and Nordic walking; starts at 10:00 AM and 11:30 AM; online registration; venue at Námestie Republiky in Petržalka.

name: Medzinárodný Novohradský Maratón štafety
description: The International Novohrad Marathon Relay is a running relay marathon taking place on May 23, 2026, on a route between the towns of Salgótarján in Hungary and Lučenec in Slovakia. The course is 42.2 km long and divided into four segments run by four relay runners. The race is open to men's, women's, and mixed relays with a minimum ratio of 50% women and 50% men. Refreshment stations are provided along the route, and at the finish line, participants can enjoy goulash, sports cups, and monetary prizes for the best relays. Runners start at 10:00 AM, and registration is possible until May 21, 2026, online or on-site if spots are available.
course_highlights: The route passes through Salgótarján, Šiatorská, Rátka, Rapovce, and Lučenec
The relay has 4 segments: 11 km, 10 km, 10.7 km, and 10.5 km
Refreshments at each relay exchange point and goulash at the finish line
additional: Registration is valid upon payment of the start fee. Capacity is limited to 20 relays. A relay team consists of 4 runners, and relay exchanges are only permitted at designated points. The total course time limit is 4 hours. Strict prohibition of accompaniment on the route (car, bicycle, scooter) for safety reasons. The start is open to runners from 15 years old. The race is run on the left side of the road with full traffic. The event is intended for participants aged 15 and above, emphasizing safety and adherence to rules. The event also includes accompanying cultural activities and online registration.

name: Memoriál Františka Daniša – cezpoľný beh
description: The František Daniš Memorial - Cross Country Race is a running event held in the village of Trstín, Trnava district, on a football pitch. The course mainly runs on a field and grassy path with a partial section of asphalt sidewalk. Various age categories compete, including men, women, juniors, and residents of Trstín, with some categories running two laps. The event is suitable for runners who enjoy natural surfaces and cross country running in the pleasant environment of Trstín.
course_highlights: The course is three-quarters on a field and grassy path
One-quarter of the course is on an asphalt sidewalk
The race takes place on a football pitch in Trstín
additional: Categories are divided by age and gender, some categories run two laps, and residents of Trstín have their own category. Local contacts: Municipality of Trstín, phone 033/558 92 62, email outrstin@slovanet.sk, mayor Peter Hlávek, phone 0918 775 109, email starosta@trstin.sk. The event includes multiple categories and is part of the spring health run, with on-site registration available. Registration can be arranged through the organizers' contact information.

name: Hlbocký boyard – extrémny beh s prekážkami
description: Hlbocký Boyard is an extreme individual race taking place on May 23, 2026, in the village of Hlboké nad Váhom. This is the 6th edition offering a single course with numerous adrenaline-pumping obstacles and steep hills on a motocross track. Competitors will race in nine categories based on age and gender, including children's categories. Participants will enjoy fresh air, challenges on the course, and after the race, they will receive awards, refreshments, and commemorative items.
course_highlights: Course length of 9 - 10 km with many new obstacles compared to previous editions
Steep hills and adrenaline obstacles on a motocross track
Drinking water at the start and along the course, refreshments and goulash after the race
additional: Registration for competitors begins at 07:45 AM at the area near the football field. The start is staggered, with the first start for the children's Boyard, followed by starts every 5 minutes with 4-5 competitors each. The registration fee includes a medal, a commemorative item, a ticket for goulash and a drink, a sweet treat, water, and refreshments on the course. Showers with hot water are available in the football cabins after the race. Spectators have free access to the entire course. Parking is free. The race takes place regardless of weather conditions. Registration can be done in advance with payment. The registration includes medals and refreshments. The registration period runs from March to May 2025.

name: Jacovská dvadsiatka
description: Jacovská dvadsiatka is a running race organized in Jacovce at the football stadium. The race offers two courses - a main 22 km and a hobby run of 8 km, which run on asphalt and field roads with gravel. The start is scheduled for 10:00 for the 22 km and 10:15 for the 8 km. The race is suitable for various age categories and genders, organized by ATK Javorina Jacovce. The entry fee is available at affordable prices, making the event accessible to a wide running community.
course_highlights: 50% asphalt roads and 50% field roads with gravel
Two courses: 22 km and 8 km
Start at the football stadium in Jacovce
additional: Categories for the 22 km are divided by age: up to 39 years, from 40 to 49 years, 50 years and above; for the 8 km, categories are men and women. The start is divided into two waves: 10:00 for 22 km and 10:15 for 8 km. 50% asphalt and 50% field roads, registration available via email, sale or exchange of starting numbers, the race takes place on May 23, 2026.

name: Kostolanský májovec
description: Kostolanský májovec is a running event organized by run ForRest run o.z., held at the Michal Podolan football stadium in Veľké Kostoľany. Participants can choose between two courses measuring 10.90 km and 5.40 km, both with an elevation gain of 64 meters and a surface combining asphalt and meadow. The start is scheduled for 11:00 AM, and competitors are divided into age categories with awards for the fastest Kostolanec and Kostolanka. The event offers refreshments and is suitable for runners seeking a pleasant run with slight elevation in a beautiful environment.
course_highlights: Course 10.90 km with elevation gain +64 m
Course 5.40 km with elevation gain +64 m
Surface 50% asphalt and 50% meadow
additional: The race results will be announced at 12:45 PM. To be classified in categories, the year of birth is decisive. For the fastest Kostolancov/Kostolanky, it is necessary to specify the municipality Veľké Kostoľany during registration. Number of refreshment stations on the course: 1. The race is conducted according to traffic rules. Participants are responsible for their own health insurance. The course is mostly flat, registration is possible online and on-site, the event includes categories for various age groups, and it is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners.

name: Sninský trailový polmaratón
description: Sninský trailový polmaratón is a running event in Snina, Slovakia, offering two courses - a main 21 km course and a shorter 7.5 km course. The race is designed for all trail running enthusiasts who want to enjoy the beauty of nature and the challenge of terrain. Organizers welcome runners of all levels and provide a quality sports event atmosphere.
course_highlights: Trail running in the natural environment of Snina
Two course options: 21 km and 7.5 km
Challenge for runners of all levels
additional: The race is suitable for runners of all levels, with the option to register online or on-site, and includes various categories including children and youth.

name: Beh Soviou Poľanou
description: The Soviou Poľanou Run in Podolínec is a forest running race that offers quality training and an opportunity to test your abilities in mountain terrain. The race is suitable for runners who want to experience an exhilarating day in nature and prepare for important races in the season. The course runs through picturesque forests around Podolínec and provides a challenge even for experienced runners.
course_highlights: Forest courses around Podolínec
Mountain terrain with natural obstacles
Scenic views in the Poľana area
additional: Children's runs and multiple course options including 11 km and 18 km variants are available. Maps, posters, and regulations can be downloaded. Registration is conducted online via the official website. The race is part of a series with the possibility of online registration and various categories, including a children's run. The event aims to promote trail running in nature and offers attractive prizes for the best in each category.

name: Turčiansky beh
description: Turčiansky Run is a charity running race held on May 23, 2026, at the football stadium in Belá - Dulice. Runners can choose between a 5 km or 10 km route, which runs through slightly hilly terrain along a country road and gravel path with an elevation gain of 40 to 80 meters. The event supports a good cause, as all proceeds will go towards the treatment of a 4-year-old boy with autism and the project "Children of My Heart." Participants will receive gifts, raffle tickets, commemorative medals, and entertainment for children, while parents can run and children are cared for. Refreshments and parking are available at the start and finish areas.
course_highlights: Route runs along a country road and gravel path
Elevation gain of 40 to 80 meters, slightly hilly
Start and finish at Belá Dulice football stadium
additional: Registration takes place on the day of the race from 8:00 to 11:00. Before the start, each participant receives a drink, a protein bar, and a gift from partners. The entry fee includes one raffle ticket with the option to purchase additional tickets. After finishing, each runner receives a commemorative medal. There are entertainment activities with professional animators and attractions for children. Parking is available near the start/finish area. Refreshments and drinks can be purchased on site. Virtual participants will receive a gift and medal sent to their address after the event. The terrain includes country roads and asphalt; parking is available at the start/finish, and changing rooms, showers, and refreshments are available on site. name: Tolarova pětka
description: Tolarova pětka is a running race held in Stříbro, offering a course of 5 kilometers. The race is part of the calendar of the Stříbro Endurance Association and is intended for amateur and recreational runners. The route runs through the city park and is suitable for all age groups. After the race, results are announced and refreshments are provided for participants.
course_highlights: The course runs through the city park across Svatováclavská bridge
The race takes place in the evening from 18:00
Friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to run in a group
additional: The race is part of the Tachovsko Runner series. After the race, results are announced and refreshments are provided. The organizer is the Stříbro Endurance Association, z.s., which supports amateur and recreational athletes. Registrations and prices are not explicitly listed on the website. The race is part of the local sports calendar; exact distances and categories are not specified.

name: Běh cestou necestou 13 km Prahou 13
description: Run the Unconventional Path is a running race held in Prague 13, offering courses of 13 km and 5 km. The race takes participants through scenic corners of Central Park Stodůlky and the Prokop Valley Nature Park. The start is on Sunday, May 24, 2026, at 13:13:13. Runners can enjoy refreshments on the course and at the finish line. The event is open to everyone and is conducted in the spirit of fair play, emphasizing adherence to the marked route.
course_highlights: The route passes through Central Park Stodůlky and Prokop Valley Nature Park
Refreshments at 8 km and at the finish for the 13 km course, refreshments at the finish for the 5 km course
Start and finish near the refreshment area Kuželkárna
additional: Start of the race is also possible on-site on the race day, May 21, 2026. Awards are given to the top 3 in each category, divided by age, with a minimum of 4 runners in each category. Participants under 18 years old may only start with parental consent. The organizer reserves the right to change the program and rules without prior notice. Photos and videos may be used for promotional purposes without compensation. The race takes place on May 24, 2026, with registration available online and on-site. The event also includes training runs and safety regulations.

name: Teplýšovický běh
description: The Teplýšovice Run is a charity race held in the picturesque village of Teplýšovice near Benešov. In 2026, the 6th edition will take place with courses of 5 km, 10 km, 15 km trail, 11 km Nordic Walking, and children's races. The main course passes through the Špulka lookout tower and offers beautiful nature and a challenging route. All courses are measured with chip timing, and each participant will receive a medal. The registration fee partly contributes to the restoration of fruit alleys in the area.
course_highlights: Main trail of 15 km passes through the Špulka lookout tower
Sprint 5 km course across the local pasture with the possibility of meeting cows
Nordic Walking 11 km follows the main trail
additional: Registration is also possible on the day of the race with the risk that medals may not be available for participants. Most routes are measured with IRONTIME chip timing. Children's races are divided into age categories and include a 650 m obstacle race for children. The registration fee contributes to the purchase of mature fruit trees for the restoration of alleys in the area. Course options: 15 km trail, 5 km run, 1300 m children's course, 10 km Nordic Walking, 650 m children's obstacle run; online registration until May 25, 2023, or May 22, 2025; proceeds go to tree planting and landscape restoration.

name: Vysocká pětka - vzpomínka na Jirku S.
location: Vysoká nad Labem, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
description: Vysocká pětka is a 5 km running race held in the village of Vysoká nad Labem. The race is a memorial to Jirka S. and is traditionally run along the cycle path. The start is scheduled for 9:00 AM with registration from 8:00 AM. The event is open to all runners and offers a friendly atmosphere with the possibility of winning a raffle.
course_highlights: Length of the course 5 km
Race along the cycle path
Friendly atmosphere with a raffle
additional: Participant registration from 8:00 AM, race start at 9:00 AM, the race is run along the cycle path, possibility of winning in the raffle. The race is part of the local sports calendar and is open to the general public. Exact course lengths and registration information have not yet been published.

price_range: Kč 0,- to Kč 300,- podle registrace a způsobu platby

tiers.label: tier_2

description: Suchdol Run is part of the seventh edition of the running series Run with us 2026, which is intended for the general public. The race takes place on Sunday, May 24, 2026, in Prague 6 - Suchdol, with start and finish in the Community Garden area. The course runs along paved field and forest paths with an elevation gain of 96 meters, offering runners a pleasant run on flat terrain and a downhill into the valley, with return via forest paths. Categories are divided into children and adults according to age groups, with participants under 18 only allowed to start with written consent from a legal guardian.
course_highlights: The course runs along paved field and forest paths
Downhill into Roztok towards Únětický Stream
Elevation gain of 96 meters for the adult circuit
additional: Start for children at 11:00, for adults at 13:00. Registration no later than 30 minutes before the start. Chip timing, start number with chip is mandatory to wear on the upper front part of the body throughout the race. The race takes place in any weather; the organizer reserves the right to cancel the race in case of extremely adverse conditions. Starts are scheduled at 11:00 for children and 13:00 for adults, online registration is available, parking is provided on Suchdolská Street, and the race course is the same as in previous editions.

name: Půlmaraton údolím Moravské Sázavy

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: přihlášení do 15.5.2026 – 500 CZK – po tento termín bude jméno závodníka vytištěno na čísle

description: The Moravská Sázava Valley Half Marathon is a traditional running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Zábřeh and its vicinity. The 21.0975 km course is certified according to IAAF rules and mainly runs on flat terrain with slight inclines between Nemilí and Hněvkov. The race is part of the Great Prize of Runners of the Olomouc Region and offers quality facilities including refreshment stations and timing with chip technology. The start is at 10:00 AM from the Swimming Complex in Zábřeh, with runners expected to finish in under 2:30 hours able to start at 9:30 AM. After the race, a buffet with refreshments and medals for all participants is available.
course_highlights: Certified 21.0975 km course mainly on flat terrain
Surface: asphalt, with sections of gravel, cobblestones, and a concrete cycle path
Four refreshment stations with isotonic drinks, water, and fruit
additional: The start is at the Swimming Complex in Zábřeh. Runners with an expected time of 2:30 - 3:00 can start at 9:30 AM. The race has a time limit of 3 hours. On the course, there are 4 refreshment stations with isotonic drinks, water, bananas, apples, raisins, and salt. At the finish line, there is a buffet with drinks (Welzl beer, draft lemonade) and pasta salad. Lockers are available for 10 CZK. Parking is at the pool above Oborník Street; the race finish is directly in front of the pool, where parking is not possible. A children's race for the youngest participants is also organized. Registration is open until May 21, 2026, with an option to order a running shirt. The course is certified, and the race starts at 10:00 AM.

name: VeganRun
description: VeganRun Slovakia is the first official Slovak vegan run organized by the Slovak Vegan Society. The event combines sport, health, and compassion, offering more than just a run – it is a collective step towards a healthier body, a cleaner planet, and an informed society. The routes lead from the iconic Amphitheatre in Rača through the interface of the Carpathian forest and vineyards, providing forest therapy, diverse terrain, and epic views of Bratislava. Participants can choose between 5 km, 10 km, and Canicross disciplines, which allow running with a dog.
course_highlights: Routes pass through the Carpathian forest and blooming vineyards with fresh air and shade of trees
Panoramic views of Bratislava from vineyard paths
Diverse terrain from soft forest trails to winding paths in the Little Carpathians
additional: Timing is available on all routes. The option to run with a dog in the Canicross discipline. The routes are suitable for beginners and advanced runners. The proceeds from the event support animals in shelters and an educational program on plant-based nutrition for doctors. The event is charitable and supports educational programs on plant-based nutrition, with proceeds donated to animal shelters and medical education.

name: Bytčiansky Kros
organizer: Behači Bytča a okolie, v spolupráci s Mesto Bytča
description: Bytčiansky Cross is a traditional running race in Bytča, offering four courses of varying lengths and difficulty levels, including the Super Cross with a length of 21 km and an elevation gain of 500 m. The course mainly runs through terrain such as dirt roads, meadows, and cycle paths, with 80% off-road surface and 20% paved surface. Participants can expect three refreshment stations on the longer routes and thorough course marking. The competitions are divided by age categories for both men and women, with the top three in each category being awarded.
course_highlights: Super Cross 21 km with an elevation gain of +500 m
Course runs 80% through terrain and 20% on paved surfaces
Three refreshment stations on longer routes
additional: Participants on the Super Cross 21 km course must have downloaded the GPS file of the course map to their phone or watch and carry a charged and functional mobile phone. The course is marked with ribbons, arrows, and volunteers. The route has changed compared to previous editions due to the cycle path, running on the left side of the Váh Canal. Registration includes the mandatory download of the GPS file and readiness on the mobile phone; the race takes place on various terrains including asphalt, dirt roads, and cycle paths.

name: TEMPO MAKERS RUN Plzeň – květnový závod
location: Baumax, Plzeň, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: TEMPO MAKERS RUN Plzeň is a regular running race held in Pilsen, offering a course length of 8 km. The race takes place on a cycle path in the Pytel area and is open to all age categories. The start is scheduled for the evening, allowing runners to enjoy a pleasant atmosphere and shared time with other running enthusiasts. Organizers emphasize safety and fairness, with the race being measured manually and held in all weather conditions except extreme conditions.
course_highlights: The course runs along a cycle path in Pytel
The race distance is 8 km
The race takes place in the evening from 18:00
additional: The race is measured manually, with a time limit of 1 hour and 15 minutes. Runners must wear a visible bib on their chest. The race is held in all weather conditions; the organizer reserves the right to cancel the race in case of extreme weather. It is open to all age groups; participants under 15 must be accompanied by an adult over 18. The race supports charitable projects. Registration is possible online or on-site. The course is flat and runs alongside the Úslava River.

name: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli - květen
description: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli is a running race organized by the group Plzeňští Tempo Makers, who are dedicated to organizing running races, charity runs, and running trainings. The event takes place in the picturesque location of Pytle in Plzeň and offers an opportunity for runners of all levels. The race is part of the running community that promotes an active lifestyle and sporting enthusiasm.
course_highlights: Flat profile along the Úslava River
Length of 7.5 km suitable for all levels of runners
Pleasant environment in the center of Plzeň and around the river
additional: The race takes place in Pytle, registration is possible online or on-site, the event is part of the running community in Plzeň.

name: Okolo svaté Juliány

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné: 50 Kč (junioři, juniorky a veteráni nad 70 let dobrovolné)

description: Around Saint Juliána is a running race in Prague-Přední Kopanina with a course length of 5600 meters, mainly along forest paths with minimal elevation gain. The start and registration take place at a tourist shelter on the cycle path in K Juliána Street, easily accessible by public transport. The race is open to various categories including juniors, adults, and veterans, and offers a friendly atmosphere with parking options nearby. The entry fee is symbolic, with a voluntary contribution for some categories.
course_highlights: Course 5600 m, one lap
Mostly forest paths with the first 600 m on asphalt
Minimal elevation gain
additional: Start and registration at a tourist shelter on the cycle path in K Juliána Street, signage from bus stops 161 and 312 (about 5 minutes walk). Parking in adjacent streets, preferably in K padesátníku Street. Categories: Juniors, young women, men and women up to 39 years old, veterans and veteran women in various age groups. The race is suitable for runners and cyclists, offering an opportunity to explore the historic site of Saint Juliána and enjoy a sporting atmosphere in nature.

name: Koutecká vertikála
location: Ski areál Kouty nad Desnou, Kouty nad Desnou, Šumperk, Czech Republic
description: Koutecká vertikála is an uphill race 2.5 km long with an elevation gain of 510 meters, held at the Kouty nad Desnou ski resort. The race features an interval start and is part of the Chlapácký běh series, which includes cross-country races in Šumperk and the surrounding area. This race offers a challenging and dynamic uphill run, ideal for mountain running enthusiasts and vertical challenge seekers.
course_highlights: Distance of the course 2.5 km
Elevation gain of 510 m
Interval start at Kouty nad Desnou ski resort
additional: Uphill race, part of the cross-country race series, opportunity for children to participate, suitable for runners seeking a challenge in hilly terrain.

name: Rasokros
location: Krčský les, Praha 4, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic
description: Cross-country is a running race in Krčský Forest in Prague 4, offering a 7.5 km course for men and a 2.5 km course for women. The race is part of the SABZO series and is suitable for runners seeking a pleasant cross-country run in a natural environment. The route runs through forest terrain and provides an opportunity to enjoy running in a peaceful part of Prague. The race is open to the general public and welcomes all runners who want to test their strength in this attractive event.
course_highlights: Forest terrain in Krčský Forest
7.5 km course for men and 2.5 km for women
Part of the SABZO series
additional: The race is very demanding with a total elevation gain of approximately 315 meters for men. The start is at 17:00, registration is possible online, and the race takes place in Krčský Forest near Hotel Nosál.

name: 3. Pekelný kilometr
location: Peklák, Česká Třebová, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: Hellish Kilometer is a uphill running race held at the Peklák ski resort in Česká Třebová. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup 2026 series and offers a 1 km course with an interval start, leading to the ski slope over grass, snow, and roads depending on the weather. The children's race starts at 17:00, and the main 1 km race begins at 18:00. The race is suitable for a wide range of age categories and is known for its atmosphere and challenging ascent.
course_highlights: Uphill run to the ski slope
Interval start except for the youngest children
Course surface: grass, snow, roads depending on weather
additional: Registrations are possible on-site. Award ceremonies for the youngest categories are held immediately, while for other categories, the top three times are considered, with a ceremonial award after the last race on August 26, 2026. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup 2026, and the overall standings count towards this series. The race takes place on Wednesday evening, the course is short and steep, crossing the ski slope and forest roads, and is designed for a wide age range from children to adults.
