description: Kunětická devítka is a traditional Wednesday cross-country running race around Kunětická Mountain, offering two routes - a short loop of 4.5 km suitable for everyone and a long loop of 9 km for more experienced runners. The race is known for its relaxed atmosphere, where runners with various ambitions meet, and emphasizes the joy of racing and good spirits after finishing. The event takes place at the parking lot near Staročeská hospoda and is the largest sporting running event on a weekday in the Pardubice Region. The organizer invites all runners to enjoy the race and the beautiful surroundings of Kunětická Mountain.
course_highlights: Short loop of 4.5 km suitable for everyone
Long loop of 9 km with long flat sections, terrain, and a climb up Kunětická Mountain via stairs
Start and finish at the parking lot near Staročeská hospoda under Kunětická Mountain
additional: Registration of competitors takes place at the finish area from 17:00 to 17:50 from April to August. An isotonic drink is available after the race. A start number for the entire series can be purchased for 50 CZK once at the first start of the year. Categories are divided by age and gender. Runners participate at their own risk, and written parental consent is required for minors. Cross-country running, start at the parking lot near Staročeská hospoda, race held on May 27, 2026.

name: BĚKODO – květen III
description: BĚKODO is a traditional 40th edition of a stage running race in Teplice, designed for fitness, recreational, and competitive runners from 15 years old. The race consists of ten best starts during the season, with the better time deciding in case of a tie in points. The measurement limit for judges is 35 minutes, after which the runner's time is recorded as 35+. A separate series for young runners, Young BĚKODO, is prepared for younger participants. The organizer is TJ Lokomotiva Teplice and BK Běkodo.
course_highlights: Stage race with ten best starts counted towards the overall score
Time measurement limit of 35 minutes with the possibility to finish after the limit
Designed for runners from 15 years old, with a separate series for young runners
additional: Start is only permitted for runners from 15 years old (born in 2011 or earlier). Younger runners can participate in the separate series Young BĚKODO. The race is mainly held on Wednesdays, except for the 3rd round, which takes place on Saturday, April 18th (Memorial Čudla Vorlíček). The race features a multi-phase format with the possibility to track the top 10 performances. Registration is open for runners from 15 years old. The race takes place in a natural environment under Teplická Doubravka.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (6) – květnový
description: Come run on a pleasant and fast course along the Vltava River in Prague Braník, where personal records are often broken! The race is part of the 16th edition of regular runs of 5 and 10 km VAŠÍ LIGA, which take place every month. You can compare yourself with other runners and track your progress throughout the year. The course is certified, and for the 10 km distance, it is possible to achieve the limit for the Czech Republic Championship. After the race, a relaxed atmosphere with refreshments and the announcement of the best runners is prepared.
course_highlights: Fast course along the Vltava River in Prague Braník
Course measured with a certified measuring device
Opportunity to meet the limit for the Czech Republic Championship at 10 km
additional: The run is timed with a chip timing system, and each runner also has a measured "chip" time. Registration takes place at the blue tent by the cycle path near U Kempinku 2, Prague. After the race, you can replenish your energy and vitamins at the restaurant in the Hamr Braník complex. Restrooms are available at the Hamr Braník complex (300 meters from the start). Bag storage is possible at the organizer’s tent. Cancellation from the race is possible up to 24 hours before the start with a refund of the entry fee. The races include various terrain types, from urban routes to trail sections, and are open to runners of all levels. Registration is available online, and the series offers regular updates on results and schedules.

name: Leśna Piątka Pikuś
location: Parking przy ścieżce edukacyjnej Nadleśnictwa Karnieszewice, Koszalin, Poland
description: Leśna Piątka Pikuś is a cross-country race held in the picturesque forest of Nadleśnictwo Karnieszewice in Koszalin. The 10 km route runs through charming forest areas, featuring numerous ascents, descents, and a section near a deep ravine, making the race demanding and full of experiences. Every participant who completes the distance receives a commemorative medal. The start and finish are located at the parking lot near the educational trail, ensuring easy access and organizational comfort.
course_highlights: A 10 km route covering one full lap
Passing through charming forest areas of Nadleśnictwo Karnieszewice
A section of the route near a deep ravine, requiring attention and providing unique experiences
additional: The start and finish of the race are located at the parking lot near the educational trail of Nadleśnictwo Karnieszewice on Słupska Street in Koszalin. The route includes various ascents and descents, wet and dry areas, ensuring full running diversity. Each participant receives a commemorative medal upon crossing the finish line. Medals are awarded, and registration and results are available online. The race enjoys great local popularity and brings together the running community in Koszalin.

name: Černovírská osmička
description: Cernovír Eight is a traditional running race organized by the Central Moravian Endurance Sports Association in Olomouc-Cernovír. The race is part of the Hanácký Running Cup, which offers courses of various lengths and is open to all runners regardless of age or performance. The course takes place through the scenic environment of the Olomouc region and is suitable for both beginners and experienced endurance runners. The organizers emphasize a relaxed atmosphere and high-quality race organization.
course_highlights: The route passes through the scenic environment of the Olomouc region
Part of the Hanácký Running Cup with courses from 5 to 42 km
The race is open to all age categories and performance levels
additional: Registration is conducted via a credit system with a chip card used for electronic timing. The entry fee is paid from preloaded credit on an account at Fio Bank. Runners can top up their credit in cash after the results are announced. The race is part of the year-round Hanácký Running Cup series, where points are awarded based on placement in individual races. The race includes trail/cross running, starts at 18:00, registration via the website, and takes place in Olomouc-Cernovír at the Bulgarian Club.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Warszawa – edycja nocna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Warszawa - edycja nocna 2026 is cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts who have been promoting this sport since 2014. The event takes place in picturesque locations, and the night edition features unique medals for participants. The race is friendly for runners who appreciate scenic routes and a community atmosphere.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in scenic locations of Warsaw
Night edition with unique medals
Organized by experienced running enthusiasts
additional: After the race, participants receive special medals different from those of the spring edition. Organizers emphasize the aesthetic qualities of the routes and the event atmosphere. There is an option to join the newsletter to stay updated with event information. Night race, scenic routes, medals, registration via website

name: Kamenická 15
location: Kamenice u Jihlavy, Vysočina, Czech Republic
price_range: 100 Kč (online), 150 Kč (na místě), zdarma pro mládež do 17 let

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 100 Kè - muži, junioři, ženy, juniorky přihlášené on-line.

description: Kamenická 15 is a traditional running race in Kamenice near Jihlava, offering adult runners a 15 km large loop on asphalt roads and paths. Youth have access to shorter loops of 1.75 km and 0.4 km on asphalt roads within the village. The course passes through scenic parts of the surroundings, including the Brodek settlement, Zátiší Chateau, and Cípy gamekeeper's lodge, with the finish at the start point. The race is suitable for a wide age range from 3 years old and offers a pleasant atmosphere with refreshments and prizes for winners and youth.
course_highlights: Large 15 km loop on asphalt roads and paths
Course passing through Brodek settlement, Zátiší Chateau, and Cípy gamekeeper's lodge
Youth loops of 1.75 km and 0.4 km within the village
additional: Each participant receives a voucher for refreshments at the U Raimunda restaurant. Monetary rewards for breaking course records: men 1000 CZK, women 500 CZK. Bus transportation from Jihlava and back is provided. Categories for children and youth are divided by age with possible route changes. The main race is 15 km on asphalt roads; shorter loops are available for youth; registration is possible online before 12:00 on race day; the event includes refreshments and prizes for winners.

name: Kapličkobraní

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné od 170 Kč 100% jde na charitu

description: Kapličkobraní is a charitable non-competitive run that takes participants around 13 chapels in the vicinity of Ludgeřovice and Markvartovice, with a total of 14 stops including the finish line. The route, approximately 10-12 km long, is suitable for running, walking, cycling, Nordic walking, or even with a stroller. The event has a deeper meaning, and all proceeds go to the family of Jan Rieml to support his sons Šimon and Matěj. Participants will receive a commemorative magnet, light refreshments at the finish, and a tasting of parish wine at one of the chapels. Kapličkobraní was awarded for the best sports project with a low budget for small organizations.
course_highlights: The route passes around 13 chapels in the vicinity of Ludgeřovice and Markvartovice
The length of the route is 10-12 km, suitable for running, walking, cycling, Nordic walking, and strollers
Tasting of parish wine at one of the chapels
additional: A commemorative magnet in medal design for the first 200 at the presentation. Light refreshments are available at the finish. There are changing rooms, showers, and convenient parking. The event is charitable, with 100% of the proceeds going to support Jan Rieml's family. There is an option to donate the entry fee to company employees via invoice or donation agreement with free registration codes. The event offers various activities, refreshments, parking, changing rooms, and showers. The route is suitable for running, walking, cycling, and Nordic walking.

name: Běh mimoňským parkem
location: Zámecký park, Mimoň, Liberec, Czech Republic
description: The Mimoň Park Run is a race held in the castle park in Mimoň, offering a flat course on paved paths along the Ploučnice River. The race is divided into loops of 7 kilometers, with options for 7 km and 21 km distances. The event is suitable for the general public as well as competitive runners, and is organized by Lenka Zeťová. The main category starts at 5:00 PM, with the first category beginning as early as 9:00 AM. The race is part of the Czech Running Club and is organized under the auspices of the Czech Athletic Federation.
course_highlights: Flat course on paved paths
7 km loop along the Ploučnice River
Start in the castle park in Mimoň
additional: Race registration takes place at the swimming pool, with the start at Vranovská Avenue. The race is of a mixed type with 7 km and 21 km courses. The organizer is Lenka Zeťová, who can also be contacted by phone at 777 909 842. The races are held in the picturesque environment of Mimoň Park, with participation options for children and adults, and are part of the running league. Registration and details are available on the official website.

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Nové Město na Moravě
location: Vysočina Arena, Nové Město na Moravě, Vysočina, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: rodinný závod 2 km - registrace on-line/na místě od 100 Kč

description: The Run for the Nation's Memory in Nové Město na Moravě is a charity event organized to support the non-profit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of witnesses and helps preserve historical memories. The race takes place at Vysočina Arena and its surroundings with routes of 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km, with 5 km being one lap and 10 km two laps. The event offers both timed and untimed runs, including a family and children's race, and is suitable for the general public, including pupils, students, and seniors with the possibility of a discount on the entry fee. The start and finish are at Vysočina Arena stadium, which provides facilities including changing rooms, a storage area, and refreshments.
course_highlights: Routes run on asphalt, paved, and forest paths at Vysočina Arena and surroundings
The 5 km course consists of one lap, the 10 km course of two laps
Start and finish at Vysočina Arena stadium with complete facilities
additional: Registration and pickup of race numbers take place on the race day from 15:00 to 16:30. Pupils, students under 18, members of the Memory of the Nation club, and runners over 65 years old receive a 50% discount on the entry fee. Changing rooms, storage, sanitary facilities, and water are available at the finish. Race distances: 2 km, 5 km, 10 km; terrain: road; registration fee: 100-400 CZK; race held at Vysočina Arena.

name: Beh v Raji – prológ
description: The Run in Paradise is a traditional running race held in the beautiful surroundings of Dobšinská Ice Cave and its vicinity. Participants can choose from several courses including a prologue, half marathon, 10 km, and 5 km routes, which mainly run on asphalt roads with partial traffic closure. The prologue is a hilly 1 km run through a forest trail from the parking lot to the ice cave. The event is suitable for the general public and also offers Nordic walking.

Half marathon route runs on an asphalt road through the village of Stratená and Stratenská Píla
10 km and 5 km routes are flat and run on asphalt roads with partial traffic closure
additional: Registration for participants is at the OOCR building. The prologue starts on Friday, May 29, 2026 from 16:00 to 17:15, with Saturday's races on May 30, 2026 from 8:00 to 10:40. Participants will receive a headband made of functional material with the Run in Paradise logo (first 300 registered) and refreshments after crossing the finish line. The races are held with partial road closure, with one lane reserved for runners. The race time limit is 2 hours and 30 minutes. The event includes categories for men and women, with a start at 17:30. Registration is possible on the website. The race is supported by the Košice Region.

The start is scheduled for 17:30, with categories for men, women, local runners, and Nordic Walking. Participants will receive a start number, a timing chip, refreshments, and a finisher's medal.

Grass track at the stadium
Two disciplines: 7 km run and 4 km Nordic Walking

Refreshments and medals for winners are provided.

Picturesque and aesthetic natural surroundings

organizer: Wyższa Szkoła Biznesu National-Louis University w Nowym Sączu

This is a special initiative organized by the community of the University of Business - National Louis University in cooperation with the Sursum Corda Association, aimed at supporting the treatment and rehabilitation of children with serious illnesses. This year, the run is dedicated to two children: Milena Ząber, who is suffering from the rare neurodegenerative disease CLN2, and Maciej Bogoń, fighting a brain tumor. Participating in the run is not only a sporting competition but above all a support for children in need and their families.

Opportunity to participate both in traditional and online formats
Distances from 150 m to 4 km, adapted for different age groups

The run is open to various age groups, offers an online option, and supports fundraising for children's treatment, with the event being supported by the Sursum Corda Association.

The race attracts both top competitors and amateurs who want to challenge the legendary ascent to the "Ślęża Olympic".

The race runs along a dirt road and the yellow trail through the Wieżyca summit
Finish at the Ślęża summit near the shelter

The registration pack includes a soft blanket, which can be used during the picnic after the race. The atmosphere of the event is family-friendly and literary, making it a unique experience.

Family Run of approximately 200 m
Integration feast in Frampol with literary accents and regional dishes
additional: The start package includes a soft blanket for use during the post-race picnic. description: The Gold Duck Run is an annual running event held in Toszek, aimed at popularizing running and Nordic Walking as recreational activities, as well as promoting a healthy lifestyle and social integration, including for people with disabilities. The main race route is approximately 10 km long and runs on mixed terrain, including cobblestones, asphalt, country roads, and park paths, predominantly with soft surfaces. The start and finish are located at the Castle in Toszek. Organizers anticipate numerous age categories and special categories, as well as trophies for the best competitors.

The organizer provides a warm meal, cakes, water, coffee, and tea for participants. The event is a municipal charity run scheduled for May 31, 2026, supporting local initiatives.

name: XI Sieradzki Cross Towarzyski
location: Park Miejski im. A. Mickiewicza, Sieradz, Łódzkie, Poland
description: Sieradzki Cross Towarzyski is an annual running event organized by the Sieradz Biega Sports Club, promoting running and integrating the running community of Sieradz. The race takes place in A. Mickiewicz City Park on a 2 km loop covered with gravel, marked every 500 meters. The event lasts 6 hours, during which participants compete to complete as many laps as possible, with the option to take breaks and return to the course. The event is social and promotional in nature, and participants receive electronic lap and time measurement.
course_highlights: 2 km loop in A. Mickiewicz City Park in Sieradz
100% gravel surface
Lap markings every 500 m
additional: The race runs from 11:00 to 17:00, participants can pause and resume at any time but must stay within the designated transition zone during breaks. Each participant receives a returnable start number with a chip for electronic lap and time measurement. The participant limit is 250 people. Minors (ages 16-17) can participate with parental consent and can run up to 10 km (5 laps). The race involves running on a 2-kilometer park loop, with electronic timing, commemorative medals, awards for the best, and starter packs.

description: TAURON Run for Angels is a charity run organized in Katowice that supports the beneficiaries of the Guardian Angels House. The event takes place in Kościuszko Park and combines sports with helping children in need. Participants can choose the main 5 km run, children's races in various age categories, and a virtual run. The entire registration fee is donated to support educational, therapeutic, and upbringing activities for nearly 600 children from difficult backgrounds. The event also features a family picnic full of attractions, and each participant receives a commemorative medal and a gift.

Children's races in various age categories
Opportunity to participate in a virtual run from anywhere

The 5 km distance includes various age categories, children's races, a virtual run, family attractions, with registration deadlines on May 15 and May 27.

The event features distances of 10 km and 5 km for running, as well as a 5 km Nordic Walking walk, with open, age, and local resident classifications. The start and finish are located at Powstańców Wielkopolskich Street near Primary School No. 2 in Kostrzyn. The organizer plans to hold a raffle for tangible prizes for participants, and the race office is open a few hours before the start.

Start and finish at Powstańców Wielkopolskich Street near Primary School No. 2 in Kostrzyn

name: XXXIX Bieg Stolemów
location: Stadion 'Arena Mistrzów', Gniewino, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Kaszubskie Stowarzyszenie Kultury Fizycznej Żukowo oraz Gminny Ośrodek Turystyki i Sportu w Gniewinie
description: The 39th Stolem Run is an annual 10 km race organized at the 'Arena Mistrzów' Sports Stadium in Gniewino. The event also includes races for children and youth, a 5 km Nordic Walking march, and a recreational walk-run. Participants can enjoy electronic timing, medals for all participants, and prizes for the best. For those wishing to participate virtually, there is an option for a virtual run from May 27 to June 4, 2026.
course_highlights: Main race over 10 km with certification
Nordic Walking march over 5 km
Children's and youth races over shorter distances
additional: The event begins with the opening of the race office at 11:00 AM, where start numbers and chips are issued. A café, deposit, and changing facilities are available. The preschool run of 80 meters is free, and every participant receives a medal. The recreational walk-run over 1200 meters requires no registration and is free of charge. Participants are classified into 15 age categories. On-site registration for the 5 km and 10 km races is possible. A free bouncy castle is available for the youngest participants, and there is coffee and cake from KGW Perlino on site. Participants can choose from various distances and age categories, and the event also features attractions and decorations at the stadium.

name: Świętokrzyski Bieg Europejski
description: The Świętokrzyski European Run is a 5-kilometer street race held in Kielce, promoting physical activity and the spirit of the European community. The race course runs through the city streets, offering participants a sporting challenge in a friendly atmosphere. The event is part of the Funduszowego Maja 2026 activities in the Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship, encouraging movement and local community integration.
course_highlights: 5-kilometer street course in Kielce
Race promoting physical activity and European spirit
Organized as part of Funduszowego Maja 2026 in Świętokrzyskie
additional: Street race in Kielce, 5 km, event as part of Funduszowego Maja 2026.

name: Nekořský kros
description: Nekoř Cross Country is a traditional running race held in Nekoř in the Pardubice Region, which is part of the ISCAREX Cup. The race offers courses through very hilly terrain along forest roads, meadows, and partially on asphalt, ensuring an interesting and diverse running experience. The start and finish are at the ice rink in Nekoř, where registration also takes place. The race is suitable for a wide range of runners including youth and is known for its friendly atmosphere and material prizes for winners in individual categories.
course_highlights: Very hilly terrain
Forest roads, meadows, and partially asphalt
Start and finish at the ice rink in Nekoř
additional: Registration is possible online and on-site no later than 15 minutes before the start of each category. The top three in each category will receive material prizes and diplomas. The race is part of the ISCAREX CUP 2026. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup 2025 and 2026, offering various age categories including children and veterans. Registration is possible online, the course is technical and demanding on terrain.

name: Běh mezi náměstími
description: The Run Between Squares is a traditional running race held at Freedom Square in Frýdek-Místek, attracting a wide range of participants from children to adults. The race offers a pleasant atmosphere, beautiful weather, and the opportunity to compete on a course leading to Castle Square and back. There are special races for children with medals, prizes, and refreshments, while adults run the main course approximately 4.7 km long. Winners and all participants receive not only prizes but also the joy of movement and social gathering.
course_highlights: A 4.7 km course from Freedom Square to Castle Square and back
Children's races with record participation and rich prizes including medals and Marlenka
Pleasant atmosphere at Freedom Square with refreshments and prize draws
additional: The children's race starts first, with a record number of children participating (e.g., 252 in 2025). The best runners are awarded medals, Marlenka, and other prizes, which are drawn among all participants. Winners of the main men's and women's race receive traditional prizes, including beer barrels for the overall winners. The main race starts at 11:00 AM, with the mayor of the city traditionally firing the starting pistol. The event takes place on May 31, 2026, registration is required in advance, start lines are at Freedom Square and Castle Square, and the race is open to all age categories.

This race is part of the Chodsko Runner competition and offers runners an interesting route with gentle inclines. It is suitable for runners seeking a challenge in the picturesque environment of the Plzeň Region.

The route mainly runs on roads from Klenčí pod Čerchovem to Hrádek hill
additional: The race takes place on May 31, 2026, with the start scheduled at 11:00 AM. The course includes a climb to Hrádek and passes through scenic landscapes of historical significance.

In addition to the main race, there is a supporting run of 5.5 km and children's races of various lengths. Timing and results are provided by the agency 4Timing using chip technology. description: The marathon and half marathon around Hracholuská Dam is an event held on May 31, 2026, offering a beautiful natural circuit around the dam. The route mainly runs on paved paths along the water surface with a few short sections of natural terrain, giving it a slight trail character without unnecessary difficulties. An exceptional experience is crossing the Pňovanský Bridge with breathtaking views of the dam and surrounding landscape. The race circuit measures 21.1 km, the exact distance of a half marathon, and is suitable for runners seeking a combination of beautiful nature, motivating atmosphere, and a pleasant profile of the track.

The series includes 6 races in various destinations, including Lesná, where the main race covers 6 to 9 km, an experiential route of 20 to 30 km, and children's races. The routes are suitable for runners, canicrossers, children, and walkers, offering a diverse sporting challenge for all age groups. The race is part of the Eastern Bohemia Grand Prix and takes place through picturesque landscapes of the Polish-Czech border region, between meadows and forests. The start is at the amphitheater on Parkowa Hill at 11:00 AM, with the finish and award ceremony at the swimming pool. Free bus transportation from Meziměstí to Mieroszów is provided for Czech participants. Registration is free and can be done online or on the race day at the venue.

additional: The bus for Czech participants departs at 9:15 AM from the Meziměstí swimming pool towards Mieroszów. Registration on race day begins at 9:30 AM at the race office or online. The organizers are the Municipal Office of Kláštor pod Znievom, Strive sport, TRIMAT, and the Slovak Athletic Federation, and the race is part of the Slovak Mountain Running Cup.

Participants can enjoy beautiful natural scenery and the atmosphere of spring when the surroundings bloom into magnificent chestnut flowers. The race is suitable for a wide public of runners and is a welcome opportunity to meet the local running community.

The race is a challenge not only for experienced athletes but also for those who want to push their limits and experience an adventure in the terrain. After a mass start at 22:00, participants plan their own route between control points within a 30-hour time limit. The race headquarters is at ZŠ Žerotínova in Valašské Meziříčí, where a gymnasium, showers, and a dining hall are available. Valašské Kilo offers freedom and space for navigation in the terrain and is one of the best ultramarathons in the Czech Republic.

name: Dopesace Backyard Ultra
description: Dopesace Backyard Ultra is an endurance race held in the Aš Forests, where a loop of nearly 7 kilometers is run every hour. The race continues as long as there is only one runner who can complete more laps than the others. This unique format emphasizes not only speed but primarily endurance and determination. The winner receives a silver coin and the opportunity to represent the Czech Republic at the team world championship in October 2026. The race atmosphere is unforgettable and the event is also connected with a charitable project.

Each lap begins exactly one hour after the previous one, with strict time discipline

Each lap must be completed within 60 minutes, otherwise disqualification follows. No assistance or aids, including trekking poles, are allowed on the route. The race is connected with charity, where runners contribute 1-10 CZK for each completed kilometer to a selected project. The race takes place in the Aš Forests, with a requirement to use a headlamp during night sections. Registration is mandatory. The event supports the idea of the Run for the Memory of the Nation and offers original race bibs with the option to contribute to the non-profit organization Post Bellum. The start is at 14:00, registration begins at 12:00, refreshments are provided after the race, and access to the area is only on foot with parking available within walking distance.

Route for Dumliky: 12 km with an elevation gain of 400 m
Start and finish at the natural amphitheater in Horní Rokytnice

Maps and contacts available on the website.

name: Banskobystrický maratón

Participants can choose from several disciplines including the marathon, half marathon, 10K run, 5K STEFE run, and relay races. The course is well secured with refreshment stations and sound systems, ensuring a quality experience for all participants. The event is suitable for active runners and families who want to enjoy movement and a sporting atmosphere.

Half marathon consists of 3 fast laps with 12 refreshment stations
Super-fast 10K with minimal elevation

The STEFE five-kilometer run is designed for families and active runners. The event takes place on June 6, 2026, starting at the Square in front of Europa SC, with several aid stations and various categories for all age groups.

name: Poludnica Run
description: Poludnica Run is a mountain race in the Low Tatras with a course length of 23 km and an elevation gain of 1600 meters. The route mainly follows marked hiking trails, through beautiful south-facing single tracks in the forest, a rock city, and the Poludnica peak with panoramic views of Liptov and the Tatras. The event is part of the Slovak Skyrunning League and the Skyrunner® National Series Slovakia, serving as a qualifying race for the World Skyrunning Championships. The atmosphere is friendly, and the course is considered one of the most challenging in Slovakia within its category. The last edition of this event will take place in 2026.
course_highlights: 23 km long course with an elevation gain of 1600 m
Route follows marked hiking trails, single tracks, and a rock city
Poludnica peak with panoramic views of Liptov, Western and High Tatras
additional: Registration opens on March 23, 2026. Check-in and pickup of race bibs are on race day from 07:00 to 08:40 at the start area. The mass start is at 09:00. The maximum number of participants is 200. There is a refreshment station at 19 km. The course is considered one of the most difficult in Slovakia within its category. After the results are announced at 14:00, a raffle will take place with tickets costing 2 €. The event is part of the seasonal ranking and ITRA point collection, with the possibility to earn points for the World Championships. The event also includes a raffle, a hot meal, and free parking.

name: Beh Vyšnou Myšľou
location: Futbalové ihrisko, Vyšná Myšľa, Košice, Slovakia

The race takes place on the football field in Vyšná Myšľa and offers categories for various age groups of men, women, and children. It also includes a relay race for pairs over 2 x 3 km. The children's categories start at 14:00 and the adults at 16:00. The event is suitable for the general public, including club members and residents of the municipality, who benefit from a reduced entry fee.

Relay race for pairs over 2 x 3 km

The event includes categories for children, adults, and relays, with the possibility of online registration as well as on-site registration. The course is situated on the football field and in the surrounding area of the village.

The race takes place on June 6, 2026, with options to choose between 8 km and 15 km loops, which pass through asphalt, concrete, forest, and field roads with an elevation gain of up to 309 meters. The event also includes children's categories with various distances, making it suitable for a wide age range of runners. The start and finish are located at the multifunctional playground on Okružná Street in Družstevná pri Hornáde.

15 km loop with an elevation gain of 309 m

It is a community run that combines sport and a good cause, allowing participants to compete in various age groups. The event is part of the pretekaj.sk platform and offers simple online registration.

Categories for men and women aged 15 and older

The race combines sport, history, and the beauty of local nature, leading participants through the avenue of thousand-year-old oaks in the Pustelnik Reserve. The event is open to experienced runners, amateurs, and families, offering races on various distances as well as Nordic Walking marches. The organizers are the Active Kazimierz Biskupi Association and the Kazimierz Biskupi Municipality, and the tradition of the race dates back to the early 21st century.

The test is available to everyone, regardless of age, gender, or running experience. Participants receive a start number, a certificate with their result, and a bottle of water. name: VI EKO Bieg z Gwizdkiem po Zdrowie

All participants will receive a commemorative medal and diploma, category winners will be awarded cups and a small surprise. The event is part of several running competitions and leagues, with organizers emphasizing the development of sport and building the reputation of the village. Facilities include toilets, storage, catering, and parking. Prizes are awarded for 1st to 3rd place in categories. Terrain: 90% forest paths, 10% asphalt roads. Elevation gain of 108 meters. Categories OPEN and FAMILY. Start at Biřička, Nový Hradec Králové.

name: Jinecký kros
organizer: Městys Jince a Jinečáček, z. s.
description: Jinecký cross-country is a traditional running race held in Jince, offering a challenging route approximately 5.7 km long with an elevation gain of around 178 meters. The start and finish are located at the football field near Biokoupaliště, which provides facilities for competitors including parking, changing rooms, showers, and refreshments. The course runs on asphalt, forest paths, and meadows, includes running over a wooden bridge, asphalt roads, and a climb to Vystrkov Hill. The race is suitable for adults and children, who have their own categories. The main race starts at 11:00.
course_highlights: The route crosses a wooden bridge over Ohrazenický Stream
Challenging ascent to Vystrkov Hill with an elevation gain of about 30 m
Surface of the course combines asphalt, forest paths, and meadows
additional: Facilities include parking, changing rooms, showers, toilets, and a refreshment stand. Registration is possible until June 13, 2026, at 17:00, or on-site on the race day. Children's races are part of the program. The course has an elevation gain of +178m and -187m, with start and finish at the SK Jince 1921 sports complex. The course is approximately 5.7 km long, terrain: asphalt, forest paths, meadows; children's races; start at the football field near Biokoupaliště.

name: Mattoni Running Festival Olomouc
description: Mattoni Running Festival Olomouc is a popular running event held in the historic center of Olomouc. The race offers an attractive route through the picturesque streets of the city, suitable for both experienced runners and recreational athletes. The event is part of the RunCzech running league and provides a unique atmosphere and professional organization. Runners can enjoy quality facilities and support throughout the race.
course_highlights: The route passes through the historic center of Olomouc
Pleasant urban environment with cultural monuments
Part of the RunCzech running league with professional organization
additional: The event includes various race categories, an expo, and accompanying activities. Registration is done via the RunCzech website. The races are certified and suitable for all age groups.

name: Jindřichohradecký půlmaraton
location: Jindřichův Hradec, South Bohemia, Czech Republic
description: Jindřichohradecký half marathon 2026 is the tenth anniversary edition of the running race, offering a unique experience combining the picturesque historic city center, water-side sections, and natural passages with significant elevation changes. The race is open to individuals for 21.1 km, as well as teams in relay races, families, and schools in shorter runs. The atmosphere is enhanced by fans, music, and organizational support including refreshment stations and showers. A special Rebel Run for schools is also prepared, focusing on team cooperation rather than time. The race starts on June 13, 2026, and participants will receive an original medal and can win material prizes.
course_highlights: Beautiful combination of city and nature - historic streets and peaceful countryside around Jindřichův Hradec
Sections along water and natural passages with notable elevation changes
Unforgettable atmosphere with fans, music, and encouragement on the track
additional: The race program includes the Rebel Run start at 15:00, Family Run at 16:00, and the main half marathon and relay race at 17:00. There are refreshment stations, showers, baggage storage, professional photos and videos from the track and finish line. The Rebel Run is a special team race for elementary schools, where the focus is on teamwork and participation rather than time. The course passes through the historic center and natural passages, with various races including relays, family, and school runs, as well as refreshments, showers, facilities, medals, and prizes.

name: LEKI JEŠTĚD SUMMER - Running Weekend
description: LEKI Ještěd Summer - Running Weekend is part of the prestigious Ještěd Skyrace series, which offers challenging and beautiful routes in the mountainous terrain of the Ještěd Ridge. The races are designed for a wide range of runners from children to experienced skyrunners, with distances from 200 meters up to 42 km. The event takes place in a picturesque setting near the ski jumps on Ještěd and offers a unique outdoor running experience with significant elevation gain. The running weekend is complemented by accompanying programs, refreshments, and the possibility of accommodation nearby the races.
course_highlights: Challenging mountain routes with elevation gain up to 1390 m
Routes of various lengths from children's races to 42 km ultramarathon
Scenic environment of Ještěd Ridge with views and technical sections
additional: The winners' announcement takes place from 16:00. The races are held at the area near the ski jumps on Ještěd. There are children's races, refreshments, and an accompanying program. Accommodation and volunteer support are available. The routes are technically demanding with significant elevation gain. The race emphasizes ecology, for example by not using disposable cups, and offers a wide range of activities during the weekend.

name: Neveklovské běhy
organizer: kulturní a sportovní komise města Neveklov
description: Neveklov Runs are a traditional running event held in the picturesque Castle Park in Neveklov. This race offers an opportunity for runners of all levels to enjoy running in a pleasant park environment with a friendly atmosphere. The event is part of the broader Běžce Podblanicka race calendar, which promotes an active lifestyle and community gathering of athletes in the region.
course_highlights: Run in Castle Park Neveklov
Natural and peaceful park environment
Traditional regional running event
additional: The races are part of the Běžec Podblanicka cup, with various courses from 50 m to 5 km, offering a sporting experience in nature for the general public.

name: 7 pohoří Jeseníky
location: Dolní Morava, Jeseníky, Olomoucký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Jeseníky Race 2026 is a technical trail run in the beautiful nature under the Kralický Sněžník, offering three routes of different lengths and elevation gains. The courses are prepared by members of the local mountain rescue service and mainly lead through natural terrain. Participants will enjoy professionally marked trails, chip timing, refreshments on the route and at the finish line, and a commemorative medal. The event takes place in all weather conditions and is suitable for all trail running enthusiasts who want to experience epic views and an atmosphere that cannot be found elsewhere.
course_highlights: Main route 23.5 km with an elevation gain of 830 m
Alternative route 11.3 km with an elevation gain of 410 m
Kari Traa RUN 7 km with an elevation gain of 230 m
additional: The race time limit is 4 hours, after which the runner is marked as DNF. Participants can store small items at the registration booth. Recommended equipment includes a windbreaker and a charged mobile phone with the rescue app. The registration fee includes a start number, chip timing, refreshments on the route and at the finish, and access to facilities at the start and finish areas. The event takes place in all weather conditions and participation is at your own risk. The race offers registration, timing, medals, and other amenities. The courses are set in mountain environments with technical trail sections and are suitable for both experienced and beginner trail runners. The race is held in June 2026.

name: Okrouhelský běh
description: The Okrouhelský Run is a traditional race as part of the District Running League of Českolipsko, held in the picturesque village of Okrouhlá in the Liberec Region. The race offers an opportunity for runners of all levels to enjoy running in a natural environment with a friendly atmosphere. The Okrouhelský Run is part of a series of regional running races that promote an active lifestyle and community sports.
course_highlights: Natural terrain around the village of Okrouhlá
Picturesque views and peaceful environment
Part of the District Running League of Českolipsko
additional: Part of a series of regional races including cross-country and half marathons, exact race distances are not specified

name: Extrem Run 5Hills
location: Vojtanov, Karlovy Vary District, Czech Republic
description: Extrem Run 5 Hills is an ultratrail running race in the westernmost tip of the Czech Republic, offering a challenging 91-kilometer route with an elevation gain of 2,174 meters. The course passes over five peaks of Egerland and combines asphalt roads, cycling trails, and forest terrain. The race is intended for experienced runners seeking an extreme sports challenge and stunning panoramas. Organizers emphasize precise timing and runner safety. The race takes place in the picturesque area of Vojtanov and also offers relay and duathlon pairs options.
course_highlights: 91 km route with an elevation gain of 2174 m
Five peaks of Egerland: Kapellenberg, Háj Aš, Zelená hora Bismarck, Dyleň, Lesný
Combination of asphalt roads, cycling trails, and forest terrain
additional: The race starts at the municipal office in Vojtanov. Timing is provided by passive or active chips with high accuracy. Participants receive a functional T-shirt with the logo and a finisher medal. Refreshments are provided during the race and at the finish line. The relay race is for teams of 3 to 6 runners with at least one woman in the team. The duathlon pairs event combines a runner and a cyclist in a fixed order of segments. The race is authorized by the Forests of the Czech Republic and the Slavkov Forest Protected Landscape Area. Registration requires a team with at least one woman, the time limit is 18 hours, the entry fee is 2400 CZK paid in cash on site. Accommodation is not provided.

name: Běh na Pajrek
description: The Pajrek Run is the second edition of a running race organized by TJ Nýrsko, taking place on June 13, 2026, in the area below the ski slope in Nýrsko. The race offers a course of 8.6 km (2 laps) for men and 4.2 km (1 lap) for women, with an elevation gain of 152 meters per lap. The finish line is located at the same place as the start. The event is part of the Czech Cup in uphill running and the Ešus League, with refreshments provided on site. Organizers warn of possible route changes due to construction modifications and provide material prizes for the top finishers in each category.
course_highlights: Course for men 8.6 km (2 laps), for women 4.2 km (1 lap)
Elevation gain of 152 m per lap, course includes uphill and downhill sections
Finish at the same location as the start in the area below the ski slope
additional: Registration on-site from 12:00 to 13:45. Payment to account with note including name, surname, year of birth. All participants run at their own risk. Refreshments available on site. Material prizes for the top three in each category. The organizer reserves the right to change the route due to construction work. The race takes place at Pajrek, registration is possible on-site, and the event is part of a series of local running races, with registration from 12:00 to 13:45 on the race day.

name: Ultra Nízke Tatry
description: The Ultra Low Tatras is the first edition of a mountain running event that traverses the ridge of the Low Tatras from west to east. The course is 49.7 km long with an elevation gain of 2650 meters and follows marked tourist trails from Donovaly to Srdiečko. The event is part of the Slovak Skyrunning Association calendar and also serves as a Memorial for Milan Styka, a notable runner and mountaineer who tragically died in 2025. The start is scheduled for June 13, 2026, at 7:00 AM in Donovaly at the Donovaly Brewery.
course_highlights: 49.7 km long course with 2650 m elevation gain
Ridge of the Low Tatras from Donovaly to Srdiečko
The route follows red, green, and yellow tourist trails passing by M.R. Štefánik Chalet and Kosodrevina
additional: Registration is possible online from December 20, 2025, at 00:00 and also on-site at the Donovaly Brewery on June 13, 2026, from 16:00 to 21:00, and on the morning of the race from 6:00 to 6:45. The provisional cut-off time at Chopok after 37 km is 15:00 (8 hours after the start). The organizer reserves the right to change the route due to weather conditions and to set time limits. The course passes through mountain terrain, with information available about registration, the commemorative nature of the event, possible route changes due to weather, and time limits depending on conditions.

name: Strečnianska mašľa
description: Strečnianska Mašľa is a mountain ultramarathon and long-distance walk around Strečno, taking place on June 13, 2026. The race offers two routes - a challenging 50 km course with an elevation gain of approximately 2985 meters and a shorter 25 km course, suitable for runners with dogs. The routes run along marked hiking trails through both parts of Malá Fatra and through a section of the national park, with start and finish at the Radinové football pitch in Strečno. Organizers provide start packages, prizes for the best participants, and quality conditions for competitors.
course_highlights: 50 km route with an elevation gain of approximately 2985 m through Malá Fatra
Routes run along marked hiking trails and through the national park area
Start and finish at the Radinové football pitch in Strečno
additional: Participant limit: 300 for 50 km, 300 for 25 km, 50 for 25 km with a dog. Starting number and chip are assigned by the organizers. Mandatory equipment includes a first aid kit, valid ID, mountain rescue insurance, a charged mobile phone, a personal drinking container, a whistle or bells (recommended for the 50 km route), a map or GPS device, sunglasses, and sunscreen. Accommodation is available in changing rooms or tents at the football pitch. Lodging is also available at Pizzeria Alžbetka and SIP ŽSR Strečno. The race features certified routes, registration opens on March 1, 2026, and is part of the Slovak Ultratrail League. The course passes through the Malá Fatra national park.

name: Krosak pod hradom
organizer: Mgr. Ján Podstavský, Vladimír Adam, Ing. Ladislav Ondrik, Vladimír Sikorai, Gabriel Sabo, Štefan Karafa
course_highlights: Trať vedie po poľnej a lesnej ceste s asfaltovým povrchom
Veľký krosák je 10 km (2 x 5 km okruh)
Pretek sa koná v malebnom prostredí Trnavy pri Laborci
additional: Prezentácia pretekárov začína od 8:00 hod. na Obecnom úrade, detské kategórie od 7:30 hod. Nové registrácie v deň pretekov sú možné len do vypredania voľných štartových čísel. Platba na mieste je 25 €. Podujatie sa koná 13. júna 2026, s štartmi o 09:00 a 11:00, a zahŕňa kategórie na 10 km, 5 km a Nordic Walking, s dôrazom na charitatívne účely a komunitnú účasť.

name: Kysucký maratón
location: Čadca, Čadca, Matičné námestie - pred Domom kultúry Čadca, Slovakia
price_range: 35 EUR do 1. 5. 2026, 40 EUR po 1. 5. 2026, 25 EUR pre účastníkov z okresu Čadca
description: Kysucký marathon is the second oldest marathon in Slovakia and an important sports and social event in the Kysuce region. The course runs through the picturesque Kysuce valley along the Kysuca River, with a safer and more attractive route on a running cycle path from 2025. The event includes, besides the marathon, a half marathon, marathon relay, and a mini marathon for children. The start and finish are at Matičné Square in Čadca in front of the Cultural House. Runners compete in various age categories, and participants have access to refreshment stations and facilities including changing rooms and wellness services.
course_highlights: The course runs through the picturesque Kysuce valley along the Kysuca River
Safe and attractive route on a running cycle path (Bystrická cycle trail)
Marathon turnaround at the square near the Slovak Orloj in Stará Bystrica
additional: The start and finish of the race are at Matičné Square in Čadca in front of the Cultural House. There are 8 refreshment stations along the course. Refreshments are provided after the race. Participants have access to changing rooms, a swimming pool, and a sauna at the local swimming pool. The marathon time limit is 5 hours for 40 km; exceeding this time may affect placement in the results. The course is on certified routes, with refreshment stations on the course, changing rooms, a pool, sauna, and post-race refreshments. Online registration is open until June 1, 2026. Organizer insurance is not included.

name: Beh Hodkovským parkom

price_tiers.distance: Beh pre zdravie 4 km a Nordic walking 4 km

description: The Hodkovce Park Run is a running event held at the Hodkovce Castle grounds in Žehra, offering a course mainly on rural and forest paths with an asphalt section. The race is divided into categories including an 8 km competitive run for different age groups of men and women, as well as non-competitive categories such as a 4 km health run and Nordic walking without age restrictions. The organizer is DOMOVINA n.o., which ensures a pleasant atmosphere and quality organization for all participants. The entry fee is available online at a discounted price, encouraging early registration.
course_highlights: The course mainly runs on rural and forest paths with an asphalt section
The race takes place at the Hodkovce Castle grounds in Žehra
Categories for various age groups and non-competitive variants of running and Nordic walking
additional: The entry fee is €7 for online registration until June 12, 2025, and €9 on-site. The course is suitable for different age categories and includes non-competitive variants of running and Nordic walking. The start and finish are located at the DSS DOMOVINA premises in Žehra, part of Hodkovce. The event features various categories for all age groups, with registration open until June 12, 2025. The course includes forest, rural paths, and asphalt sections.

name: Beh Kalváriou
description: Kalvária Run is a charity running race held in the beautiful surroundings of Kalvária in Považská Bystrica. The event offers routes for adults and children, with the course surface consisting of forest paths. This fourth edition of the race is an opportunity to experience community, movement, and joy, with the proceeds from the run donated to children in need. The organizers emphasize quality organization and support for charitable causes.
course_highlights: Forest paths in the Kalvária environment
Routes for adults and children
Beautiful varied course with nice weather
additional: Registration is only possible online via vysledkovyservis.sk. On-site registration on the day of the race will not be available. After paying the entry fee, the participant's name will appear in the list of registered participants and a confirmation will be sent via email. There is an option for a voluntary contribution during registration to support Hugovi and Simonke. The participant limit is 500 adults and 250 children. The event is governed by the rules of the Slovak Athletic Federation. Registration is only available online; the event has a charitable purpose; the participant limit is 500 adults and 250 children; races are scheduled for 10:00 for children and 12:15 for adults.

name: Lemešanská bežecká liga 2. Letné kolo
location: Lemešany, Lúka nad obcou Lemešany, Slovakia
organizer: Obec Lemešany, Športová komisia obce Lemešany, Záhrada pohybu
price_range: dospelí: 10 € online, 15 € na mieste; občania obce: 5 € online, 10 € na mieste; deti a juniorské: 3 €; detské behy zdarma
description: Lemešanská running league 2. Summer round is a running event held in Lemešany on a meadow above the village. The race is divided into several categories based on age and gender, including children's categories and Nordic walking. The start for the main categories is at 5:00 PM, children's categories start at 5:10 PM. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant summer running atmosphere.
course_highlights: Various categories for all age groups including children and adults
Online registration with low entry fee
Children's runs on the meadow are free
additional: Categories: Men A (18-39 years), Men B (40 and over), Women F (18-39 years), Women G (40 and over), Girls/Boys 1 (12-14 years), Girls/Boys 2 (15-17 years), Children up to 12 years (only accompanied by an adult), Nordic Walking men/women. Children's runs on the meadow are free, online registration until June 12, 2026, additional €2 fee per bib, start at 5:00 PM and 5:10 PM.

name: Beh na chatu pri Zelenom plese – Memoriál K. Jakeša
location: Tatranský Mlyn pri Zelenom plese, Vysoké Tatry, Prešovský kraj, Slovakia
description: The Run at Chata pri Zelenom plese is a mountain race designed for sports and nature enthusiasts, suitable for both amateur and professional athletes. The event has been held regularly since 2005 during the second weekend of June and commemorates Karel Jakeš, a prominent Czechoslovak mountaineer. The course leads through challenging mountain terrain with significant elevation gain, making the race a challenge for all participants. The goal is to connect various sports groups and offer them a unique experience in the beautiful environment of the High Tatras.
course_highlights: Distance of the course 7.7 km
Total ascent 651 m
Total descent 18 m
additional: The event is organized with financial support from the Ministry of Tourism and Sports of the Slovak Republic. The race unites athletes, runners, climbers, skiers, mountaineers, cyclists, and ski mountaineers into one sporting community. Registration for the 20th edition has closed. The race will take place in June 2026, with registration available on the official website. The course starts at the bus stop Biela voda and ends at Chata pri Zelenom plese, suitable for runners of all levels with a love for mountain challenges.

description: The 17th Elbląg Piekarczyk Run is an annual running event held in Elbląg, attracting runners for distances of 5 km, 10 km, and a Mini Piekarczyk Run for children. The event is characterized by a unique atmosphere of sporting excitement and integration, and participants receive exclusive collectible medals. Organizers provide comfortable start conditions, including a race office with packet pickup, deposit, and sanitary facilities. The run is an excellent opportunity to spend active time and compete on scenic city routes.
course_highlights: Routes for 5 km and 10 km runs through the streets of Elbląg
Mini Piekarczyk Run for children in various age categories
Unique collectible medal combined with other city runs
additional: Start packages can be collected at the Ogrody Shopping Center (Saturday 12:00-18:00) and at the Helena MOSiR Ice Rink hall (Sunday 7:30-9:30 for the 5 km and 10 km runs, 7:30-13:30 for the Mini Run). Participants have access to deposit, changing rooms, and showers at the ice rink hall. The Mini Piekarczyk Run includes several age categories for children with different distances from 50 m to 600 m, starting at 12:35 on Sunday. Distances of 5 km and 10 km, team classification, registration discounts, limited spots, online registration.

name: Bieg Charytatywny
location: Park przy dworcu kolejowym, Oława, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Urząd Miejski w Oławie, Stowarzyszenie Ludzi Aktywnych „Biegnij Oławo”
description: Charity Run FOUR SEASONS - Stage IV is a sporting event organized in Oława, in the park near the train station. Participants can take part in a run of about 5 km or a Nordic Walking walk on the same route. The event is charitable and coordinated by the Active People Association "Run Oława" and the Oława City Office. The race office is open on the day of the run from 09:30 to 10:30, and the start is scheduled for the same day. The event is supported by local partners, and the timing is provided by ZmierzymyCzas.pl.
course_highlights: Route of the run and walk approximately 5 km long
Start and finish in the park near the train station in Oława
Opportunity to participate in the run or Nordic Walking walk
additional: Race office open on the day of the run from 09:30 to 10:30 near the start. Registration for the run has been closed. Race coordinators: Mariusz Jarosławski (698-025-555), Mateusz Bularz (721-162-604). Runs of about 5 km, registration closed, events include various seasons, charity actions for Michał Proć, accompanying attractions, prize draws, massages, bike trips, and meals.

name: Dziki Trail
description: Dziki Groń is a challenging mountain route of the Pieniny Ultra-Trail® run, guided by tourist, courier transfer, and through the Małe Pieniny meadows. The race offers scenic views of the Tatra Mountains and the Beskid, with start and finish lines located at Plac Dietla in Szczawnica. The course is designed for experienced mountain runners who want to face natural, demanding terrain. The event is part of the Pieniny Ultra-Trail mountain running festival, which promotes an active lifestyle and the Pieniny region.
course_highlights: Route guided by tourist and courier transfer trails
Views of the Tatra Mountains and Beskid
Passing through the Małe Pieniny meadows
additional: Start and finish at Plac Dietla in Szczawnica. Race office and EXPO located in Park Górny in Szczawnica. There are 5 refreshment points along the route, including one at 12 km near the Shelter. Mandatory equipment required according to the regulations. The event promotes an active lifestyle and the Pieniny region. Registration opens in November 2025, event date is June 14, 2026. The course length is approximately 64 km. The event takes place in Szczawnica, featuring mountain trails and the Małe Pieniny meadows.

name: Grodziski Półmaraton Słowaka
location: Grodzisk Wielkopolski, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Hunters Grodziski Half Marathon "Słowaka" is an annual running event organized since 2007 in Grodzisk Wielkopolski. The race commemorates the patron of the local high school, Juliusz Słowacki, and promotes a healthy lifestyle and sports activity among residents. The half marathon route is flat, runs through the city streets in two loops, with numerous refreshment and nutrition points. After the race, participants receive medals and can enjoy a hot meal and drinks. The event is also an opportunity to promote the city and the local running community.
course_highlights: Flat route, through city streets, two loops of about 10.5 km each
Route marked every 1 km with vertical and horizontal signs
Four nutrition points and four refreshment points on each loop
additional: The time limit to complete the half marathon is 3 hours. The race office is located at Grodzisk Sports Hall at ul. Żwirki i Wigury 2A. Timing is done using chips in the start numbers. After the race, the organizer provides a hot meal and drinks. A team classification is conducted for the 5 km distance. The start limit for the 5 km and 10 km races is 500 people combined. Registration and packet pickup are in Grodzisk Wielkopolski, ul. Żwirki i Wigury 2A, on June 13, 2026 from 12:00 to 20:00 and June 14, 2026 from 6:00 to 8:00. Training from the moment of registration until the event.

name: IV Charytatywny Bieg z Żonkilem
location: Wyspa Bolko, Opole, Opole County, Poland
organizer: Zespół Szkół Ekonomicznych im. Gen. Stefana Roweckiego "Grota" w Opolu
description: The 4th Charity Run with Jonquil is a sporting event organized by the Economic Schools Complex named after Gen. Stefan Rowecki "Grot" in Opole. The event will take place on June 14, 2026, on Bolko Island at the "Laba" Café. Participants can take part in a 5 km run, Nordic walking over 2.5 km, or support the campaign without running. The run is a charity event promoting physical activity and support for those in need.
course_highlights: 5 km run route on Bolko Island in Opole
Nordic Walking over a distance of 2.5 km
Picturesque areas around the "Laba" Café
additional: Start categories: 5 km run, 2.5 km Nordic walking, and "Support, I do not run" option. Regulations, parental/legal guardian consent, and authorization for collecting the start package are available for download. The organizer provides electronic timing. Location: Bolko Island, online registration, the event supports charitable causes, routes: 5 km and 2.5 km, date: June 14, 2026.

name: Rozbiegane Suwałki
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Suwałkach
description: Rozbiegane Suwałki is an annual city running festival held in June in Suwałki. The event lasts three days and attracts hundreds of participants of various ages and skill levels. The program includes races for children, the Five-Kilometer Run (5 km), Suwalska Ćwiartka (10.5 km), and the Breakfast Run to the Island (about 3.5 km). The routes are flat and fast, conducive to personal bests, and the atmosphere is full of sports competition and community integration.
course_highlights: Flat, fast city routes
Evening main race of 10.5 km - Suwalska Ćwiartka
Various distances for children and adults
additional: The event lasts three days and includes races for children and youth, a 5 km run, the main evening race of 10.5 km, and a recreational run of about 3.5 km with breakfast at the finish line. The routes are flat and fast, ideal for setting personal bests. Organized by the Sports and Recreation Center in Suwałki, which also offers bike and water equipment rentals and sports facility rentals. Distances include: children's races, 5 km, 10.5 km, and approximately 3.5 km; routes are flat and fast; the event lasts three days; online registration; location in Suwałki.

name: Suszecki dziki bieg

description: Suszecki Dziki Bieg is a running event organized by the Municipal Sports Center in Suszec, promoting active leisure among children, youth, and adults. The competition will take place on June 13-14, 2026, at the Gwaruś Recreation Center in Suszec. Participants can compete in distances of 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon (21 km), as well as in races for children and youth. For the most persistent, combined classifications are prepared for the 5+21 km and 10+21 km distances with material prizes. The atmosphere of the event is friendly and encourages participation from both amateurs and more experienced runners.
course_highlights: Routes for 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon (21 km) at the Gwaruś Recreation Center
Opportunity to participate in combined classifications Dziki Dublet 5+21 km and Dziki Super Dublet 10+21 km
Races for children and youth on various distances adapted to age
additional: Race office open: Saturday 12:00-14:45, Sunday 8:00-9:30. Participant limit: 300 for 5 km and 10 km, and 300 for the half marathon. Registration must be completed no later than 30 minutes before the start of the race. Medical security on the route. For participants in the combined classifications Dziki Dublet and Super Dublet, commemorative hats and material prizes are provided for the best. Participant limit is 300, online and in-office registration, medical security, Gwaruś Recreation Center area.

price_range: od 25 zł dla dzieci i młodzieży, od 75 zł dla dorosłych
description: The 9th Charity Run for the Golden Coin in Olsztyn is an annual running event organized by the Future for Children Foundation, which supports sick and disabled children from Warmia and Mazury. The main race over a distance of 5 km takes place by Lake Ukiel and is friendly for all participants, including beginners. The event features a family picnic and numerous attractions, and participation in the run is not only a sporting competition but primarily a support for children in need. The start of the main race is scheduled for 4:30 PM, and the route is scenic and accessible also for those who prefer walking.
course_highlights: Scenic route by Lake Ukiel in Olsztyn
5 km distance suitable for runners and walkers
Family picnic and numerous attractions accompanying the run
additional: Side starts for children and youth on distances adapted to age, with the first children's race over 400 m at 3:35 PM. The time limit for the 5 km main run is 1 hour. The event has a charitable character, supporting rehabilitation and treatment of children from the region. Special guest is Krystyna Abramczyk Puzio, multiple Polish and world champion in weightlifting. The event includes various distances from 200 m for children to 5 km for adults, with participant limits and online registration. All proceeds are allocated to charitable causes, and participants receive medals and souvenirs.

name: Běh zámeckým parkem Kravaře
location: Zámecký park, Kravaře, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Castle Park Run in Kravaře is a traditional running race organized by the Prajzský Running Club Kravaře, held in the picturesque castle park in Kravaře. The race offers a main course of 8.7 km for adults and shorter distances for children according to age categories. The surface consists of gravel paths, and the course is run over three loops within the park. The event is suitable for recreational runners and families with children, with pleasant facilities and refreshments for all participants.
course_highlights: The course runs through three loops in the castle park
Surface made of gravel paths
Main course length of 8.7 km for adults
additional: Registration for children is from 8:30 to 9:10, children start at 9:15. Children's categories are divided by age with course lengths from 150 m to 1800 m. Refreshments for adults include cake and drinks, children receive a sweet reward. Facilities include changing rooms and showers at the MFK Kravaře complex. Trail run on gravel paths in the castle park, registration for adults and children, various age categories, refreshments, and prizes.

name: Půlmaraton okolo Prahy 4
location: Žluté lázně, Praha 4, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The Half Marathon around Prague 4 is a unique individual running race that offers a meditative running experience on a varied profile city trail. The course measures approximately 21 kilometers and runs around the perimeter of the Prague 4 district, allowing participants to get to know the local geography and their own running form. The race takes place without a mass start; runners start individually or in small groups between 9:00 and 10:00, which eliminates stress and crowding at the start and on the course. After a successful premiere, this half marathon is held for the second time and is suitable for everyone who wants to combine athletic performance with a pleasant experience in nature and the city.
course_highlights: City trail with a varied profile
Circuit approximately 21 km around Prague 4
Individual start between 9:00 and 10:00 without mass gathering
additional: The race is individual with a flexible start between 9:00 and 10:00; participants can run alone or in groups, using a map on their mobile or on paper. The race is held without crowds at the start, on the course, or at the finish, ensuring a relaxed experience. The course is marked, with a start between 9:00 and 10:00, and the race is part of the Trail Running Cup series. Running is at your own risk; extra caution is advised when crossing roads.

name: Přespolní běh areálem zdraví Chábory
location: Chábory u Dobrušky, Chábory, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Cross-country running at the Chábory health area is a traditional race organized by the Volunteer Fire Department of Chábory, held in the picturesque health area near Dobruška. The race offers a main run of 10,000 meters and additional categories on a 3,330-meter circuit, designed for men, women, juniors, and the general public from 4 to 90 years old. The event is part of the Eastern Bohemia Grand Prix in running and is suitable for all generations with the motto "BE FIT!". Participants can look forward to diplomas, material prizes, and a raffle, with the overall winner of the main race receiving a traveling trophy.
course_highlights: Circuit of 3,330 meters on field and forest paths
Main race of 10,000 meters
Categories for everyone from 4 to 90 years old
additional: Registration of participants takes place from 8:00 to 9:30, with an entry fee of 50 CZK paid during registration as a contribution to administration and refreshments. Results announcement and prize presentation are scheduled for 11:25. Runners participate at their own risk and must comply with current hygiene measures. The race will be held on June 14, 2026, with registration possible until June 13, 2026, 20:00. In addition to the main 10,000-meter race, shorter distances are available. Awards include diplomas, prizes, and a trophy for the overall winner.

name: Chaloupecký kros
location: Chaloupky, Komárov, South Bohemia, Czech Republic
description: Chaloupecký cross country is a traditional running race held in the picturesque environment of Chaloupky near Komárov. The race offers two main routes approximately 8 km and 4 km long, which run on asphalt, forest paths, and meadows. The main race starts at 10:00 AM, and participants can enjoy a combination of natural beauty and sporting challenge. The race is part of the Brdský Running Cup and is suitable for the general public without children's categories.
course_highlights: Surface: asphalt, forest paths, meadows
Course lengths: 8 km and 4 km
Start in Chaloupky near Komárov
additional: The race is part of the Brdský Running Cup. Children's races are not part of this event. The course surface is a combination of asphalt, forest paths, and meadows. Distances: 8 km and 4 km, start at 10:00 AM, no children's races, different lengths for various categories.

name: Běh na Hraničář
location: Lesní divadlo u Úhlavy, Nýrsko, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: The Border Runner is a traditional and prestigious uphill running race held in the picturesque environment near the forest theater at Úhlava in Nýrsko. The 5 km course with an elevation gain of 380 meters passes through the ruins of Pajrek Castle and ends at the top of Hraničář with a stunning view of Ostrý Hill. The race is part of the Czech Uphill Running Cup and has been held again since 2020 after a three-year break. After the race, participants must return to the start on their own.
course_highlights: Start at the forest theater near Úhlava
Elevation gain of 380 meters over 5 km course
Finish at the top of Hraničář with a view of Ostrý Hill
additional: The race is part of the Czech Uphill Running Cup. After the race, participants must return to the start on their own. The race includes a main category of 5 km and children's runs; registration takes place on-site from 9:15 to 10:15; the course is mainly trail with a hilly profile and an ascent to the top of Hraničář.

name: Dobývání Dívčích hradů
description: Climbing Dívčí Hrad is a 2 km uphill race with an elevation gain of 135 meters, held in Hlubočepy, Prague 5. This race is part of the Hill Running series in Prague and the surrounding area and offers runners a challenge in the form of a demanding ascent. The course runs through scenic terrain with beautiful views, making the race attractive to mountain running and uphill running enthusiasts. The race is suitable for anyone looking to test their endurance and strength in a hilly environment.
course_highlights: Length of the course 2 km with an elevation gain of 135 m
Challenging uphill run in Prague's Hlubočepy
Part of the Hill Running series in Prague and surroundings
additional: The race is part of the cycling segment - duathlon, with the possibility of participating in various categories and results recorded by over 78 runners in the past.

name: Račiansky kros – leto
location: Knižková dolina, Bratislava – Rača, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: Račiansky kros SUMMER is a running event in Bratislava-Rača offering three courses of varying lengths and elevation gains. The main course is 16 km with an elevation gain of 503 meters, another course is 9.5 km with an elevation gain of 335 meters, and there are also children's runs. The courses mainly pass through forest terrain with asphalt sections and are well marked in three ways. The event is suitable for different age categories and offers awards for the best in each category. The start is in Knižkova Dolina and the time limit is 3 hours for the main course.
course_highlights: Course 16 km with an elevation gain of +503 m, time limit 3 hours
Course 9.5 km with an elevation gain of +335 m, time limit 2 hours
Surface: 80% forest, 20% asphalt, marked with pink ribbons, white arrows, and laminated arrows on trees
additional: The course is marked in three ways: pink ribbons with race print on trees, white chalk arrows on the ground, and laminated arrows on trees (blue, pink, orange). Refreshment stations: 2 on the 16 km course, 1 on the 9.5 km course. Mandatory equipment includes a bib number attached visibly to the chest. Results are announced shortly after crossing. The course is mainly forest with asphalt sections; registration is possible online or on-site; children's runs with medals and prizes are part of the event; it is part of the Račiansky kros series with multiple editions throughout the year.

description: Vranovská desiatka is a traditional running race in the town of Vranov nad Topľou, offering courses of 10 km and 5 km. The race is organized by the Town of Vranov nad Topľou, the Municipal Sports Club, and the Municipal House of Culture. Categories are divided by age and gender, with the top three runners from Vranov also being recognized. The start and finish are at the House of Culture in Vranov nad Topľou. The race is suitable for the general public, from recreational runners to competitors.

Categories by age and gender including recognition of the top Vranov runners
Start and finish at the House of Culture in Vranov nad Topľou
additional: The race categories are divided into 10 km (men and women by age groups) and 5 km (men and women without categories). The registration fee is €15 for online registration and €20 for on-site registration. Organizers are the Town of Vranov nad Topľou, the Municipal Sports Club, and the Municipal House of Culture. The contact person is Eva Fedorňáková at phone number 0917 127 502. The race offers categories for 10 km and 5 km, with start at the House of Culture. Registration is possible online or on-site.

name: Čeľovská sedmička
description: The Cheľovská Seven is a running event held in the village of Čeľovce, Trebišov district, in front of the Cultural House. The race is designed for various categories including men, women, families, and children, offering a summer walk and a competition for the youngest runners. The event is part of the Beh.sk running community and promotes an active lifestyle in a pleasant village environment.

The event is intended for various age groups and families
The date of the event is June 14, 2026
additional: The start location is in front of the Cultural House in Čeľovce. Categories include men, women, families, and children, including the youngest runners and a summer walk. The race is part of local activities and is suitable for all age groups, including children and families.

The race takes place on the football field in Mlynčeky and offers an opportunity for runners to experience the atmosphere of a sporting event in a beautiful environment. The registration fee is available at a discounted price for early registration, and it is also possible to register on the day of the race. The organizers welcome all runners and sports enthusiasts to this traditional event.

location: Výstaviště Praha Holešovice, Praha, Czech Republic
description: UniCredit Prague Relay is a team running race held on June 16, 2026, in Prague, offering a relay run in four segments of 5 km each. The race starts at 6:00 PM in Stromovka Park, directly in front of Výstaviště Praha Holešovice, which is easily accessible by tram. The race is designed for teams and is suitable for corporate team building, school events, or other groups seeking a sporting atmosphere and shared fun. After the race, a Team Box with comfortable facilities and catering for participants and their fans is available.
course_highlights: Team relay run 4 x 5 km
Start and finish in Stromovka Park, Prague
Easy tram access to Výstaviště Holešovice station
additional: Team Box offers a fully equipped tent with catering, alcohol and non-alcoholic drinks, electrical connection, and branding for 50 visitors. Only runners with bib numbers ending in "A" will be allowed at the start. It is strictly forbidden to use skates, bikes, strollers, run with dogs, or bring children onto the track. The race takes place in Stromovka Park with options for team registration, refreshments, and an accompanying program including an evening party. The start and finish are at Výstaviště Praha Holešovice.

Trail running in Krč Forest
Part of the SABZO series
