The race is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels who want to experience the atmosphere of a quality sporting event in a pleasant environment.

Friendly atmosphere and quality organization by the KRB Chrudim club

name: Běh olympijského dne
description: The Olympic Run is a traditional sporting event organized by the Czech Olympic Committee, taking place as part of Olympic Day on June 17, 2026, in Zlín. This run connects different generations and levels of runners, from children to adults, and promotes Olympic values such as friendship, fair play, and respect. Participants can choose from shorter and longer routes, with the race complemented by sports and educational activities. The registration fee supports children's sports through the Czech Olympic Foundation. The event is open to everyone who wants to experience the joy of movement and support a good cause.

Time measurement with chip timing
Start and registration on the meadow near the sports complex Komec, Brno - Komárov
additional: Registrations are only available online until June 5, 2026; on-site registration is not possible. The first 150 adults and 70 children registered by March 31 will receive a free T-shirt (registration with T-shirt and size selection required). The route is not wheelchair or handbike accessible. Facilities include a changing room, storage, and toilets. Time measurement is provided by chip timing. Registration begins on June 19, 2026; the event takes place in Zlín as part of Olympic Day; focused on promoting friendship and Olympic values.

location: Stadion mládeže, Zlín, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Olympic Run in Zlín is a traditional sporting event held at the Youth Stadium. The race offers a classic five-kilometer course on a tartan track for adults and several children's races over shorter distances. The event supports sports participation for children from socially disadvantaged families, with part of the registration fee donated to the Czech Olympic Committee. Registrations are conducted online, and the race starts at 6:00 PM, broadcast live on Czech Radio.

Children's races over 200 m, 400 m, 800 m, and 1500 m
The course is accessible for wheelchair users and handbikes

The course is measured with chip timing. Facilities include toilets, a storage area, and changing rooms. Parking is available on Hradská Street and at the public parking lot in front of the Department Store. The race capacity is 300 adults and 200 children. The race will be started live on Czech Radio. Multiple runners can be added to one shopping cart during registration. The races include distances of 200 m, 400 m, 800 m, 1500 m, and 5 km, with participation allowed for disabled persons and children with parental consent. The event features chip timing and parking nearby the stadium.

description: The Olympic Run in Čelákovice is a traditional running race with its fifth edition in 2026. The race offers two routes for adults, 5 km and 10 km, which run along flat terrain along the Elbe River with beautiful views and interesting sites such as the railway bridge, St. Wenceslas Chapel, and the courtyard of the Municipal Museum. For children, shorter distances from 200 m to 1500 m are prepared, which also pass through the municipal museum. The start and finish are at the athletic track of the municipal stadium in Čelákovice. Registration is available online until June 5, 2026, and the main race starts at 6:00 PM.
course_highlights: Routes run upstream along the Elbe River with views of the river
The ten-kilometer route includes meadows, forest paths, and the historic site of the Municipal Museum
The entire route is flat with minimal elevation gain
additional: Registrations are only accepted online until June 5, 2026; on-site registration will not be possible. The start of the main race will be broadcast from Czech Radio. Included in the registration fee is a functional ALPINE PRO T-shirt, from which 20 CZK is donated to the Czech Olympic Foundation. Children born in 2011 or later can run the adult route only with parental consent. It is possible to register multiple runners at once in one shopping cart. If you fill in a nickname by May 7, it will be printed on the start number. The route is flat, registration only online until June 5, 2026, the main race starts at 6:00 PM, with the possibility to try the OCR park, food trucks for refreshments, accompanying program, parking on U Kapličky and Na Nábřeží streets.

name: Olympijský běh - Červená Lhota
location: Červená Lhota, Jindřichův Hradec, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Olympic Run in Červená Lhota is a traditional race that starts at the fairy-tale Červená Lhota Castle. Participants will run along the blue tourist trail through the villages of Samosoly, Pohoří, and the dam of the Kardaš pond, mainly on field and forest paths. The start is ceremoniously initiated with a shot from a historical firearm, and by participating, you support the Czech Olympic Foundation. The race is open to adults over 15 years old and offers a pleasant sporting atmosphere with refreshments provided by volunteer firefighters.
course_highlights: Start at the fairy-tale Červená Lhota Castle
The route follows the blue tourist trail through Samosoly, Pohoří, and the dam of Kardaš pond
Mainly on field and forest paths
additional: The start and finish are at different locations: start at Červená Lhota Castle, finish in Kardašova Řečice at the cider house. Participants are transported by bus from the registration site (Kardašova Řečice cider house) to the start. There are changing rooms, a storage area, and toilets available; showers are not provided. Refreshments are arranged by volunteer firefighters. The race is started with a shot from a historical firearm by the castle steward. Registration is only available online; on-site registration is not possible. The race is for runners over 15 years old; younger participants are not permitted at this location. Timing is measured with a chip timing system. Terrain: field and forest paths. Registration deadline: June 7, 2026. Start time: at Červená Lhota Castle at 18:00. Race distance: 9.2 km. Age requirement: from 15 years old. No participation for disabled or under 15. Transportation: bus from Kardašova Řečice. Facilities: changing rooms, storage, toilets; no showers. The program includes the start, refreshments, and award ceremony.

It is an excellent opportunity for mountain running enthusiasts to test their strength on a difficult but attractive course.
course_highlights: Mountain trails of Beskid Sądecki with significant elevation changes
Refreshment points distributed along the route
Scenic sections on the course, including a viewing platform at Ślimak
additional: The race starts at 3:00 AM from the courtyard of Rytro Castle (for the 100 km distance). The route passes through various mountain trails, including the Main Beskid Trail, with numerous refreshment points and demanding ascents, such as up to Wielki Rogacz. The organizer recommends using appropriate trail equipment, including shoes and technical clothing, due to changing weather and difficult terrain. The event includes various distances, attractions for families, regional food, special gadgets for the fastest runners, and a relaxation zone with Piwniczanka.

name: XIX Bieg O Błękitną Wstęgę
description: The 19th International Blue Ribbon Race is an annual running event organized by the Stargard Athletics Club, taking place on the streets of Stargard. The main race starts at 9:00 PM, creating a unique atmosphere of night running. The course begins at the Amphitheatre, around the Jewel of Pomerania, allowing participants to admire the most beautiful monuments of Stargard under the moonlight. The event promotes health, fitness, and positive energy, encouraging an active lifestyle.
course_highlights: Start from the Amphitheatre in Stargard
Course around the Jewel of Pomerania
View of the most beautiful Stargard monuments at night
additional: The race takes place at night, creating a special atmosphere. The course is prepared to allow participants to admire Stargard's monuments in the moonlight. The organizer encourages building endurance and mental preparation before the race. Night run, course around monuments, registration coming soon.

location: Owińska, Poznań County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

description: ZIELONKA CHALLENGE is an individual long-distance running and Nordic Walking race held in the picturesque Zielonka Forest Landscape Park. The event includes distances from approximately a quarter marathon to an ultramarathon, running along forest roads, paths, and ravines among nature reserves and lakes. The event is characterized by perfect organization, well-equipped nutrition points, and a unique atmosphere of sports rivalry and friendship. The race center is located in Owińska near Poznań, with the finish line at the bathing area. The race will take place on June 20, 2026.
course_highlights: Routes run through forest roads, paths, and ravines
Scenic nature reserves and lakes of Zielonka Forest
Long-distance, linear cross race and Nordic Walking
additional: Starts are staggered: 7:00 AM for ultra 100+ km and Nordic Walking 21+ km, 8:00 AM for races over 21+ km, 42+ km, 75+ km, and 10:00 AM for race and Nordic Walking over 10+ km. Time limit is 12 hours (14 hours for the ultramarathon 100+ km). The race center and registration office are in Owińska at Traperska Osada, with the finish at the bathing area. The organizer provides nutrition points and recovery meals after the race. Distances range from 10 km to 100 km, on forest terrain, cross-country routes, Nordic Walking competitions, with a time limit of 12-14 hours, online registration and registration via Facebook.

name: Velíšskej přespolňák
location: Veliše, Podblanicko, South Bohemia, Czech Republic
description: Velíšskej přespolňák is an off-road race designed for capable runners, enthusiasts, and amateurs, held in the picturesque landscape of Podblanicko. The race offers two routes of 10 km and 5.2 km, mainly along field and forest paths, ensuring a pleasant running experience in nature. This race is ideal for everyone who wants to enjoy running in a clean environment and test their strength against other runners. Velíšskej přespolňák is a traditional event that attracts a wide running community.
course_highlights: Routes mainly along field and forest paths
Picturesque landscape of Podblanicko
Two race options: 10 km and 5.2 km
additional: Children's races from 50 to 1000 meters, timed with stopwatches; the race is suitable for runners of various levels and offers a friendly atmosphere in nature.

name: Prague Park Race – Divoká Šárka
location: Divoká Šárka, Praha 6, Prague, Czech Republic

description: Prague Park Race - Divoká Šárka is a running race held on June 20, 2026, in the beautiful nature of Divoká Šárka in Prague 6. The race offers a unique atmosphere and breathtaking views that participants can enjoy on routes of 8 and 14 kilometers. The courses run on paved and unpaved paths, meadows, and trails, partly also on asphalt roads with limited traffic. The race is suitable for the general public and offers refreshments on the track and at the finish line. Registration and check-in take place at the SK ARITMA complex in Prague - Vokovicích, which is easily accessible by public transport and car.
course_highlights: Routes run on paved and unpaved paths, meadows, and trails
Distances approximately 8 and 14 km with kilometer markers
The route includes a castle passage, two sections with stairs, and narrow trails
additional: Registration and check-in are from 9:00 to 10:45, children's races start at 10:00. On the 14 km route, there is a refreshment station around the 8th km, and refreshments are available for all at the finish. The race capacity is limited; registration is also possible on-site if capacity has not been reached. Recommended public transport to Nádraží Veleslavín station (700 m from the venue), parking at Džbán water reservoir (300 m). The race takes place in a natural environment, registrations are available on the website, and the event includes scenic trail routes of various lengths and difficulties.

name: Krosový běh Chudenickým Žďárem
location: Sportovní areál Jalovčí, Chudenice, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Chudenice Žďár Run is a young cross-country race established in 2016, held in the picturesque autumn environment of Žďár hill above the village of Chudenice. The course is a challenging cross-country run without asphalt sections, with a slightly hilly profile and an attractive climb of forest stairs to Bolfánek. The start and finish are located in the area of the local physical education unit. The main race measures 6.2 km and offers runners a challenge as well as beautiful natural scenery.
course_highlights: Course without asphalt sections
Slightly hilly profile with a climb of forest stairs to Bolfánek
Start and finish in the area of the local physical education unit
additional: The race is part of the traditional and prestigious off-road running series in the Klatovy district called Ešus League. In previous years, the Ešus League races featured original prizes such as running caps, bottles with drinks, fairground pies, or Šumava cheeses. The course is known for measuring exactly 6.2 km if you do not get lost. The course is approximately 6.2 km long, suitable for all age categories, without asphalt sections, with a climb to Bolfánek. The race will take place in June 2026, on June 20th.

description: Run4Help 2026 is a charity run taking place on June 20, 2026, in Prague at Letenské sady Natural Park. The event offers races for adults over 4 km and 8 km, children's runs in various categories from birth to 14 years old, and a non-competitive run for people with disabilities over 1 km. The entry fee is donated to the non-profit organization No Foot No Stress, and each participant will receive a commemorative medal at the finish line. The race is suitable for both professional and amateur runners who want to support a good cause.
course_highlights: The route runs along wide paths in Letenské sady Natural Park
Charity run supporting the non-profit organization No Foot No Stress
Categories for children from birth to 14 years old and a special run for people with disabilities
additional: Registration on-site is possible without a package. The entry fee is free for people with disabilities and their companions. The official Run4Help T-shirt can be ordered until May 20, 2026. The number of participants is limited to 1000. A beautiful medal awaits every runner at the finish line. The program includes children's races, a non-competitive run for people with disabilities, and races of 4 km and 8 km. The charity run with proceeds supporting NO FOOT NO STRESS features various distances and accompanying activities.

name: Příborský běh
organizer: město Příbor, Atletický klub Emila Zátopka Kopřivnice
description: The Příbor Run is a traditional running race organized by the town of Příbor in cooperation with the Scout Troop and the Emil Zátopek Athletic Club Kopřivnice. The race is intended for both athletes and amateurs, who can choose the distance according to their abilities. It offers hobby category at 4.6 km, sport category at 9.2 km, and relay races consisting of 4 members (2 men + 2 women), with each running a 2.3 km loop. There are also children's races at various distances. The race atmosphere is friendly and supports a broad running community in the region.
course_highlights: Hobby category - 4.6 km (2 laps)
Sport category - 9.2 km (4 laps)
4-member relays (2 men + 2 women), each running a 2.3 km lap
additional: The race is part of the Lašská Running League. The start of categories is staggered: first the sport category, after 2 minutes the hobby category, and after another 2 minutes the relays. The race is suitable for the general public, including children, and offers various distances based on age and performance. It is intended for different age groups, including children and relays, and takes place in the historic center of Příbor. Details about registration and the exact terrain are not specified.

name: Barvám Neutečeš Praha
location: Park u Čeňku, Sokolský ostrov, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Color Run Neutečeš is a colorful run and all-day entertainment for all age groups, families, and friends. There are two routes to choose from: 5 km with five color zones and 1.5 km with three color zones and an interactive sports zone. The event is not about speed but about joy, friendship, and unforgettable experiences filled with music, laughter, and colorful explosions. The run takes place in Prague in the Park u Čeňku and on Sokolský Island and is part of a year-round colorful tour across several cities.
course_highlights: 5 km route with 5 color zones
1.5 km route with 3 color zones and Urban Challenge zone
Color zones shower runners with colors from head to toe
additional: The event is a full-day program from 8:00 to 17:00 in Prague, including music, themed zones, photo booths, 360° videos, and accompanying activities. The run is not about timing; children can start on shoulders, scooters, or strollers. It also includes a charitable project Color Run Heroes for children with disabilities. The festival features various color zones, music, activities, and is suitable for all age groups. The event takes place in Park u Čeňku and on Sokolský Island, emphasizing fun and community experiences.

name: POHO50 - Revírní pohodová padesátka
description: POHO50 - Revírní pohodová padesátka is a traditional running race held in Karviná, Moravian-Silesian Region. The race offers a pleasant atmosphere and the opportunity to enjoy running in the beautiful surroundings of the region. Participants can also order an original functional POHO50 T-shirt, which they can pick up on the race day. Registration is simple and allows for relay team registration with member management after paying the start fee.
course_highlights: Course approximately 50 km long around Karviná and Karvinská Lake
Shorter distances of 21 km, 10 km, and 6 km are also available
Natural scenery and diverse terrain around Karvinská Lake
additional: Option to order an original functional POHO50 T-shirt for 390 CZK, which participants will pick up on race day along with their bib number and race packet. Relay team registration allows for member management after paying the start fee. Participants consent to the processing of personal data and the creation of photo/video recordings for promotional purposes by the organizer. The race takes place on June 20, 2026, offers various race distances including an ultramarathon, and is suitable for all age groups and running levels.

name: Běh Jana Opletala
location: Lhota nad Moravou, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Run Along the Footsteps of Jan Opletal and the Jiří Vace Memorial is a traditional running event organized by Jan Opletal Gymnasium in Litovel. This race commemorates significant personalities and the history of the school and the town. The event takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Litovel and is suitable for the general public who want to enjoy a sporting experience with a historical undertone.
course_highlights: Start at the birthplace of Jan Opletal in Lhota nad Moravou
Race length of 8 km or 10 km depending on the year
Races include school teams and regional runs
additional: The races are held in June, often with the participation of school teams and as part of regional running series.

name: Běh okolo Vraní skály
location: Černín u Zdic, Central Bohemia, Czech Republic
description: The Vraní Skála Run is a traditional running race held in Černín u Zdic, offering a challenging course approximately 9 km long. The race combines steep road ascents, forest paths, and narrow trails leading to the summit around Vraní Skála, followed by a rolling and mostly descending section with a steep downhill to the finish. The start is at the square in Černín u Zdic, and the main race begins at 10:30 AM. The race is part of the Brdský běžecký pohár series and is suitable for runners who enjoy a combination of road and terrain with significant elevation changes.
course_highlights: Steep road ascent at the beginning up to 1 km
Moderate ascent along forest paths and narrow trails to the summit around Vraní Skála
Rolling mostly descending section and steep road downhill to the finish
additional: The registration fee is 200 CZK on-site, including a sausage. The course runs on both road and terrain. The race does not have children's races during the main event. Results are available in the system and as a PDF. The organizer is Instalatérství Ivan Raboch. The course is 9 km, start at 10:30 AM, no children's races, registration on-site, with a sausage included. The race is part of the Brdský běžecký pohár series with various distances and categories throughout May and June.

name: Běh na Kozlovský kopec
location: Kozlovský kopec, Česká Třebová, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Kozlovský Hill Run is a traditional Czech-Třebová road race uphill, taking place on June 20, 2026. The race starts at 10:00 AM from Habrmanova Street in front of the Secondary Vocational School building, with the finish line at Max Švabinský Cottage on Kozlovský Hill. The 5.2 km course with an elevation gain of 230 meters runs on asphalt surface and is considered one of the more challenging races in the regional ISCAREX Cup series and the Czech Uphill Running Cup. Race facilities are located in the school building, where registration, changing rooms, and toilets are available. Entries can be submitted in advance online at a discounted fee or on the race day.
course_highlights: 5.2 km course with a 230 m elevation gain
Road uphill run with finish at Max Švabinský Cottage
The entire course runs on asphalt surface
additional: Race facilities are located in the building of the Gustava Habrmana Secondary Technical and Transport School, where athlete registration takes place and changing rooms and toilets are available. Entries can be submitted in advance online at a discounted fee or on race day. The race is part of regional cups, registration is possible online, start is on Habrmanova Street, and the finish is at Max Švabinský Cottage.

description: The Petra Hézlová Memorial is a charitable sporting event held in Louny, offering running races for adults and children. The event is part of a sports afternoon for the whole family and features a rich accompanying program. All participants receive a commemorative wooden medal, and there is a raffle for a LIFEFIT.PRO brand running belt. The Memorial supports health and social projects, especially oncology.
course_highlights: Adult courses of 5 km and 10 km in Masaryk Gardens in Louny
Chip timing measurement
Children's races of 100 m, 400 m, and 1000 m according to age

name: Krakonošova pětadvacítka - B25

The course runs through mountain terrain with an elevation gain of approximately 903 meters and offers challenging conditions suitable for experienced runners. The event takes place annually in June and attracts participants from all over the Czech Republic who want to enjoy the beauty of the Krkonoše Mountains and the challenge of mountain running.

Part of the Krakonošova stovka series with a long tradition

name: Jirkovský crossmarathon a půlmarathon

The courses pass through beautiful nature of the Ore Mountains and are suitable for various athletic performances and recreational participation. The start and finish are at the 2nd Elementary School Jirkov, and the event takes place on June 20, 2026.

Routes for running, cycling, scooter riding, and hiking
Picturesque views and natural scenery

name: FarmaRun

For children, a short 300 m run is prepared, along with an exhibition race for the youngest under 4 years old right in the farm area. After the race, participants will receive commemorative medals, a refreshing drink, and light refreshments. In addition to the races, there is an accompanying program for the whole family.

Children's races over 300 m and an exhibition race for the youngest in the farm area

name: Velíšskej přespolňák

The Lucky Náprstkov Memorial commemorates a tragic event and is part of this sporting event. Organized by the Czech Union of Sport, which supports the general public in active movement and sports.

Cross-country run in natural terrain in Louny
Lucky Náprstkov Memorial as part of the race

Registrations and the schedule are available at www.askelna.cz. The Lucky Náprstkov Memorial commemorates a tragic event from 2002 in the High Tatras. The event is part of a broader series of sports events in the Czech Republic aimed at promoting active movement and sports participation among the general public.

Challenging terrain with beautiful views

The course includes grass, forest paths, and asphalt; start times are 9:30 and 10:30; registration is possible on-site; categories for different age groups; race distances range from 60 meters to 10 km.

name: Prešov Running Series 2. kolo
description: Prešov Running Series Round 2, known as Šariš Run, is a running event held on the banks of Rybníky in Veľký Šariš under the historic Šariš Castle. This location is a new addition to the series and has gained great popularity among runners. The event is full of sporting spirit, community, and love for nature, offering a rich accompanying program including musical performances, health stalls, a relaxation zone, and activities for children. The atmosphere is friendly and family-oriented, making running an unforgettable experience for all participants.

Natural environment with a community and family atmosphere

Pleasant natural environment and community atmosphere

Runners must report each completed lap at the check-line station, where their lap will be recorded. The event concludes with the announcement of results around 6:00 PM. The event is organized to help young girl Simonka Zigová by the toRun Stará Tura running club. It is a charitable, community, and fundraising event with online registration available.

description: Doby vežu is an extreme obstacle course and trail race held in Brezno, Slovakia. Participants must tackle challenging obstacles and complete a route leading to the top of the second highest observation tower in Slovakia, which is 40 meters tall and offers beautiful views. The course mainly runs through forest paths, meadows, and streams with minimal asphalt, featuring steep ascents and descents. In addition to the sporting experience, there is a accompanying entertainment program full of fun for all age groups. The organizer is M.Š.K Jašterice Brezno o.z., with Marek Janoštiak as the race director.
course_highlights: Forest paths, meadows, streams, minimal asphalt
Elevation gain of 450 meters with challenging obstacles (crawling in mud, slide, bars, slackline, climbing, cargo net, and more)
The top of the second highest observation tower in Slovakia at 40 meters
additional: Online registration closes on 13.06.2026 at 23:55 or when the limit is reached. After this date, on-site registration on race day is possible if the limit has not been exceeded. Penalties for not overcoming obstacles are burpees (15 for Hobby, 20-30 for Open). Assistance between competitors is allowed in Hobby, prohibited in Open. Refreshments will be available on the course and at the finish line (fruit and drinks). Children can participate only with parental consent. Categories are divided by age and race type. The event includes obstacle course racing and trail running. Registration ends on June 13, 2026. There are categories for children and juniors, and refreshments and entertainment are provided.

name: Grobský Runfest
location: Areál za MŠ a ZŠ Javorová Alej, Chorvátsky Grob, Slovakia
organizer: SBT Spid.com, s.r.o., Susedský Hi o.z., PavúčikSport Team o.z., obec Chorvátsky Grob
description: Grobský Runfest is a two-day sports festival in Chorvátsky Grob that brings together professional athletes and recreational enthusiasts of all ages. It offers running courses of various distances, children's races, cycling competitions, and a rich cultural and entertainment program including a food zone and musical performances. The event promotes community and a healthy lifestyle in a pleasant environment with diverse activities for all visitors.
course_highlights: 5 km WeLive run on an asphalt flat course
12 km Race for the Municipality Cup with 30% asphalt and 70% terrain, mostly flat
Children's races and cycling competitions divided by age categories
additional: On-site registration for the 5 km: 16:00 - 17:45, results announcement at 19:15. On-site registration for the 12 km: Saturday 16:00 - 18:00, Sunday 10:00 - 11:15, results announcement on Sunday at 13:00. The course surface is mainly asphalt and terrain with a flat profile. The festival also includes a floorball tournament, football cup, cycling zone, food zone, and recovery zone. The program features musical performances and presentations by local organizations. The event includes multiple sports activities, concerts, children's zones, refreshment stations, a recovery area, and competitive events for all age groups.

name: Bieg Lotnej Kompanii Szturmowej
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Kultury i Wypoczynku w Haczowie oraz Urząd Gminy w Haczowie

price_tiers.distance: Bieg główny 12 km, Piątka Wyżykowskiego 5 km i Nordic Walking 5 km

description: The 8th 'Lotna' Run in Haczów is an annual running event commemorating the Lotna Assault Company of Lt. Stanisław Maczek and the Heroes of the Struggles for Polish Independence in 1918-1921. The races take place on routes approximately 12 km and 5 km long, as well as a Nordic Walking walk over 5 km, mainly on asphalt and gravel roads within the Haczów municipality. The run promotes a healthy lifestyle, physical culture, and community integration. There are free shorter races for children, tailored to their age. The race office and base are located in the Manor Park at the Municipal Cultural and Recreation Center in Haczów.
course_highlights: Routes approximately 12 km and 5 km long with predominance of asphalt and gravel roads
One refreshment point with water along the route
Time limit of 2 hours for the 12 km run, 1 hour for the 5 km run and Nordic Walking
additional: The participant limit is 150 for adult races. Free races for children are available on distances from about 200 m to 1000 m depending on age category. The race office operates from 13:00 to 14:30 for adults and from 11:30 to 12:45 for children. Start packages are issued at the race office. The entry fee is non-refundable. The event takes place in Haczów, in the Manor Park and at the LKS stadium.

organizer: Starostwo Powiatowe w Gryficach, Powiatowe Centrum Sportu Rekreacji i Promocji w Gryficach, PLMKS Chrobry Gryfice, Zarząd Dróg Powiatowych w Gryficach, Klub Sportowy "RunGryf"

description: The 9th edition of Gryf Arena Run will take place on June 21, 2026, in Gryfice. The race route runs through the city streets, offering participants a great atmosphere, sporting excitement, and positive energy. The event is family-friendly, with children's races on distances from 100 to 600 meters, tailored to different age groups. Each child participant in the races will receive a commemorative T-shirt, a medal, and a sweet treat at the finish line. It is one of the largest running events in the region, combining athletic competition with fun for the whole family.
course_highlights: The route runs through the streets of Gryfice
Children's races on distances from 100 to 600 meters tailored to age groups
An atmosphere full of sporting excitement and positive energy
additional: Children's races McDonald's Gryfice start at 10:00 AM. Each child receives a commemorative T-shirt, a medal, and a sweet treat at the finish line. Electronic registration is available for the children's races. The starting fee on the race day at the event office is 50 PLN. The event takes place in the city of Gryfice, with a street route and electronic timing. Online registration is available, with medals and prizes for the best participants. The participant limit is 150 in the main race.

name: IX Bieg Wolności
location: Samorządowa Instytucja Kultury Kasztelania, Kije, Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship, Poland
description: IX Freedom Run - Kije 2026 is a unique sporting event that combines a passion for running, community integration, and promotion of the beautiful Ponidzie region. The race will take place on June 21, 2026, at 6:00 PM at the premises of the Local Cultural Institution Kasztelania in Kije, where the start and finish lines will be located. Participants can compete over two distances: 10 km and 5.5 km ("Plus Five"), running or Nordic walking with poles. The event offers a great atmosphere, cash and material prizes, and commemorative medals and starter packs for all participants.
course_highlights: Two distances: 10 km and 5.5 km (Plus Five)
Route allows running and Nordic walking
Start and finish at the premises of the Local Cultural Institution Kasztelania in Kije
additional: Commemorative medals and starter packs are provided for all participants. Organizers have prepared local and age classifications as well as attractive cash and material prizes. The start and finish are located at the premises of the Local Cultural Institution Kasztelania in Kije. The area around Kasztelania, online registration, commemorative medals, cash and material prizes.

name: X Bieg STO-nogi
location: Milanówek, Warszawa County, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Społeczne Liceum Ogólnokształcące Nr 5 STO w Milanówku
description: The 10th STO-nogi Run in Milanówek is a traditional street race covering a distance of 10 km, held in the picturesque town of Milanówek. The route is in the shape of the letter "T" and consists of two loops of 5 km each, running through the streets of the town, with turnaround points near a chapel and Brzozowa Street. The start and finish are located at the Social High School No. 5 at 41 Herbert Street. The race is organized by enthusiasts from the STO-nogi group, who promote running among residents and visitors.
course_highlights: 10 km route in the shape of the "T" with two 5 km loops
Street race through Milanówek with turnaround points near a chapel and Brzozowa Street
Start and finish at SLO No. 5, 41 Herbert Street
additional: Start and finish at SLO No. 5 (41 Herbert Street). Urban route with two turnaround points. Organized by the local running group STO-nogi, promoting sport among residents. Previous editions also featured races of other distances and night runs. Contact phone numbers for organizers: Leszek Janasik 666 353 600, Jerzy Stypa 601 825 560. The event includes a 10 km race through the streets of Milanówek, with online registration and available training plans for preparation. Participants can also take part in accompanying night events.

description: The 10th Ostróda St. George's Half Marathon is a jubilee edition of the half marathon held in Ostróda. The race route runs along the promenade by Lake Drwęckie and through the city streets, consisting of two identical loops with a total length of 21.098 km. The race starts and finishes at the Amphitheater at 17a Mickiewicza Street, with hydration points approximately every 4 km. Organizers provide a commemorative medal, a voucher for a recovery meal, and the option to choose a package with or without a T-shirt. The event is charitable, supporting the rehabilitation of girl Maja.
course_highlights: Route runs along the promenade by Lake Drwęckie and through Ostróda streets
Two identical loops totaling 21.098 km
Hydration points approximately every 4 km (4 points per loop)
additional: The participant limit is 400 people, with start and finish at the Amphitheater at 17a Mickiewicza Street. The time limit to complete the route is 3 hours. The race kit includes an individual number, a deposit bag, safety pins, a commemorative medal, and a voucher for a recovery meal. After June 10th, registration is only possible at the race office (June 20-21) with a basic package priced at 180 PLN. The timing chip is rented and must be returned after the race. The participant limit is 170 out of 400 spots. The registration fee includes medals, bags, and a meal voucher. The proceeds support a charity campaign for Maja's rehabilitation. The route is not PZLA certified. Hydration points are every 4 km, with a 3-hour time limit.

name: XI Bieg Terenowy Zgierz Malinka
location: MOSiR Zgierz Malinka, Zgierz, Łódzkie, Poland
description: The 11th Zgierz Malinka Cross Country Run is a trail race held on the forested areas of MOSiR Zgierz Malinka. The route features varied terrain, including ascents, descents of different lengths and inclines, large sandy patches, and narrow sections through bushes. The cross-country nature of the course attracts runners seeking an escape from asphalt or preparing for mountain races. The event takes place on three distances: 4 km, 8 km, and 12 km, as well as a 4 km Nordic walking march and races for children and youth. Participants receive symbolic medals referencing the raspberry, and the top competitors in the categories of women and men at each distance receive trophies.
course_highlights: The route runs through the forested areas of MOSiR Zgierz Malinka
Varied terrain with ascents, descents, sand, and narrow sections in bushes
Cross-country character of the course, unusual for urban areas
additional: All participants start simultaneously regardless of the distance. There are races for children and youth on distances of 150 m (ages 0-6) and 800 m (ages 7-15). The race village at MOSiR Zgierz Malinka offers numerous attractions, including playgrounds, a pump truck track, beach volleyball courts, mini football and basketball fields, swimming areas, a kayak rental, and a golf shooting range. The event includes various distances, children's races, medals, electronic timing, and sports attractions on site.

description: Panewnicki Bieg Dzika is a recreational running and Nordic Walking event held in the picturesque forests of Panewniki in Katowice. The competition takes place on a loop approximately 4,882 meters long, which can be completed up to four times, with a kilometer marker each. The event promotes an active lifestyle and education about proper behavior in forest areas, and both amateurs and athletes affiliated with sports clubs can participate. The organizers are the Jerzy Kukuczka University of Physical Education in Katowice and the State Fire Service Katowice.
course_highlights: Route approximately 4882 meters long with kilometer markers
Ability to complete the loop up to 4 times
Time limit of 3 hours for runners and Nordic Walking
additional: The time limit to complete the route is 3 hours. Participants under 18 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian during verification. Entry fees are non-refundable but can be transferred to the next start upon registration by Thursday before the event at 3:00 PM. Participants over 18 sign a declaration of participation at their own risk or present a medical certificate. The competition includes running and Nordic Walking disciplines, with a 3-hour time limit, electronic registration, discounts for employees and students, as well as medals and prizes for participants.

description: The Świecie Run Along the Shore of Deczna is an annual running event held in the picturesque area of Deczna near Świecie. The main race over a distance of 10 km takes place through the Recreation and Leisure Center area, offering participants an attractive route and sporting competition. The event also includes free runs for children, making it a family and community event. Organizers provide professional timing and start packages with T-shirts for early registrations. The limit of participants for the main race is 300 people, ensuring an intimate atmosphere.
course_highlights: 10 km route near the Recreation and Leisure Center in Deczna
Scenic areas along the Deczna River
Children's races as an integral part of the event
additional: The main race is limited to 300 participants, and children's races to 100 participants. Children's races are free of charge. The start package includes a T-shirt for registrations made by May 31. The children's races start at 10:00 AM, and the main race at 11:00 AM. Contact person: Bartosz Gładyszew, phone: 669-056-101. The event also features competitions for children and attractive prizes for the best runners.

name: Velichovská sedmička
description: Velichovská sedmička is a friendly family running race held in the village of Velichovky, offering a main course of 7 km along forest paths and local roads. The race is open to all age groups, including children, and promotes active leisure time in nature. The event is part of the Primátor Cup series and is ideal for sports enthusiasts and families seeking a shared sporting activity. The race takes place on the last Saturday of June, with options to participate in other shorter routes and children's categories.
course_highlights: Course run along forest paths and local roads
Suitable for all age groups and families
Part of the Primátor Cup series with various lengths and categories
additional: Suitable for children, in all weather conditions, sports event, race in May and June, canceled in 2020

name: ČEZ RunTour Plzeň
location: Plzeň, centrum města Plzně, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: CEZ RunTour Pilsen is a family running race with an atmosphere of joy and relaxation, suitable for both amateurs and elite runners. It offers various courses from children's runs through 3, 5, 10 km to a half marathon. The race takes place in the city center of Pilsen and is part of a series of races across the Czech Republic. Participants will enjoy not only running but also an accompanying program for the whole family and quality service from start to finish.
course_highlights: Courses of 3, 5, 10, and 21.1 km in the center of Pilsen
Children's runs of 500 and 1000 meters with a children's corner and babysitting
Refreshment stations on the course and a start package for every runner
additional: The race offers a guiding team, medical services, and a special emergency phone line during the race. Each participant receives a gymsack with gifts from partners. For children, a start package from Lidl and entertainment in the children's zone are prepared. There are at least two refreshment stations on the half marathon course. The event offers family activities, charitable support, start packages, facilities with refreshments, showers, and the possibility of professional photographs.

description: Dobratice Run is a traditional running race in the picturesque village of Dobratice, attracting sports enthusiasts of all ages. The race offers beautiful routes through nature and scenic surroundings, suitable for both experienced runners and families with children. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, themed categories, and valuable prizes for winners and participants. Each year brings a new theme, giving the race a unique atmosphere and joy of movement.
course_highlights: Main race route 8.8 km with 90% asphalt surface
Community run over 3.1 km without age restrictions
Scenic environment of Dobratice village and surrounding nature
additional: The race capacity is 500 participants including children and adults. Registration on site is possible only if capacity is not full. Short runs for children are scheduled to start at 9:30 AM. Medals, refreshments, and drinks are provided for all participants. Financial prizes are awarded to the top three men and women overall in both the main and community runs. Gift vouchers are awarded to the top three in each category. There is also a raffle for all starters. Race routes, orientation map, parking, various categories, themed annual editions, and prize money for main categories are included.

description: Hamelika Three Ways is a running race organized by Pro Sport Activities in Hamelika near Mariánské Lázně. The race is part of the series 'Lookouts in Motion' and the 'Plzeň Region Running Cup,' offering a sporting experience for the general public. The event is suitable for runners of all ages and levels, emphasizing a pleasant environment and a sporting atmosphere. Pro Sport Activities has a long-standing tradition of organizing running races and looks forward to participants in 2026.
course_highlights: Run through the picturesque nature of Mariánské Lázně
Part of the series 'Lookouts in Motion'
Suitable for all age groups
additional: Children's races start at 10:00 AM, adults start at 11:45 AM. The race is part of the Plzeň Region Running Cup and the 'Lookouts in Motion' series. Terrain: around the lookout tower, registration in advance, part of the 'Lookouts in Motion' running series.

name: Sunrise Marathon / Halfmaraton
location: Olympia Brno, Modřice, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: Sunrise Marathon and Half Marathon will take place on June 21, 2026, at Olympia Brno, Modřice. The race starts early in the morning at 4:46 AM to allow runners to experience the magical atmosphere of sunrise during the run. The course is flat and consists of five equally long loops, which run partly in nature and partly through shaded sections. Organizers provide electronic timing and support at key points along the course. The race is suitable for all runners who want to welcome summer actively and experience a unique dawn running event.
course_highlights: Flat course with five equally long loops
Start and finish at Olympia Shopping Mall Brno, Modřice
Part of the course runs in nature and shaded sections
additional: Electronic timing with chip. The course is marked with directional signs and organizers are present at important locations. Bag storage is available until 10:00 AM. Weather at the start is usually pleasant, 14 - 16 °C, it is recommended to adjust hydration and clothing accordingly. The start is early in the morning, with bus transportation available from Brno, refreshment stations, medical services, and the option to purchase race merchandise.

name: Hradecký kros
description: The Hradecký Cross is a traditional 10 km trail race held in the forests around Biřička in Hradec Králové. The race offers a unique experience of natural terrain with fewer asphalt sections, suitable for the general public and recreational runners. The event is part of the Great Prize of Eastern Bohemia in running and attracts competitors of all levels every year. The course runs through two 5 km loops in slightly hilly terrain, highlighting the beauty and challenge of the race.
course_highlights: The course runs through forest paths around Biřička
Two 5 km loops in slightly hilly terrain
Suitable for the general public and recreational runners
additional: Forest paths, minimal asphalt sections; registration on-site or online; race takes place on June 21, 2026, start at 10:00 AM; race length 10 km

name: Ivčin kopeček
description: Ivčin kopeček is an uphill race 3.4 km long with an elevation gain of 240 meters, which is part of the Hill Running Series in Prague and the surrounding area. This race offers runners a challenging yet attractive course in the beautiful natural environment of Beroun in the Central Bohemian Region. It is suitable for mountain running and uphill running enthusiasts who want to test their endurance and strength on a short but intense route. The race is open to the general public and welcomes all runners who want to enjoy a sporting challenge in a pleasant atmosphere.
course_highlights: Length of the course 3.4 km with an elevation gain of 240 m
Challenging uphill run in the natural environment of Beroun
Part of the Hill Running Series in Prague and surroundings
additional: Registration is possible at the Na Černém vršku pub in Beroun, early arrival is recommended due to limited parking.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 6. kolo
description: The 2-Mile Run Bratislava is a regular 2-mile race organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team at the Kuchajda swimming complex in Bratislava. The race is open to a wide range of categories including children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. Registration takes place directly on-site from 9:30 AM, with the start at 10:00 AM. There is also a competition for the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team's Traveling Cup, where runners are scored based on their performances and participation in individual rounds.
course_highlights: Distance of the course 2 miles (3.218 km), children approximately 200 m
The course runs within the Kuchajda swimming complex in Bratislava
Registration and check-in at the volleyball court
additional: Registration takes place directly on-site from 9:30 AM. The start is at 10:00 AM. Categories: children (13 years and younger), juniors, women, men, veterans (women and men). Competition for the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team's Traveling Cup with scoring based on participation and performance. In case of equal points, the best time after adjustment with a coefficient and shoe size determines the winner. The race is held at Kuchajda, with on-site registration available at the volleyball court; categories include children, juniors, women, men, and veterans; the event is part of a series of 12 races in 2025.

name: Tvrďák – Bratislava
description: Tvrďák Bratislava is the largest obstacle race in Slovakia, held at the Divoká Voda area in Čunovo. Participants overcome more than 20 obstacles over a course approximately 5 km long, with options to compete in various modes including a non-competitive fitness mode or timed mode. After the race, participants can relax by the pool, enjoy refreshments, and watch strength competitions. The race is suitable for children aged 8 to 14 and offers a medal, photos, and videos from the race as souvenirs.
course_highlights: Course approximately 5 km with over 20 obstacles
Obstacles suitable for children from 8 years old
Race held at Divoká Voda, Čunovo with poolside relaxation options
additional: Participants can run Tvrďák 5+ km solo or in a team (minimum 3 people, mixed teams possible). Fitness mode (non-competitive, no time measurement, no penalty exercises, obstacles can be skipped) and Timed mode (time measurement, penalty exercises for not overcoming obstacles). After the race, relax by the pool, enjoy refreshments, try water sports, and watch strength competitions from 14:00. Entry fee is non-refundable, with options to transfer registration to another person or to next year for a fee. The event also includes a children's race, team or individual starts, and after the race, water activities and entertainment for all age groups.

name: Behu ulicami mesta Veľký Krtíš
price_range: 15 € pre hlavnú trať, 3 € pre juniorov, 15 € pre Nordic Walking, zľavy pre seniorov
description: The Veľký Krtíš city street run is a traditional running event organized by the Civic Association Bežci VK, offering various categories including children, hobby runners, and Nordic Walking. The race takes place in the town of Veľký Krtíš and includes courses from 3,000 meters up to the main race of 11,000 meters. The start is divided into children at 09:45 and the main category along with Nordic Walking at 11:00. The event is suitable for the general public and offers discounts for seniors over 60 years old.
course_highlights: Main race 11,000 m through city streets
Hobby race 3,000 m
Nordic Walking course 6,000 m
additional: A 50% discount on the entry fee for the age category 60 years and older. On-site registration is possible at least 30 minutes before the start of the main race for an increased entry fee of €17. The course includes city streets and asphalt roads; online registration is open until June 14, 2025; the event is suitable for all age groups.

name: Moldavský pohár Bodvy
location: Hlavné námestie, Moldava nad Bodvou, Košice, Slovakia
description: The Moldava Cup Bodva is an international road race, cycling, and inline skating event held in Moldava nad Bodvou. The race offers various categories for runners, cyclists, and inline skaters, with routes passing through the surrounding countryside and villages. The event is known for its tradition and high-quality organization, with start and finish lines at the Main Square in Moldava nad Bodvou. It also features a mass run for health, allowing broad public participation.
course_highlights: The run follows a route between Moldava nad Bodvou and Jasov and back
The cycling route passes through several villages including Budulov, Janík, and Turnianska Nová Ves
The inline route is 17.5 km long and is part of the Slovak Inline Cup
additional: Registration for competitors is from 7:00 to 8:30 AM. The announcement of winners takes place in front of the building of the Secondary Vocational School of Agriculture. Monetary prizes are awarded to the top three competitors in both men's and women's categories, while others receive medals. All competition categories are age-restricted, and participants can only register for the category corresponding to their age. The event includes multiple categories, online registration, and sponsor support.

name: Kros Sázava
description: Cross Sázava is a running race in Pikovice, Central Bohemia, offering three routes of different lengths and elevation gains. The longer route measures 15.5 km with an elevation gain of approximately 500 m, the medium route 10 km with an elevation gain of approximately 230 m, and the hobby route 5 km with an elevation gain of 120 m. All routes are exclusively through nature, ensuring beautiful and challenging running experiences. The race is suitable for runners of various levels who want to enjoy cross-country running in a picturesque environment.
course_highlights: Longer route 15.5 km with an elevation gain of approximately 500 m
Medium route 10 km with an elevation gain of approximately 230 m
Hobby route 5 km with an elevation gain of 120 m
additional: routes 15.5 km, 10 km, 5 km; scenic trail along Sázava River and forest paths; scenic and technical sections

Picturesque views and natural scenery of the Hradec Králové Region
additional: Participants must be members of the Czech veteran athletics section and run in the national team uniform; the event also includes local races such as the Long Záhony Run.

name: ROZKOŠný 1/2 Maraton
location: Česká Skalice, Česká Skalice, Czech Republic
description: The Rozkoš Half Marathon is a half marathon held in Česká Skalice, running along a new cycle path around the Rozkoš water reservoir. The race offers a main run of 21.1 km and a supporting run of 2 km designed for children and mothers with strollers. The event is complemented by entertainment, refreshments, and the possibility of accommodation in a camp, creating a pleasant atmosphere for all participants and companions. The start of the main category is at 12:30, the first category starts at 10:00.
course_highlights: Half marathon along the new cycle path around the Rozkoš water reservoir
Supporting 2 km run for children and mothers with strollers
Possibility of camping accommodation and refreshments on site
additional: Start of the first category at 10:00, start of the main category at 12:30. The race takes place on the cycle path near the Autocamp Rozkoš in Česká Skalice. The supporting run is intended for children and mothers with strollers. There is entertainment, refreshments, and camping accommodation available. Terrain: road, Registration: not specified, Additional notes: entertainment, refreshments, camping accommodation

name: Záblatská osmička
description: Záblatská osmička is a running race in Bohumín-Záblatí that offers a local atmosphere and a friendly pace. The race route passes through various terrains, including asphalt roads, forest sections, and gravel-sand paths, engaging runners from start to finish. The event is open to everyone who wants to enjoy running and a great atmosphere. Registration is open until June 24, 2026, and the start is at 10:00 AM at the football field in Záblatí.
course_highlights: The route passes through asphalt roads, forest sections, and gravel-sand paths
Local atmosphere and friendly pace
Refreshments at the 4th kilometer and at the finish
additional: Registration takes place from 9:00 to 9:45. Results announcement and raffle are scheduled for 11:30. Toilets are available at the event site, but it is not possible to securely store belongings at the start and finish areas. The race is held on June 27, 2026, with the start planned for 10:00 AM, and registration closes on June 24, 2026. The event includes refreshments at the 4 km mark and at the finish. The route is similar to that of 2025 and includes categories for men and women, including local runners from Bohumín.

description: Lužany Forest Run is a traditional running race held in the recreational area of the village of Lužany near Jičín, specifically at the campsite by Marešák Pond. The jubilee 50th edition will take place on June 27, 2026, and offers various categories and distances suitable for a wide range of runners, including children. The race is supported by the Hradec Králové Region and organized by the Municipality of Lužany, ELMAT Kůtek s.r.o., and TJ Sokol Lužany. Participants can expect medals, material prizes, and monetary rewards for the best competitors in each category.
course_highlights: Routes up to 1000 m run within the campsite area, shorter distances are almost straight
Longer routes consist of loops of 300, 400, and 500 meters
The race takes place in a picturesque recreational area by Marešák Pond
additional: Prizes for the best competitors in categories, perpetual trophies, monetary rewards for record-breaking performances, free start for residents of Lužany upon registration by April 30, 2026, medals and material prizes for the top three in each category. The race offers multiple categories including children and recreational runs. Registration is possible on the official website. The event is held at the campsite by Marešák Pond and is supported by regional partners.

name: Žhavé běhy Slováckého léta
location: Uherské Hradiště, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The fiery runs of Slovácké léto are traditional running races held in the historic center of Uherské Hradiště. Participants can choose from three routes of 5, 10, and 21 kilometers, which lead through scenic countryside along the Morava River, through Kunovský les forest park, and the Novoveská lakes. The races are suitable for all runners, from beginners to experienced athletes, and offer a unique experience of movement in the beautiful environment of Slovácko. The start and finish are at Masaryk Square, adding to the race's atmosphere of the city's historic heart.
course_highlights: Route runs through the historic center of Uherské Hradiště
Running along the Morava River and its confluence with Olšava
Connection with Kunovský les forest park and Novoveská lakes
additional: The start and finish of the races are at Masaryk Square in Uherské Hradiště. The routes are laid out on city and natural paths, including cycle paths. The races are part of the sports-cultural festival Slovácké léto, which also offers other sports and cultural activities. The festival is suitable for all age groups, including families with children. The course includes the city center, the river, parks, and cycle paths; registration conditions are not specified.

name: Malofatranská stovka
description: Malofatranská stovka is a mountain ultramarathon in the Malá Fatra mountain range, offering challenging routes with significant ascents and descents. The race is intended for experienced runners with excellent physical condition and traverses the entire range, including Krivánska and Lúčanská Fatra. The event is a registered member of ITRA and serves as a qualifying race for other prestigious ultratrails. Organized by Slovak Ultra Trail in cooperation with volunteers and partners.
course_highlights: The route passes through the entire Malá Fatra mountain range (Krivánska and Lúčanská Fatra)
Significant ascents and descents with exposed sections
Available routes: MF100 (107 km / 7300 m+), MF50 (56 km / 4400 m+), MF33 (35 km / 2600 m+)
additional: A mandatory part of the equipment is insurance for intervention by the Mountain Rescue Service, which can be ordered directly during registration. A functional and cotton T-shirt with original print is available. Discounts on start fees are possible based on the ITRA Performance Index. Registration and start take place in Terchová. Trail race through Malá Fatra with significant ascents and descents, exposure, and mountain terrain; registration details not specified.

name: Svätojánsky beh na Domaši
description: The St. John's Run at Domaša is a traditional running race held at the recreational resort Domaša Dobrá. Participants can choose between two courses - a short 5 km and a long 13 km, which mainly run through forest roads and trails with varied elevation. The event is suitable for the general public, including categories by age and gender, with organizers providing refreshment stations, changing rooms, toilets, and medical services. The atmosphere is friendly and competitive, with valuable material prizes for the winners.
course_highlights: Long course 13 km with an elevation gain of approximately 356 m uphill and 314 m downhill
Short course 5 km running through forest road with an elevation gain of 70 m
Refreshment stations at 5 km, 10 km, and at the finish of the long course, refreshments at the finish of the short course
additional: Children's race is free of charge. Changing rooms, toilets, and storage are located at the port near the Bohemia Ship. Each runner must wear a visible bib number on the chest. The organizer provides medical services. Entry fee will be fully refunded if canceled by June 8. The race is conducted according to athletics competition rules and event regulations. The 13 km and 5 km courses, children's race, categories for men and women of various age groups, start from 09:45 to 10:15, parking at Bogárka, recreational resort Domaša Dobra.

name: Beh za zdravie – Záhorská Bystrica
location: BYS3T PARK, Záhorská Bystrica, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: Health Run in Záhorská Bystrica is a charitable running event that combines sports with promoting health and community. It will take place on June 27, 2026, in BYS3T PARK and offers an opportunity to experience a great atmosphere and inspiring stories, with every participant contributing to a good cause. The event is open to all age groups and fitness levels, supporting a healthy lifestyle and helping disadvantaged individuals. Health Run was established in 2023 and annually supports selected persons or foundations through movement.
course_highlights: Takes place in BYS3T PARK in Záhorská Bystrica
The event combines running and community support
Open to all age groups and fitness levels
additional: The event is charitable and supports disadvantaged individuals and organizations. Children, adults, and seniors can participate by running, walking at a slow pace, or strolling. Organizers offer the opportunity to volunteer and assist with the event organization. The event takes place on park grounds and streets in Záhorská Bystrica, with options to participate as a runner, walker, or volunteer. There is also a virtual participation option.

name: Velvet Run Košice
location: Košice, pri Urbanovej veži na Hlavnej ulici, Košice, Slovakia
organizer: Progres Promotion Košice, s.r.o., Maratónsky klub Košice
description: Velvet Run in Košice is a running event taking place on June 27, 2026, at the Urban Tower on Main Street. Participants can choose from disciplines of 5 km, 10 km, and Velvet Nordic Walking at 5 km. The event is exclusively for women and offers valuable material prizes for winners in various categories. Organizers will provide timing measurement using the MyLaps system, and results will be published on the official website.
course_highlights: Courses Velvet Run 5 km and 10 km in the center of Košice near the Urban Tower
Discipline Velvet Nordic Walking at 5 km
Presentation and start on Main Street
additional: Registration is open online until June 23, 2026, or until the limit is reached. On-site registration is also possible from 14:00, provided that technical and safety limits have not been exceeded. The announcement of winners begins at 18:00, and the event concludes at 19:00. Competitions for pairs "Mother and Daughter" and "Sisters" in 5 km and 10 km runs. Timing measurement is provided by the ChampionChip system MyLaps. The event includes various categories for different age groups, with timing using the ChampionChip system; registration is also possible on-site.

name: Čergovský umirak
location: Drienica, Sabinov District, Prešov Region, Slovakia
organizer: Marián Gargalovič, Ondrej Janiga, Slavomír Uličný

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 25,– € Po úhrade štartovného a následnom odhlásení sa z preteku si organizátor nárokuje na 50% z ceny štartovného.

description: Čergovský umirak is a mountain run approximately 30 km long with an elevation gain of around 1000 meters, intended for trained runners. The race takes place at the recreational center Drienica, with options for refreshments and additional activities for families. The course runs along marked hiking trails, and participants are required to wear a visible start number on their chest. Safety on the course is provided by the Čergov Mountain Rescue Service, and each participant runs at their own risk. After the last runners finish, there will be an evaluation and award ceremony for the best men and women.
course_highlights: Mountain run approximately 30 km long with an elevation gain of about 1000 m
Marked hiking trail in the Čergov area
Start and finish at Chata Ride pub in Drienica
additional: Mandatory equipment: charged mobile phone, minimum 0.5 liter water bottle, aluminum foil in case of bad weather. A joint briefing will be held at 8:30 AM at Chata Ride pub, including familiarization with the course and orientation. Refreshments will be provided. The start number is non-transferable and must be visibly attached to the chest. Safety during the race is secured by the Čergov Mountain Rescue Service. The course is marked as a hiking trail; trail running shoes are recommended. To register, contact the organizers by phone or email.

name: Hámornický polmaratón
description: The Hámornický Half Marathon is a traditional running race organized by the Spartak Medzev Running Club as part of the Medzev City Days celebrations. The event includes the half marathon, the accompanying Hámornícka Ten race, and children's categories Hámorníček, which are part of the children's running league. The start is symbolically marked by a hammer strike on an anvil, adding a unique atmosphere to the event. Runners can look forward to nice functional T-shirts, medals with a modern design, and refreshments during the race. The course takes place through a beautiful deep valley with natural beauty and a historic atmosphere of the town of Medzev.
course_highlights: The route passes through a beautiful deep valley with natural springs and bird songs
Symbolic start with a hammer strike on an anvil
Supporting runs including the Hámornícka Ten and children's categories Hámorníček
additional: Participants receive nice functional T-shirts and medals with a modern design. Children can participate for free in 14 categories with a package of sweets and juice at the finish line. The event is supported by the town of Medzev and the village of Štós, with organizers appreciating help from 2% of taxes. The course also includes a football stadium; registration is available online and on-site; categories for men, women, and seniors.

name: Beh cez Hornoorešanské vŕšky – Memoriál Františka Hečka
location: Futbalový štadión, Horné Orešany, Trnava, Slovakia
organizer: Bežecký klub Viktoria, Obecný úrad Horné Orešany
description: Running through the Hornoorešanské Vŕšky - František Hečko Memorial is a running race in Horné Orešany, offering a course length of 10,300 meters with an elevation gain of 100 meters. The surface of the course is a combination of asphalt and terrain in a 50:50 ratio, making the race interesting and challenging. The race is open to all age categories, from children as young as 1 year old to seniors, including men's, women's, junior, and local runners. The organizer is the Viktoria Running Club together with the Horné Orešany Municipal Office. The start for pupils is at 15:35 and for others at 17:00.
course_highlights: Length of the course 10,300 m with an elevation gain of 100 m
Course surface 50% asphalt, 50% terrain
The course runs through Hornoorešanské Vŕšky with beautiful views
additional: Start for pupils is at 15:35, for others at 17:00. Categories include all age groups from children as young as 1 year, juniors, men, and women of various age categories, including a local three-member team category. The course is approximately 10.3 km, divided into 50% asphalt and 50% terrain. Registration is available online or on-site. Start times are at 15:35 and 17:00.

name: Rajec RunTour Bratislava
description: Rajec RunTour Bratislava is a family running festival offering courses for all age groups and performance levels. Participants can choose from 3 km, 5 km, and 10 km routes, as well as children's runs over 500 and 1000 meters. The event takes place in two locations and includes a starter package with everything runners need. In addition to the race itself, there is a rich accompanying program, refreshments on the course and at the finish line, medical and guiding services, and facilities with changing rooms and storage. The entire day is designed as an experience for runners and their families, featuring a raffle and the option to engrave personal details on medals.
course_highlights: Routes of 3, 5, and 10 km for amateurs and elite runners
Children's runs over 500 and 1000 meters
Refreshment stations on the course and at the finish line, medical and guiding services
additional: Runners have access to guides with flags who help maintain pace. After the race, it is possible to have personal time and name engraved on the medal. There are showers, storage, and a rich accompanying program including a children's zone and a raffle with valuable prizes. The routes are 3, 5, and 10 km, with children's runs over 500 and 1000 meters, refreshments, showers, storage, medals, photos, a raffle, and a family atmosphere.

name: Behaj lesmi Bachledová dolina
location: Bachledová dolina, Bachledová dolina, Bachledka Ski & Sun, Slovakia
description: Run through Bachledová Dolina is a trail race in the beautiful nature of the High Tatras, offering runners a unique experience of running on soft terrain with fresh mountain air. The route passes through the Tree Top Walk, Monk's Valley, and the Spišská Magura ridge, with the start secured by a cable car. The race is part of the Run through the Forest series, which combines athletic performance with support for local families and charitable stories. Run through Bachledová Dolina is a challenge for experienced runners and beginners alike who want to experience mountain nature and unforgettable views.
course_highlights: The route passes through the Tree Top Walk
Views of the High Tatras and the Spišská Magura ridge
Start by cable car in Bachledová Dolina
additional: The race is included under UTMB Index Races with international point valuation. There is a fast section called Conti Speed Section with a chance to win a voucher for tires and a running jersey. Pre-registration and changes to the starting fee can be made online via the SportID profile or on-site at the race. The event includes eco-friendly cups, water stations, various race categories including children’s races, and offers discounts for multiple participant registrations.

name: Wielka Pętla Izerska w ramach Izerskiego Weekendu Biegowego
location: Szklarska Poręba, Jelenia Góra County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Great Izerska Loop is a scenic half marathon held as part of the Izerski Running Weekend in Szklarska Poręba. The route runs through the streets of the town and along the trails of the Izerskie Mountains, offering runners contact with nature and mountain scenery. The race is recreational and sports-oriented, promoting physical activity and popularizing running. Participants use electronic timing, and the time limit to complete the course is 3 hours.
course_highlights: The route runs through the streets of Szklarska Poręba and along the trails of the Izerskie Mountains
The surface of the route includes paved paths and forest roads
Finish line at the Municipal Stadium on Plac Sportowy in Szklarska Poręba
additional: Timing is measured with a chip mounted in the start number, which cannot be removed. The time limit to complete the course is 3 hours from the start. Participants shortening the route are disqualified. The event includes various distances, including 5 km, 10 km, and Nordic Walking, with online registration and routes in mountain terrains. It has been held since 2013, featuring well-known athletes and course records.

name: XVIII Bieg w pogoni za żubrem
description: The XV Run in Pursuit of the Bison is an annual running event held in Niepołomice, attracting runners of various distances. The competition offers routes of 8 and 15 kilometers as well as a race for children, making the event appealing to a wide range of participants. The race course runs through scenic areas, combining athletic competition with the beauty of the surrounding nature. It is an excellent opportunity to spend active time and compete in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 8-kilometer race route through scenic areas of Niepołomice
Longer 15-kilometer route for more advanced runners
Special race for children promoting physical activity among the young
additional: forest terrain, registration via form on the website, sports and recreational event

name: Izery Ultra-Trail
location: Świeradów-Zdrój, Jelenia Góra County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

tiers.description: Niższa opłata startowa do końca stycznia

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Niższa opłata startowa tylko do końca marca

tiers.description: Niższa opłata startowa do końca stycznia
