description: Izery Ultra-Trail is a unique mountain race held in the heart of the picturesque Izera Mountains, with start and finish in Świeradów-Zdrój. The routes of varying lengths and difficulty levels lead through wild, unknown terrains, offering participants unforgettable views and challenges. The event attracts both experienced ultramarathon runners and trail enthusiasts who want to face demanding terrain and the beauty of nature. Organizers provide full support at nutrition points and necessary equipment, ensuring safety and comfort for participants.
course_highlights: Routes lead through wild and unknown terrains of the Izera Mountains
Start and finish in the heart of Świeradów-Zdrój, in the Spa Park
Significant elevation gains: up to +2650 m on the longest route of 100 km
additional: Start and finish in the Spa Park in Świeradów-Zdrój. Routes equipped with nutrition points (6 on 100 km, 4 on 50 km). Mandatory equipment includes, among others, a water cup, hat or headscarf, rain jacket, water container with a minimum capacity of 1 liter, elastic bandage and sterile dressing. Participants receive a start number with a chip, route maps, and a GPS device with the route loaded. An active phone for contact throughout the race. Start and finish in Świeradów-Zdrój; registrations for 2026 began at the beginning of the year; the event includes various distances, including Ultra 50, Ultra 70, and Ultra-Trail® 100.

name: Kresowe Trail #7
description: Kresowe Trail is a series of intimate, non-commercial trail runs held in the picturesque natural surroundings of Eastern Poland and Vilnius Region. The race routes pass through pristine forests, varied ascents, sand, and roots, offering challenges for both beginners and experienced runners. The competition takes place over two distances: the shorter Szpurt (approximately 7 km) and the longer Wertep (approximately 17-21 km), which is an ultra-distance race. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, respect for nature, and the integration of runners from different backgrounds.
course_highlights: Routes pass through forests with natural obstacles: ascents, sand, and roots
Routes are marked according to standard cycling markings with clear arrows and ribbons
Scenic views and rich nature, as well as the multicultural heritage of the region
additional: The races are held in an intimate atmosphere with a limited number of participants for safety and environmental protection. Competition is conducted in overall and team classifications, with awards for the best competitors in age categories. The routes are easy to navigate thanks to markings, and the event promotes physical activity in a healthy, forest environment. As part of the Kresowe Trail series, a minimum of six races must be completed to qualify; registration details are not provided.

name: Roztoczański Festiwal Biegowy
location: Kresowa Osada, Basznia Dolna, Lubaczów, Poland
description: Roztoczański Festival of Running 2026 is one of the largest running events in the Roztocze region, organized by the Lubaczów Municipality. The three-day festival takes place in Basznia Dolna, at the Kresowa Settlement, which serves as the start and finish point for all races and Nordic walking marches. Participants can choose from ten different distances, ranging from night runs and Nordic walking marches to ultramarathons and half marathons, passing through the scenic areas of the Land of Lubaczów. This event combines sporting competition with a festival atmosphere, attracting both experienced runners and amateurs.
course_highlights: Trails lead through characteristic landscapes of the Land of Lubaczów and Roztocze
Start and finish located at the Kresowa Settlement in Basznia Dolna
Diverse distances from 5 km Nordic walking march to approximately 60 km ultramarathon
additional: The festival lasts three days: Friday features a Night Run of 7 km and a 5 km Nordic walking march; Saturday includes an approximately 60 km ultramarathon, the 39th Lwów Infantry Regiment Memorial Marathon, a marathon relay 4x10.5 km, and a Nordic walking relay; Sunday offers a 30 km run, the Crystal Goblet Half Marathon, a 10 km run, and a 10 km Nordic walking march. The event attracts many participants and spectators, with registrations available on the platform dostartu.pl. 10 distances, festival atmosphere, catering facilities, diverse routes, and regional attractions.

name: Łabiszyński Bieg Świętojański
organizer: Łabiszyński Dom Kultury, Urząd Miejski w Łabiszynie, F.W. Martex, Uczniowski Klub Sportowy Łabiszynianka
price_range: najtańsze pakiety startowe dla pierwszych zarejestrowanych
description: The Łabiszyński Midsummer Run is an annual running event held on June 28, 2026, at the Municipal Stadium in Łabiszyn. The main race over 5 km starts at 10:00 AM, followed by children's and youth races in four age categories. Participants of the main race will receive a medal and a sweet snack, while younger competitors will receive a medal and a surprise. After the races, the best runners will be awarded. The event is part of a running series and offers registration packages for the first registered participants.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Municipal Stadium in Łabiszyn
Main race route of 5 km
Children's and youth races in 4 age categories
additional: Registration packages for the first registered participants offer the lowest fees. After the main race, children's and youth races with medals and surprises are scheduled. After all races, the best competitors will be awarded. Urban area, medals, surprises, awards ceremony, time limit of 1 hour, event promoting a healthy lifestyle.

name: Sloupský lesní běh
location: Sloup v Moravském krasu, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: Sloup Forest Run is a traditional road race held in the picturesque environment of Sloup in the Moravian Karst. The course measures 11.5 kilometers and is characterized by significant elevation gain, making it a challenging and attractive race for runners. The event has a long-standing history and attracts runners from the surrounding area who enjoy the beauty of nature and the sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: Course length of 11.5 km
Significant elevation gain on the course
Road race in the natural environment of the Moravian Karst
additional: The race takes place in June 2026, with a history of events since 2016, and is designed for runners of all levels who want to experience running in nature with technical challenges.

name: Lochovice - Plešivec
description: Lochovice - Plešivec is a running race as part of the Brdský Running Cup, held on June 28, 2026, in Lochovice. The course is approximately 5.5 km long with an elevation gain of 350 meters, starting with 2 km on asphalt and continuing through forest paths with a steeper incline around the 3rd kilometer. The finish is at the top of Plešivec, offering a beautiful view. The event also includes children's races and a family run to support the local hospice Mezi břehy.
course_highlights: Approximate course length of 5.5 km with 350 m elevation gain
2 km on asphalt, the rest through forest paths with steep ascent at 3 km
Finish at the top of Plešivec with a beautiful view
additional: Transport of marked luggage (clothing for changing) by off-road vehicle to the top of Plešivec at 10:20. Fabián's Run - children's competitions from 11:10. Family run to support the hospice Mezi břehy starts at 10:30. The course includes asphalt and forest sections; transportation to the top of Plešivec is provided at 10:20; the event features children's races and activities supporting outdoor activities.

name: Půlmaratón okolo Nového Veselí

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Hlavní závod 21,1 km – on-line přihlášení startovné 100,- Kč + 20 Kč fond BV

description: The half marathon around Nové Veselí is a traditional running race organized by AO TJ Sokol Nové Veselí, which has been held for 25 years. The main race of 21.1 km takes place on a loop course repeated three times, along asphalt roads and third-class roads with minimal elevation gain. In addition to the main race, shorter courses are available for youth, pupils, and preschool children, making the event attractive to a wide age range of runners. After the race, refreshments are provided, and the winner of the main race receives a monetary prize. The start is traditionally at the square in Nové Veselí.
course_highlights: Main race 21.1 km on a loop course repeated three times
Course runs on asphalt roads and third-class roads with minimal elevation gain
Loops for youth and preschool children on local roads and the square
additional: Refreshment stations are located at both turns of the main race. After the race, refreshments are provided for all participants, with additional refreshments available at the volleyball club's buffet. The winner of the main race receives a monetary prize of 2000 CZK plus 1000 CZK for breaking the course record. Each runner can request a diploma with their placement and time achieved. The race will take place on June 28, 2026, with the main race starting at 9:45 AM. The event is open to the general public, including youth, veterans, and children.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Potůčky
organizer: Živé Sokolovsko z.s. a Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s.
description: Running in the Ore Mountains is a running and canicross series that takes you through the beautiful scenery of the Ore Mountains. The series includes 6 races in various locations, including Potůček, where the main race covers 6 to 9 km and an experiential trail of 20 to 30 km. In addition to running, there are also routes for walking and children's races. The event is suitable for runners of all levels, canicross enthusiasts, children, and walkers, offering an opportunity to enjoy the stunning nature of the Ore Mountains.
course_highlights: Main race 6 - 9 km in the nature of the Ore Mountains
Experiential trail 20 - 30 km according to the map
Children's races from 200 m to 1600 m
additional: The series includes 6 races in different locations of the Ore Mountains. Besides the main running races, there are also routes for walking with point finding according to the map and children's races. The organizer is Živé Sokolovsko z.s. in cooperation with the Destination Agency Ore Mountains z.s. and the involved municipalities. Registration is done via the website, and the event includes multiple categories and routes suitable for all levels of runners and walkers.

name: MUM - Moravský Ultramaraton / Lomnická etapa
location: Lomnice u Tišnova, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
description: MUM - Moravian Ultramarathon is an international stage running race held over seven consecutive days, with the Lomnická stage being one of its parts. This race is among the most demanding ultramarathons in the Czech Republic and offers runners a challenge in the form of long distances and difficult terrain in the South Moravian Region. The race is intended for experienced ultramarathon runners who want to test their endurance and strength in beautiful nature. The Lomnická stage takes place around Olešnice and Lomnice u Tišnova and is part of the entire ultramarathon series.
course_highlights: Stage race over 7 marathons in 7 days
Challenging terrain of the South Moravian Region
Beautiful natural scenery around Olešnice and Lomnice u Tišnova
additional: The race passes through various parts of Moravia, with start and finish in Olešnice or Lomnice u Tišnova, and is designed for experienced ultramarathoners. Registration is possible through the contact details provided on the official website.

name: Beh údolím Idy
location: Kultúrne stredisko, Železiarenská 9, Košice-Šaca, Košice, Slovakia
description: The Ida Valley Run is a traditional running race organized by the City District of Košice-Šaca and the village of Malá Ida. The race takes place in the pleasant environment of the cultural center in Košice-Šaca and offers the opportunity to compete in various age categories. The entry fee is symbolic, with local runners participating for free. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the region.
course_highlights: Race runs through the Ida Valley in Košice-Šaca
Cultural center Železiarenská 9 as start and finish point
Traditional event with a long-standing history
additional: Local runners participate for free. The organizer is the City District of Košice-Šaca and the Municipality of Malá Ida. Contact the organizer: Mgr. Janka Jaššová, phone: 055/726 08 11, 055/726 08 16. The course is not specified, registration via phone or email, the event takes place at the Cultural Center on Železiarenská 9.

name: Beh na Poludňový Grúň
organizer: Občianske združenie Grúň, Chata na Grúni
description: The Noon Grúň Run is a mountain running race in the picturesque Vrátna Valley, in the Malá Fatra mountain range. The course leads through challenging mountain terrain with beautiful views of peaks such as Poludňový Grúň, Stoh, and Veľký Rozsutec. The race is ideal for nature lovers and mountain running enthusiasts who want to experience a unique atmosphere and challenge in the heart of Malá Fatra. Organizers warmly invite you to enjoy this sporting event in the beautiful environment of Terchová.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain with ascent to Poludňový Grúň (1460 m)
Crossing Stoh Saddle and the area around Veľký Rozsutec
The route passes through Jánošíkove Diery with ladders and bridges
additional: Chata na Grúni is the highest situated mountain hut in Vrátna Valley, suitable for organizing courses and events. Nearby are two ski lifts with slopes equipped with artificial snow. The route passes through a national natural reserve with numerous waterfalls and bizarre rock formations. The race is part of regional sports events; registration includes a fee and parking. The start is at Vrátna Paseky at 10:00 AM.

name: MUM - Moravský Ultramaraton / Boskovická etapa
description: MUM - Moravian Ultramarathon is an international stage running race held in Boskovice and is part of a seven-day ultramarathon consisting of seven marathons. This race is known for its difficulty and long tradition, attracting runners seeking a challenge in the form of stage running. The Boskovice stage offers runners the opportunity to experience the beauty of Moravian nature while testing their endurance in challenging terrain. The race is suitable for experienced ultramarathoners who want to measure their strength against others in a prestigious international event.
course_highlights: Stage race of 7 marathons in 7 days
Challenging terrain around Boskovice
Beautiful Moravian natural scenery
additional: Stage ultramarathon, part of ČAU ULTRA CUP 2019, Czech Championship in stage ultramarathon, various routes and terrain difficulty

name: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli - červen
description: Tempo Makers Osmicka is a running race in Pilsen offering an 8 km course. The race is open to men and women aged 16 and above. The start and finish are at the same location, with registration and bib pickup from 17:00 to 17:45. After the race, the best runners are awarded and a raffle is held. The race capacity is limited to 75 participants, and each participant runs at their own risk.
course_highlights: 8 km course in Pilsen
Start and finish at the same location with available parking
Evening start time with registration from 17:00 to 17:45
additional: Registration and bib pickup are from 17:00 to 17:45. The awards ceremony for the best runners is at 19:05 and the raffle drawing at 19:15. The race capacity is limited to 75 runners. Categories are divided by age from 16 years and above. Parking for participants is available on the provided map. The race takes place on June 30, 2026. Registration is possible online or on-site. The course is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners.

name: Lachtan
price_range: 190 Kč do 80 dětí, 150 Kč do 80 dětí (dle počtu dětí)
description: Lachtan is located in Prague 6, Prague, and is primarily associated with the breeding and protection of the South African fur seal at Prague Zoo. In addition, a theater performance titled 'White Seal' is held here, mainly aimed at children and school groups, offering interactive experiences with ecological themes. This program is suitable for families and schools who want to combine education with entertainment and raise awareness about nature conservation.
course_highlights: Breeding and protection of the South African fur seal at Prague Zoo
Theater performance 'White Seal' with ecological themes
Interactive programs for children and schools
additional: Seal breeding at Prague Zoo, ecological theater performances for schools and children, methodological materials for teachers

name: Kolem Libotína
description: The Libotín Run is a traditional race organized by the Emil Zátopek Athletic Club Kopřivnice, held around Štramberk. The race offers a 6.5 km long circuit with a challenging profile, which has been modified in recent years and brought new course records. The event is part of the Lašská Running League and attracts runners of various categories who enjoy the beautiful natural environment and sporting atmosphere. After the race, winners are announced in their categories, and a raffle is prepared for all participants. The organizer is the Emil Zátopek Athletic Club Kopřivnice, which ensures smooth proceedings and supports the running community.
course_highlights: 6.5 km long circuit with a challenging profile
Surroundings of the local swimming pool in Štramberk
A route with a new direction that has brought course records
additional: The race is part of the Lašská Running League. After the race, a raffle is prepared for participants. Registrations are conducted electronically via the EOS application, where a medical examination must be provided. The race is suitable for the general public and runners of all categories, with the opportunity to achieve personal records and enjoy the atmosphere of a regional running gathering.

name: MUM - Moravský Ultramaraton / Bystřická etapa
location: Bystřice nad Pernštejnem, Morava, Czech Republic
description: MUM - Moravian Ultramarathon is an international stage running race held over seven marathons in seven consecutive days. The Bystřice stage is one of its parts, offering a challenging and long run in the picturesque environment of Moravia. The race is designed for experienced ultramarathoners seeking a challenge in the form of long stages and beautiful nature. Come test your strength in this prestigious ultramarathon and experience the unique atmosphere of a stage race.
course_highlights: Stage race over 7 marathons in 7 days
Challenging Moravian terrain with beautiful views
International participation and prestigious running event
additional: The race is part of the ultramarathon series, with a length of 42.2 km in the Bystřice stage, and is part of the ČAU ULTRA CUP 2019.

name: Grill Run=Fun 2026
description: Grill+Run=Fun 2026 is a race organized in Palowice that combines athletic competition with a friendly atmosphere and fun. The event starts at 08:00, and participants can expect professional RFID timing measurement and comprehensive technical support. The event is organized by the LUXTORPEDA Association, which guarantees high-quality organization and support for runners. It is an excellent opportunity to spend active time and feel the spirit of sports community.
course_highlights: Professional RFID timing measurement
Start and finish in Palowice
Organized by the experienced LUXTORPEDA Association
additional: The race offers professional timing using RFID technology, an electronic LED clock at the finish line, and results available live on time-sport.pl. The organizer also provides the possibility to rent race numbers and chips and to prepare personalized certificates for participants. Event date: 2026-07-04; Location: Palowice; Registration deadline: 2026-07-01; Participant requirements: own water bottle; The course covers approximately 82.5 km (11 laps).

name: XXIV Atlantis Bieg Opolski
location: Wyspa Bolko, Opole, Opole County, Poland
description: The 24th Atlantis Opole Race is an annual run held since 2003 on the first Saturday of July on Bolko Island in Opole. The race route runs through a designated zone of silence and greenery in the city center, offering participants the opportunity to compete over distances of 5 km and 10 km. Since 2015, the race has been called Atlantis Opole Race, thanks to the support of Atlantis-Deweloper. The event is organized by the Opole Running Association, which promotes physical activity and sports integration within the local community.
course_highlights: Route on Bolko Island - a green and quiet zone in the center of Opole
Two distance options: 5 km and 10 km
Race takes place on the first Saturday of July, traditionally since 2003
additional: Volunteers support the organization of the race in various teams, including the race office, start/finish area, deposits, route security, and refreshment points. The association involves people of different ages and encourages cooperation in organizing the event. The event takes place in urban areas, including streets and parks, with registration available at designated locations. The race enjoys great interest from the local community and attracts participants from various regions.

name: Grill+Run-Fun
description: The 8H GRF 'Szychta na Gichcie' Ultramarathon is a unique running event held on forest trails of the Palowice Lake District. The competition lasts 8 hours, during which participants face endurance challenges and enjoy contact with nature. The event is organized by the Luxtorpeda Association and attracts long-distance endurance enthusiasts. The event also features races for children, emphasizing its family-friendly character. The start and finish are located at the Orzeł Palowice sports field.
course_highlights: Forest trails of the Palowice Lake District
Time format - an 8-hour race
Family races for children during the event
additional: Participants must have their own water bottle or cup. The race office is open from 6:15 AM, technical briefing at 7:45 AM. The race starts at 8:00 AM and ends at 4:00 PM. Award ceremonies are planned for 4:30/5:00 PM. During the event, children's races in memory of Jacek Kostrzewa are also organized. The event includes grilling and participant integration, online registration is available, and the route runs through picturesque forest areas of Palowice.

name: Kaliski Półmaraton Nocny
description: Kaliski Półmaraton Nocny Bursztynowa Hellena is a unique night half marathon held in Kalisz. The event attracts hundreds of runners from various cities, offering a unique atmosphere and a running challenge during nighttime hours. The half marathon route takes runners through charming parts of the city, providing unforgettable experiences. The event has its tradition and is very popular among amateur and professional runners.
course_highlights: Night run through the streets of Kalisz
Half marathon course length (21.097 km)
Sporting celebration atmosphere with hundreds of runners
additional: Start at 10:00 PM, the run lasts until 2:00 AM. The list of confirmed participants is available online. The event has a limited number of spots, currently over 860 participants confirmed. The event includes a half marathon, with the route passing through sports facilities and streets of Kalisz. Registration is online, and participants can expect a well-organized event with rich accompanying activities.

name: Mam Marzenie 12.RAZ 25h RUN
organizer: Fundacja Mam Marzenie oraz Ruchowa Akademia Zdrowia (RAZ Szczecin)
description: 25h RUN is a unique running event organized by the Mam Marzenie Foundation, which combines sport with charity. The anniversary, 10th edition of the race, takes place by Lake Arkonka in Szczecin and aims to fulfill the dream of Marleny, a beneficiary, to travel to the island of Zakynthos. Participants run for 25 hours, and each kilometer covered brings them closer to achieving this goal. It is not only a sports challenge but also an opportunity to work together for children in need.
course_highlights: The race lasts 25 hours, which is a unique endurance challenge
The route is located by the picturesque Lake Arkonka in Szczecin
The event combines physical activity with a charity action to fulfill children's dreams
additional: The organizer is the Mam Marzenie Foundation, which has fulfilled over 10,000 children's dreams since 2004. The event is charitable, and each kilometer run contributes to realizing the dream of a beneficiary. Registration is available on the external website https://raz.szczecin.pl/. The event supports fundraising to fulfill a child's dream, registration is done via the website, and participants can count on support and motivation during the all-day run.

name: VI Półmaraton Gęstwinami Murckowskimi
location: Murcki Forest, Katowice, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 5th Gęstwinami Murckowskimi Half Marathon is a race organized by the W Kręgu Natury Association, taking place in the picturesque forests of Murcek in Katowice. The half marathon route runs through varied forest terrains, offering participants contact with nature and a unique atmosphere. The event is an excellent opportunity for active outdoor recreation, suitable for both experienced runners and amateurs. Organizers provide convenient public transportation access and parking near the start.

Varied forest terrain with views and natural obstacles
Access to a change zone for relay teams
additional: Proposed public transportation from Murcki Wzgórze Wandy stops towards Tychy and Katowice. The largest parking lot is located in Murckowska Valley and along Wolności, Mruczka, Kołodzieja streets, and other nearby streets. Date: 2026-07-04; location: Katowice; information about training and preparations.

name: XI Janikowska ZaDyszka
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Janikowie
description: The 11th Janikowska ZaDyszka is an annual street race organized in Janikowo, attracting runners from various age groups and skill levels. The event takes place on a 10 km route, providing participants with professional timing measurement using Chronotrack technology. The event is organized by the Janikowo Sports and Recreation Center, and timing is handled by STS-Timing, ensuring high reliability and organizational support. The race is open and friendly to all physical activity enthusiasts.
course_highlights: 10 km route in Janikowo
Professional timing measurement with active Chronotrack chips
Organized by the local Sports and Recreation Center
additional: Timing is performed with 99.8% reliability thanks to active Chronotrack chips. The race office and organizer are available at ul. Bp. Michała Kozala 3, 88-160 Janikowo. No information about wave starts, participant limits, or additional services. Date: 2026-07-04, location: Janikowo, event aimed at runners of various skill levels.

name: XI Krokowska 10
description: The 11th Kraków 10K is one of the events within the Kaszuby Biegają 2026 series, taking place on July 4th in Żarnowiec. The race offers a 10 km distance that runs through the picturesque areas of Kashubia, combining athletic competition with the beauty of the region. The Kaszuby Biegają series is the largest running event in northern Poland, promoting physical activity and local culture. Participants can expect professional organization and unique medals assembled from individual stages.
course_highlights: Picturesque routes of Kashubia
10 km distance in northern Poland terrain
Part of the Kaszuby Biegają series with a unique assembled medal
additional: The Kaszuby Biegają 2026 series includes 11 events in various locations across the region. Participants can collect unique medal elements by running distances of 5 km and 10 km. There is also an option to participate in Nordic Walking races at selected stages. Shorter distances from 400 to 800 meters are prepared for children. Registration is available on the portal zapisy.info. The 10 km race, options for local runners, and virtual participation will be available with registration starting from December 2025. The event commemorates Jacek Bandurski.

name: XXVI Bieg o Kryształową Perłę Jeziora Na...
location: Kretowiny, Gmina Rybno, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 26th National Run for the Crystal Pearl of Lake Narie is the main race covering a distance of 31.13 km, held in a picturesque location by Lake Narie in Kretowiny. The start and finish are located at the Main Beach in Kretowiny. The event includes age categories for men and women, and participants can look forward to a ceremonial opening and closing of the race with award ceremonies. The event is nationwide and attracts runners from various age groups.
course_highlights: Distance of 31.13 km by Lake Narie
Start and finish at the Main Beach in Kretowiny
Age categories for men and women
additional: Registration and distribution of start packages take place from 8:00 to 9:30. The ceremonial opening of the race is at 9:50, and the closing with award ceremonies is around 14:30 at the stage near the Main Beach. The race is held on the main beach in Kretowiny, with an award ceremony and participant registration on site; the event is part of the Crystal Pearl Run series.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - červenec
description: The 2-mile run in Zlín - Příluky is an open race covering 3.2 km, suitable for all age groups and running levels, from beginners to experienced runners. The course mainly runs between gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone and consists of nearly two laps around a precisely measured asphalt circuit. The race takes place on the first Saturday of each month with registration in front of the Madal Bal company building and starts at 9:00 AM. Each participant will be rewarded at the finish line with a warm cinnamon flatbread as a token of appreciation.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly between gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone
Precisely measured asphalt circuit of just under 2 laps (3.2 km)
Children's course is 800 meters long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 and older, and children up to 12 years (boys and girls). Time is measured for each runner, and the top three places in adult and children categories are awarded small prizes. The recommended access to the start is by bicycle, on foot, by car, rollerblades, or trolleybus No. 11 (stop Průmyslová zóna). Registration is held on the first Saturday of each month from 8:15 to 8:55, with the start at 9:00 AM. The race can be completed on foot, by bike, rollerblades, or car. The route is on the road, 3.2 km long, and suitable for all age groups.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - červenec
description: The 2-mile run in Prague's Stromovka Park is an open race covering 3.2 km, suitable for all age groups and running levels, including children up to 12 years old who run 1.6 km. The race is ideal for those who run for fun, want to improve their personal best, or simply enjoy a pleasant run in the beautiful park environment. After the race, each participant is greeted with a warm cinnamon pancake. The course runs along the asphalt paths of Stromovka Park, with adults running two laps and children one lap. Timing is recorded for each runner, and results are published online.
course_highlights: The course runs along the asphalt paths of Stromovka Park
Adults run 2 laps (3.2 km), children 1 lap (1.6 km + 70 m)
The race takes place in the beautiful environment of Královská obora - Stromovka Park
additional: Registration takes place at the Bruselská Gate area (under the Marold Panorama building) from 8:15 to 8:45, with the option of pre-registration online for faster check-in. It is recommended to arrive by bike, on foot, roller skates, or tram (stop Výstaviště). Parking is available near the bridge to Císařský Island on Za elektrárnou street. There are changing tents and a non-guarded storage area for belongings, as well as mobile lockers for valuables. WC cabins are available on site. The race time, adjusted by age coefficient, counts towards the annual Pancake Cup. The race takes place in Stromovka Park, registration is voluntary, with a start at 9:07 AM. There are changing rooms and toilets, and parking is available at the bridge to Císařský Island.

name: Třtická punčocha
description: Třtická Punčocha is a traditional summer running race held since 1980 in the village of Třtice, always on the first Sunday of July. The race is 8.8 km long and attracts runners from all over Bohemia. Originally intended for children, today it offers categories for adults based on age and gender. In addition to the summer run, a Christmas run of 4.8 km is also held in the village on December 26. The races are popular and have a long-standing tradition with results and photos archived on the village's website.
course_highlights: Distance of 8.8 km in the summer run
Categories based on age and gender (A, B, C, D, E)
Traditional race organized since 1980 in the pleasant environment of Třtice
additional: The race is divided into categories based on age and gender: Category A up to 39 years, B 40-49 years, C 50-59 years, D over 60 years, E women. Results and photos from previous years are available on the website. In addition to the run, there is a children's playground and sports facilities, a tennis court, and a community hall, which was renovated in 2024/2025. The race offers various age categories, including children and adults, and is part of the local sports calendar. Results and photos are regularly published on the official website.

name: Náchod - Dobrošov
description: Military Fortress Dobrošov is located near the town of Náchod in the Kladské Pomezí area in the Orlické Mountains. The fortress is an important part of Czechoslovakia's border fortifications and offers visitors tours of the main bunkers, ammunition depot, barracks, and infirmary. An educational trail runs through the entire fortress, guiding visitors along the line of fortifications to Běloves Spa. The surrounding area is rich in hiking and cycling trails, allowing visitors to explore the beauty of the Orlické Mountains and nearby historic towns.
course_highlights: Tour of artillery bunkers and fortifications from the Czechoslovak border defense period
Educational trail Fortress Dobrošov running along the line of fortifications to Běloves Spa
Hiking and cycling trails in the area with views and access to other military fortresses
additional: Parking at the fortress is free. The visitor center, including restrooms, closes 60 minutes before the end of opening hours. There are 171 steps leading to the underground, with a constant temperature of 6°C. Group size is limited to a maximum of 28 people. The last tour begins 90 minutes before closing. Accommodation options in family pensions and mountain hotels are available in Deštná in the Orlické Mountains. The race is part of the regional sports calendar, with participants able to use the surrounding hiking and cycling trails. Exact registration details and race length have not yet been published.

name: MUM - Moravský Ultramaraton / Cimrmanova etapa
location: Lomnice u Tišnova, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
description: MUM - Moravian Ultramarathon / Cimrmanova stage is the final seventh stage of the international stage race held in Lomnice u Tišnova. The race offers a challenging and diverse terrain with an elevation gain of 740 meters, presenting a challenge for experienced ultramarathon runners. The start is interval-based according to the order from the previous six races, which increases competitiveness and tension. This race is ideal for runners seeking a combination of technical difficulty and stage racing in the beautiful nature of South Moravia.
course_highlights: Challenging and diverse terrain
Elevation gain of 740 meters
Interval start based on the order from previous stages
additional: The race is the final stage of the international stage race with an interval start based on the order from the previous six races. The start location is at the elementary school in Lomnice u Tišnova. Challenging terrain, interval start, part of a stage race.

description: Kráľova hoľa is an ITRA-certified vertical kilometer event held at Kráľova hoľa in Horehronie. Runners start from the square in the village of Šumiac and the route goes directly along the blue tourist trail to the top of Kráľova hoľa. The event is a qualifying race for the Skyrunning World Championships 2024 and offers quality support including refreshments and medical services. Registration is open until July 1, 2026, with a participant limit, and the entry fee includes a commemorative item and refreshments.
course_highlights: The route is 5.2 km long with an elevation gain of 1035 m
Start at the square in the village of Šumiac, finish at the top of Kráľova hoľa
The trail is marked with colored ribbons on trees along the blue tourist trail
additional: Registration for competitors is from 7:00 to 9:30 AM either in front of the elementary school building or, in case of bad weather, inside the Šumiac municipal office. Participants under 15 years old must be accompanied by a legal guardian. Organizers provide transportation of dry clothing to the finish line. During the race, refreshments are available at Predné sedlo and at the finish. Mandatory equipment includes hiking gear and a bottle with fluids (minimum 0.5 liters). Protest submissions are accepted until 1:00 PM with a deposit of 50 EUR. The event also includes regional outdoor activities and emphasizes the promotion of tourism and sports in the Horehronie region.

name: Špačinský trojuholník
organizer: Obec Špačince, Bežecký klub 2001 Špačince, Základná škola s materskou školou v Špačinciach, Dobrovoľný hasičský zbor Špačince
price_range: 10 € štandardne, 5 € pre miestnych, zadarmo pre obyvateľov

The organizers are the Municipality of Spacince, Running Club 2001 Spacince, Elementary School with Kindergarten in Spacince, and JDS Spacince. Categories for men in an absolute overall ranking and women from 40 years old

description: The Banská Štiavnica - Vyšehrad Trail Relay is a unique 220 km relay race that connects two historic royal towns through the natural beauty of the Štiavnické Hills and the Danube-Ipeľ National Park. The race is designed for teams of 3, teams of 4 to 8 members, and 6-member teams, offering categories for experienced runners and larger teams. The route mainly follows hiking trails and natural reserves, allowing participants to explore cultural and historical monuments as well as natural scenery of the Slovak and Hungarian regions. Organizers emphasize fostering neighborly relations and promoting the region.
course_highlights: Route passes through Štiavnické Hills and Danube-Ipeľ National Park
Crosses historical and natural sites such as Hrad Drégely, NPR Burdov, Esztergom Basilica, and Duna-Ipoly River
220 km divided into 18 segments with varied ascents and descents
additional: The route is divided into 18 segments with varying elevation changes, crossing natural reserves and historical sites. Categories include ULTRA for experienced runners and a solo category from 2025. Registration is conducted via the website, where team captains create their team after registration. The race includes various categories such as ultra, mix, Nordic walking, and individual; registration is open from February to March 2026; the course runs through hiking and natural trails with an emphasis on experience and connecting countries.

name: Bieg Wilka Wilkowo 05.07.2026
description: The 7th Wolf Run Wilkowo 2026 is an annual running event organized in Wilkowo near Świebodzin. The competition attracts runners from various categories, offering the opportunity to compete on a route featuring both street and trail elements. Organizers provide professional timing measurement and technical support, and participants can count on smooth organization and a friendly atmosphere. It is an excellent opportunity for sports activity and local community integration.

Professional electronic timing measurement

name: Pogoń za Jednorożcem
description: Pogoń za Jednorożcem is an annual running event organized in Jednorożec, which will take place for the eighth time in 2026. The competition includes a 5 km run and Nordic walking over the same distance, as well as children's races over shorter distances. description: The St. Andrew's Run and the Little Caesar Children's Run are traditional events in Rajecké Teplice, bringing a sports and family atmosphere to SNP Square. The St. Andrew's Run is an asphalt race over a 4.5 km course with online registration, while the Little Caesar Children's Run is intended for children aged 1 to 9 years and is free of charge. The event also features a competition for the best-decorated children's stroller, enriching the overall experience for participants and spectators. The event takes place in the afternoon with registration and start at the square.
course_highlights: Asphalt course 4.5 km long for St. Andrew's Run
Children's categories for age groups 1-3, 4-6, and 7-9 years
Competition for the best-decorated children's stroller directly on the square
additional: Registration for St. Andrew's Run is from 14:30 to 16:30, with the start at 17:00. For the Little Caesar Children's Run, registration is from 14:00 in the foyer of the Municipal Office. The number of spots for the children's run is limited to 150. The event takes place at SNP Square in Rajecké Teplice. The children's run is open to all age groups, with online or on-site registration; the event is suitable for the whole family.

name: Bajoro 26
description: Bajoro 26 is a 10 km race scheduled to take place on July 12, 2026, in Starogard Gdański. It is an excellent opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic route and prepare for the start with dedicated training plans tailored to various skill levels. Organizers offer expert support and detailed training instructions, making this event attractive for both beginners and more experienced runners. Bajoro 26 is a medium difficulty event held on asphalt surface, ideal for improving condition and competing in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 10 km distance on asphalt surface
Medium difficulty route
Scenic surroundings of Starogard Gdański
additional: Training plans are available from 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to the runner's VDOT level. The organizer provides expert support and detailed training instructions. There is an option to use a platform for managing the race profile and marketing cooperation for organizers. The event is planned for summer 2026 and is aimed at runners of different age groups and skill levels, with the possibility to participate in the 10 km competition.

name: II Galicyjska 10
description: The 2nd Galician 10K of the Podkarpackie Regional Chamber of Civil Engineers is a sporting event that brings together members of the Chamber and their families. It will take place on July 12, 2026, in Urzejowice, in the park near the stadium. The event features a 10 km run, a 7 km Nordic Walking march, and children’s races in various age categories. It is an excellent opportunity for active, family outdoor fun, promoting a healthy lifestyle and integrating the engineering community. Participants can expect a sporting atmosphere and good fun at the finish line.
course_highlights: 10 km run
7 km Nordic Walking march
Children’s races in various age categories
additional: The event is aimed at active members of the Chamber and their families. In addition to the run and Nordic Walking march, children’s races in different age categories are organized. The event has an integrative character and promotes a healthy lifestyle. A detailed program and registration form will be published soon. The start and finish are located in the park near the stadium in Urzejowice. Race categories: 10 km run, 7 km Nordic Walking, children’s races; scheduled for July 12, 2026; in Urzejowice, park near the stadium.

name: S-Race
location: Kolonáda Ferdinandova pramene, Mariánské Lázně, Karlovarský kraj, Czech Republic
description: S-Race is an OCR run in Mariánské Lázně, held in front of the Ferdinand Spring colonnade. The race offers courses of 6 km, 12 km, and 18 km, mainly along paved forest paths with more than 20 obstacles on one lap. There are races tailored for children according to age categories. The start and finish are located directly at the colonnade, where facilities such as changing rooms, toilets, a storage area, and refreshments are available. The race is suitable for a wide age range and features interval starts with a program for children during the main race.
course_highlights: The course mainly runs along paved forest paths
More than 20 obstacles on the 6 km loop, 40+ on the 12 km, 60+ on the 18 km
Start and finish in front of the Ferdinand Spring colonnade in Mariánské Lázně
additional: Interval start of the main race every 120 seconds for 5 runners, starting with the 18K course, then 12K and 6K. Registration and chip pickup on race day from 8:00 to 9:15 for the main race, from 12:30 to 13:45 for the children's race. Participants under 18 must have written consent from a legal guardian. Male and female changing rooms, toilets, storage, and refreshments are available. During the main race, a program for children is prepared. The terrain includes paved forest paths and obstacles; the race is open to the general public, including younger participants born in 2011 or later who need parental consent; the race takes place on July 12, 2026.

name: Koblížkový pasecký běh
location: Paseka u Olomouce, Olomouc District, Olomouc Region, Czech Republic
description: The Koblížkový Pasecký Run is a traditional road race in Paseka near Olomouc, offering a course length of 8.2 km. The race takes place on asphalt, cobblestones, and park paths, passing through the village, along a cycle path to the sanatorium, and through the Odborný léčebný ústav park, returning to the start at the municipal office. The first categories start in the afternoon, creating a pleasant atmosphere for runners and spectators. The event is organized by Ivan Elischer, who ensures smooth proceedings and support for the runners.
course_highlights: The course runs on asphalt, cobblestones, and park paths
Passes through the village of Paseka and along a cycle path to the sanatorium
Includes the Odborný léčebný ústav park
additional: The race starts at the municipal office in Paseka. The course is suitable for running on asphalt, cobblestones, and park paths. The organizer is Ivan Elischer, who is available for contact and information. The event takes place on July 12, 2026, with registration and further details available on the official website. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the region.

name: Halda Trail Run
location: Kuřimská Nová Ves, Brno-Country District, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: HALDA TRAIL RUN is an off-road adventure running race in Kuřimská Nová Ves, which takes you through the picturesque landscape of the Haldy stream valley and the Libochovka river. The longest route measures approximately 24 km and includes 23 water crossings that are runnable and pleasantly refreshing in summer. The race offers three route length options (4 km, 14 km, and 24 km), which connect and allow changing the distance even during the race. The course mainly runs through forests and meadows away from main tourist trails, with panoramic views, two short steep ascents, and varied terrain, appreciated by both casual runners and ambitious trail runners.
course_highlights: 23 water crossings up to ankle-deep, runnable and refreshing in summer
Panoramic views, two short steep ascents with more than 30% incline
Course mainly runs through forests and meadows away from main tourist trails
additional: The time limit for the longest route is 3 hours. When entering the second lap (14.5 km), the time gate closes at 12:00, slower runners will be stopped and scored on the intermediate route. Routes of 4 km, 14 km, and 24 km connect and it is possible to change the route length during the race. The terrain is a combination of difficult terrain (stones, roots), light terrain, and asphalt. The course will be thoroughly marked with arrows and ribbons. Trail, water crossings, scenery, challenging terrain, registration details are not specified.

description: Summer morning run is a trail running race held in Štítná nad Vláří - Popov, offering two routes approximately 7 km and 15 km long. The race takes place on varied terrain including asphalt, forest paths, and hills, with beautiful views and challenging sections that test runners' physical fitness. The start and finish are located at the pub in Popov, and the atmosphere of the race is friendly and family-oriented, emphasizing safety and participant responsibility. The race is part of the Zlín Runs series and is organized by the Martinát family and their friends.
course_highlights: Trail race with a mix of asphalt and forest paths
Challenging ascent to the saddle below Hložecká Chapel
Beautiful views of Popov and the surrounding landscape
additional: Registration is possible online up to 2 working days before the race and also on-site until 9:30 AM. Timing is measured using Race Result chip technology. Refreshments (water, Kofola) are provided on the course, and at the finish line, there are sweets, fruit, and for pre-registered participants, goulash. The start and finish are at the pub in Popov, parking is available at the bus stop according to organizer instructions. Children under 15 must be accompanied by a person over 18, and youth aged 15-18 start with written consent from legal guardians. The race takes place on July 12, 2026, starting at 10:00 AM, registration closes 2 days before the race, with chip timing. Suitable for runners aged 15 and above.

name: Běh o Ludgerův meč
description: The Ludger's Sword Run is the third edition of a running race organized by the Náchod Running Club in cooperation with the municipality of Hořičky. The race is part of the Primátor CUP running series and the Velká cena východních Čech cup. The routes lead around Hořičky with beautiful views of Kladské pomezí, in gently rolling terrain with surfaces of gravel, forest paths, and minimal asphalt. There are courses for children, a main race of 8 km, and a FIT route of 4 km. The start and registration take place at the area near the football field in Hořičky.
course_highlights: Main race 8 km in gently rolling terrain with gravel and forest paths
FIT route 4 km with minimal asphalt
Beautiful views of Kladské pomezí
additional: Registration from 8:00 at the area near the football field in Hořičky. Registration closes 30 minutes before the start for children categories, and at 10:00 for adults. Children's races start from 9:00 to 9:35 depending on age categories. The main race and the FIT route start at 10:30. The registration fee includes timing with chip technology, homemade buns, cakes, juice, and tea at the finish. Parking is provided at the football field with instructions from organizers. Prizes for the fastest children, medals and material prizes in adult categories, and monetary prizes for the top three men and women overall in the main race (600 CZK, 400 CZK, 200 CZK). Terrain: gently rolling with surfaces of gravel, forest paths, and minimal asphalt; online registration via sportchallange.cz; the race includes medals and prizes; held at the area near the football field in Hořičky.

name: Malý Štrbský maratón
organizer: Obec Štrba, Obec Liptovská Teplička, Športový klub Štrba
price_range: 20,- € to 25,- € depending on registration date, free for some categories
description: The Small Štrbský Marathon is a traditional running race held annually on the second Sunday of July in the village of Štrba under the Tatras. Participants can choose between two main routes - 31 km and 10 km, which run along an asphalt road between Štrba and Liptovská Teplička. The event is part of the Tatry v pohybe project and attracts runners from several countries, with the atmosphere in the square in front of the Cultural House always lively and sports-oriented. The organizers are the municipality of Štrba, the municipality of Liptovská Teplička, and the Štrba Sports Club.
course_highlights: 31 km route along a third-class asphalt road from Štrba to Liptovská Teplička and back
Refreshment stations at 8, 12, 16, 20, 25, and 28 kilometers
10 km route introduced as a new feature from 2021
additional: The participant limit is 500 runners overall, with priority given to the 31 km route (limit 200) and the 10 km route (limit 300). The race takes place without traffic restrictions, so increased caution is required. Medical support is provided by the Tatra Mountain Rescue Service, NsP Poprad, and the local Red Cross. Participants run at their own risk. The organizer arranges transportation from selected train connections from Tatranská Štrba. The route includes 48 km, 10 km, and children's races; it is part of the Eastern Slovak Youth Running League; registration has set dates and age categories; Nordic Walking is part of the event.

description: Two laps along the wall is a traditional cross-country race in Prague's Hvězda Park, offering courses for men, women, and children. Men run the main course of 7.8 km along the perimeter walls of the park, women have a shortened course of 4 km but can also run the men's course. There are two shorter loops prepared for children. After the race, participants can enjoy a raffle and substantial refreshments.
course_highlights: The course runs along the perimeter walls of Hvězda Park
The main men's course is 7.8 km long with a total elevation gain of approximately 120 meters
The women's course is 4 km long with an elevation gain of approximately 60 meters, with the option to run the men's course
additional: Registration on site is possible from 16:30 to 18:00 (children from 16:00 to 16:30). Runners will receive an electronic chip for precise timing. The start and finish are in Hvězda Park at the main entrance from Vypich. There is substantial refreshments including non-alcoholic drinks, beer, and bread with English bacon. After the race, a raffle with material prizes takes place. Mobile toilets are available. The race offers refreshments, electronic timing, a raffle with material prizes, and various age categories including children.

name: Halda
description: HALDA TRAIL RUN is an outdoor adventure running race through the beautiful landscape of the Halda stream valley and the Libochovka creek. It offers three routes of 4, 14, and 24 kilometers, which are interconnected and allow for changing the distance during the race. The course mainly runs through forests and meadows away from main tourist trails, featuring 23 stream crossings, two short steep ascents, and panoramic views. The race is suitable for both casual runners and ambitious trail runners, and is thoroughly marked with arrows and flags.
course_highlights: 23 stream crossings up to ankle-deep, runnable and refreshing in summer
Panoramic views, two short steep ascents with more than 30% incline
The route mainly runs through forests and meadows away from main tourist trails
additional: The time limit for the longest route is 3 hours. When entering the second lap (14.5 km), the time gate closes at 12:00, slower runners will be stopped and scored on the intermediate route. The terrain is a combination of difficult terrain (stones, roots), light terrain, and asphalt. It is permitted to change the route to a shorter variant during the race. Routes 4 km, 14 km, 24 km; trail terrain, brooks, scenic views, time limit 3 hours.

description: Lower Silesian Mountain Running Festival is a prestigious trail event held in the picturesque Landek-Zdrój. During the festival, participants can challenge themselves with various routes of different distances and elevation gains, from short night runs to mountain ultramarathons. The event attracts mountain running enthusiasts, offering unforgettable views and technically demanding courses. In 2026, the festival will take place from July 16 to 19, with a rich accompanying program and professional organization.
course_highlights: 7 Peaks Route - approximately 240 km with an elevation gain of about 7670 m
Super Trail - 130 km with the highest point around 1425 m above sea level
Night Trail - 15 km, ideal for beginners with beautiful views
additional: Possibility to purchase a commemorative technical T-shirt (99 PLN) and running arm warmers (60 PLN). During the festival, DFBG CAMP will be held (May 7-10, 2026). Starts take place at various locations in Landek-Zdrój and the surrounding area. Deposits and relay exchanges are available on the routes. A rich accompanying program is organized, including an opening ceremony and award ceremony. The event lasts four days, covering different distances, and participants can buy commemorative T-shirts and running arm warmers. Registration opens on November 17, and participants can enjoy various amenities such as expo and accommodation.

description: Leśna Eko Piątka is a race organized in Piekary Śląskie that promotes the city and supports integration and addiction prevention among children and youth. The race route runs along asphalt and gravel roads in the Dioblina forest, with start and finish lines located at the MOSiR stadium at 3 Olimpijska Street. The event is held under the honorary patronage of the Mayor of Piekary Śląskie and offers participants a starter pack with a bib number, time measurement, medal, and medical care. The time limit to complete the course is 45 minutes, and the participant limit is 500 people.
course_highlights: Race route along asphalt and gravel roads in the Dioblina forest
Start and finish at MOSiR stadium at 3 Olimpijska Street
Checkpoints along the route and a 45-minute time limit
additional: Race office open on July 17, 2026 from 16:00 to 18:30 at 3 Olimpijska Street. Nearby facilities include changing rooms, deposit, and toilets. The starter pack includes a bib number, electronic time measurement, medal, medical care, surprises, and the option to use a deposit. An additional shirt can be purchased until June 18, 2026, for 70 PLN. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, physical activity, and social integration. The participant limit is 500 people, and fees can be paid online or in cash. Starter packs include items such as shirts, making them attractive to participants.

name: Night Run Gdynia
description: Night Run Gdynia is a nocturnal 5-kilometer race held along the Baltic Sea coast as part of the IRONMAN Poland triathlon weekends. After dark, when city lights reflect on the asphalt and water, hundreds of runners set out on a spectacular route through the streets of Gdynia. This event has become an important and eagerly awaited element of the city's sports calendar, combining athletic competition with a unique nighttime running atmosphere.
course_highlights: 5 km race route along the Baltic Sea coast
Night race with spectacular city lighting reflecting on asphalt and water
Event held as part of IRONMAN Poland triathlon weekends
additional: The race takes place as part of IRONMAN Poland triathlon weekends in Gdynia, Warsaw, and Poznań. It attracts hundreds of runners and is a regular feature of these sporting events. The route is along the seaside, with a participant limit of 1500. Starting fees are 60 zł, 75 zł, 90 zł, and 100 zł.

name: Běh o Neplachovský Hrneček
description: The Neplachov Cup Run is a traditional running race held in Neplachov, South Bohemia, which will take place for the 14th time on Friday, July 17, 2026. The race is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup and is supported by the South Bohemian Region budget. The event offers a sporting experience in the beautiful regional environment and attracts runners from the surrounding area. Organizers warmly invite all runners to participate in this popular event.
course_highlights: 10 km course with asphalt and natural sections
Includes various age categories including children
Part of the South Bohemian Running Cup
additional: The course consists of two five-kilometer loops, registration is available via the website, and results are accessible online. The run is supported by the South Bohemian Region.

name: Kružberský Tesák
location: Kružberský přehradní areál, u přehrady Kružberk, Kružberk, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Kružberský Tesák is a sporting event held at the Kružberk Dam area, offering routes and categories for experienced racers, semi-advanced runners, and complete beginners. The race is suitable for solo runners, hikers, and families with children. The event also features Pejskiáda, an entertaining exhibition and competitions for dogs of all sizes and breeds. Organizers Kateřina and Lucie, nature and sports enthusiasts with dogs, aim to create a friendly atmosphere and ensure enjoyable experiences for all participants.
course_highlights: Routes suitable for runners of various levels from beginners to experienced
Surroundings of Kružberk Dam with beautiful nature and views
Pejskiáda with exhibition and competitions for dogs of all breeds and sizes
additional: Registration opens in May 2026. After submitting the application, a variable symbol for payment of the start fee will be sent to the participant's account. Payment must be made as soon as possible after registration. The event includes dog competitions and exhibitions, suitable for families with children and dog lovers. A two-day event with the option to camp in tents, competitions, and a traveling trophy for the winners.

description: The 12th Night Port Marathon Szczecin and the 7th Night Port Half Marathon Szczecin are nocturnal street races held in Szczecin, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The marathon course consists of two identical loops of 42.195 km each, and the half marathon is a single loop of 21.097 km, both certified by PZLA. The start is at 11:00 PM, and participants can expect original t-shirts and a special classification for individuals connected to the maritime industry. The event is organized by the Movement Health Academy, the West Pomeranian Sports Federation, and RAZ Event, with support from the city of Szczecin and port partners.
course_highlights: Marathon route consists of two identical loops through Szczecin streets with PZLA certification
Start and finish at the Florian Krygier Municipal Stadium
Markers every 1 km and nutrition points along the route and at the finish of each loop
additional: The marathon time limit is 6 hours. A new classification category 'Sea People' for individuals associated with the maritime industry. Start and finish at the Florian Krygier Municipal Stadium. The route may have minor modifications due to renovations near Trasa Zamkowa. Registration opens at 12:00 PM. The route may undergo slight changes due to construction work, and a 'Sea People' category is planned for participants connected to the maritime industry.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Lublin edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Lublin - summer edition is cross-country running organized by running enthusiasts who have been promoting this sport since 2014. The event takes place in the picturesque UMCS Botanical Garden in Lublin, combining athletic competition with the beauty of nature. The run is part of the Botaniczna Piątka series, known for its aesthetic routes and friendly atmosphere. We invite all running enthusiasts to participate in this exceptional summer edition.
course_highlights: Cross-country route in UMCS Botanical Garden
Picturesque and aesthetic green surroundings
Organization emphasizing natural and sporting values
additional: The event is scheduled for July 19, 2026, in Lublin, with the possibility to participate in various distances and age categories.

name: Garmin Ultra Race Tolkmicko
description: Garmin Ultra Race Tolkmicko is a unique trail run taking place on July 18, 2026, on the picturesque terrains of the Elbląg Upland by the Vistula Lagoon. The route passes through wild trails, varied elevations, and a quiet, natural scenery, offering runners contact with nature and the region's history. The event is part of a nationwide mountain running series promoting physical activity in harmony with nature, suitable for both beginners and experienced ultramarathoners. Participants can expect professional organization, medical support, and a rich race package.
course_highlights: Wild nature of the Elbląg Upland with scenic elevations
Routes passing through the Elbląg Upland Landscape Park and four forest reserves
Views of the Vistula Lagoon and historic sites such as Old Prussian hillforts and the Imperial Stone
additional: The race package includes a waterproof bib with a chip, medical support, trail marking, nutrition points, drinks and snacks at the finish line, a commemorative medal, and a GPS tracker for the 81 km distance. Starts are scheduled in waves from 5:00 AM (81 km) to 10:30 AM (14 km), with separate races for children called Garmin Junior. An online technical briefing on Facebook will be held on July 15, 2026, at 8:00 PM. The system offers discounts when registering for more than one event in the series. The event also includes junior categories and challenge options, with routes passing through reserves and tourist trails, providing unique experiences for runners and nature enthusiasts.

name: Nocna zaDyszka 2026
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Piekarach Śląskich
description: Night Run is a 10 km race organized as part of the 7th PKO Piekarski Half Marathon, which will take place on July 18, 2026, in Piekary Śląskie. The event attracts many runners, with a participant limit of 900 for this distance. The day before, on July 17, there will also be a companion race, the Forest Eco Five (Leśna Eko Piątka), covering 5 km. Organizers invite participation and expect nearly 3,000 runners across all distances in 2026.
course_highlights: Night race over 10 km
Participant limit of 900
Companion race Leśna Eko Piątka over 5 km with a limit of 500 participants
additional: Participant limit: 1500 for the half marathon, 900 for Night Run (10 km), 500 for Forest Eco Five (5 km). Registration available online. The companion race takes place the day before the main event. The event also includes races for children, with the possibility of early online registration, and a time limit of 2 hours and 30 minutes to complete the course. The race enjoys great interest from the local community and is one of the most important sporting events in the region.

name: 2 Chojnicka Piątka
description: 1. Chojnicka Piątka is an urban race organized in Chojnice, which will take place on July 26, 2026. The event is part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich and attracts runners from various places, offering sporting competition and a good atmosphere. The race route runs through the streets of the city, providing participants with attractive views and the opportunity to test their form over a distance of 5 km.
course_highlights: Urban race in the center of Chojnice
Route length of 5 km
Organized as part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich
additional: The event is scheduled for July 18, 2026, and the route runs through the streets of Chojnice, mainly along Rybacka Street. Details regarding registration have not been provided.

name: Botaniczna Piątka
location: Ogrod Botaniczny UMCS, Lublin, Lublin County, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Lublin is a spring edition of a popular cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place in the picturesque Botanical Garden of UMCS in Lublin, combining athletic competition with the beauty of nature. The race aims to popularize running and promote aesthetic and attractive running routes. Organizers place particular emphasis on the natural values of the proposed locations, making the race a unique experience for participants.
course_highlights: Cross-country route in the Botanical Garden of UMCS in Lublin
Picturesque and aesthetic natural surroundings
Race organized by experienced enthusiasts since 2014
additional: race over 5 km, route in the Botanical Garden, children's races, Nordic Walking, July 2026

name: Garmin Ultra Race Tolkmicko
description: Garmin Ultra Race Tolkmicko is a unique trail run taking place on July 18, 2026, on the picturesque terrains of the Elbląg Upland by the Vistula Lagoon. The route passes through wild trails, varied elevations, and quiet forests, offering runners contact with nature and historical sites of the region. The event is part of the nationwide Garmin Ultra Race series, which promotes physical activity in harmony with nature and attracts both beginners and experienced ultramarathoners. Tolkmicko is a new location in the series, known for its beautiful views, forest reserves, and rich history.
course_highlights: Wild nature of the Elbląg Upland with scenic trails and elevations
The route passes through the Elbląg Upland Landscape Park and four forest reserves
Views of the Vistula Lagoon and historical sites such as Old Prussian hillforts and the Imperial Stone
additional: Starts are scheduled in waves: 81 km at 05:00, 51 km at 08:00, Garmin Junior and distances of 21.5 km and 14 km from 09:15 to 10:30. The time limit for completing the route ranges from 2 hours (14 km) to 15 hours (81 km). Race kits are distributed on July 17-18, and there is an online technical briefing on Facebook. Participants can download their race bib 5 days before the race by logging into startlist.pl. Discounts are available for those registering for more than one event in the series. The route features a total elevation gain from 250 m (14 km) to 1400 m (81 km). Distances range from 12 km to 81 km, with time limits from 2 to 15 hours, mountain terrain, scenic trails, forest reserves, and proximity to the Vistula Lagoon.

name: Zkus Noční Kuks
location: Kuks, Trutnov District, Hradec Králové Region, Czech Republic
description: Try Noční Kuks is a night running race set in the picturesque baroque environment of Kuks. It offers two routes - 10 km and 5 km - which pass by historic landmarks such as Braun's Nativity Scene and Hospital Kuks. Running in the darkness illuminated only by headlamps provides a unique experience and atmosphere that participants will remember for a long time. The 10 km route includes the pilgrimage route of the 21st-century Cross Path, while the shorter 5 km route runs along the night-time Elbe River and the Count's Avenue with 222 trees.
course_highlights: 10 km route runs through the magical heart of baroque landscape with Braun's Nativity Scene and the 21st-century Cross Path
5 km route starts at the hospital and passes along the night Elbe River and the Count's Avenue with 222 trees
Night run illuminated by headlamps with an unforgettable atmosphere under the glowing facade of Hospital Kuks
additional: The registration fee includes a start number and chip. It is possible to purchase the registration as a gift voucher with a unique code. Registration is done online via myresult.cz, and a contractual relationship is established upon payment of the registration fee. The race is organized by TURN ON EVENTS s.r.o. from Hradec Králové. The race offers routes of 5 km and 10 km, the option to start with a headlamp, refreshments during and after the race, participation with dogs is allowed, registration is possible through the website, and the registration fee is payable within 14 days of registration.

name: ČEZ RunTour Olomouc
location: Smetanovy sady, Olomouc, Olomouc District, Czech Republic
description: CEZ RunTour Olomouc is a family running event offering courses for amateurs and elite runners in lengths of 3, 5, 10, and 21.1 km, including children's runs of 500 and 1000 meters. The race takes place in the picturesque environment of Smetanovy sady and is part of a nationwide series with unique routes. Organizers emphasize excellent service, safety, and fun for the whole family, including an accompanying program and a charitable aspect. Each participant receives a start package and can look forward to refreshments and support from a guiding team. CEZ RunTour is not only a sporting event but also a full-day experience for all age groups.
course_highlights: Courses of 3, 5, 10, and 21.1 km including children's runs of 500 and 1000 m
Start and finish in Smetanovy sady in Olomouc
Accompanying program and charitable aspect of the race
additional: The race offers relay races 2x5 km and 4x2.5 km within the 10 km run. A guiding team helps runners achieve their target time. There are refreshment stations on the course, including at least two on the half marathon. Children receive a start package and entertainment in the children's zone. A special emergency phone line is available during the race. The event includes various routes, family activities, charitable support, medals, photographs, and facilities for runners. The start and finish are in Smetanovy sady, with a capacity of approximately 1700 runners.
