description: Night Run Rusava is an unforgettable night race in the Hostýn Hills, offering a 12-hour run on a single loop as well as a 5 km race. The event is suitable for individuals and relay teams, and it is not mandatory to run the entire 12 hours. The race facilities include a gym for rest, a all-night buffet, and refreshment stations. The event takes place in a picturesque environment with a ski slope and forests around Rusava, providing a unique sporting experience under the starry sky.
course_highlights: Night run on a ski slope and in the forests of the Hostýn Hills
One loop 5 km long with the possibility of repeating for 12 hours
All-night refreshment stations and facilities at the local school
additional: The race facilities include a gym at the local school for rest, with the option to bring sleeping bags and mats. Throughout the night, a buffet and refreshment stations with drinks, fruit, and food are open. Parking is available at designated spots in the village. It is not necessary to run the full 12 hours; walking with poles is also allowed. Starting numbers can be supplemented with a band for 150 CZK. Terrain: forests and ski slope, registration, relay system, ecological requirements for cups, all-night catering.

name: 7 pohoří Krušné Hory
description: The Krušné hory 2026 race is a technical trail run that takes you through the beautiful Krušné hory mountains and the former mining landscape listed as UNESCO World Heritage. The route starts in Abertamy and passes through the former Eva mine, Jelení, Swiss Cottage on Plešivec, Merklín, the former Kaff settlement, Pstruží, and a ski resort to the finish line. It offers three courses of different lengths and elevation gains, suitable for both experienced runners and beginners. The race takes place in all weather conditions, and participants receive a commemorative medal and refreshments on the route and at the finish.
course_highlights: Natural route with the beauty of Krušné hory and UNESCO mining landscape
Main course 22 km with 1000 m elevation gain
Alternative routes 13 km and 8 km with 510 m and 220 m elevation gain
additional: The race has a time limit of 4 hours, after which the runner is marked as DNF. Participants can store small items at the registration stand. Recommended equipment includes a windbreaker and a charged mobile phone with the Záchranka app. The registration fee includes a professionally marked route, a start number, chip timing, a commemorative medal, and refreshments on the route and at the finish. The event takes place in all weather conditions and participation is at your own risk. The registration fee covers the course, medal, refreshments, facilities, and recommended gear including a windbreaker and a mobile phone with the Záchranka app. The race is organized by the local mountain rescue team.

name: Rokytnice nad Jizerou - Dvoračky
location: Dvorská bouda, Rokytnice nad Jizerou, Krkonoše, Czech Republic
description: The route from Rokytnice nad Jizerou to Dvoračky is a popular hiking trail in the western Krkonoše Mountains, starting at the Upper Square in Rokytnice. The blue-marked trail leads around the Hutský Stream to the picturesque Hutský Waterfall and further to the mountain lodge Dvoračky, which is known for its history and traditional cheese production. The path offers beautiful natural scenery, especially in the autumn season when the surrounding beech forests display all the colors. The route is suitable for hikers, ski mountaineers, and cross-country skiers, who can enjoy the snowy landscape and refreshments at the Štumpovka restaurant at Dvoračky.
course_highlights: Blue-marked trail leading around Hutský Stream
Hutský Waterfall surrounded by beech forests with beautiful autumn colors
Historical mountain lodge Dvoračky with traditional cheese production
additional: Parking is available at the parking lot by Tesco on the Lower Square in Rokytnice. Refreshments are available at the Štumpovka restaurant at Dvoračky and at the U Vocta pub in Rokytnice. The route is also suitable for winter hiking, ski mountaineering, and cross-country skiing, with the need to respect groomed ski tracks and not enter them. The race is part of the local sports calendar, with options to participate in various distances, including an ascent race to Dvoračky. The event is suitable for runners of all levels and offers beautiful views and sporting experiences.

name: Kordícky Extrém
organizer: Marathon Banska Bystrica, s.r.o., ON-POINT o.z.
description: Kordícky Extrém is a challenging mountain run that takes place through the picturesque surroundings of Kordíky in the Banská Bystrica district. The course is designed for runners seeking extreme challenges in nature with significant elevation gain and technical sections. The event is part of the Marathon Tour series and offers a unique running experience in a beautiful mountain environment. Organizers welcome all runners who want to test their endurance and courage in this extreme terrain.
course_highlights: Mountain environment with significant elevation gain
Technically demanding sections on natural trails
Picturesque views of the Kordíky area
additional: Several categories and registration options including online and in person, the event is associated with a large social gathering with food and entertainment.

name: Mesciské pancaky
location: Futbalové ihrisko, Mestisko, okres Svidník, Slovakia
description: Mesciské Pancaky is a running event in Mesciské, Svidník district, offering courses of 5 km and 10 km without age restrictions for men and women. The course mainly runs on asphalt, with sections on grassy areas and field roads, providing a varied surface for runners. The race starts at the football pitch in Mesciské. Registration is available online or on-site at the event.
course_highlights: Surface: 60% asphalt, 20% grassy area, 20% field road
Two categories: 5 km and 10 km with no age restrictions
Start at the football pitch in Mesciské
additional: Categories are open to all ages for both men and women. The start location is the football pitch in Mesciské. The course surface is a combination of asphalt, grass, and terrain. The event is open to all age groups, with registration available online and on-site, and the course features a mix of asphalt, grass, and terrain.

name: Behaj lesmi Veľká Fatra
location: Hrabovo, Národný park Veľká Fatra, Slovakia
description: Run the Veľká Fatra trail race in the Veľká Fatra National Park, offering runners unforgettable views of the Low Tatras, forest single trails, and special forest roads. The routes pass through the UNESCO site Vlkolínec and include a cable car and Sidorovo. The race is part of the international UTMB Index Races, where runners earn points based on performance and race length. There are three routes with different distances and elevation gains, suitable for various levels of runners.
course_highlights: Unforgettable views of the Low Tatras
Forest single trails and special forest roads
The route passes through the UNESCO site Vlkolínec
additional: The course includes speed sections called Conti Speed Section over 150 meters, marked with Continental flags. Runners can earn points for the UTMB Index Races based on performance and race length. The routes have different elevation gains: 730 m for 18 km, 405 m for 11 km, and 267 m for 5 km. The courses are mainly on soft natural surfaces. The race is part of a series supporting environmental and charitable projects, with details on registration, entry fees, and accompanying activities available on the official website.

description: Kashubian Running Festival is a unique running event taking place on July 19, 2026, on a scenic route passing through the towns of Różewie, Swarzewo, Jastrzębia Góra, and back to Różewie. The festival offers various distances: marathon, half marathon, and races of 15 km, 10 km, and 5 km, ensuring that every runner, regardless of skill level, finds a suitable course. Part of the Maratonstavu of the Czech Cup

name: Bančanská desiatka
description: Bančanská desiatka is a traditional running race in the Banský district of Vranov nad Topľou, held in front of the Cultural House in Banské. The race is known for its difficulty and beautiful uphill course, organized by the Banské Sports Club. In addition to the main race, there are uphill time trials and other accompanying events.

Elevation gain 130 m
Uphill race in Prague 5-Velká Chuchle
additional: The race takes place as part of the series of hilly runs, starting in three waves, with results published in categories. The event is suitable for runners of all levels who want to conquer a hilly course in a pleasant environment.

description: Gliwice Park Run Provocation is a series of 12 running and Nordic Walking events organized in Gliwice in 2026. The events take place on Saturdays, once a month, on a 4219.5-meter route in the municipal forest, with start and finish at the Piast stadium. The event promotes a healthy and active outdoor lifestyle, encouraging regular physical activity under the slogan "Let yourself be provoked to fight laziness!".

Refreshment point with drinks at the start/finish line after each lap

description: Pogórze Ultra Trail is a mountain race organized by the Pogórze Ultra Trail Association, which combines a passion for running and exploring the natural beauty of the Pogórze Strzyżowskie region. The race routes lead through picturesque areas with diverse natural features, including old deciduous forests, thickets, loess ravines, and unique rock formations. Participants have the opportunity to run through historic shelter tunnels in Strzyżów and Stępin, as well as admire the Brzeżanka mountain range, the Kiczora massif, Herby, and Chełm Hill. It is the largest running event in the region, attracting trail and ultramarathon enthusiasts every year.
course_highlights: Routes lead through the Brzeżanka mountain range and Kiczora massif
Passing through shelter tunnels in Stępin and Strzyżów
Picturesque Pogórze Strzyżowskie with forests, ravines, and rock formations
additional: In 2026, the competition will be held over 4 distances. Finisher area will feature new elements. The organizers are a group of running and photography enthusiasts who take care of logistics and timing. The routes include unique historical and natural elements of the region. The event attracts trail running lovers, offering beautiful views, local supporter presence, and professional organization.

The race route takes participants through picturesque areas of Kashubia, offering unique views and sporting challenges. We invite runners of all ages to participate and celebrate sport and outdoor activity together.

Participants can choose from several routes of different lengths and age categories, whether they want to compete or just walk. This 41st edition will welcome runners from the Czech Republic and Poland, who aim to conquer Lysá hora, the queen of the Beskydy Mountains. The race starts near the Zlatník restaurant at the intersection to Lysá hora, where registration and the award ceremony also take place. The course runs along an asphalt road on a forest road managed by the Czech Forests Authority up to the summit of Lysá hora.

The entire course runs along an asphalt road on a forest road managed by the Czech Forests Authority
Finish at the summit of Lysá hora, the queen of the Beskydy Mountains
additional: The race is open to runners from the Czech Republic and Poland, takes place in the Beskydy Mountains, and is part of regional and national running competitions.

The start and finish are located in the center of the village, with refreshment stations on the course and at the finish. After the race, there is abundant refreshments and a ceremonial announcement of winners in various categories.

organizer: RUDA Śląska i MOSiR Ruda Śląska
description: The 9th Rudzki Industrial Half Marathon will take place on August 1st at 9:00 PM in Ruda Śląska. The route, 10.5 km long, runs through the central part of the city, showcasing the industrial character of the region and post-industrial monuments such as the Chebziu station, Mikołaj Shaft, Kaufhaus housing estate, and the blast furnace of Huta Pokój. In addition to the half marathon, a companion race of approximately 10 km is organized, intended for those who do not feel capable of running the full distance. The start and finish are located at the athletics stadium on Czarnoleśna Street, where the race office and organizational facilities are also situated.
course_highlights: 10.5 km route on a loop in the central part of the city
Passing through post-industrial monuments: Chebziu station, Mikołaj Shaft, Kaufhaus estate
Passing by the only blast furnace of Huta Pokój in Silesia
additional: Start and finish at the athletics stadium on Czarnoleśna Street, where the Race Office and facilities are located. A companion race of approximately 10 km for those not ready for the half marathon. Registrations are available on the platform DO:ST:AR:TU. The route passes through post-industrial monuments, with start and finish at the athletics stadium. Registrations on the DO:ST:AR:TU platform. There are also 10 km races and Nordic Walking, with PZLA certification for the half marathon.

name: XI Czastarska Piątka
description: The 11th Czastarska Five is an annual street race organized in the Czastary municipality, attracting runners from various regions. The event has a sports and recreational character and takes place on a 5-kilometer route passing through picturesque areas of the municipality. Organizers ensure a friendly atmosphere and support for participants, promoting an active lifestyle and integration of the local community.
course_highlights: 5 km long route
Street race through picturesque areas of Czastary municipality
Sports and recreational event
additional: Registration for the race opens on May 5, 2026; details about the route are not specified

name: Krkonošská 50
location: Špindlerův Mlýn, Krkonošský národní park, Czech Republic
description: Krkonošská 50 is a traditional trail run held in the picturesque environment of the Krkonoše National Park, starting in Špindlerův Mlýn. The race offers a challenging route of 50 km with an elevation gain of 1784 meters, passing along marked trails and mountain paths. The event is limited to 300 participants and is divided into several age categories for men and women. Organizers emphasize ecology and safety, including mandatory mobile phone equipment and a ban on littering outside refreshment stations.
course_highlights: 50 km course with an elevation gain of 1784 m
Route runs along marked trails in Krkonoše National Park
Refreshment stations at 13, 18, 27, 33, 39 km and at the finish
additional: Limited to 300 participants. Start and finish at the Svatý Petr area, Špindlerův Mlýn. Parking available at the central parking lot in Špindlerův Mlýn. Possibility to change the route from long to short after reporting to the control at Svatý Petr - hotel Horal. Trail marked with black arrows on a yellow background only at intersections and turns. Mobile phone is mandatory for all participants. Trail race with marked paths, online registration, limited to 300 participants, categories for men and women, possibility of route changes.

name: Běhej lesy Bílá
location: Bílá, Beskydy, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: Běhej lesy Bílá is a mountain trail race held in the beautiful environment of the Beskydy Protected Landscape Area (CHKO Beskydy). The race offers various routes including a short and a long one, with the long route ČSOB 20 km included in the international UTMB Index. Runners can use the cable car to the top and look forward to special speed sections Conti Speed Section and Generali Investments Finish, which bring additional competitive elements and rewards. The race is suitable for all mountain trail running enthusiasts who want to experience the beauty of the Beskydy and compete on well-marked trails.
course_highlights: Trails run within the Beskydy Protected Landscape Area (CHKO Beskydy) with respect to nature and a ban on entry outside marked paths
Conti Speed Section - a 200-meter speed segment on the Nova 11 km and ČSOB 20 km routes
Generali Investments Finish - an extended 500m finish straight with a measured section and performance analysis
additional: The race is part of the UTMB Index Races with international points. The cable car to the top of the Bílá ski resort is available. At the finish line, there is an extended 500m straight with a measured section called Generali Investments Finish, where the fastest men and women are announced and rewarded with a functional running jersey from the brand Craft. Trail routes of various lengths, cable car ascent, speed sections, charity race, respect for the Beskydy Protected Landscape Area, GPX routes available for download.

name: Zlatá stezka
location: Stožec, Šumava, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Golden Trail is a historic and international tourist route connecting the Czech Republic with the Danube region, passing through the beautiful nature of the Šumava and Bavarian Forest. The route, 631 km long, offers a unique experience through its connection with the German Golden Trail and crossing several national parks and natural reserves. Tourists can explore historic towns, castles, lookouts, and cultural monuments along the trail, which is equipped with informational boards and rest areas. The Golden Trail is ideal for hiking and discovering the natural and historical beauty of the South Bohemian and Pilsen regions.
course_highlights: The route passes through the Šumava National Park and Bavarian Forest, the largest forested areas in Central Europe
Historic towns of Prachatice, Vimperk, and Kašperské Hory with cultural monuments and museums
Cross-border connection with the German Golden Trail with 13 border crossings
additional: The route features the Golden Trail logo, informational boards, and rest areas. There are various stages with different difficulty levels and lengths. Nearby attractions include the Volary Museum, Libín Lookout Tower, and historic sites such as Hus Castle and Vimperk Castle. The route offers different lengths and levels, including ultra challenges and sports challenges, with the possibility of pre-registration. The event is suitable for runners, cyclists, and tourists who want to explore the region actively and respectfully of nature.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - srpen
description: The 2-mile run in Zlín - Příluky is an open race covering 3.2 km, suitable for all age groups and running levels, from beginners to experienced runners. The course mainly runs between gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone and consists of nearly two laps on a precisely measured asphalt track. The race also features a children's course of 800 meters. Each participant can enjoy a warm cinnamon pancake at the finish line. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month with registration from 8:15 to 8:55 and a start at 9:00.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly between gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone
Precisely measured asphalt track of just under 2 laps (3.2 km)
Children's course is 800 meters long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building. Categories are divided into men and women from 13 to 127 years old and children up to 12 years old. Time is measured for each runner, and the top three in each category receive small prizes. Recommended arrival methods include cycling, walking, driving, rollerblading, or taking trolleybus no. 11 (Průmyslová zóna stop). The course length is 3.2 km with an asphalt surface, and the children's course is 800 meters. The run is open to all age groups, including children up to 12 years old. The race starts every first Saturday from 8:15 to 8:55, with the gunshot start at 9:00.

name: Běh na Kamenný stůl
location: Rataje nad Sázavou, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Kamenný stůl Run is a traditional running race held in Rataje nad Sázavou, celebrating its 10th anniversary this year. The race offers a challenging and beautiful route from the castle courtyard to the Kamenný stůl monument, with varied surfaces and hilly terrain. The event is suitable for both professional runners and amateurs, as well as families with children, for whom shorter routes are prepared. The race is part of the Běhej zámky series, which connects running races in attractive castle locations.
course_highlights: The course leads to the Kamenný stůl monument with various surfaces: cobblestones, asphalt, paved and unpaved forest paths
Hilly terrain with parts of the route passing through the forest and field roads
Start and finish directly on the castle courtyard in Rataje nad Sázavou
additional: Start numbers with chip and name, water, cookie, promotional materials, castle entrance ticket. For children, a voucher for ice cream and for adults, a sausage. The facilities include fruit, buns, and a drinking regime. Parking is available at the playground on Zámecká Street and other nearby locations. Results are announced after completing each route. Registration includes a running package, refreshments, and castle entry; races take place under normal traffic conditions.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - srpen
location: Stromovka Park, Praha 7, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The 2-mile run in Prague's Stromovka Park is an open race covering 3.2 km, suitable for all age groups and running levels, including children up to 12 years old running 1.6 km. The race is friendly and focused on the joy of running, whether you want to improve your personal best or just enjoy a pleasant run in a beautiful environment. The course runs along asphalt paths in Stromovka Park, with adults running two laps and children one lap. At the finish line, everyone is greeted with a warm cinnamon pancake as a reward for their effort.
course_highlights: The course runs along asphalt paths in Stromovka Park
Adults run 2 laps (3.2 km), children up to 12 years run 1 lap (1.6 km)
The race takes place in the beautiful environment of Královská obora - Stromovka Park
additional: Registration takes place at the Brussels Gate area from 8:15 to 8:45, with the option of pre-registration online for faster check-in. Categories are divided by age and gender, results are measured with an age coefficient and count towards the annual Lívancový Cup. Recommended transportation includes cycling, walking, rollerblading, or tram (stop Výstaviště). There are tents for changing clothes and storing belongings, a mobile valuables locker, and portable toilet cabins. Parking is recommended near the bridge to Císařský Island on Za elektrárnou street. The race is held in Stromovka Park, starting at 9:07 AM, with registration from 8:15 to 8:45 AM, online registration available. Categories for different age groups, parking at the bridge to Císařský Island, changing rooms and toilets available. The race is regularly held on the first Saturday of each month.

name: Mšecká sedmička
organizer: Městys Mšec a TJ Sokol Mšec
description: Mšecká sedmička is a traditional running race held in Mšec in the Central Bohemian Region. The race is 7 km long and runs through forest and field paths, offering runners a pleasant natural terrain. The start is at the TJ Sokol Mšec football field, and the race is suitable for the general public. The event is organized by the Městys Mšec and TJ Sokol Mšec, who ensure a friendly atmosphere and quality organization.
course_highlights: Race length of 7 km
Surface of forest and field paths
Start and finish at TJ Sokol Mšec football field
additional: The organizer is Městys Mšec and TJ Sokol Mšec. The race is of a mixed type with a course through forest and field paths. The race starts at the TJ Sokol Mšec football field. The course includes forest and field paths; registration conditions are not specified.

name: Libeř - Radlík
description: Libeř - Radlík is an uphill race 2.47 km long with an elevation gain of 170 meters, which is part of the Hill Runs series in Prague and the surrounding area. The route is not purely uphill; it includes several flat sections and one downhill, adding interest and dynamism to the race. The atmosphere is pleasant, and the entry fee is symbolic, with generous prizes for winners from the company Botanicus. The race is suitable for runners seeking a challenge in hilly terrain near Prague.
course_highlights: Length of the route 2.47 km with an elevation gain of 170 m
The route includes flat sections and one downhill
Part of the Hill Runs series in Prague and surroundings
additional: Entry fee is symbolic, winners receive generous prizes from the company Botanicus. The route runs on wide, partly gravel paths, which some runners mention in comments as a disadvantage compared to forest trails. The race has a pleasant atmosphere despite slightly punk conditions. The route is not purely uphill; it includes a few flat sections and one downhill; runs on wide, partly gravel paths; part of the Hill Runs series.

name: Trail Running Cup - Krkonošská padesátka
description: The Krkonošská Fifty is a traditional trail race held in the picturesque environment of Špindlerův Mlýn in the Krkonoše Mountains. The race offers a challenging route of 50 km with an elevation gain of 1784 meters, running on marked trails and mountain paths. The start is at the Svatý Petr area, and participants can use the central parking lot in Špindlerův Mlýn. The race is limited to 300 starters and announces an absolute male and female winner, as well as ten age categories for men and women.
course_highlights: 50 km course with 1784 m elevation gain
Route runs on marked trails and mountain paths in the Krkonoše Mountains
Checkpoints at 13 km, 18 km, 27 km, 33 km, 39 km, and at the finish line
additional: The race starts at the Svatý Petr area in Špindlerův Mlýn. Parking is available at the central parking lot in Špindlerův Mlýn. Mobile phones are mandatory equipment for all participants, must be functional and charged. The race strictly prohibits littering outside refreshment stations. Route changes from longer to shorter are possible after notifying the control at Svatý Petr - Hotel Horal. The route is marked with black arrows on a yellow background only at intersections and turns. The participant limit is 300 runners, the race is open to men and women, registration is online, and the race day is August 1, 2026.

name: Bear Foot Poľana
price_range: € 1 - € 40 (podľa vlny registrácie a dostupnosti na mieste)
description: BEAR FOOT POĽANA 2026 is a mountain run set in the wild and unique environment of the Poľana mountain range, which is the highest and best-preserved volcano in Central Europe. The race offers two main courses: 24 km with a cumulative ascent of over 1300 meters and 10 km with over 600 meters of elevation gain. The route passes through tourist-attractive sites such as the Bystrô Waterfall, the Celtic hillfort Kaľamárka, and the Predná Poľana peak, allowing runners to enjoy the beauty of deep forests, mountain streams, and pastures. The race is part of the Slovak Skyrunning Association league and is limited to 150 runners for each course.
course_highlights: 24 km course with over 1300 m of cumulative ascent passing through Bystrô Waterfall and the Celtic hillfort Kaľamárka
10 km course with over 600 m of ascent, start and finish at the Mountain Hotel Poľana
Surface of the course is a combination of hiking trails, forest roads, and mountain meadows
additional: Check-in for participants is from 7:30 to 9:30; late registration is not possible. Throughout the course, it is mandatory to use a bell or a rattle. There are three refreshment stations at 4.4 km, 10 km, and 15 km. The registration fee includes refreshments during and after the race, a unique start number, a participant package, and timing services. The limit for participants is 150 for each course. The race covers 24 km with over 1300 meters of elevation gain, with a participant limit of 150, and is part of the Slovak Skyrunning League. Registration is limited. The race will take place on August 1, 2026.

name: Porubska 11-ka
description: Porúbska 11-ka is a running race held in the village of Porúbka in the Bardejov district, characterized by a slightly hilly, upland to flat terrain at an altitude of 196 meters. The course runs through the Carpathian mountain range area, offering a combination of plains and hills, ideal for runners seeking a pleasant and natural run. The race is organized by the village of Porúbka and is part of local sports activities with a tradition and community spirit. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the region.
course_highlights: Slightly hilly, upland to flat surface
Altitude of 196 meters
The route passes through the Carpathian mountain range area
additional: The race takes place on August 1, 2026; registration is possible via Google Forms; the routes lead through nature around Porúbka; the event is supported by the local community and sports enthusiasts.

name: Island Gladiator Slovakia
description: Island Gladiator Slovakia is an OCR race that tests your strength, endurance, and determination in the authentic natural environment of Slovakia. The course runs through meadows, forests, streams, and hills with various technical sections and obstacles such as walls, crawling, pulling, balancing, and carrying loads. The race is open to men and women, beginners and experienced athletes, with a time limit of 3 hours. Each participant receives an official T-shirt, medal, start package, and electronic timing. Island Gladiator is not just a competition but a challenge to overcome oneself and become a stronger gladiator.
course_highlights: The course runs through meadows, forests, streams, and hills
Technical sections with obstacles such as walls, crawling, pulling, balancing, and carrying loads
Time limit of 3 hours to complete the course
additional: Each participant receives an official T-shirt, a unique medal, electronic timing, a start package with surprises from partners, hydration, and refreshments at the finish line or on the course. Failing to overcome an obstacle results in a penalty of 20 burpees or a penalty lap. External assistance is only permitted with the organizers' consent. The race starts at 09:00 in waves, registration is possible through their website, and early discounts are available.

name: Kresowe Trail #9
description: Kresowe Trail is a series of intimate trail runs organized by the Kresowe Marathons Foundation, promoting a healthy lifestyle and respect for nature. The event in Narewka offers two running distances: Szpurt (7 km) and Wertep (16.6 km), featuring scenic routes with markings and a refreshment station along the course. Participants can expect electronic timing, commemorative medals, and a warm recovery meal. The event emphasizes ecology and the local community, creating a friendly atmosphere for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Szpurt route - 7 km with green arrows on a yellow background
Wertep route - 16.6 km with red arrows
Refreshment station on the Wertep distance and careful route marking
additional: Online registration closes 3 days before the event. Registration on the day of the race is possible from 8:30 AM, but the start package may be incomplete (e.g., without a medal). The time limit for the course is 2 hours and 15 minutes. Strict prohibition on littering; gel and bar wrappers can be left at the refreshment zone. The package includes a warm recovery meal with vegetarian options, electronic timing, medical support, finish and Wertep course refreshment stations, general classification points, and a special photo service. The event is scheduled for August 2, 2026, with previous results and archives available on the website. Participants can choose from various distances, and the event enjoys great interest from the local community.

name: XI Bieg Wśród Krasnych Pól
organizer: Gminne Centrum Czytelnictwa i Kultury w Krasnopolu
description: The Run Among the Red Fields is a forest race organized in the Krasnopol municipality, offering routes of approximately 10 km and 5 km, as well as Nordic Walking over 5 km. The course runs exclusively on forest gravel and grassy roads, providing contact with nature and pleasant running conditions. The race office is located at the Municipal Reading and Culture Center in Krasnopol, and the start takes place in the afternoon. The race is open to all and organized with outdoor activity enthusiasts in mind.
course_highlights: Route of approximately 10 km and 5 km
Forest gravel and grassy roads
Start and finish in Krasnopol municipality
additional: The race office is open from 13:00 to 15:00 at the organizer's headquarters at 1 Maja Street 1 in Krasnopol. Parking is available in designated areas within the town, marked on the map. The running and Nordic Walking routes are free of charge; the organizer requests responsible registration. Race packets are distributed from 11:00 to 13:30. The event includes a 5 km Nordic Walking category, starting at 15:00 from the stadium at the Primary School in Krasnopol. Participation is free, and participants can support charitable causes.

name: XIV Panewnicki Bieg Dzika (8)
organizer: Akademia Wychowania Fizycznego im. Jerzego Kukuczki w Katowicach, KS AZS AWF Katowice
price_range: 20-110 zł w zależności od kategorii i dnia

description: Panewnicki Wild Boar Run is a recreational running and Nordic Walking event held in the picturesque forests of Panewniki in Katowice. The competition aims to promote an active and healthy lifestyle as well as the charms of the local nature. The route, approximately 4.9 km long, is marked every kilometer and can be completed up to four times, with a time limit of 3 hours. The event is open to amateurs and athletes affiliated with sports clubs, and participants can expect education on proper forest behavior.
course_highlights: Route approximately 4882 meters on a loop in the Panewniki forests
Route marked every 1 km
Ability to complete the loop up to 4 times with a 3-hour time limit
additional: The time limit to complete the route is 3 hours. The route is marked every 1 km. Participants can run or walk the loop up to 4 times. Individuals born in 1950 or earlier are exempt from the start fee. Start fees can be paid via bank transfer to KS AZS AWF Katowice. There is an option to purchase a package for all races in the year. The event is recreational and educational, promoting proper behavior in forest areas. Electronic registration, 3-hour time limit, running and Nordic Walking competitions, Panewniki forest terrain, race preparations, and training plans.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - srpen
description: The 2-Mile Run Olomouc is an open race over 2 miles (3.2 km) designed for all age groups and running levels, from beginners to experienced runners. The race focuses on the joy of running and self-improvement, where each participant competes primarily against themselves. The event is usually held in Smetanovy Sady near the fountain, except for the June and August races, which take place by the river on U Dětského domova street. It also includes a trophy competition, where results are adjusted according to age coefficient and points are accumulated throughout the year.
course_highlights: Distance of the course 2 miles (3.2 km), children's course 600 m
The course mostly runs in Smetanovy Sady in Olomouc, near the fountain
June and August races are held by the river on U Dětského domova street
additional: Registration takes place from 9:30 to 10:00 AM. The top three places in each category are awarded. Results are adjusted according to age coefficient and points are accumulated for the trophy competition for the period September 2025 - August 2026. The race includes an asphalt track of 3.2 km and a children's race of 600 m; registration is from 9:30 to 10:00; the event is scheduled for August 2, 2026.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Moldava
location: Moldava, Krušné hory, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Running in the Ore Mountains is a cross-country and canicross series that takes you through the beautiful Ore Mountains. The series includes 6 races in various locations, including Moldava, with routes for runners, canicrossers, children, and walkers. Each race offers a main running event of 6 to 9 km, an experiential route of 20 to 30 km according to the map, a walking route of 5 to 8 km with point finding, and children's races from 200 to 1600 meters. The series is suitable for the general public who want to actively and sportingly explore the beauty of the Ore Mountains.
course_highlights: Main race 6 - 9 km in the nature of the Ore Mountains
Experiential route 20 - 30 km according to the map with orienteering elements
Children's races and walking with point finding 5 - 8 km
additional: The series includes 6 races in various locations of the Ore Mountains. The routes are suitable for runners, canicrossers, children, and walkers. Children's races range from 200 to 1600 meters in length. Experiential routes are guided by a map and include point finding for walking. The races are part of a series with overall scoring and winners announced at the final race in Stříbrná; the event also features races with dogs and children's categories.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 8. kolo
description: The 2-Mile Run Bratislava is a regular running race organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team at the Kuchajda swimming complex in Bratislava. The race covers a distance of 2 miles (3.218 km) with categories for children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. Registration takes place directly on-site from 9:30 AM, and the start is at 10:00 AM. The competition is part of a series where runners earn points towards the Traveling Cup based on their performances and participation in each round.
course_highlights: Course length of 2 miles (3.218 km)
Presentation and start near the volleyball court at the Kuchajda complex
Categories for children, juniors, women, men, and veterans
additional: Registration is on-site at the volleyball court from 9:30 AM. The competition for the Traveling Cup of the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team awards points based on performances and participation. In case of a tie in points, the best time is the deciding factor, followed by shoe size. Children have a separate category with a shorter distance of approximately 200 meters. The race takes place on a public road at Kuchajda, with on-site registration also possible. The start is scheduled for 10:00 AM. There is also a category for children with shorter distances.

name: Malý Kavečianský maratón
organizer: TJ Mladosť Kavečany a MÚ MČ Košice - Kavečany
price_range: 21 km: 15,- € online, 20,- € na mieste; 7 km: 12,- € online, 17,- € na mieste; zadarmo pre ženy nad 60 rokov a mužov nad 70 rokov
description: The Small Kavečiansky Marathon is a running event in Kavečany near Košice, offering courses of 21 km and 7 km, as well as children's runs. The race starts at the football stadium and is designed for a wide range of categories from children to veterans. The organizer is TJ Mladosť Kavečany in cooperation with the City District of Košice - Kavečany. The event is suitable for runners of various age groups and performance levels, with registration fees available at affordable prices and the possibility of online registration.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the football stadium in Kavečany
Courses of 21 km and 7 km suitable for different age groups
Children's runs starting at 9:10 AM
additional: Women over 60 years and men over 70 years have free registration. Categories include children's, pupil, youth, absolute, and age groups for men and women. Children's runs start at 9:10 AM. The course includes city streets and the football stadium; online registration until August 1, 2025; start at 9:00 AM for all categories.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Karlštejn
location: Autokemp Karlštejn, Karlštejn, Středočeský, Czech Republic
price_range: 240 Kč (voucher na 12 závodů), 316 Kč (voucher na 6 závodů)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 240 Kč (v rámci voucheru na celou sérii 12 závodů)

description: The Berounka Running Series in Karlštejn is a community trail race held in the beautiful natural environment of Autokemp Karlštejn. The route passes through fields, meadows, and forests to the Malá Amerika quarry, continues along the red St. James path to Karlštejn Castle, and ends with a downhill run to the finish line. The race offers a friendly atmosphere, marked trail, and options for refreshments and baggage storage. Each participant receives a bib number, and the top finishers in each category will receive diplomas and medals.
course_highlights: The route passes through fields, meadows, and forests to the Malá Amerika quarry
Continues along the red St. James path to Karlštejn Castle
The final part of the route is downhill towards the finish line
additional: The route is marked with red and white flags and red ground markers. Refreshments and baggage storage are available on site. The top three places in each category will receive diplomas and medals. The recommended arrival time is no later than 17:45. Bib numbers, refreshments, baggage storage, and registration are available on the day of the race. Registration can be done online or on-site. The race starts by 17:45, and the trail is marked.

name: Rozdělovský čtvrtmaratón
location: Kladno-Rozdělov, Kladno, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Rozdělov Quarter Marathon is a running race organized by the Marathon Club Kladno, held in Kladno-Rozdělov. The club focuses on endurance running and organizing running events in the region. The race offers an opportunity for runners of all levels to test their strength on a quarter marathon course in the pleasant environment of the Central Bohemian Region. The event is part of the club's running calendar and supports the running community around Kladno.
course_highlights: Quarter marathon course in Kladno-Rozdělov
Organized by Marathon Club Kladno focusing on endurance running
Part of the regional running calendar
additional: The race takes place on a Wednesday or Thursday in the first half of August from 18:00, with a route through forest paths. The event has an intimate character and the number of participants is growing.

name: Krčský lomcovák
description: Krčský lomcovák is a traditional running race held in Krčský Forest in Prague 4. The race offers a 5 km route starting at the Great Pavilion, suitable for both men and women, with different start times. The event is part of a sports and entertainment afternoon in Nové Roztyly Park, where participants and families with children can try various activities such as slackline, sack jumping, or disc golf. The race is organized by the magazine Krčák žije, which focuses on activities and news related to Krčský Forest and its surroundings.
course_highlights: 5 km route in Krčský Forest
Start at the Great Pavilion
Mostly forest terrain with natural features
additional: Men start at 18:30, women half an hour earlier. The start is at the Great Pavilion. The event is part of a sports and entertainment afternoon in Nové Roztyly Park with accompanying activities for families with children. The race is open to all age groups, offers various running disciplines, and is part of a community sports day in Prague 4.

name: niedamiRUN - Ultramaraton Sudecki
organizer: Stowarzyszenie NIEDAMIRÓW WIOSKA CUDÓW i Foxter Sport
description: NiedamiRUN is an ultramarathon in the Sudetes taking place on August 8, 2026, in Niedamirow, a picturesque village located at the border of three cultures. Participants can choose from four distances: 10K, 20K, 50K, and 100K, which lead through the Karkonosze Mountains, Lubawska Gate, and Bóbr Valley, offering challenging elevation gains and beautiful views. The routes pass through historical and natural attractions of the region, with start and finish lines in Niedamirow. This is a unique opportunity to face the Sudecki ultra in the company of wild nature and local culture.
course_highlights: Routes pass through Karkonosze Mountains, Lubawska Gate, and Bóbr Valley
Elevation gains up to 3970 meters on the 100K distance
Views of Bukówka Lake and historical crucifixes on the 10K route
additional: The participant limit for each distance is 100 people. There is an option to change the distance until August 4, 2026, with an additional fee or without a refund of the difference. The routes have nutrition points and time limits. The start and finish are located at the former WOP Guardhouse and sports field in Niedamirow. Routes are available for download to Garmin, Suunto, Polar, and other GPS devices. The courses go through the Karkonosze and Sudetes, with a time limit from 3 to 18.5 hours, various distances, attractions for children, and local delicacies at the finish line.

name: 10 Śliwicka Dyszka
description: Sliwicka Dyszka is an annual race organized by the association Running Sliwice, promoting active lifestyles and running. The event takes place in the picturesque area of Sliwice, offering participants an attractive 10 km route. The race attracts both amateurs and experienced runners, creating a friendly atmosphere of sporting competition and community integration.
course_highlights: 10 km route
Picturesque terrain around Sliwice
Organized by the local association Running Sliwice
additional: The event is part of the local running calendar, and details regarding registration and the route are not specifically available on the website, but it is a popular sporting event in the region.

name: 12 eXtremalny Bieg Godzinny
description: The 12th Extreme One-Hour Run is a unique one-hour race held in Koszalin on a demanding approximately 1-kilometer loop in forest terrain with significant elevation changes and varied ground, including sandy sections. Participants compete to complete as many laps as possible within one hour, and the last lap must be started before the time expires. The race promotes sport, recreation, volunteering, and active tourism, and at the finish line, competitors receive an extremely heavy medal and a drink. The event is organized by the 'SFX' Association and Rozbiegany Koszalin.
course_highlights: Loop approximately 1 km long in challenging, hilly forest terrain
Varied ground with sandy sections
Significant elevation changes and demanding terrain
additional: Electronic chip timing; medical support from the PCK Rescue Group Koszalin; each participant receives a start number with safety pins; a drink is provided at the finish; the race starts together; participants must complete the last lap started before the one-hour limit; the race is open to individuals aged 18 and over with current medical examinations or a signed declaration. Registration opens on June 6, 2025; the event takes place on sandy terrains in Koszalin; participant limit; ability to complete 1 km within an hour.

name: Bieg Zbója
description: The Zbój Race is a mountain run held in the picturesque region of Bielsko-Biała, on routes around the Klimczok peak. The race's name refers to the legend of the bandit Klimczok, who formed a gang to help the poor and left behind traces in the form of a shelter and a cave. The course is demanding, with significant elevation gains and technical ascents that test the character and endurance of participants. This event attracts runners from all over Poland, offering not only a sporting challenge but also a unique atmosphere and beautiful mountain views.
course_highlights: Mountain route with over 1530 m of elevation gain over a 25 km distance
Legendary ascents and sections requiring great endurance
Refreshment point 'Hilton' with a rich buffet along the route
additional: The start package includes a limited-edition running band and a neck gaiter in the color assigned to the distance. There is an option to purchase an extended package with a T-shirt and a belt for the race number. Finisher medals are cast, and participants receive a recovery meal and a certificate of completion with time and place. The 'Hilton' refreshment point offers a rich buffet on the route. The race is mountain-based, with limited distances, start packages with T-shirts and belts, certificates, medals, and meals.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
location: Ogród Botaniczny UAM, Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań - summer edition is cross-country race organized in the picturesque UAM Botanical Garden in Poznań. The event is part of a series of races that since 2014 promote running and the beauty of natural routes in Greater Poland. The race attracts running enthusiasts who appreciate the aesthetics and character of cross-country trails. The alternative location is Lake Rusałka, situated just 500 meters from the Botanical Garden, providing additional scenic value.
course_highlights: Cross-country route in UAM Botanical Garden in Poznań
Picturesque natural terrain and aesthetic surroundings
Alternative location at Lake Rusałka, 500 m from the start
additional: Start packages can be collected with authorization. The organizer emphasizes the aesthetic qualities of the routes and the character of cross-country races. The partner of the autumn cycle is Trzymsie.pl. The alternative race location is Lake Rusałka, 500 meters from the UAM Botanical Garden. The 5 km route runs through park terrain, online registration is available, with a limit of 500 participants. The start and finish are at the UAM Botanical Garden. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and outdoor activity.

description: I Jura Night Dog Run is a night canicross race taking place on August 8, 2026, in Klucze, Poland. The event offers two main routes: 10 km and a half marathon of 21 km, with options for individual or team participation. The event is limited to 500 participants, ensuring a intimate atmosphere and comfortable competition. The race is scheduled to start at 8:00 PM, highlighting the unique nature of a night run with a dog.
course_highlights: Night canicross race
Routes of 10 km and 21 km (half marathon)
Participant limit of 500
additional: Number of participants limited to 500. Options for individual or team (team) participation. Possibility to join teams, training plans available, event promotes activity with dogs.

name: Złota Dycha
description: The 6 Gold Ten is a street race held in the heart of Złotoryja, the oldest town in Poland. The event is scheduled for August 8, 2026, combining sporting excitement with the celebrations of the European Gold Panning Championships. The race offers two distances - 5 and 10 kilometers, and participants have the opportunity to compete on the picturesque streets of the town. The organizer is the Złotoryja City Office and the Złotoryja Cultural Center, supported by the local running community.
course_highlights: Street race through the picturesque streets of the oldest town in Poland
Two distance options: 5 and 10 kilometers
Event combined with the European Gold Panning Championships
additional: The participant limit is 300 people, divided between the 5 km and 10 km distances. Starts are scheduled for Saturday morning at 9:00 and 10:00. The race is part of the celebrations of the European Gold Panning Championships, and participants will receive special medals and trophies. The race covers 10 km and 5 km distances, in the center of Złotoryja, with the town center closed to vehicle traffic on race day. Registration is available at the Złotoryja Cultural Center, with options to purchase start packages. Training sessions are available from the moment of registration.

name: Měřínský kros
description: Měřínský cross-country is a traditional cross-country race set in the beautiful nature of the Vysočina region, offering a main race of 13 km across Dědkovská Mountain and a relaxed 8 km course suitable for recreational runners. For children aged 5 to 12, there is a obstacle run called Junior Kros with a giant jumping castle. The race is timed with chip timing, and after the run, an evening volleyball tournament with refreshments takes place. The start and finish are at the playground behind the elementary school in Měřín, where parking, a storage room, toilets, changing rooms, and showers are available.
course_highlights: Main course of 13 km mainly runs on field and forest paths and trails (about 70%), with the rest consisting of asphalt sections in the village
Route over Dědkovská Mountain with new viewpoints thanks to bark beetle damage
Small refreshment station along the route
additional: Junior Kros is a free obstacle run for children aged 5-12 with distances of 700 m and 1400 m. After the race, a giant jumping castle is available. Parking is possible at the Měřín elementary school. On-site registration closes 20 minutes before the start. The registration fee includes a sausage and a drink. The race limit is 100 runners. The race is run at your own risk, without insurance. After the race, an evening volleyball tournament with refreshments takes place. The course is mainly on field and forest paths, marked route, limit of 100 runners, free children's obstacle runs, evening volleyball tournament after the race.

name: Barvám Neutečeš Pardubice
description: Color Run You Can't Escape is a colorful run in Pardubice offering two routes - 5 km and 1.5 km. The event is not about speed but about joy, friendship, and fun, where participants pass through colorful zones, being splashed with colors. The run is suitable for all age groups and is ideal for families, friends, and individuals who want to experience a day full of colors, music, and great atmosphere. In addition to the run, there is a music program and various entertainment activities.
course_highlights: 5 km route with 5 colorful zones
1.5 km route with 3 colorful zones and an interactive sports zone
Colorful zones, music, and entertainment activities along the route
additional: The event takes place from 9:00 to 16:00 in Pardubice, Park Na Špici. It features a music program with Pavel Calta and others. The event is charitable, with the option to contribute by purchasing a symbolic heart. Participants can join a prize draw from partner STANLEY on Instagram. The event offers BASIC and WOW start packages, with registration available online and on-site. It is suitable for team-building and charitable activities, with rules including paid entry fee and a visible participant T-shirt.

name: Mořice Run
location: Mořice u Olomouce, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Mořice Run is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, held in the picturesque village of Mořice near Olomouc. The race is part of a series of running events focused on fitness and performance running, organized by the club in Central Moravia. Liga stovkařů is known for supporting regular running and endurance races, and Mořice Run offers an opportunity for runners of all levels to enjoy a quality race atmosphere. The club also provides support and advice to runners who want to start or improve their training.
course_highlights: 8 km course on asphalt roads around the castle in Mořice
Children's run of 1.5 km as part of the event
Friendly atmosphere and facilities for competitors in the local area
additional: The race takes place on August 8, 2026, as part of the Great Prize of endurance runners of the Olomouc region, start at 9:00 AM, registration and details are not specified

name: Slatinická sedmička
location: Slatinice u Olomouce, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The Slatinická Sedmička is a charity run covering 7 km, primarily through terrain around the village of Slatinice near Olomouc. The race is dedicated to the memory of Šárka Krčková and offers runners a pleasant route with a natural character. The event is suitable for all runners who want to combine sport with supporting a good cause.
course_highlights: 7 km mainly off-road route
Surroundings of the village of Slatinice near Olomouc
Charity run in memory of Šárka Krčková
additional: The run is part of charitable activities supporting oncology care, and the event is associated with fundraising and support for local sports.

name: Vnorovská desítka
location: Vnorov, Vnorovy, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
price_range: platba přes bankovní účet, ceny nejsou explicitně uvedeny
description: Vnorovská desítka is a popular 10 km running race held annually in August in the village of Vnorovy. The race is part of the Moravian-Slovak Running Cup and attracts over 200 runners from various countries, including Czech elites and African runners. The course runs on a closed asphalt circuit with minimal elevation gain, with start and finish at the elementary school. The race atmosphere is very lively due to a large audience and numerous participants, with nearly 700 runners competing in all categories.
course_highlights: Course 4 x 2.5 km on asphalt road with minimal elevation gain
Closed circuit with traffic exclusion
Start and finish at the elementary school in Vnorovy
additional: Registration is open online until August 6th; same-day registration is not possible. The main race is timed with AMB chip technology. Women and men over 70 years run a shorter course of 2 x 2.5 km. Results of the main race will be announced at the Ajax pub area in Lidéřovice. Starting numbers for participants starting at 17:00 are entered into a raffle for running prizes. The race is 4 x 2.5 km on a closed circuit, with online registration until August 6th, start at 17:00, start and finish at the elementary school, with an atmosphere of spectators and a raffle.

name: Dačického 12
location: GASK Kutná Hora, Kutná Hora, Czech Republic
description: Dačického 12 is a traditional cross-country running race in Kutná Hora, which is already in its 18th edition. The race offers courses of 12 km and 6.7 km, as well as children's races with shorter distances. The route runs through the picturesque Vrchlice and Bylanka valleys, passing by historical landmarks such as the Church of St. Barbara and the Sedlec Cathedral. The race is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant sporting experience in the beautiful environment of Kutná Hora.
course_highlights: The route runs through the Vrchlice and Bylanka valleys
Passes between the Church of St. Barbara and Sedlec Cathedral
Refreshment station at the Holy Trinity
additional: Children's races are divided into categories based on year of birth with distances ranging from 300 m to 1000 m. The start is at the Jesuit College / GASK on Barborská Street. The route includes running through the streets of Pod Hrádkem, Na Podskalí, around the Šafrán guesthouse and the Great Pond. After the race, participants can order custom plaques for clubs or events. The race includes the main 12 km course, 6 km course, children's races in four categories, online registration, start and finish at GASK Kutná Hora, and the event is complemented by music and support for the charity collection Světluška.

name: Východniarska

description: Východniarska is a mountain ultra trail and long-distance walk for individuals, following the popular Východniarska Hundred. The route runs through the eastern part of the Slovenské Rudohorie mountains, mainly through the Volovské Vtáky, and offers a challenging 85 km run with an elevation gain of +4200 m. The start is in Kluknava and the finish in Kysak, with a time limit of 22 hours. The event is open to the public for participants aged 18 and over and requires proper registration and payment of the start fee.
course_highlights: 85 km long route with +4200 m elevation gain
Crossing the Volovské Vtáky in the Slovenské Rudohorie
Control and refreshment stations along the route with time limits
additional: Registration for competitors is on Thursday in Košice from 16:00 to 20:00 and on Friday, August 7, 2026, from 18:00 to 23:00 at the Biela Dama Čierny Rytier Hotel Castle. Before the start, there is an option to stay overnight in the gymnasium at the Elementary School in Kluknava; participants should bring their own sleeping mats and sleeping bags. Dropbags can be sent to the refreshment station at Vyšný Klátov (56 km), which are handed over on the morning of the race before 8:30 in the elementary school gym in Kluknava. Transportation to Kluknava is available by train and bus; it is recommended to arrive by train to Margeciany and then take a bus to Kluknava. The route is 85 km long with a 22-hour time limit, mandatory equipment including an emergency blanket, GPS, personal cup, and others; dropbags can be sent to the 56 km station. The event also offers the possibility to stay overnight in the gymnasium and transportation by train or bus to Kluknava.

name: Rajecký In-line polmaratón
description: The Rajeck Inline Half Marathon is a competitive inline skating race held in Rajecká on SNP Square. The course runs from Rajecká to Čičmany and back, with the finish line at the marathon turnaround in Čičmany. Participants are required to wear a helmet throughout the race and to have rented chips, which must be returned at the finish line. The organizer provides refreshments, changing rooms, showers, and free transportation back to Rajecká for inline skaters. The final stretch of the finish line is reserved for runners, so participants must respect the organizer's rules.
course_highlights: The course runs from Rajecká to Čičmany and back
Races are held on the right lane of the road
The final finish stretch on SNP Square in Rajecká is reserved for runners
additional: Participants must wear a helmet and have a start number attached to their right thigh during the race. Rented chips must be returned at the finish line. Refreshments (sandwiches) are provided on the square in Rajecká based on the start number. Changing rooms and showers are available at the gym on Lipová Street. A minibus for personal belongings will be available from 8:00 to 8:30 at the start area. Inline skaters must use the free bus back from Čičmany to Rajecká and are not allowed to enter the start and finish areas designated for runners; violation may result in disqualification. The race has a limit of 120 participants, registration depends on the payment date, and fees vary according to the registration period.

name: Rajecká štafeta
description: The Rajeck Relay is a running event organized by the Maratón klub Rajec, held at SNP Square in Rajec. It is a relay race that is part of the Rajecký Marathon and offers athletes the opportunity to compete in teams. The organizer provides race bibs, timing, and complete care for participants during the race. The event is suitable for runners of various levels and promotes community spirit and sports enthusiasm in the region.
course_highlights: Relay categories for men, women, and mixed teams
Takes place at SNP Square in Rajec, in the picturesque surroundings of Žilina
Registration is paid, with prices ranging from 90 to 120 euros depending on the registration period
additional: The organizer processes participants' personal data in accordance with GDPR and the personal data protection law. Registration is conducted online via the organizer's website. Participants receive race bibs upon check-in, and their results are published on official websites and sports portals. relay race, registration fees increase closer to the event date, terrain details not specified

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Kielce - summer edition is cross-country running organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes that highlight the aesthetic qualities of the proposed locations. The organizers aim to popularize running and provide participants with exceptional sports and natural experiences. It is an excellent opportunity to spend active time in a beautiful environment.
course_highlights: Cross-country run on scenic routes
Aesthetic qualities of the proposed locations
Organized with passion since 2014
additional: The event takes place on August 9, 2026, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle among residents of Kielce and the surrounding areas.

name: Chudy Wawrzyniec
description: Chudy Wawrzyniec is a mountain ultramarathon held in the Żywiec Beskids, offering six distances from 3 km to 100 km. The event takes place on August 8-9, 2026, starting in Rajcza and ending in Ujsoły. The routes are technically demanding, with significant elevation gains and beautiful views, and the 80 km race is the venue for the Polish Mountain Running Championships at Ultra Distance. Organizers ensure professional organization and nutrition points along the route, as well as the possibility to transfer the start package.
course_highlights: Routes with large elevation gains: 50 km (+2525 m), 80 km (+3825 m), 100 km (+5115 m)
Technically demanding mountain trails with numerous ascents and descents
Start in Rajcza, finish in Ujsoły, routes passing through Wielka Rycerzowa, Pilsko, and other peaks
additional: Time limit for distances 50/80/100 km is 16 hours. The 100 km route requires reaching the control point at Trzy Kopce within a maximum of 11h30 to continue the race. There are nutrition points (3 on 100 km, 2 on 80 km, 1 on 50 km) without disposable cups. Transfer of the start package to another participant is possible from April 1 to July 31. Registration for the event begins on December 11, 2025. The race takes place in the Żywiec Beskids, with options to participate in various distances and mountain climbing elements. The time limit for completion is 16 hours.

name: VII Charytatywny Bieg świętego Dominika
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Bieg Świętego Dominika w Ustroniu
description: The St. Dominic International Run is a prestigious running event held annually since 1994 in Gdańsk, as an integral part of the St. Dominic Fair. This unique sports event attracts both amateurs and professionals, offering races of various distances in the picturesque city center with a route around Neptune. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and social integration, as well as providing an unforgettable atmosphere thanks to the cheering of thousands of spectators and a rich accompanying program. The event is appreciated by local authorities and sponsors, highlighting its importance and significance in the Polish running calendar.
course_highlights: Route in the center of Gdańsk around Neptune with a length of 1412 meters
Loop leading through Długi Targ, Powroźnicza, Kotwiczników streets, and others
Cheering from over 25,000 spectators along the route of each race
additional: The event includes four races under the common slogan "Chase St. Dominic," including a prologue for all fair participants, a race for disabled persons, and traditional races for women and men over 5 km and 10 km. The route is a closed loop, allowing spectators to follow the competition closely. The event is accompanied by a rich program of attractions, including partner stalls, presentations, shows, and concerts of the St. Dominic Fair. There is also a charity run over 10 km and 5 km, with entry fees donated to charitable causes, and the event is part of the GRAND PRIX USTRONIA.
