course_highlights: Single-loop route through Szczecin streets
Distance selection point at 9.6 km of the route
Route certified by PZLA, marked every 1 km
additional: Participants can choose between a basic or extended package with a Ventus technical shirt. Start and finish at Jasne Błonia Square named after John Paul II. Participant limit is 6000 people. Electronic timing with chips in race bibs. Wave start options available. Courier packages shipped via InPost with the option to redirect to a parcel locker. Distances: half marathon and 10 km run; location: Jasne Błonia, Szczecin; date: August 30, 2026, from 09:00 to 13:00.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Poznan
location: Jezioro Kierskie, Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: IRONMAN 70.3 Poznań is a prestigious triathlon held at the historic Lake Kierskie, the site of Poland's first triathlon event in 1984. Participants can enjoy calm and warm waters for swimming, a fast and flat cycling route through picturesque villages and the western part of Poznań, and a run leading towards the city center with a finish at the International Fairgrounds Poznań — a modern symbol of the city. This unique event combines athletic competition with local culture and modern infrastructure.
course_highlights: Swimming in the calm and warm Lake Kierskie, site of Poland's first triathlon
Flat and fast cycling route through villages and the western part of Poznań
Run leading towards the city center with a finish at the International Fairgrounds Poznań
additional: Start in a rolling start format. The start and finish locations are Lake Kierskie and the International Fairgrounds Poznań. The IRONKIDS event will take place the day before, on August 29, 2026, starting at 11:00. Registration for the main race is sold out; notifications about additional spots are available. Participants have the option to change their start date free of charge within the Flex90 offer. The event also includes accompanying activities such as Night Run and IRONKIDS, with a participant limit of 1500. Registration requires a credit card.

name: Kresowe Trail #10
description: Kresowe Trail is a series of intimate trail runs organized by the Kresowe Marathons Foundation, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in nature. The series takes place on scenic routes in eastern Poland, respecting nature and local communities. The events are suitable for both beginners and experienced runners, aiming to build a community based on passion, competition, and friendship. The events are non-commercial and intimate, with a limited number of participants to ensure safety and high-quality organization.
course_highlights: Trail routes through picturesque forests and hilly terrains in eastern Poland
Respect for nature and local communities
Intimate character with a limited number of participants
additional: The runs are intimate with a limited number of participants. The organizer provides electronic timing, medical support, refreshment stations along the course and at the finish line, and commemorative medals. Participants can earn points towards the overall classification and titles of Finisher and Super Finisher for completing multiple races. The organizer encourages environmental respect and litter-free trails. The event focuses on the trail community, promotes outdoor activity, and supports the development of the local running scene. Registration is conducted via an electronic platform, and the event is part of a series covering various locations.

name: Półmaraton Buski
organizer: Buski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Busku-Zdroju

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pierwsza tura zapisów potrwa do 31 maja

description: The Busko Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Busko-Zdrój, which will take place on August 30, 2026. The start will be from the Municipal Stadium at 8:30 AM. The half marathon route passes through representative hotels and sanatoriums, the picturesque Spa Park, and charming promenades, giving the race a unique atmosphere. The time limit to complete the 21.0975 km distance is 3 hours and 30 minutes, and the race is open to both experienced runners and amateurs.
course_highlights: The route runs past representative Busko hotels and sanatoriums
Race through the picturesque Spa Park and charming promenades
Unique atmosphere and scenic surroundings of the route
additional: The time limit to finish the half marathon is 3 hours and 30 minutes. The route is verified and popular; this is the fourth time the race is held on this same course. The event is organized by the Busko Sports and Recreation Center and the Athletics Busko-Zdrój Sports Club. GPX files of the route are available for download for Suunto and Garmin devices. Registration is open until May 31, 2026. The start is at 8:30 AM, with a time limit of 3 hours and 30 minutes. The route includes urban and park areas.

name: Běh teplickými skalami
location: Teplicích nad Metují, Náchod District, Hradec Králové Region, Czech Republic
price_range: Základní 200 Kč, zvýšené 300 Kč, dodatečné 400 Kč (La Sportiva Cross); 100 Kč, 150 Kč, 200 Kč (Bufo Cross)
description: The Teplice Rocks Run is a public trail race held annually on the last Sunday of August in Teplice nad Metují. The race has been a tradition since 1994 and is part of the sports program of the International Mountaineering Film Festival. The 9 km course runs along the Metuje River to the rock city, includes sandy sections and stairs, and returns along the same route. Since 2011, a children's race by age categories has also been part of the event. The start and finish are at the TJ Slavoj football field.
course_highlights: 9 km course along the Metuje River and Teplice rock city
Sandy sections and stairs on the sightseeing circuit
Start and finish at the TJ Slavoj football field
additional: Online registration until August 26, 2026, at the basic entry fee; from August 27 to 29, 2026, at an increased fee; additional registration on race day at double the entry fee. The children's race starts by age categories on circuits. The race office is located at the start and finish area at the football field. The race is part of the Primátor Cup 2026 series. The 9 km trail is a terrain course with sandy sections and stairs, for various age categories, with online registration. The race takes place at the TJ Slavoj football field and is part of the Primátor Cup 2026 series.

name: Běh zámeckou zahradou
location: Zámecký park, Lysá nad Labem, Czech Republic
organizer: Tělocvičná jednota Sokol Lysá nad Labem
description: The castle garden run is a traditional running race held in the castle park in Lysá nad Labem. This 62nd edition takes place on August 30, 2025, and is intended for a wide range of participants from preschoolers to seniors. The race offers a pleasant environment of the historic park and promotes sports activity for all age groups. The organizer is T. J. Sokol Lysá nad Labem, which has long supported sports for everyone.
course_highlights: Lysá nad Labem castle park
Course suitable for all age groups
Pleasant environment of the historic garden
additional: The race is part of a long-standing Sokol tradition and is open to the general public, including children and seniors. The organizer is T. J. Sokol Lysá nad Labem. Information about the race is available on the Sokol website in the events section. The race takes place in the castle park, is part of a long tradition, and offers various categories for all age groups.

name: Běh Bezděkovem
location: Bezděkov pod Třemšínem, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Bezděkov Cross Country Race is a traditional trail running event approximately 9 km long, held in the picturesque surroundings of Bezděkov under Třemšín. The course mainly follows forest paths through varied terrain with gentle elevation changes, offering a combination of asphalt and rocky sections. The race starts at the hunting lodge and includes a challenging uphill section with up to 7% incline, testing runners' performance. After this demanding segment, there is a final downhill and flat finish, allowing runners to showcase their pace. The event also features children's races, making it attractive to a wide audience.
course_highlights: 90% forest trail in varied terrain, 10% asphalt
Loop run clockwise with gentle descents and ascents
360-meter uphill section with up to 7% incline as a performance test
additional: Children's races are part of the event. Start and finish at the hunting lodge in Bezděkov under Třemšín. The course is mainly through forest paths with varied terrain. Results are available in PDF format from the organizers. The race length is approximately 9 km, with options for children's races, registration in advance or on-site, and the event takes place in the Brdy nature area with various categories and distances.

name: Kolínská desítka
location: Sportovní stadion Mirka Tučka, Kolín, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: Kolínská desítka is a turnaround race over 10 km, running on asphalt and a modified forest trail around the Mirka Tučka sports stadium in Kolín. The race is part of the Grand Prix of Kolín and offers runners a pleasant combination of an asphalt surface and natural environment. This race is suitable for all runners looking for a fast and scenic run in nature. Come enjoy the race atmosphere and test your strength against other runners in the beautiful surroundings of Kolín.
course_highlights: A 10 km course with a turnaround character
Surface combining asphalt and modified forest trails
Start and finish at the Mirka Tučka sports stadium in Kolín
additional: The course is slightly hilly with an edge around Veltruby, registration is conducted online, the race is suitable for the general running public

name: Rakovnická 15
description: Rakovnická Patnáctka is a road race of 15 km, which alternates annually between starting in Rakovník and Křivoklát. The race is part of the Kladensko and Rakovnicko Running Cup and offers runners the opportunity to compete on an attractive course in the beautiful environment of the Central Bohemian Region. This race is suitable for all runners seeking a quality road run with tradition and the atmosphere of a regional running cup.
course_highlights: Road course 15 km long
Start alternates annually between Rakovník and Křivoklát
Part of the Kladensko and Rakovnicko Running Cup
additional: The race takes place in 2026, with the start planned for August 30 in Křivoklát. The course includes ascents and descents and is part of the regional running cup.

name: Sázava - Lázek
location: Sázava u Lanškrouna, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: Sázava-Lázek is a hill running race with a length of 7.9 km and an elevation gain of 375 meters. The course starts on asphalt and continues through field and forest paths, with the steepest climb at the end. This race offers a challenging and varied terrain for runners seeking a challenge in the natural environment of the Pardubice region.
course_highlights: Length of the course 7.9 km with an elevation gain of 375 m
The route goes on asphalt, field, and forest paths
The steepest climb is in the final part of the race
additional: Registration is possible on-site until 9:00 AM, the race starts at 9:30 AM, the race is intended for runners of all levels, the course offers technical challenges and beautiful natural scenery.

name: Běh okolo Hříšné Milady
location: okolí České Lípy, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Hříšná Milady Run is a cross-country race around Česká Lípa in the Liberec Region, offering two courses of 12 km and 6 km. The route mainly follows forest roads and hiking trails that are open to regular traffic. The race is part of the District Running League and is suitable for trail running enthusiasts seeking natural and technically interesting terrain. The main category starts traditionally at 11:45 AM, allowing comfortable participation for a wide range of runners.
course_highlights: The route mainly follows forest roads and hiking trails
Cross-country/trail race character
Surroundings of Česká Lípa in the Liberec Region
additional: The race is part of the District Running League (www.oblcl.cz). The organizer is Pavel Souhrada, contact: 736 138 052. The race offers courses for children and adults, with various loop lengths, and takes place around Česká Lípa at a water reservoir. Registration and further details are not specified.

name: Draždiak Run

description: Draždiak Run is a running event held in Bratislava, in the Veľký Draždiak area, Petržalka. Participants can expect courses running over gravel and hiking trails, suitable for various age groups and levels. The event includes children's runs, a 5 km race for adults, Nordic walking, and a family run with a dog. The organizer is the Športová Nadácia Kotrmelec, which ensures a pleasant atmosphere and quality organization.
course_highlights: Surface: gravel path and hiking trail
Start location: beach at Barracuda kiosk, Veľký Draždiak, Petržalka
Courses for children, adults, Nordic walking, and a family run with a dog
additional: The children's races start at 10:00. Categories include children's run, 5 km run for men and women in various age groups, 5 km Nordic walking, and a 1.8 km family run with a dog. The registration fee for children is lower than for adults. Online registration is available until August 21 at a discounted price, followed by more expensive online registration until September 4, 2025, and finally on-site registration at the highest price if quota is not filled. Online registration is open until August 21, 2026. The start is at 10:00, and the course includes gravel, grassy, and asphalt sections, with various categories including a family run and Nordic Walking.

name: Beh pod Sninským kameňom

The races are held on asphalt and field roads, with children's categories covering distances from 50 to 600 meters depending on age. The main category starts at 4:30 PM and is divided by age groups of men and women. The organizer is BehajmeSpolu o.z. in cooperation with the town of Snina, with an entry fee of €15 for online registration and €20 on-site.
course_highlights: Surface: asphalt and field roads (10%)
Recreational area of Sninské rybníky - OMW Snina
Multiple age categories from children to seniors

Categories are detailed according to age and gender, including juniors and various age groups of men and women. The event features routes for children from 50 m to 600 m, with the main race covering 6000 m. Children's start is scheduled for 3:30 PM and the main run at 4:30 PM.

name: 3 x 1 km

description: Athletics Nový Jičín and SVČ Fokus Nový Jičín organize a running race of 3 x 1.5 km, which will take place at the athletics stadium in Nový Jičín. The race is part of the Novojičín Running League and takes place on a varied surface including terrain, asphalt, and tartan. The race is intended for adult runners divided into age categories based on year of birth. Registration is conducted online and the start is scheduled for 17:00. The race offers an opportunity for sports activity and competition in a friendly atmosphere at the athletic complex.
course_highlights: The race takes place at the athletics stadium, in the Bocheta complex, and on the asphalt surface of the former gardens of the Nový Jičín Gymnasium
The course surface includes terrain, asphalt, and tartan
The race distance is 3 x 1.5 km
additional: Registration for adults is online with the schedule: 16:00 - 16:45 registration, 17:00 start, followed by results announcement. Categories are divided by age and gender, from men and women born in 1987 and earlier to older age groups. The race will be held on September 2, 2026, registration is online, the event is open to the general public, including children and adults.

name: Běh Anny-Marie
description: Anna-Marie Run is a race held in Prague 4, offering a 6.6 km course through mixed terrain across Milíčov Forest and an artificial hill. The event is organized by SABZO Prague and is part of their series of runs, attracting runners of all levels. The course includes forest paths as well as asphalt sections, making the race attractive to various types of runners. The race takes place on September 2, 2026, and provides a unique opportunity to enjoy nature and the sporting atmosphere in Prague.
course_highlights: 6.6 km course through Milíčov Forest
Mixed terrain including forest paths and asphalt sections
Organized by SABZO Prague
additional: The race is part of the SABZO series and is designed for runners of all levels, offering an opportunity to enjoy nature in Prague 4.

name: Leśna Piątka Odwrotnie
description: Forest Five Reverse is a cross-country race organized in Koszalin, taking place on September 3, 2026. The race route is run in a different direction than usual, allowing participants to experience it anew. The event is open to runners, Nordic Walking enthusiasts, and mixed pairs, with medals for all finishers and trophies for the best in various categories. The race is the finale of the Forest Five season and part of the Tour of Running in the Area - TurBO, encouraging activity throughout the year.
course_highlights: Cross-country route in the Nadleśnictwo Karnieszewice forest
Start and finish at the parking lot on Słupska Street in Koszalin
Race in the reversed direction of the route to experience it anew
additional: Start numbers with chips are to be collected at the race office on the day of the event. Participants can compete in categories for runners, Nordic Walking, and mixed pairs. The race is part of the Tour of Running in the Area - TurBO, where the collected kilometers matter more than pace. After the race, a photo gallery prepared by the A7 FILM team will be available. Participants can register online, and the event includes photographic attractions as part of the Tour of Running in the Area - TurBO.

name: Nocny Jelczański Bieg Towarzyski 3
description: Night Jelcz-Laskowice Friendly Run 3 is a night race covering a distance of 10 km, which will take place on September 4, 2026, in Jelcz-Laskowice. It is an excellent opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic route and prepare for autumn races. Organizers offer training plans tailored to various skill levels so that everyone can optimally prepare for the run. The event is aimed at runners who appreciate the atmosphere of night running and sporting competition.
course_highlights: Distance of 10 km
Night race in the picturesque town of Jelcz-Laskowice
Route suitable for intermediate difficulty level
additional: Organizers offer training plans from 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to the runner's VDOT level and expert support. The event is promoted on the platform TreningBiegacza.pl, which allows management of the race profile and marketing cooperation. The event is part of local sports initiatives promoting outdoor activity and community integration among runners.

name: Z Ľubotína na hrad Plaveč
description: Lubotin Run to Plaveč Castle is a traditional running race starting in the village of Ľubotín near the Multifunctional House. The race offers categories for men, women, juniors, Nordic walking, and a 4 km hobby run. The main category starts at 17:30, with children's categories beginning at 16:30. Organized by the villages of Ľubotín and Plaveč, it welcomes runners of all ages and levels. The race is suitable for those who want to experience running in a beautiful environment with the finish at Plaveč Castle.
course_highlights: Start in the village of Ľubotín near the Multifunctional House
Finish at the historic Plaveč Castle
Route suitable for hobby runners and Nordic walking
additional: Children's categories start at 16:30, main category at 17:30. Categories are divided by age and gender, including Nordic walking and a 4 km hobby run on an asphalt road. Residents of Ľubotín and Plaveč, women over 60, and men over 70 have free starting fees. There is an option for a discounted start package of 20 € for participants also taking part in the Jastrabskými vŕškami 2025 run. The event includes categories for various age groups, including juniors and Nordic walking, with online and on-site registration, and discounts for early registration. It also features a children's run and races on an asphalt track.

name: RAWki na Surowo
location: Bieszczadzki Park Narodowy, Wetlina, Bieszczady, Poland
description: RAWki na Surowo is a mountain trail race held in the magical Bieszczady Mountains, leading through the scenic Mała and Wielka Rawka meadows. The 29 km course with an elevation gain of +1550 m runs through the Bieszczady National Park, which necessitates a race format without aid stations and trail marking. The event is certified by ITRA and UTMB and is part of the MTrail Running Series league. The start and finish are located in Wetlina, and the race is conducted in a self-support format, emphasizing its raw character.
course_highlights: 29 km course with +1550 m elevation gain through Mała and Wielka Rawka meadows
Self-support race format without aid stations and trail marking
Runs through Bieszczady National Park with views of the Polish-Ukrainian and Polish-Slovak borders
additional: The race starts at 08:00 from the ticket point at the green trail to Mała Rawka. The finish line and race office are located in Wetlina 36 at Arszenik - Jadło & Nalewki. The race office is open on September 4th from 18:00 to 21:00 and on September 5th from 06:30 to 07:30. The time limit to complete the course is 15:30. The start and finish are approximately 1300 meters apart, with participant parking available in Wetlina, including near the green trail to Jawornik. The race is conducted without aid stations or hydration points; participants must be self-sufficient. The main distance is approximately 28.5 km, with limited access due to park regulations. The event also includes online registration and electronic timing.

name: 60. Festiwal Chodu
location: Portowy region Gdańska, Gdańsk, Pomorskie, Poland
description: The 60th Race Walking Festival is a prestigious international sporting event organized in the port region of Gdańsk, scheduled for September 5, 2026. The event gathers competitors across various age categories and skill levels, offering race walking competitions over distances of 10 km (women and men, including Open, U20, U18 categories), 5 km, and 3 km for younger participants, as well as the Polish Masters Championships over 5 km. The festival also features the Polish U23 Championships over 10 km and accompanying events such as the Prologue "Walking with the Postman" and the Memorial Run for the Polish Post Defenders - Energa Cup. The organizer, the LECHIA Gdańsk Athletics Club, promotes physical activity among people with disabilities by organizing wheelchair races and FrameRunning competitions.
course_highlights: Race walking over distances of 10 km, 5 km, and 3 km tailored to different age categories
Polish Masters Championships 5 km and Polish U23 Championships 10 km
Accompanying events including the Prologue "Walking with the Postman" and the Memorial Run for the Polish Post Defenders
additional: The festival promotes activity among people with disabilities through wheelchair races and FrameRunning competitions. The organizer is the LECHIA Gdańsk Athletics Club, and the event is supported by the Ministry of Sport and Tourism. The competitions include various distances such as 10 km, 5 km, and 3 km, with online registration available. The event encourages sports activity among different age groups and people with disabilities, with support from the Ministry of Sport and Tourism.

name: Chojnik Karkonoski Festiwal Biegowy
location: Sobieszów, Jelenia Góra, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

description: The Chojnik Karkonoski Running Festival is a mountain running event held in Sobieszów, in the heart of the Karkonosze Mountains. The festival offers a variety of distances, from a family educational run to a demanding ultramarathon of 102 km with over 5000 meters of elevation gain. The routes lead through scenic, rocky trails of the Karkonoski National Park, offering unique views and challenges for runners of different skill levels. The event has an integrative character and promotes running as a team sport, as well as environmental education.
course_highlights: Routes lead through Karkonoski National Park with rocky descents and steep ascents
Ultramarathon 102 km with over 5110 m elevation gain and a time limit of 20 hours
Start and finish at Chojnik Castle in Sobieszów, scenic mountain views
additional: Races start from 2:00 AM (Ultra Chojnik) to 10:30 AM (Educational Run). The participant limit for Ultra Chojnik is 100 people, and for Chojnik Marathon 325 people. Mandatory equipment for the ultra includes, among others, a headlamp, a roaming phone, an NRC foil, and a trail map. There are refreshment points and drop bags along the route. The Educational Run features educational stops and questions about nature. Mountain terrain, participant limit 325, mandatory equipment required, refreshment points on the route, time limit 9 hours.

name: Olkuski Bieg Uliczny
location: Stadion przy ul. 29 Listopada 12c, Olkusz, Poland
description: Olkuski Street Run VII Silver Ten Thousand is an annual running event organized by the Olkusz Running Association, the Olkusz City and Municipality Office, and the Municipal Sports and Recreation Center in Olkusz. The main race over a distance of 10 km takes place on two laps of 5 km each, with chip timing and kilometer markers. The route runs through streets with asphalt and partially cobblestone surfaces, with the start and finish located at the Market Square in Olkusz. The event promotes an active lifestyle and running as a form of recreation for all age groups.
course_highlights: The 10 km route consists of two 5 km laps
Asphalt and partially cobblestone surfaces
Kilometer markers every 1 km and intermediate timing at 5 km
additional: The time limit to complete the run is 90 minutes. There is a refreshment point around the 6 km mark. The participant limit is 300 people. Verification and collection of start packages will take place on September 6 and 7. Chip timing is mandatory and attached to footwear. Participants under 18 must have written parental consent. The participant limit is 300, the time to complete the route is 90 minutes, online registration is available, the registration fee is non-refundable, and it is possible to transfer the fee until August 26, 2024.

name: Półmaraton Praski
description: Praga Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Warsaw, attracting both amateurs and experienced runners. The half marathon route runs through the picturesque and historic parts of Praga, offering participants unique views and atmosphere. The event is held at night, which adds a special climate and appeal. Organizers provide professional service, electronic timing, and start packages with an official T-shirt.
course_highlights: The route passes through the historic district of Praga in Warsaw
The race takes place in the evening, giving the event a nocturnal character
Scenic views and a unique atmosphere of the night half marathon
additional: Official race T-shirt for participants. Electronic timing. The event is held at night, starting at 20:00. Start packages with number and chip are available. The route is certified and secured. There is also an option to participate in a 5 km run - Praska 5k Run. The event includes results and details about the route and regulations. The races are accessible to a wide range of participants, and the event is increasingly popular among runners from Warsaw and the surrounding areas.

name: XLVI Usedom Marathon
description: The 46th International Usedom Marathon is a unique running event that takes place across two countries along Europe's longest seaside promenade. The 42 km route connects Polish Świnoujście with German Wolgast, passing through historic resorts and scenic forested areas. Runners can enjoy a variety of surfaces and beautiful views of the Baltic Sea, as well as the exceptional atmosphere of the Usedom island.
course_highlights: The route runs along Europe's longest seaside promenade
Passes through historic resorts Ahlbeck, Heringsdorf, and Bansin
Diverse surfaces: asphalt, cobblestone, and forest trails
additional: Transport to the marathon start is organized by buses from the organizer with a stop near the race office at 7:15 AM. There are options to board at various points on Usedom island. Baggage transport to the stadium in Wolgast is provided. Time limit: participants must pass Kölpinsee (km 21.8) within 2:30 hours and Zinnowitz (km 30) within 3:30 hours; otherwise, they will be withdrawn from the course. After exceeding time limits, there is no route security or refreshment points. Start in Świnoujście, finish in Wolgast, bus transfer available. Registration is open until August 30, 2026. The route includes urban, forest, and seaside sections.

description: Sokolovská 12/24 RUN is an endurance running race lasting 6, 12, or 24 hours, intended for individuals, pairs, and teams of four. The event is suitable for a wide range of sports enthusiasts and offers various age and team categories with the possibility of relay exchanges at the relay area near the buffet.

Participation in categories for individuals, pairs, and teams of four
Facilities with a buffet and relay exchange options

The registration fee includes accommodation in the campsite (own tents, caravans, shelters) and participation porcelain or medals. There are toilets, showers, electrical power, and catering options available in the campsite. The race is part of a larger multisport weekend that also includes MTB races and kick scooter events. Registration occurs on September 4, 2026, from 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM and on September 5, 2026, from 7:30 AM to 10:00 AM.

name: Běh kolem Světa
description: The Run Around the World is a traditional running event held in Třeboň, which takes place around the Svět Pond. Since its inception in 2012, the race has gained loyal supporters and offers an attractive route of 11.7 km, following the Educational Trail around the World. The event is regularly held in September and is popular for its natural scenery and diverse surface, including dirt, mud, sand, grass, wooden bridges, and sections of asphalt. The race is suitable for a wide range of runners and offers the possibility to purchase an entry fee in the form of a Christmas voucher.
course_highlights: The route runs around Svět Pond with beautiful nature
The length of the course is 11.7 km, suitable for recreational and competitive runners
Surface includes dirt, mud, sand, grass, wooden bridges, and sections of asphalt

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - září
location: Průmyslová zóna Příluky, Zlín, Czech Republic
description: The 2-mile run in Zlín in Příluky is an open race covering 3.2 km, suitable for all age groups and running levels, from beginners to experienced runners. The course mainly runs between gardens in the Příluky industrial zone and consists of nearly two laps on a precisely measured asphalt track. The race also features a children's course of 800 meters. Each participant receives a warm cinnamon pancake as a reward for their performance at the finish line. The race takes place every first Saturday of the month with registration before the start and timing for all runners.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly between gardens in the Příluky industrial zone
Precisely measured asphalt track of just under 2 laps (3.2 km)
Children's course is 800 meters long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women from 13 to 127 years old and children up to 12 years old, with age categories valid throughout the calendar year. The top three places in the men's, women's, and children's categories receive small prizes. Recommended access to the start is by bike, on foot, by car, roller skates, or trolleybus no. 11 (stop Průmyslová zóna). Regular monthly registration is on the first Saturday of each month from 8:15 to 8:55, with the start at 9:00. The 800-meter children's course is part of the event. Location: Příluky Industrial Zone, Zlín, start in front of Madal Bal.

name: Kosiřské žiganec
location: Drahanovice, Olomouc District, Olomouc Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné: 150 Kč za každého účastníka, dětský závod ZDARMA

description: Kosiřské žiganec is a traditional running race held in Drahanovice on Velký Kosíř, which is part of the Great Prize of endurance runners of the Olomouc Region. The race offers courses of 10 km and 5 km running through fields and forest paths with mild to moderate elevation gain. There are shorter runs for children of 400 and 1500 meters. The event is open to the general public and, besides the sporting experience, offers refreshments and entertainment after the race. The start and registration take place at the football field, with results announcement and prizes for the best runners in individual categories.
course_highlights: The 10 km route runs through fields and forest paths with an elevation gain of 180 meters
The 5 km route also runs through fields and forest paths with an elevation gain of 50 meters
Children's races of 400 and 1500 meters with the route specified on site
additional: Registration for the main race is only possible via www.liga100.cz, children's categories register on site. The capacity for the 10 km race is limited to 150 participants. The race is accompanied by medical services and each participant runs at their own risk. Refreshments and entertainment are provided after the race. Special prizes are awarded for the best runners in categories as well as for the fastest medical personnel and local residents. Registration takes place on site, races are open to all age groups, race day includes registration, start times, and winners announcement.

description: Vorkloster Run is a stage race held in the picturesque environment of the foothills of the Bohemian-Moravian Highlands and in the atmosphere of the medieval Porta Coeli Monastery. The race offers three stages of varying length and profile, from a fast flat stage to more challenging hilly sections. It is organized by the experienced team DálRunDál in cooperation with the Porta Coeli Monastery Brewery, which contributes to an authentic experience. The routes are carefully marked and mostly run off-road, with beautiful views of the surrounding landscape and historical monuments.
course_highlights: 1st stage: 5 km, a fast flat course on quality asphalt and cycle paths along the Svratka River with views of Květnice Hill
2nd stage: 11.4 km, a hilly course on paved forest and field roads with panoramic views of the Bohemian-Moravian Highlands foothills
3rd stage: 14.7 km, a moderately demanding course with one hill and a flat finish, passing under unique railway viaducts
additional: The start of the 1st stage is at 10:00 on Saturday. The route is mainly run off-road, on cycle paths and quality asphalt. Bus transportation is available approximately 10 minutes before the start from the parking lot near the start. Accommodation is possible at the Porta Coeli Monastery premises in Předklášteří near Tišnov. The routes are carefully marked with arrows and flags. Starting numbers must not be torn on the bridge over the Svratka River, where the intermediate time is measured. The race includes multiple stages of different lengths and terrains, including team relay options. The event takes place in the beautiful environment of the historic monastery and surrounding nature, with various start times and routes.

name: Podhostýnská 10
location: Zámecký park, Bystřice pod Hostýnem, Zlín, Czech Republic
description: Podhostýnská 10k is a running race held in Bystřice pod Hostýnem, offering courses of 10 and 5 kilometers, including children's races. The event takes place in the castle park and is part of the Zlín Running Series. The race is suitable for the general public and runners of all ages who want to enjoy a sporting atmosphere in a beautiful environment. Organizers emphasize tradition and high-quality organization of the race.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the castle park area in Bystřice pod Hostýnem
Two main routes: 10 km and 5 km
Includes children's races
additional: Registration of participants takes place at the castle in the stables area. The race is part of the year-round Zlín Running Series, which includes 13 races from 5 km to half marathon. Organizers emphasize ecology and environmental friendliness. The races are held in the castle park in Bystřice pod Hostýnem, registration is possible online and on-site, the race course is mainly on roads and park paths, and the event also includes children's races and medals for participants.

name: Běh Plzeňské teplárenské kolem Boleveckých rybníků
description: The Plzeňská teplárenská Run around Bolevecké Ponds is a traditional running event organized by Pro Sport Activities agency, offering routes for children and adults in the picturesque surroundings of Bolevecké Ponds in Plzeň. The race is part of the Youth Running Cup of the Plzeň Region and is suitable for the general public, including the youngest runners. The registration fee is free, and the first 300 registered participants will receive a voucher for refreshments. In addition to the races, there is an accompanying program for children and an autograph session with athletes.
course_highlights: Routes from 300 m for the youngest children up to 5.5 km with hills for adults
Scenic surroundings of Bolevecké Ponds with flat and hilly sections
Time measurement using chips and results service by APACHI s.r.o.
additional: The registration fee is free for all participants. The first 300 registered participants will receive a voucher for refreshments (a sausage with bread and mustard, 0.33 l beer or non-alcoholic drink). Chip rental, bibs, and pins are available, along with an original finisher medal. The accompanying program includes face painting, a bouncy castle, and an autograph session with athletes. Parking is available in the parking lots around Bolevecké Ponds; entry by car to the start and finish area is not permitted without permission. Routes range from 300 m to 5.5 km, registration is through APACHI company, race office is located at Ostende near Velký Rybník, parking is available around Bolevecké Ponds, and the program includes face painting and a bouncy castle.

name: Birell Večerní Běh na 10 km Praha
description: Birell Evening Run in Prague 10 km is a traditional night run that offers a unique atmosphere of illuminated Prague streets. The race starts at dusk and allows runners to experience the city's beauty in an unconventional light. You can participate as an individual or in a team and enjoy the magical night atmosphere under the starry sky. This race is part of the RunCzech running series and attracts thousands of runners every year.
course_highlights: Night run through illuminated Prague streets
Start at dusk with a magical atmosphere
10 km course in the center of Prague
additional: The race is open to individuals and team runs (women, men, mixed teams). A mobile app from RunCzech provides all information about the race, accompanying program, and virtual package. The 2026 edition will be the 29th race with up to 8,500 participants. The race takes place on September 5, 2026, starting at 19:30, with a length of 10 km, team running options, refreshments along the route, medical support, online results, and diplomas.

name: adidas Běh pro ženy 5 km Praha
description: Come run at the adidas Women’s Run 5 km in Prague, the largest race created specifically for women. The 5 km course is suitable even for runners without prior training, with a time limit of 50 minutes. Enjoy the unique atmosphere and support of thousands of women at this exclusive race without men on the track. Register with your friends and experience the joy of running and solidarity together.
course_highlights: 5 km course in the center of Prague
50-minute limit suitable for beginners
Exclusive race only for women
additional: The race is exclusively for women; men are not on the track. The start number can be picked up at the pre-race EXPO, with the option to authorize another person to collect it. A mobile app, RunCzech, provides information about the race and accompanying program. The race is suitable for beginners, with team participation options, registration via the website, and a virtual version of the event.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - září
description: The 2-mile run in Prague's Stromovka is an open race covering 3.2 km, suitable for all age groups and skill levels, including children up to 12 years old running 1.6 km. The race is ideal for those who run for fun, want to improve their personal best, or simply enjoy a pleasant run in the beautiful park environment. After the race, each participant is greeted with a warm cinnamon pancake. The time is measured for everyone, and results are published online, counting towards the annual Pancake Cup.
course_highlights: The course runs on asphalt paths in Stromovka Park
Adults run 2 laps (2 miles, 3.2 km), children run 1 lap (1 mile + 70 m)
Beautiful surroundings of Královská obora - Stromovka Park
additional: Registration takes place at the Brussels Gate area from 8:15 to 8:45, with the option of prior online registration for faster check-in. Recommended arrival by bike, on foot, rollerblades, or tram (stop Výstaviště). Parking is available at the bridge to Císařský Island on Za elektrárnou street. There are tents for changing clothes and storing belongings (unattended), a mobile valuables storage, and portable toilet cabins. Categories are divided by age and gender, time is measured for each runner, and results are published online. The race is on a road course, 3.2 km, run without bib numbers, voluntary registration, start at 9:07, registration from 8:15 to 8:45, parking at the bridge to Císařský Island, refreshments at the finish line, categories for adults and children, open to all age groups.

name: Barokomaraton
description: Barokomaraton is the 19th edition of a cross country run held in the picturesque environment of the town of Plasy and the valley of the Střela River. The race is suitable for both experienced runners and those who run for fun and want to enjoy the beautiful autumn nature. Participants can expect courses passing through forest and field paths with regular refreshment stations. The organizers also prepare a cultural program, entertainment for children, and refreshments, making the Barokomaraton a pleasant day full of sport and relaxation for the whole family.
course_highlights: Forest and field paths in the Střela River valley
Regular refreshment stations with water, isotonic drinks, and fruit
Start and finish at the Velká Louka area in Plasy
additional: Registration of competitors takes place at the Velká Louka area in Plasy on September 4th from 18:00 to 20:30 (ultra until 23:30) and on September 5th from 7:30 to 9:20. The time limit is 6 hours for the marathon and 16 hours for the ultra 100 km. Dogs are not allowed to run (canicross). It is recommended to use your own foldable cup at refreshment stations; a limited number of cups are available for purchase on site. There is an option for team relay for groups of three runners on the 10 km, half marathon, and marathon courses. The races include various distances, including ultra 100 km, and are suitable for runners of all levels. The event also offers cultural and accompanying activities, including an expo and entertainment for children.

name: Strážný nahoru a dolů
location: Dolní Dobrouč, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: Strážný nahoru a dolů is part of the ISCAREX Cup, a traditional series of running races in the Pardubice Region. The race offers a challenging uphill and downhill run in the picturesque environment of Dolní Dobrouč. Organizers ensure a quality sporting atmosphere and facilities for all participants. The event is suitable for experienced runners and hobby athletes who want to try running in hilly terrain.
course_highlights: Uphill and downhill run in the terrain of Dolní Dobrouč
Technically interesting profile with elevation gain
Picturesque natural environment of the Pardubice Region
additional: The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup 2025 series, registration from 8:00, start at 10:00, the race takes place in nature on hilly terrain, finish station at the top of Strážný.

name: Lupenická dvanáctka
description: Lupenická Twelve is a traditional running race in Lupenice, held for the 33rd time. The race offers a 12 km course with an elevation gain of 98 meters, entirely on asphalt and well marked. The start is at the Lupenice sports complex, and the race is part of the Great Prize of Eastern Bohemia. Each participant runs at their own risk, and those under 18 must provide parental consent.
course_highlights: 12 km course with an elevation gain of 98 m
100% asphalt surface
Marked route in the Lupenice sports complex
additional: Registration takes place on-site from 8:00 to 10:00 at a price of 250 CZK. The registration fee includes a start number, refreshments along the course and at the finish, and facilities at the start and finish area. The registration fee is non-refundable in case of absence. On-site registration is also possible, with the start at 10:30. The event is open to the general public, including families with children.

name: Jenštejnská pětka
location: Jenštejn, Jenštejn, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Jenštejnská pětka is an annual 5 km running race held in the village of Jenštejn since 2014. In addition to the main race, other running categories are organized, allowing participation from a wide range of runners. The event is a traditional sports gathering in the Central Bohemian Region and offers an opportunity for sporting activity in the picturesque environment of Jenštejn.
course_highlights: Race over 5 km in the village of Jenštejn
Various running categories for all age groups
Traditional annual event since 2014
additional: The race takes place on September 5, 2026, and is part of the local sports calendar, offering different categories and being popular among locals and visitors.

name: Zbraslavská Závist
location: Nádraží v Praze-Zbraslavi, Praha-Zbraslav, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Zbraslavská Závist is a trail uphill run that starts in Prague-Zbraslav near the former mini zoo and leads to the former Celtic hillfort at the top of Závist. The course is 3.5 km long with an elevation gain of 190 meters, offering a challenging and interesting running experience. The race is suitable for athletes who are prepared for a brisk start and a demanding ascent. Organized by the KOPEC association, under the auspices of the Czech Athletic Federation, it is part of the traditional running calendar in Prague.
course_highlights: Trail uphill run with an elevation gain of 190 meters
Start near the former mini zoo in Prague-Zbraslav
Finish at the former Celtic hillfort at the top of Závist
additional: The race is recommended for athletes in good condition who can handle the demanding climb. The course begins flat, then starts ascending up to the lookout tower. The organizer is KOPEC, z.s., Petr Schovánek. The course length is 3.5 km with an elevation gain of 190 m, starting at the station in Prague-Zbraslav. The race offers beautiful views from the top of Hradiště Závist. Registration is possible online or on-site. The race is open to all age categories.

name: Marathon Chopok
description: The Chopok Marathon is a challenging mountain run in the beautiful environment of the Low Tatras, testing your abilities on various surfaces and terrains. The race takes place on September 5, 2026, starting at 7:00 from Srdiečko and finishing at Chopok at an altitude of 2004 meters above sea level. There are two main routes available: the SkyMarathon Chopok with a length of 43 km and an elevation gain of 2600 meters, and the shorter Sky Race Jasná Trail with a length of 21 km and an elevation gain of 1400 meters. On the longer route, there is also an option to participate in relay teams. The course runs along both the southern and northern sides of Chopok, including the main ridge, offering beautiful views and diverse terrain.
course_highlights: 43 km course with 2600 m elevation gain across the Low Tatras on both the southern and northern sides of Chopok
Crossing the main ridge with diverse surfaces requiring appropriate footwear
Finish at Chopok at an altitude of 2004 m above sea level with the possibility of quick access by cable car
additional: Option to start in relay teams on the long route with 4 or fewer members in segments of approximately 10-11 km. The race is included in the Slovak Skyrunning Association calendar for 2026. The courses are the same as in previous years, allowing performance comparisons. Spectators can watch the runners at various points along the course. Trail race with relay team options, start at 07:00 and 10:00, part of the Slovak Skyrunning Association calendar, the course runs from Srdiečko to Chopok and back.

name: Kokava Trail
location: Kokava nad Rimavicou, Banská Bystrica, Slovakia
description: Kokava Trail is a certified trail run starting and finishing in Kokava nad Rimavicou, which takes a loop through the Veporské vrchy and Stolické vrchy mountain ranges. The race is held on two routes - the main route is 78 km long with an elevation gain of +3330 m and a time limit of 18 hours, while the shorter Pasiečky Trail is 23 km with +1200 m elevation gain and a 7-hour limit. The course is diverse, with 45% meadow sections, 45% forest trails, and 10% asphalt, without difficult technical passages but including several steeper descents and ascents. Participants will appreciate six refreshment stations and mandatory equipment, which includes an insulating foil, headlamp, mobile phone with a charged SIM card, GPS device, reflective vest, and sufficient fluids. Winners in the categories Men, Women, Men 50+, and Women 50+ will receive medals and material prizes during the awards ceremony at the cultural house.
course_highlights: Diverse surface: 45% meadow, 45% forest, 10% asphalt
Elevation gain of +3330 m on the 78 km main route
6 refreshment stations along the course
additional: Mandatory equipment includes an insulating foil, headlamp with new batteries, a charged mobile phone with an active SIM card, a GPS device with the race route (power bank required for mobile navigation), reflective vest or bands, at least 1.5 liters of fluids, your own cup or bottle with a wide mouth, proof of identity, and a visible starting number. The top three in categories Men, Women, Men 50+, and Women 50+ will be awarded. The course does not contain difficult technical sections but includes several steeper descents and ascents. There are 6 refreshment stations on the route. Two routes: 78 km and 23 km, mandatory equipment, certified course, mountain terrain, online registration, part of the Slovak Ultratrail League.

name: Prešov Running Series 3. kolo
description: Prešov Running Series Round 3 is part of a series of running events in Prešov taking place throughout 2026. The event is suitable for all age groups and skill levels, from beginners to professionals. The courses are designed to foster community, promote a healthy lifestyle, and bring joy through movement. Included in the registration fee are a timing chip, medal, refreshments, and an accompanying program. Children who are members of the Prešov Running Team can run for free.
course_highlights: Courses for various skill levels from beginners to professionals
Event on Main Street in Prešov with a community atmosphere
Accompanying program and refreshments for all participants
additional: The registration fee includes a bib with a chip, timing, medal, refreshments, accompanying program, medical service, race organization, and photos. On-site registration is possible depending on capacity, but early online registration is recommended. It is advised to pick up the bib the day before at OC Novum. Children who are members of the Prešov Running Team can participate for free after paying the annual membership fee. The series includes three races at different locations in Prešov with themes of fantasy, history, and sport; registration is mandatory; maps, medals, and children's categories are available; a raffle is also part of the event.

name: 6 hodinovka pod Šarišským hradom
description: The 6-hour race under Šariš Castle is an endurance running event held in Veľký Šariš, Prešov district. The race is open to individuals and relay teams, with categories divided by age and gender. The registration fee is the same for all runners, and the event offers an opportunity to test your endurance in a six-hour run in a beautiful setting beneath the castle. The organizers are Gejza Sabanoš and Ondrej Fedor, who ensure the smooth running of the event.
course_highlights: The race takes place around the historic Šariš Castle with a beautiful view of the surrounding landscape
Opportunity to participate in various categories including relay races
A long, six-hour endurance challenge for runners of all levels
additional: The race includes various categories and relay options; the course is situated around the castle, but details about the terrain are not specified

name: Beh Novoveskou Hutou
location: Novoveská Huta, Spišská Nová Ves, Slovakia
organizer: Športový Klub ROHALS a Mesto Spišská Nová Ves

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: muži nad 60 a ženy nad 50 rokov - 3 €

price_tiers.distance: Dorast a beh pre zdravie 5 km

description: The Rohals Sports Club cordially invites you to the 16th edition of the Novoveská Hut Run, which will take place in Novoveská Hut. For adults, a new course measuring 12.2 km is prepared, leading to Vojtechova Samota and back, the same for women and men. For those who prefer shorter distances, a 5 km course is available. Children and young runners will compete on shorter routes in the streets of Hut according to age categories. After the run, participants can recharge with goulash, children can enjoy a puppet show, and adults will be entertained by the band 3násť ciest.
course_highlights: New course for adults leads to Vojtechova Samota (Šadroň) and back
The distance for adults is 12.2 km, uniform for women and men
Shorter routes for children in the streets of Novoveská Hut according to age categories
additional: Registration for youth is from 11:30 to 12:45, for juniors and adults until 14:45. Start is only possible in one category. After the run, goulash is provided, children can enjoy a puppet show, and adults will be entertained by the band 3násť ciest. In the adult categories, participants compete for points in the Spišská Nová Ves District Running League. The courses are 12.2 km and 5 km, with categories for different age groups, registration on the day of the event, and accompanying activities for children and adults.

name: Ozorovská dvanastka
description: Ozorovská dvanástka is a running race held in Malé Ozorovce, offering courses for children and adults. The race is organized by OZ Zorovčan in cooperation with the municipality of Veľké Ozorovce, and participants can compete on 6 km and 12 km courses with categories based on age and gender. The start for children is at 9:00 AM and for adults at 10:00 AM. The race is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere near the cultural house.
course_highlights: Course runs in Malé Ozorovce with parking in front of the cultural house
Two main courses: 12 km and 6 km with categories by age and gender
Children's start at 9:00 AM, adults at 10:00 AM
additional: The race categories include children's categories and age divisions for men and women on the 12 km course (Men A up to 39, B 40-49, C 50 and over; Women F up to 39, G 40-49, H) and a 6 km course for men and women. The event takes place on September 5, 2026, with starts at 9:00 AM and 10:00 AM. The course includes local roads, with registration available online or on-site.

name: Horský kros Gerlach
description: The Gerlach Mountain Cross is a traditional mountain uphill run that starts from the village of Gerlachov, passes through the Velická Valley, and ends at the Sliezsky Dom mountain hotel. The course is 8,400 meters long with an elevation gain of 879 meters, and runners traverse a rocky trail and sometimes an asphalt road. The event is suitable for runners who enjoy challenging mountain terrain and beautiful views of the High Tatras. The race also includes children's runs and the option to purchase an entry with original Gerlach Mountain Cross socks.
course_highlights: Course length of 8,400 meters with an elevation gain of 879 meters
Rocky trail and sometimes an asphalt road
Finish line at the Sliezsky Dom mountain hotel
additional: Maximum capacity of 200 runners. The time limit at Velický Bridge (5.7 km) is 1:30 hours. During the race, refreshments are provided on the course and at the finish line, with transportation of belongings to the finish, and food after the race. Children's races (100-500 meters) are not scored; each child receives a medal and a sweet treat. There is an option to purchase an entry with HKG socks for €7. The race takes place in mountain terrain, registration is possible at the municipal office, and children's races are included.

name: Beh za Tatry
organizer: Barbora a Slavomír Ogurčákovci v spolupráci s občianskym združením Žiť Tatry

tiers.label: tier_1

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 6,50 € – pri kúpe samostatne registrované od 15.3. do 30.6.2025
