description: The Tatry Run is a running event held in the picturesque environment of Štrbské Pleso in the High Tatras, beneath the Tatras Tower observation tower. The race offers a start for children at 2:00 PM and for adults at 4:00 PM, with the course running on natural terrain along the lake's shoreline and cross-country ski trails. Categories are divided by age and gender, allowing broad participation of runners from various age groups. The organizers are Barbora and Slavomír Ogurčákovci in collaboration with the civic association Žiť Tatry, ensuring a pleasant atmosphere and quality organization.
course_highlights: Natural surface along the shore of Štrbské Pleso lake
Cross-country ski trails of Štrbské Pleso
Picturesque environment of the High Tatras under Tatras Tower
additional: Children start at 2:00 PM, adults at 4:00 PM. Categories divided by age and gender. Organized by Barbora and Slavomír Ogurčákovci in cooperation with the civic association Žiť Tatry. The course surface is natural, running around the lake and along cross-country ski trails. Registration from March 15, 2025, to September 4, 2025; categories for different age groups.

name: Veľatský lesný beh
description: The Veľatský Forest Run is a traditional running event organized by the civic association OZ Stopa in the village of Veľaty. The race takes place at the FK Veľaty sports field and offers courses of various lengths for men and women aged 15 and above, with children's runs held directly on the football pitch. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, voluntary registration as a donation, and provided refreshments. Throughout the day, volunteers accompany the runners, and results are measured with timing systems, followed by the announcement of winners and distribution of material prizes.
course_highlights: Courses in the forest environment of Veľaty village with lengths of 6 km, 11 km, and 16 km
Children's runs on the FK Veľaty football pitch
Changing rooms, showers, and toilets directly at the start location
additional: Registration is possible online until September 4, 2024, after which on-site registration is available until 9:30 AM. The start fee is voluntary and in the form of a donation to OZ Stopa. After the last runner finishes, results are announced and prizes are awarded. Parking is secured in designated parking lots with guidance from organizers. The race is conducted according to athletics rules, with participants running at their own risk. Children run immediately after the start of the main disciplines. The course includes forest, asphalt, and gravel sections; the event is open to all age categories; registration can be done online or on-site; the event includes refreshments and commemorative items.

name: 14 Tyski Półmaraton
location: Stadion Lekkoatletyczny w Tychach, Tychy, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 14th Tyski Half Marathon is a race over the half marathon distance (21.0975 km) certified by PZLA, taking place on the streets of Tychy and around Lake Paprocańskie. The start, finish, and race village are located at the Athletics Stadium in Tychy. The event promotes an active lifestyle and a sporting atmosphere of the city, offering numerous accompanying attractions such as children's races, massages, and sports demonstrations. The course was modified in 2022 to reduce the number of inclines, making it more participant-friendly. The race is held under the honorary patronage of the Mayor of Tychy and has been increasingly popular since 2012.
course_highlights: Street course around Lake Paprocańskie (asphalt, cobblestone, paved path)
Signage every 1 km with vertical markers
Finish at the Athletics Stadium in Tychy
additional: The time limit to complete the race is 3 hours. Electronic timing with a chip in the start number, net classification. Water stations are located along the route. The race office and packet pickup are on September 4-5, 2026 at Gemini Park Tychy and on race day from 6:30 to 8:30 at the stadium. The race packet includes a chip bib, technical T-shirt (if paid before August 2), medal, warm meal after the race, drinks, medical support, and route security. Children's races take place before and after the main race. The event will be held in an urban area, with race offices at Gemini Park Tychy and the Athletics Stadium. The program also includes races for the youngest participants.

name: 26 Eco Półmaraton Wałbrzych
description: The 26th edition of the Toyota Eco Wałbrzych Half Marathon is one of the most important running events in the region and in the country, attracting runners from all over Poland. Following last year's organizational success and record attendance, the event once again confirms its strong position on Poland's sports map. The half marathon route has been highly rated by participants, and the unique atmosphere created by Wałbrzych supporters adds a distinctive character to the event. We warmly invite both participants and spectators.
course_highlights: New, well-rated half marathon route
Unique atmosphere thanks to Wałbrzych supporters
An event with an established position on Poland's sports map
additional: On August 24, 2025, there will be traffic disruptions and special transportation for participants and spectators. Racebook – a practical guide with essential information before the start – is available. In addition to the half marathon, accompanying races and events for juniors are organized. Registration opens on January 27, 2026; the event includes the half marathon, 10 km races, and children's races; participants can choose from various start packages and enjoy attractions at the Old Mine.

name: 44 Międzynarodowy Otwarty Bieg Przełajowy o Puchar Leśny pamięci Tomasza Hopfera
description: We invite you to the 44th International Open Cross Country Race for the Leśny Cup in memory of Tomasz Hopfer, which will take place on September 6, 2026, in Obliwice. The main race course is 6.4 km long and consists of two loops of 3.2 km each, with the start and finish at the same location. The event has a unique sporting atmosphere, combining competition with recreation for entire families in a natural setting. The race commemorates Tomasz Hopfer, a legend of Polish sports journalism and an athlete, and also promotes a healthy lifestyle and physical activity within the local community.
course_highlights: Main race course: two loops of 3.2 km
Start and finish at the same point
Eco-forest surroundings of the course in Obliwice
additional: Program for September 6, 2026: from 11:00 am ceremonial opening, children's and youth races over 600 m and 1.609 km, at 1:20 pm the main 6.4 km race starts, at 2:00 pm the race of village heads and VIPs, at 5:00 pm the International Mile in memory of Piotr Gładki, and at 5:30 pm the Ecological Feast. Approximately 300 competitors will participate in the main race. The top finishers qualify for the International Mile. Forest terrain, online registration, accompanying events, sports memorial.

name: 64 Bieg Westerplatte
description: The 64th Westerplatte Run is the oldest continuously organized street race in Poland, covering a distance of 10 kilometers, held in Gdańsk. The race starts at a historic site where World War II began, giving the event a unique character and an atmosphere of reflection on sacrifice and peace. The route is certified and marked every kilometer, and the finish line is at the Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, which adds an extra attraction for participants. The event attracts up to 5,000 runners and is both a sporting challenge and a tribute to the Coast Defenders of 1939.
course_highlights: Certified route marked every 1 km
Opportunity to run through the Tunnel under the Dead Vistula, closed to pedestrian traffic on regular days
Finish at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk - a modern football facility
additional: Number pickup at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk on September 6-7, 2026. Water refreshment point approximately at 6 km on the route. Participant limit is 5000 people. Free buses transport competitors to the start on race day. Deposit for belongings with a start number sticker. No showers available. Award ceremony around 11:45 at the finish line. Cash prizes and trophies for winners in the OPEN classification and age categories. Registration from March 2, 2026, to August 20, 2026, with a limit of 4900 participants, and the option to purchase official T-shirts at the Expo. The event includes package pickup, expo, transportation, start, and awards at Westerplatte.

name: Bieg KoBBiet
location: Stadion Miejski, Bielsko-Biała, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The KoBBiet Run is an annual race organized in Bielsko-Biała, which will take place in 2026 on September 6th at the Municipal Stadium. The event is dedicated to the memory of Ewa Szymanek-Płaska, head of the Department of Education and Sports at the City Hall in Bielsko-Biała. This year's edition of the run supports children on the autism spectrum, and registration will open on April 10, 2026, at 10:00 AM. The race is under the honorary patronage of the President of Bielsko-Biała, Jarosław Klimaszewski.
course_highlights: The route runs through the streets of the center of Bielsko-Biała
Start at the Municipal Stadium, finish at the Polish Army Square
5 km distance with attractions at the finish line
additional: The event supports children on the autism spectrum, registration is available at datasport.pl, the race is dedicated to women, commemorative medals and attractions await at the finish line.

name: Szybka Piątka Sokoła
description: Szybka Piątka Sokoła is a 5 km race held in Bukownica, Mazowieckie. It is an excellent opportunity for runners of various skill levels to test their form on an easy, asphalt course. Organizers encourage preparation with the help of training plans tailored to individual levels, offering expert support. The event is friendly and motivating, ideal for those looking to improve their fitness and enjoy running.
course_highlights: Course length of 5 km
Easy, asphalt surface
Picturesque surroundings of Bukownica
additional: Training plans available from 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to the runner's VDOT level with instructions and expert support. Training preparations are available for participants, and the event promotes activity and a healthy lifestyle within the local community.

name: XIV Panewnicki Bieg Dzika (9)
organizer: AWF Katowice, KS AZS AWF Katowice

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: dzieci i młodzież do lat 18 – w wysokości 20 zł przelewem na konto

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: pozostałe osoby – w wysokości 45 zł przelewem na konto

tiers.label: tier_5
tiers.description: małżeństwa – w wysokości 80 zł przelewem na konto

description: Panewnicki Bieg Dzika is a recreational running and Nordic Walking event held in the picturesque forests of Panewniki in Katowice. The race aims to promote an active and healthy lifestyle as well as the charms of the local nature. The course is a loop approximately 4.9 km long, which can be completed up to four times, with a time limit of 3 hours. The event is open to amateurs and athletes affiliated with sports clubs, and participants can expect education on proper forest behavior.
course_highlights: Forest course in Panewniki approximately 4.9 km long
Loop marked every 1 km
Ability to complete the course up to 4 times
additional: The time limit for completing the race and Nordic Walking is 3 hours. Participants can purchase a package of entries for the entire year 2026. Individuals born in 1950 or earlier are exempt from the start fee. Entry fees are non-refundable but can be transferred to a future start after notifying the organizer. The event includes training preparations and information on training plans, making it attractive for runners at various levels of experience.

name: XVIII Bieg Koguta
description: The XVIII Rooster Run is a 10 km race organized in Oława, scheduled for September 6, 2026. The event is organized by the Oława Running Group in cooperation with local institutions, and participants can expect professional timing services. The race office will be open both the day before the race and on the race day, facilitating the collection of race packs. The race is open and friendly to runners of all levels of experience.
course_highlights: 10 km distance in the picturesque scenery of Oława
Professional electronic timing measurement
Support from local institutions and partners, including the Municipal Pools "Termy Jakuba"
additional: Race office open on September 5 from 16:00 to 20:00 and on September 6 from 07:00 to 09:15. Acceptance of the regulations and consents related to personal data processing is required. It is possible for a third party to collect the race pack after giving the appropriate consent. The race office is located the day before the race, online registration is available, and the participant limit is 891.

name: Běh s Klokanem
description: The Kangaroo Run is a traditional cross-country race in Olomouc-Hejčín, held annually at the end of September. The race is designed for children, youth, and adult athletes, and is part of the Olomouc Region Children's and Youth Running Cup and the Olomouc Region Endurance Runners Grand Prix. Men run 9 km, women 7 km, and shorter distances are available for children according to age categories. The event is not only sporting but also social, with accompanying activities for children and parents, including games, scooter rides, puzzles, and a raffle. Registration takes place at the U Travise Inn by the Mill Stream.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in terrain by the Mill Stream in Olomouc-Hejčín
Men run 9 km, women 7 km, children have courses from 60 m to 1.5 km depending on age
Part of the Olomouc Region Children's and Youth Running Cup and the Olomouc Region Endurance Runners Grand Prix
additional: Registration takes place at the U Travise Inn. The accompanying program includes scooter rides, sack jumping, puzzles, horse riding, a photo booth with a kangaroo, an educational trail about kangaroos, a performance by the band 3+1, and a raffle with valuable prizes. All children at the finish line receive sweets. Cross-country terrain, registration at the U Travise Inn, family event.

name: Ostrava City Marathon
location: Masarykovo náměstí, Ostrava, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
price_range: 600-1500 Kč podle druhu závodu a data registrace
description: The Ostrava City Marathon is the oldest marathon in the Czech Republic and a summer running festival full of fun for all runners. It takes place on September 6, 2026, in the center of Ostrava at Masaryk Square and offers courses for various performance levels including a mini-marathon, 10 km, half marathon, and marathon. The event is suitable for both competitive runners and hobbyists, and includes a charitable MiniMarathon. In addition to the races, a rich accompanying program is prepared to enliven the city center with sport and culture.
course_highlights: The course passes through historic, industrial, and green parts of Ostrava
Refreshment stations are located approximately every 5 km with water, isotonic drinks, and food
Start and finish are at Masaryk Square in the center of Ostrava
additional: Registration for competitors takes place on Saturday, September 5, 2026, from 14:00 to 19:00 and on Sunday, September 6, 2026, from 6:30 to 8:00 at the Ostrava University City Campus. The race time is measured with chip technology embedded in the non-refundable race bibs. Mobile toilets and baggage storage are available at Masaryk Square. Showers and changing rooms are available in the City Campus building. Refreshments are available approximately every 5 km and at the finish line. The start and finish are at Masaryk Square in the center of Ostrava. Men over 70 and women over 60 can register for free for the marathon after obtaining a registration code via email at info@ostravacitymarathon.cz. On-site registration is also possible. The event offers refreshments, showers, medals, and other equipment for participants.

name: Podčerchovský kros
location: Chodov u Domažlic, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Podčerchovský cross country is a demanding cross-country run held on Babí Hora near Chodov, which takes place on forest paths with several challenging ascents. The longest loop measures 2.5 km and is suitable for runners using spikes. The race is open to all age categories and offers various distances from children's categories to the main men's race. Results are announced shortly after the race, and winners receive medals, material prizes, and in the main category, monetary rewards.
course_highlights: The course runs on forest paths
The longest loop is 2.5 km with several demanding ascents
Option to use spikes
additional: Results for all categories are announced at 12:30. Categories have different distances: 1100 m (2x550 m), 4000 m (2x2000 m), 5000 m (2x2500 m), 7500 m (3x2500 m). Monetary rewards are paid in the main men's category and overall women's ranking according to the organizer's possibilities. The race offers pre-registration and on-site registration options, with over 100 runners participating, including children and youth, and is part of the Běžec Chodska series.

name: Běh na Lahti
description: We invite you to the 47th edition of the traditional running race Lahti Run, which takes place on September 6, 2026, in Děčín. The race offers two courses - the main route nearly 10 km long with an elevation gain of 230 meters, leading over the Kvádberk lookout to the village of Ludvíkovice, and a shortened route of just under 5 km with an elevation gain of 130 meters. The trail runs through the terrain in the Děčín forests above the sandstone canyon of the Elbe River, ensuring beautiful views and a challenging run. Registration and check-in are on-site at the start from 8:00 to 9:45 AM, with the race starting at 9:00.
course_highlights: Terrain trail in the Děčín forests above the sandstone canyon of the Elbe River
Main course 9.8 km with a 230 m elevation gain, start at Kvádberk lookout
Shortened course 4.9 km with a 130 m elevation gain, turnaround at the cemetery in Ludvíkovice
additional: Registration and check-in on-site at the start (Kvádberk lookout) from 8:00 to 9:45. Children's races range from 100 to 1000 meters depending on the category. The main course is a loop with a turnaround after 5 km, the shortened course has a turnaround after 2.5 km. Online registration is available as well as on-site. Course maps and GPX files are available on the race website. The race takes place above the sandstone canyon and offers various distances suitable for the general public.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - září
description: The 2-Mile Run Olomouc is an open race over 2 miles (3.2 km) designed for all age groups and running levels, from beginners to experienced runners. The race takes place in the picturesque environment of Smetanovy Sady in Olomouc, where everyone can enjoy running for fun and compete primarily with themselves. It also includes a trophy competition, where results are adjusted according to age coefficient and points are accumulated throughout the year. Registration takes place on the race day from 9:30 to 10:00 AM, and winners are announced in each category.
course_highlights: Course length of 2 miles (3.2 km) in Smetanovy Sady in Olomouc
Race suitable for all age groups and running levels
Scenic environment near the fountain in the park, except for June and August races near the river
additional: Registration takes place on the race day from 9:30 to 10:00 AM. The top three places are announced in each category. The race is part of an annual trophy competition with results adjusted according to age coefficient and points accumulated for participation in multiple races. The race is held on asphalt paths in Smetanovy Sady, registration is voluntary and takes place from 9:30 to 10:00 AM. The event focuses on the joy of movement and supporting the sporting spirit.

name: Rychnov pomáhá během
location: Rychnov nad Kněžnou, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Rychnov helps during the charity running race organized in Rychnov nad Kněžnou, which offers routes for children and adults in various age categories. The race takes place at the beginning of September and is known for its friendly atmosphere, accompanying program, and support for those in need. Each participant receives a start package and a medal, and the top runners in each category receive valuable prizes. The event also features an autograph session and a fun quiz for prizes, contributing to family comfort and community spirit.
course_highlights: Routes for children from 400 m to 10 km for adults
Start and finish at Poláčkovo Square in Rychnov nad Kněžnou
Option to watch children during the race
additional: The accompanying program includes free taping and physiotherapy for runners, Spartan obstacles for children, a bouncy castle, creative workshops, face painting, InBody body diagnostics, and a photo booth. Refreshments offer sweet and savory snacks, lemonade, coffee, beer, and grilled specialties. There is a storage, changing rooms, and toilets available. The event supports charitable causes, includes online and on-site registration, and is complemented by photo galleries and support for female athletes.

name: Běh mezi mosty
description: Run between the bridges is a charitable sporting event organized by Domácí hospic Athelas and the Friends of the Stone Bridge Písek Association. This run, which revives the tradition of the original race, is intended for everyone who wants to support seriously ill patients and their families. Participants can run, walk, or make a symbolic contribution, with the entry fee being a donation that helps ensure home care for those who can no longer run. The event takes place in Písek and offers various routes including children's runs and family walks.
course_highlights: Routes lead on concrete, asphalt, cobblestones, bridges, and forest terrain
The profile of the tracks is mostly flat with a hilly elevation of 144 m
The race takes place around the Stone Bridge in Písek with safety measures and volunteer support
additional: Registration is possible electronically and on-site on the race day at the Stone Bridge. Starting numbers and chips are issued from 11:00. The program begins at 12:00, warm-up for children at 13:00. Children's runs start at 13:15, main runs from 14:00 to 15:30. Routes are marked with white arrows, there is a pacer and volunteers on the track. Parking, facilities, and refreshments are provided. After the race, results are announced and a raffle takes place. Terrain includes concrete, asphalt, cobblestones, bridges, and forest; T-shirts are available for purchase on-site; various age categories and distances are available.

name: Jihlavský půlmaraton

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 500 Kč na osobu při elektronickém přihlášení a bezhotovostní platbě

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 600 Kč při osobním přihlášení na místě závodu

description: Jihlava Half Marathon is a traditional running race over 21.0975 km, held on two loops in the center of Jihlava. The race is open to individuals, pairs, and groups of four, offering an officially measured course with kilometer markers. The event also includes a Family Run and children's races, supporting a charitable project for Filípek. The event takes place at the Český mlýn complex and offers quality facilities, chip timing, and refreshments for runners.
course_highlights: Officially measured course of 21.0975 km on two loops
Course marked every kilometer
Start and finish at the Sport and Relaxation Center Český mlýn in Jihlava
additional: Start number includes a chip for timing measurement, which is not returned. The time limit for the half marathon is 3 hours; the course will be closed at 15:00. You can order a T-shirt during online registration for 250 CZK, on-site for 300 CZK until supplies last. The race also features relay teams of two and four, a Family Run (1.1 km), and children's races. Race registration opens on race day from 8:00 to 10:30 at the Český mlýn complex. The race takes place on two loops, starting in the center of Jihlava, with online or on-site registration available. The time limit is 3 hours. The race day is September 6, 2026.

name: Běžíme pro náhradní rodiny
description: Running for Foster Families is an event organized by CPNRP, o.p.s., which supports children growing up in foster care and their foster parents. The event aims to raise awareness about the needs of these children and promote a stable and loving environment for their development. The run is an opportunity for the general public to express support and solidarity with foster families. The organization has long-term involvement in professional counseling, education, and support for foster and adoptive families.
course_highlights: Various route lengths including 4 km, 8 km, 1 km for strollers and walkers
Support for foster families and children in care through proceeds
Family activities, face painting, and accompanying program
additional: The event takes place on September 6, 2026, and is part of a broader charitable project to support children's care, with online registration and accompanying activities.

name: Horský čtvrtmaraton Jablonné nad Orlicí - Suchý vrch
location: Jablonné nad Orlicí, areál koupaliště, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: The Jablonné nad Orlicí - Suchý vrch Mountain Quarter Marathon is a mountain race taking place on September 6, 2026, in Jablonné nad Orlicí. The course runs through mountain terrain to Suchý vrch and is part of the Czech Cup in uphill running and the Krkonošský Cup in uphill running. The race offers approximately 10 km with an elevation gain of around 580 meters, with the course demanding endurance and running technique in mountain terrain. Registrations are possible on-site, and the race is intended for runners seeking a challenge in nature.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain environment at Suchý vrch
Elevation gain of approximately 580 meters over about 10 km
Part of the Czech Cup in uphill running
additional: The race starts at the swimming pool area in Jablonné nad Orlicí, the course runs through mixed terrain, registration is possible on-site, the start is at 10:30 AM, registration deadline is before the race begins.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 9. kolo
description: The 2-Mile Run Bratislava is a regular 2-mile running race organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team at the Kuchajda swimming pool area in Bratislava. The race is open to the general public, including children, juniors, women, men, and veterans, who are divided into categories. Registration takes place directly on-site at the volleyball court from 9:30 AM, with the start at 10:00 AM. The competition is part of a series of races where runners earn points towards the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team's Traveling Cup based on their performance and age.
course_highlights: Distance of the course 2 miles (3.218 km), children approximately 200 m
The course runs within the Kuchajda swimming pool area in Bratislava
Registration and start at the volleyball court
additional: Registration is on-site from 9:30 AM. The start is at 10:00 AM. Categories: children (13 years and under), juniors, women, men, veterans (women and men). Competition for the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team's Traveling Cup with scoring based on age coefficients and number of participations. In case of a tie, the best time and shoe size determine the winner. The race is part of a series held in Kuchajda, Bratislava, with on-site registration available. The race includes various categories such as children, juniors, adults, and veterans, and aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and community.

name: Dukelský beh mieru
description: Dukelský Peace Run is one of the oldest and most significant running events in Slovakia, held annually on the first Sunday of September. The course runs from Dukla to the center of Svidník and measures 19 kilometers with an elevation change from 479 meters above sea level at the start to 244 meters above sea level at the finish. Runners pass through a historic route associated with the Carpatho-Dukla Operation, commemorating the victims and the fight for peace in 1944-1945. The event has a rich history and strong emotional significance, attracting both competitive runners and amateurs.
course_highlights: Course length of 19 km from Dukla to Svidník
Start at an altitude of 479 m above sea level, finish at 244 m above sea level
Historic route connected with the Carpatho-Dukla Operation
additional: Registration for 2026 is still in preparation. The course is known for its historical significance and challenge for runners, passing through a route once traversed by soldiers during the Carpatho-Dukla Operation. The event also features accompanying race categories such as the Great Health Run and the Small Health Run. The course is approximately 19 km, starting at the Dukla Pass and ending in the pedestrian zone of Svidník. The event includes short runs and inline races, with online registration available until August 2025.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Srbsko
price_range: 240 Kč (voucher na 12 závodů), 316 Kč (voucher na 6 závodů)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 240 Kč (v rámci voucheru na celou sérii 12 závodů)

description: The Berounka Running Series in Srbko is a community trail race primarily along the Educational Trail Heart of the Czech Karst. The route starts at the station and passes through Srbecká Lávka, Bubovické Waterfalls, and the Kačák Valley along the Berounka River to the finish line. The race offers beautiful natural scenery, a friendly atmosphere, and the possibility of refreshments and baggage storage on site. Each participant receives a bib number, and the top three in each category earn diplomas.
course_highlights: The route follows the Educational Trail Heart of the Czech Karst marked in red and white
Overcoming ascent through Bubovické Waterfalls and Doutnáč Hill
Running through the Kačák Valley along the stream and the Berounka River
additional: Registration is possible online and on-site. Each participant receives a bib number. Please arrive no later than 17:45. Refreshments and baggage storage are available on site. The top three in each category will receive diplomas. The race is part of a series of 12 trail races held around the Berounka River from Radotín to Nižbor, with various distances and elevation gains. The start is mostly accessible by train, races feature water stations and category evaluations. The race takes place on September 7, 2026, in Srbko.

name: S kopečka do kopečka
description: The Run Uphill and Downhill is a traditional endurance race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, offering runners the opportunity to test their strength on a challenging course in Olomouc. The race is part of the Great Prize of the Runners of the Olomouc Region and is suitable for both recreational runners and competitors with ambitions. Liga stovkařů is known for its long-standing tradition and support of the running community in Central Moravia. The race is suitable for everyone who wants to experience running in a beautiful environment with the challenge of hilly terrain.
course_highlights: Challenging hilly terrain in Olomouc
Part of the Great Prize of the Runners of the Olomouc Region
Traditional endurance run with a long history
additional: Cross-country race over 7.8 km in Olomouc, taking place on September 9, 2026. The race is open to runners of all levels and offers the opportunity to participate in a friendly atmosphere with support from the local running community.

name: Okolo Lováku
description: Around Lovák is a running race in Šumperk, which is part of the Šumperk Winter Running League. The race course takes runners through picturesque scenery around Sklený vrch and Lovák, offering interesting terrain sections and opportunities for athletes of all levels. The race is popular among local runners and promotes an active lifestyle in the region. It is organized by the Šumperská sportovní project, which focuses on supporting sports and leisure activities in Šumperk and the surrounding area.
course_highlights: The route goes around Sklený vrch and Lovák
Interesting terrain with natural panoramas
Part of the Šumperk Winter Running League
additional: The race is part of the winter running league in Šumperk. The organizer is the Šumperská sportovní project, which supports sports and leisure activities in the region. Participants can look forward to an interesting course and a friendly atmosphere. The race is part of the winter running series, registration is possible online, the race includes timing and refreshments after the race.

name: Novostrašecký běh - Memoriál Vildy Šubrta
location: Nové Strašecí, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Novostrašecký Run - Memorial Vilda Šubrt is a traditional running race held in Nové Strašecí, offering a 6 km course. The race takes place at the SK Nové Strašecí football stadium and its surroundings, with a surface combining asphalt, field, and forest paths. The main category start is scheduled for 6:00 PM, and the race is suitable for the general public, with adults paying an entry fee of 100 CZK, while children participate for free. Online registration is available even on the day of the race, ensuring convenient access to participation.
course_highlights: The course runs on asphalt, field, and forest paths
Start and finish at SK Nové Strašecí football stadium
Mixed type race with a length of 6 km
additional: Online registration is possible on the day of the race. The event is organized by the town of Nové Strašecí, with Ivana Rezková as the contact person. Children participate for free. The race takes place at the football stadium and surrounding area, with online registration available. Suitable for the whole family.

name: Geofyzikální běh
location: Krčský les, Praha 4, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The Geophysics Run is a traditional running event organized by the Geophysical Institute of the Czech Academy of Sciences, held in the picturesque environment of Krč Forest in Prague 4. This run has a long history dating back to 1985 and offers a sporting experience in nature with a scientific background. The event is suitable for the general public and combines sports activity with the popularization of geophysics and natural sciences.
course_highlights: The route passes through the scenic Krč Forest in Prague 4
The run is part of a traditional event organized since 1985
Natural terrain suitable for recreational and competitive runners
additional: The event is organized by the Geophysical Institute of the Czech Academy of Sciences and is part of the institute's social activities. The run takes place regularly in September and is associated with the popularization of science and geophysics. The website also lists other activities of the institute, but specific information about registration and entry fees is not published. The race is held annually, attracting both scientists and members of the public, and is part of a broader series of runs in Prague.

name: 7. Běh pro zdraví
location: Park B. Němcové, Karviná, Czech Republic
description: Health Run is a charitable series of seven runs held in the beautiful surroundings of Božena Němcová Park in Karviná. Each run offers a 3 km route that anyone can run at their own pace. The proceeds from the entry fees are donated to help those in need, giving the race purpose and added value. The start is traditionally at 17:45 at Lodičky, with registration beginning at 17:00. Everyone is warmly invited to participate and support a good cause.
course_highlights: 3 km route in the beautiful environment of Božena Němcová Park
Surface: cycle path suitable for running
Charitable run with proceeds supporting those in need
additional: Registration begins at 17:00, start is at Lodičky. A series of seven runs where everyone can run at any pace. The proceeds from the entry fees go to help those in need. Track: cycle path; length: 3 km; registration from 17:00, race at 17:45; series of seven races throughout 2026.

name: Witzenmann Opavská míle

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Registrace do 25. 8. 2025 budou mít na startovním čísle jméno

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Registrace od 26. 8. do 3. 9. 2025, platba pouze kartou, na startovním čísle nebude jméno

description: Witzenmann Opavská míle is a prestigious one-mile running race (1609 meters) that continues the tradition of the Stanislav Mikeska memorial. The race is open to a wide range of participants including professionals, amateurs, children, families, corporate and school teams, disabled athletes, and wheelchair users. It takes place in Opava and is supported by the main partner Witzenmann Opava. The course record is held by Filip Sasínek with a time of 3:55 minutes from 2023. The race is held regularly and is one of the most significant running events in the Czech Republic.
course_highlights: Course exactly one mile long (1609 meters)
The race is an official middle-distance athletic discipline
Suitable for all age groups and various team types (corporate, family, school)
additional: Race categories include men and women in different age groups, children's categories, corporate, family, and school teams with conditions for composition and evaluation. Team registration allows adding members using the team name and PIN code. Payment can be made by card or bank transfer. The organizer reserves the right to make changes. The race will be held on September 4, 2025, with payment options via card or transfer, and is part of the TIPSPORT SPORTUJ S NÁMI 2025 series. Historical results and information about past editions are available on the official website.

name: Noční běh pro světlušku Liberec

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Cena startovného je 500 Kč. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do projektu Světluška na úhradu nákladů běhu. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do veřejné sbírky Světluška na přímou pomoc těžce zrakově postiženým.

description: Night Run for Svetluška in Liberec is a charity running event held on September 10, 2026, at the Vesec sports complex. Participants can choose between a 3 km course (1 lap) and a 6 km course (2 laps), with the run starting at 8:00 PM. The registration fee is 500 CZK, half of which goes to support the Svetluška project and the other half directly helps people with severe visual impairments. The event offers an accompanying program including a concert and starter packs with a headlamp or sports headband for those registered in time.
course_highlights: Night run at Vesec sports complex
Option to choose between 3 km and 6 km courses
Start at 20:00 with accompanying program and concert
additional: Registration counters are open from 18:00. Starter packs are available in two variants: with a headlamp or a sports headband. Holders of TP, ZTP, and ZTP/P cards with an escort can enter for free but do not receive a starter pack, which can be purchased on site for 250 CZK. Registration is via the GoOut.cz portal. An entry ticket with a unique code (printed or on mobile) is required for access to the area. The run starts at 20:00, registration from 18:00, free registration with ZTP and ZTP/P cards, proceeds support visually impaired individuals.

name: Běh Akátkami

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné je 150 Kč. Platba startovného probíhá před závodem při registraci závodníků.

description: The Acacia Run is a regular running race in Brno-Židenice, offering courses for men, women, and children. Men run 5.2 km (3 laps), women 3.6 km (2 laps), and children of any age have their own 1.6 km loop. The race takes place in the evening with registration from 17:15 and the main race starting at 18:00. After the race, refreshments are provided along with the possibility to store belongings. Participants run at their own risk and can use available city transportation and parking nearby.
course_highlights: 1.6 km loop in Brno-Židenice
Men run 3 laps (5.2 km), women 2 laps (3.6 km)
Children's race with loop length determined before the start
additional: Registration takes place on-site from 17:15. The children's race starts at 17:45, the main race for men and women together at 18:00. After the race, water and a storage tent are available. Transportation options include parking in adjacent streets and trolleybuses lines 25, 26, 27 (Pálavské náměstí stop). The start is scheduled for 18:00, and the race includes refreshments, water, and baggage storage. On-site registration is also possible.

name: Garmin Ultra Race Radków 2026
location: Radkowskie Lake, Radków, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
distance_verbose: 50 mil, Ultramaraton, Maraton, 24 km, Półmaraton, 10 km
description: Garmin Ultra Race Radków 2026 is a mountain trail run taking place in the picturesque surroundings of the Table Mountains, near Radkowskie Lake. The routes lead through rocky labyrinths, technical trails, and beautiful rock formations such as Szczeliniec Wielki and Błędne Skały. The event attracts both beginners and experienced ultramarathon runners, offering various distances and a unique atmosphere close to nature. Radków is an ideal place for a sporting adventure and relaxation amidst nature.
course_highlights: Spectacular trails of the Table Mountains with rock formations
Routes leading around Szczeliniec Wielki and Błędne Skały
Proximity to Radkowskie Lake as a place for recovery
additional: Ceremonies for awards are held after the completion of each distance. Starting packs are distributed at designated times before the start and during the event. Starts are staggered, with the longest distance beginning at 05:00, and shorter distances starting in subsequent hours. There are also Garmin Junior races for children in various age categories. Participants can enjoy the EXPO and have the option to track results online and download completion certificates. Trail running, multiple distances, registration details, scenic mountain terrain, event dates September 11-13, 2026.

name: Prajzské kilo
description: Prague Kilo is an ultratrail race in the Hlučínsko landscape that commemorates the historical borders and stories of the region divided in 1742. The race offers three routes of 30, 50, and 100 km with different time limits and elevation gains. You run through terrain full of old roads, chapels, and field tracks that bear traces of history and the identity of local residents. The race is scored within the Czech-Slovak Ultratrail Cup and also offers points for the UTMB index and ITRA. It features a unique medal, a T-shirt, refreshments on the route and at the finish line, and child supervision for shorter distances.
course_highlights: Routes of 30, 50, and 100 km with elevation gains of 270, 350, and 600 m
Running through the Hlučínsko landscape with historical monuments and chapels
7 refreshment stations on the 100 km route, GPS live tracking, and online monitoring
additional: The registration fee includes a unique metal finisher's medal, a commemorative magnet, a cotton T-shirt with the logo, a hot meal at the finish line (meat/vegetarian), refreshments on the route, GPS live tracking (100 km), child supervision for 30/50 km (registration required), online monitoring at control points (30/50 km), timing and scoring within the Czech-Slovak Ultratrail Cup with points for the UTMB index and ITRA. We are waiting for your time to set course records; race routes of 30 km, 50 km, 100 km; time limits of 6-24 hours; child supervision for 30/50 km; GPS live tracking; scoring for UTMB and ITRA points.

name: 10. PKO Bieg Charytatywny
description: The 10th PKO Charity Run is a nationwide initiative that combines sporting excitement with tangible support for an important social cause – mental health of children and youth. The event will take place on September 12, 2026, across Poland, encouraging participants to run together and act for the community. Every lap, kilometer, and minute on the route matters, emphasizing the idea of community and help. This anniversary edition invites runners to actively participate and support.
course_highlights: Multiple locations in Poland, including Gdańsk, Ruda Śląska, Łomża, Krosno, and Stalowa Wola
Virtual run option with an app
Relays and runs for children and adults for charitable purposes
additional: The event takes place across Poland, combining sports activity with a charitable goal for the mental health of children and youth. The PKO Charity Run is an initiative where not only the result matters but primarily collective action and social support. The event supports children's and youth's mental health, includes relay races and fundraising for therapies, and features participation in many Polish cities as well as virtual participation.

name: Bieg 7 Dolin
location: Piwniczna-Zdrój, Nowy Sącz County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 7 Valleys Run is a mountain ultramarathon covering a distance of 100 km, taking place in the picturesque Beskid Sądecki, with start and finish in Piwniczna-Zdrój. The route runs through challenging mountain trails with significant elevation gain, offering participants exceptional views and contact with nature. The event is part of the Running Festival, which combines sports competition with regional promotion and active lifestyle. The time limit to complete the course is 19 hours, and there are food and drop-off points along the route. This is a challenge for experienced mountain runners who want to face difficult but beautiful terrain.
course_highlights: Elevation +3740 m / -3740 m over 100 km
6 food points and 3 drop-off points along the route
The route runs through Beskid Sądecki trails with views of mountains and the Poprad valley
additional: The time limit to finish the race is 19 hours (until 9:00 PM). Intermediate cut-off times at checkpoints are: Rytro (36 km) - 7 hours (by 9:00 AM), Krynica (62 km) - 12 hours (by 2:00 PM), Wierchomla (89 km) - 17 hours (by 7:00 PM). Recommended technical equipment includes, among others, a reusable cup or bottle, a backpack or running belt, NRC foil, a headlamp, reflective elements, health insurance, a whistle, hand sanitizer, and an active phone with ICE number recorded on the back of the bib. The event features various distances, including 100 km, 42 km, 61 km, 23 km, and 11 km, with accompanying attractions such as festivals and expo. The race will take place in early September 2026.

name: 5 Aktywna Piątka
price_range: 100 zł w dniu zawodów, wcześniejsza rejestracja
description: The 5th edition of the "Active Five" race will take place on September 12, 2026, in Frydek, Miedźna Municipality. It is a fast street race on a course certified by the Polish Athletic Association (PZLA) with a length of exactly 5 km, starting at 11:00 AM. As part of the event, the Silesian Voivodeship Championships in the 5 km run will be held, with a participant limit of 600 people. Additionally, there is a Family Run for children and youth up to 15 years old on three distances.
course_highlights: Fast, PZLA-certified 5 km course
Asphalt route marked every 1 km
Watering points and water curtains along the route
additional: The main race participant limit is 600 people. In the OPEN classification, the top 5 women and men are awarded. The race starts at Modowa Street 189C. The accompanying Family Run is intended for children and youth up to 15 years old, with three distances: 800 m for ages 10-15 and shorter distances for younger age groups. Only registered main participants of the family run receive a commemorative medal. The limit of paid participants is 400. No participation with a dog, wheelchair, or stroller is allowed.

name: XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic
description: Grand Prix Truchtacza in Mysłowice is a series of races organized by the Truchtacz Mysłowice Association, promoting a healthy and active lifestyle as well as the integration of runners from different regions. The event is open to everyone, regardless of skill level and age, and participants can compete in running, Nordic walking, and canicross. The races take place on forest and urban routes, creating a friendly atmosphere of sporting competition and community. The Grand Prix is a tradition and passion that has united runners for many years.
course_highlights: Forest routes over Bolina
Various competitions: running, Nordic walking, canicross
Participants from many cities and sports clubs of Silesian Voivodeship and Lesser Poland
additional: Registrations for the Grand Prix series are only possible at the Race Office on the day of the race. Participation in the Grand Prix events is free of charge. The events are open to both runners and participants in Nordic walking and canicross. Athletes from different cities and sports clubs take part, with women accounting for over 27%. The event includes various distances and seasonal competitions, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity within the local community.

name: Okolo Kolovrat
description: The Okolo Kolovrat Run is a traditional race that takes you through the beautiful surroundings of Kolovrat, including neighboring villages of Uhříněves, Lipany, and part of Říčany. It offers routes of 11 km and 21 km, with the shorter course also available as a two-person relay. The courses mainly run along field, meadow, and forest paths lined with trees, ensuring wonderful running experiences in nature. The race is suitable for all runners who want to improve their time or set a personal course record.
course_highlights: Routes run along the walking circuits around Kolovrat with a short passage into neighboring villages
Mostly field, meadow, and forest paths and trails lined with trees
On the main route, the course crosses the border of Prague into Říčany at the 50th parallel
additional: Option to run the shorter course as a two-person relay. The race takes place in all weather conditions. Detailed regulations are available in the attached PDF and on the race website https://ok.nasekolovraty.cz. Trail running, distances 11 km and 21 km, relay options, beautiful natural scenery, event scheduled for September 2026, supporting the local community and refreshments at the start and finish area.

name: Přeloučská desítka
description: Přeloučská desítka is a running race held in Přelouč, offering courses of 10 km, 5 km, and a children's race of 1 km. The race takes place on asphalt roads, cobblestones, and paths with minimal elevation gain. The start and finish are at Masaryk Square. The event is suitable for all age groups and promotes running as a social phenomenon. After the race, refreshments are provided, and results are sent via SMS.
course_highlights: Course without significant elevation gain
Surface: 60% asphalt, 40% cobblestones and paths
Start and finish at Masaryk Square in Přelouč
additional: Refreshment stations on the course and at the finish line. SMS with the finishing time after the race. On-site registration will not be available. Option to purchase a functional Přeloučská 10 T-shirt for 490 CZK. Prizes for the top three men and women in the form of trophies and material prizes. Races of 5 km, 10 km, children's race of 1 km, registration only online, start and finish at Masaryk Square in Přelouč. The event supports patients with butterfly wing disease (DEBRA ČR).

name: ČEZ RunTour Brno
location: Brněnská přehrada, Brno, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
distance_verbose: Maraton, Půlmaraton, 10 km, 5 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
price_range: 500 Kč - 200 Kč (dle tratě a data registrace)
description: The CEZ RunTour Brno is a family running race held near Brno Dam, offering courses for all age groups from children to experienced runners. Participants can choose from distances of 500 m, 1 km, 3 km, 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon (21.1 km). The race is known for its friendly atmosphere, quality facilities, and accompanying program for the whole family. Each participant receives a start package and contributes to charity. CEZ RunTour is an ideal opportunity for hobby runners and elite athletes who want to experience the joy of running in the beautiful surroundings of Brno Dam.
course_highlights: Courses run around Brno Dam with unique views
Children's runs of 500 m and 1000 m with a kids' corner and supervision
Refreshment stations on the half marathon and longer distances
additional: The race includes a start package, guiding and medical teams, a special rescue service hotline during the race, refreshments at the finish and on the course, an official gymsack with gifts from partners, a kids' corner with supervision, and an accompanying program for the whole family including warm-ups and entertainment in the kids' zone. More courses, charitable contributions, medal engraving options, online and on-site registration, facilities near Brno Dam.

name: Běh na Boží horu
location: Ivančice, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Boží Hora Run is a traditional race in Ivančice, presenting a challenge in the form of running up 109 steps to Boží Hora. Participants start individually at one-minute intervals, ensuring a smooth race flow. The event is part of a rich program of activities organized by the Ivančice Leisure Center, which has a long-standing tradition and support from the town. The race is suitable for the general public and offers a unique sporting experience in an attractive environment.
course_highlights: Run up 109 Ivančice steps
Individual starts at one-minute intervals
Traditional event with a long history in Ivančice
additional: Participants start individually at 1-minute intervals. Regulations for download are available in the event section on the website. The race is open to all age groups, with options to download regulations and register online. The event takes place regularly and is part of the local sports calendar.

name: Běh Kovohutěmi
location: TJ Kovohutě stadion, Lhota u Příbramě, Příbram District, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
price_range: 50,- předem, 100,- na místě, děti a nad 60 let zdarma
description: Kovohutě Run is a traditional running race held in Lhota near Příbram, which has been taking place since 1967. This race offers a main course of 12 km as well as races for children and youth. The event is held at the TJ Kovohutě stadium and is popular among runners of all ages. It attracts many participants each year and is part of the Brdský Running Cup.
course_highlights: Main race of 12 km
Races for children and youth
Start and finish at TJ Kovohutě stadium in Lhota near Příbram
additional: The race is part of the Brdský Running Cup. Registration and provisional start lists are available for the main race, children and youth races, and also for the mile race. The races include the main 12 km course, children's and youth races, various age categories, and are held on hilly roads with asphalt and grass surfaces.

name: Strojařská desítka
description: The Strojařská desítka is a traditional road running race in Zlín, held for the 42nd time. The race offers 10 and 5 kilometer routes with an elevation gain of 153 meters on a certified turnaround course passing through Zlín's Maják, U Boudy crossroads, Salaš, and back. The start is always at 10 a.m. at the Road Maintenance Department headquarters on K Majáku street. The race is suitable for the general public and runners of all categories who want to compete in the beautiful environment of Zlín.
course_highlights: Turnaround road course 10 km long with an elevation gain of 153 meters
Certified route between Zlín's Maják, U Boudy crossroads, and Salaš
Start and finish at the Road Maintenance Department on K Majáku street
additional: The race is part of the Zlín Running Series. Junior and children categories have specific registration and scoring rules. Results and photo galleries are regularly published online. Starting numbers and other organizational information are available on the official website. The race runs on forest, asphalt, and hilly roads, with registration available in advance or on-site, and results accessible online.

name: Běh přátelství Klenčí pod Čerchovem - Waldmünchen
location: Klenčí pod Čerchovem, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Friendship Run Klenčí pod Čerchovem - Waldmünchen is part of the Running Series Chodsko Runner, which offers a diverse range of races in the Chodsko area. This race takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Klenčí pod Čerchovem and attracts runners of all ages. The course is suitable for nature lovers and trail runners, with the race atmosphere fostering friendly gatherings of the running community. The Chodsko Runner series is known for its tradition and quality organization, ensuring a pleasant experience for all participants.
course_highlights: Run in the picturesque environment of Klenčí pod Čerchovem
Trail course suitable for nature enthusiasts
Part of the Chodsko Runner series with a tradition
additional: The race takes place in September 2026, the course is approximately 15.5 km long, and is suitable for runners of all levels. The event is associated with the celebration of friendship and sports competition.

name: Bezdězský půlmaraton
location: Doksy, Liberec District, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Bezděz Half Marathon is a running race held in the picturesque environment of the Mácha region around Bezděz Castle. It offers two routes approximately 13.6 km and 21.2 km long with an elevation gain of 200 to 300 meters, passing through forest paths, trails, and short sections on asphalt. The race is suitable for the general public and is complemented by children's races. There is catering, baggage storage, toilets, and results announcement with a raffle in the area. The capacity is limited to 500 participants, ensuring a pleasant atmosphere and quality facilities.
course_highlights: Routes pass through extensive forests of the Mácha region and around Bezděz Castle
Surface of the routes includes paved and unpaved roads, trails, and short asphalt sections
Two refreshment stations on the 21 km route, one on the 13 km route
additional: Registration and check-in on site is possible from 8:30 to 10:30, the race capacity is limited to 500 runners. Baggage storage, changing tents, toilets, refreshments, and a raffle are available for participants. Children's races start at 10:00, main races on 13 km and 21 km begin at 11:00. The route is marked with flags, signs, and chalk, with each kilometer approximately indicated. Registration is possible through the official website. The race takes place in September 2026. The course includes natural terrains and forest paths.

name: 7 pohoří Krkonoše
description: Trail Run Series 7 Mountains is the largest event of its kind in the Czech Republic, taking you through seven of the most beautiful and challenging mountain ranges. The races offer technical trails with epic views and an atmosphere you won't experience anywhere else. Whether you are an experienced mountain runner or a beginner, the 7 Mountains will test your strength, willpower, and determination. Conquer all the mountains and become a legend of trail running.
course_highlights: Technical trails with elevation gain around 900 - 1230 meters on main routes
Epic views of significant peaks and landscapes such as Ještěd, Bezděz, Kozákov, Trosky, Zvičina, Velká Deštná
Routes lead through mountain paths, ancient trails, and the natural scenery of national parks
additional: The time limit to complete the race is 4 hours, after which the participant is marked as DNF. Each participant receives a commemorative finisher medal and has access to refreshments on the route and at the finish line. Recommended gear includes a windbreaker and a charged mobile phone with the Rescue app. Storage for small items is available at the registration booth. The event takes place in all weather conditions and participation is at your own risk. The course includes mountain trails, technical sections, and scenic viewpoints. Registration includes a map of the course, chip timing, a medal, and refreshments.

name: Běh k Mohyle Hanče a Vrbaty
location: Bílý most přes Labe, Špindlerův Mlýn, Krkonoše, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 150 Kč pro přihlášené předem online do 12.9.2025

description: The Hanče and Vrba Memorial Run is a traditional mountain race held in the Krkonoše Mountains, starting at the White Bridge over the Elbe in Špindlerův Mlýn and ending at the Hanče and Vrba Memorial. The 9 km route with an elevation gain of 696 meters mainly runs on asphalt and terrain, offering beautiful views and unforgettable experiences. The race is part of the Czech Cup in uphill running and is suitable for a wide range of runners in various age categories. After the race, there is an opportunity for refreshments and a raffle, as well as the use of public transportation back from the finish line.
course_highlights: 9 km route with an elevation gain of 696 m
65% asphalt, 35% terrain
Start at 715 m above sea level, finish at 1411 m above sea level
additional: Maximum number of participants is 100. Registration takes place on race day from 9:30 to 10:30 in Špindlerův Mlýn. There are two refreshment stations along the route with water and isotonic drinks. After the race, there is a raffle and the possibility of refreshments at Vrbatova Bouda. No changing rooms or showers are provided. There is an option to transport light personal belongings from the start to the finish. Trail race with an elevation gain of 696 m, start at the White Bridge over the Elbe, finish at the Hanče and Vrba Memorial, online and on-site registration, part of the Czech Cup in uphill running.

name: Dětmarovická 10

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 350,- Kč (registrace předem, uhrazené do 3 dnů od registrace)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 700,- Kč (cena je za oba dva běžce v případě registrace předem, uhrazené do 3 dnů od registrace)

tiers.label: tier_1

description: Dětmarovická 10 is a traditional running race held in the village of Dětmarovice, offering a main race of 10 km, a relay of 2 x 5 km, and children's runs called Cipísek's Run. The course mainly runs on asphalt roads and forest trails, combining brisk sections with gentle challenges and allowing participants to enjoy the picturesque corners of the village. The race is suitable for both experienced runners and enthusiastic amateurs, with the joy of running and a sporting atmosphere being more important than performance. Short courses with a cheerful atmosphere and illustrations of Cipísek are prepared for children. Registration is conducted online with the possibility to register on-site, and runners receive a start number with a chip for timing and gift items from partners.
course_highlights: The course mainly runs on asphalt roads and forest gravel and dirt trails in the municipality of Dětmarovice
A combination of brisk sections and gentle challenges suitable for both experienced and amateur runners
Picturesque corners of Dětmarovice with a unique atmosphere
additional: Start and finish of the race are at the Dětmarovice Sports Hall. Participants will receive a start number with a chip for timing. Refreshment stations are located at the 6 km mark and at the finish line. Medical services are available at the finish. For the 2 x 5 km relay, transportation of runners between segments is provided. Children's runs are divided by age into 100 m, 200 m, and 400 m distances. On-site registration is possible but without guarantee of the same benefits as online registration. The race includes electronic registration, chip timing, medical security, refreshments, and a raffle. The course includes asphalt, forest, and gravel paths and is suitable for all levels of runners.

name: Nočný beh mestom Lučenec
location: Synagóga, Adyho 69/7, Lučenec, Banskobystrický kraj, Slovakia
description: Night Run in the city of Lučenec is a night running race held along illuminated streets of Lučenec with a course length of 4.5 km. The event is open to the general public, including juniors and adults, with categories based on age and gender. Organized by the City of Lučenec and OZ Novohrad, the race takes place near the Synagogue with electronic timing and chip technology. The start is scheduled for 19:30, and participants will receive a commemorative medal, a start number, refreshments, and an accompanying program.
course_highlights: Night illuminated streets of Lučenec
Course length of 4.5 km
Electronic timing with chip technology
additional: Registration for participants is on September 15, 2025, from 17:00 to 19:00 at the Synagogue. The participant capacity is limited to 350. The registration fee includes a commemorative metal medal, a start number with the event logo, a collage of photos sent via email, medical services, refreshments, and a show program. The race takes place with partial traffic restrictions and at participants' own risk. The event includes online and on-site registration, with a maximum of 350 participants, and also features medals, start numbers, photographs, medical care, and refreshments.

name: Školáčik detský beh
description: The Schoolchild Children's Run is a running event for children of various age categories held in Lučenec near the synagogue. The organizers are the city of Lučenec and OZ Novohrad. The race is intended for boys and girls from 3 to 15 years old, including children with disabilities. The entry fee is symbolic and supports children's participation in sports activities in a pleasant city environment.
course_highlights: Races for children from 3 to 15 years old in different age categories
Running tracks adapted to children's age and abilities
Organized in the center of Lučenec near the synagogue
additional: The entry fee is €5 for online registration until 12.9.2025, €7 on-site if there is available capacity. Categories are divided by age from 3 to 15 years old, including children with disabilities. The organizers are the city of Lučenec and OZ Novohrad. Contact person: Marian Duzbaba, phone: 0907146181. children of various age categories, entry fee online and on-site, location Lučenec, synagogue

name: Beh okolo Lysej
location: Lysá pod Makytou, Púchov District, Slovakia
description: Running around Lysej is a traditional race in the village of Lysá pod Makytou, offering various categories for children, juniors, women, and men according to age. The race takes place near the cultural house and is organized by the Running Club Lysá pod Makytou. The start for children is at 11:00, for categories E, women, and juniors at 12:30, and for men at 13:00. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the region.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the village of Lysá pod Makytou near the cultural house
Multiple age categories from preschool to veterans over 70 years old
Start divided by categories: children, juniors, women, and men
additional: Start for children at 11:00, for categories E, women, and juniors at 12:30, and for men at 13:00. Categories are divided by age from preschool to veterans over 70 years old. The organizer is the Running Club Lysá pod Makytou. The race likely takes place in a natural or mountain terrain; registration details are not specified; date of event: September 12, 2026.

name: Behaj lesmi Topoľčianky
description: The Run Through the Forests Topoľčianky are nocturnal trail races in the beautiful wine-growing region of Topoľčianky, taking place on September 12, 2026. Runners will enjoy routes passing around the Topoľčianky Castle and Hrušov Castle, with forest paths and an atmosphere under the stars. The race is part of the Run Through the Forests series and is included in the international UTMB Index, which increases its prestige. There will be two main routes - 11 km and 22 km, with a fast section called the Conti Speed Section offering a valuable prize.
course_highlights: Routes pass through the wine-growing region with views of Topoľčianky Castle and Hrušov Castle
Forest paths with soft surfaces suitable for trail running
Night run under the stars with a marked Conti Speed Section
additional: The race features the Conti Speed Section - a 150-meter fast segment with a chance to win a voucher for tires and a running jersey. The event is nocturnal, providing a unique atmosphere and experience. The routes are 80% on soft terrain and 100% in fresh air. It is part of the Run Through the Forests series with multiple events across Slovakia and the Czech Republic. The race offers several routes including a children's race with prizes starting from 5 EUR when purchasing 7 or more races, and includes entertainment for children, registration outside of the Terminovka.sk website, and the option to participate in the night run.

name: Marina Liptov RUN
organizer: Olympijský klub Liptova a rezort Marina Liptov
description: Marina Liptov RUN is a sports and recreational event set in the beautiful environment of the Marina Liptov resort near Liptovská Mara. This unconventional run offers a combination of nature and quality services in harmony with the four elements - fire, water, earth, and air. Runners can enjoy a peaceful and inspiring setting with views of the surrounding nature and the opportunity to relax after the run in the resort. Marina Liptov is an ideal place for athletes and families seeking an experience in nature.
course_highlights: The route runs through a natural environment near Liptovská Mara
Beautiful views of the surrounding nature, meadows, mountains, and forests
Peaceful and harmonious environment of the four elements of nature
additional: Marina Liptov offers accommodation, wellness, water activities, a boatyard, and a port, which can be utilized by runners before or after the race. The resort's opening hours are daily from 09:00 to 19:00. There are opportunities for hiking, cycling, skiing, and fishing nearby. The course is a 9 km trail with possible changes, registration is available online or on-site, and technical and medical support is provided.

name: Lemešanská bežecká liga 3. Jesenné kolo
organizer: Obec Lemešany, Športová komisia obce Lemešany
price_range: 7€ online, 10€ na mieste; zľavy pre obyvateľov obce a deti
description: Lemešanská Running League - III. Autumn Round is a running competition organized in the village of Lemešany in the beautiful environment of the Garden of Movement. The race is intended for all age groups and performance levels, offering a pleasant atmosphere and the opportunity for outdoor sports recreation. The organizer is Garden of Movement, which ensures quality conditions for sports and recreation.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the Garden of Movement area in Lemešany
Course suitable for all age and performance categories
Pleasant natural environment with pump track and playground
additional: The race is part of the Lemešanská Running League series, which includes four rounds in 2024 with the option to participate in all at discounted prices. The event is suitable for recreational and competitive runners, with online registration or on-site registration available.

name: Beh pre Labky jesenný špeciál
organizer: Únia vzájomnej pomoci ľudí a psov
description: Autumn Special Run for Paws is a running event in Košice, part of Kavečany, near Hrešná Cottage, organized by the Union of Mutual Help for People and Dogs UVP. The race is open to various categories including women, men, children, and runners with dogs, including shelter dogs. The course is 5 km long and offers a pleasant autumn atmosphere in nature. The entry fee is available online at a discounted price and on-site at a higher rate. The event promotes dog adoption and connects runners with animals in a friendly environment.
course_highlights: 5 km route in the natural environment of Kavečany near Hrešná Cottage
Opportunity to run with a dog, including shelter dogs
Categories for women, men, children up to 15 years old, and runners with dogs
additional: Categories include women, men, children up to 15 years old, and runners with dogs, including shelter dogs. The entry fee is €10 for online registration until 19.9.2025, and €15 on-site. The organizer is the Union of Mutual Help for People and Dogs UVP. The start location is Hrešná Cottage in Kavečany, Košice. The event is outdoor, suitable for dogs and their owners, with an emphasis on charitable purposes and community atmosphere.

name: Night run Michalovce
organizer: Mesto Michalovce, TAZS Michalovce, MSKS Michalovce, Fitko Michalovce, R M s.r.o.
description: Night Run Michalovce is a night running race held at Námestie osloboditeľov in Michalovce. The race offers three courses of different lengths: 10 km, 5 km, and 3 km, suitable for various age groups and performance levels. The start for adults is at 19:00, and children's races begin at 17:00. The organizers are the City of Michalovce, TAZS Michalovce, MSKS Michalovce, Fitko Michalovce, and R M s.r.o. The event is suitable for the general public who want to enjoy a sports atmosphere in the night city environment.
course_highlights: Night run in the center of Michalovce at Námestie osloboditeľov
Three courses: 10 km, 5 km, and 3 km
Categories for all age groups including children's races
additional: On-site registration fee can be paid by card. The race has categories based on age and gender, including junior, male, and female categories. Children's races start at 17:00. The event begins at 19:00 for adults and at 17:00 for children; online registration is available, with associated fees and deadlines. Details about registration and deadlines are available on the official website.
