description: The Run to Choč is a unique running event in the heart of Orava, testing your physical abilities as you run to the summit of Veľký Choč. The course follows hiking trail markers with elevation gain and offers beautiful views and natural surroundings of the Choč National Nature Reserve. The event is suitable for all lovers of running, sports, and nature who want to experience an exceptional atmosphere and enjoy quality refreshments and rewards. The run is also a tribute to Jožo Čajka, an athlete and friend with a big heart.
course_highlights: Ascent along the green and red hiking trail markers to the summit of Veľký Choč
Refreshments at Drapáč clearing and at the top of Choč
Time limit at Drapáč clearing of 1:15 hours
additional: The maximum number of participants is 250. Registration is possible online until September 6, 2023, or on the morning of the race from 7:30 in Vyšný Kubín. The registration fee includes refreshments on the course, lunch, and a souvenir item. The course is marked with colored ribbons; shortening the route will lead to disqualification. The top three in each category will receive material prizes and monetary rewards, including bonuses for course record. The race is part of a series of mountain races, with online registration available also on-site, and includes refreshments and a finisher gift. The race is organized within the Choč National Park and is suitable for runners of all levels.

name: II Złotowska Dziesiątka
description: The 2nd Złotów Ten Kilometer Run is a street race taking place on September 13, 2026, in Złotów. Participants complete two loops of 5 km each, totaling a distance of 10 km. The event is organized by the Złotów Social Activity Center and aims to promote an active lifestyle and integrate the local running community. We invite all running enthusiasts to participate in this event.
course_highlights: The route consists of two loops of 5 km each
Street race in the center of Złotów
Organized at the Municipal Stadium and surrounding streets
additional: The race takes place at the Municipal Stadium in Złotów and the surrounding streets. The route includes two loops of 5 km. Registrations are conducted through the Domtel-Sport platform. The organizer provides contact and support through the Złotów Social Activity Center. The 10 km street race offers online registration, is supported by local companies, features an attractive route, and prizes.

name: Poznań Track Day 2026
location: Tor Poznań, Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Poznań Track Day is a series of exciting motorsport events held at the race track in Poznań. Participants have the opportunity for competitive racing, training, and eliminations across various rounds scheduled for the 2026 season. The event is aimed at motorsport enthusiasts, offering also the possibility to rent cars and receive individual training sessions with instructors. It is an excellent opportunity to experience racing thrills and improve skills on a professional track.
course_highlights: Race track in Poznań with professional infrastructure
Opportunity to participate in various rounds and eliminations of the 2026 season
Options for training and individual instructor-led coaching
additional: Car rental options available for personal use or as a gift. The starter package includes participation for a team member, the possibility of co-driving (age >17), full catering, individual timing measurement, and training options with an instructor. Payments for participation must include the appropriate title format to confirm attendance. Multiple rounds including training, eliminations, and night races; focus on sporty driving and excitement on the track.

name: XI Bieg Nadziei oraz VII Mistrzostwa Wielkopolski Prawników
location: Środa Wielkopolska, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 11th Hope Run and the 7th Greater Poland Lawyers Championships is a charity run organized in Środa Wielkopolska, supporting the activities of the Piotr Hospice. The event combines sporting competition with an important social goal, engaging the local community and the legal environment. It is a well-established event that promotes physical activity and solidarity.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Old Market Square in Środa Wielkopolska
Charity run supporting the hospice
Various distances and activities, including runs for children and Nordic walking
additional: The run is charitable in nature, supporting the Piotr Hospice. Registrations open on March 1, 2026. No details about the route, start times, or fees are available on the website. The event is planned for September 13, 2026, and includes different forms of running and activities, with participation supporting the activities of the Piotr Hospice.

name: XRUN - Vistula Trail
location: Wisła, Cieszyn County, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Vistula Trail is a mountain trail run organized in Wisła, offering a variety of distances from short routes for children to demanding mountain trails. Participants can experience scenic views of the Beskidy Mountains, starting both in the center of Wisła and on the Czech side in Třinec. The routes lead through characteristic points such as Soszów Wielki, Soszów Shelter, and Czantoria, combining an international adventure with the Beskid climate. This event is for mountain running enthusiasts who appreciate diversity and the beauty of natural landscapes.
course_highlights: Start in the heart of Wisła at the Skolnity Ski & Bike Park
The route passes through Soszów Wielki, Soszów Shelter, and Czantoria
Scenic descents along the green trail to the center of Wisła and Kopczyński Park
additional: Time limits for the routes: 35 km - 9h, 24 km - 7h, 15 km - 4h. Starts are scheduled at different times: 35 km at 07:00, 24 km at 08:00, 15 km at 09:30. Age categories for children from 3 to 15 years are available on short distances. Start and finish in Wisła, with transportation to the start of the Classic Trail from Třinec. The event offers various distances divided into age categories, organized transport for some routes, marked trails, and a category for children. The start is in a picturesque area with the possibility to enjoy mountain scenery.

name: 16 Bieg Częstochowski
description: The 16th Częstochowa Run is a street running event scheduled for September 13, 2026, in the center of Częstochowa. The 10 km route runs through the city's representative streets, including the area around Jasna Góra, which gives the race a special prestige. The race has official certification, attracting competitors focused on fast pace and personal bests. It is an excellent opportunity for sporting competition in a picturesque urban setting.
course_highlights: 10 km route through the center of Częstochowa
Course passes near Jasna Góra
Official certification of the route conducive to fast running
additional: Registration takes place at the Sports Hall of IV Liceum, payment in cash. The event also includes training sessions and information from sponsors.

name: Bieg na Skałę
organizer: Centrum Kultury, Sportu i Rekreacji w Skale
price_range: 30 zł do 19.09.2025, 50 zł w dniu zawodów, 120 zł w dniu biegu
description: The Run to the Rock is a unique sporting event that combines physical activity with the beauty of nature in Ojców National Park. The race route runs through picturesque paths and hills, offering participants varied terrain, including forest trails, rocky sections, and steep ascents. The race is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners who want to experience the spirit of adventure and enjoy fresh air. After the race, participants will receive commemorative medals, prizes, and numerous attractions, including entertainment for children. The entire event takes place in a friendly, sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: Route through charming paths and hills of Ojców National Park
Varied terrain: forest trails, rocky sections, steep ascents
Amazing views of the surrounding area
additional: Available distances: Pstrąg Ojców Run (8 km) with team classification and a prize for the best resident of Skała municipality, and the Trail of Rocks and Valleys Run (15 km) with similar classification. For children, races are scheduled at distances of 100 m (ages 2-5, no classification), 800 m (ages 10-11), and 1300 m (ages 12-15). After the race, attractions for the youngest include inflatable castles, entertainers, and competitions with prizes. The route includes charming paths and hills, with diverse terrain from forest trails to rocky sections and steep ascents. The event features races at various distances, including for children, with the option to download GPX files, and start packages can be collected on September 19-20, 2025.

name: Chyża 10
location: Nowy Tomyśl, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The XII Chyża Ten is a fast and popular 10 km race organized by the Nowotomyski Biegacz Club Chyży. The event takes place in Nowy Tomyśl and is part of the Grand Prix of the Nowotomyski County in running. The race is scheduled to start at 9:00 AM, and the race office is open from 7:00 AM to 8:30 AM. The race attracts both amateurs and more experienced runners, offering a friendly atmosphere and a well-prepared route.
course_highlights: Fast 10 km route
Part of the Grand Prix of the Nowotomyski County
Start at 9:00 AM, race office open from 7:00 AM
additional: Race office open from 7:00 AM to 8:30 AM. Winners' ceremony at 10:45 AM. The race is co-financed by the Gmina Nowy Tomyśl and the Nowotomyski County. The event also includes 5 km runs, with registration opening on June 1, 2025. The race is part of a series of sporting events organized by the club.

description: The North Running Festival is a unique running event taking place on September 13, 2026, on the Hel Peninsula, combining the tradition of the North Marathon and Marathon Relays under one banner. The race route runs through picturesque locations of Hel, Jastarnia, and Rozewie, along the Puck Bay, with views of the sea and four lighthouses, which give the race a distinctive character. The event offers a variety of distances for runners of all levels, from marathons and relays, through half marathons, 10 km, and 5 km, to a children's run - Little Lighthouse Runner. It is not only a sport event but also a journey through beautiful coastal corners and contact with nature.
course_highlights: The route runs along Puck Bay with a view of the sea
There are four lighthouses on the route: in Hel, Jastarnia, and two in Rozewie
The route leads through the most beautiful corners of the Hel Peninsula and the coast
additional: The race route is available in .GPX, .KML, and .TCX formats for download. Registration is open from January 1, 2026, to August 24, 2026, until 3:00 PM. Co-organizers and partners include local sports and cultural centers and a holiday resort. Honorary patronage by the Marshal of the Pomeranian Voivodeship. The Little Lighthouse Runner is dedicated to children and youth up to 14 years old. The route is available for download in .GPX, .KML, .TCX formats; marine and seaside terrain; the event includes various distances and competitions for adults and children.

name: XV Półmaraton Damak
description: The XV Damak Half Marathon in Tarczyn is a family celebration of running that guarantees a great atmosphere and unforgettable experiences. The half marathon route runs through scenic areas along fields, forests, and apple orchards, giving the race a unique character. The event attracts runners of all ages, offering also children's and youth races. Organizers take care of participants by providing attractive start packages and sponsor support.
course_highlights: The route runs along fields, forests, and apple orchards
Scenic areas provide a unique race atmosphere
Family event with races for children and youth
additional: Start packages include eco-friendly bags, reflective bands, and thermal mugs with the sponsor Fakro logo. The start packages also contain Kamis spices. The limit for children's and youth races is 150 participants. The race office is located at ul. Szarych Szeregów 8 in Tarczyn. Urban area, online registration, family event, local sponsors and partners.

name: XXI Radomski Maraton Trzeźwości
location: Jedlnia-Letnisko, Kozienice County, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Radomski Marathon of Sobriety is an annual running event organized by the Association "Biegiem Radom!". The race takes place on scenic routes through the Kozienice Forest near Jedlnia-Letnisko, offering participants the opportunity to compete in a marathon, half-marathon, and other accompanying runs. The marathon promotes a healthy lifestyle and sobriety, as well as integrating the local running community. This event with an established tradition attracts both amateurs and experienced runners.
course_highlights: Routes run through Kozienice Forest
Picturesque forest trails and natural surroundings
Available distances: marathon and half-marathon
additional: Participants can personalize medals for a symbolic fee of 10 PLN. The organizer encourages participation in the marathon, half-marathon, and other accompanying runs. The "Biegiem Radom!" association also conducts integration and promotional activities for running in the region. The event includes various distances, including marathon and half-marathon, with training plans and support for participants. Registration opens from September 14, 2025.

name: Żyrardów w Biegu
description: Żyrardów w Biegu is an annual running event organized by the Żyrardów Cycling Society, which will take place on September 13, 2026, by the Żyrardów Reservoir. Participants can choose between two distances: 10 km and 5 km, which run around the reservoir with multiple laps and finish on the reservoir grounds. The race promotes physical activity, integration, and a friendly sporting atmosphere, as well as supports the promotion of the city of Żyrardów and the Mazowsze region. The event is open to adults, and on the 10 km distance, active wheelchair users can also participate.
course_highlights: Route around the Żyrardów Reservoir
4 laps for the 10 km distance, 2 laps for the 5 km distance
Start and finish located at the Żyrardów Reservoir, ul. Ziołowa 17
additional: Online registration is available until September 10, 2026. After this date, registration is only possible at the event office until 9:00 AM on the day of the race. Each participant receives a start number with a chip at the event office. For the 10 km race, active wheelchair users can participate. The event base, start, finish, and parking are located at the Żyrardów Reservoir, ul. Ziołowa 17. Distances: 10 km and 5 km, online registration, a time limit of 100 minutes for the main race, wheelchair start options, and a swimming area available during the weekend of the event.

name: Okolo Muňáku
location: Munice u Hluboké nad Vltavou, South Bohemia, Czech Republic
price_range: Dospělí: online 300 Kč, na místě 500 Kč; děti: online 100 Kč, na místě 200 Kč; štafety: online 550 Kč, na místě 750 Kč
description: Around Muňák is a family running race in Munice near Hluboká nad Vltavou, offering a relaxed atmosphere and a fast course around Munický Pond. The race is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup and is open to all age groups, including children's runs. Each edition supports the charitable organization Centrum Bazalka, which receives a portion of the entry fees. After the race, there is a rich accompanying program including a raffle and prizes for the fastest runners.
course_highlights: Course length of 10 km with an elevation gain of 35 meters
Mostly asphalt cycle paths (60% asphalt, 40% gravel)
The route runs around Munický Pond, Hluboká, ZOO, and Bažantnice
additional: Registration for children is from 9:30 to 10:30, the main race starts at 13:30. Starting numbers with names can be ordered until September 10. Members of #tymdejvid have free entry. After the race, there is a raffle and children receive a ticket to the ZOO and a medal. The race is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup, the course is fast and flat, start is from 9:30 to 15:30, registration is open until September 13, 2026.

name: Vrchlabský 1/2 Maraton
location: Náměstí T. G. Masaryka, Vrchlabí, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Vrchlabský City Half Marathon is the first edition of the half marathon held in the heart of the Krkonoše Mountains at T. G. Masaryk Square in Vrchlabí. Participants will enjoy a sporting challenge on asphalt roads, field and forest paths, as well as a cultural program and a friendly atmosphere. In addition to the main half marathon, shorter routes of 2 km and 9 km are available, suitable for children, juniors, and families with children, which lead through the city and its side streets. The event combines running, experiences, and community and is co-financed by the State Environmental Fund of the Czech Republic.
course_highlights: The course runs on asphalt roads, field and forest paths
Start and finish at T. G. Masaryk Square in Vrchlabí
Side streets of the city are part of the shorter routes for children and juniors
additional: The 2 km route starts at 13:00 with categories 7 - 9, 10 - 12, and 13 - 15 years. The half marathon (21.1 km) starts at 15:00 with categories 18 - 29, 30 - 39, 40 - 49, and 50+ years. Parking is available in the city center; some parking lots are paid, others free. The larger parking lot near the monastery is temporarily closed; it is recommended to use the parking lot at the cultural house, about a 10-minute walk from the square. The course includes asphalt roads, field, and forest paths; registration is possible via contact details on the website.

name: Forestova čtrnáctka
location: Záluží u Třemošné, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: Forest Fourteen is a running race on a 14 km course around Záluží near Plzeň, offering a combination of field, forest, and gravel paths with light trail terrain. The race is suitable for the general public, including children and youth, who can participate for free. Participants can enjoy abundant refreshments, a finisher's medal, and race photos. Registration begins at 9:00 AM and the start is scheduled for 9:45 AM, with the race taking place in all weather conditions. The organizer emphasizes safety and the participants' health, who run at their own risk.
course_highlights: 14 km course through fields, forests, and gravel paths with light trail terrain
Pink ground arrows complemented by red and white ribbons for course marking
Rich refreshments at the finish line including drinks, fruit, and homemade buns
additional: Registration begins at 9:00 AM, on-site registration is possible no later than 30 minutes before the start, bib numbers are issued by the organizer 20 minutes before the start. Participants receive a finisher's medal and refreshments at the finish. Portable toilets provided by Johny servis are available. The start is in Záluží near Plzeň, best accessible by tram line 4. Each participant runs at their own risk and is not insured by the organizer. Registration takes place 30 minutes before the start, which is scheduled for 9:00 AM. The race is part of a series of trail events in the region and is suitable for the general public.

name: Králický Lískovec
location: Chata Amálka, Králíky, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_3

description: Králický Lískovec is a traditional running race held in the beautiful surroundings of Lískovec Hill and its vicinity in Králíky, Pardubice Region. The race offers various courses from short children's categories to the main race, which is 8 km long and part of the ISCAREX Cup. The main race starts at 11:30 AM, with children's categories starting as early as 10:30 AM. The race is suitable for the general public and offers prizes for winners in individual categories. Applications can be submitted on-site on the day of the race from 8:00 to 9:45 AM.
course_highlights: Main race 8 km long in mountain terrain of Lískovec Hill
Additional courses for children and youth from 200 m to 5 km
Race is part of the ISCAREX Cup 2026
additional: Applications on-site on the day of the race from 8:00 to 9:45 AM. The absolute winner and winner of the main race will receive a separate prize. The pre-schoolers' start takes place during the race. The race begins at the Amálka cottage and focuses on mountain running in nature, with on-site registration available from 8:00 to 9:45. The event is part of the cup series and offers various distances for different age groups and runner levels.

name: Kokořínský kros
description: Kokořínský cross is a trail run held in the picturesque nature of the Kokořínsko Protected Landscape Area, near Prague. The race offers three main routes with distances of 15 km, 10 km, and 5 km, which lead through romantic gorges and around unique sandstone towers. The start and finish are located in the area of the municipal baths in Mšeno, where facilities including refreshments and a children's corner are provided. The race is suitable for all runners, from beginners to experienced, and offers a variety of categories with the possibility to change the route length even on race day.
course_highlights: Routes lead through scenic Kokořínsko with sandstone cliffs and ponds
Romantic gorges and unique sandstone towers, which are rare in the Czech Republic
Start and finish in the municipal baths area in Mšeno with swimming options
additional: Children's corner for kids aged 3 to 10 with art activities and supervision by an experienced teacher. Possibility to change the route length on race day during registration. Refreshments at the finish include Corny bars, bananas, water, and Ionilyte electrolyte drink. Parking is available at a designated lot approximately 200 meters from the race facilities. Entry of dogs is prohibited at the swimming area. Trail routes with registration options, gift vouchers, parking, and refreshments on site, as well as individual registration with personalized bib number.

name: Hostivařská 15°
price_range: 500 Kč online / 700 Kč na místě (15 km), 400 Kč online / 500 Kč na místě (5 km), 200 Kč online / 250 Kč na místě (děti)
description: Hostivařská 15 is a family trail race set in the natural environment of Prague Hostivař, offering an experience beyond just performance. The race takes place around the reservoir, golf course, and meanders of the Botič River, predominantly on forest paths with minimal asphalt. It starts without timing technology; the winner is the one who best estimates their time. The atmosphere is natural, brewery-themed, and suitable for all age groups, including children.
course_highlights: Forest paths with minimal asphalt
Surroundings of the reservoir, golf course, and Botič River meanders
Family and natural atmosphere with brewery facilities
additional: Registration is from 8:00 to 10:30 at the Hostivar Brewery area 2 with a bag drop. Refreshments are available on the 15 km course and at the finish line. Online registrants will receive a commemorative gift. The accompanying program includes a raffle, dance show, and entertainment for families with children. Parking is limited at the brewery, with additional options nearby. Public transport connections include Prague-Horní Měcholupy, buses 154, 183, 224, 240, and train. Forest surface, online registration until September 11, 2026, start at Hostivar Brewery, refreshments on the course and at the finish, accompanying program, raffle, family atmosphere.

name: 4Drun
location: Dubany u Prostějova, Prostějov, Olomoucký kraj, Czech Republic
description: 4Drun is a traditional running race organized by the Sports Club DDsport, z.s., held in the picturesque environment of Dubany near Prostějov. The race offers a 10.2 km course through the surroundings of Dubany, neighboring villages Hablov and Bystročice, and a newly built cycle path, combining asphalt and cross-country sections. The program also includes a 2x5 km relay race, a 4 km family run, and children's races, making the event suitable for all age groups. During race day, a rich accompanying program is prepared, and each participant will receive a commemorative medal.
course_highlights: The 10.2 km course runs through the surroundings of Dubany, neighboring villages Hablov and Bystročice, and a newly built cycle path
Combination of asphalt and cross-country sections
Family run of 4 km suitable for participation with a stroller
additional: Start packages and numbers can be picked up at the 4Drun Expo at Sokolovna Dubany on Friday, September 11th from 16:00 to 18:00, on Saturday, September 12th from 9:00 to 10:00 and 18:00 to 19:00, and on race day, September 13th from 8:00 to 12:30. On-site registration on the race day is not possible. Each participant who completes the race will receive a commemorative medal. It is recommended to pick up the start package well in advance, ideally an hour before the start. Only runners up to and including 18 years old can be on the podium in the family run. The accompanying program includes children's races, family run, relays, and prize draws. Registration is required in advance online; the race is part of multiple categories and accompanying events.

name: Beh Ždaňou
description: Ždaňa Run is a running event in the village of Ždaňa in the Košice-okolie district, offering courses for various age groups and performance levels. Races are held on 2.5 km and 5 km routes, with categories divided by age and gender. The event is suitable for the general public, including children, adults, and seniors. Organizers welcome all runners who want to enjoy a sports day in the pleasant environment of the village.
course_highlights: Courses of 2.5 km and 5 km
Categories by age and gender
Start and finish at the Municipal Office in Ždaňa
additional: The races are suitable for all age groups, including children, with the possibility of online registration. The event also includes a 700 m children's run, and the participant limit is 150 runners.

The course passes around the historic Spiš Castle and is suitable for various age groups, including children and adults. The organizer is the Town of Spišské Podhradie, which ensures a pleasant atmosphere and quality organization of the race. The registration fee is available online or on-site, with residents of Spišské Podhradie participating for free.

3.7 km paved country road and grassy surface
The route passes around Spiš Castle

The registration fee can be paid online or on the day of the race on-site. The start location is in front of the Town Hall in Spišské Podhradie. The course includes 12 km with an elevation gain of 227 meters, 80% asphalt and 20% grass and forest path; registration is possible online or on-site; the event is suitable for all age groups, including children.

name: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli - září
description: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli is a regular 8 km running race held in the pleasant environment of Pilsen. The race is open to all runners who share a passion for running and spending time together. The start and finish are at the same location with parking available for competitors. The event offers a friendly atmosphere and is suitable for various age categories.
course_highlights: 8 km course in Pytel area in Pilsen
Start and finish at the same place with parking for participants
Categories divided by age from 16 years and above
additional: Registration and bib distribution are from 17:00 to 17:45. After the race, the best runners are announced and a raffle is held. The race capacity is limited to 75 participants. Each participant runs at their own risk. The race is part of a series of runs in Pilsen, including various distances and charity events, held regularly throughout the year.

name: Malý Pieninský maratón – mem. Bohuša Ježíka
organizer: Malý pieninský maratón – memoriál Bohuša Ježíka
description: The Small Pieniny Marathon - Bohuš Ježíek Memorial is a running event in Červený Kláštor offering an 18 km course with an elevation gain of 163 meters. The route passes through the gorge of the Dunajec River, with surfaces that are half asphalt and half forest. The start is scheduled for 10:00 AM, and the registration fee includes a medal, a gift, a bib number, refreshments on the course and at the finish line, lunch, and a raffle. In addition to the main race, there is also a non-competitive relay of 9+9 km.
course_highlights: The route passes through the gorge of the Dunajec River
Surface 50% asphalt, 50% forest
Elevation gain of +163 m over 18 km
additional: The registration fee includes a medal, a gift, a bib number, refreshments on the course and at the finish line, lunch, and a raffle. Registration is conducted outside the Terminovka.sk portal. The number of participants is limited, and registration on the day of the event is possible in exceptional cases. Participants run at their own risk and are required to follow traffic rules and organizer instructions. The course includes asphalt and forest paths. Registration is closed due to capacity being reached. The race is open to runners of all levels.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (10) – zářijový
description: The 5 and 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY is a regular running series in Prague Braník, offering a pleasant and fast course along the Vltava River, where personal records are often broken. The races are part of the 16th edition and are suitable for runners of all levels, from beginners to professionals. The course is certified, and a 10 km run can meet the limit for the Czech Championships. After the race, there is an opportunity for socializing and refueling at the local restaurant, contributing to a relaxed running atmosphere.
course_highlights: Fast course along the Vltava River in Prague Braník
Certified course with the possibility of meeting the Czech Championships limit for 10 km
Pleasant atmosphere and post-race refreshments
additional: Registration begins at 18:00, the 10 km race starts at 19:00, the 5 km race starts at 19:05. After the race, refreshments are available at the Hamr Braník restaurant. Bag storage is possible at the organizer's tent. After the race, a raffle with prizes such as free entry, massage vouchers, and more. The course is measured by a certified measurer. Cancellation is possible up to 24 hours before the start with a refund of the entry fee. The race is part of the VAŠÍ LIGY running series in Prague, including various courses and categories. Registration is possible in advance. The event supports both regular and recreational runners.

The start is in the early evening, with slower runners starting earlier. The event is open to all runners and is supported by the Prague 20 municipal district. After the race, participants are offered potatoes as a reward from the sponsor Europlant.
course_highlights: Distance of 7.5 km
Combination of asphalt and trail
Start in the early evening with separate starts for faster and slower runners
additional: Registrations are possible on-site until 17:45. Slower runners start at 17:30. Transportation: Metro B Černý Most, then bus to Vojická or Vysokovská stops. Participants run at their own risk. Organizer: Tomáš Procházka, contact: 606629062. After the race, potatoes are provided for participants by sponsor Europlant breeding company s.r.o. Course: 7.5 km asphalt and trail, registration on-site until 17:45, start: 17:30 for slower runners, race at own risk, organizer is not responsible for lost items.

name: Běh proti násilí
location: Obora Hvězda, Praha 6, Praha, Czech Republic
organizer: Asociace pro práci s lidmi, kteří se dopouštějí násilí z.s.

description: The Run Against Violence is a traditional charity run held at Obora Hvězda in Prague 6, supporting the Stop Violence program and clients of long-term therapies focused on managing anger and aggression. This run brings together runners of all ages who want to express support and hope for those trying to change their behavior. The course is 5 km long and suitable for everyone who wants to support a good cause and enjoy outdoor activity. The organizer is Diakonie ČCE, a major provider of social services in the Czech Republic.
course_highlights: The course runs through Obora Hvězda in Prague 6
The main route length is 5 km
Charity run supporting the Stop Violence program
additional: Start packages can be picked up on race day at the registration tent, labeled according to gender and T-shirt size. There is a baggage storage, changing rooms, refreshments during and after the race, and free massages before and after the run. Starting numbers and chips are non-transferable and must be visibly placed on the chest. The race is charitable and supports the Stop Violence program. The program includes children's races, the main 5 km race, accompanying activities in the children's corner, relaxation techniques, and massages. The event promotes therapeutic programs and violence prevention.

name: Maraton 3 Jezior / Three Lakes Marathon
location: Międzybrodzie Bialskie, Żywiec County, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Maraton 3 Jezior is a mountain running festival held in the picturesque region of the Small Beskids, in the Soła River valley. The main distance is an ultramarathon approximately 43 km long with an elevation gain of about 2485 meters, leading through the highest parts of the Small Beskids, with beautiful views of three lakes and surrounding mountains. The route combines challenging ascents and technical descents, giving participants the opportunity to experience both wild nature and historic sites of the region. The event takes place during the beautiful transition period from summer to autumn, which further emphasizes the charm of the route and the area.
course_highlights: Ultramarathon route approximately 43 km long with an elevation gain of +/- 2485 m
Views of three lakes: Międzybrodzkie, Tresna, and the surrounding area
Technically demanding ascents and descents, including a steep climb to Magurka and the Czupel peak
additional: Start and finish: start at 8:00 AM in Międzybrodzie Bialskie, finish at the stadium in Porąbka. Time limit for the route: 10 hours 30 minutes. The route passes through diverse terrains: forests, meadows, a suspension bridge over the Soła River. There are refreshment points and a spectator zone in Czernichów. The route is technically challenging with significant elevation gain. The festival also offers other distances and accompanying races. The event includes various distances, a festival atmosphere, electronic timing, and routes that lead through lakes and mountains, providing unforgettable experiences.

name: 23 Przejście Dookoła Kotliny Jeleniogórs...
location: Jelenia Góra, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Walk Around the Jelenia Góra Basin is one of the most recognizable long-distance hiking events in Poland, organized since 2004. Participants cover approximately 140 km around the Jelenia Góra Basin, traversing the ranges of the Karkonosze, Janowickie Rudas, Kaczawskie Mountains, and Izerskie Mountains. The event commemorates GOPR rescuers, and as part of the start fee, participants receive start materials, a gadget, a hot meal, and a certificate. The route is demanding, with a total ascent of about 5500 meters, and the time limit to complete the route is 48 hours.
course_highlights: Long route approximately 140 km around the Jelenia Góra Basin
Total positive elevation gain of about 5500 meters
Crossing the ranges of Karkonosze, Janowickie Rudas, Kaczawskie Mountains, and Izerskie Mountains
additional: No time measurement or classification. The start fee includes start materials (number, route map), a logo gadget (t-shirt), a hot meal and drinks at the refreshment point, water at selected control points, a certificate, photographic coverage, prize draws, and GOPR security. Long distance, mountain terrain, difficult weather conditions, memorial in honor of GOPR rescuers.

name: 3 Backyard Ultra Zagłębie
description: Backyard Ultra Zagłębie is a unique ultramarathon held on a loop measuring 6.706 km around Lake Pogoria 3 in Dąbrowa Górnicza. Participants start every hour, and the last runner in each round continues running until only one winner remains. The route combines various surfaces - asphalt, dirt and forest trails, and a beach section, requiring participants to have both endurance and technical precision. The event is the finale of the Polish Backyard Ultra League and attracts extreme challenge enthusiasts from all over Poland.
course_highlights: Loop of 6.706 km around Lake Pogoria 3
Mixed surfaces: 60% dirt and forest trails, 40% asphalt, cobblestone, and concrete
Beach section approximately 250-300 meters near the pier and stairs at the finish
additional: Start of each round occurs exactly on the hour. A participant must arrive at the start within 3 minutes of the round's beginning, otherwise they are eliminated. The race village is located at the Summer Sports and Water Activities Center. The organizer reserves the right to modify the route due to weather or safety reasons. All participants except the winner receive the title DNF (Did Not Finish) as a symbol of perseverance. Participant limit: 140; start at 12:00; location: Dąbrowa Górnicza; ultramarathon format with hourly loops.

name: 17. PKO Bytomski Półmaraton
organizer: Klub MKS MOSM Bytom, Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Bytomiu, Centrum Handlowe Plejada
description: The 17th PKO Bytom Half Marathon is an event promoting a healthy lifestyle and the integration of the local community of Bytom and surrounding areas. The race takes place on an accredited, asphalt course measuring 21.097 km, which is a single loop. The start and finish are located at the G City Plejada Shopping Center in Bytom. Participants can count on nutrition and refreshment points as well as support from pacemakers, and after the race, there is an option to personalize the medal by engraving the result.
course_highlights: Single-loop half marathon course of 21.097 km with PZLA accreditation
100% asphalt surface with markings every 1 km
Nutrition and refreshment points along the route and a 3-hour time limit
additional: After the race, there is an option to personalize the medal with the result through engraving (cost 25 PLN). Pacemakers with balloons and special T-shirts are present on the route. The time limit to complete the half marathon is 3 hours; after this time, participants must stop and reach the finish line by minibus marked END OF THE HALF MARATHON. A group warm-up is scheduled for 9:45 AM. An active zone is prepared for children. The event attracts over 1200 participants annually, offering personalized medals, a 3-hour time limit, and activities for children. Registration is available online and at the race office.

name: PKO Wieczorny Półmaraton Łódź
description: PKO Evening Half Marathon Łódź is a new, atmospheric running event held in the center of Łódź. The start and finish are located at the revitalized EC1 combined heat and power plant, which is now a center of culture and science. The 21.097 km route takes runners through the most recognizable places in the city, combining industrial history with modernity. This race is not only about the result but also about the unique atmosphere and energy of the city.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the revitalized EC1 combined heat and power plant
Route passes through the most recognizable places in Łódź
Evening street race in the city center
additional: The participant limit is 5000 people. The start package includes a souvenir drawstring bag and a medal for everyone who completes the race. There is an option to purchase an official technical T-shirt by SMMASH. The participant limit is 5000, with discounts for PKO Bank Polski customers when paying online. Registrations began a week before the event. The route covers key points of Łódź.

name: 44 Strzeliński Rogaining
location: Wzgórza Strzelińskie, Strzelin, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Polskie Towarzystwo Turystyczno-Krajoznawcze Oddział Ziemi Strzelińskiej
description: Strzeliński Rogaining is a pedestrian orienteering rally organized by the Polish Tourist and Sightseeing Society, Ziemia Strzelińska Branch, since 1996. Teams of 2-5 people plan their own route, aiming within the allotted time to visit as many control points as possible, each with different point values, which requires navigation skills and strategy. The event is open to participants of various ages and skill levels, making it an attractive activity for enthusiasts and families alike. The event takes place in the picturesque terrain of the Strzelin Hills, offering opportunities for contact with nature and active recreation.
course_highlights: Terrain of the Strzelin Hills with diverse control points
Route of any length from about 5 km to 70 km, individually planned by teams
Use of map and compass for pedestrian navigation
additional: The competition is held in teams of 2-5 people, who independently plan and can modify their route during the race. Control points have different point values depending on the difficulty of finding them. The event is open to everyone, regardless of age and gender, with results divided into age and gender categories. The race includes various route lengths, from 6 to 70 km, with registration and route planning available before the start. The event takes place in the Strzelin Hills, surrounded by forests and terrain with varied topography.

name: Gontyniec Celtic Trail
location: Gontyniec, Chodzież, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Gontyniec Celtic Trail is a unique reverse-format race lasting 6 or 12 hours on loops of approximately 10 km in the picturesque Gontyńca massif. Participants cover as much distance as possible, benefiting from well-equipped refreshment stations after each loop. The route offers changing landscapes at different times of the day, with beautiful views of the Noteć Valley and unique natural and cultural attractions, such as figurative beehives shaped like ancient gods. This is a special experience for runners seeking challenges and unforgettable sensations.
course_highlights: Non-stop race on loops of about 10 km
Refreshment station after each loop for participants
Views of the Noteć Valley and unique figurative beehives along the route
additional: The race lasts 6 or 12 hours non-stop. The route runs on loops of about 10 km. A refreshment station is available after each loop. Participants can choose the 6- or 12-hour option. The route traverses the Gontyńca massif with scenic views and natural attractions. Trail, mountain, and forest paths, participant limit of 150 in each race, preparations from 8 to 20 weeks.

The start and finish are located at the Sports and Entertainment Hall at Aleja Jana Pawła II 6. The participant limit is 600 people, and the race is scheduled to start at 5:00 PM on September 19, 2026. A companion race takes place from 3:00 PM to 3:50 PM on the same day.

Start and finish at the Sports and Entertainment Hall at Aleja Jana Pawła II 6
Urban route in Jastrzębie-Zdrój

The accompanying race occurs before the main race from 3:00 PM to 3:50 PM. The event includes the main 10 km race as well as shorter competitions on site, with a participant limit of 600 people.

Participants can enjoy a pleasant landscape around the local ponds with views of the surrounding mountains.

Courses of 2, 5, and 10 km on rolling mixed terrain with predominance of asphalt
Beautiful scenery around the ponds in Červený Kostelec with views of the Orlické Mountains, Krkonoše, and Hejšovina

Runners receive a bib with a timing chip, a commemorative medal, and additional services including refreshments and race photos.

Parking is available near the start and finish. Trail terrain, forest paths, registration online and on-site, race categories include main race, relay, and children’s races.

description: Li.t.r. is a weekend trail festival featuring a main race of 108 km with over 2000 meters of elevation change around Lipno. The run offers a unique opportunity to explore the unknown landscape of Lipno, its history, and stories during a challenging ultratrail. The race is open to both solo runners and teams, and is complemented by an accompanying program from Friday to Sunday. The atmosphere is community-oriented and friendly, organized by runners for runners with respect for nature and local culture.
course_highlights: 108 km long trail with over 2000 meters of elevation gain
The route runs along narrow forest trails around the largest water surface in the Czech Republic - Lipno
The route is divided into 8 sections (8 - 14 km), all transfer points are easily accessible by car
additional: Start and finish of the race are in front of the Stodola restaurant in Lipno nad Vltavou. There are changing rooms, showers, and parking available at the start. The route is divided into 8 sections with transfer points accessible by car. Included in the registration fee is a dropbag for solo runners, refreshments at transfer points (water, isotonic drinks, fruit), timing and results service. The accompanying program runs from Friday to Sunday, including lectures, music, and group activities. The registration fee is non-refundable but transferable. Participants must be at least 18 years old, or 15+ with parental consent. Children under 6 years old only with accompaniment. A multi-segment trail race with an accompanying program, accommodation options, involvement of local gastronomy and history.

name: Mattoni Running Festival Ústí nad Labem
location: Ústí nad Labem, Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: Mattoni Running Festival Ústí nad Labem 2026 is a traditional running race with a fast and flat course that runs along the Elbe River and past the local chemical plant. This half marathon is known as the "Ferrari among races" due to its speed and frequently broken records. During the race, runners will enjoy beautiful views of the České středohoří mountains and Střekov Castle. The festival offers various running disciplines including the half marathon, relay half marathon, 10 km run, and family runs.
course_highlights: Fast and flat course along the Elbe River
Passage through the local chemical plant
Views of the České středohoří mountains and Střekov Castle
additional: Possibility to authorize another person to pick up the start number. Start times for different races during the day: half marathon at 09:00, other runs at 11:00, 14:30, and 14:45. The 16th edition, approximately 3500 runners participated. The race is part of running series and offers the RunCzech mobile app for participants. The event takes place on September 19, 2026, and includes various races, an expo with official merchandise, and registration options. The course passes through city landmarks and industrial areas, suitable for all age groups.

name: Mladé Běchovice
description: Young Běchovice is a traditional running race intended for children from 1 to 18 years old, held on a grass field in Prague-Běchovice. The race offers courses of various lengths from 50 to 1300 meters to accommodate a wide age range of participants. Approximately 800 children participate each year, making it a significant sporting event for young runners. In 2026, the 61st edition of this popular race will take place.
course_highlights: Courses from 50 to 1300 meters suitable for children from 1 to 18 years old
The race takes place on a grass field
Approximately 800 participants annually
additional: The race is suitable for children, held on a grass field in Prague-Běchovice. The organizer is the association Mladé Běchovice, z.s. Contact is also possible by phone at +420 606481222. The race is intended for children and youth, taking place in September 2026, with approximately 800 participants. The event focuses on promoting sports and a healthy lifestyle among youth.

name: Běh Moravským krasem
location: Sloup v Moravském krasu, Blansko, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Moravian Karst Run is part of the Blansko District Running League, which has a tradition since 1976. This race offers runners from the Blansko area and surroundings the opportunity to test their strength in the beautiful natural environment of the Moravian Karst. The race is suitable for the general public and is part of an annual competition that promotes running sports in the region. The organizers strive to ensure quality service and a pleasant atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: The route passes through scenic terrain of the Moravian Karst
The race is part of the traditional Blansko District Running League
Natural scenery and quality running facilities
additional: The race takes place on September 19, 2026, in Sloup in the Moravian Karst, and is part of a regional running league with multiple events throughout the year.

name: Litovelská nealkoholická čtrnáctka
description: The Litovel Non-Alcoholic Fourteen is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, held in the picturesque town of Litovel in the Olomouc Region. The race is part of a running series and offers an opportunity for both fitness and competitive runners. Liga stovkařů is known for its long-standing tradition and support of the running community in Central Moravia. The race is suitable for the general public, and its friendly atmosphere is emphasized by its name, which refers to the non-alcoholic nature of the event.
course_highlights: The route passes through scenic surroundings of Litovel and its vicinity
Mostly asphalt and paved surface suitable for fast running
Part of the Great Prize of Long-Distance Runners of the Olomouc Region
additional: The race is part of a series of local running events in Olomouc and the surrounding area, with offerings for organizers and other races in the region.

name: Podzimní běh Heřmanův Městec

description: The autumn run in Heřmanův Městec is a traditional race held in the beautiful castle park. It offers two main routes of 5 km and 10 km (two laps) as well as children's races at the start and finish area. The race is part of the Vládce Mrdic sports league and attracts runners of all ages who enjoy a pleasant autumn atmosphere and quality facilities.
course_highlights: The route runs through the castle park of Heřmanův Městec
Two race options: 5 km and 10 km (two laps)
Children's races at the start and finish area

The race runs through forest paths and asphalt and starts from Valdecká Street near the water tower towards Hvozdec. The main race begins at 10:00 AM and is intended for adult runners without children's categories. The registration fee is 150 CZK in advance and 200 CZK on the spot. The race is part of the Brdský Running Cup and has a long history with available results and statistics.

Start in Hořovice, Valdecká Street near the water tower towards Hvozdec
Traditional race with history and results since 2014

The race offers routes for children up to 800 meters and for adults 5 and 10 km long, mainly along gravel and forest paths. The event is suitable for all lovers of movement and nature and offers a pleasant atmosphere with refreshments on the track and at the finish. The start and facilities are located at the back of Kačina Castle, where registration and results announcement also take place.

70% gravel path, 30% forest path
Refreshments on the track and at the finish (bananas, orange, apple, water)

Children immediately receive a participation medal after finishing. Parents can run with children in categories 2-3 and 4-5 years old. Parking is available according to the parking map, with a warning not to park on the road shoulders. Course maps and videos are available on the website; the race takes place in the castle park of Kačina.

The race offers various distances from children's races up to 21 km, including categories for running, canicross, walking/running, and dogtrek. Refreshment stations for people and dogs at the finish and along the route

At the finish in Štramberk, all registered participants receive an original medal and can order a T-shirt with a print. The start is from Havlíčkovo náměstí, and part of the registration fee is dedicated to supporting sports equipment for youth. The race is part of the Vysočina Runner Running Cup and offers refreshments at the start and finish lines.

description: The Emila Zátopka Running Race through his native land is a traditional event dedicated to the legacy of the famous Olympian Emil Zátopek, held regularly on the Saturday closest to his birthday, September 19. The race starts in his hometown of Kopřivnice at the Emil Zátopek statue and finishes at the Wallachian Open-Air Museum in Rožnov pod Radhoštěm after a challenging 22.3 km course with a hilly profile. The race is open to participants aged 15 and older and also offers accompanying runs for children and the public. After the race, a ceremonial award ceremony takes place with the participation of prominent guests.
course_highlights: Course length of 22.3 km from Kopřivnice to Rožnov pod Radhoštěm
Surface asphalt and gravel in forest sections
Elevation gain of 375 m, undulating and hilly profile
additional: There are three refreshment stations and one hydration station along the route. The race takes place with full road traffic. The time limit is 3 hours from the start, with an intermediate cut-off at 1:20 hours in Veřovice. Changing rooms are available at the Cultural House in Kopřivnice and at the Wallachian Open-Air Museum in Rožnov. Belongings are transported by bus to the finish line. The organizer provides bus transportation from Rožnov to the start and back after the race. Accommodation at the Stadion Hotel in Rožnov pod Radhoštěm is available at the runner's expense. Participants under 18 require parental consent. The event also includes accompanying runs for children and the public. The route includes asphalt and forest paths, registration is required, team and relay races are available, transportation and accommodation are arranged, and prizes are awarded.

name: Kocelovice-Hornosín-Kocelovice
description: Cross-country race Kocelovice - Hornosín - Kocelovice is a traditional sporting event organized by the municipality of Kocelovice in the South Bohemian Region. The event is suitable for running enthusiasts and those active in the scenic tourist and cycling terrain. The start and finish are at the building of the former school in Kocelovice, where the race organization also takes place. The event lasts approximately 4 hours.

Start and finish at the building of the former school in Kocelovice
Cross-country race connecting the villages of Kocelovice and Hornosín
additional: The event lasts approximately 240 minutes (4 hours). The start and finish are at the building of the former school in Kocelovice. Organized by the Municipality of Kocelovice. The race is held annually in autumn, with the last edition in September 2023, and the next planned for September 2026. The length of the course is approximately 18 km, with varying levels of difficulty and terrain.

In addition to the main race, the event includes children's races, relays, and the shorter Havlíček Five race, allowing broad public participation across various age groups and performance levels. The race offers quality facilities, refreshments on the course and after the race, professional timing, and a rich accompanying program.
course_highlights: The course runs along public cycle paths and sidewalks, mostly along the Sázava River

Start and finish at Havlíčkův Brod Square, with no significant elevation gain
additional: The registration fee includes a race bib (with the runner's name for registrations paid by September 1, 2026), a medal, refreshments on the course and after the race, free entry to the Vysočina amusement park, facilities (changing room, baggage and bike storage, mobile toilets, drinking water, seating), musical accompaniment, event moderation, professional electronic chip timing, online results display, medical services, and race organization.
