description: The Mělník Wine Run is a traditional running race in Mělník, offering courses of 10 km and 21 km. The race takes place on a single loop with beautiful views of the castle and vineyards, with the route passing through historical and natural attractions around the town. After finishing, participants can enjoy a tasting of local wines, a commemorative glass, a free lunch, and a rich raffle. The race is suitable for the general public, including children, who have their own free races. The organizer is the association Run the World, which promotes running as a community and friendly activity.
course_highlights: The course passes through Mělník Castle and vineyards with a view of the Vltava River
The loop includes crossing a lock chamber and passing through Hořín Park
Refreshment stations along the route, including a turnaround point at Vrbno
additional: Registration and changes on race day are not possible. Bib pickup is only available until 9:30. After finishing, each participant receives a commemorative glass and can participate in a wine tasting. Lunch is free for all runners, including a vegetarian option. After the winners are announced, a rich raffle will take place. The race capacity is 500 runners for both the 10 km and 21 km courses. Children's races are free. The registration fee varies depending on the registration date. The event supports charitable causes to help people with cystic fibrosis. The race is limited to 500 runners.

name: Grymovská pětka
description: Grymovská pětka is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, offering athletes the opportunity to test their strength in the pleasant environment of Grymov. Liga stovkařů Olomouc is a specialized club for fitness and performance running, organizing a number of endurance races in the Olomouc region. The race is part of their running calendar and attracts runners of various age groups and performance levels. The club also supports runners in training and race preparation, ensuring a quality sporting experience.
course_highlights: Road course in a beautiful sports complex by the Bečva River
Opportunity for both fitness and performance runners
Part of the Great Olomouc Region Endurance Race Cup
additional: The race takes place on September 26, 2026, the course is adapted for different performance levels, exact registration information is not provided.

name: Běh Bohutínem
location: Fotbalové hřiště Litavan, Bohutín, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 100 CZK pro dospělé, 20 CZK pro děti
description: The Bohutín Run is a traditional running race organized by SK Sporting Bohutín, held at the Litavan football field. The race offers courses for men of 8 km and for women of 4 km, with a surface combining asphalt and forest paths. The event also includes children's races, making it suitable for a wide range of runners. The main race starts at 1:00 PM, and the atmosphere is friendly and sports-oriented.
course_highlights: The course runs on asphalt and forest paths
Men run 8 km, women 4 km
Start and finish at Litavan football field
additional: Children's races are part of the event. The course is GPS-measured at 4.88 km, according to the regulations men run 8 km and women 4 km. Results are regularly published in the system and in PDF format. The organizer offers neoprene chip bands for purchase at 100 CZK. The start is at Litavan football field at 1:00 PM, the event includes children's races and runs in a natural environment with asphalt and forest sections.

name: Běh Zlínského kraje
location: Baťovský areál, Zlín, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Zlín Region Run is part of the celebrations of Zlín Region Day, which takes place on September 26, 2026, in Zlín. The event offers not only a sporting experience in the form of a 6 km run but also a cultural program, regional gastronomy, and family activities. The run is open to the general public and is part of a rich day full of entertainment, crafts, and regional products. The organizer is the Zlín Region, which supports sports and local traditions.
course_highlights: The course runs on a closed asphalt circuit in the Baťovský area
The day also includes a children's run and other sports activities
The program includes regional gastronomy, crafts, and cultural performances
additional: Regional gastronomy, run, sports and cultural program, family activities, regional products

name: Běh Velké skály
description: The Velká skála Run is a traditional running race held in Děčín, offering courses of 11 km and 6.5 km in forest and urban terrain. The race is part of the Děčín Running Cup and is suitable for the general public, including children, for whom special races are prepared. The start is at the ASK Děčín athletics stadium, and the race atmosphere is enhanced by beautiful nature and rock formations in the surroundings. The race is already in its 56th year and is known for its exceptional atmosphere and quality organization.
course_highlights: Forest and urban terrain
Courses of 11 km and 6.5 km
Start and finish at ASK Děčín athletics stadium
additional: Registration is possible online at www.nazavody.cz with a deadline of September 23, 2026, at midnight. Payment of the entry fee must be made in advance for the lower price; on-site payment is possible at a higher price. The race office is open for late registration no later than 30 minutes before the start of the category. The course is in forest and urban terrain, registration via www.nazavody.cz, children's races and relay races are available, and the main race is part of the Děčín Running Cup.

name: Plzeňský kardioběh
description: Pilsen Cardioběh is the largest cross-country run in Pilsen with courses of 5.8 km and 10 km. The race is part of the Youth Running Cup of the Pilsen Region and also the Czech Republic Championship for medical personnel in cross-country running. It is organized by Pro Sport Activities, an agency with many years of experience in organizing sports events in Pilsen and the surrounding area. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a quality sports experience in the natural environment of Pilsen-Roudná.
course_highlights: Cross-country run in Pilsen-Roudná
Two courses: 5.8 km and 10 km
Czech Republic Championship for medical personnel in cross-country running
additional: The races include cross-country and asphalt routes, there are children's races and an accompanying program with activities. Registration is handled through the company Apachi, and parking is available at Rychtářka.

name: KEEN Prague Park Race – Konopiště
description: KEEN Prague Park Race - Konopiště is a running race held in the beautiful nature of Konopiště, offering a unique running experience in the picturesque environment of the Central Bohemian Region. The course runs on both paved and unpaved paths and features a combination of natural scenery and historic sites. The race is part of the Prague Park Race series, known for its relaxed atmosphere and high-quality organization. It welcomes runners of all levels who want to experience a sports challenge close to nature.
course_highlights: The course runs on both paved and unpaved paths in the nature of Konopiště
Combination of natural scenery and historic sites
Friendly atmosphere and high-quality race organization
additional: Participants can choose between an 8 km or 14 km course with the option to change the course before the race. The longer course features a refreshment station approximately at the 8th km, with refreshments also available at the finish line. The race is part of the Prague Park Race series with pre-race runs. Registration is available through irontime.cz, and payment must be made within three days of registration. The event includes a children's race, on-site registration, parking nearby, and a detailed schedule on the website. The event also features test rides and KEEN running shoe presentations.

name: 7 pohoří Beskydy
location: Ski Areál Severák, Trojanovice, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: Trail Run Series 7 Mountains is the largest event of its kind in the Czech Republic, taking you through seven of the most beautiful and challenging mountain ranges. The Beskydy race takes place in the amphitheater at Horečky in Trojanovice and offers technical trails, epic views, and an atmosphere you won't experience anywhere else. The routes lead along forest paths and trails with climbs to interesting peaks and long descents. Each participant receives a commemorative medal and can look forward to refreshments and professional facilities.
course_highlights: Technical trails with an elevation gain of 1,230 meters on the main 23 km route
Routes lead along forest paths and trails with climbs to interesting peaks
Beautiful views and atmosphere in the amphitheater at Horečky in Trojanovice
additional: The race has a time limit of 4 hours, after which the runner is marked as DNF. Participants can store small items at the registration booth. Recommended gear includes a windbreaker and a charged mobile phone with the Záchranka app. The registration fee includes chip timing, refreshments on the route and at the finish line, and a commemorative medal. The races are held at Ski Area Severák in Trojanovice, and registration includes a start number, chip timing, medal, refreshments, and facilities. The time limit is 4 hours.

name: ŠumpeRUN
description: ŠumpeRUN is a popular city running race held in the historic center of Šumperk. The eighth edition of the race will offer routes for the general public including the main race over 10 km, a 3.33 km race, relay races for three-member teams, and children's races of various lengths. The race promotes a healthy lifestyle, community cohesion, and commemorates the cultural heritage of the city. For 2026, a rich accompanying program is prepared, including group warm-ups and musical entertainment on the course.
course_highlights: The course runs through the historic center of Šumperk, a city monument zone, pedestrian zones, and parks
The main race is 10 km long, consisting of three laps of 3.33 km with a total elevation gain of approximately 60 meters
Children's races are held in Sady 1. máje park with distances from 100 m to 2 km depending on age
additional: Registration begins on June 1, 2026. Children's races have free entry. A joint warm-up with professional instructors will take place before the start of children (10:30) and adults (14:00). There will be musical accompaniment on the course by a DJ or live band. The start and finish are at Svoboda Square near Hotel PERK and the Business Academy. The capacity of the main race is 350 runners, 100 runners for the 3 km race, 50 relay teams, and 100 children in each category. The race is aimed at the general public, offers various categories, and results are available online. The event is part of the local sports calendar and promotes an active lifestyle.

name: K3-run
description: K3 - Krčmaňský běh přes tři vrcholy is a race with a length of 11.3 km and an elevation gain of approximately 350 meters. The route takes runners through beautiful scenery over three peaks, mostly on paved paths and partially on grass with a predominantly hard surface. This race offers athletes a pleasant experience in nature and a challenge in the form of uphill running and trail running.
course_highlights: Race length 11.3 km
Elevation gain approx. 350 m
Route passes over three peaks mostly on paved paths
additional: The race is mainly on paved paths and grass, suitable for runners of all levels, and offers beautiful views of the surrounding landscape.

name: Horský beh Pačanským chotárom
location: Pača, Rožňava District, Košice Region, Slovakia
description: Mountain Run in Pačanský Chotár is a running event in the village of Pača, offering two main courses - a more challenging main run of 13.5 km with an elevation gain of 492 m, and a shorter hobby run of 6.3 km with an elevation gain of 203 m. The routes pass through a combination of asphalt and forest paths with beautiful views and refreshment stations along the way. Runners start and finish in front of the cultural house in Pača, with organizers providing navigation and route marking. The event is suitable for both advanced and recreational runners and offers a sporting atmosphere with refreshments and a raffle.
course_highlights: Main run 13.5 km with an elevation gain of 492 m, 40% asphalt, 60% forest trail
Hobby run 6.3 km with an elevation gain of 203 m, a mix of asphalt and forest trail
Refreshment stations along the route and panoramic views of Pačanský Chotár
additional: Registration for participants is from 8:30 to 9:45 in front of the cultural house in Pača. Children's races are free with a medal for every participant and material prizes for the top three in each category. The start package includes a bib with a chip, a commemorative gift - a headband, a medal, nutritional supplements, and participation in a raffle. After the run, refreshments including goulash, beer, or Kofola are provided. The 13.5 km and 6.3 km routes feature scenic forest and mountain terrain, with online registration, prizes for top finishers, scenic views, mountain trail, and mountain race.

name: Rybnícka 10-ka a 5-ka
location: Futbalový štadión, Rybník, Rybník, Levice, Slovakia
organizer: Obec Rybník, ZŠ s MŠ Rybník
description: Rybnícka 10-ka and 5-ka is a running event held at the football stadium in the village of Rybník, Levice district. The race is on two distances - 5 km and 10 km, with various age categories for men and women competing. The children's start is at 9:00 AM, and the adults' start is at 11:00 AM. The event is suitable for the general public, including high school students and seniors, who have discounted entry fees. Organizers ensure a pleasant atmosphere and quality facilities for runners.
course_highlights: The course runs around the football stadium in Rybník
Two distances: 5 km and 10 km
Categories for children, women, and men of different age groups
additional: Children's start at 9:00 AM, adults at 11:00 AM. Discounted entry fee of €10 for high school students up to 18 years old and seniors over 65 years old. The race is open to all age categories, including children, with options for online registration or on-site registration. The event also includes sports activities in the environment of the football stadium.

name: Behaj lesmi Devín
description: Run through the Devín forests are unique trail races near Bratislava, offering a run along a route with views of the confluence of the Danube and Morava rivers and the Devín Saddle. The routes pass along the historic Amber Road and blooming bear garlic avenues, making the run an unforgettable experience. The races are part of the Run through the Forest series and are included in the UTMB Index Races, ensuring international point scoring. You can compete on a short 12 km route or a half marathon of 22 km, with both routes featuring the Conti Speed Section, a speed segment with a valuable prize.
course_highlights: Route with views of the confluence of the Danube and Morava rivers and the Devín Saddle
Historic Amber Road and avenues of bear garlic
Conti Speed Section - a speed segment with marked 150 meters
additional: The races are part of the Run through the Forest series, with marked routes and refreshment stations along the course. The Conti Speed Section competition offers a chance to win a voucher for tire shopping and a running jersey. The races are rated within the UTMB Index Races, allowing for international point scoring. The course passes through forested areas and the historic Amber Road, with medals, participant gifts, photographs, and medical services available.

name: S Ankou za život
description: Run for Anka for Life is a charity event held in Košice at St. Elizabeth's Cathedral. The registration fee is a voluntary contribution, and all proceeds from the registration fee are donated to the Oasis - Hope for a New Life facility. The organizer is the Pastoral Center of Anka Kolesárová from Vysoká nad Uhom. Runners can combine athletic performance with support for a good cause.
course_highlights: Charitable nature with proceeds supporting social projects
Running relay in Košice and surrounding areas
Event connecting community and support for life
additional: The registration fee is a voluntary contribution, and all proceeds are donated to the charity facility Oasis - Hope for a New Life. The event is aimed at supporting life and charity; registration is possible through a voluntary contribution.

name: Hutčanská 5 s vierou – beh srdcom i telom
price_range: 10 € online, 15 € na mieste, 0 € pre deti 8-17 rokov a niektoré vekové skupiny
description: Run with Heart and Souls in Nižná Hutka is an annual running event that offers a 5 km course for experienced runners and a fun 500 m route for children. In addition to the sporting experience, the program includes a spiritual reflection, refreshments, a panel discussion, and a music program. The event creates a pleasant community atmosphere and promotes competitiveness and joy of running.
course_highlights: 5 km course for experienced runners
500 m fun route for children
Refreshments with goulash for runners
additional: Registration is possible online and in person, with in-person registration incurring a higher fee. Start numbers, pins, and the participant list will be prepared. After the run, there will be an evaluation, thanks, a raffle, and a concert by the band Kalap. The event includes spiritual activities, refreshments, entertainment, and categories by age, with different registration fees.

name: 21. Kamień Extreme - Rybnik
description: 21st Kamień Extreme is a demanding mountain running race organized in Rybnik, attracting enthusiasts of extreme running challenges. The event takes place on September 27, 2026, and offers professional timing using RFID technology. The race is organized by MOSiR Rybnik, ensuring smooth organization and a sporting atmosphere. The race start is scheduled for 12:00 PM, and registration ends on September 17, 2026, at 11:59 PM.
course_highlights: Extreme mountain trail
Professional RFID timing
Organized by MOSiR Rybnik
additional: Date: 2026-09-27, start at 12:00, registration until September 17, 2026, location: Rybnik

name: 48. Maraton Warszawski
description: The 48th Warsaw Marathon is a unique running event held in the heart of Warsaw, attracting thousands of runners. The route passes through the most beautiful and historic sites of the capital, offering unforgettable views and atmosphere. Each participant receives a commemorative medal and T-shirt, and spectators can enjoy numerous attractions and cheering zones. It is a celebration of running that combines sport, culture, and community.
course_highlights: Start from the Palace of Culture and Science in the center of Warsaw
The route goes through Krakowskie Przedmieście, Nowy Świat, Poniatowski Bridge with a view of the Vistula River, and PGE National Stadium
Car traffic is closed, ensuring safe and comfortable running conditions
additional: The start number must be placed on the front of the outfit and cannot be covered or modified. The start and finish are located in the city center, near the metro station. On race day, deposits, changing rooms, and toilets are available. The event features numerous attractions, cheering zones, and programs in the Marathon Fan Zone and EXPO Sport&Fitness. Participants can join the charity route #BiegamDobrze with a free start number. During the same weekend, there are also 10 km races (Warszawska Dycha) and a Mini Marathon for children and youth. Registrations can be made through the official website. The event also includes a half marathon and a 5 km run. The organization provides attractions and support for participants.

name: 13. Garmin Półmaraton Gdańsk Nocna Piątka
location: Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, Gdańsk, Pomorskie, Poland
organizer: Akademicki Związek Sportowy COSA Oddział w Gdańsku
description: Garmin Half Marathon Gdańsk is an annual running celebration held in the heart of the Tricity area, which will take place in 2026 on September 26-27. The program includes a new event - Night Five, an evening 5 km run with light illuminations, fireworks, and cheering spectators. The main part of the event is the 13th edition of the half marathon on a distance of 21.0975 km, which traditionally starts and finishes at Polsat Plus Arena in Gdańsk. The route is fast and conducive to personal bests, and the atmosphere is exceptional thanks to supporter encouragement and beautiful cityscapes.
course_highlights: Half marathon route of 21.0975 km, fast and PB-friendly
Start and finish at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk - the most beautiful stadium in Poland
Night Five - evening 5 km run with light illuminations and fireworks
additional: Start and finish at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk. The Garmin Gdańsk Half Marathon start is divided into start zones based on declared results (red, blue, green, yellow). Relays start from the blue zone. The Night Five starts in the evening of September 26, 2026, after 8:00 PM with light illuminations and fireworks. Race packets are issued at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk on September 26-27, 2026. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 1:30 PM on the half marathon day. The event also includes children's races on various distances, warm-ups, award ceremonies, and pre-registration from October 7. Participants can expect attractive cash prizes and record bonuses.

name: 16 Bieg im. Pawła Lorensa
location: Lake Paprocańskie, Tychy, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 16th Pawła Lorensa Memorial Race is an annual 10 km run organized in the picturesque scenery of Lake Paprocańskie in Tychy. The race commemorates the achievements of the outstanding runner Pawła Lorensa, who was a multiple medalist at the Polish Championships and a promoter of athletics in the region. The route is flat and fast, leading along paved pedestrian paths and cobblestone sidewalks. On race day, free children's runs are also organized, which can be registered for on the day of the event.
course_highlights: 10 km route in the scenic setting of Lake Paprocańskie
Flat and fast course along paved paths and cobblestone sidewalks
Free children's races with registration on the day of the event
additional: On race day, free children's races are held with registrations on the day of the event. The race route is flat and fast, leading along paved pedestrian paths and cobblestone sidewalks. Race on a flat, fast route around Lake Paprocańskie, includes free children’s races, registration on the day.

name: Kresowe Trail #11
description: Kresowe Trail is a series of intimate, non-commercial trail runs organized by the Kresowe Marathons Foundation, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in nature. The series mainly takes place in the Podlasie region and surrounding areas, offering two distances: Szpurt (approximately 6-8 km) and Wertep (approximately 17-21 km). The events are characterized by a limited number of participants, ensuring safety and respect for nature and local communities. The events are friendly for both beginners and experienced runners, and also include Nordic Walking competitions. The 2026 season will conclude with a final run in Michałów on September 27.
course_highlights: Two distances: Szpurt (6-8 km) and Wertep (17-21 km)
Trail routes through picturesque areas of Podlasie and surroundings
Well-marked routes with refreshment stations on the longer distance
additional: Starts at 9:00 AM (except Mielnik, where the start is at 11:00 AM). Participant limit for each event. New start numbers are required for the 2026 season. The race pack includes, among other things, a warm recovery meal, electronic timing, medical support, refreshment stations at the start, finish, and along the route, and a commemorative medal (for registrations at least 10 days before the event). Registration on the day of the race is possible until 8:40 AM, but the race pack may be incomplete. Transfer of the registration fee to another date is possible without additional charges before the online registration closes. The run is part of a trail event series, with training preparations and online registration available. The event promotes outdoor activity and sports competition in the beautiful natural surroundings of Podlasie.

name: VIII Bieg Zielonym Szlakiem Niziny Mazow...
location: Czerwonka Włościańska, Gmina Błędów, Mazowieckie, Poland
price_range: 40 zł – przelew online do dnia 25.09.2025 r., 60 zł – płatne w biurze zawodów

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 40 zł – przelew online do dnia 25.09.2025 r.

description: The 8th Green Trail Run of the Mazovian Lowland is a 5 km race scheduled for September 27, 2026, in Czerwonka Włościańska. The start and finish are located at the Primary School in Czerwonka. The event is organized by local sports clubs and institutions, and the course runs through the scenic terrain of the Mazovian Lowland. The event is open to adults and youth over 15 years old with parental consent.
course_highlights: 5 km course
Start and finish at the Primary School in Czerwonka Włościańska
Scenic terrain of the Mazovian Lowland
additional: The race office is located at the school sports field in Czerwonka. Registration of participants takes place from 08:30 to 10:00. After the race, there will be a winners' ceremony, summary, and closing of the event. The participant limit is 200 people. Timing is measured using a modern UHF RFID system with passive chips, and results are immediately displayed at the finish line and sent via SMS to participants. Terrain: 5 km course, registration from 8:30 to 10:00, limit of 200 participants, age from 15 years with parental consent, online payments or at the office.

name: X Półmaraton Crossowy
location: Nad Stawem, Jelcz-Laskowice, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 10th Toyota Cross Country Half Marathon is an off-road race taking place in Jelcz-Laskowice on September 27, 2026. The event is organized by KB Harcownik Jelcz-Laskowice, and the race office operates from 08:00 to 10:30 at the Nad Stawem center. Participants can compete in distances of 21.1 km and 10.5 km, as well as in Nordic Walking on 10.5 km. The event is supported by local institutions and partners, and timing is measured electronically using modern equipment.
course_highlights: Off-road route around Jelcz-Laskowice
Available categories: half marathon, 10.5 km run, and Nordic Walking walk
Electronic timing with visualization at the finish line
additional: Race office open from 08:00 to 10:30 on the day of the event at Nad Stawem, Jelcz-Laskowice. Timing is conducted using passive chips and measurement mats. The organizer provides race numbers and electronic timing with visualization at the finish line. Support from local partners and companies, including Toyota Motor Manufacturing Poland. Medals for participants and training preparations available for starters.

name: XXVIII Jesienne Biegi Małkińskie
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Małkini Górnej

price_tiers.distance: Jesienne Biegi Małkińskie i Marsz NW

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Zapisy na XXVIII Jesienne Biegi Małkińskie 2026r. i IX Jesienny Małkiński Marsz Nordic Walking 2026r. Szczegóły znajdziecie w linku https://dostartu.pl/chodze-biegam-nie-ulegam-na-ogom-v16267

description: The 28th Autumn Małkińskie Runs is an annual running event organized in Małkini Górna, attracting runners and Nordic walking enthusiasts. The competition takes place on cross-country routes, offering participants the opportunity to compete in a beautiful autumn scenery. The event is part of the Grand Prix in cross-country running and Nordic walking marches, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle within the local community.
course_highlights: Cross-country routes in the picturesque terrain of Małkini Górna
Autumn scenery conducive to running and Nordic walking
Event as part of the Grand Prix in cross-country running and NW marches
additional: The event is part of the Grand Prix in cross-country running and Nordic walking marches organized by the Municipal Cultural and Sports Center in Małkini Górna. Registrations are conducted through the portal dostartu.pl. The organizer provides support and information at gokis@malkiniagorna.pl. Registration for the runs is available via the dostartu.pl platform. The race includes various distances, including options for children and youth.

name: Běchovice - Praha, MČR v silničním běhu mužů, žen, juniorů a juniorek
description: Běchovice - Prague is a legendary road race over 10 km with the longest uninterrupted tradition in Europe, held for the 130th time. The race is the official Czech national championship in road running and offers a challenging course of 10,031 meters, which will test every runner. The race atmosphere is exceptional and complemented by modern facilities, including an accompanying program and commemorative medals. The race is open to a wide range of categories from juniors to veterans and also offers a relay race.
course_highlights: The course measures 10,031 meters, 31 meters longer than the traditional 10 km
Start in Běchovice, finish at Pražačka in Prague
Official Czech national championship in 10 km road running with 26 categories
additional: Start numbers are issued at the Masaryk Railway Station hall in Prague on the days before the race and on race day in Běchovice. The race offers a functional Joma T-shirt and a commemorative medal included in the registration fee. The relay race starts simultaneously with the 3rd wave of the race at 11:50, consisting of 4 members with predetermined segments. The race capacity is 3,333 runners. Photos and personalized videos from the race are free of charge. The race is part of the celebrations and tradition of running sports in Prague, offering online registration and start in Českobrodská Street in Běchovice.

name: Běh metropole Praha 1
location: Praha 1, Centrum Prahy, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic
description: The Metropole Run is a series of public running races held in various districts of Prague, aimed at promoting a healthy lifestyle and community belonging among residents. The race is open to all age categories, from children to seniors and people with disabilities, who represent their city district. Each start provides points for the competition for the most athletic district of Prague. The atmosphere is friendly and motivating, with unique medals and gifts for participants.
course_highlights: Races take place in different districts of Prague, including the city center
Support for a healthy lifestyle and community spirit among Prague residents
Categories for all age groups including people with disabilities
additional: Each participant represents their city district based on permanent residence and contributes to the point evaluation of the districts. The project emphasizes competition among Prague districts for the title of the most athletic district. Participants receive original medals and running magnets for their race bibs as souvenirs. The races feature various distances, are part of a series with medals and updates on the event locations; registration is available online and on-site.

name: Mariatálsky štvanec
description: The Marianka Run is a traditional race set in the beautiful scenery of the Little Carpathians, offering various disciplines for both hobby runners and competitive athletes. The event takes place in the village of Marianka with a family-friendly atmosphere and culminates in a stunning sunset. Participants can compete in categories of 6 km, 10 km, 15 km, in three-person teams over 3×6 km, or in children's races called Záhoráčik Run. The start and finish are at the football pitch, and the race is governed by the rules of the Slovak Athletic Federation.
course_highlights: Courses run through the Little Carpathians with beautiful nature
Family atmosphere with children's races Záhoráčik Run
Stunning sunset as the highlight of the event
additional: Registration and pickup of start numbers is available at the TUI branch in BORY MALL shopping center. The number of adult participants is limited to 500, children to 400. The number of teams is unlimited. Time limits are 1 hour for 6 km, 1:30 hours for 10 km, 2 hours for 15 km, and 1.5 hours for the 3×6 km relay. The event includes multiple courses, categories for adults, children, and relays, online and on-site registration, chip timing, refreshments and medals. The participant limit is 900.

name: MTBIKER Kylof Ľubietová
description: Kylof Ľubietová Running Race is a running event that combines history, nature, and good mood in the picturesque environment of central Slovakia. The race is held on three courses: 4.3 km hobby course for beginners and young people from 13 years old, 10 km main race for competitive and hobby runners, and children's runs over 850 meters for children aged 6 to 12. The course features climbs, beautiful views of the Low Tatras, and participants can compete for monetary prizes and valuable awards. After the race, participants can enjoy traditional granadír and an original medal belonging to the Marathon Tour.
course_highlights: 4.3 km hobby course with a nice loop and ascent
10 km course with views of the Low Tatras and a mining trail
Children's runs in the center of Ľubietová over 850 meters
additional: Children's runs start at 9:30 according to age categories, hobby course starts at 10:40, and the main race at 10:30. Each participant receives an original medal for the Marathon Tour. A granadír is prepared at the finish line. The fastest runners will receive vouchers and trophies, overall winners of the 10 km race will receive monetary prizes. All finishers are entered into a raffle for experience prizes such as a parachute jump or sightseeing flight. Trail running, registration, family event, historical themes, beautiful views.

name: Gréta Run
location: Koliba Gréta, Liptovská Sielnica, okres L. Mikuláš, Slovakia
description: Gréta Run is a traditional running race set in the picturesque environment of Kvačianska Valley and Liptovská Sielnica, offering courses of various lengths for children and adults. The race follows the yellow tourist trail and embankment, with the finish line at Gréta Cottage, where participants can enjoy refreshments and a cultural program. The event also features a rich accompanying program for families and children. Organized by the Olympic Club of Liptov, which ensures quality technical and medical services.
course_highlights: 7.4 km course from Kvačianska Valley along the yellow trail to Gréta Cottage
15 km course from Gréta Cottage through Kvačianska Valley and Prosiecka Valley back to Gréta Cottage
3 km course along the embankment to Liptovská Sielnica and back
additional: The first 200 registered participants will receive a starter pack with goulash, spaghetti, a T-shirt, and a medal. Transportation for runners to the 7.4 km start is provided by a bus at 15:30. After the race, goulash and results announcement will take place at Stodola Gréta, followed by a concert. Changing rooms and toilets are available at Gréta Cottage. The organizer is not responsible for personal belongings and luggage. There is an option for discounted accommodation directly on site. The course sections lead from Kvačianska Valley and Gréta Cottage, registration is possible online or on-site, and the registration fee includes goulash, a medal, refreshments, and other services. The race offers multiple categories, including children’s and veteran categories, with awards and prizes for winners.

description: Šamorín Running League 2026 - Round 5 is a running event organized by the 3klub Šamorín in cooperation with the town of Šamorín. The race takes place in the pleasant environment of Lesopark Pomlé in Šamorín and is intended for various age categories from preschoolers to adults. The start for children's categories is at 10:00 AM, with the main race beginning at 10:30 AM. The event offers the opportunity to join the league and experience a sporting atmosphere in a community setting.
course_highlights: Races in the natural environment of Lesopark Pomlé
Categories for children and adults
Children's start at 10:00, main race at 10:30
additional: Categories: Preschoolers (0 - 6 years), Younger pupils (7 - 10 years), Older pupils (11 - 15 years), Adults (women, men). The organizer is 3klub Šamorín o.z. in cooperation with the town of Šamorín. Contact for the organizer: Juraj Nagy, phone: 0905 984 190. Routes on asphalt and forest trails, categories from preschoolers to adults, no performance or age limit.

name: Ivančická hodinovka
location: Městský stadion Ivančice, Ivančice, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Ivančice Hour Race is a traditional athletic event organized by the Ivančice Athletic Club, held at the Ivančice Municipal Stadium. The race takes place at the stadium near Malovaný mlýn and offers a sporting experience in a pleasant city environment with a rich history. The start is scheduled for the morning, allowing participants to enjoy the race and other activities in Ivančice. The event is suitable for the general public and sports enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Race at Ivančice Municipal Stadium
Pleasant sporting environment in a historic town
Start at 10:30 AM
additional: The race is organized by the Ivančice Athletic Club at the FC Ivančice field on Malovansko. The venue is Ivančice Municipal Stadium, U Malovaného mlýna no. 1515, 664 91 Ivančice. The race offers chip timing, online and on-site registration options, and is part of the local sports tradition.

name: Svatováclavský běh Blažovicemi
organizer: Spolek přátel Svatováclavského běhu - sdružení Vévoda
description: The Svatováclavský Run in Blažovice is a traditional cross-country and trail race held in the picturesque environment of Blažovice in the South Moravian Region. It offers two main routes of 10 km and 5 km, which mainly follow natural paths and forest sections. The event also includes fun runs and children's races ranging from 50 to 1100 meters, making the race attractive to the general public and families with children. The organizer is the Association of Friends of the Svatováclavský Run, which ensures a friendly atmosphere and quality organization.
course_highlights: Cross-country and trail character of the routes
Two main routes: 10 km and 5 km
Fun runs and children's races from 50 to 1100 meters
additional: The race starts at the football field in Blažovice. The main category begins at 12:45 PM. The organizer is the Association of Friends of the Svatováclavský Run - Vévoda association, contact person František Kubínek, phone 739 150 283. The race is part of the Czech Running Club and the Czech Athletic Federation. It is part of the local running tradition and offers various race lengths including children's categories, making the event suitable for the whole family.

name: Běh Neumannovou stezkou
description: The Neumannová Trail Run is a traditional running race organized by the T. J. Sokol Unhošť running club in the picturesque forested surroundings of Unhošť. The race offers an opportunity for outdoor sports activity and is complemented by children's runs. Registered participants in advance benefit from a lower entry fee. The event has a long-standing tradition and is regularly held in the fall.
course_highlights: Picturesque forested surroundings of Unhošť
Traditional running race with children's runs
Natural terrain suitable for running
additional: The race includes children's runs. Pre-registered participants have a cheaper entry fee. Results and statistics are regularly published on the website. Trail maps are available in a photo album. The start is scheduled for September 28, 2026, at 10:00 AM. Exact registration details are not provided. The event is suitable for the general running public.

name: MilešovKa(p)
location: Teplice, Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: MilešovKa(p) is a traditional running race from Teplice to Milešovka, covering a distance of 17.5 km with an elevation gain of 846 meters. The course runs on asphalt, hiking trails, field and forest paths and is marked with red and blue signs by the Czech Tourist Club. The race is open to the general public and offers awards for the best in categories, mountain climbers, and age record holders. It is organized by the SPONA Teplice association, which supports amateur sports in the region. The results are announced together with other running events in November.
course_highlights: Distance of 17.5 km with an elevation gain of 846 m
Surface: asphalt, hiking trail, field and forest paths
Course marked with red and blue signs by the Czech Tourist Club
additional: Awards for the top five in each category, medals and diplomas, trophies for winners and teams, bonuses for mountain climbers and the fastest Václav, plaques for five and ten consecutive participations. The course is marked by the Czech Tourist Club. Results are announced in November together with BĚKODO. Registration is open until August 31, 2025. Participants will receive a T-shirt and a race medal. The race is part of a series of local runs in Teplice.

name: Běh kolem Panské skály
location: Kamenicko Šenov-Prácheň, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The run around Panská Skála is a popular trail race held on September 28, 2026, in Kamenický Šenov-Prácheň in the Liberec Region. The race offers routes of 3 km and 6 km, which lead through hilly terrain around Panská Skála, and is part of the District Running League of Česká Lípa. The event is suitable for both recreational runners and experienced competitors, providing a unique outdoor running experience with beautiful views.
course_highlights: Trail routes through hilly terrain with views of Panská Skála
Two distances: 3 km and 6 km suitable for various levels of runners
Included in the District Running League of Česká Lípa
additional: The race is supported by local organizations, results and regulations are regularly published, the event has a long tradition and attracts runners from the surrounding area as well as from across the country.

name: Podzimní běh projektantů "Od hospody k hospodě"
location: Krčský les, Praha 4-Krč, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic
description: Autumn runners' project "From pub to pub" is a traditional running event held in the picturesque environment of Krč Forest in Prague 4-Krč. This race is popular among runners and has been organized for many years, welcoming all running enthusiasts and nature lovers. Organizers Pepa Krejčí and Honza Vočko warmly invite you to participate in this popular course, which offers a pleasant experience in nature. Registrations are accepted on the day of the race approximately one hour before the start.
course_highlights: The route runs through the picturesque Krč Forest
A traditional running course popular among local runners
Pleasant natural environment in Prague 4-Krč
additional: Registrations for the race are accepted on the day of the event about 1 hour before the start. Running course in Krč Forest, event for design enthusiasts and runners

name: Festiwal Biegowy JuraRun 2026
distance_verbose: 50 mil, 50 mil, Maraton, 23 km, Półmaraton, 12 km, 10 km, 5 km
description: The JuraRun Running Festival is a unique sporting event held in the heart of the Kraków-Częstochowa Upland, combining a passion for running, competition, and the satisfaction of pushing one's limits. In 2026, as many as 9 different running events are planned, including distances from 5 km to over 100 km, as well as Nordic Walking and night running. The routes lead through picturesque landscapes, limestone rocks, forests, and Jura hills, offering both technical challenges and beautiful views. The festival is open to runners of various skill levels, providing a rich accompanying program and attractive start packages.
course_highlights: Routes lead through forests, limestone rocks, and picturesque castles of the Kraków-Częstochowa Upland
JuraRun ULTRA 100+ is over 100 km ultra with minimal asphalt, requiring technique and endurance
On the JuraRun ULTRA 100+ route, among others, Góra Zborów (467 m above sea level) and the characteristic Rzędkowickie Rocks
additional: Starts are held in waves, including the JuraRun Night 10+ night run starting at 21:00. The start package includes, among other things, timing measurement, medical support, nutrition points, a medal, a recovery meal, and the option to purchase technical clothing with personalization. Ultra routes have mandatory equipment checked before the start. During the festival, animations, expo, and lectures on running and healthy lifestyle topics are organized. 9 sporting events, installment options, lectures and meetings on running and healthy living, and online registration are available.

name: Festiwal Biegowy Silesia Marathon 2026
description: Silesia Marathon is the largest running event in Silesia, which in 2026 will take place as a three-day running festival. Participants can choose from various distances, including the marathon, half marathon, ultramarathon, as well as 10 km and 5 km runs. The finish line is located at the iconic Silesian Stadium, adding a unique character to the event. It is not only a competition but also an unforgettable experience filled with emotions and a community atmosphere of runners.
course_highlights: Finish at the Silesian Stadium in Chorzów
Routes covering various distances: marathon, half marathon, ultramarathon, 10K, and 5K
Three-day running festival with many attractions
additional: In 2026, the Silesia Marathon will be held for the first time as a three-day running festival, offering more distances and options to choose a run suited to skills and goals. Participants receive a starter pack, including a free technical T-shirt when choosing the half marathon, marathon, or ultramarathon. Registration opens on December 15, 2025. The event includes various race categories, with regulations and routes available on the website. Participants can expect support and attractions throughout the event.

name: Baran Trail Race
location: Węgierska Górka, Żywiec County, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Baran Trail Race is a series of running events held in the picturesque Węgierska Górka. The race offers a variety of distances from 10 km to 100 km, taking place on challenging mountain routes with beautiful views and natural terrain. The event attracts both amateurs and experienced runners, providing unique challenges and atmosphere. Organizers ensure a professional course and participant safety.
course_highlights: Mountain routes of varying difficulty
Picturesque views of the Beskids
Natural, forested, and rocky terrain
additional: Start and finish in Węgierska Górka. The routes lead through the Beskids with diverse terrain. The event takes place on October 2-3, 2026. Four distances are available: 10 km, 25 km, 60 km, and 100 km. There are refreshment points along the course and medical support. The event offers different participant categories, as well as an archive of results and event partners.

description: The Karel Havlíček Borovský Run is a traditional circuit race in Havlíčkův Brod, offering routes for various age groups from young children to adults. The course runs through the Budoucnost park and past significant sites such as the memorial to the victims of the world wars and the statue of Karel Havlíček Borovský. The race is suitable for all age groups and features a combination of asphalt and unpaved paths with gentle elevation. The start and finish are at the elementary school V Sadech 560, where showers and toilets are available.
course_highlights: Circuit route through Budoucnost park
Passes by the memorial to the victims of World War I and II and the statue of Karel Havlíček Borovský
Highest point of the course at Calvary with three crosses
additional: Start and finish at elementary school V Sadech 560. Showers and toilets available at the school building. Parking is available in several nearby locations, some with a fee, others free. Runners from 3 years old and above can participate. Youth up to 17 years old start for free. The event includes various age categories, with online and on-site registration options, parking nearby. Races are held at the Elementary School Havlíčkův Brod and around the park.

name: ING Biegnij Warszawo
description: ING Run Warsaw is one of the most recognizable running events in Poland, attracting thousands of participants to the heart of the capital every year. The race takes place on the first Saturday of October and offers a 10-kilometer route through the most characteristic places of Warsaw. The FUNRUN formula emphasizes the joy of movement, without pressure or competition, encouraging running, walking, or jogging at your own pace. Along the route, participants are supported by music zones, cheerleaders, and motivating partner points, and each participant receives a commemorative Nike Dri-FIT shirt and a medal at the finish line.
course_highlights: 10 km route through the most atmospheric and characteristic places of Warsaw
Music zones and cheerleaders along the entire route
Hydration zone at the halfway point and comprehensive medical support
additional: The start package includes a Nike Dri-FIT shirt with a commemorative print, a start number with a chip for timing, gifts from partners, and a commemorative medal. Package pickup is available at Legia Sports Bar at Legia Warsaw Stadium from September 29 to October 3, 2026, with a recommendation for early collection. Drivers using catering services receive 2 hours of free parking. The route is certified by PZLA and is friendly for beginner runners. The event attracts over 6,000 participants, and the route has been changed to the right bank of the Vistula River, with significant involvement from ING employees and a charity collection.

name: XIII Podbieg na Makowicę
location: Rytro, Nowy Sącz County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 13th Makowica Ascent is a mountain race covering a distance of 10 km, scheduled to take place on October 3, 2026, in Rytro, Lesser Poland. The race route features a challenging profile with ascents, making it an excellent challenge for runners who enjoy mountain trails. Organizers encourage preparation with dedicated training plans tailored to various skill levels. The event is part of the TreningBiegacza.pl running calendar, which promotes running activity and supports runners in their preparations.
course_highlights: Mountain trail of 10 km
Challenging ascents on the route
Scenic views around Rytro
additional: Training plans are available from 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to the runner's VDOT level, with instructions and expert support. Organizers encourage using the TreningBiegacza.pl platform, which offers support in preparations and managing race information. The event focuses on trail running, and registration details have not yet been announced. The race is an opportunity to spend active time in the beautiful surroundings of Rytro.

name: PUMA Třeboňský půl/maraton 10 a 5 km
description: The Třeboň Marathon, half marathon, 10 km, and 5 km are races set in the unique natural environment of the Třeboňsko Protected Landscape Area. The routes are flat with minimal elevation gain, mostly on asphalt cycle paths and forest roads, allowing runners to achieve personal bests in a beautiful and peaceful setting. The race starts at the Renaissance square in Třeboň and passes through a historic gate into a nature reserve that is a candidate for UNESCO World Heritage status. The ideal date in October offers pleasant running weather and an inspiring atmosphere with professional pacemakers on the course.
course_highlights: Flat routes with minimal elevation gain in the protected natural area of Třeboňsko
Most of the course runs on asphalt cycle paths and quality forest roads
Start at the Renaissance square and pass through a historic gate into a UNESCO candidate nature reserve
additional: Registration allows for a refund of the entry fee until September 8, 2026, with an administrative fee of 150 CZK, transfer of the registration to another year until September 30, 2026, and after the race, the possibility to receive a voucher for running shoes worth 777 CZK. The race is limited in participant numbers and registration transfer to another runner is not possible. Included in the registration is a free 12-month subscription to the magazine Svět běhu. Routes are available for download in .GPX format. The race includes a half marathon, 10 km, and 5 km, supported by regional authorities, with the option to purchase gift vouchers. The event takes place in October 2026.

description: Run Berounka Run is a relay race for teams and individuals, running along the Berounka River from Újezd u Svatého Kříže to Prague Radotín. The 130 km route is divided into 6 sections with a total elevation gain of over 3100 meters, mostly on forest and field paths. The race starts on October 3, 2026, at 5:00 AM in several waves, with the Ultra category starting on the evening of October 2. The race is intended for teams of 2 to 6 runners and individuals in the Ultra category, with winners announced in several categories and refreshments provided at the finish line.
course_highlights: 130 km route along the Berounka River divided into 6 sections
Total elevation gain of 3182 m, mainly on forest and field paths
Start in Újezd u Svatého Kříže, finish in Prague Radotín at the Říční Lázně kiosk
additional: Start takes place in waves from 5:00 AM, the Ultra category starts on October 2 at 8:00 PM and at midnight. The time limit for completing one section for teams is 4 hours. Each team receives a starter pack with bib numbers, a GPS chip, and gifts from sponsors. Mobile toilets are available at relay points. Refreshments are provided at the Říční Lázně kiosk at the finish. The maximum number of teams is 80, with up to 6 runners per team, and in the Ultra category, a maximum of 55 individuals. The race begins in Újezd u Svatého Kříže and ends in Prague Radotín, with registration open from November 1, 2025, to September 20, 2026. The Ultra category starts on Friday evening. The route mainly runs on forest and field paths with a total elevation gain of 3182 meters.

name: 24DS (24 Dlouhé Stráně)
location: Kouty nad Desnou, Jeseníky, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1

description: The 24DS is a 24-hour endurance challenge in the unique environment of the Hrubý Jeseník mountains, leading from Kouty nad Desnou to the upper reservoir of the Dlouhé Stráně pumped-storage hydroelectric plant. The race offers stunning views of the Jeseníky and combines daytime and nighttime running with sunrise and sunset. The route is demanding, with an elevation gain of 820 meters and 90% trail surface, suitable for individuals and pairs. The Kouty nad Desnou area provides comfortable facilities including restaurants, accommodation, and parking.
course_highlights: 14.7 km loop with an elevation gain of 820 m
90% trail surface
Views from the upper reservoir of Dlouhé Stráně at an altitude of 1354 m above sea level
additional: Registration runs from May 1, 2026, to August 30, 2026, or until capacity is reached. Each participant must have a GPS tracker, which is activated on race day during check-in. The start package includes a voucher for a cable car ride to view the route. Participants can switch in pairs at will. It is mandatory to follow the rules and have a functioning mobile phone on the route. The organizer provides map materials and marks the route with white spray paint and yellow flags. At the finish line, it is necessary to submit the chip and GPS tracker. The race takes place on October 3, 2026, offers nearby accommodation options, and is associated with supporting the MORAVA FLOW projects.

name: Běh kolem Hejtmanu
location: Chlum u Třeboně, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Hejtman Run is a traditional sporting event held in Chlum u Třeboně in the Třeboň region, always on the second Saturday of October. The main race is a 10 km run with a time limit of 1 hour and 20 minutes, taking place on local roads and dikes of ponds in a picturesque environment. The race is open to the public and takes place amidst regular road traffic with an emphasis on safety and adherence to rules. Shorter races are prepared for children and youth up to 15 years old, with presentations directly on site on the day of the race. The organizer is TJ Jiskra Chlum u Třeboně, z.s.
course_highlights: The route of the main race passes over the dike of Hejtman Pond and Staňkovský Pond dike
The race takes place on local roads with scenic views of Třeboňsko
Start and finish are at the TJ Jiskra Chlum u Třeboně stadium
additional: Registration for competitors takes place on the day of the race from 8:30 to 10:15 at the TJ Jiskra Chlum u Třeboně stadium, where race numbers and chips for the 10 km main race are issued. Participants run at their own risk and must follow traffic rules. For younger competitors up to 18 years old, accompaniment by a legal guardian or a declaration is required. The race is conducted on local roads and a shale track, with registration possible on-site and online. The start is within the stadium area. The races are open to all age groups with different distance options.

name: ČEZ RunTour Praha
distance_verbose: Maraton, Půlmaraton, 10 km, 5 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: CEZ RunTour Prague is a family running race offering courses for hobby runners and elites in lengths of 3, 5, 10, and 21.1 km, including children's runs of 500 and 1000 meters. The race takes place in the beautiful environment of Ladronka Park and is part of a nationwide series of eight unique locations. Organizers emphasize perfect service, safety, and fun for the whole family, including an accompanying program and a charitable aspect. Each participant receives a start package and has the opportunity to contribute to charity through their participation.
course_highlights: Courses of 3, 5, 10, and 21.1 km in Ladronka Park
Children's runs of 500 and 1000 meters
Perfect service including guides and medical team
additional: On the course, there are guides, a medical team, and refreshment stations (1 at 5 and 10 km, at least 2 at the half marathon). Each runner receives a gymsack with gifts, children receive a start package from Lidl. There is a children's zone, warm-up sessions for children, and an accompanying program for families. A special emergency phone line is available for the race. More courses, family activities, charitable support, medals, photographs, refreshments, and facilities for participants.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - říjen
description: The 2-mile run in Zlín - Příluky is an open race covering 3.2 km, suitable for all age groups and running levels, from beginners to experienced runners. The course mainly runs between gardens in the Příluky industrial zone and consists of less than two laps on a precisely measured asphalt track. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month with registration in front of the Madal Bal company building and starts at 9:00 AM. At the finish line, each participant is rewarded with a warm cinnamon flatbread as a token of appreciation.
course_highlights: Precisely measured asphalt track of 3.2 km (2 miles)
The course mostly runs between gardens in the Příluky industrial zone
Children's course is 800 m long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 and older, and children up to 12 years old. Time is recorded for each runner, and the top three places in men's, women's, and children's categories receive small prizes. The recommended access to the start is by bicycle, on foot, by car, roller skates, or trolleybus no. 11 (stop Průmyslová zóna). Regular monthly race, 3.2 km course, road surface, running for all age groups, children's course 800 m, with options to arrive by bike, car, or trolleybus no. 11.

location: Flemmichova zahrada, Rýmařov, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: zdarma pro děti do 14 let, 150 Kč pro ostatní při online přihlášení, 200 Kč při prezenci na místě

description: The Čerťák Run is a traditional race organized by AK Běžci z Rýmařova, held at the Flemmichovi Garden area in Rýmařov. The race offers routes for various age categories from preschoolers to seniors, with the main trail passing through forest paths and the summit of Kamenná Hora. The start is at the SKI Flemmichova Garden area, and the course includes running on field roads, meadows, and forest trails with beautiful views. After the race, refreshments and results announcements are provided at the SKI area. The race is part of the Great Prize of endurance runners of the Olomouc Region, and winners in categories receive material prizes.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the SKI Flemmichova Garden area
Run over the summit of Kamenná Hora (799 m above sea level) with Čerťák's swinging bridge
Forest and field roads with beautiful views
additional: Registration at the SKI area facilities in Flemdě from 9:30 to 10:30. Men’s categories D, E, and all women run a shortened course. After the race, refreshments: beer, soft drinks, coffee, tea. Results are announced at the SKI area after all competitors have finished. The course includes forest paths and meadows, online registration until October 3, 2025, start at the SKI area in Flemdě. The race takes place on October 3, 2026.

name: Benešovská osmička
location: Benešov u Semil, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: Benešovská osmička is a traditional cross-country race in Benešov u Semil, which has been held for over half a century. The race offers courses for the whole family, from preschool children to veterans, with the main race covering 8,000 meters through picturesque countryside around the village and on the slopes of Benešov Hill. The start and facilities are located in the sports complex in Horní Benešov. Prizes and light refreshments are prepared for all participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Main course of 8,000 m mainly runs through meadows, field and forest paths of varying quality
Children's courses run on asphalt within the area
Surroundings of the village and slopes of Benešov Hill (567 m above sea level)
additional: Registration and check-in take place at the start area from 12:30 PM, no later than 15 minutes before the start of each category. The race is divided into categories: preschool children (50 and 100 m), pupils (400 - 1200 m), youth, women, men, veterans (courses of 2,250 m and 8,000 m). The top three finishers in each category will receive material prizes. Light refreshments are available for participants and spectators. Various courses from 50 m to 8 km, family event, refreshments, material prizes.

name: Běh města Příbrami
price_range: dospělí - předem 200 Kč, na místě 300 Kč; štafety - předem 400 Kč, na místě 600 Kč; děti a studenti zdarma; rodinné startovné 200 Kč
description: The Příbram City Run is a traditional running race held for the 32nd time in the picturesque environment of Nový Rybník in Příbram. The race offers various categories including the main 10 km race, relays, and children's runs, allowing participation from a wide range of runners. The event is suitable for families, students, and individuals who want to enjoy a sports day with a friendly atmosphere. Start times and registration are adjusted for each category to ensure everything runs smoothly and organized.
course_highlights: Main 10 km race in the natural environment of Nový Rybník
Categories for children, adults, family and student relays
Traditional race with over thirty years of history
additional: Registration from 8:00 to 10:30 for children, from 10:30 to 11:00 for adults. The school category starts at 9:00, the main 10 km race and relays start at 11:30. Conditions for family relays require a familial relationship, student relays must be composed of students from elementary, secondary, or university schools with possible status verification at registration. Start from 8:00, the main 10 km race begins at 11:30, registration from 8:00 to 10:30, various categories including relays and children.

name: Mattoni Liberec Trail Run
location: Liberec, Jizerské hory, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: Mattoni Liberec Trail Run is an outdoor race that offers runners the chance to escape the city hustle and enjoy running through forest trails of the Jizerské Mountains. The race is the final event of the season and takes place through the woods, around the dam, through a granite quarry, and back. Runners can choose between a shorter 12 km route and a longer 22 km route, allowing them to test their strength in beautiful natural scenery.
course_highlights: Forest trails of the Jizerské Mountains
Running around the dam
Passing through a granite quarry
additional: The race takes place on October 3, 2026, with staggered starts from 10:00 to 12:15. There are two routes available: 12 km and 22 km. The event includes an accompanying program and a virtual package. It is part of the RunCzech running league and is in its ninth edition with approximately 2000 participants. The terrain includes forest trails, and the race offers various categories. Registration is possible via a code, and the race map is available in JPG/PNG and GPX formats. Family races are also part of the event.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - říjen
description: The 2-mile run in Prague's Stromovka Park is an open race for all age groups and running levels, whether running for fun, aiming to improve personal bests, or just enjoying a pleasant run in a beautiful park. The course runs along asphalt paths in Stromovka Park, with adults running two laps (3.2 km) and children under 12 running one lap (1.6 km). After the race, everyone is rewarded with a warm cinnamon pancake. The race is part of the year-round Pancake Cup, which encourages regular participation and performance reflection.
course_highlights: The course runs along asphalt paths in Stromovka Park
Adults run 2 laps (3.2 km), children 1 lap (1.6 km)
After the race, a warm cinnamon pancake for all participants
additional: Registration takes place at the Brussels Gate area from 8:15 to 8:45, with the option of pre-registration online for faster check-in. Recommended transportation includes cycling, walking, rollerblading, or tram (stop Výstaviště). Parking is available at the bridge to Císařský Island on Za elektrárnou street. There are changing tents, a mobile valuables storage, and WC cabins. Categories are divided by age and gender, with times measured for each participant and results published online. Adjusted times based on age coefficient count towards the Pancake Cup. The 3.2 km course starts in Stromovka Park, with pre-registration available and on-site registration. The race is suitable for all age groups and running levels.
