description: SILESIA cross 1/2 marathon is a traditional cross-country running race held in Opava-Kylešovice with the center at the U Chovatelů area. The race offers courses of 21 km and 13 km, which pass through scenic locations such as Raduň, Vršovice, Chvalíkovice, Hradec nad Moravicí, Branka, and Opava. The course is challenging and partially runs on roads with full traffic, requiring participants to follow fair-play rules and respect nature. Timing is measured electronically without chips, and the results are announced at the finish area. The race is canceled for 2026, but information about previous editions and courses is available.
course_highlights: The route passes through Raduň, Vršovice, Chvalíkovice, Hradec nad Moravicí, Branka, and Opava
The race takes place on roads with full traffic, with electronic timing without chips
Course adjustments due to fenced private land; the 21 km course does not lead to Radun Castle
additional: Participant registration takes place at the race center on Friday from 17:00 to 19:00 and on Saturday from 7:30 to 9:00. The start is at the playground behind the elementary school in Raduň, with the finish at the U Chovatelů area in Opava-Kylešovice. The race occurs on roads with full traffic; participants run at their own risk. Timing is electronic without chips. Due to a small number of participants in the short courses, the 750 m, 1500 m, 3 km, and 5 km races start directly at the finish area. The course is marked year-round, with additional portable signage and course officials. Entry fees increase from October 1, 2025, to 350 CZK for 21 km, 250 CZK for 13 km, and 150 CZK for shorter distances. If the fee is paid by September 26, participants can have a start number with their name. Registration usually takes place in October. The event offers various courses and is known for its specific cross-country terrain. In the past, course changes occurred due to private land.

name: Běh zámeckým parkem
location: Zámecký park ve Vlašimi, Vlašim, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Castle Park Run is a running race held in the picturesque environment of Vlašim Castle Park. The course, 8.4 km long, combines trail and asphalt sections, offering runners a diverse experience. The race is organized by Atletika Vlašim, z.s., and is part of the official Czech Running calendar. The event is suitable for runners who want to experience running in a beautiful park with a historic atmosphere.
course_highlights: Course runs through Vlašim Castle Park
Combination of trail and asphalt sections
Course length of 8.4 km
additional: The race is part of a running series and offers various course lengths, including trail and asphalt sections.

name: Z(a)tracené vrchy
description: Z(a)tracené vrchy is an adrenaline-filled orienteering-beer running-walking-crawling race in teams, held in the picturesque terrain of Bordovice in the Moravian-Silesian Region. Participants must complete the course with a 10-liter beer barrel on their back, complete mini-games at stations, and drink beer at the stations. The race combines physical challenge with team cooperation and fun, with the route passing through varied terrain with ascents and descents. The winning team receives a traveling trophy and gift packages. The event is intended for adults over 18 years old and emphasizes safety and participant responsibility.
course_highlights: The route passes through varied terrain with ascents and descents
Completing the course with a 10-liter beer barrel on the back
Five control stations with mini-games and beer consumption
additional: Mandatory equipment includes a charged phone, a tap (bayonet), a pump, a barrel harness, a trash bag, and a headlamp. Recommended equipment is a basic first aid kit, water, and nutritious food. Beer may only be consumed at control stations, where it is served from a single competition container with a maximum of 0.5 liters. The start of barrel distribution is from 7:30 to 7:35 at the start location. The race is intended for participants over 18 years old who sign a declaration of personal responsibility. The use of transportation devices other than trekking poles is prohibited. The event is part of the ultratrail series, with results from 2024 available, and is aimed at experienced runners seeking a challenge in demanding terrain.

name: Běh Pístovickou riviérou
location: Pístovice, Vyškov, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Pístovická Riviera Run is a traditional cross-country race held on forest paths above the recreational area Pístovická Riviera in Pístovice near Vyškov. The race is open to all enthusiasts of healthy movement, from children to adults, and takes place in all weather conditions. The course is uneven, with possible puddles and mud, and includes running and walking uphill and downhill. The organizers from the Vyškov Ski Club warmly invite competitors and spectators to participate and support sports in the region.
course_highlights: Forest paths above the recreational area Pístovická Riviera
Uneven terrain with potential puddles and mud
Cross-country character with runs uphill and downhill
additional: The course is not closed, participants must follow the organizers' instructions. The race takes place regardless of weather, only extreme conditions may cause postponement or cancellation. Runners under 15 years must be accompanied by a person over 18 years old, participants under 18 must have written consent from a legal guardian. A bib number is mandatory and must be visibly worn on the chest. The use of skates, bikes, trekking poles, and shortening the course is prohibited. The race is open to all age groups, offering a rich program, refreshments, and activities for children. The event is supported by the town of Vyškov and Lesy České republiky, s.p.

name: Cibulka - Košířský okruh
description: Cibulka - Košířský okruh is a popular running race held in the Prague district of Košíře, offering a course approximately 4.5 km long. This race is part of a series of local running events and is suitable for both recreational runners and those looking to improve their performance in a natural environment. The course runs through forest paths and trails around the Cibulka lookout tower, providing a pleasant and varied setting for running. The event is suitable for all age groups and running levels, emphasizing the joy of movement in nature.
course_highlights: Course approximately 4.5 km long with forest paths and trails
Natural environment around the Cibulka lookout tower in Prague 5
Opportunity to participate as a recreational or competitive runner
additional: The race takes place in Prague 5-Košíře, with the start near the bus stop 'U lesíka'.

name: Běh za bořetickým burčákem
price_range: 150 Kč / 6 EUR pro hlavní závod, zdarma pro mládežnické kategorie
description: Run for Bořetice Burčák is a traditional sporting event held in the picturesque wine-growing village of Bořetice in the heart of the Blue Mountains. The run offers participants the opportunity to experience beautiful scenery with vineyards and wine cellars, which are characteristic of this South Moravian region. The event is organized by the Cultural Committee of Bořetice, SDH Bořetice, and the Kraví Hora Republic and is part of the village's rich cultural calendar. The run is scheduled to start in the afternoon of October 3, 2026, at Sóla near the cultural house.
course_highlights: The route passes through picturesque wine-growing landscapes of Bořetice and Kraví Hora
Surroundings of wine cellars and fertile vineyards
Start and finish at the cultural house in Bořetice
additional: The event is organized by the Cultural Committee of Bořetice, SDH Bořetice, and the Kraví Hora Republic. The race starts at Sóla near the cultural house. Bořetice offers a rich cultural and sports program, complemented by other events throughout the year. The race includes running on asphalt, registration begins at 13:20, there is a bouncy castle for children, and after the race, participants can taste burčák and local specialties.

name: Jarabský polmaratón
description: Jarabský half marathon is a unique mountain trail race in the Low Tatras with a length of 22.1 km, offering a challenging route full of ascents, descents, and technical terrain. The race is intended for trail running enthusiasts and active recreation lovers who can enjoy beautiful views and the atmosphere of a community of runners from professionals to recreational athletes. The event has been held since 2015 and carries the spirit of a friendly running gathering "Go as you can around Jarabá." In 2025, it is included in the Slovak Skyrunning League, emphasizing its quality and challenge.
course_highlights: The route passes through pristine nature, forests, and mountain trails
Challenging trail terrain with ascents and descents
Beautiful views of the central ridge of the Low Tatras
additional: The course features elements of a true Sky Race and has been part of the Slovak Skyrunning League since 2025. The race is open to a broad community of runners from professionals to recreational athletes. In the past, the course has been adjusted several times depending on weather conditions; the current length is 22.1 km. The event has a friendly atmosphere and originates from an informal running gathering without timing. It is a demanding mountain trail with an elevation gain of 1240 meters, registration via the website, refreshment stations, marking, medical services, and technologies to enhance the experience.

name: Karpaty Run – Bratislava Trail Run
location: Malokarpatské Námestie 1, Bratislava - Lamač, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: Karpaty Run - Bratislava Trail Run is the largest trail running festival in the Little Carpathians, offering routes of various lengths and difficulties for runners and hikers. The race takes place in a pleasant natural environment with an emphasis on nature conservation and a healthy lifestyle. The routes mainly pass through forest roads and trails with minimal asphalt surface, suitable for intermediate to advanced runners. The organizer is the civic association Hojta, which promotes sports and ecological values.
course_highlights: Routes pass 65% through forest roads and 33-35% through forest trails
Elevation gain ranges from 80 m to 876 m depending on the route length
Refreshments available on the course at multiple locations depending on the route length
additional: The start is 700 meters from Malokarpatské námestie in Lamač, with a transfer 20 minutes before the start. There is no time limit for most routes, except for the longest ones, where the limit is 5 or 7 hours. Refreshment stations are available along the course according to the route length. Refreshments can be purchased at Biely Kríž. The race takes place on October 3, 2026. Registration is possible through the official website. Race categories include various age groups. Most distances are without a time limit.

name: U.S.Steel Family Run – Minimaratón
description: U. S. Steel Family Run - Mini Marathon is a running event in Košice that is part of the traditional International Peace Marathon. Runners of all age categories are welcome without age restrictions. The event is governed by the rules of World Athletics and the Slovak Athletic Federation, with organizers ensuring quality preparation and organization. The start and finish are located on Main Street in Košice, allowing for an attractive city run.
course_highlights: The course runs through the city center of Košice along Main Street
The event is suitable for all age groups without age limit
Organized according to the rules of World Athletics and the Slovak Athletic Federation
additional: The start time cannot be moved to the next year. Moving the start to a new participant is possible under certain conditions. Registration and payment of the entry fee are checked online through the runner's account. Registration is open to all interested, with participants expecting a friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to take part in a short but dynamic run in the heart of Košice.

name: 25 Poznań Maraton
description: The 25th Poznań Marathon named after Maciej Frankiewicz is a jubilee, 25th edition of the royal distance of 42.195 km, which will take place on October 4, 2026, in Poznań. The race has been attracting thousands of runners and spectators for a quarter of a century, offering a new, attractive route starting and ending at the International Fairgrounds in Poznań. Organizers ensure professional medical security, timing measurement, and a rich start package. This is a unique sports celebration with strong support from Poznań fans and a rich tradition.
course_highlights: New, attractive route starting and ending at the International Fairgrounds in Poznań
Royal marathon distance of 42.195 km
Jubilee, 25th edition with rich tradition and support from local fans
additional: The start package includes a bib with a chip, safety pins, sponsor materials, professional timing, medical security, nutrition points with isotonic drinks, water, chocolate, fruits, and sugar. The organizer provides free accommodation for 600 people in POSiR sports halls on October 3-4, 2026; participants must bring their own mats and sleeping bags. Numerous parking lots are available near MTP with various prices. Participants of the OK Poznań program receive a 25% discount, and seniors 60+ get a 50% reduction. An official marathon t-shirt can be ordered until September 1, 2026, for 70 PLN. Registration is open until October 1, 2026, with discounts for seniors and program participants, official gadgets and sportswear available, as well as accompanying events like Poznań Run Expo and Kids Marathon.

description: The Olsztyn Half Marathon is an annual race covering a half marathon distance (21.1 km) around the picturesque Ukiel Lake in Olsztyn. The course is mixed, including asphalt, cobblestone, hardened gravel paths, and forest trails, making it attractive and varied for runners. The event is accompanied by 5 km races and children's races, creating a sports atmosphere for the whole family. Organizers provide at least two refreshment zones along the route and professional race office support. It is an excellent opportunity to combine sport with the beauty of nature and active recreation.
course_highlights: Course length of 21.1 km around Ukiel Lake
Mixed surface: asphalt, cobblestone, gravel, forest trails
At least 2 refreshment zones along the route
additional: Start packages can be collected on 13.09.2025 from 14:00 to 20:00 and on race day from 8:00 to 10:45 at the race office at CRS UKIEL. Collection of packages is only in person. The time limit to complete the half marathon is 3 hours, and for the 5 km race 45 minutes. Registration on race day is not possible. The course is not certified by PZLA. The event includes various distances, including the half marathon, 5 km, relays, and the Family Mile. Participants can expect start packages, medals, finisher photos, insurance, and on-site attractions.

name: Wild Run
organizer: Fundacja Zoo Wrocław – DODO i Zoo Wrocław Sp. z o.o.

description: Wild Run is a charity run organized in Wrocław, with the route passing through the Wrocław Zoo area. The event aims to support the protection of endangered animal species living in Poland, and participants can also run virtually on any route. The main race consists of two loops of approximately 5 km each, and there are also runs for children and youth. All participants receive commemorative medals, and the top runners receive prizes from sponsors.
course_highlights: The main route is two loops of about 5 km each within Wrocław Zoo
Virtual run on any route, 10 km distance
Runs for children (100 m) and youth (about 1 km) with medals and prizes
additional: Start packages are issued on the race day from 12:00 to 15:30 at the zoo ticket offices. It is possible to order an extended package with a T-shirt, towel, or race bib belt. Participants of the main race are asked to return their race bibs, which will be used in subsequent editions. Shipping of start packages for the virtual race is carried out according to the registration deadline. The event includes various attractions, costume contests, support for animal protection, and the opportunity to participate in a virtual run. The run is part of activities promoting nature conservation and an active lifestyle.

name: XRUN Wielki Finał
location: Domu Zdrojowego CECHINI, Żegiestów-Zdrój, Małopolskie, Poland
description: The Grand Finale XRUN is a mountain trail run taking place on October 4, 2026, in Żegiestów-Zdrój, with the base at the CECHINI Spa House. Participants can choose from four distances: 40 km with an elevation gain of 1800 m, 28 km with 1300 m elevation gain, 18 km with 900 m elevation gain, and shorter distances for children. The routes pass through picturesque mountains, offering technical descents and challenging ascents, making the race attractive for mountain enthusiasts. The event is a perfect culmination of the running season, combining intensity with the beauty of mountain nature.
course_highlights: 40 km route with 1800 m elevation gain, start at 08:00, time limit 8 hours
28 km route with 1300 m elevation gain, start at 09:00, time limit 6 hours
18 km route with 900 m elevation gain, start at 09:30, time limit 4 hours
additional: Race office and start/finish for all distances at the CECHINI Spa House. Age categories for children from 3 to 15 years on distances of 150, 300, 500, 800, 1000 meters. Time limits for individual distances: 8h (40 km), 6h (28 km), 4h (18 km). The routes pass through Pusta Wielka, Jaworzynka, Bacówka PTTK near Wierchomla, and other mountain trails. Participants must be at least 16 years old (younger with written guardian consent). The event also includes family runs for kids and is the finale of the mountain running series in Poland, ending the season at the highest sporting and community level.

description: The 15th Legnica Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Legnica, attracting runners from various parts of Poland. The half marathon course runs through the picturesque streets of the city, offering participants the opportunity to test their endurance and enjoy a sporting atmosphere. The event is organized by the Sports and Recreation Center in Legnica, which ensures professional organization and participant safety. It is an excellent opportunity to spend active time and connect with the running community.
course_highlights: The course runs through the center of Legnica and surrounding streets
Flat profile of the route conducive to achieving good results
Picturesque city views and a sporting atmosphere
additional: The starter package includes a race number, a timing chip, and a commemorative medal. There are nutrition and medical points along the route. After the race, a refreshment is organized for participants. The participant limit is set, and registrations are conducted online. Registration for the race is on October 4, 2026, in Legnica, with various distances available. The event is promoted on Facebook.

name: OLFINCAR HRADECKÝ PŮL/MARATON
location: Malšovický stadion, Hradec Králové, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: OLFINCAR Hradecký Half Marathon is the largest sporting event in Eastern Bohemia, held since 2013. The race offers certified routes including a marathon, half marathon, relay race, 10 km run, and children's races. The course is among the fastest in the Czech Republic and is considered one of the most beautiful city routes. In 2026, the race will also host the Czech Republic Veteran Half Marathon Championship and the Czech Republic Rescue and Security Forces Half Marathon Championship. The facilities of the new football arena in the city center provide comfortable services for participants.
course_highlights: Certified routes with a fast profile
Course among the fastest in the Czech Republic
Facilities of the new football arena in the center of Hradec Králové
additional: Start times: 11:15 AM (marathon), 12:30 PM (half marathon and 10 km), 12:40 PM (charity run). Facilities include changing rooms, baggage storage, toilets, catering, parking, and clothing sales. The starter pack includes an original medal, a gift, a start number, and an electronic chip for timing. Refreshments are provided during the race and at the finish line. Photos and diplomas are available for download (not guaranteed for everyone). There is an accompanying program and prizes for 1st-3rd place in categories. Races include half marathon, marathon, 10 km run, and children's races, with a limit of 3,500 runners, chip timing, and certified routes.

name: Horský běh Alfrédka - Memoriál Miroslava Čermáka
location: Stará Ves u Rýmařova, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Alfrédka Mountain Run - Miroslav Čermák Memorial is a race mainly run on forest paths, covering a distance of 13.6 km with an elevation gain of 430 meters. The race is part of the Great Prize of Runners of the Olomouc Region and the Czech Mountain Running Cup. It offers a challenging route in the beautiful nature of the Moravian-Silesian Region, which will delight mountain running and endurance discipline enthusiasts. The race takes place in Stará Ves u Rýmařova and is suitable for experienced runners seeking a terrain challenge.
course_highlights: Distance of 13.6 km mainly on forest paths
Elevation gain of 430 m
Part of the Great Prize of Runners of the Olomouc Region and the Czech Mountain Running Cup
additional: The race is part of running series and cups, scheduled for October 4, 2026.

name: Běh okolo Panoramy
description: The Panorama Run is a traditional cross-country race in the challenging mountain terrain around the Jáchymov football stadium. This race is open to all age groups and has been held for the 33rd time. The event is organized by the Jáchymov Physical Education Union and offers sporting activity in the beautiful environment of the Ore Mountains.
course_highlights: Challenging mountain terrain around TJ Jáchymov football stadium
Traditional cross-country race with a long history (33rd edition)
Suitable for all age groups
additional: The race starts at the TJ Jáchymov football field. The event is open to the general public and all age categories. The race takes place in the demanding mountain terrain of the Ore Mountains around Jáchymov. The event is suitable for all age groups; registration details are not explicitly provided. The course runs through mountain terrain around Jáchymov.

description: The Orlice Valley Run is a traditional cross-country race held in Klášterec nad Orlicí, offering courses through meadows and local roads with hilly terrain. The race is part of the ISCAREX cup and is suitable for a wide range of runners, including children and adults. Winners can expect medals, material prizes, and monetary awards. The start and finish are located at the football field near the school, with the main race beginning in the morning.
course_highlights: Cross-country courses through meadows and local roads
3 km loop with 60 m elevation gain
Combination of flat and hilly sections with grassy and field paths
additional: Registrations on site from 8:30 AM. The main race starts at 11:15 AM. Prizes for winners include diplomas, medals, material prizes, and monetary awards for the best in the 6 km and 9 km races. The 9 km course is run in three loops of 3 km each, the 6 km course in two loops. The 3 km loop has an elevation gain of 60 m. Hilly terrain, trail/cross-country, various race lengths, on-site registration, refreshments, and a raffle of start numbers.

name: Slatinský kros
location: Park Terénky, Dědická, Brno-Slatina, Brno, Czech Republic
description: The Slatinský cross-country race is a traditional cross-country running event held in Brno-Slatina, now in its 19th year. The race takes place in Terénky Park on Dědická Street and offers a grassy course with a hilly profile, challenging runners in a pleasant natural environment. The race is under the auspices of the Brno-Slatina City District and is suitable for the general public. Participants can expect cups, medals, and valuable material prizes.
course_highlights: Grassy course with a hilly profile
Terénky Park in Brno-Slatina
Cross-country run in a natural environment
additional: Prizes include cups, medals, and valuable material prizes. Online registration will be launched in summer 2026. The race is under the auspices of the Brno-Slatina City District. The race offers cups, medals, and material prizes; registration is possible online, and the course runs through Terénky Park in Brno-Slatina.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - říjen
description: The 2-Mile Run Olomouc is an open race over 2 miles (3.2 km) designed for all age groups and running levels, from beginners to experienced runners. The race focuses on the joy of running and competition primarily with oneself. The event takes place in Smetanovy sady in Olomouc near the fountain, except for some races in June and August, which are held by the river. The run is part of a cup competition, where results are adjusted according to age coefficient and points are accumulated throughout the year.
course_highlights: Distance of 2 miles (3.2 km) with a children's category over 600 m
Event location in Smetanovy sady in Olomouc near the fountain
Races by the river on U Dětského domova street in June and August
additional: Registration takes place from 9:30 to 10:00 AM on race day. The top three places are announced in each category. Results are adjusted according to age coefficient and points are accumulated within the cup competition from September 2025 to August 2026. The course runs on asphalt paths in Smetanovy sady; registration is voluntary, the race is held on October 4, 2026; a children's race over 600 m is also part of the event.

name: Roštejnské stráně
location: Ranč u Lipek, Telč, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Roštejnské stráně is a traditional cross-country run organized by Orel Telč, which is part of the Orel Running League. This 14th edition takes place in the beautiful environment near Ranch u Lipek in Telč and offers runners various categories including family relays and a popular run for beginners. The race is open to all age groups and emphasizes fair play and sporting values. Medals, diplomas, and material prizes are prepared for winners, including special awards for the youngest and oldest runners.
course_highlights: Start at Ranch u Lipek in Telč
Cross-country run in natural terrain
Part of the Orel Running League
additional: Categories include children's runs, family relays (3 members with one child up to 12 years old), and a popular run for beginners over 18 years old. Start times are approximate between 12:30 and 13:20, and it is recommended to arrive at least half an hour before the start. Each participant runs at their own risk and is responsible for their health. The race is part of the Orel Running League, with start times between 12:30 and 13:20, and emphasizes fair play and sporting values.

name: Běh kolem Lužnice
location: TJ Lokomotiva stadion, Veselí nad Lužnicí, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run Around Lužnice is a traditional running race organized by the Atletika Veselí athletics club in Veselí nad Lužnicí. The race offers a unique opportunity for runners of all ages to enjoy beautiful nature and a sporting atmosphere at the TJ Lokomotiva stadium. The club has been dedicated to athletics and running races for a long time, emphasizing quality organization and a friendly atmosphere. The race is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners and children.
course_highlights: The route runs around the Lužnice with beautiful natural scenery
Start and finish at the TJ Lokomotiva stadium in Veselí nad Lužnicí
Friendly atmosphere and support from the Atletika Veselí athletics club
additional: Athletics training sessions are held outdoors at the stadium according to the spring schedule. Parking is available in the TJ Lokomotiva sports complex. The club also offers the sale of club caps and headbands. Payments and registration are conducted electronically through club membership. The race is open to all age groups, with registration available via the website. The start is at the TJ Lokomotiva stadium, and participants can choose between the 8.09 km and 5.67 km routes.

name: Huť - Bratříkov - Huť
location: Huti, Jablonec nad Nisou, Liberec, Czech Republic
description: Huť-Bratříkov-Huť is a traditional cross-country race held annually on the first Sunday of October in Huta near Jablonec nad Nisou. This race, with a history dating back to 1972, offers a main race of 10 km and shorter variants for different age categories. The course runs through picturesque scenery with a grassy field serving as the start and finish area. The race is suitable for all running enthusiasts, from children to adults, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and quality organization.
course_highlights: Main race of 10 km through scenic nature
Traditional date on the first Sunday of October
Start and finish on the grassy field at the fire station in Huta
additional: Registrations and bib numbers are submitted directly on site at the start. Youth categories register from 08:10 to 09:00, other categories from 08:10 until 15 minutes before the start. The program begins with a collective assembly at 09:10 AM. Categories include preschool children, youth, unregistered men and women, and the main 10 km race. The race takes place on the first Sunday of October on a grassy field near the fire station in Huta, with the possibility of online registration. The course is quite hilly, mainly forest and meadow paths, suitable for trail runners.

name: Medzinárodný maratón mieru
description: The International Peace Marathon in Košice is a traditional running festival held on October 4, 2026, on Main Street. Organized by the Košice Marathon Club, it offers a marathon course, half marathon, and other disciplines, with start and finish lines located in the city center. The event is known for its long history and quality organization, including the Slovak Championships in the half marathon. Runners can expect professional timing and a rich accompanying program.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Main Street between DoubleTree by Hilton and Dargov Department Store
Slovak Championships in the half marathon are part of the event
The course is certified according to World Athletics and Slovak Athletic Federation rules
additional: Start and finish are on Main Street in Košice. The organizer provides professional timing. The event includes the Slovak Championships in the half marathon. There are age categories and special categories for relays and handbikes. Registration is available online, and payment can be made by card, Google Pay, Apple Pay, and registration code. The event features various categories including marathon, half marathon, relays, and inline disciplines, with the possibility of online registration and changing start times or disciplines within set deadlines.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Tetín
location: Hospůdka u Plotice, Tetín, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 240 Kč (voucher na 12 závodů), 316 Kč (voucher na 6 závodů)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 240 Kč (v rámci voucheru na celou sérii 12 závodů)

description: The Berounka - Tetín Running Series is a community trail race held on October 5, 2026, in the picturesque surroundings of Tetín. The route goes over hills and offers beautiful views of the Czech Karst and the surrounding landscape, including a climb to the lookout over Beroun. The race is part of a series of 12 runs that motivate runners of all levels to stay active in nature with a friendly atmosphere and support from local pubs. Refreshments, baggage storage, and awards for the best in categories are provided on site.
course_highlights: The route passes over Damil hill with views of Tetín and the Czech Karst
The highest point is near Na Koledníku village, then mostly downhill
Picturesque lookout over Beroun and the surrounding landscape before the final descent to the finish
additional: The route is marked with red-white and yellow reflective signs and red ground arrows. Refreshments and baggage storage are available on site. It is recommended to bring a headlamp. The top three places in each category will receive a diploma and medal. The trail race features a marked route, starting at Hospůdka u Plotice, includes hilly terrain and beautiful views, registration via voucher, with refreshments and baggage storage on site. Bringing a headlamp is advised.

name: Mrdická mašina
location: Heřmanův Městec, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Mrdická Machine is a fast run of 2.0 km across Mrdické meadows in Heřmanův Městec. This race is part of the Heřmanoměstecká sports league, which includes ten athletic and cycling events in the vicinity of Mrdice fortress. The race is open to the general public and offers a fun and sporting challenge for all runners. Organized by the Heřmanův Městec Running Club, which supports running and sports activities in the region.
course_highlights: 2.0 km run across Mrdické meadows
Part of the Heřmanoměstecká sports league with 10 races
Surroundings of the historic Mrdice fortress
additional: The race is intended for all running enthusiasts, registration is available in the regulations, and the course runs through meadows and forest paths around Heřmanův Městec.

name: Roštejnskou oborou
description: Roštejn Forest Run is a friendly race for the general public held in the picturesque surroundings of the forests near Růžená in the Vysočina region. The course runs through forest paths and is suitable for all age groups from 4 years old, with distances ranging from 300 meters to 8,900 meters. The event is part of the Vysočina Runner Cup and offers a unique experience of running in nature with the opportunity to observe local wildlife. Organized by TJ Růžená, z.s., the race is ideal for families and sports enthusiasts who want to combine sport with nature.
course_highlights: Forest terrain with opportunities to observe local wildlife
Course lengths from 300 m to 8,900 m suitable for all age groups
Part of the Vysočina Runner Cup, ideal for families and sports enthusiasts
additional: The race takes place on October 9, 2026, around Růžená. The main race length is 7.3 km, the course runs through forest paths and is suitable for all age groups from 4 years old.

name: Pražský Kelt
description: Prague Celts is a unique 100 km ultra trail in the heart of Prague, offering runners the opportunity to experience beautiful nature and Celtic hillforts with a total elevation gain of 2500 meters. The route leads through wooded hilly terrain of Prague, including historical sites such as Šance hillfort, Butovice, Závist, Vyšehrad, and others, providing stunning views of the city and surrounding nature. The race starts and ends at the Kunratice Elementary School grounds and is intended for runners who want to experience the atmosphere of an ultramarathon in an unconventional urban environment. The race capacity is limited to 120 participants, ensuring an intimate and friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 100 km route with 2500 m elevation gain in wooded hilly Prague
Connection of three Celtic hillforts and historical sites of Prague
Beautiful views of Prague from Vyšehrad, Branické rocks, and other locations
additional: Start and finish are at the Kunratice Elementary School grounds. The race capacity is 120 people. Bus transportation is available via bus 193 from Kačerov station to Kunratice School (12 minutes). Parking is available around the school. Mandatory equipment is specified in the race rules (chapter 3.3). The route for the new edition is sent via email to registered participants. Refreshment stations are part of the race and highly appreciated by participants. The course is 100 km with 2500 m elevation gain, includes refreshment stations, the option for a relay race, a diploma and medal, registration until September 30, 2026, capacity of 120 persons.

name: II Korczyński Półmaraton Górski XI Korczyński Bieg i Nordic Walking "Do Prządek"
description: The 2nd Korczyński Mountain Half Marathon and the 11th Korczyńskie Races and Nordic Walking "To Prządek" is a sporting event taking place in the picturesque areas of Korczyna and Czarnorzek. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, engaging both experienced runners and amateurs of Nordic walking. The routes lead through mountain trails, offering participants contact with nature and terrain challenges. Registrations are conducted electronically, and the organizers ensure a good atmosphere and safety for the competitors.
course_highlights: Mountain routes around Korczyna and Czarnorzek
Scenic landscapes and natural trails
Routes suitable for runners and Nordic walking
additional: Registrations are conducted electronically via the TIMEKEEPER platform. The event will take place on October 10, 2026, in Czarnorzeki. The regulations are available for download on the organizer's website. The event includes a half marathon, a race, and Nordic walking, with the possibility of online registration. The date of the event is October 10, 2026.

name: 30 Bieg Przełajowy o Nóż Komandosa
location: Stadion miejski, Lubliniec, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 30th Commando Knife Cross Country Run is a prestigious running event organized under the honorary patronage of Bishop of the Polish Armed Forces, Dr. Wiesław Lechowicz. The race takes place at the Municipal Stadium in Lubliniec and is dedicated to soldiers and uniformed service officers who compete in full field uniform. The event aims to identify the top uniformed services runners in cross country, promote mass running events, and foster integration within uniformed communities. The course runs along the street in front of the stadium to the finish line on the stadium track, with the start at 12:00 for women and 12:27 for men.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Municipal Stadium in Lubliniec
Course runs along the street in front of the stadium and finishes on the stadium track
Race in full field uniform and special tactical shoes
additional: All participants compete in the OPEN category without age group divisions. Full field uniform with long sleeves and special tactical shoes above ankle height in military colors are required. Additional civilian elements are only allowed if they match the uniform's colors. Approval is at the discretion of the race judge. Participants must be soldiers or officers of uniformed services, either on active duty or reserve. Cross-country terrain, online registration, participant limit until 09/15/2026, entry fees from 150 PLN to 200 PLN, start at 12:00 at the Municipal Stadium in Lubliniec.

name: XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic
description: The 17th Mysłowice Grand Prix is a series of races organized by the Truchtacz Mysłowice Association, combining a passion for running with an active lifestyle. The event promotes health, integration, and joy of movement, inviting runners of various skill levels and ages. The races take place in the picturesque areas of Mysłowice, creating a friendly atmosphere and a running community. Participants can compete in running, Nordic walking, and canicross, and participation in the Grand Prix is free of charge.
course_highlights: Trails run through the forest above Bolina
Various competitions: running, Nordic walking, canicross
Picturesque areas of Mysłowice conducive to recreation and competition
additional: Registrations for the Grand Prix series are only possible at the Race Office on the day of the race. Participation in the events is free. The event attracts competitors from different cities and clubs, with women making up over 27%. Organizers ensure proper organization and support the integration of runners. The event includes various dates in 2026, focusing on community and promoting an active lifestyle.

name: Cena Metuje
location: Nové Město nad Metují, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
organizer: Sportovní klub Nové Město nad Metují z.s.
price_range: 300-500 Kč pro dospělé, zdarma pro členy SK Nové Město nad Metují

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 300,- Kč při přihlášení a zaplacení on-line do středy 8.10. 2025, 23:59 hod.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 350,- Kč při přihlášení on-line do soboty 11.10. do 8:00 hod.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 75,- Kč při přihlášení on-line do středy 8.10. 2025, 23:59 hod.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 100,- Kč při přihlášení on-line do soboty 11.10. do 8:00 hod.

description: The Metuje Race is a traditional 10 km road run held in Nové Město nad Metují as part of the PRIMÁTOR CUP running series. This 65th edition also features races for youth in various age categories. The course runs along an asphalt road through the valley of the Metuje River to Peklo and back, providing a pleasant yet challenging running experience. The race is suitable for the general public, including children, parents, and grandparents, who can collect points within the series. The winners are announced both in children's categories and in the main race, with monetary and material prizes.
course_highlights: Road course over 10 km through the valley of the Metuje River
The route goes to Peklo and back along an asphalt road
Youth races with various distances from 100 m to 1700 m
additional: Registration is only available online at sportchallenge.cz, including on the race day until 8:00 AM. The race office is open on race day from 8:00 AM at the Sokolovna in Nové Město nad Metují. SK Nové Město nad Metují members have free entry. Children can earn points within the PRIMÁTOR CUP series and receive rewards for participation. Children's races are divided into categories from 9:00 to 10:30, with the main race starting at 10:45. Winners are announced at 10:45 (children's categories) and at 12:00 (main race). The race is part of the Primátor Cup 2025 series and the Grand Prix of Eastern Bohemia, including various age categories and offering prizes and certificates.

name: VOKOLO priglu
location: Brněnská přehrada, Brno, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
organizer: Brněnský klub běžeckých a sportovních aktivit z.s.
price_range: early bird ceny do konce roku 2025, přesné ceny nejsou specifikovány
description: Vokolo priglu is a traditional running race around Brno Dam, taking place on October 10, 2026. The race offers a unique sporting experience on a 14.1 km course, which is approximately one-third of a marathon. The route is slightly hilly, mostly asphalt with a section of rocky terrain, and offers beautiful views of Brno Lake, Veveří Castle, and autumn forests. The race is open to individuals, pairs in relay teams, four-member teams, companies, and universities, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization.
course_highlights: 14.1 km course around Brno Dam
Slightly hilly profile with 85% asphalt and 15% rocky surface
Views of Brno Lake, Veveří Castle, and autumn Podkomorské forests
additional: The main race starts in waves, timing is measured with chip technology integrated into the race bib, and the time limit for completion is 2.5 hours. There is a sports EXPO, accompanying program for adults and children, changing rooms, mobile toilets, baggage storage, refreshments, and rescue services on the course and at the start and finish areas. Gift vouchers are sent electronically in PDF format. The race offers various categories, the option to purchase official race merchandise, and an eco-friendly solution with electronic vouchers.

name: Běh Borským parkem
description: The Borský Park Run is a traditional autumn sporting event in Plzeň with a history dating back to 1970. The race is suitable for both beginner hobby runners and experienced athletes of all ages. It offers excitement at the starting line, the tension of the competitive atmosphere, and joy at the finish. Organizers ensure a friendly environment for runners and provide local refreshments for all participants.
course_highlights: Race takes place in Borský Park in Plzeň
Traditional autumn running event with a history since 1970
Friendly atmosphere for hobby and competitive runners of all ages
additional: Registration is possible in advance until October 10, 2024, with discounted entry fees at web nazavody.cz. On race day, registration is available at the start area from 8:30 to 9:45 on October 12, 2024. Organizers provide local refreshments for runners. Race in Borský Park, registration at https://www.nazavody.cz/zavod/565-beh-borskym-parkem, start from 8:30 to 9:45.

name: Běhej lesy Lednice
location: Lednice, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: Run the Forests Lednice is part of a popular running series that offers races in the most beautiful natural locations in the Czech Republic. The race in Lednice takes place in the picturesque Lednice-Valtice area, where runners pass through the castle park, around ponds, and past iconic landmarks such as the Temple of the Three Graces and Apollo's Temple. The routes are suitable for runners of various levels and include a short route Nova 14 km and a longer ČSOB 21 km, both with an international UTMB Index. The race is complemented by speed competitions and an attractive finish straight, providing additional motivation for participants.
course_highlights: Routes pass through the Lednice-Valtice area with landmarks like the Temple of the Three Graces and Apollo's Temple
150-meter Conti Speed Section marked with Continental flags
500-meter Generali Investments Finish straight with measured section
additional: The race includes the Conti Speed Section - a 150m speed segment marked with Continental flags and the Generali Investments Finish - a 500m measured finish straight. The fastest man and woman will receive a functional running jersey from the brand Craft. It is recommended to pick up race numbers at least 90 minutes before the start. The event features various distances from 3 to 50 km, is suitable for families and children, includes a charity run, and partners with major companies such as Continental and ČSOB.

name: Hradčanské vlnky
location: Hradčany u Olomouce, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Hradčanské vlnky is a traditional cross-country trail race in Hradčany near Olomouc, offering three main routes: 5.6 km, 10.4 km, and a half marathon of 21.1 km. The race emphasizes movement in terrain with a predominance of forest and field paths, ensuring an attractive and challenging run. The event also includes children's categories with various distances. Participants are provided with refreshments, chip timing, and extensive facilities including showers. The atmosphere is friendly, and the race is suitable for a wide range of runners from children to experienced trail runners.
course_highlights: Main route 10.4 km with an elevation gain of approximately 260 m, 5% asphalt, 25% field roads, 70% forest paths and trails
Half marathon 21.1 km with an elevation gain of approximately 505 m, a combination of asphalt, field, and stony paths, second half in terrain
Short route 5.6 km with an elevation gain of approximately 155 m, fast and technical blue trail
additional: Registration for children's races begins at 8:30, main races start at 9:45. The half marathon starts at 11:00 from the excursion area, the main route 10.4 km and the short route 5.6 km start from the square. Included in the registration fee are race organization, facilities, showers, food, beer/soft drinks, chip timing, start number, on-trail refreshments, and post-race refreshments. Parking is organized by volunteers with an emphasis on obeying traffic regulations and consideration for Hradčany residents. The race offers various categories, including children's, and is complemented by a rich accompanying program and a raffle.

name: Podzimní běh Olympu
description: The Autumn Run of Olymp is a traditional running race organized by the Police Sports Club Olymp Prague, taking place in the picturesque environment of Stromovka Park in Prague 7. The race offers an opportunity for runners of all levels to enjoy the autumn atmosphere and a sporting challenge in a pleasant urban park. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes team spirit and an active lifestyle. Organizers welcome all interested participants and provide support during registration and the race.
course_highlights: Run in Stromovka Park, Prague 7
Picturesque urban environment with natural scenery
Traditional autumn running event with a friendly atmosphere
additional: The run takes place in the Stromovka area, registration is possible online via results.bezeckenadeje.cz

name: Benešovský půlmaratón a desítka Pojizeřím
location: Podmošně, Benešov u Semil, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Benešov Half Marathon and Pojizeří Ten is a traditional running race in the picturesque environment of the village of Benešov u Semil in the Liberec Region. The race offers a half marathon and a 10-kilometer route through the beautiful nature of Pojizeří with varied terrain. The organizer is TJ Benešov u Semil, which ensures a friendly atmosphere and light refreshments for competitors and spectators. The race is suitable for the broad running public and is part of the community's sports activities.
course_highlights: Routes lead through the scenic nature of Pojizeří with forest and field paths
The half marathon course features elevation and views of the Benešov hills
The 10 km offers a faster run on partly asphalt and forest paths
additional: The race facilities are located in the sports complex in Upper Benešov. Registrations and check-in take place at the start area from 12:30 PM, no later than 15 minutes before the start of each category. Light refreshments are available for competitors and spectators. The organizer is TJ Benešov u Semil z.s. with the support of the municipality of Benešov u Semil. The races include the half marathon, the 10 km, and a non-competitive 10 km route, scheduled for October 2026, with the start in Podmošně.

name: Běh Bukovem
description: Bukov Run is an annual sporting running festival held in the beautiful natural surroundings of Bukov and Plískov as part of the Brdy Running Cup. The race takes place exclusively on meadows, forest roads, and trails, offering runners a pleasant experience in nature. The event is suitable for a wide range of age categories, from young children to veterans. It is organized by the municipality of Plískov in cooperation with Farm Ekl and is known for its friendly atmosphere and tradition.
course_highlights: The course runs through meadows, forest roads, and trails in Bukov and Plískov
Various distances for children and adults, from 100 m to 8250 m
Start and finish at the playground near the swimming pool in Plískov
additional: Participant registration takes place on the terrace of the inn in Plískov from 9:00 to 10:50. The race starts gradually according to categories from 10:05 (youngest children) to 11:21 (women, juniors, veterans). Winners are announced continuously for children's categories and after the race for others. Please observe Covid precautions; disinfectant is available at the start. Participants without health restrictions run at their own risk. The race is held in October, with a primarily forest and meadow course, and offers online registration and various race distances throughout the year.

name: Kašavský kros
price_range: 400 CZK dospělí, 200 CZK junioři, 50 CZK děti
description: Kašava Cross is a traditional cross-country running race in the vicinity of Kašava, offering two main routes for competitors aged 16 and above, as well as children's races. The race takes place on Saturday, October 10, 2026, and is known for its proven course with hills and a pleasant atmosphere. The organizer is the VALACHBAJK TEAM KAŠAVA association, which collaborates with the local municipality and school. Children's races are held after the main races and are divided into several age categories with different distances.
course_highlights: Main course 16.6 km with an elevation gain of 679 m
Short course 8 km with an elevation gain of 254 m
Children's races with distances from 100 to 1300 m
additional: Registration for children is only possible on-site on race day. Check-in begins at 10:30 AM, the deadline for check-in for the long course is at 11:30 AM, the start of the long course is at 12:00 PM, the start of the short course is at 12:30 PM. Children's races start at 2:30 PM. The organizer provides a limit of 200 adult participants. After the race, winners are announced and a raffle is held. Terrain: trail, registration: online and on-site, includes children's races and main adult courses.

name: MUTRAverz - Mikulovský Ultra Trail Run (2)
location: Mikulov, Krušné hory, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Mikulovský Ultra Trail Run, z. s.
description: MUTRAverz is an extreme ultra trail race held in the Ore Mountains, specifically in Mikulov and its surroundings. This race is intended for experienced runners seeking a challenging course in beautiful nature with marked tourist trails. Organizers emphasize safety, fair play, and quality organizational support. The race is suitable for runners over 18 years old who are physically and mentally prepared for extreme conditions. We look forward to your participation in the next edition on October 10, 2026.
course_highlights: Extreme ultra trail in the Ore Mountains
Tourist-marked trails in the nature of Mikulov
Challenging terrain suitable for experienced runners
additional: The race is only for persons over 18 years old. Participants must be physically and mentally capable and are obliged to follow race rules and safety measures. The organizer is not responsible for the condition of the courses or any health complications. Runners agree to audiovisual recording of their performance for race presentation purposes. Trail race with over 50 km and 16 km courses, suitable for both experienced and recreational runners, supporting sports performance in nature.

name: Rybský trhák
description: Rybský trhák is a road running race organized by the Emil Zátopek Athletic Club Kopřivnice in cooperation with the municipality of Rybí and TJ Sokol Rybí. The race covers a distance of 7 km with an elevation gain of 135 meters and is intended for various age categories of men and women. The start is at the TJ Sokol Rybí football field, and runners can use secured changing rooms and showers. Refreshments and material prizes are prepared at the finish line for the best runners in each category, including a prize for the oldest participant and the best runner from the village of Rybí.
course_highlights: Distance of the course 7 km
Elevation gain 135 m
Start and finish at the TJ Sokol Rybí football field
additional: Changing rooms and showers are provided. Refreshments and treats are available at the finish. Material prizes for the top three runners in each category, a prize for the oldest participant, and the best runner from the village of Rybí. The race takes place on October 10, 2026, starting at 11:00. Registration is at the football field in Rybí. Participants can expect refreshments and material prizes for category winners.

name: Běh pro Kleofáše
location: Lázeňský park Aurora, Třeboň, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Kleofáš Run is a traditional charity run held in the spa park in Třeboň, supporting the local hospice. Participants can choose from several categories, from children's short runs to a 12-kilometer run around Lake Svět. For less experienced runners, a pleasant 4-kilometer route is available, as well as a relay for two or four runners. The event offers a rich accompanying program for children and is part of the Hospice Week.
course_highlights: Beautiful natural route around Lake Svět
Pleasant 4-kilometer route for other runners
Relay race over 4 km for two or four runners
additional: Registration begins at 9:00 AM, with the possibility to register on-site on the day of the event. Children's races are divided by age with distances of 200 m, 450 m, and 1 km. Results are announced gradually after the children's races, as well as the 4 km and 12 km races. The event is part of Hospice Week. The routes include various lengths from 200 m to 12 km, with surfaces of forest paths, asphalt, and trail, with slight or flat elevation. Registration is via an online form or on-site, with the start in the Aurora Spa Park.

name: Malá cena Špindlerova Mlýna
location: Městský úřad ve Špindlerově Mlýně, Špindlerův Mlýn, Krkonoše, Czech Republic
description: The Small Prize of Špindlerův Mlýn is the traditional 34th uphill run held as part of the Czech Cup. The race starts at the Municipal Office in Špindlerův Mlýn and offers a challenging route of 14 km with an elevation gain of 901 meters. This race is ideal for mountain running enthusiasts who want to test their strength in the beautiful mountain environment of the Krkonoše.
course_highlights: Distance of the route 14 km
Elevation gain of 901 m
Start at the Municipal Office in Špindlerův Mlýn
additional: The race is part of the Czech Cup running series. Organizers call for the protection of the Krkonoše nature. The race offers various categories for men and women, registration is through www.jktiming.cz, and it is known for its difficulty and the beauty of the surrounding Krkonoše nature.

name: Červený okruh
location: Termit, Doksy, Liberec District, Czech Republic
description: The Red Circuit in Doksy is a traditional race as part of the District Running League of Česká Lípa, taking place on October 10, 2026. The race offers runners the opportunity to test their strength on an interesting course in the natural environment of Termit in Doksy. The event is part of a series of regional running races and attracts both the general public and experienced athletes. Organizers ensure a pleasant atmosphere and quality facilities for all participants.
course_highlights: Natural terrain in the Termit area, Doksy
Part of the District Running League of Česká Lípa
Traditional autumn running race with history
additional: The race takes place in the Termit area in Doksy, the course runs through forest terrain, registration on-site or via email, suitable for various age groups.

name: Bašťanská šestka
description: Bašťanská šestka is a traditional running race held in the picturesque environment of the Baška reservoir in the Moravian-Silesian Region. The event is organized by Tělovýchovná jednota Slezan Frýdek-Místek, z.s., which has long been dedicated to athletics and promoting sports activities in the region. The event is suitable for the general public and offers an opportunity for sporting activity in beautiful nature. Registration and participation are welcome from both experienced runners and recreational athletes.
course_highlights: The race takes place on a route around the Baška reservoir
Picturesque natural environment of the Moravian-Silesian Region
A traditional running event organized by the athletics club Slezan Frýdek-Místek
additional: The race takes place on a road circuit around the Baška reservoir, with the start scheduled for 11:00. The event is suitable for all age groups and also offers races for children.

description: St. Wenceslas Run Tyreto RUN 2026 is a charity running race held on October 10th in Děčín. The race offers courses for men, women, and children, including a family run, and supports multiple sclerosis patients through proceeds from registration fees. Participants can enjoy a sporting experience while helping a good cause. The first ten registered participants will receive a reward in the form of a discount on tire purchases at Tyreto.
course_highlights: Traditional running race in Děčín
Courses for all age groups: 2.5 km, 5 km, 12 km, and 21 km
Charitable aspect supporting the St. Joseph's Home
additional: The first ten registered participants who pay an entry fee ranging from 250 to 1000 CZK will receive a voucher for a discount equal to the paid amount on tire purchases at Tyreto. Routes for 5, 12, and 21 km, races in Děčín, charity support, musical and accompanying program.

Finish in Lysej pod Makytou
Long time limit of 27 hours with several stage time limits

Organizers provide luggage transport and drop bags for control point K4. Medical assistance and safety are ensured during the event. Accommodation is available in Čadca, with a gymnasium of a primary school providing overnight rest for participants. The course includes 80% forest roads, 5% asphalt, and 15% meadows; mandatory equipment includes a headlamp, reflective elements, hydration, and first aid; registration closed on September 26, 2025.

description: GARMIN Run through the Suľov Rocks is a traditional running race set in the beautiful environment of the Suľov Rocks, offering three courses of varying lengths and difficulty. Runners pass through picturesque nature with views of rock formations and ridge trails, with refreshment stations along the route. The event is suitable for the general public, including children, who have their own categories and starts. The organizer is the Slovak Cycling Club CYKLO TOUR Suľov - Hradná, which ensures quality preparation and service for participants.
course_highlights: The route passes through the picturesque Suľov Rocks with views of rock formations and ridge trails
Elevation gain of up to 850 meters on the longest 17 km course
Three refreshment stations on the route and separate children's categories with their own starts
additional: The participation limit is 1200 runners for the main race and 350 children for the children's race. The children's race is free of charge. Registration is valid only after the registration fee is paid. There is an option for personal registration and payment on the day before the start if the participation limit has not been reached. Starts for children's categories are scheduled between the main race starts. The route includes forest trails and short asphalt sections; registration is possible through the official website; the event is known for its beautiful nature and atmosphere.

name: Grand Prix – Cabaj-Čápor
price_range: 10 € online, 15 € na mieste, zadarmo pre deti a niektoré kategórie
description: Grand Prix Cabaj-Čápor is a traditional cross-country race set in a beautiful natural environment, taking place in the village of Cabaj-Čápor with the start at Salaš Cabaj. Runners can choose from several courses including 10 km, 3 km, and children's races of 600 m and 1000 m. The event is suitable for everyone who wants to experience the atmosphere of sport in nature, whether for competition or for the joy of movement. Registration is open and the number of participants is limited, so it is advisable to register early.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in the nature of Cabaj-Čápor
Courses of 10 km, 3 km, and children's races of 600 m and 1000 m
Start at Salaš Cabaj
additional: The presentation of competitors begins at 9:00 AM. The number of participants is limited. Participants of the main and hobby races receive participation awards. The event takes place on October 10, 2026. Registration is available online, and the race is suitable for all age groups and performance levels.

description: Autumn Run of Michalovce Residents is a traditional running race in Michalovce, offering an opportunity for participants of various age groups. The race takes place at the premises of 2nd Elementary School on J. Švermu 6 and includes a children's run over 400 meters and the main race over 3 kilometers. The event is suitable for families and runners who want to enjoy the autumn atmosphere and sports activities in a pleasant environment. Organizers provide refreshments and commemorative items for participants.
course_highlights: Children's run over 400 m for kids up to 9 years old
Main run over 3 km consisting of 3 laps of 900 m each
Start and finish at the premises of 2nd Elementary School, J. Švermu 6, Michalovce
additional: Participants will receive commemorative items and refreshments are provided. Registration for runners is from 08:00 to 09:15. Results announcement and medal awards are at 10:30. The children's run (500 m) starts at 9:30, the main run (3 km) at 9:45; registration on site; categories for adults, children, and seniors; the event is part of the autumn sports calendar.

name: Beh Myšľou
location: Archeoskanzene Nižná Myšľa, Nižná Myšľa, Slovakia
description: Vyšná Myšľa Running Race is a running event organized by the Vyšná Myšľa Running Club and the municipality of Vyšná Myšľa. The race takes place on the football field in the village of Vyšná Myšľa in the Košice okolí district. The start of the children's categories is at 14:00 and adults at 16:00. Men and women of various age groups can compete, including a relay race for pairs over 2 x 3 km. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere of running sport in the village.
course_highlights: The race takes place on the football field in the village of Vyšná Myšľa
Relay race for pairs over 2 x 3 km
Multiple age categories for men and women
additional: Registration fees are waived for Men E, Women I, members of BKO Vyšná Myšľa, residents of Vyšná Myšľa, and children. The children's race starts at 14:00, and the adult race at 16:00. The race features various distances from 350 m to 8 km, with online registration or on-site registration available. The event is suitable for all age groups.

name: 12. PKO Cracovia Półmaraton Królewski
description: The Cracovia Royal Half Marathon is an international half marathon held in Kraków, a city with a thousand-year tradition and former residence of Polish kings. The race attracts thousands of participants from around the world, combining sporting passion with sightseeing of historic sites. The finish line at the impressive TAURON Arena Kraków provides unforgettable emotions and the cheers of spectators. The event is part of the Royal Running Trilogy and the Polish Half Marathon Crown, highlighting its prestige and importance among runners.
course_highlights: The route runs through the streets of Kraków, a city rich in history and royal heritage
Finish at the largest entertainment and sports hall in Poland - TAURON Arena Kraków
The race is part of the prestigious Royal Running Trilogy and the Polish Half Marathon Crown
additional: Race packets are collected at designated points in accordance with the Run with Class principles. In 2026, the race is part of the Royal Running Trilogy, where participants can earn special medals and a trophy for completing all three events in the series. The event includes various race categories, including the half marathon and other distances, with online registration and registration at the race office. The race takes place in the city area, with routes leading through attractive locations in Kraków.

name: Wzgórzowa Trzynastka
location: Chrząszczyce, Opole County, Opole Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Hilltop Thirteen is a cross-country race covering a distance of 13 km, held in the picturesque area of Chrząszczyce. The route goes along municipal roads and through a military training ground between the towns of Chrząszczyce, Domecko, Opole-Winów, and Górki. The event promotes a healthy and active lifestyle and popularizes running as a form of recreation. In addition to the individual race, relay competitions, a category for uniformed services, and family orienteering teams are organized. The start and race office are located in Chrząszczyce, and the participant limit is 300 people.
course_highlights: The route passes through a military training ground and municipal roads
Picturesque surroundings of Chrząszczyce, Domecko, Opole-Winów, and Górki
Time limit of 120 minutes to complete 13 km
additional: Participant limit: 300 people. Start and race office in Chrząszczyce at ul. Szkolna 3, open on race day from 10:00 to 13:00. Technical running shirts can be ordered until September 28, to be collected with the race kit. Individuals over 16 years old can participate; those under 18 require written parental consent. Cross-country race, relays, outdoor game for children, fundraising for the stadium.
