description: Slapy Trail Maniacs is a challenging trail race set in the picturesque surroundings near Slapská Dam in the Central Bohemian Region. It offers three courses with distances of 61 km, 47 km, and 33 km, which lead through varied terrain with significant elevation changes. The race is suitable for experienced runners who want to test their abilities in nature and also earn points towards the UTMB index. The race center is located in the village of Cholín, with starts divided according to the courses, taking place on Saturday. Organizers also provide accommodation and refreshments during the race.
course_highlights: 61 km course with an elevation gain of 2300 m up and 2400 m down
47 km course with an elevation gain of 1850 m up and down
Scenic routes around Slapská Dam with technical sections
additional: The 61 km race starts at 7:00 in Nečín, the 47 km race starts at 9:00 in Cholín, and the 33 km race starts at 12:00 near Živohošťský Bridge. The race cutoff time is 23:00 in Cholín. Accommodation is available for 250 CZK per night on a bed or on a mat in a communal room. Registration changes are possible free of charge until October 12, 2025, and afterward for a fee of 100 CZK. The terrain includes trails, unmarked paths, rocky areas, and ascents; the race offers accommodation options, start times, and limits; it also contributes to the UTMB index.

name: Olomoucký kros
location: Stadion AK Olomouc, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Olomouc Cross Country is a traditional cross-country race organized by AK Olomouc, held at the AK Olomouc stadium. The race offers a challenging 9 km trail in the terrain, which tests the endurance and strength of runners. The main category starts at 10:15 AM, and the race is part of the official Czech Running calendar under the Czech Athletic Federation. Organizers invite runners of all levels to participate in this popular event in Olomouc.
course_highlights: 9 km cross-country trail in the terrain
Start and finish at AK Olomouc stadium
Challenging terrain suitable for endurance runners
additional: The race takes place at the AK Olomouc stadium; registration and further details are not specified.

name: Skalička run
description: Skalička Run is an outdoor adventure running race held in the picturesque valley of the Lubě stream in South Moravia. It offers three interconnected routes of 7, 13, and 22 kilometers, mainly through forests and meadows along hiking trails and cycle paths. The course is gently undulating with a few hills and suitable for hobby runners and casual participants who want to enjoy beautiful nature and autumnal colorful scenery. The race is well marked, and the shallow fords along the route are easily crossed. During the race, it is possible to switch to a shorter distance.
course_highlights: Trail course mainly through forests and meadows off asphalt
Longest route of 22 km with three interconnected loops and a gentle elevation gain of 436 m
Autumn run through fallen leaves with well-marked trail and shallow fords
additional: During the race, it is possible to switch to a shorter distance. The course is thoroughly marked with arrows and flags. The fords are shallow and can be crossed dry-footed via a bridge. The time limit for the longest route is 3 hours. Trail running, registration details are not specified, autumn race with a beautiful natural atmosphere.

name: Leskros Hradečák
location: Hradec Králové, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Leskros Hradečák is part of the Leskros series, which promotes a healthy lifestyle and running in nature. The race offers various running categories including a half marathon, 10 km, and shorter distances for children and youth. It also features canicross with categories for different age groups and experience levels. The race takes place in the beautiful forest environment of Hradec Králové and is suitable for the whole family and beginner runners.
course_highlights: Forest routes GELOREN and MIZUNO with distances of 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon (21 km)
Canicross tracks from 1 km for children up to 4 km for experienced competitors
Refreshment stations on the course and at the finish line, chip timing, and a unique finisher medal
additional: The registration fee includes a unique finisher medal, Speedcup cup, chip timing, hydration, refreshments, race photo, gifts from partners, and parking arrangements. Canicross equipment rental is available upon request. Categories for children and adults, including junior and non-competitive categories for beginners. Refreshment stations on the course and at the finish line, prize money for elite canicross runners. Trail running and canicross, categories for children and adults, registration opens in December. The event includes charitable activities and equipment rental options.

name: KEEN Prague Park Race – Prokopské údolí
description: KEEN Prague Park Race in Prokopské údolí is a running race in beautiful nature within reach of Prague. The race offers a unique atmosphere and a course leading through a picturesque valley with natural and paved paths. Prokopské údolí is an ideal place for nature-loving runners who want to experience a sporting challenge in a peaceful and scenic environment.
course_highlights: The course runs on paved and unpaved paths in Prokopské údolí
Natural terrain with scenic views and natural sections
Race near Prague with the atmosphere of a natural park
additional: The course is accessible during the race, with no specified wave divisions or capacity limits. Participants will receive payment instructions via email after registration. The race is part of the Prague Park Race series with other races in Průhonický Park, Divoká Šárka, and Konopiště. Trail running, multiple races in various parks of Prague, registration on the website, pre-race runs, and shoe testing events with KEEN footwear.

name: Běhej Valachy
description: Run Valachy is a traditional running race held in the picturesque environment of Velké Karlovice and its surroundings in the Beskydy Mountains. The race offers athletes of all ages and fitness levels the opportunity to test their strength in beautiful nature with views of the Wallachian hills. Since 2013, it has been part of the Valachy Tour series, which offers attractive prizes and prize money. Come enjoy running in the heart of Wallachia and experience the unique atmosphere of this sporting celebration.
course_highlights: Picturesque valley of Velké Karlovice and surroundings
Running in the nature of Beskydy with Wallachian hills
Traditional race with a long history since 2013
additional: The race is part of the Valachy Tour series, which offers races in various disciplines for all ages and fitness levels. The organizer is MORAVIA EVENTS s.r.o. and BESKYDY OUTDOOR s.r.o. The contact phone number for the race director is +420 602 275 790. The race routes go along asphalt and forest paths, with the possibility of relaxation in thermal pools. Registration begins at 8:00 AM, races start at 9:30 AM. Maps of the routes are available at mapy.cz.

name: Zlatý maraton Emila Zátopka Ostrava
description: The Emil Zátopek Golden Marathon Ostrava is a prestigious running race held on a fast, certified course in Ostrava. The race offers a marathon, half marathon, 10 km, and a mixed team race, with every runner, whether a beginner or experienced, welcome. The atmosphere is professional, with participation from the world elite and rich amenities including refreshments, music, and sports shopping. The course runs on a single loop, with start and finish at the famous Vítkovice Stadium, where Emil Zátopek set his records.
course_highlights: Fast, certified course in Ostrava
Start and finish at Vítkovice Stadium
Opportunity to run with elite world runners
additional: Registration fees can also be purchased on-site in cash or via QR code at check-in. The race pack includes an original functional Macron T-shirt, finisher's medal, refreshments during and after the race, a rich expo, and free taping and physiotherapist care. The race takes place on a single loop with partial traffic restrictions during the event from 8:50 to 15:00. The race includes various categories, including relay races, and supports charitable activities. The event is supported by the city of Ostrava and the Moravian-Silesian Region.

name: Beh hrebeňom Čergova
description: The Čergov Ridge Run is the longest mountain race in the Čergov Mountains, designed for outdoor running enthusiasts and trained runners. The course runs from the village of Kamenica through the highest peaks of the range, such as Minčol, Dvoriská, Solisko, Veľká Javorina, Čergov, Lysá, and Sedlo Besná, with a length of 32 km and an elevation gain of 1413 meters. Runners can enjoy beautiful panoramic views and challenging terrain on hiking trails. The race takes place on October 24, 2026, starting at 9:00 AM at Farma Kamenica and finishing at Sedlo Besná near Hotel Šport Lysá.
course_highlights: 32 km mountain run with an elevation gain of 1413 m
Crossing the highest peaks of Čergov: Minčol, Dvoriská, Solisko, Veľká Javorina, Čergov, Lysá, Sedlo Besná
The course runs along marked hiking trails with blue and green signs
additional: A large bus will be provided for all participants, transporting them from the village of Drienica to Kamenica in the morning (departure at 7:15 AM from the parking lot near Hotel JAVORNÁ). The organizer also provides transportation for personal belongings from the start to the finish. Participant registration is from 7:00 to 8:30 AM on race day at Farma Kamenica. Results announcement and lunch are at Hotel Šport Lysá. The race is held on October 24, 2026, and is open to men and women of various age categories, with the opportunity to participate in mountain trail running in the beautiful environment of the Čergov Mountains.

name: Rajecká 12-minútovka
location: Ihrisko pri ZŠ na Lipovej ulici, Rajec, Slovakia
description: Rajecká 12-minute run is a dynamic race organized by the Rajec Marathon Club, held on the playground near the elementary school on Lipová Street in Rajec. This short, intense run is ideal for runners of all levels who want to test their speed and endurance within a limited time. The event is part of the regional running tradition and offers a pleasant atmosphere with support from the local community. Organizers ensure quality course preparation and a friendly environment for all participants.
course_highlights: Run on the playground near the elementary school on Lipová Street in Rajec
Intensive 12-minute time limit
Pleasant atmosphere with support from the local community
additional: Registration is conducted online with an option for late payment for an additional fee. The event is suitable for all age groups and running levels. Refreshments and results evaluation are provided on-site after the run. The race takes place on the playground near the elementary school on Lipová Street in Rajec, with the opportunity to improve personal records in a friendly atmosphere.

name: Beh vinicami Bojničiek a Hlohovca
location: Cultural center near the church, Bojničky, Trnava District, Slovakia

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 15 € pre prihlásených on line do 23.10.2024 aj so zaplatením štartovného

description: Running race through the vineyards of Bojničky and Hlohovec is an athletic event organized by the Bojničky Athletic Club and the municipality of Bojničky. The race takes place at the cultural center near the church in Bojničky and offers categories for men, women, and Nordic walking over a 6 km course. The registration fee is available online and on-site, with a discount for students. The event is suitable for the general public and runners of various age groups.
course_highlights: Course runs through the vineyards of Bojničky and Hlohovec
Categories for men, women, and Nordic walking
Start at the cultural center near the church in Bojničky
additional: Categories: Men (M, M 40, M 50, M 60), Women (Ž, Ž 40, Ž 50), Nordic walking for men and women over 6 km. Registration can be paid online or on the day of the race. The event also includes Nordic walking, with online registration available. The venue is the cultural center near the church in Bojničky.

name: Ružínska desiatka
price_range: 15,-€ online, 20,-€ na mieste; detské preteky 5,-€ online, 7,-€ na mieste
description: The Ružín Ten is a running race organized by the Jaklovce Sports Club in cooperation with the Jaklovce municipality, held near the Ružín Dam. The course mainly runs on asphalt with a small portion of gravel, offering a fast and pleasant run. Men and women of various age groups can compete in 10 km and 5 km categories, with children's races also available. The main categories start at 11:00, and children's categories begin at 10:00. The race is suitable for the general public and running enthusiasts of all levels.
course_highlights: 90% asphalt surface, 10% gravel (macadam)
The route runs around the Ružín Dam in Jaklovce
Categories for men, women, and children of various age groups
additional: Children's categories start at 10:00, main categories at 11:00. Categories include various age groups of men and women, with absolute rankings and special awards for the oldest, youngest, and best Jaklovce residents. The course surface is mainly asphalt with a small portion of gravel. The race features 5 km and 10 km categories, children's races, a raffle, and a bouncy castle.

name: 16 Nocna Ściema
description: Night Deception is a unique night marathon and half-marathon held in Koszalin, known for its excellent atmosphere and distinctive nocturnal setting. The race course consists of a loop approximately 7 kilometers long, which participants complete multiple times depending on the chosen distance. The race has an official PZLA certification, ensuring the verification of the course length and the possibility of setting world records. This is the sixteenth edition of the event, attracting runners eager to improve their personal bests in the unforgettable conditions of a night run.
course_highlights: The course consists of a loop about 7 km long, completed 3 or 6 times
Official PZLA certification confirming the course length
Views of the stadium along the route and the hilly terrain of Koszalin
additional: The registration office for children and youth opens around 7:00 PM, with a limited number of 20 spots. The registration office for adults is located at the Koszalin University of Technology Sports Hall at Racławicka Street, about 300 meters from the stadium, and is open until 30 minutes before the start. A photo ID is required to collect the race number. The race route runs through the streets of Koszalin with views of the aviation museum exhibits. Medals and gadgets are updated annually and are an important part of the event. The event offers various distances, including marathon and half-marathon, with live reports, photo galleries, and videos, as well as online and in-person registration options. Participants can look forward to attractive prizes and the opportunity to compete in different thematic categories.

name: Chwałowicki Maraton Napoleoński

The 42.195 km route runs through forest and rural roads, in a peaceful atmosphere without crowds, with signage and convenient access. The event is organized by local runners who emphasize a friendly atmosphere and recreational character of the race, rather than competition and prizes. It is an excellent option for cross-country running enthusiasts in a natural environment.

name: Sopot Półmaraton
description: Sopot Half Marathon is an annual race covering the half marathon distance, held in the picturesque seaside city of Sopot. Participants have the opportunity to run through charming parts of the city, with the finish line at ERGO Arena, providing a unique atmosphere and comfort. The event attracts runners from all over Poland, offering professional organization and attractive starting packages. It is an excellent opportunity to experience sports emotions in the Pearl of the Baltic and to receive a commemorative medal and T-shirt.

The courses lead through picturesque areas of the Vistula Valley, with varied surfaces including asphalt and gravel, and the race takes place with limited vehicle traffic. The marathon starts in Tczew at 9:00 AM, and the half marathon begins in Małe Walichnawy at 11:00 AM, with the finish line located in Tczew.

description: Perła Paprocan Run is a unique marathon around Lake Paprocany in Tychy, combining competition with training on almost any distance. Participants can run one or multiple laps of the 7-kilometer loop, up to the full marathon distance. The run is recreational and integrative, promoting a healthy lifestyle and a good atmosphere among runners. Tychy is the only city in Poland where the marathon takes place twice a year, and Perła Paprocan is one of these editions.

A station with drinks, fruits, and sweets available after each lap

Participants from 12 years of age are allowed with written parental/guardian consent. Valuable items can be left in a deposit. The run is recreational, and the rule of running on half of the paths applies to allow overtaking. Participation from 12 years old with guardian consent, stations with drinks and fruits, participant limit 1111, online registration, organized twice a year.

name: XVI Półmaraton Szakala Dookoła Lasu Łagi... (Łódź)

The XVI Szakal Half Marathon features a classic, demanding route with scenic ponds and steep ascents, ideal for runners seeking a challenge and contact with nature. The program also includes Ultra Szakal, Cross Szakal, and races for children, making the festival attractive to a wide range of participants. Organizers ensure a good atmosphere and safety, and the course allows for competition or a leisurely enjoyment of the autumn forest.

The event includes various distances and locations for pick-up of race kits, requiring proof of identity. The race takes place in a forest setting, making it a unique experience for nature lovers and trail runners.

name: Kobeřický půlmaraton
description: The Kobeřice Half Marathon is a traditional athletic race organized by TJ Sokol Kobeřice, with a long-standing history dating back to 1996. The race is part of the Moravia and Silesia Championship in the half marathon and attracts runners from across the Czech Republic and abroad. The course offers opportunities for both experienced and recreational runners and is part of a series of public races organized by the athletics club in Kobeřice. The organizers emphasize support for youth and the development of running traditions in the region.

Natural and urban sections suitable for runners of various levels

The athletics club focuses on youth and has a long-standing tradition in the region. In 1998, the half marathon was included in the Moravia and Silesia Championship, and in 2005 and 2009, championships in the half marathon and for veterans were held here. The race is part of the Moravian-Silesian Running Cup and the Prajzsko-Opava Running League, with a history and tradition in the region.

The start is mass and takes place at 10:00 AM, allowing for a shared experience of running in the beautiful autumn environment of the Krkonoše mountains.

Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 and older, and children up to 12 years (boys and girls). Timing is recorded for each runner, and the top three in both adult and children categories receive small prizes. The recommended ways to reach the start are by bike, on foot, by car, rollerblades, or trolleybus No. 11 (stop Průmyslová zóna). The races are held on the first Saturday of each month, starting at 9:00 AM, with registration from 8:15 to 8:55. Participants can arrive by bike, on foot, by car, or by trolleybus. The main course is a precisely measured asphalt circuit, with a length of 3.2 km, and the children's course is 800 meters long.

name: Memoriál MUDr. Josefa Podmolíka - Běžecký festival Otrokovice 2026
description: The Otrokovice Running Festival is a traditional sporting event offering a wide range of races including a marathon, half marathon, relay half marathon, decimarathon, and youth races. The Memorial of MUDr. Josef Podmolík is the highlight half marathon race, held in the beautiful environment of Otrokovice. Participants can enjoy a quality course with electronic timing and the atmosphere of a running festival with a rich program for all age groups. Registration and winners' ceremony take place at the Otrokovice Municipal Sports Hall.
course_highlights: Half marathon and marathon course in Otrokovice with chip timing
Decimarathon circuit of 4.2195 km
Youth races with various distances from 200 m to 1700 m
additional: Registration of participants takes place at the Otrokovice Municipal Sports Hall. Runners are required to pick up their start number and chip for electronic timing. Winners are announced gradually after each race, and attendance at the awards ceremony is mandatory. Registration is done via email. The event includes various age categories and races on city streets and in the sports hall.

name: Svatojánská 20
location: TJ Lokomotiva Beroun, Beroun, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Svatojánská 20 is a traditional running race held in Beroun, offering two main routes of 11 and 18 kilometers. The start and finish are located at the TJ Lokomotiva Beroun athletics stadium. The routes mainly run on asphalt and cycle paths along the Berounka River and Loděnický Stream, with turnarounds in V Kozle settlement (11 km) and in Svatý Jan pod Skálou (18 km). The race is open to a wide age category and offers refreshments at the finish line, as well as monetary and material prizes for the best runners.
course_highlights: Routes mainly run on asphalt and cycle paths along the Berounka River and Loděnický Stream
Turnaround for the 11 km route is in V Kozle settlement, for the 18 km route in Svatý Jan pod Skálou
Start and finish at the TJ Lokomotiva Beroun athletics stadium
additional: Registration and check-in on-site on race day from 11:00 to 12:40. Pre-registered runners with payment by November 5th will receive a start number with their name. Refreshments at the finish line include tea and cookies. The race takes place in full road traffic; participants must follow traffic rules and run at their own risk. Parking is available around the stadium; nearby parking lots are recommended due to blue zones. The race offers online registration as well as on-site registration, medals, certificates, and monetary prizes are awarded.

name: Kovářská pětka
location: Baťovský areál, Zlín, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Kovárna VIVA a spolkem Běhy Zlín
description: Kovářská pětka is a traditional city road race 5 kilometers long, held in the Baťovský area in Zlín. The race is intended for both adults and children, organized by Kovárna VIVA in cooperation with Běhy Zlín. The event offers a quality sports experience in the center of the regional city with international participation. It attracts a wide running community every year and is known for its friendly atmosphere and well-organized course.
course_highlights: The route passes through the former Baťovský area in Zlín
Road race over 5 kilometers in an urban environment
The race is suitable for adults and children
additional: The race is part of the year-round Zlín running competition. Organizers provide online results and event photos. Children's categories are also offered within the race. The organization ensures quality timing and supports the regional running community. The race is part of a series of runs in Zlín, offering various age categories and is suitable for the general public.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - listopad
description: The 2-mile run in Prague's Stromovka Park is an open race covering 3.2 km, suitable for all age groups and running levels, including children up to 12 years old running 1.6 km. The race is suitable for slow and fast runners, experienced and beginners who want to improve their personal best, train, or simply enjoy a pleasant run in the beautiful park environment. After finishing, everyone is greeted with a warm cinnamon pancake. The time is measured for each participant, and results are published online, counting towards the annual Pancake Cup.
course_highlights: The course runs on asphalt paths in Stromovka Park
Adults run 2 laps (2 miles, 3.2 km), children run 1 lap (1.6 km)
The race takes place in the beautiful environment of Královská obora - Stromovka Park
additional: Registration takes place at the Bruselská Gate area (under the Marold Panorama building) from 8:15 to 8:45, with the option of prior online registration for faster check-in. Recommended arrival by bike, on foot, rollerblades, or tram (stop Výstaviště). Parking is available at the bridge to Císařský Island on Za elektrárnou street. There are tents for changing clothes and storing belongings (unattended) and a mobile valuables storage. WC cabins are available on site. The start is at 9:07 AM, registration from 8:15 to 8:45 AM, online registration available. The race takes place in Královská obora - Stromovka Park, parking at the bridge to Císařský Island, with changing rooms and toilets available.

name: Labský půlmaraton
location: Lysá nad Labem, Lysá nad Labem, Středočeský, Czech Republic
description: The Labský Half Marathon is a running race held in Lysá nad Labem, offering two routes approximately 12.5 km and 21.3 km long. The routes run through flat Polabian forest with surfaces combining paved and unpaved roads, footpaths, and short sections of asphalt or concrete. The start and finish are at the racecourse, which provides refreshments, baggage storage, and other facilities. The race is suitable for the general public, with a capacity limited to 700 participants. The program also includes children's races of various lengths depending on age.
course_highlights: Routes run flat through the beautiful Polabian forest
Start after about 1 km on the racecourse
Refreshment stations at 8 km and 17 km (21 km route), one station at 8 km (12 km route)
additional: The race capacity is limited to 700 participants. Baggage storage, changing tents, toilets, refreshments, and a raffle are available for runners. Parking is available on-site for a fee of 50 CZK per car. Children's races range from 200 to 1000 meters depending on age. The route is marked with flags, signs, and flour arrows, with each kilometer approximately indicated. The race includes children's races, online registration is possible, and the route may be adjusted due to nearby reconstruction.

name: Závod dvojic
description: Hostivařské dvojice is a relay running race for pairs, offering a unique team running experience in the beautiful environment of Hostivař. The race is designed for pairs who want to enjoy a sporting challenge while experiencing the atmosphere of a friendly race. The course runs through scenic terrain and is suitable for runners of all levels. Come run and enjoy a great sporting event in a friendly community.
course_highlights: Relay run in pairs
Scenic environment of Hostivař
Friendly race atmosphere
additional: The race takes place on November 7, 2026, in Kladno. It is a team relay discipline, with registrations available online.

name: Hornická desítka
location: Národní dům, Frýdek-Místek, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: Hornická desítka is a traditional running race held in Frýdek-Místek, which has been taking place since 1980 with breaks and a revival of the tradition in 1996. The race offers various running disciplines including youth races, a health run, and the main 10 km race. The event celebrates movement and sportsmanship, attracting hundreds to thousands of participants of all ages and is known for its excellent organization and friendly atmosphere. The start is at the National House in Frýdek-Místek, and the race is suitable for the general public, including families with children.
course_highlights: The course runs around Frýdek-Místek with a history dating back to 1980
Main race of 10 km with accompanying youth races and a health run
Start and finish at the National House in Frýdek-Místek
additional: The race includes a non-competitive run for parents with children, youth races, a health run, and the main 10 km race. The event is known for its excellent organization and relaxed atmosphere. The organizer is Tělovýchovná jednota Slezan Frýdek-Místek, z.s. The race takes place on Saturday, November 7, 2026, at the National House in Frýdek-Místek, and includes road closures and traffic measures.

name: Malá Pardubická cross country
location: Labe and vicinity, near TJ Dynamo canoe club, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: The Small Pardubice Cross Country is a traditional cross country race organized by the athletic club AC Pardubice. The race takes place around the Labe River and near the TJ Dynamo Pardubice canoeing club. Organizers warmly invite all runners and running fans to this popular event, which offers a sporting experience in a natural environment. Regulations and further information are available on the club's website.
course_highlights: Cross country race in natural terrain around the Labe River
Start and finish near the TJ Dynamo Pardubice canoeing club
Traditional running event organized by AC Pardubice
additional: The race takes place on November 7, 2026, is open to the general public including children and youth, and is part of the local sports calendar.

name: Marceliński Bieg Jesienny 2026
description: Marceliński Autumn Run 2026 is a cross-country race organized in Poznań by running enthusiasts from the Biegi.Wlkp. group. The event takes place on scenic routes that highlight the aesthetic qualities of the location. Since 2014, the organizers have focused on popularizing cross-country running in Greater Poland, offering participants a unique running experience in beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Cross-country race on scenic routes in Poznań
Routes highlighting the aesthetic qualities of the location
Organized by experienced running enthusiasts from Greater Poland
additional: The race route is available on Garmin Connect. Participants can pick up their race kit with an authorization form. Cross-country event held in Lasek Marceliński, November 8, 2026. Medals in the form of puzzles. Forest routes.

name: Žandovská desítka
description: Žandovská desítka is a traditional 10-kilometer race held in Žandov in the Liberec Region. The event is part of the District Running League Českolipsko and welcomes runners of all ages. The course runs on roads and in terrain, offering a diverse environment for competitors. The race is a popular event within the regional running community and provides opportunities for personal achievements and meeting running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: The course runs on roads and in terrain
Part of the Českolipsko regional running league
Suitable for all age groups
additional: The race takes place in November 2026, registration and further details are not specified, the event is part of a broader series of regional runs.

name: Dobřichovický běh
location: Škvárový stadion TJ Sokol Dobřichovice, Dobřichovice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Dobřichovice Run is part of the Brdy Running Cup and offers runners a course approximately 6 km long. The race starts at the ash track stadium of TJ Sokol Dobřichovice and runs along field paths, ensuring a pleasant terrain for running. The event is suitable for both adults and children, who have their own races. The start of the main race is at 1:00 PM, and the organizer is ASK Dipoli.
course_highlights: Course length approx. 6 km
Start at the ash track stadium of TJ Sokol Dobřichovice
Course runs along field paths
additional: Start location: TJ Sokol Dobřichovice, Pražská 375. The course is GPS-measured at 5.72 km, officially listed as 6 km. The race is part of the Brdy Running Cup, which also includes children's races. The surface of the course is a combination of ash track stadium and field paths. The course includes an ash track stadium and field paths; online registration available; races suitable for all age categories.

name: Velká kunratická
location: Kunratický les, Praha 4, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The Velká kunratická is one of the oldest running races in the Czech Republic, held annually on the second Sunday of November in Kunratický Forest in Prague. The race has been held continuously since 1934 and is known for its challenging profile and variable weather, which contribute to its unique atmosphere. It attracts a wide range of runners from young children to veterans, competing on six courses ranging from 370 to 3100 meters. The organizer is the athletic club Spartak Praha 4.
course_highlights: Challenging course profile in Kunratický Forest
Six courses from 370 m to 3100 m
Interval start in pairs with a 10-second gap
additional: All categories start in pairs with a 10-second interval. Official BUSHMAN brand T-shirts can be purchased exclusively during registration. Pickup of ordered T-shirts takes place at the tent on the dam. The total number of participants is limited to 3600, with 2700 runners crossing the Hrádek. Changes to registration are possible until October 14, 2026 via email, thereafter only upon presentation. The race takes place in November, with a limited number of participants set at 3400, online registration opens on October 5, 2026, on-site registration available, with various age and performance categories.

name: 14. PKO Bieg Niepodległości w Rzeszowie
description: The 14th PKO Independence Run in Rzeszów is an annual running event organized by the Rzeszów Running Club "Rzeszów Biega" in partnership with the Rzeszów City Hall and PKO Bank Polski. The main race on a 10 km distance starts and finishes at the Rzeszów Market Square, taking place on November 11th at 11:11 AM. The event promotes an active lifestyle and running in the Podkarpacie region, offering age classifications and special categories, including categories for doctors and lawyers. Participants receive a race kit with a T-shirt, number, and chip, and a commemorative medal at the finish line. The participant limit is 3000 people, and participation requires confirmation of fitness to run through a medical certificate or declaration.
course_highlights: Main race on a 10 km distance with start and finish at Rzeszów Market Square
Separate age classifications and special categories (e.g., doctors, lawyers)
Participant limit of 3000 people, race kit includes a T-shirt, number, and chip
additional: Gilding on the medal is available for an additional fee of 30 PLN. On race day, the number of race kits is limited, and the registration fee is non-refundable. Participants must be over 16 years old (minors with guardian consent). Race kits include a T-shirt, race number, and chip. The route is marked every 1 km, and the event features warm-up sessions and refreshment points along the course. Wearing the organizer's mandatory T-shirt is required.

name: 36. Bieg Niepodległości w Warszawie
description: The 35th Independence Run in Warsaw is an annual running event organized on the occasion of National Independence Day. The main 10 km race takes place on the streets of the capital city, with start and finish lines located on Aleja Jana Pawła II. The event attracts both experienced runners and amateurs, offering also a Nordic walking category and a commemorative mile race over 1918 meters. The main race starts in waves, ensuring comfort and safety for participants. Organizers provide a rich program and efficient service, including the collection of race numbers at convenient times before the race.
course_highlights: Certified route by PZLA measuring 10 km through Warsaw streets
Start and finish on Aleja Jana Pawła II, at ul. Miła
Wave start of the main race divided into zones based on expected times
additional: The main race starts at 11:11 with a wave division into time zones. The Independence Mile begins at 10:00. Participants in active wheelchair, handbike, and tandem categories start at 11:08. Race numbers can be collected at Westfield Arkadia from November 7 to 10; on race day, the race office is closed (except for packet pickup for participants from outside Warsaw between 8:00 and 10:00). Participants are asked to line up at the start in white or red shirts, forming a white-red flag. The route is well-known and loved, with about 20,000 participants taking part. The event includes various categories such as the main race, Nordic walking, and virtual options available until November 17. In previous years, it was the most numerous running event in Poland.

name: Poznański Bieg Niepodległości – Kocham Polskę!
location: Strzeszyn, Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
price_range: 20 zł za koszulkę techniczną, wpisowe na stronie nie jest wyraźnie podane
description: Poznański Bieg Niepodległości - Kocham Polskę! is cross-country race organized in picturesque locations in Poznań, especially at Strzeszyn near Malibu Beach. The event is part of activities by a group of running enthusiasts who have been promoting cross-country running in Greater Poland since 2014, emphasizing the aesthetics of the routes and the sporting character of the event. The race has a patriotic dimension, taking place on November 11, combining sport with honoring Poland's independence. We invite runners to participate in various distances in beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Cross-country route around Strzeszyn and Malibu Beach
Picturesque green areas of Poznań
Patriotic race organized on November 11
additional: The organizer is a group of running enthusiasts from Greater Poland, active since 2014, specializing in cross-country races. The race takes place on green areas of Strzeszyn, near Malibu Beach. The event has a patriotic character and is part of the Poznań Running Trilogy. Participant limit is 750, with scenic routes and cross-country races.

name: 10 Bieg Niepodległości z wąsem
location: Stadion Olimpijski, Wrocław, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Wrocław Independence Run with a mustache is an annual running event organized at the Olympic Stadium in Wrocław, commemorating the 107th anniversary of Poland regaining independence. Participants can choose between a 10 km or 5 km distance, and the main race route is certified by PZLA. The race takes place on closed roads, and at the finish line, runners receive a medal and a recovery meal. Free accompanying runs are organized for children, and participants can purchase a high-quality technical T-shirt with the race logo.
course_highlights: 10 km route certified by PZLA, consisting of two 5 km loops
Start and finish at the Pergola of the Olympic Stadium
Route runs on asphalt and gravel roads at the foot of flood embankments
additional: Race kits are issued at the event office at the Olympic Stadium on November 10 and 11. The kit includes a start number, mustache socks, a stick-on mustache, sponsor products, a calendar, a T-shirt (if ordered), a medal, and a recovery meal. There is a hydration point along the route. The race is held on roads closed to traffic. Free accompanying runs for children are organized. Technical T-shirts can be ordered until October 16, 2025, for 90 PLN. Changing rooms and deposit facilities are available on site. The 5 km race starts at 10:11, and the 10 km race at 11:11. The race takes place on closed roads, with accompanying runs for children, the option to purchase a T-shirt during registration on DataSport, medals for participants, and registration on the day of the event.

name: 9 Olsztyński Bieg Niepodległości
location: Centrum Rekreacyjno-Sportowe Ukiel, Olsztyn, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Olsztyn Independence Run is an annual patriotic sporting event held in Olsztyn, combining the joy of running with the celebration of Independence Day. The event is open to everyone, from experienced runners to families with children. The races take place at the Ukiel Recreation and Sports Center and include 5 km and 10 km runs, Nordic walking marches, and short children's races up to 400 meters. The atmosphere is lively despite the autumn weather, and the number of spots is limited, with online registration open until November 6th.
course_highlights: The 5 km and 10 km race routes run through the Ukiel CRS area and nearby streets: Sielska, Schumana, and Kapitańska
The event combines athletic competition with patriotic celebration
Nordic walking marches and children's races up to 400 meters are also available
additional: Start and finish are located at the Ukiel Recreation and Sports Center. The event takes place on November 11th, with online registration open until November 6th. Participants can choose from 5 km and 10 km runs, Nordic walking marches, and children's races up to 400 meters. Due to the race, traffic disruptions are expected on the route. Road traffic restrictions will be in place on the course, with the start at 9:00 AM, registration until November 6th, and the event held at the Ukiel Recreation and Sports Center as well as on Sielska, Schumana, and Kapitańska streets.

name: Gdyński Bieg Niepodległości
description: The Gdynia Independence Run is an annual running event organized in Gdynia, as part of the Gdynia Grand Prix 2026. The main race on a 10 km distance attracts runners of various ages, and there are also children's and youth races. The event has a sports-recreational character, and participants can expect professional organization and an atmosphere celebrating Polish independence. During the event, photos and video materials are taken for promotional purposes by the organizers.
course_highlights: Main race on a 10 km distance
Children's and youth races
Part of the Gdynia Grand Prix 2026
additional: During the event, photos and video materials will be taken for promotional purposes of events organized by GCS and the Gdynia City Municipality. Registration is open until October 28, 2026. Results, photo galleries, and partner information are available.

name: II Bieg Legionów Polskich
description: The Polish Legion Run II is a race commemorating the anniversary of Poland regaining independence, held on two distances: 5 km and 10 km. Starts take place in scenic seaside locations: Władysławowo, Rozewie, and Jastrzębia Góra. The organizer provides transportation from Jastrzębia Góra to the start locations and opens the race office the day before and on the race day. The race route is available online, allowing participants to familiarize themselves with the course before the start.
course_highlights: The race route passes through Władysławowo, Rozewie, and Jastrzębia Góra
10 km start from the Haller monument at Morska Street in Władysławowo
5 km start from the bust of Marshal Piłsudski at Garnizonowa Street in Rozewie
additional: Transportation from Jastrzębia Góra to the start locations is provided. The race office is open on November 10, 2025, from 14:30 to 15:30 at OSiR Władysławowo and on November 11, 2025, from 10:20 to 10:50 in Jastrzębia Góra. The race route is available online at https://www.traseo.pl/trasa/bieg-legionow-polskich. Registration is open from September 22 to November 5, 2025; the event takes place on moderately elevated routes, starting in Władysławowo and Rozewie.

name: XIV Bieg Niepodległości
description: The 14th Independence Run is an annual street race covering a distance of 10 km, organized in Rzeszów to promote an active lifestyle and running in the Podkarpacie region. The start and finish are located at the Rzeszów Market Square, and the race takes place on November 11th, on Poland's Independence Day. Participants compete in various age categories and special classifications, including for doctors and lawyers. Participants receive a race kit with a T-shirt, number, and chip, and a commemorative medal at the finish line. The participant limit is 3000 people, and participation requires confirmation of fitness to run through a medical certificate or declaration.
course_highlights: Street race over 10 km with start and finish at the Market Square in Rzeszów
Separate age and special classifications (e.g., doctors, lawyers)
Commemorative medal for every participant at the finish
additional: The participant limit is 3000 people. Participants must be at least 16 years old on the day of the race. Minors participate with parental or legal guardian consent. The race kit includes a T-shirt, race number, and chip. Custom engraving on the medal is available for an additional fee of 30 PLN. The registration fee is non-refundable. On race day, race kits are available only in cash and in limited quantities. Participants can expect a well-marked route, detailed safety regulations, and information on registration and participant limits. The race takes place in Rytro, and the event is part of the celebrations of National Independence Day.

name: Běh na Dobrošov
location: Náchod-Běloves, Náchod, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Dobrošov Run is a public uphill race with a mass start, held in Náchod-Běloves in the Hradec Králové Region. This race is part of the Běžecké vršky series and offers athletes the opportunity to test their strength on a challenging course leading uphill. The race is organized by the Redpoint Teplice nad Metují club and is popular among runners who enjoy challenges in a natural environment. Traditionally, runners of all ages and performance levels gather here.
course_highlights: Uphill run with a mass start
Challenging course in the natural environment of Náchod-Běloves
Part of the Běžecké vršky series
additional: This is a public mountain run with various categories, including historical information about the race and related events.

name: Hannah Pilsen Trail Krkavec
description: Hannah Pilsen Trail Krkavec is a traditional autumn trail race around Pilsen, offering scenic routes in nature with minimal asphalt. The race is suitable for both enthusiasts of healthy outdoor activity and competitive athletes and top trail runners. Participants can choose from routes of 42 km with an elevation gain of 700 m, 22.5 km, 7 km, and shorter children's and pupils' courses including a multigenerational relay. The race center is located in the suburban part of Pilsen - Bílá Hora, where the start and finish are also held. Organizers adhere to the motto "I don't run on asphalt" and prepare the race with an emphasis on running in nature and beautiful views.
course_highlights: Scenic trails along footpaths on both banks of the Berounka River valley
Forests around Bolevecké ponds
Climb to Krkavec with an elevation gain of 700 m on the marathon route
additional: There are three main routes (42 km, 22.5 km, 7 km) and shorter children's and pupils' courses including a multigenerational relay. The race is part of the Pilsen Running Cup. The race center is in the suburban part of Pilsen - Bílá Hora. Terrain: trail, cross-country; the race takes place in November 2026, specific registration details are not provided.

name: BoBoBěh
description: BoBoběh is the final mountain run of the BoBoloppet trilogy, taking place through the beautiful Jizera Mountains. The race offers a challenging route of 30 km with ascents to Olivetská Mountain, passing over the Černá Nisa dam, and a steep climb through Bílý Štolpich. For less experienced runners, there is a shorter 10 km route and a children's MINI run of 1 km. The race is open to all running and nature enthusiasts, whether registered for the entire trilogy or just participating in this race.
course_highlights: 30 km mountain run across the Vysoký Hřeben and Kanál
Twice ascending Olivetská Mountain and passing over the Černá Nisa dam
The toughest climb in the Jizerské Mountains - Bílý Štolpich
additional: The race does not have a mass start; the start corridor is open for two hours, allowing runners to choose their start time. The route is not marked; the race is partially orienteering. There are three variants available: 30 km, 10 km (fit), and a children's MINI run of 1 km. The event is open to all interested participants, offering registration options for different routes, and emphasizing the natural beauty and sporting experience in the mountain environment.

name: Běh přes Černovírský les
description: The run across Černovírský Forest is a flat 10 km race held in Hlušovice near Olomouc. The race is part of the Great Prize of Long-Distance Runners of the Olomouc Region and attracts regional runners who enjoy a course that runs along cycle paths and asphalt. The event is suitable for runners of all ages and offers not only a sporting experience but also an opportunity to meet the local running community. The race is a welcome opportunity to enjoy the autumn atmosphere and actively spend time in nature.
course_highlights: Flat course running along cycle paths and asphalt
Part of the Great Prize of Long-Distance Runners of the Olomouc Region
Opportunity to participate in various age categories
additional: race over 10 km, part of the Great Prize of Long-Distance Runners of the Olomouc Region, flat terrain, participation of regional long-distance runners

name: Běh Dlouhými záhony
description: The Long Flowerbeds Run is a challenging cross-country race 6.8 km long with significant elevation changes, held in Úpice. The race is part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup and the Winter Running League of the Jestřebí Mountains. The course offers runners a challenge with hilly terrain and beautiful natural scenery of the Jestřebí Mountains. This race is suitable for experienced runners seeking a technically demanding mountain run.
course_highlights: Challenging cross-country with large elevation differences
Course length of 6.8 km
Part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup and the Winter Running League
additional: The race is part of the Winter Running League and the Czech Mountain Running Cup, with an evaluation of the best mountain runners in the Czech Republic after the race.

name: Hannah Pilsen Trail Krkavec
description: Hannah Pilsen Trail Krkavec is a traditional autumn trail race in Pilsen, held in the picturesque nature of Bílá Hora. The race offers three main routes of 42 km, 22.5 km, and 7 km, including shorter categories for pupils and children. The course runs along paths around the Berounka River, through forests near Bolevecké rybníky, and includes a challenging ascent to Krkavec with an elevation gain of 700 meters. Organizers emphasize running in nature without asphalt, which is appreciated by both recreational runners and top trail runners. The race center is located in the suburban part of Pilsen - Bílá Hora.
course_highlights: Picturesque trails along paths around the Berounka River
Forests around Bolevecké rybníky
Challenging ascent to Krkavec with 700 m elevation gain
additional: There are three main routes (42 km, 22.5 km, 7 km) and shorter pupil and children’s routes, including a multi-generational relay for children with parents or grandparents. Organizers emphasize the motto "I don't run on asphalt." The race is part of the Pilsen Running Cup. The race center is located at the restaurant area in Háj na Bílá Hora. The course is recommended to be uploaded to smartwatches, registration includes refreshments and a medal, registration is available online or on-site, with a time limit of 6.5 hours for the marathon. The event is part of a series of races in 2026.

name: Svatomartinský běh
location: Petřkovice u Starého Jičína, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: St. Martin's Run is a traditional running race held in the picturesque environment of Petřkovice near Starý Jičín in the Moravian-Silesian Region. The race offers a sporting experience in beautiful nature with a route approximately 5.5 km long, suitable for the general public. The event is organized in the grounds of the Berchtold Castle Hotel, which provides facilities and comfort for participants and spectators. The race is ideal for all runners who want to combine sport with a pleasant atmosphere and beautiful views in the surroundings.
course_highlights: Route approximately 5.5 km long in natural environment
Picturesque surroundings of Petřkovice near Starý Jičín
Start and finish at the grounds of Berchtold Castle Hotel
additional: Results from previous editions are available online. The route is set in a natural environment with predominantly forest and field surfaces. The Berchtold Castle grounds offer facilities for participants including parking and refreshments. The race takes place in November 2026, specific details regarding registration and routes are not provided, and the event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle.

name: Ludgeřovický kros

price_tiers.distance: běh 10 km, 4 km, Nordic walking 9 km, děti

description: Ludgeřovický cross-country is a traditional running race in the natural environment of the village of Ludgeřovice, attracting both young and old runners every year. The main course measures 10 km and passes through varied terrain - forest paths, field trails, and around local landmarks. In addition to the main race, shorter runs of 4 km, Nordic walking of 9 km, and children's courses by age categories are available. The race is part of the Prajzsko-opavská running league and bears the subtitle Veterans' Run, paying tribute to heroes not only from the past.
course_highlights: Main course 10 km with 140 m elevation gain
Terrain includes forest roads, field trails, and surroundings of local landmarks
Additional races: 4 km run, 9 km Nordic walking, children's courses 100 and 500 m
additional: Metal finisher medal of own design, commemorative magnet for the first 200 participants at the presentation, book "Ještě jeden maraton" for the first 300 registered, monetary prizes for the winners of the main race, chip timing for children as well, awards including 4th place in all races, accompanying program Veterans' Day Ludgeřovice, personal videos and photos from the race, changing rooms, showers, and convenient parking, children's races with awards and raffle. The course includes 10 km, 9 km, 4 km, children's runs, uncertain weather, connection with Veterans' Day.

name: Půlmaraton pátera Václava Kosmáka
description: The Pater Václav Kosmák Half Marathon is a road loop race running from Moravské Budějovice to Lukov and back. This race offers runners the opportunity to test their strength on a half marathon course in the picturesque environment of the Vysočina region. The race is suitable for all runners seeking a quality road race with a traditional atmosphere. Organizers welcome both experienced and beginner runners and look forward to your participation.
course_highlights: Road loop race from Moravské Budějovice to Lukov and back
Picturesque environment of Vysočina
Traditional half marathon course
additional: The race is open to all age groups and is part of a running league, offering a friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to participate as a recreational runner.

name: Hrouzovka 2026
description: Hrouzovka 2026 is a running race taking place on November 14, 2026, in Krnov. This race offers a course approximately 15 km long, passing through hilly terrain with a variety of surfaces, including asphalt, grass, and rocky paths. The event is intended for runners seeking a challenge in a natural environment and wishing to enjoy a sporting atmosphere in a beautiful setting. Details about the organizer and registration have not yet been published, but the race is part of the local running calendar.
course_highlights: 15 km course through hilly terrain with diverse surfaces
Running in the natural environment of Krnov
Part of the local running calendar
additional: The race is suitable for runners of all levels, offering an opportunity to enjoy a sporting atmosphere in a beautiful natural environment.

name: Beh na Minčol
description: The Minčol Run is the most challenging uphill race in the nearby area, taking place through the beautiful surroundings of the Višňovská Valley. The route starts in the valley and continues with a steep ascent to the main ridge up to the summit of Minčol, offering stunning views of the Krivánska and Lúčanská parts of the Malá Fatra. Runners can look forward to a demanding profile with minimal rest opportunities and a final steep climb, where most will opt for brisk walking. After finishing, refreshments and participant evaluation with prizes for the best in each category are provided.
course_highlights: The route is marked with a blue tourist trail sign
Steep challenging ascents from start to finish
Beautiful views from Minčol's summit of Krivánska and Lúčanská parts of Malá Fatra
additional: The start is at the parking lot at the valley entrance, with the finish at the top of Minčol (1363 meters above sea level). Refreshments are available on the course at approximately 2 km and at the finish line. After the race, a meal (homemade cabbage soup and a drink) is served at the Holý Diel ski resort. Participants have the option to leave their belongings in a drop bag, which will be transported to the base area along with the results announcement. The top three in each category will be awarded if at least three runners start in that category. The event is part of the traditional running calendar in Malá Fatra, with online registration, refreshments on the course and at the finish, and awards for the fastest runners. After the race, a traditional cabbage soup and social program are prepared.

name: Zemplínsky extrém – Beh v múzeu
price_range: 20€ online, 25€ na mieste pre hlavné kategórie; 3€ online, 5€ na mieste pre deti
description: Zemplínsky extrém - Running in the museum is an autumn running race held at the premises of the Zemplín Museum in Michalovce, taking place on November 14, 2026. This race offers a unique experience connected with the cultural environment of the museum and the surrounding nature. The race is part of the Zemplínsky extrém series, which includes several events in the region. Runners can expect an interesting course with an autumn atmosphere and a touch of local history.
course_highlights: The course runs through the premises of the Zemplín Museum in Michalovce
Autumn environment with a cultural touch
Part of the Zemplínsky extrém series with multiple events
additional: The event takes place on November 14, 2026, featuring several categories including children, and is held at the premises of the Zemplín Museum in Michalovce.

name: Grand Prix Powiatu Kościerskiego
description: The Grand Prix of Kościan County is a series of five 5 km races organized by all municipalities of Kościan County under the patronage of the Starosta of Kościan. The aim is to promote physical activity, healthy competition, and integration of local residents. Participants must be residents of the county and at least 16 years old in 2025. Each race is paid separately, and the overall classification is based on the total points earned in each race.
course_highlights: Series of 5 races of 5 km each
Organized by all municipalities of Kościan County
Separate classification for women and men, without age category divisions
additional: Participation in the Grand Prix is free; only the entry fee for individual races, determined locally, is payable. The race dates are spread from June to December 2025 in various towns within the county. The point classification sums results from each race, with prizes for the top 6 women and top 6 men, as well as additional special prizes from the organizers of each race. The series includes five 5 km races held from June to December, with classification and prizes for the best. The main 10 km race is scheduled for November 15, 2026, in Kościerzyna, with typical autumn weather, possible rain.

name: XXIV Maraton Odrzański
description: The 24th Odra Marathon is a race held in Kędzierzyn-Koźle, organized by the Odra Consortium Foundation. The event includes two categories: a full marathon of 42.195 km and a half marathon of 21.097 km. The event has a sporting and recreational character, and its partner is the Municipal Sports and Recreation Center in Kędzierzyn-Koźle. The race office operates on the days preceding and on the day of the race, providing support for participants.
course_highlights: Marathon and half marathon route in Kędzierzyn-Koźle
Organized by the Odra Consortium Foundation
Partnership with the Municipal Sports and Recreation Center
additional: Race office open on 14.11.2025 from 17:00 to 19:00 and on 15.11.2025 from 7:00 to 8:30. Contact phone numbers for organizers: Piotr (+48) 500 028 811, Piotr (+48) 604 589 483, Ania (+48) 602 534 780. The event is partnered with the Municipal Sports and Recreation Center in Kędzierzyn-Koźle. Electronic timing measurement, 6-hour limit to complete, the event includes both marathon and half marathon, taking place in November in Kędzierzyn-Koźle.

name: Beh jastrabskými vŕškami – 3. ročnik memoriálu Jána Dobáka
location: Šarišské Jastrabie, Obec Šarišské Jastrabie, Slovakia
organizer: Obec Šarišské Jastrabie, ZŠ s MŠ Šarišské Jastrabie
price_range: € (rôzne kategórie, niektoré zadarmo pre špecifické skupiny)
description: The Jastrabské Vŕšky Run is the 3rd edition of the Ján Dobák Memorial, held in the village of Šarišské Jastrabie. The race offers categories for children and adults with various age groups and disciplines, including a 10 km run and a 5 km run for men and women, as well as Nordic walking. The start for children is at 12:30 PM and for adults at 2:00 PM. The organizers are the Municipality of Šarišské Jastrabie and the Elementary School with Kindergarten Šarišské Jastrabie, welcoming runners of all ages and levels.
course_highlights: The route passes through Jastrabské Vŕšky in the village of Šarišské Jastrabie
Categories for different age groups and disciplines including Nordic walking
Start at the premises of the Šarišské Jastrabie Municipal Office
additional: Registration on-site is possible only in exceptional cases by agreement with the organizer. Children’s categories, residents of Šarišské Jastrabie, men over 70 years old, and women over 60 years old have free entry. There is an option for a discounted race package from Ľubotín to Hrad Plaveč + Jastrabské Vŕšky Run. The event includes 5 km and 10 km routes, with registration available online and on-site; prices vary depending on the category and registration method. Categories for children, seniors, and Nordic Walking are included.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 11. kolo
description: The 2-Mile Run Bratislava is a regular running race over a distance of 2 miles (3.218 km), held at the Kuchajda swimming complex in Bratislava. It is organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team and is part of a series of races with scoring based on categories for men and women. Registration takes place directly on-site at the volleyball court from 9:30 AM, with the start at 10:00 AM. Competitors include children, juniors, women, men, and veterans, and participants can earn points for improving their times throughout the year.
course_highlights: Course length of 2 miles (3.218 km)
Registration and start at the volleyball court within the Kuchajda swimming complex
Categories for children, juniors, women, men, and veterans
additional: Registration is available on-site at the volleyball court from 9:30 AM. The event competes for the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team Traveling Cup with scoring based on coefficients according to year of birth. In case of a tie in points, the best time is the deciding factor, followed by shoe size. At the end of the year, the two months with the lowest points are canceled (amnesty). Registration can be done on-site; the event takes place in various rounds throughout the year, with each run approximately 2 miles (3.218 km) long.

name: Beh na Husárik
location: Horské hoteli Husárik, Čadca, Žilina, Slovakia
description: Husárik Run is a traditional running race organized by the Kysucké Maratón Club Čadca, the town of Čadca, and the Husárik Mountain Hotel. This race is held in honor of Student Day and offers runners the opportunity to test their strength in a beautiful mountain environment. The start is always at 11:00 AM, and the race is known for its friendly atmosphere and the mayor's cup of Čadca as a prize for the winners. Husárik Run is suitable for the general public interested in sports and nature.
course_highlights: Mountain environment around Husárik Mountain Hotel
Race in honor of Student Day
Mayor's cup of Čadca for the winners
additional: Online registration has ended; registration is also possible on the day of the race with an increased entry fee of 8 EUR. The race takes place on November 15, 2026, with a start at 11:00 AM. Online registration is available. The course is hilly and trail-based, organized in Čadca near the Husárik Mountain Hotel.

name: Beh oslobodenia mesta Strážske
organizer: Mesto Strážske, bežecký klub MBO Strážske
description: The Liberation Run of the town of Strážske is a traditional sporting event that commemorates the anniversary of the town's liberation each year. This 49th edition attracted runners of various age groups, from children to adults, competing on different distances. The atmosphere is sporty and friendly, with awards for the fastest runners and a rich history of winners. The organizer is the town of Strážske in cooperation with the MBO Strážske running club, which supports the development of running sports in the region.
course_highlights: Multiple categories by age and gender
Courses suitable for youth and adults
Historical tradition since 1970
additional: The event has a long-standing tradition with awards for the fastest runners in each category. After the run, prizes are awarded, including a raffle with valuable prizes such as a mountain bike. In the past, over 300 runners participated, including local and international athletes. The event includes several categories, and results and historical winners are publicly available. Registration is possible online, and the course details are not specified.

name: Hermanovská desiatka
location: Hermanovce nad Topľou, Vranov nad Topľou, Slovakia
organizer: Obec Hermanovce nad Topľou a Hermanovský bežecký oddiel

description: Hermanovská desiatka is a running race organized by the municipality of Hermanovce nad Topľou and the Hermanovce Running Club. The race takes place in front of the Municipal Office building in Hermanovce nad Topľou and offers categories for children, youth, and adults. The start for children and youth is at 12:00 PM, and for adults at 2:00 PM. The race is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the region.
course_highlights: Competition for various age categories including children, youth, and adults
Organized in the picturesque environment of Hermanovce nad Topľou
Registration available via QR code and low entry fee of €10
additional: The start for children and youth is at 12:00 PM, and for adults at 2:00 PM. Categories are divided by age and gender, including local categories. Registration is mandatory by November 10, 2025, via QR code. The race is open to runners of all levels, with categories for children, youth, and adults. The event takes place on November 15, 2026, with starts at 12:00 PM for children and 2:00 PM for adults.

price_range: 10 € pre dospelých, 5 € pre seniorov a podujatie 'Prebehni sa s nami', zadarmo pre deti a mládež

description: Ferčekovská Ten is a running race held in the village of Ferčekovce near Spišská Nová Ves, offering courses for children, youth, and adults. The race takes place on forest roads and grassy, hilly terrains, creating a pleasant and natural environment for runners of all ages. The organizer is the Ferčekovce Sports Club in cooperation with the town of Spišská Nová Ves. The race is suitable for the general public, including families and running enthusiasts, who can choose from several categories and distances.
course_highlights: Surface: forest trail and grass
Hilly terrain in a natural environment
Multiple categories based on age and gender
additional: The start for children and youth is at 11:00, the race 'Run with us' begins at 12:15, and adults for 5 km and 10 km at 13:00. Categories are divided by age and gender, including special categories for seniors. The registration fee is lower with online registration; on-site the flat rate is €15. The event includes refreshments, medals for all finishers, the possibility of online registration, and various categories for all age groups.

name: Krosová 12°
description: The Cross 12° is a running race over 12 km or 6 km, which takes place on a hilly 6 km circuit around Velešín in the South Bohemian Region. This cross-country race offers runners a challenge in the form of demanding terrain with elevation gain, ideal for lovers of natural runs and hilly courses. The race is suitable for the general public who want to try running in terrain with beautiful views and a natural atmosphere. After the race, it is possible to use recommended running gear and accessories, which are presented on the official website.
course_highlights: Hilly 6 km circuit with elevation gain
Option to choose between 12 km and 6 km courses
Natural terrain with views around Velešín
additional: The race offers two course length options: 12 km and 6 km, run on a hilly circuit. The website recommends running gear and accessories such as Ultra Trail socks, Altra and Puma running shoes, and lightweight jackets suitable for variable weather. The race is suitable for runners of all levels, offering an attractive hilly course and the choice between two race distances.

name: Běh 17. listopadu
location: Ostrava-Hrabová, Ostrava, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The November 17th Run is a traditional running race in Ostrava-Hrabová that commemorates an important day in Czech history. It offers two main courses - the certified 10 km Free Ten and the 5 km Revolutionary Five. The race is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels who want to experience a sporting atmosphere and support the idea of freedom. Registration and check-in take place at ZŠ Paskovská, with the start in the morning. The routes lead through the picturesque environment of Ostrava-Hrabová with good public transport access and the possibility of using shared bikes from Nextbike.
course_highlights: Certified 10 km course Free Ten
5 km Revolutionary Five
Routes lead through Ostrava-Hrabová with good public transport access
additional: Registration and check-in on site take place at ZŠ Paskovská 110/46 from 8:30 to 9:40. The start of individual races is in the morning. Transport is provided by public transport lines 27, 39, 41, 77 with a stop at Šídlovec. Shared bikes from Nextbike are also available. The race includes various course lengths, online registration is available, and the event has a long tradition with results from previous editions.
