description: The Satin Run is a traditional running event held in Odolena Voda, offering courses for all age groups including a family run for parents with children. The race takes place on a football field and includes distances of 300 m, 600 m, 5 km, and 10 km. Participants can enjoy a friendly atmosphere, a handmade gingerbread medal, and small refreshments after the race including tea and mulled wine. Organizers ensure the safety of the course and also prepare a raffle with a variety of prizes. The main race is scheduled to start at 11:17.
course_highlights: Courses of 300 m, 600 m, 5 km, and 10 km
Start and finish on the football field in Odolena Voda
Handmade gingerbread medals for participants
additional: Runners registration begins at 08:45 at the race site. After the race, there is small refreshments available including tea, mulled wine, and homemade buns. Participants will receive a start number with a chip and safety pins. Parking is available at Penny Market. The organizers ensure course and race security. Categories are divided by age and gender, including categories Fighters, Champions, and Legends. The course surface includes the football field; the event features a raffle, refreshments, and fun activities for families; registration is possible on-site.

name: Běh 17. listopadu Přerov
description: The November 17th Run in Přerov is a traditional athletic event organized by Atletika SK Přerov. This race offers an opportunity for runners of all ages and levels to enjoy a sporting atmosphere and test their strength on an interesting course. The event takes place in the beautiful environment of Přerov and is part of the local athletics calendar. The race is suitable for both recreational runners and competitors.
course_highlights: Cross-country race over 9 km with children's categories available
Part of the Olomouc Region Long-Distance Runners Grand Prix
Affordable registration and results available online
additional: The race is part of the local running calendar, offering various courses including cross country and attracting a wide participation from the region.

name: Běh kolem koupaliště
description: The Run Around the Swimming Pool is a traditional running race organized by the Emil Zátopek Athletic Club Kopřivnice. The race takes place on a 5,000-meter circuit that runs around the local swimming pool. The start is at 11:00 AM, and participants can compete in several age categories. The event facilities include registration at the sports hall, changing rooms and showers, and after the race, an award ceremony with material prizes. The race is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels.
course_highlights: Circuit length of 5000 meters (4 laps)
The route runs around the swimming pool in Kopřivnice
Start and registration at the SOU Kopřivnice sports hall
additional: Registration from 9:45 AM at the SOU Kopřivnice sports hall. Categories divided by age and gender. Changing rooms and showers provided. Results announcement at 12:30 PM in the sports hall buffet with material prizes. Registration takes place at the SOU Kopřivnice sports hall. The race is open to men and women. Participants run 4 laps. Safety signage for roots and stones. Refreshments at the finish line. Raffle. Festive start with a shot by the mayor.

name: Běh 17. listopadu Kadaň
location: Rooseveltovy sady, Kadaň, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The November 17th Run in Kadaň is a traditional running race organized by the sports club SK Městská policie Kadaň. The race takes place in Roosevelt Gardens and offers an opportunity for runners of all ages. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and support of the local running community. The regulations and additional information are available for download in PDF format on the official website.
course_highlights: Race runs through Roosevelt Gardens in Kadaň
Course suitable for various age groups
Friendly atmosphere and support of the local running community
additional: The race regulations are available for download in PDF format. Results and photo galleries from previous editions are published on the website. The organizer is SK Městská policie Kadaň, a sports club with contact person Bc. Jiří Vlasák. The event includes starts at various distances (e.g., 100 m, 280 m, 550 m, 1300 m, 1800 m, 2500 m, 5000 m). Registration is available on the website, and the event is suitable for all age groups. The location is in Roosevelt Gardens in Kadaň, behind the sports hall.

name: Běh městem Hradec Králové
location: V Lipkách, Hradec Králové, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
description: The city run in Hradec Králové is a traditional road race held in the city center on a flat course. The race offers a 9.7 km long route, which is composed of five laps. A shorter loop of 200 meters is prepared for children and youth. The event is suitable for the general public and is organized by TJ Liga 100 Hradec Králové with the support of the Czech Athletic Federation.
course_highlights: 5 laps on a flat course in the city center
Children's loop 200 meters long
Road race with a length of 9.7 km
additional: The first category starts at 10:00, the main category starts at 12:00. The race takes place in the Lipky housing estate near ZŠ Josefa Gočára in Hradec Králové. The organizer is TJ Liga 100 Hradec Králové z.s., contact person Jiří Brych. The race is held in the Lipky housing estate, with starts scheduled at 10:00 and 12:00, and registration is possible via the sports portal sport-reg.cz.

name: Běh 17. listopadu Polička
location: Lesopark Liboháj, Polička, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 100 Kč hlavní závod, dobrovolné startovné lidový běh
description: The November 17th Run in Polička is a traditional cross-country race held in the Liboháj forest park. The main race covers 6 km, divided into two three-kilometer loops, and is complemented by a popular 3 km run. The event is part of the ISCAREX running cup and also features an additional race on the Polička ski slope for the brave. The race starts on the ski slope at 11:00 AM, with registration from 10:00 to 10:45 AM. The event is suitable for the general public and runners of all performance levels.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in Liboháj forest park with roads and trails
Main race 6 km (2x 3 km loops), popular run 3 km (1 loop)
Additional race on the Polička ski slope
additional: Registration for competitors takes place from 10:00 to 10:45 AM. The race is part of the ISCAREX cup. The additional race on the ski slope is intended for brave competitors. Weather is usually autumnal, and the course may be slippery and icy after overnight rain. The course runs on roads and trails in the forest park, with a competitive bonus on the ski slope, as part of the ISCAREX 2025 cup.

name: Beh oslobodenia mesta Michalovce
organizer: Mesto Michalovce, Atletický klub Michalovce, ZŠ Pavla Horova Michalovce
description: The Liberation of Michalovce city run is a traditional evening running race held in the center of Michalovce. Participants run through the city streets along a course approximately 5.8 km long, consisting of several loops. After finishing, they can enjoy refreshments and receive a participant medal. The race is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere with the opportunity for personal presentation on the race day.
course_highlights: Evening run through the center of Michalovce
Course length of 5.8 km, composed of loops of 1,450 m each
Refreshments and participant medal after finishing
additional: Registration takes place in the vestibule of the City Hall from 16:30 to 17:45, headlamps are recommended for safety. After finishing, race numbers are returned and participants receive a medal. Results announcement is at 19:30 in the gymnasium of 8th Elementary School P. Horova. The course is shortened to 5.8 km, run on asphalt and stone surfaces. Registration is possible online or on-site, with an entry fee of 20 €, reduced for online registration until 19.11.2025.

name: XLVII MnO Pierwszy Śnieg
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Rozwoju Orienteeringu, GKT Cyrkino Gliwice, Czartak Katowice, AKInO Kraków, RO PTTK Częstochowa, PlesInO Pszczyna, be-lość Piekary Śląskie, Krokus Miliardowice
description: The Śląskie Voivodeship Cup in Orienteering Marches is a series of events organized by tourist clubs and circles in the Silesia region. The competitions take place in various rounds throughout the year, with participants competing in six age categories and in team classification. The "First Snow" round is the tenth edition of the cup in the 2026 season, which will take place on November 21 in Katowice. The event combines sports competition with active outdoor recreation and terrain orientation.
course_highlights: Orienteering marches in the Silesian Voivodeship
Competition in six age categories
Team classification and trophies for the best
additional: The event includes various age categories, is part of a series of orienteering events, and takes place in forested and urban areas in Katowice.

name: Kružská Kundratická - Memoriál Honzy Šíra
description: Kružská Kundratická - Honza Šír Memorial is a hilly road race in Kruh, Liberec Region, offering men a 12 km course with a turnaround in Kundratice and women a 5 km course, which turns back earlier. The race is named in memory of Honza Šír and is suitable for runners seeking a challenge in hilly terrain. For more information, contact the organizer. The race is part of the running community and offers an opportunity to test strength on a demanding course.
course_highlights: Hilly road terrain
12 km course for men with a turnaround in Kundratice
5 km course for women with an earlier turnaround
additional: For race information, contact Jiří Sedláček at 606280856 and Jan Šír at 732851697. Race details are available via phone numbers of Jiří Sedláček (606280856) and Jan Šír (732851697).

name: Přáslavická desítka
location: Přáslavice u Olomouce, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The Přáslavice Ten is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, held in the village of Přáslavice near Olomouc. The race offers an opportunity for both recreational and competitive runners to enjoy a course set in the picturesque environment of Central Moravia. Liga stovkařů is known for its long-standing tradition and support of the running community in the region. The Přáslavice Ten is part of the Olomouc County Long-Distance Runners Grand Prix series and attracts runners of all ages and levels.
course_highlights: The route runs through the scenic landscape of Přáslavice near Olomouc
Mostly asphalt and forest surface
Part of the Olomouc County Long-Distance Runners Grand Prix
additional: The race takes place on April 21, 2026, as part of a series of local runs, with the course mainly on asphalt roads.

name: Běh na Čáp
location: Teplice nad Metují, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
description: The Čáp Run is a public uphill race with mass start held in Teplice nad Metují. This traditional race is part of the Běžecké vršky series and offers a sporting experience in beautiful nature. The race is suitable for the general public and provides an opportunity to test strength in challenging terrain. It is organized by Redpoint Teplice nad Metují, which ensures quality organization and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Uphill run with mass start
Challenging terrain around Teplice nad Metují
Part of the Běžecké vršky series with tradition and history
additional: The race features categories, registration is possible for an entry fee of 50 CZK, and it takes place in terrain with demanding elevation changes. Results are regularly published, and the race has a long tradition.

name: Forestovo Nočník
location: Záluží u Plzně, Plzeň-sever, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Forestovo Nočník is a night trail race in Záluží near Plzeň, offering a 5 km course full of fun and challenges. The race takes place in the dark, so a headlamp is mandatory and the course is marked with reflective elements, ensuring safety and a unique atmosphere. After finishing, participants are served tea and refreshments. This race is ideal for night running and trail enthusiasts who want to experience running in an unconventional environment with a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Night trail course 5 km
Course marked with reflective elements
Mandatory headlamp for safe running
additional: At the finish line, tea and refreshments are provided for racers. The race is characterized by 100% darkness and 100% fun. Organized by Jiří Cipra and team. The course is 5 km long, with mandatory headlamps, reflective markings, refreshments at the finish, and is suitable for various age groups.

name: Slánské běhy
description: Slaný Runs are a traditional orienteering race organized by the Slaný Orienteering Club. The race takes place around the town of Slaný and offers various categories including the main 12 km category and children's categories. The event is suitable for the general public and attracts runners of all ages. The organizers provide facilities and a friendly atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Main category of 12 km around Slaný
Children's and youth categories with shorter courses
Facilities provided by V.B.T. Grammar School Slaný
additional: The race is traditionally held in November, with the last edition on November 29, 2025. The organizers thank all competitors for their participation and look forward to the next edition. In the past, about 70 runners participated in the main category and several dozen children and youth. The main race is 12 km long, registration takes place at V.B.T. Grammar School Slaný, and the race will be held on Saturday, November 21, 2026, at 10:00 AM.

description: The Devil's Winter Trail is an off-road run through hills, forests, and between rocks around Hamr na Jezeře. The race offers two routes of 33.3 km and 16.6 km, with the possibility to change the route free of charge. Participants will enjoy challenging winter terrain with several refreshment stations and intense experiences on the hellish trail. The start is jointly at 10:00 AM, and the time limit is 7 hours. Included in the registration fee are timing services, gifts, refreshments on the course and at the finish line.
course_highlights: Off-road run through hills, forests, and between rocks
Two routes: 33.3 km and 16.6 km with free change option
3 refreshment stations on the long route and 1 on the short, plus refreshments at the finish
additional: The maximum number of participants is 400. The time limit is 7 hours, with checkpoint time limits at 15 km (3 hours) and 25 km (5 hours). Participants must bring their own cup for drinks; a devilish running cup can be purchased at the presentation. The registration fee includes pre-race refreshments (coffee, homemade cake), gifts in the race pack (sports socks), a timing chip for measuring times and splits, and food and drinks at the finish (soup, main meal, beer, soda, mulled wine, tea). The route is marked, with refreshment stations, a personal cup for drinks, nearby accommodation, and registration available on Friday and Saturday before the race.

name: Lesný beh priateľov Šemše

description: The Šemša Forest Friends Run is a running event in the village of Šemša in the Košice okolí district, offering three courses of different lengths: 22 km, 11 km, and 5.5 km. The route goes along paved forest roads, trails, field paths, and asphalt, creating a pleasant and diverse running environment. The race is open to all age categories without division into age groups and is organized by the civic association Šemša v pohybe. The start is divided into two waves, with the longer route starting at 10:00 AM and the shorter routes at 11:00 AM. The event is suitable for runners seeking forest running with varying difficulty and trail lengths.
course_highlights: The route goes along paved forest roads and trails
Includes field paths and asphalt sections
Three course lengths: 22 km, 11 km, and 5.5 km
additional: The start is divided into two waves: at 10:00 AM the 22 km route starts, and at 11:00 AM the 5.5 km and 11 km routes start. Categories are open to all ages, including children, men, and women. The organizer is the civic association Šemša v pohybe. The terrain is diverse, including forest roads, field paths, and asphalt. The race takes place on terrain with forest roads, field paths, and asphalt. Registration is possible online or on-site. There are categories for children, men, and women, with options to choose between short and long routes.

description: The Kysacký Castle Run is a running event organized by the Orienteering Club Kysak and the municipality of Kysak, held at the Cultural House in Kysak. The course mainly runs through forest roads (85%) with a smaller portion on asphalt (15%). The race is intended for various age categories from juniors to veterans, divided by age and gender. The registration fee is divided by categories and is paid during registration via bank transfer by a specified deadline. The event offers a pleasant atmosphere and the opportunity to compete in a beautiful natural environment.
course_highlights: 85% forest roads, 15% asphalt
Start at the Cultural House in Kysak
Multiple age categories from juniors to veterans
additional: Categories are divided by age and gender: juniors, juniors, men, and women in various age groups. The start location is at the Cultural House in Kysak. The race is organized in the environment of the historic Kysacký Castle with the possibility of registration via an online form and payment by bank transfer until 18.11.2024. There are categories for different age groups and genders.

description: The 13th Makowska Piętnastka is an annual race organized in Maków Mazowiecki, scheduled for November 22, 2026. The event features two distances: 15 km and 5 km, with start and finish lines located at the municipal stadium. The race is organized by the Athletic Sports Club Maków Mazowiecki in collaboration with local authorities. It attracts both experienced runners and younger participants, offering competitive sport and a friendly atmosphere.

Two distance options: 15 km and 5 km
City route suitable for adult and youth runners
additional: Timing is measured using a modern UHF RFID system with passive chips. Results are immediately displayed on a screen at the finish line and sent via SMS to participants. The event is recorded with a Full HD camera, and an electronic clock at the finish line tracks the time. Organizers provide original bib numbers on synthetic or laminated paper. Runners can choose between 5 km and 15 km races; the event includes training plans from 8 to 20 weeks and expert support; it is part of a series of sporting events in the region.

description: Panewnicki Wild Boar Run is a recreational running and Nordic Walking event held in the picturesque forests of Panewniki in Katowice. The competition takes place on a loop approximately 4,882 meters long, which can be completed up to four times. The event promotes an active lifestyle and education about proper behavior in forest areas. Participants can start individually or in pairs, and the event is open to both amateurs and members of sports clubs.
course_highlights: Route through the Panewniki forests approximately 4882 meters long
Loop marked every 1 km
Ability to complete the course up to 4 times
additional: The time limit for completing the run and Nordic Walking is 3 hours. Participants over 18 must sign a participation statement at their own risk or present a medical certificate. Children and youths under 18 can participate only in the presence of a parent or guardian. There is an option to purchase a package for all events in the year. Entry fees are non-refundable but can be transferred to the next start if registered by Thursday before the event at 3:00 PM. Running and Nordic Walking competitions, 3-hour time limit, possibility to buy packages for the entire year.

name: 405. Malá cena Monaka
description: The 405th Small Monaka Prize is a traditional running event taking place on November 22, 2026, in Slatiňany in the Pardubice Region. This event is part of the Monaka race series and offers an opportunity for runners of all levels to participate and enjoy the sporting atmosphere in a picturesque setting. Exact details about the course and registration are not yet available, but the race is popular among local and visiting runners.
course_highlights: Traditional local race in the heart of the Pardubice Region
Pleasant atmosphere and friendly environment
Opportunity to participate in various categories and performance levels
additional: The race is part of the Monaka series, which has a long tradition in the region. Exact information about registration and course length has not yet been published.

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
organizer: Miejski Zarząd Usług Komunalnych w Gliwicach
description: 146th Gliwice Park Run Provocation is an annual running event held in Gliwice that combines sport, a good atmosphere, and contact with urban greenery. The run is open to both experienced runners and those looking to spend active time without the pressure of competition. The race traditionally starts on the clearing behind the Piast stadium, and participants can expect a friendly atmosphere and an active way to end February. The event is an excellent opportunity to start the new month with energy and good spirits.
course_highlights: Start on the clearing behind Piast stadium (access from Leśna Street)
The route runs through urban greenery
The event combines sport with a good atmosphere and recreation
additional: Race office open from 9:00 AM. To be classified, prior registration and an entry fee are required. The event takes place on the last day of February, encouraging an active end to the month. trail run, online registration, start and finish on the clearing behind Piast stadium

name: Jesienny Ultra Świr
description: Autumn Ultra Świr is a mountain ultra race held in Grybów, challenging long-distance running enthusiasts in natural terrain. The course mainly runs through forest and gravel paths, with minimal asphalt sections, providing an authentic trail experience. The event offers various competition formats, including timed runs and Nordic Walking marches, tailored to different skill levels. Organized by experienced enthusiasts who ensure a good atmosphere and participant safety.
course_highlights: 98% of the course runs through forest and gravel paths
Minimal asphalt participation - only 2%
Start and finish at the Winter Sports Center in Ptaszkowa
additional: Start and finish as well as the race office are located at the Winter Sports Center in Ptaszkowa. The race office is open on race day from 06:45 to 07:30 for the 6/12/24-hour distances and until 9:30 for Nordic Walking and single lap runs. In the 6h and 12h races, the winner is the participant who completes the greatest number of full 17 km laps. Running during the Nordic Walking march is prohibited, and judges are present on the course to monitor proper technique. Participants must verify their identity at the race office with an ID and have the mandatory equipment. The event is part of the Autumn Ultra Świr series, which includes various distances and activity formats, with online registration. The course may change due to weather conditions.

name: XXIII Maraton Komandosa
description: The 23rd Commandos Marathon is a demanding marathon race covering a distance of 42.195 km, organized in Lubliniec. The event will take place on November 28, 2026, and is organized by the Military Running Club "Meta" Lubliniec. The race route has recently been changed and is available online. Participants can expect professional timing measurement and full technical support for the event.
course_highlights: New race route available online
Marathon distance 42.195 km
Organizer: Military Running Club "Meta" Lubliniec
additional: Race office open on 28.11 from 15:00 to 20:30 and on 29.11 from 07:00 to 08:40. The start fee is payable only via an individual link to quick online payments at tpay.com sent by email. After 31.10.2026, the fee is only available with the organizer's approval and without a full start package. The participant limit has been reached, registrations are suspended. New race route; participant limit reached; urban and forest terrain; electronic timing measurement.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (12) – listopadový
description: 5 and 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (12) - November is a regular running race in Prague Braník, offering a pleasant and fast course along the Vltava River. The race is part of the 16th edition of the Vaší Liga running series, where runners can compare their performances with others and track their progress throughout the year. The course is certified, and for the 10 km distance, it is possible to achieve the limit for the Czech Republic Championship. After the race, a relaxed atmosphere with refreshments and the opportunity to share experiences in the restaurant at Hamr Braník is provided.
course_highlights: Pleasant and fast course along the Vltava River in Prague Braník
Course measured with a certified device, suitable for the Czech Republic Championship limit at 10 km
Relaxed running atmosphere with refreshments after the race
additional: The start of the 10 km race is at 14:00, and the 5 km race at 14:05. Registration begins at 13:00 at the blue tent near the cycle path close to U Kempinku 2, Prague. After the race, an isotonic drink is available, and refreshments can be enjoyed at the Hamr Braník restaurant. Bag storage is available at the organizer’s tent. The race is timed with chip timing, and each runner also has a measured "chip" time. The race takes place in November 2026, with registration likely through the official website. The series includes multiple races throughout the year.

name: Mikulášský běh Zlín
description: St. Nicholas Run in Zlín-Louky is a traditional running race held in a beautiful environment along the Dřevnice River. The race offers courses of 5 km and 10 km, which run on flat circuits crossing bridges and cycle paths. The event also includes a family mask run over 1.5 km, an accompanying program for children, and a St. Nicholas and devil costume parade. Runners receive a starter pack with gifts and a commemorative medal at the finish line. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere of the Advent season.
course_highlights: The route runs along a wide grassy path along the Dřevnice River
Crossings over a concrete and iron bridge
Flat circuits around the football field in Zlín-Louky
additional: Family mask run over 1.5 km with a gingerbread reward at the finish. Accompanying program for children, St. Nicholas and devil costume parade. The starter pack includes gifts from partners and a commemorative medal. Charitable tombola for Krtek with sales and prize distribution during the event. Races of 5 km and 10 km, family and children's runs, charity event, start and finish at the football field in Zlín-Louky, rich accompanying program and starter pack.

name: Výběh na Lovoš
location: Lovoš, Lovosice, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Lovoš Run is a traditional uphill running race held in Lovosice in the Ústí Region. The race offers a challenging terrain run with a climb to the top of Lovoš, a popular destination for runners seeking a challenge and beautiful views. The start is on Lovošská Street, and the race is suitable for runners who want to try uphill running in a natural environment. The event is organized with a friendly atmosphere and the possibility of registration in advance or on-site.
course_highlights: Uphill run in terrain
Start on Lovošská Street in Lovosice
Challenging ascent to the top of Lovoš
additional: Luggage transport is provided from 12:30 to 13:30, the bus with backpacks departs at 13:30, and it is necessary to keep track of the departure time. The race is part of a series of sports events in Král středohoří, offering the possibility of registration in advance or on-site, with the start at 14:00. Luggage departure time is at 13:30.

description: Stupenská sedmička is the sixth edition of a trail running race held on Saturday, November 28, 2026, at the TJ Sokol Stupno grounds. The race offers a 7.2 km loop mainly on forest paths with minimal asphalt, suitable for both experienced runners and beginners of all ages. The race atmosphere is friendly and relaxed, with ample facilities and refreshments after the run. The registration fee includes a participant medal, timing, race photos, material prizes, and a raffle. The race is open to all athletes considering their health and abilities.
course_highlights: 7.2 km loop mainly on forest paths with minimal asphalt
Forest trail with tree roots and several forest hills
Crossing a road under volunteer supervision and running along an MTB trail
additional: The registration fee includes refreshments after the race such as tea, water, mulled wine, beer, soda, homemade buns, salty snacks, Christmas rolls, bananas, and energy bars. After the race, winners will be announced and a raffle will be drawn. The start number is equipped with a chip for timing, which must be returned after the race (500 CZK fee for loss). Race facilities include toilets, changing rooms, and parking at TJ Sokol Stupno. Participants are advised to write any allergies and emergency contact on the back of their start number. A medical professional will be present at the start and finish area. Registration includes gift vouchers, with proceeds supporting charity. A detailed route description is available.

name: 45 Strzeliński Rogaining
location: Kamiennik, Strzelin County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Polskie Towarzystwo Turystyczno-Krajoznawcze Oddział Ziemi Strzelińskiej
description: Strzeliński Rogaining is a pedestrian orienteering rally where teams of 2-5 people plan their own route to visit as many control points as possible within a designated time. The points are located in the terrain and marked on the map. The event is open to participants of all ages and skill levels, including enthusiasts and recreational participants, such as families. Rogaining has a tourist-sport character and allows for flexible route modifications during the competition, making it an attractive outdoor activity. The event is organized by the Polish Tourist and Sightseeing Society, Strzelin Branch, which has been hosting orienteering competitions in the region for years.
course_highlights: Teams move exclusively on foot, using a map and compass for navigation
Control points have different point values depending on the difficulty of finding them
Participants can choose and change their route freely, from 5 to 70 km in length
additional: The competition is open to all age groups and genders. Teams consist of 2-5 people. Rogaining is a tourist-sport activity suitable for both advanced competitors and families. Routes can be modified during the event. In 2026, four editions of rogaining are planned around Strzelin, including the 45th edition in November. The events cover various distances from 5 km to 70 km, with maps and compasses, catering to different skill levels, with options for recreational and competitive participation.

name: Szybka Piątka
description: Szybka Piątka is a 5 km race organized in Lublin, taking place on November 29, 2026. The event is part of a series of races organized by the Sports Development Foundation in Lublin, promoting physical activity and social integration. The race is an excellent opportunity for runners of various skill levels to test their form and enjoy the sporting atmosphere of the city.
course_highlights: 5 km distance in an urban environment
Training support from 8 to 20 weeks
Organized by a local sports foundation
additional: The race is part of local sporting events, includes various distances and age categories, and also features the Lublin Grand Prix classifications.

name: Garmin Ultra Race Gdansk
description: Garmin Ultra Race Gdańsk is a unique trail running event taking place on December 5, 2026, in the picturesque Trójmiejski Landscape Park. The route combines a seaside climate with varied mountainous terrain, offering runners challenging ascents, valleys, gorges, and ravines. It is an excellent opportunity to end the season in an atmosphere of sporting competition and contact with nature. The event is part of a nationwide mountain running series that promotes physical activity and respect for the environment.
course_highlights: The route runs through Trójmiejski Landscape Park with proximity to the sea
Varied terrain with dense forests, valleys, gorges, and ravines
Challenging elevation changes and natural ascents characteristic of trail running
additional: Start packages are issued on December 4-5, 2026, at the race office. Starts are staggered: a 6 km night run at 19:00 on December 4, and on December 5, races on distances of 101 km (05:00), 53 km (07:45), 27 km (10:30), 12 km (13:30), as well as Garmin Junior runs for children. The time limit for completing the distances ranges from 2 to 15 hours depending on the course length. Discounts are available when registering for more than one event in the series. The athlete card is available 5 days before the race after logging in at startlist.pl. Distances range from 12 km to 86 km, with time limits, qualification points for Ultra Trail du Mont Blanc, and accompanying races for children and youth.

name: XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic
description: The XVII Mysłowice Grand Prix is a series of races organized by the Truchtacz Mysłowice Association, promoting a healthy and active lifestyle as well as the integration of runners at various levels of advancement. The event takes place in Mysłowice and is open to all age groups and running levels. Participants can expect a friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to compete within the entire Grand Prix series. Registrations are only possible at the Race Office on the day of the race, and participation in the event is free of charge.
course_highlights: 10 km race in the picturesque surroundings of Mysłowice
A series of seasonal events promoting a healthy lifestyle
Running community and integration of the local community
additional: Registrations for the Grand Prix series are only possible at the Race Office on the day of the race. Participation in the Grand Prix events is free of charge. The event is open to everyone, regardless of skill level and age. The event focuses on promoting physical activity, health, and the running community, with various routes and seasonal editions.

name: Maraton Praha – Dobříš
location: A Park, Braník, Praha 4, Prague, Czech Republic

The route runs from Prague 4, Braník through Dobříš to Kytín, with elevation gain from 125 to 593 meters. Participants can use transportation for their belongings from the start to the finish line and are awarded absolute winners as well as category winners by age and gender. The event is suitable for trail running enthusiasts seeking a challenge in a natural environment with various race distances.
course_highlights: 42 km course with 593 m elevation gain
Start in Prague 4, Braník, finish in Kytín
Transport of participants' belongings from start to finish
additional: The 42 km race has an individual start, while the 21 km and 10 km races have mass starts. Aid stations are located at 10 km, 16 km, 27 km, 33 km, and at the finish line for the 42 km course. Parking is available near the start and finish areas. Participants run at their own risk and should exercise caution when crossing roads. The course is suitable for runners of all levels. Registration is available online, and maps of the route and information about participant categories are provided.

name: Mikulášský běh Čimelice
description: St. Nicholas Run Čimelice is a traditional annual race held in Čimelice, a popular event with a long history that usually takes place in early December. This event attracts local runners and visitors who can look forward to a sporting experience in a friendly atmosphere. Specific details about the course and race distance are not currently available, but the race is part of the local sports calendar and has a long-standing tradition.
course_highlights: Traditional race with a long history in Čimelice
Held annually in December
Friendly atmosphere and local community
additional: The race is part of the local sports calendar, and results from 2025 are available online.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - prosinec
description: The 2-mile run in Zlín - Příluky is an open race on a 3.2 km course designed for all age groups and running levels, from beginners to experienced runners. The route mostly passes between gardens in the Příluky industrial zone and consists of less than two laps on a precisely measured asphalt circuit. The race takes place every first Saturday of the month with registration in front of the Madal Bal company building and starts at 9:00 AM. Each participant is rewarded at the finish line with a warm cinnamon roll as a token of appreciation.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly between gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone
Precisely measured asphalt circuit of just under 2 laps (3.2 km)
The children's course is 800 meters long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 and older, and children up to 12 years (boys and girls). Time is measured for each competitor, and the top three places in adult and children categories are awarded small prizes. It is recommended to arrive by bike, on foot, by car, roller skates, or trolleybus No. 11 (stop Průmyslová zóna). The course is a precisely measured asphalt circuit, with the children's course being 800 meters long. The race is open to all age groups, with categories for men, women, boys, and girls. Start options include cycling, walking, driving, roller skating, or trolleybus No. 11.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - prosinec
description: The 2-mile run in Prague's Stromovka Park is an open race covering 3.2 km, suitable for all age groups and running levels, including children up to 12 years old who run 1.6 km. The race is friendly and encourages joy in running, whether you want to improve your personal best or just enjoy a pleasant run in a beautiful park. After finishing, everyone is greeted with a warm cinnamon pancake. The course runs along asphalt paths in Stromovka Park; adults run two laps, children run one lap.
course_highlights: The course runs along asphalt paths in Stromovka Park
Adults run 2 laps (3.2 km), children up to 12 years run 1 lap (1.6 km)
Beautiful environment of the Royal Game Reserve - Stromovka
additional: Registration takes place at the Brussels Gate area (under the Marold Panorama building) from 8:15 to 8:45, with the option of prior online registration for faster check-in. Categories are divided by age, with an age coefficient for the year-round Lívancový Cup. Recommended transportation includes cycling, walking, rollerblading, or tram (stop Výstaviště). There are tents for changing clothes and storing belongings, a mobile valuables storage, and WC cabins. Parking is recommended near the bridge to Císařský Ostrov on Za elektrárnou street. The course length is 3.2 km, asphalt surface, registration is voluntary, and running without bibs is possible.

name: LEKI WINTER SkyRace®
description: LEKI WINTER SkyRace® is a winter skyrunning race held at Ještěd in the area near the ski jumps. The race offers a challenging royal route of 22 km with an elevation gain of 1180 meters, closing the skyrunning season of 2025. In addition to the main race, shorter routes and children's races are available, allowing participation from a wide range of runners. The race atmosphere is complemented by the announcement of winners and an accompanying program.
course_highlights: Royal route Winter SkyRace®: 22 km with 1180 m elevation gain
Other routes: Winter Trail 12 km / 520 m+, Winter Easy 6 km / 220 m+
Children's races on 200 m, 500 m, and 1200 m
additional: The winners are announced from 15:30. The race takes place in the area near the ski jumps at Ještěd. There are also Canicross races of the same lengths as the main routes. The race is part of the LEKI JEŠTĚD SERIES. winter mountain race, multiple routes, children's races, canicross, registration, race equipment, and refreshments.

name: LEKI JEŠTĚD SkyRace®
description: LEKI Ještěd SkyRace® is a trail running race held on the Ještěd ridge in the Liberec region. It offers challenging courses with beautiful views and natural scenery appreciated by both experienced runners and mountain running enthusiasts. The race is part of the JEŠTĚD SKYRACE series and is known for its friendly atmosphere, quality organization, and rich accompanying program including healthy refreshments and a partner zone. Participants can also purchase original merchandise for the 10th anniversary of the race.
course_highlights: Trails on the Ještěd ridge with beautiful views
Challenging mountain terrain with various course lengths (22 km, 13 km, 6 km)
Rich accompanying program including healthy and diverse refreshments
additional: Participants receive a specially prepared race kit. There is healthy and diverse catering including meat, vegetarian, and vegan options, as well as quality coffee. The event also features a TV studio with interviews and competitions, and an expanded partner zone with equipment and accessories for runners. Original merchandise for the 10th anniversary of the race is available. Races on different courses, a series of races in summer and winter, registration options, results, and rules are available on the official website.

name: Čertovská 5
description: Čertovská 5 is a traditional winter run in Unhošť covering a distance of 5.7 km, offering not only a sporting experience but also social gathering and the announcement of the Sokol Cup. Runners are welcome to participate in devil costumes, which adds a unique atmosphere to the race. The race is divided into categories based on age and gender, allowing for fair competition. The event takes place at the Sokol Hall and is popular among locals and visitors.
course_highlights: Traditional winter run over 5.7 km
Runners in devil costumes are welcome
Announcement of the Sokol Cup after the race
additional: The race takes place on December 6, 2025, from 08:00 to 11:00 in Unhošť, Sokol Hall, Melicharova Street. Categories are divided by age and gender (men and women in various age groups). After the race, there will be social gathering and the announcement of the Sokol Cup results. Terrain: winter course, registration via naZávody.cz, suitable for all age groups and mask enthusiasts.

name: Běh do vrchu Ráztoka-Pustevny
description: The Ráztoka-Pustevny uphill run is a traditional mountain race held in Ráztoka and around Pustevny. This race offers a challenging course with elevation gain that tests runners' endurance and strength in the beautiful environment of the Moravian-Silesian Beskids. The event is popular among athletes of all levels and has a rich history dating back to 1969. It welcomes all who enjoy mountain running and want to experience the unique atmosphere of this race.
course_highlights: Ascent to Pustevny with an elevation gain of 400 m
Course length approximately 5.7 km
Mountain environment of the Moravian-Silesian Beskids
additional: The race is suitable for children, weather can affect conditions, registration details are not specified, the event has a long tradition and is very popular.

name: Malá cena Velké Verandy
description: The Little Prize of Velká Veranda is a traditional forest cross-country race held in Chocen. The race is 4,300 meters long and runs along forest roads and paths with an elevation gain of approximately 200 meters. The route is marked with flags and includes a short section of asphalt. This race is also a Memorial of Jirka Švadlena and is popular among runners seeking challenging terrain with a hilly profile.
course_highlights: 4,300 meters through forest roads and paths
Hilly profile with approximately 200 meters of elevation gain
Route marked with flags, approximately 400 meters of asphalt
additional: The race offers approximately 400 meters of asphalt, suitable for runners seeking a challenge in a natural environment, and is part of the local sports calendar.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - prosinec
description: The 2-Mile Run Olomouc is an open race over 2 miles (3.2 km) designed for all age groups and running levels, from beginners to experienced runners. The race takes place in the picturesque environment of Smetanovy Sady in Olomouc, where everyone can enjoy running for fun and compete primarily with themselves. There is also a trophy competition, where results are adjusted according to age coefficient and runners collect points throughout the year. Registration takes place on the race day from 9:30 to 10:00 AM, with the start at the fountain in the park.
course_highlights: Course length of 2 miles (3.2 km) in Smetanovy Sady in Olomouc
Race suitable for all age groups and running levels
Picturesque park environment with a fountain as the starting point
additional: Registration takes place on the race day from 9:30 to 10:00 AM. The race location is at the fountain in Smetanovy Sady, except for two races in June and August, which are held by the river on U Dětského domova street. The top three places in each category are awarded. The race is held on an asphalt track, registration is from 9:30 to 10:00, and the event is part of a series of runs in Olomouc with multiple dates throughout the year.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 12. kolo
description: The 2-Mile Run Bratislava is a regular running race over 2 miles (3.218 km) organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team at the Kuchajda swimming complex in Bratislava. The race is open to a wide range of categories including children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. Registration takes place on-site from 9:30 AM, and the start is at 10:00 AM. The competition is part of a series where runners earn points towards the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team's Traveling Cup, with finishing times converted according to coefficients based on the year of birth.
course_highlights: Course length 2 miles (3.218 km), children approximately 200 m
Location: Kuchajda swimming complex, Bratislava
Registration at the volleyball court
additional: Registration is on-site at the volleyball court from 9:30 AM. Categories include children (13 years and under), juniors, women, men, veterans, and veteran women. Participants are scored based on the number of participants in their categories, with juniors and junior women scored separately. In case of a tie in points, the year of birth and the best time of the year are decisive. An amnesty is announced for two participations, during which the two months with the lowest points are canceled. The races have various rounds throughout the year, including the December 12th round. Registration is possible on-site; details about the price are not specified, and the course is mostly asphalt in an urban environment.

name: Mikulášsky nočný výbeh na rozhľadňu na Balážke
location: Základná škola Hviezdoslavova, Lipany, Prešov, Slovakia

tiers.label: tier_1

description: Mikuláš Night Run to the lookout tower at Balážka is an adrenaline-filled night run designed for participants over 15 years old. The event takes place on December 6, 2025, starting at 7:00 PM from the Hviezdoslavova Elementary School in Lipany. Runners can look forward to a unique experience in a nocturnal environment with a view from the lookout tower. The registration fee is set at a minimum of €7, and interested participants must register by December 5, 2025.
course_highlights: Night run with an adrenaline atmosphere
The route leads to the lookout tower at Balážka
Event intended for participants over 15 years old
additional: The event is a unique night event with a minimum starting fee of €7. Participants must be over 15 years old. Registration is possible until December 5, 2025. The start is from Hviezdoslavova Elementary School in Lipany. Night run, start from ZŠ Hviezdoslavova, registration until 5.12.2025, discounted starts available for groups and costume participants, the event includes refreshments and showers.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Nižbor
price_range: 390 Kč za závod, 1 900 Kč za 6 závodů, 2 900 Kč za celou sérii

tiers.label: tier_1

description: The Berounka Running Series is a series of 12 races in the beautiful surroundings of the Berounka River from Radotín to Nižbor, taking place from January to December 2026. The routes run along trails with stunning views and diverse terrain, often near nature reserves and historic sites. The series is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners, with the goal of motivating regular running. Starts are usually at accessible locations with train connections and facilities in local pubs. At the end of the series, winners are announced and prizes are awarded in 12 categories.
course_highlights: Trails run along with views of the Berounka River and the Czech Karst Protected Landscape Area
Challenging ascents and natural reserves, such as Klapice and Radotín Rocks
Starts at accessible locations with train connections and facilities in local pubs
additional: On-site at the races, there is the possibility of refreshments, baggage storage, changing rooms with showers, and race numbers. It is recommended to bring a headlamp. The ranking is based on the 10 best scored races in the series. Starts are mostly near train stations and in local pubs that provide facilities. Trail races around Berounka, mainly accessible by train, winners announced in December, 12 categories, scoring based on the best 10 races.

name: 9 Bieg Śladami Żubra
description: The Trail of the Bison Run is an annual running event organized by the Sports Association "Active Pszczyna" in Studzienice, held in December. The race course runs over one or two loops through the Studzienice forest, part of the Pszczyna Forest, offering picturesque forest landscapes. The event features various distances, including Costume Run, races for children, as well as 6 km and 12 km runs and Nordic Walking, as well as a half marathon and marathon. Participants can expect medals, awards for costumes, and traditional pea soup at the finish line.
course_highlights: Course through Studzienice forest, part of Pszczyna Forest
Competition over one or two forest loops
Scenic forest landscapes and natural mud
additional: Start times are scheduled at different hours: 08:00 for the marathon, 08:30 for the Costume Run (1.8 km), 10:10 for the half marathon. For children, races are prepared over distances of 200m, 400m, 800m, and 250m, 400m, 850m depending on age. Medals and awards for the most interesting costumes are available at the finish. A team classification (top 4 times after 1 loop) is organized. The course is also used for Nordic Walking. Traditional pea soup is served at the finish. GPX files for the half marathon, marathon, and 6 km and 12 km runs are available. The new marathon distance, changed start and finish locations, culinary and recovery attractions, honorary patronages, additional cross competitions, and team classification are also featured.

name: Winter Milada Run
location: Chabařovice, Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: WINTER Milada Run is a winter running race held in the unique landscape of the former lignite mine, which has been transformed into the beautiful natural environment of Lake Milada on the border of the Ore Mountains and the Central Bohemian Uplands. The race takes place on December 12, 2026, in Chabařovice and offers routes of 12.5 km and 5.3 km, including children's races Olympia. The event marks the end of the running season in northern Bohemia and attracts hundreds of runners each year to the magical snowy and icy scenery of the lake. All races have a family-friendly and friendly atmosphere and are suitable for children, families, and adult competitors.
course_highlights: Routes lead through the natural environment of the former lignite mine transformed into Lake Milada
Winter run in the snowy and icy landscape of Lake Milada
Two main routes: 12.5 km and 5.3 km, plus children's races
additional: Start packages and medals for all participants. The official Milada Tour 2026 T-shirt can be ordered during registration and picked up on race day. A children's T-shirt is provided free to the first 100 registered children. The race capacity is limited to 500 runners. The accompanying program includes St. Nicholas, Krampus, and the Angel, as well as the Olympia children's corner. Terrain in the area of the former mine, winter/ice conditions, family and children's categories, on-site registration, medals for all participants, official T-shirts available for purchase.

name: Mikulášský běh Úpice
location: Náměstí v Úpici, Úpice, Czech Republic
description: The Mikulášský Run in Úpice is a traditional running race organized by the physical education club Maratonstav Úpice. The race takes place at the square in Úpice and offers categories for children and adults. The start number is valid for the entire series of races organized by the organizer. The event is suitable for all age groups and runners of various levels.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the square in Úpice at A. Jiráska Theatre
Categories for children and adults with separate starts
Friendly atmosphere and the possibility to participate in the race series
additional: The race office is open one hour before the start of the first category. Registration closes at 13:30 for children’s categories and at 14:00 for adults. The start number is valid for the entire race series and must be with you for each subsequent race. Results are not announced after individual races but are published on the organizer's website. The race takes place on December 12, 2026, at the square in Úpice, with the start scheduled at 14:00 for children and 14:30 for adults. Registration is conducted one hour before the start, and results are published online.

name: Zručský adventní běh
location: Zruč nad Sázavou, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Zruč Advent Run will take place for the seventh time on December 12, 2026, and has both charitable and competitive aspects. The goal of the race is to motivate more people to engage in sports, help those in need, and offer participants a way to escape pre-Christmas stress by running through the Christmas-lit Zruč. The course passes through a beautiful castle park and surrounding areas with a Christmas atmosphere, which can be viewed in a video or downloaded as a GPX file for smartwatches. After the race, a warm soup and mulled wine are prepared for a pleasant conclusion to the event.
course_highlights: Run through the Christmas-lit Zruč
The route passes through a castle park and surroundings with a Christmas atmosphere
Option to download a GPX file of the route for smartwatches
additional: The race has a charitable character and after the run, participants are served warm soup and mulled wine. The absolute winner and winner have a record time of 19:10. The course is illuminated with Christmas lights, and the atmosphere is enhanced by Christmas decorations. The event offers two routes of 900 meters and 5500 meters, suitable for children and adults, and is associated with a Christmas atmosphere and the possibility to download a GPX file of the route.

name: Předvánoční běh
description: The pre-Christmas run is a traditional running race with a history dating back to 1984, held in Frýdek-Místek. The race offers courses for youth and adults, with youth running on asphalt circuits in the stadium area from 180 meters to 1.7 km. Adults run on one-kilometer circuits, men 8 km and women 3 km, with the possibility of different lengths within the stadium area. The race is suitable for the general public and is part of the TJ Slezan Frýdek-Místek athletics calendar.
course_highlights: Asphalt circuits in the stadium area for youth from 180 m to 1.7 km
One-kilometer circuits in Staré Město for adults - men 8 km, women 3 km
Race history since 1984 with a long-standing tradition
additional: Race in the stadium area with on-site registration, refreshments at the stadium clubroom, various courses from 200 m to 8 km

description: Panewnicki Wild Boar Run is a recreational running and Nordic Walking event held in the picturesque forests of Panewniki in Katowice. The competition takes place on a loop approximately 4,882 meters long, which can be completed up to four times. The event promotes an active lifestyle and education about proper behavior in forest areas. Participants can start individually or in pairs, and the event is open to both amateurs and athletes affiliated with sports clubs.
course_highlights: Route through the Panewniki forests approximately 4882 meters long
Loop marked every 1 km
Ability to complete the route up to 4 times
additional: The time limit for completing the route in running and Nordic Walking is 3 hours. Participants over 18 must sign a declaration of participation at their own risk or present a medical certificate. Minors must be accompanied by a parent or guardian during verification. There is an option to purchase a start package for the entire year. Entry fees are non-refundable but can be transferred to the next start if registered by Thursday before the event at 3:00 PM. The competition is recreational, with a 3-hour time limit, electronic registration, and non-refundable fees. The event also has an educational aspect, promoting proper behavior in forest areas.

name: Bieg po moczkę i makówki
location: Szkoła Podstawowa w Stanowicach, Stanowice, Opole, Poland
description: The Moczka and Makówki Run is an annual friendly running event held in Stanowice, which has been a fixture in the Christmas race calendar since 2012. The course is 10 km long, divided into four loops of 2.5 km each, with the option to finish early after any number of loops. After the race, participants receive handmade gingerbread medals and traditional holiday dishes: moczka and makówki, as well as hot coffee and tea. The event is characterized by a relaxed, friendly atmosphere, as well as a contest for the most interesting costume and a fan contest with prizes.
course_highlights: 10 km course divided into four 2.5 km loops
Start and finish at the Primary School in Stanowice, ul. Szkolna 17A
Option to complete the race after any number of loops
additional: After the race, participants receive handmade gingerbread medals and a portion of traditional holiday dishes: moczka and makówki. There is a fan contest with prizes, as well as a contest for the most interesting holiday-carnival costume, both individual and group. The event features a relaxed, friendly atmosphere and encourages active cheering. The event includes costume contests, recreational activities, a base at the Primary School in Stanowice, and the opportunity to participate in a 10 km race. The race usually takes place in December during the holiday season.

name: 406. Malá cena Monaka – Vánoční
description: The Little Monaka Prize - Christmas is a traditional running race held in Slatiňany in the Pardubice Region. This Christmas race is part of the Little Monaka Prize series and offers runners the opportunity to compete in a pleasant pre-Christmas atmosphere. The race is suitable for the general public and is known for its friendly organization and sporting spirit. The organizer is KRB Chrudim, which has been organizing running events in the region for many years.
course_highlights: Traditional Christmas run in the picturesque environment of Slatiňany
Friendly atmosphere and quality organization
Part of the Little Monaka Prize series with a long-standing tradition
additional: The race takes place on December 20, 2026, in Slatiňany, Pardubice Region, and is part of the Little Monaka Prize series. The event is suitable for all age groups and running levels.

name: Vánoční běh Opava
description: The Christmas Run Opava is a traditional running race organized by the BěhOpava - spolek team. The race takes place on a 4.7 km course leading from Englišova Street towards Gappay (Latarna) along a rural asphalt road with several turns and returning back to the finish line. The course is marked with kilometer signs to help runners monitor their performance. The race is open to various age categories from pupils to men in several age groups. Organizers provide small prizes for the top runners and hold a raffle for additional prizes.
course_highlights: 4.7 km course along a rural asphalt road
Kilometer markers on the course for orientation
Start and finish at Englišova Street - Školní statek gate
additional: The course record is held by Petr Gebel from 1994 with a time of 13:39. The race is run at your own risk with a warning to be cautious when crossing roads and to follow the instructions of the organizers. The finish line judges are members and supporters of the BěhOpava association. The race takes place on an asphalt course with a slight incline, starting at Školní statek, and is complemented by small prizes and a commemorative run.

name: Vánoční běh v Ďáblickém háji
location: Ďáblický háj, Praha 8, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic
description: Christmas Run in Ďáblický háj is a non-competitive running event held in the health area of Ďáblický háj in Prague 8. The route goes through two loops in Ďáblický Forest, mainly flat with one gentle hill, making it suitable for runners of all levels. The event traditionally takes place on December 24th, with the first category starting at 10:00 AM. Organized by AVC Prague, the run is free of charge, fostering a friendly and community atmosphere.
course_highlights: Two loops in Ďáblický Forest
Flat terrain with one gentle hill
Forest environment in the health area
additional: The race is non-competitive, starting in the health area of Ďáblický háj, and the run is free. Organized by AVC Prague, contact: Zdeněk Weig, phone: 733 690 323. The course is suitable for all age groups. The event takes place on Christmas Eve, December 24, 2026, in the health area of Ďáblický háj.

description: The St. Stephen's Run in Prachatice is a traditional sporting event held for the forty-fourth time, open to the general public from children to veterans. The morning program begins with children's and youth categories, with the main 10 km race and the 5 km hobby race starting at 11:00 AM. The route runs along an asphalt road with an elevation gain of 176 meters on the main course and 68 meters on the hobby course. The race takes place in front of the Municipal Stadium in Prachatice and is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup 2025.
course_highlights: Main course 10 km with an elevation gain of 176 meters
Hobby race 5 km with an elevation gain of 68 meters
Start and finish in front of the Municipal Stadium in Prachatice
additional: Runners have access to changing rooms and showers in the stadium stands, and refreshments (tea and bread) are available at the finish line. Start numbers and chips are issued during registration and are to be returned to the organizers after the race. Prizes include trophies, material prizes, and monetary rewards for breaking the course record. The first 100 registered and paid participants of the main races will receive gifts from sponsors. The race includes 5 km and 10 km courses, registration is available via maraton.cz, and showers, refreshments, and facilities for competitors are provided.

name: Štěpánský kros pro děti všech kategorií a Lidový běh

The race is suitable for all age groups, from the youngest children with a 100-meter course to adults with the adult People's Run over 4,200 meters. The event takes place in all weather conditions and offers a sporting atmosphere and support for all participants. Registrations are possible online, via email, or on-site on the day of the race.
course_highlights: Mixed surface course - asphalt and grass
Categories for children from 4 years old to adults
Adult People's Run over 4200 meters (2x large loop)
additional: Registration on-site takes place from 8:45 to 9:45 AM, children's categories until 9:30 AM. Changing rooms are available at the stadium stands but are public and the organizer is not responsible for lost items. Registrations can be submitted electronically until December 23, 2025, via email, QR code, or in person on the race day. The course has a mixed surface - asphalt and grass; registrations online or on-site; different distances for different age groups; changing rooms available; the event is suitable for all age groups.

name: Štěpánský běh Zlín
location: Příluk u Zlína, Zlín, Czech Republic
price_range: zdarma (dětské běhy), ceny za dospělé od 300 Kč výše
description: Stěpánský běh ve Zlíně is a traditional running race organized by Běhy Zlín association in Příluky. The main race over 10 km is divided into three laps and starts at the football field at 10:00 AM. The event also includes free children's runs held after the main race. The race offers awards for adult runners and unique medals for winners in various categories. The event attracts runners from the wider area and is part of the Běhy Zlín series.
course_highlights: Main 10 km course divided into three laps
Surroundings of the football complex in Příluky
Children's runs after the main race
additional: Winners will be announced at 11:45 AM on site. Category winners will receive original medals and possibly material prizes. Children's runs are free with a small reward for each child, without winner announcements. The race is part of Christmas celebrations, with winners announced at 11:45 AM, and offers various categories and prizes for winners. The event takes place around the football complex in Příluky and is suitable for all age groups.

name: Vánoční běh Třtice
description: The Christmas Run Třtice is a traditional running race held annually on December 26th in the village of Třtice in the Central Bohemian Region. The race is 4.8 km long and is run in categories based on age and gender. This run is a popular sporting event that continues a long-standing tradition and attracts runners from the surrounding area. The race is part of the village's sports activities and offers a pleasant atmosphere for athletes and spectators.
course_highlights: Distance of the course 4.8 km
Categories by age and gender: A (up to 39 years), B (40-49 years), C (50-59 years), D (over 60 years), E (women)
Traditional Christmas run organized since 1976
additional: The race is run in the same categories as the summer Třtice Sock Run. Results from previous years are regularly published on the village's website. The village of Třtice offers sports facilities including a children's playground and a multi-purpose sports field. The race takes place on December 26, 2026, with approximately 200 runners participating. The course is about 4.8 km long with an elevation gain of approximately 50 meters. The race is suitable for the general public and promotes the Christmas sporting atmosphere.

name: (Před)Silvestrovský běh Lysá nad Labem
location: Lysá nad Labem, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Tělocvičná jednota Sokol Lysá nad Labem
description: The New Year's Run Lysá nad Labem is a traditional race organized by the Physical Education Union Sokol Lysá nad Labem. This run takes place at the end of December and attracts runners who want to enjoy sports activity even in the winter season. After a two-year break, the event is once again welcoming participants who can enjoy a pleasant atmosphere and a sporting challenge in Lysá nad Labem. The event is part of a long-standing tradition and promotes physical fitness and the spirit of sport.
course_highlights: The course runs through the city streets of Lysá nad Labem, including the city center
Available routes are 6.2 km and 3.1 km long
The race is part of a traditional year-end celebration with a Christmas atmosphere
additional: The race starts and ends in Lysá nad Labem, it is a traditional annual event supporting sports activity in the community

name: Silvestrovský běh Jistebnice
location: Jistebnice, Jistebnice, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: SPOLEK PRO SPORT VŠEHO DRUHU a Město Jistebnice
description: The New Year's Eve Run in Jistebnice is a traditional running race organized by the Association for All Sports and the town of Jistebnice, held annually on New Year's Eve. In 2025, the 43rd edition of this popular event will take place, which also includes a scooter race and children's races. The race takes place amidst full road traffic with support from organizers at key intersections and offers a sporting experience for the general public. The organizers warmly invite all sports enthusiasts to participate and wish everyone an enjoyable experience and a great start to the new year.
course_highlights: The race takes place amidst full road traffic with support from organizers at junctions and intersections
Includes scooter races and children's races
Traditional New Year's Eve run with a long-standing history (43rd edition)

The race is part of the broader SPSVD Jistebnice sports calendar and is accompanied by other sports and cultural events. races, routes, schedule, facilities, start, health warnings, road traffic

name: Silvestrovský běh Hrabovou
location: Ostrava-Hrabová, Ostrava, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: The New Year's Eve Run in Hrabová is a traditional race held at the end of the year in Ostrava-Hrabová. This run offers participants the opportunity to end the year actively and in a friendly atmosphere. The routes lead through the picturesque environment of Hrabová and are suitable for various performance levels. The race is part of the Hrabovské běhy series and is known for its long-standing tradition and community spirit.
course_highlights: Routes lead through the picturesque environment of Ostrava-Hrabová
Various distances suitable for a wide range of runners
The race is part of the traditional Hrabovské běhy series
additional: The race is part of the Hrabovský pohár and the Moravskoslezský běžecký pohár. After the race, refreshments, changing rooms, and toilets are provided. Photos and videos are taken for event promotion. There is an option to find relay partners and participate in the New Year's Eve relay. The event takes place annually on December 31st, with participants able to choose from different categories and distances. Registration is available on the website.

description: The New Year's Eve Run around 3 Reservoirs is a relaxed race held on the last day of the year in Jablonec nad Nisou. The route passes around three reservoirs in Jablonec nad Nisou and is approximately 5 km long. The race is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant sporting atmosphere at the end of the year. For those who register in advance, gifts are prepared, and interesting prizes from partners are available for the winners.

Start and finish at the Volt brewery premises

The course is approximately 5 km long, with possible changes in bad weather. Registration is possible until 29.12.2025, and the entry fee is non-refundable. The event is open to the general public and is ideal for an active end to the year.

name: Silvestrovský běh Karviná

description: The New Year's Eve Run in Karviná is a traditional road race over 10 km, held annually on December 31st. The route passes through the outskirts of the city with an elevation gain of over 100 meters, presenting a challenge for every runner. The event also includes children's runs in the local forest park on tracks ranging from 200 m to 1.8 km, which are free of charge. Registration and check-in take place at the city stadium, where the entire event is also based. After the race, participants can enjoy refreshments and an award ceremony for medalists in various categories.
course_highlights: The 10 km route passes through the outskirts of Karviná
Elevation gain of over 100 meters
Children's runs in the forest park on tracks of 200 m, 350 m, 900 m, and 1.8 km
additional: Check-in is from 8:30 to 9:45. The children's runs start at 10:05. The main route surface is asphalt road, children's runs take place in the forest park. After the race, refreshments including goulash and tea with the option of rum are provided. Registered athletes register through clubs, unregistered parents can also participate. The race starts at 10:00, children's runs at 10:05. Registration is open until December 28 or 29. The event takes place at the City Stadium and in the forest park.

name: Silvestrovský běh Havlovicemi
description: New Year's Eve Run Havlovice is a traditional running race organized by Maratonstav Tělovýchovná Jednota Úpice, held annually on New Year's Eve in Havlovice. The race offers a main run of 6.6 km, which follows a new route of four laps, as well as children's categories with shorter distances. The event is suitable for adults, juniors, and youth and concludes with New Year's Eve refreshments at the finish line. The start is at the HAPO complex in Havlovice, where athlete registration is also arranged. This run is part of a long-standing tradition of running races in the region.
course_highlights: Main race 6.6 km - 4 laps on a new route
Start and finish at the HAPO complex in Havlovice
New Year's Eve refreshments at the finish
additional: Children's categories start at 10:00 AM, the main race begins at 11:00 AM. Registration is open until 9:30 AM for children's categories and until 10:30 AM for the main race. The race includes the main course and children's categories; race day concludes with a festive refreshment; the event is suitable for all age groups.

name: Silvestrovský běh Zlín
description: New Year's Eve Run in Zlín is a traditional race held on New Year's Eve, offering courses of 10 and 5 kilometers. The main 10 km race takes place over two laps on a turnaround route along the cycle path from Vršava to Kostelec and back. The race is suitable for the general public, including youth and juniors, and is part of the Zlín Running Series. Winners are announced shortly after the race with material prizes for the best in each category.
course_highlights: The route runs along the cycle path from Vršava to Kostelec and back
The main race is 10 kilometers divided into two laps
Shorter courses for youth and juniors of 5 kilometers are available
additional: Online registration is possible until December 30th at 12:00 PM, with on-site registration on race day until 10:40 AM. Winners are announced at 12:45 PM at the race check-in location. Age categories are according to the rules of the Zlín Running Series. Category winners will receive material prizes according to the organizer's possibilities. The race includes courses of 5 km and 10 km, online registration, category winner announcements, photographs, and results available.

name: Silvestrovský běh Stříbro
organizer: Sdružení vytrvalců Stříbro, z.s. a TJ Baník Stříbro
description: The New Year's Run in Stříbro is a traditional running race held at the end of the year in the picturesque town of Stříbro in the Plzeň Region. The race offers a 10.5 km course mostly off-road, with start and finish in the KERMI area. The run is suitable for all runners who want to end the year actively and pleasantly, with the option to start in different waves according to speed. After the race, results will be announced, and participants can enjoy seating and refreshments. The organizer is KERMI Stříbro, which ensures a friendly atmosphere and quality organization.
course_highlights: 10.5 km course mostly off-road
Start and finish in the KERMI Stříbro area
Option to start at 10:00 or 10:30 depending on the runner's speed
additional: Results will be announced after the race, with seating and refreshments available. Entry fee can be paid in advance via email or on-site at the KERMI training center. description: New Year's Eve Run - Richard Plch Memorial is a traditional running race organized by the athletic club AC Moravská Slavia Brno. It takes place on December 31 in Brno-Nové Lískovce in the Pod Plachtami park and offers courses for all age groups from children to veterans. Participants can choose between the main races of 9.84 km and 4.92 km, a popular run of 1.64 km, and children's categories starting from 100 meters. The course is asphalt with a combination of paved paths, and runners will enjoy a pleasant atmosphere to end the year in motion.

Routes for all age groups from 100 m to 9.84 km

Results will be posted continuously at the start/finish area and subsequently published on mslavia.cz and atletika.cz. The top three finishers in each category will receive material prizes, and children at the finish line will receive a small prize. In the Popular Run, prizes will be drawn among three participants. Entry to two races is only possible for categories up to older youth. The course consists of asphalt and paved paths; online registration is open from November 20, 2025, to December 29, 2025; the event includes various age categories and a popular run for all ages.

Results can be sent to the organizer via email or SMS and will subsequently be published in the results list. The start is at the FK Kolín football field, and the course runs along roads, a cycle path, and a chestnut alley with the finish at the athletics stadium.

name: Půlnoční silvestrovsko - novoroční běh metropolí
description: The Midnight New Year's Eve Run of the metropolis is a unique sporting event held in the night Prague just before midnight on New Year's Eve. The race starts at Galerie Butovice and offers the last run in Europe in 2025. It is intended for both recreational runners and more experienced competitors who want to celebrate the arrival of the new year actively and sportingly together. The start is scheduled for December 31, 2025, at 11:50 PM, with registration possible in advance and on the day of the race.

The race offers a pleasant atmosphere at the end of the year and the opportunity to compete in the beautiful environment of Přerov. Registration is possible in advance online or on the race day at the race office. We look forward to your participation!

description: The Winter Holy Cross Mountains Marathon is a unique tourist event held in the picturesque Holy Cross Mountains, around Chęciny and Ciekoty. Participants can choose between two routes: the Royal Battle and the Knight's Charge, which lead through natural terrain in challenging winter conditions. This challenge attracts hundreds of runners and hiking enthusiasts from all over Poland each year, offering a unique atmosphere and beautiful views. Organizers ensure the safety and comfort of participants by providing refreshment and control points along the route.

Organizers have been promoting outdoor activity and mountain tourism for years, creating and renewing tourist trails. This event is for enthusiasts of long-distance challenges and nature contact.

Picturesque landscapes and natural tourist trails
Routes adapted for running, walking, and Nordic walking

description: The Winter Run at Blaník is a legendary January race in the picturesque town of Načeradec, taking place on January 16, 2027. The race offers two main runs - a challenging main race of 19.9 km across Velký and Malý Blaník, and a supporting race of 11.2 km. The routes lead through beautiful nature of Podblanicko with significant ascents, forest sections, and views from the lookout tower on Velký Blaník. The start and finish are directly in the center of Načeradec with cozy facilities. The race capacity is limited to 700 runners, ensuring a pleasant atmosphere and quality organization.
