description: Garmin Ultra Race Myślenice is a mountain trail running event taking place on May 9, 2026, in the picturesque Beskid Wyspowy, near Kraków. The routes lead through forest paths with numerous steep ascents and breathtaking views, offering challenges for runners of various skill levels. Myślenice is a place that combines natural beauty, history, and modern infrastructure, making the event an attractive activity for active recreation enthusiasts. The Garmin Ultra Race series promotes running in harmony with nature, fair play, and supporting the running community.

additional: Race packets are issued at the event office on May 8-9. Starts are staggered according to distances, with the longest distance of 78 km starting at 05:00. The time limit to complete the 78 km distance is 15 hours. Discounts are available when registering for more than one event in the series. Athlete cards can be downloaded 5 days before the event after logging in at startlist.pl. Award ceremonies take place after the completion of each distance. Distances range from 6 km to 101 km, with time limits from 1 hour to 17.5 hours, various start packages, the possibility to start on multiple distances within the Challenge, mountain terrain, medical security, trail marking, nutrition points, GPS tracker (only for 78 km).

name: Herbatka u Tadka, czyli Bieg do Herbacia...
Bieg Herosa
description: The Hero Run is a unique running event held in Klucze near Olkusz, offering various distances and competition formats on challenging, sandy terrain. The most extreme competition is Nomad 9h, where participants fight against desert sand and their own limits for 9 hours, emphasizing strategy and endurance. Shorter distances are also available, such as Nomad 3h, dynamic 5- and 7-kilometer loops, as well as races for children and special dog runs that highlight cooperation and trust between the handler and the dog. This event is for those seeking a sporting challenge and contact with nature in a unique desert climate.
course_highlights: Sandy, desert-like terrain requiring good technique and endurance
Long-distance competition up to 9 hours in extreme conditions
Special routes for dog runs and for children on distances from 200 to 1000 meters
additional: The event includes various forms of races: an extreme 9-hour run, 3-hour run, short loops of 5 and 7 km, races for children, and dog runs that require cooperation and trust between the competitor and their pet. The event focuses on overcoming personal limits, endurance, and strategy in difficult terrain conditions.

name: Blue Power Run
organizer: Fundacja Pełnoprawni MY i Stowarzyszenie Pomocy Dzieciom z Autyzmem SENSE
description: Blue Power Run is an inclusive race organized for people on the autism spectrum, their families, and friends. The event aims to support social integration through a shared sporting event that connects participants and raises awareness about autism. The race takes place on an asphalt pathway at Arkonka Bathing Area in Szczecin, and participation is primarily about personal satisfaction and overcoming oneself, regardless of the finishing position. The event also features joint activities coordinated by therapists and volunteers, which further promotes integration.
course_highlights: The route runs along an asphalt pathway at Arkonka Bathing Area
Inclusive race for people on the autism spectrum and their families
Joint activities coordinated by therapists and volunteers
additional: The number of spots is limited to 300 participants. Start packages can be collected at the Race Office on Friday, May 16, from 10:00 to 12:00 and 14:00 to 16:00, as well as on the day of the event from 12:00 to 13:00. Starts are divided into age categories with different distances from 200 to 600 meters. The Race Office and start are located at the Szyszka restaurant. The race is inclusive, with routes for children and adults, taking place on an asphalt trail in Arkonka, with online registration available until May 10, 2025. The race is scheduled to start at 13:00.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Łódź
description: Botaniczna Piątka Łódź - spring edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts who have been promoting this sport since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes that highlight the aesthetic qualities of the proposed locations. It is an excellent opportunity to spend active time and enjoy the beauty of nature in Łódź.
course_highlights: Cross-country race on scenic routes
Aesthetic qualities of the proposed locations
Organized with passion since 2014
additional: cross-country, scenic routes, spring 2026 event

name: Czerwona Trasa Nordic Walking Do Najdłuż...
description: Red Nordic Walking Route in Wilkowo Nowowiejskie is a picturesque and challenging trail measuring 8.2 km, serving as the first stage of the 14th edition of the Grand Prix Nordic Walking. The event will take place on May 9, 2026, and offers an excellent opportunity for sports competition and exploring local attractions such as the largest chodak and a banquet table. Participants can prepare by using certified Nordic Walking routes available in the Nowa Wieś Lęborska municipality.
course_highlights: Red route measuring 8.2 km
Picturesque but challenging terrain
Local attractions: banquet table, largest chodak, and tobacco box
additional: The event starts at 11:00 AM. Registration is open from March 18, 2026, to May 7, 2026. The route runs through the Nowa Wieś Lęborska municipality, encouraging the use of certified Nordic Walking trails available in the region. The event offers sporting challenges, beautiful views, and local attractions to enrich participants' Nordic Walking experience.

name: III M Park4RUN
description: The III M Park4RUN Half Marathon is a race approximately 21.2 km long, scheduled to take place on May 9, 2026, in Tarnów, at the M Park Shopping Center. The race route is 100% asphalt, flat, and marked every 1 km, with limited road traffic during the event. The event promotes popularization of running and recreation as well as integration of the local community. In addition to the main race, there are also races for children and youth on various distances suitable for their age. Participants of the main race receive a starter pack containing items from sponsors as well as informational and promotional materials.
course_highlights: Route approximately 21.2 km, 100% asphalt
Flat route, marked every 1 km
Refreshment points at 5 km, 10 km, 15 km, and finish
additional: The main race has a time limit of 180 minutes. The race office is open from 7:30 to 9:15. The office for children opens at 10:00, with children's and youth races around 12:00-12:30, and awards ceremony approximately 12:30-13:00. Right-hand traffic is enforced on the route. Classifications include OPEN women and men as well as age categories for adults and children. Approximate distances for children: 100 m (preschoolers), 250 m (grades I-III), 500 m (grades IV-VI), 800 m (grades VII-VIII). Registration for the event was available online. The event also includes races for children and community activities.

name: IV Płużnicka Piątka
description: The 4th Płużnicka Five-Kilometer Run is a race covering 5 kilometers held in the picturesque town of Płużnica. The course features varied surfaces, making it attractive for both amateurs and more experienced runners. Participants start in the town center, and the event includes children's races and a ceremonial award ceremony. The atmosphere is friendly and family-oriented, as confirmed by positive feedback from previous participants.
course_highlights: 5 km course through the center of Płużnica
Surface: 71% asphalt, 23% dirt road, 6% cobblestone
Scenic views and varied terrain
additional: Program of the day: 10:40 official start, 10:50 warm-up, 10:55 lining up at the start, 11:00 race start, 11:50 children's races, 12:15 award ceremony, 12:45 official end. The route starts in the town center. After the race, prizes and a friendly atmosphere with refreshments are provided. The participant limit is 200. The race is part of the Grand Prix of Chełmno Land. Online registration, timing measurement, and live results are available.

name: Mistrzostwa Gminy Kąty Wrocławskie w Bie...
location: Krobielowice, Kąty Wrocławskie, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Kąty Wrocławskie Municipality Cross Country Championships is a series of cross country races organized within the Kąty Wrocławskie municipality. The first event will take place in Krobielowice and invites runners to participate in this outdoor sporting competition. The event is local in nature and promotes physical activity and community integration.
course_highlights: Cross country races in the natural terrain of Kąty Wrocławskie municipality
The first race in picturesque Krobielowice
Course adapted for various runner categories
additional: The organizer is the Kąty Wrocławskie Running Club. The event is cyclical and takes place in different localities within the municipality. Registrations are conducted through a Facebook group. Sign-ups for the 2026 edition can be made on Facebook, and the event enjoys great interest from local runners.

name: ProviRun for Invisibles IX Mistrzostwa Biegowe Provi Run
description: ProviRun for Invisibles / IX Running Championships Provi Run is a street race covering a distance of 5.5 km, scheduled to take place on May 9, 2026, in Łódź. The event is dedicated to runners of various skill levels, and participants can benefit from training plans tailored to their individual level and needs. The race is of moderate difficulty and takes place on an asphalt urban route. Organizers provide expert support and detailed training instructions to help everyone prepare optimally for the start.
course_highlights: Street route of 5.5 km length
Race on asphalt surface in Łódź city
Customized training plans from 8 to 20 weeks
additional: Participants can choose a training plan matched to their VDOT level, with training instructions and expert support. Training lasts from 8 to 20 weeks, allowing for optimal race preparation. The race covers a distance of 5.5 km, with online registration, an eco-friendly event, categories for children and adults, support for foundations, starter packs with gifts, parking, and a meal after the race.

name: Rajd Beskidy Short

tiers.label: tier_1

description: Beskidy Short Race is a European adventure race held in the picturesque Beskid Mountains, on the border between Poland and Slovakia. The competition includes various disciplines such as MTB, trekking, kayaking, climbing, and orienteering, with routes leading through mountainous areas offering beautiful views and challenging sections. The event is designed for teams of two or individual participants, providing an intense challenge for adventure and outdoor sports enthusiasts. The start and finish are located in the Koszyce area, and organizers provide professional support and assistance.
course_highlights: Approximately 200 km route with MTB, trekking, and kayaking
Traversing the Beskid Mountains and Orawa region
Varied mountain terrain with orienteering and climbing elements
additional: The race lasts about 30 hours plus an additional 2 hours. Teams can be mixed 4-person or 2-person of any gender. The race office and start/finish: Dworek nad Wisłą, Wyzwolenia 65, 43-460 Wisła, Poland. The race includes disciplines such as climbing, kayaking, navigation, and field tasks, with routes passing through scenic areas of Polish mountains, including caves and rock formations.

name: VIII Ultramaraton Warmiński Warneland
description: The 8th Warmia Ultramarathon Warneland is a unique running event held in the picturesque Olsztyn. The route takes runners through charming Warmia trails, along the Łyna River and Ukiel Lake, offering contact with nature and beautiful views. The event is a great opportunity for active recreation, suitable for both experienced ultramarathon runners and younger running enthusiasts, who can participate in the children's races Ultra Warmiaczek. The atmosphere of the competition fosters integration and shared sporting adventure.
course_highlights: Picturesque Warmia trails around Olsztyn
Route along the Łyna River and Ukiel Lake
Contact with nature and charming views
additional: Packet pickup takes place on May 9, 2026, from 17:00 to 21:00 at the Best Western Plus Olsztyn Old Town Hotel and from 07:30 to 10:00 at CRS Ukiel for children's races. The start times for the W50+ and W25+ distances are at 08:00. The time limit for completing the W50+ race is 10 hours, and for W25+ it is 5 hours. After this time, participants must leave the course and remove their bib numbers. The Ultra Warmiaczek children's races start at 11:10. The race village is located at the Ukiel Recreation and Sports Center, near numerous hotels and apartments. The event includes distances of 53 km, 32 km, 19 km, and children's races, with time limits of 10 and 5 hours, and the start and finish are at CRS Ukiel in Olsztyn. Participants can expect medical and logistical support. Registration closes on April 26, 2025.

name: XXVII Bieg Wilka
description: The 27th Wolf Run is a street race covering a distance of 10 km, scheduled to take place on May 9, 2026, in Grajewo. This event has a moderate level of difficulty and attracts runners of various skill levels. Organizers encourage preparation through training plans tailored to individual levels, offering support from experts. The race is part of the TreningBiegacza.pl running calendar, which promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: Street course of 10 km
Moderate difficulty level
Scenic areas of Grajewo
additional: Organizers offer training plans from 8 to 20 weeks tailored to the runner's VDOT level and provide expert support. There is an option to use a platform for managing race profiles and marketing collaborations. No details about start waves, participant limits, or registration fees are available on the website. The race takes place in an urban area, with parking available near the swimming pool and the Milk Museum; preparations include training plans, and registration is available online.

name: Malá cena Kunětické devítky Duben 2
location: Kunětická hora, Ráby, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic

description: Kunětická devítka is a traditional Wednesday cross-country run around Kunětická Mountain, offering two routes - a short loop of 4.5 km suitable for everyone and a long loop of 9 km for more experienced runners. The race is known for its friendly atmosphere, where runners of all levels meet, and emphasizes the joy of racing rather than time. The course includes various surfaces, long straight sections, narrow paths, and a challenging climb up the stairs to Kunětická Mountain. The event is the largest sporting running event in the Pardubice Region held on a weekday and is part of a series of Wednesday races.
course_highlights: Short loop of 4.5 km suitable for all runners
Long loop of 9 km with terrain, narrow paths, and a climb up the stairs to Kunětická Mountain
Start and finish at the parking lot near the Old Czech Inn under Kunětická Mountain
additional: Registration takes place at the finish area from 17:00 to 17:50 from April to August. The race is held in all weather conditions unless safety is at risk. An isotonic drink is available after the race. Results are not announced on-site but are published within 24 hours on the website. The start number for the entire series can be purchased for 50 CZK once at the first start of the year. Terrain running routes with on-site registration, a series of races with scoring and categories for different age groups.

name: Bratrušovské vrchy
description: Bratrušovské vrchy is a cross-country race organized by volunteer firefighters in Bratrušov, which is part of the Chlapácký běh series. The race offers a challenging route approximately 10.7 km long with an elevation gain of 418 meters, starting from the football field in Bratrušov. There is a shorter course for children, 2 km long with an elevation gain of 80 meters. The race is suitable for runners seeking a terrain challenge with a hilly profile.
course_highlights: Route length of 10.7 km with an elevation gain of 418 m
Children's course 2 km with an elevation gain of 80 m
Start at the football field in Bratrušov
additional: The race is part of the Chlapácký běh series. Organized by the Volunteer Fire Department of Bratrušov. In 2025, the race was held on April 16th starting at 17:00. The race will take place on April 15th, 2026, as part of the Chlapácký běh series, with results available on the organizer's website.

name: Zbraslavská pila VAŠÍ LIGY 2026
description: The Zbraslavská VAŠE LIGA 2026 is a mountain cross race in Prague-Zbraslav, presenting a challenging challenge with a elevation gain of 500 meters over a 7 km course. During the race, participants will face three demanding ascents and descents that test their strength and endurance. The race starts at 6:00 PM at the Prague-Zbraslav train station and is suitable for runners seeking an intense trail experience in an urban environment with natural elements. The organizer is VAŠE LIGA under the leadership of Petr Lundák.
course_highlights: 7 km mountain cross/trail race
Elevation gain of 500 meters
Three demanding ascents and descents
additional: The race is a mountain cross/trail with significant elevation gain and challenging sections. The organizer is VAŠE LIGA, contact person Petr Lundák. The start is at the Prague-Zbraslav train station. The race is part of the VAŠE LIGA series. The course is designed for trail runners, registration is possible online, and the start and finish are at the Prague-Zbraslav train station. The race is part of a series of mountain runs and offers both a challenge and beautiful natural scenery.

name: Jarní běh Olympu
description: Spring Olymp Run is a traditional cross-country and trail race held in the beautiful surroundings of Stromovka Park in Prague 7, at the OLYMP CSMV complex. It offers three courses of different lengths (5.5 km, 4.4 km, and 3.3 km), which run through nature and are suitable for runners of various levels. The race is organized by PSK Olymp Prague and is part of the running community of the Czech Athletic Federation. The main category starts at 18:55, allowing runners to enjoy the evening atmosphere of the race.
course_highlights: Cross-country and trail character of the courses in Stromovka Park
Three course lengths: 5.5 km, 4.4 km, and 3.3 km
Start and finish at the OLYMP CSMV complex in Prague 7
additional: Registrations are only possible online until October 8, 2026, at midnight; registrations on the race day are not accepted by the organizers. The first category starts at 16:00, the main category starts at 18:55. The organizer is PSK Olymp Prague, z.s., contact person Jindřich Linhart. The race takes place in the Olymp complex area, with various age categories, online registration until October 8, 2026, course lengths of 3.3 km, 4.4 km, and 5.5 km, and is open to the general public.

name: Olomoucká desítka
description: Olomouc Ten is the third edition of a 10 km running race held in the picturesque environment of Smetanovy Sady in Olomouc. The course runs on asphalt paths and participants complete three laps of 3.343 km each, with the first lap being slightly shorter. The race is part of the Hanácký Running Cup 2026 and offers categories based on age as well as an open run regardless of age. The award ceremony takes place at the Music Pavilion, and runners receive small sweet gifts for placing on the podium.
course_highlights: A 3.343 km lap on asphalt paths in Smetanovy Sady
The race is run 3 times, with the first lap being 28 meters shorter
Start and finish at the Music Pavilion in Smetanovy Sady
additional: Pre-registration of participants takes place on-site. Runners must have a chip card with a credit of at least 70 CZK, which will be deducted during registration. Items can be stored in the start/finish area. The race is run according to road running rules, each participant at their own risk. The event takes place in April 2026, with information available about registration, prices, and rules, and is part of the local running series organized by TJ Liga stovkařů.

name: Noční běh pro světlušku Olomouc

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Cena startovného je 500 Kč. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do projektu Světluška na úhradu nákladů běhu. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do veřejné sbírky Světluška na přímou pomoc těžce zrakově postiženým.

description: Night Run for Světluška in Olomouc is a charity run held on April 16, 2026, in Flora Park. The race starts at 9:00 PM, and participants can choose between a 2.5 km course (1 lap) and a 5 km course (2 laps). The registration fee is 500 CZK, half of which covers the event costs and the other half goes to support people with severe visual impairments. The event offers an accompanying program including a concert and starter packs with a headlamp or sports headband. Capacity is limited for safety and participant comfort.
course_highlights: Course in Flora Park in Olomouc
Option to choose between 2.5 km and 5 km routes
Night run with a headlamp or sports headband
additional: Registration counters are open from 7:00 PM. Starter packs are available with options including a headlamp or sports headband. Holders of TP, ZTP, and ZTP/P cards with an escort can enter for free and can purchase a starter pack on-site for 250 CZK. The event capacity is limited for safety and comfort. The accompanying program includes a concert by Rodan from 8:00 PM. The route is also suitable for walking. The registration fee supports the visually impaired. The start is from 7:00 PM to 8:45 PM, the accompanying program runs from 7:30 PM to 9:00 PM, and the starter pack includes a headlamp or sports headband.

name: Kateřinský běh Hrabovou
location: Kostel svaté Kateřiny, Ostrava-Hrabová, Ostrava, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
price_range: Cena je při registraci a zaplacení do 15.4.2025
description: We invite all runners to the traditional 18th edition of the Kateřinský Run in Hrabová, which will take place on April 16, 2026, in Ostrava-Hrabová. The main route runs around the historic St. Catherine's Church, giving the race a unique atmosphere. The event offers courses of 5 km and 2.5 km, children's races, and Nordic Walking on 5 km. Participants will enjoy a friendly atmosphere, refreshments, and an accompanying program.
course_highlights: The route runs around St. Catherine's Church in Ostrava-Hrabová
Available courses of 5 km and 2.5 km, including children's races and 5 km Nordic Walking
Start and registration at the Cultural House Ostrava - Hrabová, Bažanova Street
additional: The maximum number of participants is 400. The start number is with a chip and is refundable. The registration fee includes a medal for those registered by April 13, 2026, post-race refreshments, changing rooms and toilets, SMS result service, and participation in the Hrabovský and Moravian-Silesian Running Cups (for 5 km). Recommended transportation is buses DPO lines 27, 41, 39, 77 with a stop at Hrabová, kostelík. Results are announced within 20 minutes at the registration site after the race. For safety reasons, the use of headphones during the race is not allowed. The 5 km and 2.5 km courses include running, Nordic Walking, and children's races (150 m, 300 m, 600 m, 1000 m). The surface is asphalt, suitable for all age groups, promoting a healthy lifestyle.

name: Mistrovství Moravy a Slezska v půlmaratonu + 24. Hanácký půlmaraton
location: TJ Lokomotiva Olomouc, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The Moravia and Silesia Half Marathon Championship along with the 24th Hanácký Half Marathon is a traditional running event organized by the Olomouc Athletic Club. The race takes place in the heart of Olomouc and offers quality organization at the home stadium of TJ Lokomotiva Olomouc. The club boasts a rich history and participation of its athletes in major European and world competitions. The race is suitable for a wide running public, who can enjoy the atmosphere of a championship half marathon in the beautiful environment of Moravia.
course_highlights: Regional Championship of Moravia and Silesia in Half Marathon
24th Hanácký Half Marathon with a traditional venue in Olomouc
Opportunity for runners of all levels to participate in a friendly atmosphere
additional: The races include various runs and events, detailed course information and registration have not yet been published

name: Běh Javorkou
location: Javorka, Česká Třebová, Pardubice, Czech Republic
price_range: 150 Kč (předem), 200 Kč (na místě) pro dospělé; 30 Kč (předem), 50 Kč (na místě) pro děti; 50 Kč za štafetu
description: The Javorka Run is a traditional spring running race with many years of history, held regularly in April in the beautiful environment of Javorka Park in Česká Třebová. The main race over 6 km is among the fast races because the course runs on hard park paths and is only slightly hilly. The race is part of the regional running series ISCAREX Cup and offers quality performance experiences for runners of all categories. In addition to the main race, there are also children's categories and team relays.
course_highlights: The 6 km course runs on hard park paths (gravel, paving)
Loop courses from 200 m to 1200 m, marked with flags according to categories
Slightly hilly profile of the track in a beautiful park environment
additional: Registration is possible in advance online or on the day of the race no later than 20 minutes before the start of the respective category. The race facilities are at the outdoor stage (Music Pavilion) next to Javorka Restaurant. Starts: children's categories at 9:30, main race at 11:30, team relays at 12:10. The race takes place in Javorka Park, registration is possible online or on-site, the track is surface-paved with gentle inclines and turns. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup and offers various categories including athletes with disabilities.

name: Žehrovický Kalspotkros
location: Kamenné Žehrovic, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Zehrovický Kalspotkros is a cross-country running race covering a distance of 6.2 km with a hilly profile, held in Kamenné Žehrovice in the Central Bohemian Region. The race is part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runner Cup and offers runners an interesting and challenging course in a natural environment. This race is suitable for trail running enthusiasts seeking a challenge in the form of hilly terrain. Organizers welcome all runners who want to experience a quality race atmosphere and sporting experience.
course_highlights: Cross-country course of 6.2 km
Hilly profile with undulating terrain
Part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runner Cup
additional: The race takes place on April 18, 2026, with the start scheduled for 10:30 AM and registration from 9:00 to 10:00 AM. More information is available in the regulations on the official website.

name: Listonošův krpál
location: Praha - Jarov (u Zbraslavi), Praha, Czech Republic
description: Listonošův krpál is a hill race in Prague - Jarov near Zbraslav, measuring 2.88 km with an elevation gain of 150 meters. This race is part of the Hill Runs series in Prague and the surrounding area and offers runners a challenge in the form of a demanding ascent. The race is suitable for mountain running enthusiasts and uphill runners who want to test their endurance and strength in hilly terrain. The course is short but intense, providing a dynamic and attractive racing experience.
course_highlights: Distance of the course 2.88 km
Elevation gain 150 m
Part of the Hill Runs series in Prague and surroundings
additional: The race takes place on April 18, 2026. Registration details are not specified. It is part of the mountain running series in Prague.

name: Cena Tolštejnského panství Jiřetín pod Jedlovou – Jedlová
location: Jiřetín pod Jedlovou, Lužické hory, Czech Republic
description: The Tolštejn Estate Race Jiřetín pod Jedlovou - Jedlová is a mountain uphill run 6 km long with an elevation gain of 340 meters, aiming to reach the summit of Jedlová in the Lusatian Mountains. The race is part of the Czech Cup in uphill running and offers a challenging course with beautiful views. This race is suitable for mountain running enthusiasts seeking a challenge in a natural environment. Come and enjoy the sporting atmosphere and the beauty of the Lusatian Mountains.
course_highlights: Length of the course 6 km with an elevation gain of 340 m
Finish at the summit of Jedlová
Part of the Czech Cup in uphill running
additional: The race is open to the general public, registration is possible online, and children can participate for free. The event is combined with opportunities for trips around the area, including visits to the Jedlová lookout tower and the Tolštejn ruins.

name: SAFARIBĚH
location: Safari Park Dvůr Králové, Dvůr Králové nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: Safariběh ČSOB: I Don't Want to Be Last is a running race held in Dvůr Králové Safari Park, offering a unique experience of running in an African and walking safari environment. The race is open to the general public and offers three routes: 2 km family run, 5 km, and 10 km race, with the 10 km route being two laps of the 5 km course. The surface of the routes is mainly paved asphalt, with start and finish at the main entrance to the safari park. Included in the registration fee is free entry to the safari park on race day and support for the rescue of bald zebras.
course_highlights: The route passes through African and walking safaris
Mainly paved asphalt surface
Start and finish at the main entrance to Dvůr Králové Safari Park
additional: Race bibs are equipped with a chip that remains with the runner. The registration fee includes free entry to the safari park on race day, a registration bag with gifts from partners, a meal voucher for refreshments after the race (one drink and one meal), a commemorative medal, light refreshments at the finish line (water, fruit), and accompanying activities for children at the main partner ČSOB's stand. The race is suitable for families and more experienced runners, with online registration available for various dates. The event is combined with activities in the safari park and supports nature conservation.

name: Jarní běh Dražovkou
description: Spring Run in Dražovka in Hořovice is a traditional trophy race that invites competitors of all ages to an active sporting experience. The race takes place in the picturesque environment of Dražovka and offers an opportunity for sports enjoyment and meeting other runners. Registration is possible online at brdskypohar.cz or directly on-site on the day of the race. We look forward to your participation and wish everyone much success and joy in running.
course_highlights: Trophy race in the picturesque environment of Dražovka
Suitable for both large and small competitors
Online registration available as well as on-site
additional: Registration is preferred online at www.brdskypohar.cz, but on-site registration on the race day is also possible. Trail run suitable for all age groups, registration via the website, same-day registration on-site is available.

name: Husínský kros
location: Tajanov u Klatov, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: Husínský cross-country is a traditional spring running race in Tajanov near Klatovy, which was created as a replacement for the canceled Klatovská patnáctka. The race has been held since 2012 and is part of the prestigious Ešus league series. Men run three laps, women and girls two laps, with each lap approximately 3.6 km long and mostly on forest paths with a section on smooth asphalt. In recent years, the course has returned to the original longer variant around the Husín forest. The main referee is running legend Vlastík Zwiefelhofer.
course_highlights: Circuit approximately 3.6 km with two-thirds on forest paths
One-third of the course runs on smooth asphalt
Course runs around the Husín forest
additional: The race is part of the Ešus league series, which will have its 42nd edition in 2026 and includes 22 races. Men run 10.5 km (3 laps), women and men over 70 run 7 km (2 laps). The start is at the volleyball courts in Tajanov. The organizer is Jiří Přibík (tel. 608279305). The race is part of the prestigious Ešus league series, which has previously been held virtually due to the pandemic. The event attracts a wide participation and has a long tradition in the region.

name: Bakovský půlmaraton
location: Bakov nad Jizerou, Central Bohemia, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 300 Kč pro předem přihlášené s platbou předem do 16.4.2026

description: The Bakov Half Marathon is a traditional running race held in Bakov nad Jizerou, now in its 43rd year. The race takes place on a certified course of 21.097 km, which runs along a hilly asphalt road with varying surface quality and includes ascents and descents. The start is at 10:00 AM at the square in Bakov nad Jizerou, and the race offers monetary and material prizes for the best men and women. Registrations are possible in advance with a lower starting fee or on the race day for a higher fee.
course_highlights: Certified course of 21.097 km
Hilly asphalt road with variable surface quality
Refreshment stations at 9.7 km, 14.5 km, and at the finish
additional: Registration of participants takes place from 8:00 to 9:45 AM in a building approximately 150 meters from the start. Categories are divided by age for men and women. A prize of 2000 CZK is awarded for breaking course records in the absolute categories of men and women. The entry fee can be paid by bank transfer or on the race day at the venue. The route runs along a hilly asphalt road with alternating surface quality, there are refreshment stations on the course, and categories are announced by age, with the possibility of winning prizes for records.

name: Ještěd SkyRace®
location: Ještěd, Liberec, Liberec District, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: Ještěd SkyRace® is a traditional trail running race held in the beautiful environment of the Ještěd ridge near Liberec. The race offers several route options, including the premier SkyRace route with a length of 22 km and an elevation gain of 1390 m, as well as shorter trails Trail (13 km) and Easy (6 km). The event is suitable for runners of all levels, including races for children and canicross. The start and finish are located in the area near the ski jump towers on Ještěd, providing stunning views and challenging terrain. The award ceremony takes place from 4:00 PM.
course_highlights: Premier SkyRace route: 22 km with 1390 m elevation gain
Other routes: Trail 13 km / 945 m+, Easy 6 km / 300 m+
Start and finish in the area near the ski jump towers on Ještěd
additional: The award ceremony takes place from 4:00 PM. The races include children's categories and canicross. Start and finish are in the area near the ski jump towers on Ještěd. The routes are challenging with significant elevation gain, suitable for mountain running enthusiasts. Distances are 6 km, 13 km, and 22 km; accompanying events, trail camps, merchandising, registration, entertainment, and nutrition are available during the race weekend.

name: Pyšelský kopeček
organizer: parta běžců z Pyšel a Kopeček 2016, z.s.
description: Pyšelský Kopeček is a traditional trail run in the picturesque environment of Pyšel, offering routes for all levels of runners from recreational to ultramarathoners. The course is 90% forest trails and includes loops of 6.5 km, 11.5 km, 21 km, 52 km, and 105 km. Races of 21 km, 52 km, and 105 km are designated as UTMB index races, attracting experienced runners. The start and finish are at the football field in Pyšel, which provides facilities including changing rooms, showers, and refreshments. The event is suitable for the general public and is accompanied by children's races and canicross.
course_highlights: Course is 90% forest trails
Loops of 6.5 km, 11.5 km, 21 km, 52 km, and 105 km
Races of 21 km, 52 km, and 105 km are UTMB index races
additional: The race has a limit of 250 participants. Changing rooms, toilets, and showers are available at the start and finish area. Parking is available at designated spots outside the start area, respecting residents. For canicross, there are refreshment stations for dogs along the course. Children's races have manual timing, adult categories use electronic timing. Starts are divided into waves from 10:00 to 14:15 with winners announced at 17:00. The ultraPUNKtrail courses of 52 km and 105 km branch off and reconnect with the classic 21 km route. The race includes registration, timing, and facilities at the start and finish; it is also suitable for children and beginners.

name: Run for ProCit
price_range: 550 Kč online, 600 Kč na místě, děti do 10 let zdarma
description: RUN for ProCit is a charitable family run organized by the civic association ProCit in Pilsen, supporting families with children with autism spectrum disorder. The event takes place annually in April on the occasion of World Autism Awareness Day and offers routes for children and adults, including the possibility of Nordic walking. The run is complemented by a rich accompanying program for children and parents and is dog-friendly, so runners with dogs can also participate. The proceeds from registration fees and accompanying activities are donated to support families with children with autism.
course_highlights: 2 children's routes without registration and time measurement
2 km and 5 km routes with time measurement and winners announced
Color zone on the track, which can be run around
additional: On-site registration from 8:30 AM. Children's runs start at 10:00 and 10:10, 2 km run at 10:15, 5 km run at 10:45. Possibility to complete the 2 km route as Nordic walking with an instructor. Every participant who crosses the finish line receives a commemorative medal. The run is dog-friendly. On-site charity raffle and refreshments. Registration from 8:30, starts from 10:00, charity event, opportunity to purchase small gifts and raffle tickets.

It offers various courses and categories, including for adults, youth, and children, with predominantly mixed terrain consisting of fields, forest paths, and asphalt sections. The event is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup and is suitable for both recreational runners and competitive enthusiasts, with the opportunity to win valuable prizes and set record times.
course_highlights: Various course lengths including 13.5 km, 9.7 km, 4.3 km, and 1.475 km
Mixed terrain including fields, forest paths, and asphalt sections
Categories for different age groups including youth and children
additional: The race offers multiple distances and categories, registration is possible online and on-site, including for children and youth categories. The course runs through fields, forest paths, and park trails, with opportunities to win prizes for record times and is complemented by refreshments and water during the race.

name: ŘepoRun

The race is organized by the enthusiastic group Run Labe Run and is intended for all running enthusiasts. The route runs around Řeporyje, and participants receive a start package and a medal after finishing. Registration is available online with a lower entry fee until April 10, 2026; later, on-site registration is possible until capacity is reached.

Children's courses 200 m, 600 m, and 1300 m
Time measured with a chip on the start number

After the race, a baggage storage service is available. Parking is limited; public transport is recommended. On-site registration is possible until capacity is reached. Registration is open until April 10, 2026. Race categories include various distances, with starts divided by age groups. The race features chip timing.

friendly environment in nature in the Elbe Valley
accompanying activities for children and adults

Participants can look forward to a demanding terrain with obstacles that will test their strength, endurance, and determination. Registration is possible online and on-site with an increased starting fee, and parental consent is required for competitors under 18.
course_highlights: Obstacle course race in terrain with various challenging obstacles
Course suitable for competitors born in 2011 and earlier
Categories for children and canicross

The race includes the main run, canicross, and children's races. Registration must be completed in advance. The race is open to the general public, including people with disabilities and children from 2 years old.

The event is part of the accompanying program of the Bakov Half Marathon and is known for its friendly atmosphere and recognition of the best competitors with diplomas, medals, and gifts from sponsors.
course_highlights: Circuits around the athletic track at the elementary school
Circuit length of 313 meters
Running on the sidewalk, possibility to use trainers

The race will be held in April 2026, featuring various distances from 200 m to 1500 m, and is open to the general public. Applications can be submitted via the race's website or Facebook page.

name: VALAŠSKÝ TRHÁK

name: Běh do vrchu Jiřetín - Jedlová
description: The Jiřetín - Jedlová uphill run is a traditional sporting event organized by the Varnsdorf Running Club, taking place on Saturday, April 18, 2026, in Jiřetín pod Jedlovou. The race is part of the Czech Cup in uphill running and offers a challenging route of 5.7 km with an elevation gain of 340 meters, leading from 434 meters above sea level to the summit of Jedlová Mountain at 774 meters above sea level. The course is a combination of asphalt, gravel, and forest paths. Participants start at 8:00 AM from the sports complex and can look forward to monetary prizes and a running raffle.

Start at the sports complex in Jiřetín pod Jedlovou, finish at the top of Jedlová Mountain

name: Dehtářská 10°

Registration is from 11:00 to 13:30, with the race start at 14:00 at RS Kletečná. The event is suitable for all age groups and offers a friendly atmosphere for runners and families.

name: Safari běh ČSOB
location: Safari Park Dvůr Králové, Dvůr Králové nad Labem, Czech Republic

The routes mainly lead along paved asphalt paths and include passages through African and walking safaris, providing a unique experience in contact with nature and animals. The start and finish are at the main entrance to the safari park. The race is suitable for the general public, including families, and promotes the protection of bald zebras and other animals in the park.

Surface mainly paved asphalt paths
Start and finish at the main entrance to Dvůr Králové Safari Park

There is an option to contribute to elephant protection as part of the registration fee. Activities for children are available at the main partner ČSOB's booth. The event has been moved to October 18, 2026, due to animal protection measures against foot-and-mouth disease. The park operates with safety measures; registration is possible with options for transfer or refund of the registration fee. The event is suitable for families and athletes, with beneficent activities supporting animal protection in Africa.

name: Chřibská – Studenec

course_highlights: Courses run on paved paths along the Ohře River
Half marathon 21 km and 10K 10 km
Accompanying children's races of 400 m, 750 m, and 1,500 m

name: Petřín třikrát jinak

description: Petřín Three Ways is a unique race in Prague where participants conquer Petřín Hill in three different ways: by interval running up 299 steps of the Petřín Lookout Tower, running uphill with a mass start, and interval running down a slope on an unpaved path and stairs. The routes go on asphalt and terrain, around ponds, through forests, and the village of Brniště, ensuring a diverse and attractive running experience. The event is suitable for the general public and families, with ample facilities and refreshments. The start package includes a T-shirt, medal, and other gifts from sponsors for early registrants. The atmosphere is friendly, and the race is supported by local residents and organizers.

The surface of the course is approximately half asphalt and half terrain
There are three refreshment stations and a water station along the course

The course is marked with colorful arrows and monitored by organizers at intersections. Organizers note that participants are participants in road traffic and run at their own risk. The event is organized by SDH Vysoká u Holic and is known for its friendly atmosphere and support of local community projects.

Additional races of 7 km and 3 km with category awards

The time limit for the main race is 3 hours. A portion of each paid entry fee is donated to the Special Elementary School Neratov, and the sponsor appreciates the kilometers run. The race takes place on April 25, 2026, supported by the local school and sponsors, offering refreshments, a raffle, and medals. The start is in Vysoká u Holic at the sports field.

The run offers courses for all age groups, from children's races of 400 and 800 meters to the main race of 10 km. The event is also open to participants who wish to complete the course in Nordic walking style. The proceeds from the entry fees are donated to help premature babies, known as Little Balls.

Main 10 km race runs around ponds in CHKO Poodří
Option to complete any course in Nordic walking style without time measurement
additional: Children's races start at 9:30, the main races of 10 km and 2.7 km begin at 11:00 and 11:05. Parking is available at several locations in Polanka nad Odrou. T-shirts for the run can be purchased online until April 11, 2026, or on the race day until supplies last. The team competition is free and counts the three best times from each team. The event takes place at the Workers' House in Polanka nad Odrou, with parking available at several sites, and proceeds are donated to support neonatology.

The race follows an educational trail through the Přerov Meadow, offering beautiful natural scenery and an opportunity to explore the local landscape. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes active outdoor movement. Organizers invite all runners and tourists to participate in this popular event.
course_highlights: The route follows an educational trail through Přerov Meadow
Natural scenery and forest environment
Opportunity to learn about the local landscape and nature
additional: The run is part of a series of outdoor activities organized by the Czech Tourist Club, focused on running tourism and nature exploration.

name: Cross Coutry Race – Hruboskalský půlmaraton
location: Kemp Sedmihorky, Český ráj, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Hruboskalský Half Marathon is a traditional running race held on April 25, 2026, in the picturesque environment of the Bohemian Paradise, at the Sedmihorky campsite. The race offers two routes - a half marathon approximately 21.8 km long with an elevation gain of 500 m, and a shorter route of 12.5 km with an elevation gain of 300 m. The course runs on paved and unpaved roads, paths, and hiking trails, including stairs and stones, and is suitable for nature lovers and those seeking a more challenging terrain. The race is part of the Cross Country Race series and is known for its atmosphere and beautiful views in the Bohemian Paradise Protected Landscape Area (CHKO).
course_highlights: Undulating course with a 500 m elevation gain on the half marathon route
Combination of paved roads, paths, stairs, and stones
Course runs on marked tourist trails with approximate kilometer markers
additional: Start numbers are color-coded (red, green, yellow for children). The route is marked with flags and signs on trees, with approximate kilometer markers every kilometer on the half marathon course. In case of wet conditions, the route may be muddy; trail shoes with a rugged sole are recommended. The race capacity is limited and often filled in advance. Participants receive payment instructions via email after registration. The race is part of the 2026 running series, with registration available through the official website. The course has been adjusted due to road reconstruction, and the capacity was filled quickly. Runners can expect a challenging and beautiful race in the natural environment of the Bohemian Paradise.

The race offers a sporting challenge in a natural environment with elevation gain and is suitable for the general public, including children who start independently. The organizer is Libuše Vlachynská, who ensures a friendly atmosphere and quality organization. The main category starts traditionally at 10:30, allowing comfortable participation even for families with children.
course_highlights: Forest cross-country trail along the Vltava River
Distance of 5.3 km with natural terrain
Children's separate start at 10:35
additional: Children start independently at 10:35. The organizer is Libuše Vlachynská. The race is part of the Czech Run, a service of the Czech Athletic Federation for runners and running. Terrain: trail/cross-country, registration: in advance or on-site, date: April 25, 2026

name: Posázavská trilogie
location: Týnec nad Sázavou, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Posázavská Trilogy is a legendary race that traditionally kicks off the summer season. The race combines three disciplines: running, water, and cycling, offering a diverse and challenging experience in the beautiful nature around the Sázava River. The start is in Týnec nad Sázavou and the route passes through Hradištko and Pikovice. The race is suitable for individuals and pairs and is known for its friendly atmosphere and retro refreshments after the finish.
course_highlights: Running 7 or 14 km in loops around Týnec nad Sázavou
Water segment 16 km from Týnec nad Sázavou to Pikovice without markers
Cycling 25 km from Pikovice back to Týnec nad Sázavou with marked route
additional: Mandatory equipment includes your own tourist boat (maximum length 3.5 m), vest, helmet, and cycling helmet. Kayak paddles are not allowed. Canoes can be rented at Bisport with a 20% discount using the code "Posázavská trilogie". After the race, retro refreshments are provided, including water, beer, cheese, and apples. Registration of participants takes place from 7:00 to 8:30 at the start location, where they also receive a chip and timing device. The start is in front of the Bisport building in Týnec nad Sázavou. The race includes various disciplines, mandatory equipment such as a tourist boat, helmet, and vest, and is open to the general public of different age categories.

It offers two races - Hobby over 6.7 km and the main race over 10.1 km, both run on a single loop with mostly field and forest paths. The course is suitable for nature lovers and trail runners with gentle elevation changes. The race is part of the Znojmo Running Cup and provides a pleasant atmosphere and sporting challenge.
course_highlights: Hobby race: 6.7 km, 60% field and forest paths, 40% asphalt
Main race: 10.1 km, 70% field and forest paths, 30% asphalt
Gentle elevation with hills up to 101 m of ascent
additional: The race starts at the gate of Autokemp Pohoda Únanov. Both races are run on a single loop. The terrain is a combination of field, forest paths, and asphalt. The race is suitable for a wide range of runners, from children to experienced ultramarathoners, emphasizing respect for nature and race rules.

name: Dokola Kletě

The race is intended for runners seeking a tough spring fitness test in the terrain, suitable for both amateurs and experienced ultramarathoners. The course runs on forest and field paths, trails, and asphalt with clear markings and refreshment stations. The start and finish are in Třísov near Český Krumlov. The race takes place on April 25, 2026.

Views from around Klet and four refreshment stations on the course

The time limit for the long route is 8 hours with a checkpoint at the halfway point. Mandatory equipment includes a personal cup, mobile phone, rescue foil, and suitable clothing. Parking is available directly at the start in Třísov, with limited capacity; carpooling is recommended. The race includes registration, parking, and safety rules, which are detailed on the website. There are various course lengths available, including 45 km and 44 km, with support and timing services.

name: VOKOLO trail
organizer: Brněnský klub běžeckých a sportovních aktivit z.s.
description: Vokolo TRAIL is a spring running race held on April 25, 2026, around the Brno Dam. It offers a beautiful, hilly course in natural terrain with stunning views of the water surface and the historic Veveří Castle. The race is designed for runners who want to experience a personal challenge and push their limits on a moderately difficult course. It also features a unique steamer relay, combining running and boat travel on the dam. The organizer is the Brno Club of Running and Sports Activities z.s., which emphasizes quality facilities and participant safety.
course_highlights: 18 km hilly course in natural terrain along both banks of the Brno Dam
Stunning views of the water surface and Veveří Castle
Unique steamer relay 2x 9 km with crossing the dam
additional: The race capacity is limited to 700 runners. The start package includes a bib with a chip, safety pins, a locker tag, partner vouchers, a voucher for hot soup after the race, and a ticket for the tombola. There are separate changing rooms, a guarded baggage storage, and storage for bikes and scooters. Timing is done with chip technology with real-time results. Medical support is available on the course, at the finish, and in the facilities. The start of the first relay segment and the main race is between 9:45 and 9:55, the second relay segment starts at 9:20 with departure to the steamer. The race is limited to 700 participants and includes timing, technical facilities, medical support, and refreshments on the course and at the finish.

name: Hlučínská 24ka

The race offers the opportunity to test your endurance by running as many laps as possible on a course measuring 6180 meters. In addition to the main individual race, a new event for pairs has been introduced, allowing participants to share the experience with a partner. The event also includes children's runs and shorter races for the general public, all in a friendly and supportive atmosphere. The organizer is the Benešováci z.s. association, which emphasizes sportsmanship, fair play, and support for an active lifestyle in the region.
course_highlights: Loop length of 6180 meters around Hlučín Lake
Flat asphalt terrain without significant elevation changes
Beautiful natural environment of Hlučín Gravel Pit
additional: The race takes place from April 25, 2026, ending on April 26, 2026, at 9:00 AM with the 24-hour ultramarathon. Children's and shorter runs start from 14:00 to 15:00. The course is flat asphalt with low difficulty. Each participant receives a bib number and an ID chip; the bib number must be worn visibly. The organizer recommends a medical check-up before the race, and participation is at your own risk. A t-shirt for ultramarathoners is included. Facilities are located in a camp directly at Hlučín Gravel Pit. 24-hour ultramarathon, course length 6180 meters, held at Hlučín Gravel Pit, possibility of pairs race, accompanying activities.

name: Rychlebský maraton
description: The Rychlebský Marathon is a spring supplementary race set in the beautiful environment of the Rychlebské Mountains, known for their wild and remote nature. The routes lead along perfect mountain trails, through deep valleys, deserted cliffs, old mountain meadows, and abandoned settlements, offering runners an unforgettable experience of wilderness and stunning views. The race is suitable for everyone who wants to explore the Rychlebské Mountains through the eyes of experienced locals and enjoy running in nature with minimal asphalt. Available routes are 26 km, 46 km, and 76 km, with the longer variants also passing into neighboring Poland.
course_highlights: Routes run along perfect mountain trails and border paths
Across deep valleys, deserted cliffs, and mountain meadows of former settlements
Minimal asphalt, mostly forest trails and footpaths
additional: Registration is also possible on-site, but prior registration helps with preparation. Participants are divided into two age categories (up to 39 years and 40 years and above). The fee includes a fee for forest owners, a map, a start number, a chip timing system, a GPS tracker for the long route, a finishers' diploma, generous refreshment stations along the course, and a hot soup at the finish line (vegan and non-vegan options). Accommodation in a secondary gym in Javorník is available for 150 CZK/night. Trail ultramarathon on mountain trails, registration information, special programs including evening lectures, and location changes for race day.

The race runs through the city park, along the Labe cycle path, and across two bridges, with the finish and facilities located under the historic city walls. For less experienced runners, a 10K race is available, which is shorter and also runs on a flat route. The event is suitable for recreational runners as well as those training for longer races, and offers quality facilities and refreshments on the course and at the finish line.
course_highlights: The course runs through the city park and along the Labe cycle path
Crossing two bridges over the Labe River with 60 steps
Flat profile with minimal elevation gain
additional: Refreshments are provided at the start, finish, and every 5 km along the course (water, isotonic drinks, fruit, chocolate). An ample lunch or baguette of choice is prepared for runners at the finish. Starting numbers with names are sent for payments made by April 12, 2026. Facilities in the park under the castle walls include changing rooms, baggage and bike storage, mobile toilets, and seating. Electronic timing with chip, results are available online, and runners receive an SMS with their final time. The time limit for the half marathon is 2 hours. Races take place in the park under the castle walls, registration opens on May 19, 2025, with race distances of 21.1 km and 10 km, refreshments on the course and after the race, facilities in the park area including changing rooms, storage, toilets, and drinking water.

name: Běh Škarmanem (Domažlice)
organizer: Sportovní klub policie ŠPS Domažlice z. s.
description: The Škarman Run is a traditional cross-country race held in Domažlice in the Škarman Forest Park. The race is part of the Běžec Chodska series and offers an opportunity for both adults and youth to run in a beautiful natural environment. The start is at 10:00 AM, and the race atmosphere is friendly and open to the broad running community. Participants can enjoy more challenging courses with forest terrain that will test their endurance and strength.
course_highlights: Cross-country run in Škarman Forest Park
Challenging terrain with natural obstacles
Picturesque environment of Domažlice
additional: The race starts at 10:00 AM in Škarman Forest Park in Domažlice. The registration fee is divided for adults and youth. The race is part of the Běžec Chodska series, which includes various running events in the region. Members of the Běžec Chodska association can enjoy benefits such as choosing a start number with their own name at selected races. The race is in memory of Marek Kubalík, with results and categories, and is part of the regional running series. Registration and further information are available on the official website.

name: JAK
description: Operational Programme Jan Amos Komenský (OP JAK) supports the development of research, development, and education in the Czech Republic with the aim of strengthening strategic intelligence, innovation, and modernization of educational methods. The program focuses on supporting top research teams, internationalization, and the development of institutional research environments. OP JAK also emphasizes equal opportunities and individual potential development, which contributes to increasing the competitiveness of the Czech Republic and improving the living conditions of its citizens. The program's calls are open to projects with a nationwide impact in the fields of R&D and education.
course_highlights: Held in Prague 4, Prague
Support for a healthy lifestyle and community spirit
Opportunity for broad public participation
additional: Application for support is submitted via the IS KP21+ system from April 3, 2025, to June 1, 2026, until 14:00. The managing authority of OP JAK is the Ministry of Education, Youth and Sports, with contact addresses in Prague 1 and Prague 9. There is a consultation line for OP JAK templates with phone support available every working day from 9 am to 3 pm. The Harfa Office Park building is wheelchair accessible with an elevator. A contact form for inquiries is also available. The race is part of a broader program focused on supporting research, development, and education in the Czech Republic, with an emphasis on community engagement and a healthy lifestyle.

name: Memoriál Luboše Svobody – cena Běžce Vysočiny
location: Lesopark Heulos, Jihlava, Vysočina Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 100 Kč - muži, junioři, ženy, juniorky přihlášené on-line

description: Memorial of Luboš Svoboda - the Běžce Vysočiny race is a traditional running event held in the Heulos forest park in Jihlava. The race offers various courses for all age groups from young children to veterans, with the main course being 8.8 km long for men, juniors, and veterans. The route runs along asphalt and unpaved paths of the forest park with scenic sections along the Jihlávka River and around the athletic stadium. The race is also a tribute to the memory of Luboš Svoboda, a prominent runner from Vysočina.
course_highlights: 2.2 km circuit on asphalt and unpaved paths of Heulos forest park
The main course runs along the left bank of the Jihlávka River and across footbridges near the ZOO and athletic stadium
Approximately 25% of the surface of the track is asphalt
additional: The start takes place in the area of the Summer Cinema in Jihlava Heulos. Changing rooms and toilets are available under the cinema screen. Runners from 3 years old and older participate. Categories are divided by age with different distances from 350 m for the youngest to 8.8 km for adults and veterans. There is an option to use a season ticket for registration fee. The race is part of the Běžce Vysočiny series, which promotes active lifestyle and sports activities in the region. The start is scheduled from 17:15 to 17:30 in the area of the Summer Cinema in Jihlava.

name: 6666m
description: The 6666m race in Chotěšov is a cross-country run held on Sunday, April 30, 2026, starting at 4:00 PM. The route takes runners through the picturesque environment of the Central Bohemian Uplands and offers a challenge in the form of trail running with natural obstacles. The event is suitable for all runners who want to enjoy a sporting atmosphere and the beauty of the surrounding landscape.
course_highlights: Cross-country run in the natural terrain of the Central Bohemian Uplands
Route length of 6666 meters
Scenic views and natural obstacles
additional: Registration is conducted online via a form on the website. The organizer is O. Maršík, who can be contacted by phone at 606 248 978. Results from previous editions are available on the website. The race offers a cross-country course, registration information, date and time, and is part of a series of races with the possibility to participate in other disciplines and an afterparty.

location: Horní Bečva, Vsetín, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: DSO – Prostřední Bečva a Horní Bečva
