location: Zámecká zahrada, Brandýsy nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: The Municipal Run through Brandýsek and Boleslav is a traditional running event held in the castle garden in Brandýsek nad Labem, offering races for all age groups and running levels. The program includes 5 km, 10 km (double loop of 5 km), and 3 km courses, all starting in the afternoon. It also features a children's run with several age categories and a team race, where the best times of three team members are summed. The event is complemented by an accompanying program, refreshments, and valuable prizes for the winners.
course_highlights: Mostly asphalt surface with sections on cobblestones, concrete paving, and paved paths
The 5 km and 10 km courses are the same, with the 10 km run twice
Children's courses in the castle garden on paved paths
additional: You can pick up your packet on April 9-10 at the museum info center in the square or on the race day at the Carriage House from 9 am to 1 pm. There is a baggage storage and changing room at the start of the race. On the course, there is a refreshment station with water; at the finish line, water and fruit are available. Traffic restrictions in the city center from 1:45 pm to approximately 4:00 pm due to road and bridge closures. The team race requires at least 3 runners; the combined time of the three best times determines the team result. Castle garden, family program, children's races, team races, online registration or at the info center.

name: Radonický běh
location: Radonické parky Amerika, Radonice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Radonický Run is the 11th annual running race for children and adults, held at Radonický Park Amerika. The main races are 3.5 km and 6.5 km long and run along field and forest paths with a section on an asphalt road. Children's courses are marked within the park area, and the event is suitable for the general public, including families with children. After the race, participants can enjoy refreshments and entertainment such as Zumba exercise. Runners participate at their own risk; minors must be supervised by parents.
course_highlights: The main race courses run along field and forest paths with a section on an asphalt road
Children's courses are marked within the park area
The race takes place in the picturesque environment of Radonický Park Amerika
additional: Registration begins at 9:00 and ends at 9:40 for children and at 11:15 for adults. The start of children's categories is from 10:00 according to age, with main races starting at 11:30 (canicross), 11:37 (3.5 km), and 11:44 (6.5 km). The participation fee is voluntary; prizes and medals are awarded to the top three in each category, and all children receive sweets. At the finish line, there are tea, fruit, Tatranky bars, and soup. Runners participate at their own risk; minors must be supervised by parents. The race includes main routes of 3.5 km and 6.5 km, children's courses, running along field and forest paths, registration from 9:00 to 11:15, refreshments at the finish, and accompanying activities such as Zumba.

name: Smrt krásných běžců (backyard ultra)
location: Ježkovka, Heřmanův Městec, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: The Death of Beautiful Runners is a backyard ultra race held at Ježkovka in Heřmanův Městec. The event is accessible to wheelchair users and is organized by the Heřmanův Městec Running Club z.s. The race starts on Saturday, April 11, 2026, at 9:00 AM. This race offers a unique running experience in the beautiful environment of Eastern Bohemia.
course_highlights: Backyard ultra race format
Location at Ježkovka in Heřmanův Městec
Accessible for wheelchair users
additional: The nearest accommodation options are available at the House of Children and Youth Ježkovka and at the Autocamp Konopáč in Heřmanův Městec. The terrain is not specified; the event is suitable for the general public, including wheelchair users; the surroundings offer accommodation at Hotel Eden and Hotel Marina Heřmanův Městec.

name: Benefiční rodinný běh
location: Pastva Malý Újezd, Malý Újezd, Czech Republic
description: The 2nd Beneficial Family Run is a charitable running event held in Malý Újezd, taking place on April 11, 2026. The event is aimed at families and offers an opportunity to actively spend an afternoon in the pleasant environment of Pastva Malý Újezd. The start is at 1:00 PM and the run lasts approximately 5 hours. This is the second edition of this successful event, which supports a good cause and community gathering.
course_highlights: Takes place in the Pastva Malý Újezd location
Family atmosphere and charitable purpose
Event duration approximately 5 hours with open running
additional: The event lasts 5 hours and is intended for families. It takes place in the Pastva Malý Újezd location. This is the second edition of the beneficent run. The event is charitable, outdoor, suitable for families and children, with support for disabled athletes and an accompanying program.

name: ČEZ RunTour Hradec Králové
location: Malšovická aréna, Hradec Králové, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
distance_verbose: Maraton, Půlmaraton, 10 km, 5 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: CEZ RunTour Hradec Králové is a family running race offering courses for all age groups from children to adults. The race takes place at Malšovická Arena and features distances of 3, 5, 10, and 21.1 km, including children's runs of 500 and 1000 meters. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, quality facilities, and accompanying program for the whole family. Each participant receives a starter pack and contributes to charity. The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners.
course_highlights: Courses of 3, 5, 10, and 21.1 km at Malšovická Arena
Children's runs of 500 and 1000 meters with age categories
Refreshment stations on the course and a starter pack for every runner
additional: The race is secured with medical and guiding teams, a special phone line for emergency services during the race, refreshments at the finish and along the course, a children's corner with supervision, a starter pack with gifts from partners, and an entertaining accompanying program for the whole family. Distances include 3, 5, 10, and 21.1 km; children's runs of 500 and 1000 meters; accompanying program, charitable contributions, refreshments, medals, photographs, showers, massages.

name: Běh cyklostezkou
location: Světlá nad Sázavou, Vysočina Region, Czech Republic
organizer: AZ tým ve spolupráci se Sportovním zařízením města s.r.o. ve Světlé nad Sázavou

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 150 Kč při online registraci a uhrazení startovného

description: The cycling trail run is a traditional race held in Světlá nad Sázavou, offering a main run of 5.2 km along the Sázava River on a cycle path to the corn mill in Mrzkovice and back. The race is divided into categories based on age and gender, including a special category for married couples. There are separate races for children with various distances according to age groups. Participants can look forward to chip timing, commemorative medals, prizes for the best, and refreshments at the finish line and in the area’s buffet. In case of bad weather, covered facilities are available in a tennis hall.
course_highlights: 5.2 km course along the Sázava River on a cycle path
Finish at the corn mill in Mrzkovice and return
Timing with chip timing system
additional: Registration for the main race from 12:00 to 14:30, registration for children's races from 12:00 to 12:30, children's races start at 13:00. At the finish line, light refreshments and the option to refresh at the area’s buffet. In case of bad weather, facilities are available in a covered tennis hall. New: prize for breaking the course record by gender. Raffle for main race participants. The race takes place on a cycle path along the Sázava River, with categories for children, medals, prizes, and refreshments available. The event is suitable for all age groups and includes indoor facilities in case of bad weather.

name: Běh vítězství, Hranická dvacítka a Hranická desítka
description: Victory Run, Hranická Twenty and Hranická Ten are traditional running races organized by SK Hranice in Hranice near Olomouc. In 2026, the 57th Victory Run, the 53rd Hranická Twenty, and the 10th Hranická Ten will take place. The races offer courses from 100 to 500 meters on a stadium track and longer trail courses, including forest paths. The event is suitable for the general public, including children and youth, and is part of the regional athletics tradition.
course_highlights: Races from 100 to 500 meters take place on a stadium track
Hranická Twenty runs through forest paths with elevation profile
Combination of stadium and trail courses around Hranice
additional: The races are part of the SK Hranice athletics calendar and the Czech Athletic Federation. Photos from previous editions are available online. The races will be held on Saturday, April 11, 2026. Children's categories have their own training and race schedules. The races include various categories from children to adults, registration is possible on the website, the event is part of the regional running series, and also offers trail courses.

name: Velká Morava
description: Velká Morava is a multimedia exhibition dedicated to the history of the Great Moravian Empire, presenting visitors with the story of the archeologically named warrior Mojslav from the 9th century. The exhibition features life-sized historical dioramas depicting key historical moments and everyday life of the inhabitants of Great Moravia. It also includes an introductory film, an electronic guide, computer animations, and 3D models of reconstructed buildings. Texts and audio guides are available in several languages, and the exhibition is adapted for visually impaired and blind visitors.
course_highlights: Life-sized historical dioramas with figures
3D models of reconstructed churches and fortifications of Veligrad
Audio guide and texts in Czech, English, German, and Russian
additional: The recommended visit duration is 60 minutes. The exhibition is adapted for visually impaired and blind visitors. The virtual guide also offers Russian language. The event focuses on education and popularization of Great Moravia's history, suitable for the general public and schools.

name: Jarní bahno - Goethovka
location: Goethova vyhlídka, Karlovy Vary, Karlovarský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Spring Mud is a traditional and iconic series of XC races in Karlovy Vary, celebrating its 25th edition in 2026. The series includes four races in mountain biking, running, and canicross disciplines, with the final race Goethovka offering a fast and dynamic course around Goethova Lookout. The races are suitable for all age groups and levels, emphasizing a friendly atmosphere and the opportunity for sports enthusiasts to meet after the winter break. The organizer is the association A.M.bike, which also organizes the region's largest cycling event, the Karlovy Vary AM Bike Marathon.
course_highlights: Fast and dynamic course near Goethova Lookout with a length of 5.8 km and an elevation gain of 240 m
Four races in the series with various terrains from hilly to rugged
Opportunity to compete in mountain biking, running, and canicross
additional: MTB starts take place in three waves from 12:00 to 12:15, the fourth race is an individual time trial with interval starts from 12:00. Free bottled water and hot tea are available at each race, refreshments are provided at selected locations. During registration, a timing chip is loaned; a fee of 500 CZK applies for non-return. The organizer reserves the right to change the program and conditions; participants agree to the taking of photographs and videos during the race. The race is part of a series with four disciplines - mountain biking, running, and canicross; registration and details are available on the website; medals and diplomas are awarded to the best.

name: Jarní rozBěh
location: Husinec - Řež, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Spring Run is a cross-country and trail run held on April 11, 2026, in the picturesque surroundings of the villages Husinec and Řež in the Central Bohemian Region. The race offers three courses with lengths of 11.4 km, 7.4 km, and 5.7 km, which lead through nature and are suitable for runners of all performance levels. The organizer is the municipality of Husinec - Řež, which invites all runners to enjoy running regardless of fitness. The event is part of the Czech Running Club and the Czech Athletic Federation, ensuring quality organization and atmosphere.
course_highlights: Cross-country and trail course characteristics
Course lengths of 11.4 km, 7.4 km, and 5.7 km
Picturesque environment of the villages Husinec and Řež
additional: The race is open to everyone regardless of fitness. The organizer is the municipality of Husinec - Řež. The event is part of the Czech Running Club and the Czech Athletic Federation. The event focuses on fun, promoting an active lifestyle, and community cohesion, with participants receiving medals, and local volunteers and the fire brigade participating.

name: Štěpánovský trhák
location: U Dub, Trhový Štěpánov, Czech Republic
description: Stěpánovský Trhák is a traditional running race that will take place for the eleventh time in 2026. After a one-year break, the race moves to a new location at U Dubu in Trhový Štěpánov, where participants can enjoy a new course through the forest, along forest paths, and partially on a cycle path. The race offers an atmosphere of friendly sporting gathering with children's and main races. The start and facilities are arranged to support the comfort and safety of participants.
course_highlights: New course at U Dubu
The route goes through the forest, along forest paths, and partially on a cycle path
Mostly natural terrain with slight elevation
additional: Registration for the main race is available online and on-site on the race day from 12:30. Children's races start at 13:40, the main race at 15:00. Parking is available on Lesní, Lipová streets, and surrounding areas; race facilities are located in a place where vehicle entry is not permitted. The results announcement for the main race is scheduled for approximately 16:00. The race includes a 7 km main course, children's categories, and a charity walk. Registration is open online and on-site. The event is part of the Běžec Podblanicka series.

name: Peršlácký kros
location: Fabián - Homolka, Nový Vojířov, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Peršlácký cross country is a running race for the general public, suitable for all performance levels and age groups. The race takes place in the Fabián - Homolka nature reserve near the Novomlýnský pond, under the Forest Hotel Peršlák in Nový Vojířov. The 10 km long route is gently hilly and runs on asphalt and forest paths, well marked. After the race, participants can enjoy refreshments and changing facilities in a tent at the start and finish. The race offers medals and prizes for the best runners and is supported by local sponsors.
course_highlights: The route runs around the Fabián - Homolka nature reserve
Distance of the route is 10 km, gently hilly
Track surface: 60% asphalt, 40% forest paths
additional: Registration is also possible on the day of the race at the venue no later than one hour before the start. Bib pickup begins at 9:00. Children's races start at 10:00, children's race awards at 11:30, main race awards at 13:30. Parking is approximately 1 km from the start on a meadow; it is recommended to arrive early. There is a tent for changing and storing belongings under organizer supervision. After the race, refreshments are available, and there is an option for lunch at the Forest Hotel Peršlák restaurant. Trail race with refreshments, runner facilities, online and on-site registration, limited parking about 1 km from the start.

name: 7 pohoří Jizerské hory
location: Severák, Janov nad Nisou, Liberec, Czech Republic
description: The Jizerské hory 2026 race will take you to a new location with start and facilities at Severák in Janov nad Nisou. You will run mainly on forest paths and terrain around Smržovka, Josefov Důl, and Maxov. The routes were prepared by mountain rescue worker Michal Zavadil from the Jizerské hory Mountain Rescue Service. There are three tracks of different lengths and elevation gains, offering technical trails and epic views. The registration fee includes a professionally marked route, timing measurement, a commemorative medal, and refreshments on the trail and at the finish line.
course_highlights: Technical trails around Smržovka, Josefov Důl, and Maxov
Main course 25 km with an elevation gain of 860 m
Alternative course 14 km with an elevation gain of 400 m
additional: The time limit to complete the race is 4 hours; after that, the participant is marked as DNF. Participants can store small items at the registration booth. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Recommended gear includes a windbreaker and a charged mobile phone with the rescue app. Each participant will receive a commemorative finisher's medal and refreshments on the trail and at the finish. The course is technically demanding, passing through spruce and deciduous forests, and has been prepared by local mountain rescue members. Registration is based on the date of registration; the event is suitable for all weather conditions.

name: Jarní běh Plzeň
description: Spring Run Plzeň is a friendly cross-country and trail race held in the beautiful environment of Homolka Park in Plzeň. It offers courses of 6 km, 2 km, and a relay race, making it suitable for the general public, including children and adults. The event is characterized by a joyful atmosphere and support for athletic performances. Registration is possible online and on-site, providing easy access for all interested participants.
course_highlights: Cross-country and trail course characteristics
Course lengths of 6 km, 2 km, and relay race
Environment of Homolka Park in Plzeň
additional: Registration is available online and on-site. The race is part of the Czech Running Club. Categories include children, adults, and relays. The race features children's races from 300 m and the main race of 6 km, complemented by family activities and a sports atmosphere in nature.

name: Jarní stodůlecký kros
description: Spring Stodůlky Cross is a single-loop challenging cross-country race that introduces runners to various corners of Prague 13. The course passes through the Stodůlky residential area, Central Park, and rocky areas above the Prokop Valley. The race offers medals and diplomas for the top three in each category and material prizes for the fastest. After the race, all participants are served tea, sweets, and enjoy a pleasant atmosphere of a small race.
course_highlights: Single-loop cross-country race in Prague 13-Stodůlky
The route passes through the residential area, Central Park, and rocky areas above the Prokop Valley
Challenging terrain with diverse surfaces
additional: Medals and diplomas are awarded to the top three in each category, with material prizes for the fastest. All participants receive tea and a small sweet. Organized by TJ Stodůlky Praha, contact Martin Žežulka. The course is diverse, including urban and trail sections. Registration is online. The race is suitable for the general public.

name: Běh lipovou alejí – Nymburská desítka
location: Nymburk, Nymburk District, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Linden Alley Run is a traditional road race in Nymburk, held for the 31st time. The race offers a loop course of 10 km, mainly on asphalt paths along Tyršova Island and the athletic stadium with a synthetic surface. The event is suitable for the general public, including children and youth, for whom shorter distances are prepared. The atmosphere of the race is friendly and sporting, with an emphasis on a quality course and organization.
course_highlights: Loop course of 10 km with predominantly asphalt surface
Initial and final section of 1,800 m on the athletic stadium with a synthetic surface
The route passes around the Elbe River, Sports Center, and Tyršova Island
additional: Children's and youth categories register only on the day of the race, no later than 30 minutes before the start of the respective category. The main men's and women's race over 10 km starts at 11:15 AM. The course is measured according to IAAF/AIMS rules and meets their standards. Running segments are also available on Garmin and Strava platforms for individual training. The race includes the main 10 km course, children's categories, and the evaluation of the best runners. The start is on a tartan track, the course includes three asphalt loops, and the last 800 meters are on tartan.

name: Horské běhy v Novohradských horách
location: Hojná Voda, Novohradské hory, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic

price_tiers.distance: Easy – Běh Pro Paměť národa 2,2 km

description: Mountain runs in the Novohradské Mountains are traditional spring races held in the beautiful environment of the Novohradské Mountains with the center at Hojná Voda. They offer various routes from children's categories through shorter runs to a demanding ultra trail of 63 km with an elevation gain of 2050 m. The races are suitable for men, women, and canicross, providing a sporting experience in nature with the opportunity to discover the beauty of the Novohradské Mountains. The organizer is Martin Brožka and the team of Sportcentrum Novohradské hory, who prepare detailed maps and facilities for competitors.
course_highlights: Ultra trail 63 km with an elevation gain of 2050 m
Classic route 19 km with an elevation gain of 660 m
Experience 12.4 km with an elevation gain of 430 m
additional: Registration is also possible on the race day at Hojná Voda - U Lípy from 9:30 to 10:30 for children and from 12:00 to 13:45 for other categories. Participants have access to detailed route maps in the Mountain Running section and in printed form at the start. A final raffle with valuable prizes including accommodation in the Alps and a subscription to the magazine Svět běhu is prepared for participants. Route maps, online registration, raffle, accommodation options nearby, weather usually around 19°C.

name: Kyfův Jarní běh
location: Hrušov, Senohraby, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Kyfův Spring Run is a traditional running race organized by TJ Sokol Senohraby, held on a meadow beneath the former ski jump in Hrušov. The race is part of the Ladov Region Cup and offers sporting experiences in a spring environment with courses that include crossing a stream. Participants can also enjoy a mobile café serving hot drinks. The courses are known for their natural difficulty and atmosphere, attracting runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Course 1.8 km with stream crossing and wading for younger participants
Meadow beneath the former ski jump in Hrušov
Natural surface with unevenness caused by wildlife
additional: The race is part of the Ladov Region Cup. The 1.8 km course includes stream crossing; it is recommended to bring change shoes. A mobile café with coffee and hot chocolate is available. The courses are marked and manually maintained, but the terrain under the jump is uneven due to wild boar activity. The event takes place on April 12, 2026. The course includes forest and cross-country sections. Registration is recommended in advance. The entry fee is often donated to charity. The event is part of local community activities.

name: Kros Sázava
location: Pikovice u fotbalového hřiště, Příbramsko, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Cross Sázava is a running race in Pikovice near the football field in Příbram district, offering three routes with different lengths and elevation gains. The longer route measures 15.5 km with an elevation gain of approximately 500 meters, the middle route is 10 km with an elevation gain of about 230 meters, and the hobby route is 5 km with an elevation of 120 meters. All routes are exclusively in natural terrain, ensuring beautiful and challenging running experiences. The race is suitable for runners of various levels who want to enjoy cross-country running in the picturesque landscape of the Central Bohemian Region.
course_highlights: Longer route 15.5 km with an elevation gain of approx. 500 m
Middle route 10 km with an elevation gain of approx. 230 m
Hobby route 5 km with an elevation of 120 m
additional: The course is technically demanding with forest trails and natural obstacles; the race takes place on April 12, 2026.

name: Žďárská 10
location: Žďár nad Sázavou, Žďárské vrchy, Czech Republic
description: Žďárská 10 is a fast road race over 10 km that opens the spring season in the heart of the Žďár Hills. The route runs from the center of Žďár nad Sázavou along cycle paths to the end of Pilská Reservoir and back, offering beautiful nature and minimal elevation gain. The race is precisely measured and starts in a mass start, ensuring a fair and competitive environment. It is organized by Sportovní klub Žďárák z.s. and is scored within the Žebříček 2025.
course_highlights: Road route with minimal elevation gain
Runs along an asphalt cycle path around Pilská Reservoir
Short section of 200 m on Dvorská Street with low traffic
additional: Registration is also possible on race day from 9:45 to 10:45 at the start area in front of the Cultural House. Parking is available at the Municipal Office and nearby areas. Results will be announced at 12:30. Children's races are organized separately with pre-registration via a form. The race takes place on a measured route, with online registration and on-site registration, start at 11:00, results at 12:30, and children can participate in accompanying races.

name: Jarní běh zámeckým parkem v Krásném dvoře
location: Krásný Dvůr, Karlovy Vary, Czech Republic
description: Spring Run through the Castle Park "Memorial of Jaroslav Štůla" is a traditional running race held in the beautiful surroundings of the castle park near the state castle Krásný Dvůr. The race is open to all age categories, from young beginners to adults, and offers 19 different categories. The course runs along natural paths in the hilly terrain of the park, providing an interesting and enjoyable running experience. Participants have the opportunity for refreshments, and the best in each category are awarded prizes.
course_highlights: The course runs along natural paths in the hilly terrain of the castle park
Start and finish at the courtyard of the state castle Krásný Dvůr
The race offers 19 different categories for all age groups
additional: The start and finish of the race are at the courtyard of the state castle. Registrations can be sent via the registration form until 10.04.2026 at 12:00 PM. Participants have the opportunity for refreshments. Full entry fee is 20 CZK. The route runs along natural paths in the hilly terrain of the park, the race is suitable for all age categories, refreshments are provided, registration is open until 10.04.2026, with the start at 9:15 AM.

name: Lahofer run
location: Suchohrdly u Znojma, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 150 Kč pro hlavní závod, 50 Kč pro děti
description: Lahofer Run is the first edition of a running race as part of the Znojmo Running Cup, starting from the premises of the new Vinařství LAHOFER building in Dobšice. The approximately 8 km course runs around local vineyards and combines 80% forested and paved paths with 20% asphalt. Spectators can watch the finish from the unique roof of the winery with a view of the surrounding area. A children's race will also take place before the main race.
course_highlights: Course approximately 8 km around vineyards
80% forested and paved paths, 20% asphalt
Start and finish at the same place with a view from the winery roof
additional: Parking is available at the Vinařství LAHOFER premises. The children's race will take place before the start of the main race. The race is scheduled for April 12, 2026, with routes including 3 km, 6 km, and 9 km. Participants can also take part in children's races. The race course includes both asphalt and forest paths.

name: Korunou za korunu
location: Nové Město na Moravě, Vysočina, Czech Republic
organizer: TJ Nové Město na Moravě z.s.
description: Korunou za korunu is a short cross-country run around the dyke of Cihelský Pond in Nové Město na Moravě. The race is suitable for runners who prefer trail running and can use spikes. It is organized by TJ Nové Město na Moravě z.s. and is part of the running activities of the Czech Athletic Federation. The main category starts at 11:20 and the race offers a pleasant atmosphere in the beautiful Vysočina region.
course_highlights: Short cross-country run around Cihelský Pond
Option to use spikes
Trail course in the Vysočina region
additional: The first category starts at 9:30, the main category starts at 11:20. The organizer is TJ Nové Město na Moravě z.s., contact Petr Hubáček, phone 776 046 260. The race is cross/trail type and takes place on the dyke of Cihelský Pond. The race will be held on April 12, 2026, with a course length of 3.2 km for men and 1.6 km for women, running around Cihelský Pond. Registration is possible online or on-site.

name: Jarní běh zámeckým parkem
location: Krásný Dvůr, zámecký park, Czech Republic
description: Spring Run through the Castle Park "Memorial of Jaroslav Štůla" is a traditional running race held in the beautiful surroundings of the castle park in Krásný Dvůr. The race is open to all age groups, from young beginners to adults, and offers 19 different categories. The course runs along natural paths in the hilly terrain of the park, providing an interesting and enjoyable running experience. The start and finish are located in the courtyard of the state castle, where refreshments and awards for the best competitors in each category are also provided.
course_highlights: The course runs along natural paths in the castle park
The hilly terrain of the park offers an interesting run
Start and finish in the courtyard of the state castle
additional: The race offers 19 different categories for all age groups. The start and finish are in the courtyard of the Krásný Dvůr state castle. Registrations can be sent via the registration form until 10.04.2026 at 12:00 PM. Participants have the opportunity to enjoy refreshments. The entry fee for the event is 20 CZK. Course distances: 6,541 m, 4,082 m, 3,136 m; park, flat routes; various age categories; online and on-site registration; refreshments and prizes for winners.

name: Jaroměřský kros
description: Jaroměř Cross is a cross-country race held in the unique environment of the fortress and underground tunnels in Jaroměř - Josefov. The race takes place on April 12, 2026, and features a varied course profile with undulating terrain, hills, and grassy sections without obstacles. The start is beneath the fortress walls, adding a magical atmosphere of a Terezian fortress. Participants of all ages, from children to seniors, take part in the race, which is organized according to athletics rules with chip timing.
course_highlights: Unique environment of the fortress and underground tunnels
Varied course profile with undulating terrain and hills
Start beneath the fortress walls with a magical atmosphere
additional: Registration and chip pickup begin at 9:00 AM, with registration closing 30 minutes before the start of each category. Chip timing is worn on the shoe and bib numbers are worn on the chest. Changing rooms are available in tents near the race office, and there is quick refreshment and first aid provided by ČČK Jaroměř. Parking is available at the parking lot or along the road. Accommodation can be arranged through TJ Sokol Jaroměř or in the offerings of the town of Jaroměř and the surrounding area. Terrain, online registration until April 8, 2026.

name: Přespolní běh Cvikováčku
location: Cvikov, Liberec District, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: Cross-country run Cvikováček is a traditional running event organized by the House of Children and Youth Cvikováček in Cvikov. The race takes place on Sunday, April 12, 2026, and is open to the general public, including children and youth. The event offers an opportunity for sports activities in a pleasant environment of Cvikov region and promotes active leisure time. The start list and results are available online, and registration is conducted through a specialized registration system.
course_highlights: Trail mostly on forest paths
Part of the regional running league
Available distances of 9.1 km and 2.7 km
additional: Start list and results are available online at irontime.cz. Registration is possible via an online form on irontime.cz. The event is part of the activities of the House of Children and Youth Cvikováček, which also offers other leisure clubs and activities in the region. The race is part of the series of running races called District Running League Českolipsko, with registration possible through the organizer's website.

name: Běh u Chlumce
location: Louka u hrušňového sadu, Chlumec u Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1

description: We invite you to the 2nd annual run for the whole family - NaPOLEon run, which takes place on the meadow near the pear orchard in Chlumec. Races of various lengths and difficulties will take you through the beautiful landscape of Chlumecko. Registration is possible in advance by email or directly on the day of the race. The entry fee is symbolic 50 CZK for adults, making the event accessible to all runners and families with children.
course_highlights: Routes of different lengths: 500 m, 1 km, 5 km, and 10 km (2x 5 km loop)
Beautiful landscape of Chlumecko
Start and finish under a shelter on the meadow near the pear orchard
additional: Registration is also possible on the day of the race from 9:00 to 10:00. The start and finish are located under a shelter on the meadow near the pear orchard in Chlumec. Routes from 500 m to 10 km, registration via email or on-site, taking place on the meadow near the pear orchard in Chlumec.

name: 57. Běh vítězství, 53. Hranická dvacítka a 10. Hranická desítka
location: Areál DDM Ježkovka, Heřmanův Městec, Czech Republic
description: Victory Run, Hranická Twenty and Hranická Ten are traditional running races organized by SK Hranice, held at the DDM Ježkovka area in Heřmanův Městec. The races include various distances, from short children's runs on the stadium oval to longer trail courses. The event is open to the general public and offers a sporting experience in a pleasant environment with a history dating back several decades. The races take place on Saturday, April 11, 2026, and are popular among runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Races from 100 to 500 meters take place on the stadium oval
Hranická Twenty and Ten partly run through forest paths
The course profile includes various elevation changes (see attached profiles)
additional: The races have a long tradition (57th Victory Run, 53rd Hranická Twenty, 10th Hranická Ten). Photos from previous editions are available online. The courses are detailed in attached maps and profiles. The races are part of the broader athletic activities of SK Hranice. They are organized as part of a sports day with the possibility of pre-registration; the races are suitable for the general public and experienced runners.

name: Priateľský nočný beh mestom Vranov
location: Základná škola Sídlisko II., Vranov nad Topľou, Prešov, Slovakia
description: The friendly night run through the city of Vranov is a traditional running event in Vranov nad Topľou that offers a nocturnal running experience through the city. The race takes place at the premises of the Sídlisko II Elementary School and is open to men, women, and children. The main category starts at 19:30, and the children's run begins at 17:00. The organizers are OZ S rukou v ruke, Sídlisko II Elementary School, the town of Vranov nad Topľou, and OZ Vranovské Vydry, who warmly invite all runners to enjoy a friendly atmosphere and a sporting experience.
course_highlights: Nočný beh mestom Vranov
Štart a cieľ pri Základnej škole Sídlisko II.
Kategórie pre mužov, ženy a deti
additional: Detský beh štartuje o 17:00 hod. Štartovné na mieste je 20 €. Nočná trať, registrácia online a na mieste, detský beh, štafetové behy

name: Beh Galantou – Beh oslobodenia
price_range: 15 € online, 12 € s GALAkartou; štafeta 40 € online, 32 € s GALAkartou; Samsung Run 10 €, 8 € s GALAkartou
description: Galantou Run - Liberation Run is a jubilee 40th edition of a traditional running event in Galanta, offering various disciplines for all age categories. The event is intended not only for athletes but also for everyone who wants to experience an atmosphere full of emotions, joy of movement, and self-overcoming. Each participant will receive a commemorative medal, hydration, and refreshments; children will additionally get a ticket to Water World Galandia and a package from COOP Jednota Galanta. The best runners will receive monetary rewards and valuable prizes, including televisions in special categories. After the run, a cultural program will be held at the City Cultural Center in Galanta.
course_highlights: Courses for beginners and advanced runners
Commemorative medal for every participant including children
More than 40 valuable prizes in the final raffle
additional: Registration opens on the day of the event at 8:00 AM and closes 20 minutes before the start of each category. Children will receive a ticket to Water World Galandia and a package from COOP Jednota Galanta. The top runners will receive valuable polished glass instead of trophies. Winners of special categories must hold a GalaKARTA. After the run, a cultural program will be held at the City Cultural Center. The event includes various disciplines, rewards, refreshments, and cultural activities. Registration is online, and street closures are expected during the races.

name: Ultramaratón Košice – Miskolc
organizer: Marathon Club Miskolc, Košice Marathon Club
description: The Košice - Miskolc Ultramarathon is a challenging international ultramarathon race taking place on April 18, 2026. The route runs from the center of Košice to Miskolc, offering runners a challenge with long and diverse terrain. The event is part of a series of running events organized by the Košice Marathon Club and is intended for endurance runners seeking a unique experience at the edge of their capabilities. The start is on Main Street in Košice, which adds a historic atmosphere to the race and support from local spectators.
course_highlights: The route runs from Košice to Miskolc through various terrains
Start and finish in the historic center of Košice on Main Street
International character of the race with crossing borders
additional: The race starts on Main Street in Košice between the DoubleTree by Hilton hotel and the Dargov department store. The event is part of the Košice Marathon series and organized by the Košice Marathon Club. Specific information about start waves, capacities, or fees is not provided. The race begins at 6:00 and 7:00, with registration deadlines and fees set. The race takes place on Main Street and Dolná brána in Košice, intended for runners aged 16 and older. Categories include individual, pairs, and relay teams.

name: Ultramaratón Miškolc - Košice
organizer: Marathon Club Miskolc, Košice Marathon Club
description: Ultramarathon Košice - Miskolc is a prestigious running event taking place on April 18, 2026. Participants run from Košice to Miskolc, covering a challenging ultramarathon route. The event is part of a rich running calendar in the region and offers a unique experience for endurance runners. The organizer is the Košice Marathon Club, which ensures professional preparation and organization.
course_highlights: Ultramarathon route from Košice to Miskolc
Challenging terrain requiring endurance and fitness
Crossing two countries - Slovakia and Hungary
additional: The event is part of a series of running events in Košice, including the International Peace Marathon and other accompanying activities. Organizers offer opportunities to participate as a volunteer, driver, or pacer. Runners have access to comprehensive organizational support and benefits associated with the entry fee. The route passes through cycle paths and has low traffic, with categories for individuals, two-person, five-person, and ten-person relays; start times are at 6:00 and 7:00.

name: BoleRuN
location: areál TJ Slavoj Boleráz, Boleráz, Slovakia
description: BoleRuN is a running event held at the TJ Slavoj Boleráz premises, offering courses for various age groups including children, youth, and adults. Participants can compete on distances from 50 meters up to 10 km, with the children's race starting at 1:00 PM and the adults' race at 2:00 PM. The organizer is the municipality of Boleráz in cooperation with the initiative Boleráz - Hýb sa. The event is suitable for all runners aged 9 and above who want to enjoy a sports day in a pleasant environment.
course_highlights: Adult course 10 km and 5 km
Youth course for ages 10 to 14 - 2 km
Children's course up to 9 years old from 50 meters to 1 km
additional: Children's race starts at 1:00 PM, adults' race starts at 2:00 PM. Categories are divided by age and distance. The organizer is the municipality of Boleráz and the initiative Boleráz - Hýb sa. Registration is likely closed as of April 2024; the event includes categories for children and adults, with electronic timing and a participant medal.

name: Šarišská míľa
description: The Šariš Mile is a running event organized by BK ZasRun in Šarišské Bohdanovce at the football field. The race is intended for various age categories including children, youth, adults, and Nordic Walking. The start is divided into a children's mile, running, and Nordic Walking for women and men, with participation in the race free of charge and an option for a voluntary contribution during registration. The event offers a pleasant atmosphere for runners of all levels and age groups.
course_highlights: The race takes place on the football field in Šarišské Bohdanovce
Categories for children, youth, adults, and Nordic Walking
Start divided into a children's mile, running, and Nordic Walking for women and men
additional: Participation in the race is free of charge, with an option for a voluntary contribution during registration. The children's mile starts at 16:00, women’s running and Nordic Walking at 16:20, men’s running and Nordic Walking at 16:45. Categories are divided by age and gender, including overall standings for Nordic Walking. The race begins at 16:00, is open to the general public, and suitable for all age groups.

name: Chlieb náš….
description: Our Bread is a craft bakery in Hronský Beňadik that produces sourdough bread using traditional methods from quality ingredients. It is committed to honest baking work, which is reflected in a crispy crust, lively sourdough, and soft interior of the bread. The bakery offers an authentic experience where you can choose fresh bread directly from the oven. In addition to the quality of the bread, the bakery is also known for its unique Baroque ceiling, which is one of the most original in Trnava.
course_highlights: Traditional baking of sourdough bread from quality ingredients
Crispy crust and soft interior of the bread
Unique Baroque ceiling in the bakery
additional: The bakery is open Tuesday to Friday from 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM and Saturday from 7:00 AM to 11:30 AM, or until supplies last. The operation emphasizes honest craftsmanship and the family character of Trnka Gastronomy. The event is associated with traditional bread baking, organized at Dumas bakery in Hronský Beňadik, suitable for all interested in baking crafts.

name: Beh oslobodenia Turčianska Štiavnička
description: The Turčianska Štiavnička Liberation Run is a traditional race with a rich history, held to commemorate the anniversary of the village's liberation by the Soviet Army. This 32nd edition will take place on April 18, 2026, at the football pitch in Turčianska Štiavnička. The course, approximately 10 km long, mainly traverses mountain terrain and offers runners a challenging yet beautiful experience. Participants are divided into age categories, including children's categories and the best Štiavničans. Organizers welcome all runners and look forward to their participation.
course_highlights: The course mainly runs through mountain terrain with forest paths and a local park
Distance approximately 10 km, known as the 'Štiavnická ten' or 'Štiavnická ten'
Start and finish at the cultural house and football pitch in the village
additional: Online registration is open from April 1, 2026, to April 16, 2026. The race is divided into men's age categories, women's, and children's categories. Starting numbers are traditionally sewn and printed according to the original pattern from Ružomberok and are still used today. Before the race, a ceremonial laying of a wreath at the fallen heroes' memorial takes place. The races start at 10:00 and 13:15, with registration possible from April 1 to April 16, 2026. The event has historical significance and is part of the local sports calendar.

name: Banská Bystrica - Bežíme spolu v Banskej Bystrici
location: Park pod pamätníkom SNP, Banská Bystrica, Slovakia
description: Running Together in Banská Bystrica is a running event held in the park under the SNP Memorial in Banská Bystrica. It offers four courses of different lengths, including a children's run, suitable for the general public including children up to 6 years old. The course is flat with no elevation gain, allowing for an enjoyable run for all age groups. The event supports people with disabilities, with 2 € from each registration fee going towards motivating them to stay active.
course_highlights: Flat courses with no elevation gain
Four courses: 10 km, 5 km, 3 km, and a children's run of 500 m
Start and finish in the park under the SNP Memorial in Banská Bystrica
additional: Support: 2 € from each paid entry fee will go towards supporting people with disabilities. The children's run is intended for children up to 6 years old (born 2020 - 2026) and requires the presence of a legal guardian. The registration fee is valid from April 7, 2026. The course is flat, ensuring an easy race experience. The course is flat, registration is online, the event supports people with health disabilities, and includes information about data usage consent.

name: Polus Tower Run
location: Polus Tower 2, Bratislava-Nové Mesto, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: Polus Tower Run is a unique stair running event taking place on April 18, 2026, at the Polus Tower 2 office building in Bratislava. Participants climb the height difference on their own on two courses - a children's course with 4 floors and 116 steps, and an adult main course with 19 floors and 416 steps. Starts are individual at 30-second intervals, and times are measured electronically. The event is organized by the KOTRMELEC Sports Foundation and is conducted according to the current TWA rules.
course_highlights: Adults: 19 floors / 416 steps, length 400 m, elevation +80 m
PHZ (police, firefighters, rescuers): 416 steps / 19 floors, length 400 m, elevation +80 m
Children: 4 floors / 116 steps, length 200 m, elevation +21 m
additional: The children's start is at 11:00, the adults at 11:30. Race results are announced at 13:00. The course surface is 100% paving. Starts are individual at 30-second intervals with electronic timing. Awards are based on age categories for men and women. Stair race, multiple categories, online registration, limited to 300 participants, race for children and adults, various age groups and medals.

name: Národný beh Devín - Bratislava (5.kolo BP SAZ)
description: TIPOS National Run Devín - Bratislava is the oldest sports event in Slovakia with over 100 years of tradition, taking place for the 78th time. Runners will complete an iconic route from the historic Devín Castle to the center of Bratislava, offering a unique atmosphere and a connection between history and sport. The event is suitable for hobby athletes as well as more demanding runners and attracts thousands of participants of various ages each year. The organizer is STaRZ of the city of Bratislava, which provides complete organizational information and registration.
course_highlights: The route goes from Devín Castle to the center of Bratislava
Road race with over 5,000 participants
Historical and iconic running tradition since 1921
additional: Online registration is possible until April 15, 2026, at 20:00. Group registration is available via email hromadne_prihlasky@starz.sk with billing details. A limited edition T-shirt is available for 13 EUR. The start list is available online. The event is organized by STaRZ of the city of Bratislava. The event includes various routes in Devín, registration is available online, and it is part of the Slovak Athletic Federation's running series. Participants can also watch results and statistics on the official websites.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 4. kolo
description: The Bratislava 2-Mile Run is a regular running race over a distance of 2 miles (3.218 km), held at the Kuchajda swimming complex in Bratislava. Organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team, it is open to the general public, including children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. Registration takes place on-site on race day from 9:30 AM, with the start at 10:00 AM. The competition is part of a series where runners earn points towards a traveling trophy based on categories and performances.
course_highlights: Course length of 2 miles (3.218 km) at the Kuchajda swimming complex
Registration and check-in at the volleyball court
Categories for children, juniors, women, men, and veterans
additional: Registration is on-site on race day from 9:30 AM. In case of a tie in points, the better time after applying a coefficient and then shoe size determines the ranking. Participants can earn an extra point for improving their best time of the year. At the end of the year, the two worst months are discarded from the overall results (amnesty). The race takes place on a public road in the Kuchajda area, Bratislava; categories include children, juniors, women, men, and veterans; on-site registration is also available.

name: Beh 2 míle
description: The 2-mile run in Bratislava at Kuchajda is a regular running race over a distance of 2 miles (3.218 km), organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team. Registration and check-in take place directly on-site near the volleyball court from 9:30 AM, with the start at 10:00 AM. The race is open to various age categories including children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. The competition is part of the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team's traveling cup, where finishing times are adjusted according to age coefficients and runners are scored based on participation and performance.
course_highlights: Course length of 2 miles (3.218 km) at Kuchajda swimming area
Registration and start near the volleyball court
Categories for children, juniors, women, men, and veterans
additional: Registration takes place on-site from 9:30 AM at the volleyball court. The competition for the Traveling Cup of the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team awards points based on participation and performance, with an option to exempt the two worst participations of the year. In case of a tie in points, age and the best time of the year determine the winner. The race is held at Kuchajda swimming area, Bratislava, with registration from 9:30 AM and start at 10:00 AM. The competition for the Traveling Cup of the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team involves scoring based on points and times, with categories for various age groups.

name: Sačurovská pätnástka – 20. Memoriál Heleny Slukovej
organizer: Obec Sačurov, OZ Sačurov, ZŠ Sačurov, MŠ Sačurov
description: Sačurovská pätnástka - 20. Memoriál Heleny Slukovej is a traditional running race held in the village of Sačurov in the Vranov nad Topľou district. The race starts in front of the elementary school building in Sačurov and offers categories for various age groups including children, youth, and adults. The main category starts at 13:00, children at 12:00. The organizers are the village of Sačurov, OZ Sačurov, ZŠ and MŠ Sačurov. The race is suitable for local runners and beginner athletes.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the village of Sačurov in front of the elementary school
Categories from preschool age to seniors over 70 years old
Evaluation of the best runners for the Vranov district
additional: Start fee is paid exclusively online. Men over 70 years and women over 60 years do not pay a start fee. Children's race starts at 12:00, main categories at 13:00. The evaluation of the best runners for the Vranov district is part of the event. The race is part of a community support event, with online registration available and various categories for all age groups.

name: Kajňanská desiatka – Memoriál Jána Osloviča
location: Obec Slovenská Kajňa, Slovenská Kajňa, Slovakia
organizer: Obec Slovenská Kajňa, MATORE s.r.o. Humenné, Bežecká akadémia Marcela Matanina
description: Kajňa Ten - Ján Oslovič Memorial is a traditional running race held in the village of Slovenská Kajňa. The race offers three disciplines: a long run of 10 km, a short run of 3.66 km, and a short Nordic walking of 3.66 km, all starting simultaneously at 13:00. The competition is divided into several age categories for men and women, allowing broad participation of runners of different ages and abilities. The organizer is the company MATORE s.r.o., which ensures quality organization and timing.
course_highlights: Long run of 10 km in the pleasant environment of Slovenská Kajňa
Short run and Nordic walking of 3.66 km with the same start
Multiple age categories for men and women
additional: Registration on-site is possible from 9:30 on race day. The participant limit for adults is 130. All disciplines start simultaneously at 13:00. The event includes multiple categories and age groups, registration is possible online and on-site, the start is scheduled for 13:00, and there are also children's races and accompanying activities.

The organizers are the Municipality of Slovenská Kajňa, MATORE s.r.o. Humenné, and Marcel Matanin's Running Academy. The event is part of the POWERGRAF running league Michalovce - Sobrance 2026.
course_highlights: Courses of 10 km, 4 km, and Nordic Walking in Slovenská Kajňa
Start in front of the Municipal Office building
Part of the POWERGRAF running league Michalovce - Sobrance 2026
additional: Children's races start at 12:00. The participant limit is 150. Categories are divided by age and gender, including Nordic Walking. The organizers are the Municipality of Slovenská Kajňa, MATORE s.r.o. Humenné, and Marcel Matanin's Running Academy. Details about registration or entry fees have not yet been published, but it is a significant running event in the region.

name: Oslobodenie Likavka - Beh oslobodenia o Putovný pohár starostu obce Likavka
location: Futbalový štadión Obecného športového klubu v Likavke, Likavka, Ružomberok, Slovakia
description: The Freedom Run for the Mayor's Traveling Cup of Likavka is a traditional running race organized by the Likavka Municipal Office and Likavka Elementary School with Kindergarten. The race takes place at the Likavka Municipal Sports Club Football Stadium and is part of the 2025 Liptov Running League. Competitors include children, pupils, juniors, women, and men in various age categories. The start for youth is at 10:05 AM, and for adults at 11:40 AM according to the regulations. The event is suitable for the general public and offers an opportunity to test one's strength in the beautiful environment of Likavka.
course_highlights: The race takes place at the Likavka Municipal Sports Club Football Stadium
Part of the 2025 Liptov Running League
Categories for children, pupils, juniors, women, and men in various age groups
additional: The start for youth is at 10:05 AM, and for adults at 11:40 AM according to the regulations. Categories include children, pupils, juniors, women, and men in various age groups. The organizer is the Likavka Municipal Office and Likavka Elementary School with Kindergarten. The race is part of the 2025 Liptov Running League. The race takes place at the football stadium, registration is possible online and on-site, and the event includes various categories as part of the regional running series.

name: Čadčianska desiatka
description: The Čadčianska Ten is a traditional running race organized by the Kysucké Marathon Club Čadca, the city of Čadca, and the Social Services Center Čadca Žarec. This 30th edition will take place on April 19, 2026, starting at 10:00 AM at the Žarec Housing Estate in Čadca. Runners can look forward to a well-prepared course and a pleasant atmosphere, making it a popular event among the running community in the region. Registration is available online until April 17, 2026, with the option to register on the race day for an increased entry fee.
course_highlights: Traditional running race with a long-standing history
Start and finish at Žarec Housing Estate in Čadca
Race for the Mayor's Cup of Čadca
additional: Registration is also possible on race day with a higher entry fee of €10. Organizers request participants to register even if uncertain about attendance to speed up the check-in process and minimize errors in name entries. If not attending, the name will not be listed in the results. The race takes place on April 19, 2026, at 10:00 AM, with registration open until April 17, 2026. The start and finish are at Žarec Housing Estate. The event is part of a traditional sports event with a rich history.

name: UCM Night Run
description: UCM Night Run is a charity evening run taking place on April 21, 2026, at 8:00 PM on Trinitarian Square in Trnava. Runners will cover a 5-kilometer route through the historic streets of Trnava's city center, offering a unique atmosphere of the 'Little Rome'. The event is open to everyone regardless of performance and aims to unite the community, promote movement, and support those in need. The proceeds from the run will be used to support rehabilitation and treatment for a child with disabilities. The organizers are the city of Trnava, students of FMK UCM, and the main partner CUKROVAR.
course_highlights: 5 km route through the historic streets of Trnava's city center
Evening atmosphere at Trinitarian Square
Charitable event supporting people with disabilities
additional: Program: 16:00 - 19:15 registration, 19:00 guest performances, 19:30 warm-up and route presentation, 20:00 start. Timing is provided by Terminovka. The event collaborates with the APPkA.app application to support people with disabilities. Registration via terminovka.sk, the event includes a charity collection, discussions about the CUKROVAR project, refreshments, and a chill zone with a DJ.

name: Ultra Kras
location: Národný park Slovenský kras, Turni nad Bodvou, Slovakia
description: The Ultra Kras is a mountain ultramarathon with a length of 57 km and an elevation gain of 2400 meters, taking place in the Slovenský Kras National Park. The start and finish are in Turna nad Bodvou, with a time limit of 12 hours. The race is part of the Slovak Ultratrail League and offers a challenging route with several refreshment and control points. Registration for participants takes place the day before the start and on the race day, with a common start at 7:00 AM.
course_highlights: The route passes through Slovenský Kras National Park
Length of 57 km with an elevation gain of +2400 m
Live control stations at refreshment points
additional: Participant registration is on Friday, April 24, 2026, from 18:00 to 22:00 and on Saturday, April 25, 2026, from 5:00 to 6:30. The time limit to reach the finish is 12 hours from the start, i.e., by 19:00. The control point K3 Hačava (30 km) has a time limit of 7.5 hours from the start (by 14:30). Both the start and finish are at the parking lot next to the Hviezda cinema in Turna nad Bodvou. An electronic timer records arrivals at control points and at the finish. The route is 57 km long, with a 12-hour limit. Registration is open on April 24-25, 2026. There are refreshment stations, mandatory equipment, categories for men and women, and the race is part of the Slovak Ultratrail League.

name: Demänovský Štvanec
location: Demänová rezort, Liptovský Mikuláš, Žilinský kraj, Slovakia
organizer: WinTeam o.z. a Agentúra 8P v spolupráci s Demänová rezort
description: Demänovský Štvanec is a running event designed for both recreational runners and competitive athletes, held in the beautiful nature of Demänovská Valley in Liptovský Mikuláš. The race offers three disciplines: Small Štvanec 5 km, Large Štvanec with TUI 10 km, and children's runs Štvanček. In addition to the sporting experience, participants can enjoy a family atmosphere and supplementary activities at Demänová Resort. The event is part of a weekend full of movement, games, and joy, organized by WinTeam o.z. and Agentúra 8P in cooperation with Demänová Resort.
course_highlights: Courses run through the beautiful nature of Demänovská Valley
Small Štvanec 5 km and Large Štvanec 10 km with time limits of 1:30 and 2:00 hours
Children's runs Štvanček with staggered starts according to age categories
additional: Registration and pickup of start numbers on Friday, 24.04.2026 from 17:00 to 19:00 and on Saturday, 25.04.2026 from 8:00 to 10:00 for children and adults. Timing for adults is provided by VOS-TPK using chips with continuous results publication at www.sportsofttiming.sk. When booking accommodation at Demänová Resort, the start fee is included in the price of the stay. Children's categories start sequentially from 11:00 based on age. The event includes online and on-site registration, categories for different age groups, and family activities and packages with accommodation at Demänová Resort.

name: Prešov Running Series 1. kolo
price_range: 10 eur (detský štart), zľava 2 eurá pre poistencov Dôvery
description: Prešov Running, o.z. warmly invites you to the Prešov Stars Run 2026, which will take place on April 25th in the center of Prešov. This running evening will take you back to the atmosphere of the 90s with music, retro sports fashion, and entertainment. Participants can choose from children's races and courses of 5 and 10 km, accompanied by DJs and a performance by MC Erika. Prešov Stars Run is the first round of the Prešov Running Series 2026, consisting of three separate races in different parts of the city and its surroundings.

name: Beh oslobodenia Chtelnice
description: Freedom Run Chtelnica is a traditional running race with an unchanging route, starting at Námestie 1. mája and leading through the picturesque environment of the Little Carpathians. The course combines asphalt sections with forest paths near the water reservoir Priehrada Chtelnica, a monument to the fallen from World War II, and the Chapel of St. Rócha. Runners can enjoy natural scenery and challenges such as the legendary "staircase" in the forest section. The event is suitable for runners seeking a combination of asphalt and natural terrain in a peaceful mountain environment.
course_highlights: Course passes through beautiful Little Carpathians scenery
Section near water reservoir Priehrada Chtelnica
Forest path with monument to the fallen and Chapel of St. Rócha
additional: Online registration and timing are provided by SunBell s.r.o. - VysledkovyServis.sk. Online registration closes on 24.04.2025 at 23:59; after this date, on-site registration on race day is possible if the participant limit has not been reached. Runners participate at their own risk and must have health insurance. The course is marked with white markings on asphalt and white ribbons in the forest. It is recommended not to use trail shoes due to asphalt sections. Registration is available online or on-site. The event is part of the celebrations of Chtelnica's liberation and is included in the 41st edition of the event.

The event also features 800-meter children's races suitable for younger runners. The event takes place in Radobica in front of the municipal office and is open to various age categories, including local runners. Organizers offer monetary rewards for breaking course records.

additional: The race results will be announced at 17:15. Categories include various age groups of men, women, and youth. The event is organized at participants' own risk. The race is suitable for all age groups, registration is possible on-site, and the event begins in the afternoon with various categories and accompanying activities.
